mandarin_meaning: 選錯靠山 / 投錯人 / 站錯隊
english_meaning: to back the wrong person/horse; to ally with the wrong side
explanation_mandarin: 「貼錯門神」字面是把門神貼錯位置，俗語用法比喻選擇了錯誤的靠山或支持了不會成功的人或勢力，因此得不到幫助或被連累。
explanation_english: Literally 'pasting the wrong door gods.' Figuratively it means choosing the wrong ally or supporting the wrong person/group, resulting in no help or being negatively affected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一開始就貼錯門神，依家冇人幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 zau6 tip3 co3 mun4 san4, ji4 gaa1 mou5 jan4 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一開始就投錯人，現在沒有人幫他。
examples.english_sentence: He backed the wrong person from the start, and now no one helps him.

jyutping: tip3 co3 mun4 san4 — min6 zo2 zo2
mandarin_meaning: 靠錯人；選錯依靠／認錯人
english_meaning: To rely on the wrong person / back the wrong horse — end up being exploited, suffering losses, or having bad luck because of a bad choice of ally/partner.
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，字面是把門神貼錯了，借指依靠或選擇了錯誤的人或勢力，結果被利用、受損或倒楣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression. Literally 'pasted the wrong door god', it figuratively means you relied on or chose the wrong person/ally and as a result were taken advantage of, suffered losses, or had bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢貼錯門神——面左左，成日畀人利用，依家好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tip3 co3 mun4 san4 — min6 zo2 zo2, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 lei6 jung6, ji1 gaa1 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠錯了人，常被人利用，現在很後悔。
examples.english_sentence: He relied on the wrong person, was often used by others, and now regrets it.

mandarin_meaning: 切題 / 与主题相关
english_meaning: on-topic; relevant to the subject; fitting
explanation_mandarin: 表示某言論、例子、內容或回應與主題相關或切合主題，恰當不離題。
explanation_english: Indicates that a comment, example, or content is relevant to and fits the topic — appropriate and not off-topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅例子好貼題，大家都明白多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 lai6zi2 hou2 tip3 tai4, daai6gaa1 dou1 ming4 baak6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讲的例子很切题，大家都更能理解。
examples.english_sentence: The example you gave is very on-topic; everyone understands it better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講稿要貼題，唔好離題太遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 gou2 jiu3 tip3 tai4, m4 hou2 lei4 tai4 taai3 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 讲稿要切题，不要离题太远。
examples.english_sentence: The speech should stay on topic; don't stray too far from the subject.

mandarin_meaning: 遗留；赠予；使遭受（多用于成语中，如“貽笑大方”“貽害後代”）
english_meaning: to leave behind; to bequeath; to cause (often appears in idioms meaning to bring ridicule or harm to future generations)
explanation_mandarin: “貽”作動詞時可表示留下、贈予或使遭受不良後果，常見於成語，如“貽笑大方”（讓人笑話）、“貽害後代”（使後代受害）。
explanation_english: As a verb, 貽 can mean to leave behind, to bequeath, or to cause (usually something undesirable). It commonly appears in idioms such as 貽笑大方 (to expose oneself to ridicule) and 貽害後代 (to harm future generations).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次嗰番講嘢真係貽笑大方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 go2 faan1 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 ji4 siu3 daai6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次那番讲话真是令人尴尬/丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: His remarks this time really made him look ridiculous.

mandarin_meaning: 使受人譏笑；成為笑柄（如「貽笑大方」）
english_meaning: to be ridiculed; to become a laughingstock (as in the idiom '貽笑大方')
explanation_mandarin: 表示使自己或他人遭到別人的嘲笑、成為別人的笑柄，常用於“貽笑大方”。
explanation_english: Indicates causing oneself or others to be laughed at or become a laughingstock; commonly used in the idiom '貽笑大方'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做出嚟畀人貽笑大方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 ceot1 lai4 bei2 jan4 ji4 siu3 daai6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做出讓人笑話的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things that will make you a laughingstock.

mandarin_meaning: 讓行家或專家笑話；自取其辱。
english_meaning: to be ridiculed by experts; to make experts laugh (because one's words or actions are foolish or unprofessional).
explanation_mandarin: 指因言行不當或不專業而被內行人或專家嘲笑，常用來形容某人的做法會讓專業人士看笑話。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to be laughed at by specialists or experts because one's words or actions are silly or unprofessional; used to warn that something will expose one to ridicule from those knowledgeable in the field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你咁樣教學生，會畀老師同專家貽笑大方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gam2 joeng6 gaau3 hok6 saang1, wui5 bei2 lou5 si1 tung4 zyun1 gaa1 ji4 siu3 daai6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你這樣教學生，會讓老師和專家笑話。
examples.english_sentence: If you teach students like that, you'll be laughed at by teachers and experts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰份報告資料錯漏百出，簡直貽笑大方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi1 liu2 co3 lau6 baak3 ceot1, gaan2 zik6 ji4 siu3 daai6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那份報告資料錯漏百出，簡直讓內行人笑話。
examples.english_sentence: His report was full of errors and omissions; it's simply something experts would laugh at.

mandarin_meaning: 貿（mào），主要表示貿易；在合成詞如「貿然」中表示草率、冒然。
english_meaning: The character for trade/commerce (as in 'trade' 貿易); also appears in compounds meaning 'rash' or 'reckless' (as in 贸然).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞/動詞（多用於合成詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「貿」常見於「貿易」表示商業上的交易；在「貿然」等詞中表示輕率、冒然行事。
explanation_english: Used mainly in compounds such as 貿易 (trade) to denote commerce/transactions. In compounds like 貿然 it conveys acting rashly or without due consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港同多個國家有緊密嘅貿易關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 tung4 do1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 jau5 gan2 mat6 ge3 mau6 jik6 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港與多個國家有著密切的貿易關係。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has close trade relations with many countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢貿然決定辭職，事後後悔咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mau6 jin4 kyut3 ding6 ci4 zik1, si6 hau6 hau6 fui3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他貿然決定辭職，事後後悔了。
examples.english_sentence: He rashly decided to resign and later regretted it.

mandarin_meaning: 贸易 (màoyì)
english_meaning: trade; commerce (the buying and selling of goods and services)
explanation_mandarin: 指國家、企業或個人之間買賣貨物或提供服務的行為或經濟活動，包含進出口、貿易協議等範疇。
explanation_english: Refers to the activity or economic practice of buying and selling goods or providing services between countries, companies, or individuals; includes imports/exports and trade agreements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅對外貿易好發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 deoi3 ngoi6 mau6 jik6 hou2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的对外贸易很发达。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's foreign trade is very developed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想擴大同其他國家嘅貿易往來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 kwok3 daai6 tung4 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 mau6 jik6 wong5 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想扩大与其他国家的贸易往来。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to expand trade relations with other countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩國簽咗一份貿易協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gwok3 cim1 zo2 jat1 fan6 mau6 jik6 hip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两国签署了一份贸易协定。
examples.english_sentence: The two countries signed a trade agreement.

mandarin_meaning: 貿易戰 / 贸易战 (màoyì zhàn)
english_meaning: trade war
explanation_mandarin: 指國家之間通過提高關稅、限制進口、實施貿易制裁等手段互相施壓或報復，引發的經濟衝突或對抗。
explanation_english: Refers to conflicts between countries where they impose tariffs, import restrictions, or other trade sanctions on each other as pressure or retaliation, causing economic disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有啲國家爆發貿易戰，對全球經濟造成影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 di1 gwok3 gaa1 baau3 faat3 mau6 jik6 zin3, deoi3 cyun4 kau4 ging1 zai3 zou6 sing4 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有些國家爆發了貿易戰，對全球經濟造成影響。
examples.english_sentence: Recently some countries have launched trade wars, affecting the global economy.

mandarin_meaning: 貿易行（貿易公司）
english_meaning: trading firm; trading company
explanation_mandarin: 指從事進出口或商品買賣、代理及分銷等業務的公司或商號，常用於商業或貿易行業的稱呼。
explanation_english: A company or firm engaged in import/export, buying and selling of goods, agency or distribution — commonly used to refer to businesses in the trade sector.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺一間貿易行做採購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 mau6 jik6 hong4 zou6 coi2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在一家貿易行做採購。
examples.english_sentence: I work as a purchaser at a trading firm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋同嗰間貿易行簽咗份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung4 go2 gaan1 mau6 jik6 hong4 cim1 zo2 fan6 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們和那家貿易行簽了合同。
examples.english_sentence: They signed a contract with that trading firm.

mandarin_meaning: 贸然；鲁莽地（在未充分考虑或评估的情况下行动或决定）
english_meaning: rashly; recklessly; without careful consideration
explanation_mandarin: 表示在沒有經過充分考慮、評估或準備的情況下輕率行動或作決定，帶有可能產生不良後果的含義。
explanation_english: Indicates acting or making decisions without sufficient thought, assessment, or preparation; implies a risk of negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁貿然做決定，最好先諗清楚所有風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mau6 jin4 zou6 kyut3 ding6, zeoi3 hou2 sin1 lam2 cing1 co2 so2 jau5 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這麼貿然做決定，最好先想清楚所有風險。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make such a rash decision; you'd better think through all the risks first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇足夠資料就貿然回覆，可能會出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 zuk1 gau3 zi1 liu2 zau6 mau6 jin4 wui4 fuk1, ho2 nang4 wui5 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果沒有足夠資料就貿然回覆，可能會出錯。
examples.english_sentence: If you reply rashly without enough information, you may make mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 香港貿易發展局（簡稱貿發局）
english_meaning: Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC)
explanation_mandarin: 「貿發局」是香港貿易發展局（Hong Kong Trade Development Council，簡稱HKTDC）的俗稱或簡稱，為推廣香港對外貿易、舉辦貿易展覽及促進商業交流的官方機構。
explanation_english: “貿發局” is the short name for the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC), an official organization that promotes Hong Kong's external trade, organizes trade fairs and promotes business exchanges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司喺貿發局嘅展覽攤位已經登記咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 mau6 faat3 guk6 ge3 zin2 laam5 taan1 wai2 ji5 ging1 dang1 gei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司在貿發局的展覽攤位已經登記了。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has already registered a booth at the HKTDC exhibition.

mandarin_meaning: 贸贸然（鲁莽地、轻率地）
english_meaning: rashly; precipitately; without careful consideration
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事態度輕率、沒有經過深思熟慮就行動，帶有魯莽或倉促的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates acting hastily or without careful thought; doing something rashly or precipitately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你貿貿然答應佢，冇諗清楚會有咩後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mau6 mau6 jin4 daap3 jing3 keoi5, mou5 lam2 cing1 co2 wui5 jau5 me1 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你贸贸然答应他，没有想清楚会有什么后果。
examples.english_sentence: You agreed to him rashly without thinking through the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢貿貿然辭職，最後發覺未準備好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mau6 mau6 jin4 ci4 zik1, zeoi3 hau6 faat3 gok3 mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他贸贸然辞职，最后发现还没准备好。
examples.english_sentence: He resigned rashly and later realized he wasn't ready.

mandarin_meaning: 贺 (hè) — 祝贺
english_meaning: to congratulate; to celebrate; congratulations
explanation_mandarin: 表示向某人表达祝贺或庆祝的行为，例如祝贺婚礼、生日或取得成就。常见于“祝贺”、“恭贺”等词语中。
explanation_english: Used to express congratulating someone or celebrating an occasion, e.g. weddings, birthdays, or achievements. Commonly appears in compounds like "祝贺" and "恭贺".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去賀阿明結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 ho6 aa3 ming4 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去祝贺阿明结婚。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to congratulate Ah Ming on his wedding tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年大家互相賀歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 ho6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历新年大家互相贺岁。
examples.english_sentence: During Lunar New Year everyone exchanges New Year greetings.

mandarin_meaning: 賀卡 / 祝賀卡
english_meaning: greeting card; congratulatory card
explanation_mandarin: 用於表達祝賀或祝福的印刷或手寫卡片，常在生日、節日或喜慶場合送給對方。
explanation_english: A card, printed or handwritten, used to express congratulations or well wishes; commonly given on birthdays, holidays, or celebratory occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一張生日賀卡畀阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zoeng1 saang1 jat6 ho6 kaa1 bei2 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一張生日賀卡給媽媽。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a birthday card for my mom.

mandarin_meaning: 賀卡
english_meaning: greeting card
explanation_mandarin: 用來表達祝賀或祝福的卡片，例如生日賀卡、賀年卡或結婚賀卡。
explanation_english: A card used to convey congratulations or good wishes, such as a birthday card, New Year card, or wedding card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張賀咭畀媽媽慶祝佢生日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 ho6 kaat1 bei2 maa1 maa1 hing3 zuk1 keoi5 sang1 jat6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一張賀卡給媽媽慶祝她的生日。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a greeting card for my mother to celebrate her birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住寫張賀咭俾佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 se2 zoeng1 ho6 kaat1 bei2 keoi5 aa3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記得要寫張賀卡給他喔。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to write him a greeting card.

mandarin_meaning: 贺喜（向人表示祝贺）
english_meaning: to congratulate; congratulations
explanation_mandarin: 用於表示向某人表示祝賀（如結婚、升職、開張等）；可作動詞使用（去賀喜佢），亦可作呼喊的祝賀語（賀喜！）。
explanation_english: Used to express congratulations to someone (e.g., on marriage, promotion, shop opening); can function as a verb (to congratulate someone) or as an exclamatory congratulation ('Congratulations!').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去賀喜阿明，佢啱啱結咗婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 ho6 hei2 aa3 ming4, keoi5 aam1 aam1 git3 zo2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去賀喜阿明，他剛剛結婚。
examples.english_sentence: We're going tonight to congratulate Ah Ming; he just got married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家一齊去賀喜佢新店開張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 ho6 hei2 keoi5 san1 dim3 hoi1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一起去恭賀他新店開張。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone is going together to congratulate him on his new shop opening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到新人出場，大家齊聲講：「賀喜！」
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 san1 jan4 ceot1 coeng4, daai6 gaa1 cai4 seng1 gong2: "ho6 hei2!"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到新人出場，大家齊聲說：「賀喜！」
examples.english_sentence: When the newlyweds appeared, everyone called out, "Congratulations!"

mandarin_meaning: 贺寿
english_meaning: to congratulate someone on their birthday; to celebrate (an elder's) longevity/birthday
explanation_mandarin: 指向壽星表示祝賀長壽或祝賀生日，常用於為年長者慶祝生日或祝壽場合。
explanation_english: To offer congratulations for someone's birthday (especially an elder) or to celebrate their longevity; commonly used for birthday/anniversary celebrations for older people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋去賀壽，幫阿爺慶祝八十大壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ho6 sau3, bong1 aa3 je4 hing3 zuk1 baat3 sap6 daai6 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们去贺寿，帮爷爷庆祝八十大寿。
examples.english_sentence: Today we're going to congratulate grandpa on his birthday and help him celebrate his eightieth birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫佢寫賀壽卡，送畀佢表達祝福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 keoi5 se2 ho6 sau3 kaa1, sung3 bei2 keoi5 biu2 daat6 zuk1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮他写贺寿卡，送给他表达祝福。
examples.english_sentence: I helped write a congratulatory birthday card to give to him to express our best wishes.

mandarin_meaning: 贺年（向亲友祝贺新年、拜年）
english_meaning: to celebrate the (Lunar) New Year; to offer New Year greetings
explanation_mandarin: 指在農曆新年期間向親友道賀、拜年或互相送上祝福、賀卡等的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of celebrating the (Lunar) New Year — offering New Year greetings, visiting relatives, or exchanging well-wishes and New Year cards during the festival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年快到，我哋記得要去親戚屋企賀年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 faai3 dou3, ngo5 dei6 gei3 dak1 jiu3 heoi3 can1 cik1 uk1 kei2 ho6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆新年快到了，我們記得要去親戚家賀年。
examples.english_sentence: Lunar New Year is coming soon; we should remember to visit relatives to celebrate the New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，我哋通常會畀利是同賀年咭畀長輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 bei2 lei6 si6 tung4 ho6 nin4 kaat1 bei2 zoeng2 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過年的時候，我們通常會給長輩紅包和賀年卡。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we usually give elders red envelopes and New Year cards.

mandarin_meaning: 賀年卡 / 贺年卡 (hè nián kǎ)
english_meaning: New Year's card (greeting card for the Lunar New Year)
explanation_mandarin: 指在農曆新年期間用來向親友送上祝福的卡片，通常會寫上吉祥話或印上賀年圖案。
explanation_english: A greeting card exchanged during the Lunar New Year to convey good wishes; usually contains auspicious phrases or New Year-themed images.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗幾張賀年咭，會寄俾屋企人同朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gei2 zoeng1 ho6 nin4 kaat1, wui5 gei3 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4 tung4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了幾張賀年卡，會寄給家人和朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a few New Year's cards and will send them to family and friends.

mandarin_meaning: 贺岁（庆祝新年、互道新年祝福；亦用于指与春节相关的事物，如“贺岁片”）
english_meaning: to celebrate the New Year; New Year greetings; relating to Lunar New Year (e.g., 'New Year films')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「賀歲」通常指在農曆新年期間互相祝賀新年、慶祝新歲；也常用作複合詞，如「賀歲片」指在春節檔上映的電影。
explanation_english: Refers to offering New Year greetings or celebrating the Lunar New Year; also used in compounds (e.g., 'New Year film' for movies released for the Lunar New Year season).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年大家會互相賀歲，祝大家身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 daai6 gaa1 wui5 wu6 soeng1 ho6 seoi3, zuk1 daai6 gaa1 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年大家會互相賀歲，祝大家身體健康。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year people exchange New Year greetings, wishing everyone good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年都有好多賀歲片喺農曆新年前上映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 ho6 seoi3 pin3 hai2 nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 cin4 soeng5 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年都有很多贺岁片在农历新年前上映。
examples.english_sentence: Every year many New Year films are released before the Lunar New Year.

mandarin_meaning: 春节/農曆新年期間舉行的足球或表演賽（常為表演賽、慈善賽或明星友誼賽）
english_meaning: a football match held during the Lunar New Year period, often an exhibition, charity, or celebrity friendly
explanation_mandarin: 「賀歲波」是廣東話俗稱，指在農曆新年期間舉辦的足球比賽，通常重在慶祝和娛樂，可能邀請球星或娛樂圈名人參與，形式可為表演賽或慈善賽。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for football matches held around Lunar New Year. These matches are usually festive and entertaining in nature and often take the form of exhibition games, charity matches, or celebrity friendlies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年賀歲波好熱鬧，唔少明星都落場踢波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ho6 seoi3 bo1 hou2 jit6 naau6, m4 siu2 ming4 sing1 dou1 lok6 coeng4 tek3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的賀歲波很熱鬧，很多明星都下場踢球。
examples.english_sentence: This year's Lunar New Year match was lively; many celebrities took part in the game.

mandarin_meaning: 賀歲片（賀年電影）
english_meaning: New Year film; a film released for the Lunar New Year period
explanation_mandarin: 指在農曆新年期間上映、以喜慶、家庭或喜劇元素為主的商業電影，通常製作輕鬆、娛樂性高，目的是吸引家庭觀眾並取得票房效益。
explanation_english: Refers to commercial films released around the Lunar New Year, typically featuring festive, family-oriented or comedic themes. They are usually light-hearted and designed to attract broad audiences and box-office revenue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年檔期有好多賀歲片上映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 dong2 kei4 jau5 hou2 do1 ho6 seoi3 pin3 soeng5 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆新年檔期有很多賀歲片上映。
examples.english_sentence: Many New Year films are released during the Lunar New Year period.

mandarin_meaning: 賀歲杯 / 新年杯
english_meaning: New Year Cup (a sporting cup/tournament held during the Lunar New Year)
explanation_mandarin: 指在農曆新年期間舉辦的比賽或頒發的獎杯名稱，常用於足球、乒乓等體育友誼賽或錦標賽。
explanation_english: Refers to a cup or tournament held around the Lunar New Year period; commonly used for sporting events (e.g., football, table tennis) or friendly competitions awarded as the New Year Cup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年賀歲盃嘅足球賽下星期開賽，球隊都好期待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ho6 seoi3 bui1 ge3 zuk1 kau4 coi3 haa6 sing1 kei4 hoi1 coi3, kau4 deoi2 dou1 hou2 kei4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的賀歲杯足球賽下星期開打，球隊都很期待。
examples.english_sentence: This year's New Year Cup soccer tournament starts next week; the teams are really looking forward to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上年我哋隊贏咗賀歲盃，大家都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 nin4 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 jing4 zo2 ho6 seoi3 bui1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年我們隊贏得了賀歲杯，大家都很高興。
examples.english_sentence: Last year our team won the New Year Cup; everyone was very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 賀禮 / 賀赠的礼物（hè lǐ）
english_meaning: congratulatory gift; a gift given to express congratulations
explanation_mandarin: 指用來向別人表示祝賀的禮物，常見於婚禮、滿月、升職、開業等喜慶場合。
explanation_english: A gift presented to congratulate someone, typically given at celebratory occasions such as weddings, baby events, promotions, or openings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋帶咗一份賀禮去參加婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daai3 zo2 jat1 fan6 ho6 lai5 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們帶了一份賀禮去參加婚禮。
examples.english_sentence: We brought a congratulatory gift to the wedding.

mandarin_meaning: 贺辞（祝贺的话或致辞）
english_meaning: congratulatory words; congratulatory message; congratulatory address
explanation_mandarin: 指用來表示祝賀的話語或在慶祝場合中發表的致辭，常見於婚禮、開業、春節等場合。
explanation_english: Words or a short address expressing congratulations, typically delivered or written for celebrations such as weddings, openings, or New Year greetings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺婚禮上講咗一段感人的賀辭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fan1 lai5 seong6 gong2 zo2 jat1 dyun6 gam2 jan4 dik1 ho6 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在婚礼上说了一段感人的贺辞。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a touching congratulatory speech at the wedding.

mandarin_meaning: 贺电（表示祝贺的电报或祝贺信息）
english_meaning: congratulatory message (originally a telegram; can be card, message, or notice expressing congratulations)
explanation_mandarin: 指為表示祝賀而發出的電報、函件或書面/電子訊息，常見於婚禮、升遷、開幕等慶祝場合。
explanation_english: A message sent to express congratulations—traditionally a telegram but also cards, letters, or electronic messages—commonly used for weddings, promotions, openings, and other celebratory occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司收到咗好多賀電，氣氛好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sau1 dou3 zo2 hou2 do1 ho6 din6, hei3 fan1 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司收到了很多贺电，气氛很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The company received many congratulatory messages; the atmosphere was lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋收到咗好多親友嘅賀電同賀卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau1 dou3 zo2 hou2 do1 can1 jau5 ge3 ho6 din6 tung4 ho6 kaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们收到了很多亲友的贺电和贺卡。
examples.english_sentence: They received many congratulatory messages and cards from relatives and friends.

mandarin_meaning: 賁（贲，bēn）：古漢語詞，表示華美、旺盛或到來，常見於書面語或成語中（如「賁臨」）。
english_meaning: An archaic/formal word meaning 'to arrive; to honor with one's presence; to be splendid or flourishing', used mainly in literary/formal contexts (e.g., '敬請賁臨' = please honor us with your presence).
explanation_mandarin: 「賁」為書面或文言用字，可表達到來、光臨之意，或形容華美、旺盛。現多見於固定用法如「敬請賁臨」。
explanation_english: A literary/archaic character used to indicate arrival or to denote splendor/flourishing. Commonly appears in set phrases such as '敬請賁臨' (please honor us with your presence).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬請賁臨本店，光臨指教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 cing2 ban1 lam4 bun2 dim3, gwong1 lam4 zi2 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敬請賁臨本店，光臨指教。
examples.english_sentence: We respectfully invite you to visit our shop; please honor us with your presence and offer guidance.

mandarin_meaning: 賄賂（huìlù）：以金錢或其他利益行賄或受賄
english_meaning: bribe; to bribe; bribery
explanation_mandarin: 表示用金錢或其他利益賄絡、行賄或收受賄賂的行為或名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to giving or receiving money or other benefits to influence someone's actions; can be used as a noun (bribe) or a verb (to bribe).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賂咗個官員，而家畀人查緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou6 zo2 go3 gun1 jyun4, ji4 gaa1 bei2 jan4 caa4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他賄賂了官員，現在被人調查。
examples.english_sentence: He bribed an official; now he's being investigated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收賂係違法嘅行為，唔好做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 lou6 hai6 wai4 faat3 ge3 hang4 wai4, m4 hou2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收受賄賂是違法的行為，不要這樣做。
examples.english_sentence: Accepting bribes is illegal; don't do that.

mandarin_meaning: 租賃 / 租赁 (lìn)，租用
english_meaning: rent; lease; hire
explanation_mandarin: 「賃」表示以付出租金的方式租用或出讓使用權，常見於「租賃」、「租賃合約」等語境，既可作名詞亦可作動詞。
explanation_english: “賃” refers to renting or leasing (the act or the arrangement), commonly seen in compounds like “租賃” (lease). It can function as a noun (the rent/lease) or a verb (to lease).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司同對方簽咗租賃合約，期係兩年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tung4 deoi3 fong1 cim1 zo2 zou1 jam6 hap6 joek3, kei4 hai6 loeng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司與對方簽了租賃合同，期限是兩年。
examples.english_sentence: The company signed a lease with the other party for a two-year term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個單位係按月租賃，租金要每個月交一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan1 wai6 hai6 on3 jyut6 zou1 jam6, zou1 gam1 jiu3 mui5 go3 jyut6 gaau1 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個單位是按月租賃，租金要每個月交一次。
examples.english_sentence: This unit is leased monthly; rent must be paid every month.

mandarin_meaning: 賄（贿），指以金錢或其他利益收買或行賄
english_meaning: bribe; to bribe; bribery
explanation_mandarin: 表示用金錢或其他利益收買、賂送他人以取得不正當利益，常見於法律、政治語境，常與「賄賂」一詞連用。
explanation_english: Refers to giving or receiving money or other benefits to influence someone or obtain improper advantages. Commonly used in legal and political contexts; often appears in compounds such as '賄賂'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗賄賂畀個官員，而家俾人查緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 wui6 lou6 bei2 go3 gun1 jyun4, ji4 gaa1 bei2 jan4 caa4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他給官員賄賂，現在正在被調查。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a bribe to the official and is now under investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司因為賄賂而畀罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 wui6 lou6 ji5 bei2 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家公司因為賄賂而被罰款。
examples.english_sentence: This company was fined for bribery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行賄同收賄都係非法嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 wui6 tung4 sau1 wui6 dou1 hai6 fei1 faat3 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行賄和收賄都是非法的行為。
examples.english_sentence: Both offering and accepting bribes are illegal acts.

mandarin_meaning: 賄款（huìkuǎn）：指行賄或受賄的金錢款項
english_meaning: bribe money; funds used for bribery or kickbacks
explanation_mandarin: 指用來行賄或收受賄賂的款項，常用於法律、反貪調查等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to money used to bribe or money received as a bribe; commonly used in legal or anti-corruption contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人揭發收賄款，依家要面對刑事調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 sau1 wui6 fun2, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 min6 deoi3 jing4 si6 tiu4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人揭發收受賄款，現在要面臨刑事調查。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for accepting bribe money and now faces a criminal investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 贿赂（huì lù）：以金錢或其他利益給予或接受以獲取不當利益
english_meaning: bribe; to bribe — giving or receiving money or favors to obtain improper advantages
explanation_mandarin: 指以金錢、禮品或其他利益向他人提供或接受，以換取不正當利益或影響決策的行為。
explanation_english: The act of offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting money or other valuables to influence the actions of an official or other person in a position of trust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為收受賄賂被定罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sau1 sau6 wui6 lou6 bei6 ding6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因收受贿赂被定罪。
examples.english_sentence: He was convicted for accepting bribes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司透過行賄攞咗個合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 tau3 gwo3 hang4 wui6 lo2 zo2 go3 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司透过行贿拿到了合同。
examples.english_sentence: The company obtained the contract by bribing.

mandarin_meaning: 賄選 (huìxuǎn)，在選舉中以金錢或其他利益買票或收買選票的行為
english_meaning: vote-buying; electoral bribery — the act of buying votes or bribing voters during an election
explanation_mandarin: 指在選舉過程中，用金錢、物品或其他利益收買選民以獲取選票的不法行為。
explanation_english: Refers to the illegal practice during elections of offering money, goods, or other benefits to voters in order to obtain their votes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方調查發現有人喺選舉期間賄選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 diu6 caa4 faat3 jin6 jau5 jan4 hai2 syun2 geoi2 kei4 gaan1 wui6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方調查發現有人在選舉期間賄選。
examples.english_sentence: A police investigation found that someone was engaging in vote-buying during the election period.

mandarin_meaning: 涵蓋；包括；概括
english_meaning: to cover; to include; comprehensive
explanation_mandarin: 表示包含或概括多方面的內容，常用於書面或正式語境，如「賅括」、「賅全」等。
explanation_english: Indicates inclusion or comprehensive coverage of various aspects; chiefly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., in compounds like 賅括).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告賅括咗所有相關嘅數據同分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 goi1 kut3 zo2 so2 jau5 soeng1 gwaan1 ge3 sou3 geoi3 tung4 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告涵蓋了所有相關的數據和分析。
examples.english_sentence: This report covers all the relevant data and analyses.

mandarin_meaning: 資；資源；資本；資料（拼音：zī），表示財力、材料或提供的意思
english_meaning: resources; capital; funds; data; to provide (in compound words)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；（在複合詞中可作前綴或動詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「資」常用於構成詞語，如「資源」「資金」「資料」「資本」，表示財力、物力、資訊或提供、供應的概念。
explanation_english: The character 資 is commonly used in compounds (e.g., 資源, 資金, 資料, 資本) to denote resources, capital, information, or the act of providing/supplying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有足夠嘅資本去開公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 zi1 bun2 heoi3 hoi1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有足夠的資本去開公司。
examples.english_sentence: He has enough capital to start a company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校提供咗好多學習資源俾學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 tai4 gung1 zo2 hou2 do1 hok6 zaap6 zi1 jyun4 bei2 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校提供了很多學習資源給學生。
examples.english_sentence: The school provided many learning resources to students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我未搵到相關嘅資料，仲要再搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mei6 wan2 dou2 soeng1 gwaan1 ge3 zi1 liu2, zung6 jiu3 zoi3 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還沒找到相關的資料，還要再找。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't found the relevant information yet; I need to look further.

mandarin_meaning: 资不抵债（zī bù dǐ zhài）：資產不足以償還債務，陷入無力還債或破產的狀況。
english_meaning: Insolvent; assets are insufficient to cover debts — unable to repay creditors.
explanation_mandarin: 表示資產不足以償還債務，常用來形容企業或個人已處於破產或無力還債的狀況。
explanation_english: Indicates that assets are insufficient to repay debts; commonly used to describe a company or person that is insolvent or unable to meet liabilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司早就資不抵債，員工都未收到遣散費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou2 zau6 zi1 bat1 dai2 zaai3, jyun4 gung1 dou1 mei6 sau1 dou3 hin2 saan3 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家公司早就資不抵債，員工都還沒收到遣散費。
examples.english_sentence: This company has long been insolvent; the employees still haven't received their severance pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司資不抵債，法院可能會宣佈破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 zi1 bat1 dai2 zaai3, faat3 jyun6 ho2 nang4 wui5 syun1 bou3 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司資不抵債，法院可能會宣告破產。
examples.english_sentence: If the company is insolvent, the court may declare it bankrupt.

mandarin_meaning: 資優（指資優生／有特殊才能）
english_meaning: gifted; talented (often referring to a gifted student)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（視上下文）
explanation_mandarin: 「資優」用來形容在學術或能力方面特別優秀或有特殊才能的人，常用於「資優生」或「資優班」等教育語境。
explanation_english: “資優” describes someone who is especially talented or academically outstanding. It is commonly used in educational contexts (e.g., gifted student, gifted program).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係資優生，成日參加數學比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zi1 jau1 saang1, sing4 jat6 caam1 gaa1 sou3 hok6 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是資優生，經常參加數學比賽。
examples.english_sentence: He's a gifted student and often participates in math competitions.

mandarin_meaning: 資優生（zī yōu shēng）：在學業或某方面表現特別優秀的學生
english_meaning: gifted student; honors student; an academically or otherwise especially talented student
explanation_mandarin: 指在學業或某些領域（如音樂、數學等）表現特別優秀、能力突出的學生，常會被安排到資優班或接受額外培訓。
explanation_english: Refers to a student who is especially high-achieving or talented academically or in specific areas (e.g., music, math); such students are often placed in gifted programs or given additional instruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係班入面嘅資優生，成日考試攞滿分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 baan1 jap6 min6 ge3 zi1 jau1 saang1, sing4 jat6 haau2 si3 lo2 mun5 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是班上的資優生，常常考試拿滿分。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the class's gifted student and often gets full marks on tests.

mandarin_meaning: 资助 (zīzhù)：提供金钱或物资上的帮助
english_meaning: to subsidize; to provide financial or material assistance
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府、機構或個人提供金錢或物資上的支持或補助，幫助受助者完成特定活動或減輕負擔。
explanation_english: To provide financial or material support from governments, organizations, or individuals to help someone complete activities or reduce their burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會資助低收入家庭嘅小朋友上學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 zi1 zo6 dai1 sau1 jap6 gaa1 ting4 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5 soeng5 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會資助低收入家庭的孩子上學。
examples.english_sentence: The government will subsidize children from low-income families to attend school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司資助員工參加專業培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zi1 zo6 jyun4 gung1 caam1 gaa1 zyun1 jip6 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司資助員工參加專業培訓。
examples.english_sentence: The company subsidized employees to attend professional training.

mandarin_meaning: 资料 (zīliào) — 信息、数据或材料
english_meaning: data; information; materials
explanation_mandarin: 指用於參考、分析或處理的資訊、數據或相關材料，可指紙本、電子或口頭的內容。
explanation_english: Refers to information, data, or materials used for reference, analysis, or processing; can be in paper, electronic, or verbal form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要更多資料先可以完成報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 zi1 liu6 sin1 ho2 ji5 jyun4 sing4 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要更多资料才能完成报告。
examples.english_sentence: I need more information to finish the report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲資料係咪可信？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zi1 liu6 hai6 mai6 ho2 seon3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些资料可靠吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is this information reliable?

mandarin_meaning: 數據庫 / 資料庫（電腦系統中用來儲存與管理資料的集合）
english_meaning: database (a system or collection for storing and managing data)
explanation_mandarin: 用來儲存、管理和檢索資料的系統或集合，通常指電腦或網絡上的結構化資料存放處。
explanation_english: A system or organized collection used to store, manage, and retrieve data, typically referring to a computerized or online storage structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅資料庫有超過一萬條記錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 zi1 liu6 fu3 jau5 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 maan6 tiu4 gei3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們的數據庫有超過一萬條記錄。
examples.english_sentence: Our database has over ten thousand records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺公司嘅資料庫入面搵返嗰份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 liu6 fu3 jap6 min6 wan2 faan1 go2 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在公司的資料庫裡找到那份報告。
examples.english_sentence: You can find that report in the company's database.

mandarin_meaning: 資本（資金、資產，用於生產或投資）
english_meaning: capital (funds, assets, or resources used for production or investment)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於生產、投資或經營的資金或資源；在經濟學中亦可指資本主義等相關概念。
explanation_english: Refers to money, assets, or resources used for production, investment, or operation; in economics it also relates to concepts like capitalism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業需要足夠嘅資本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 seoi1 jiu3 zuk1 gau3 ge3 zi1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 創業需要足夠的資本。
examples.english_sentence: Starting a business requires sufficient capital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅資本主要來自股東同投資者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 bun2 zyu2 jiu3 loi4 zi6 gu2 dung1 tung4 tau4 zi1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司的資本主要來自股東和投資者。
examples.english_sentence: The company's capital mainly comes from shareholders and investors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 資本主義喺社會科學中討論經濟制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 bun2 zyu2 ji6 hai6 se5 wui6 fo1 hok6 zung1 tou2 leon6 ging1 zai3 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 資本主義在社會科學中討論經濟制度。
examples.english_sentence: Capitalism is discussed in the social sciences when analyzing economic systems.

mandarin_meaning: 资本主义
english_meaning: capitalism
explanation_mandarin: 一種以私有制和市場經濟為基礎，強調利潤動機與資本積累的經濟與社會制度。
explanation_english: An economic and social system based on private ownership and market exchange, characterized by profit motive and the accumulation of capital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺資本主義社會，財富分配唔平均係常見嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zi1 bun2 zyu2 ji6 se5 wui6, coi4 fu3 fan1 pui3 m4 ping4 gwan1 hai6 soeng4 gin3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在资本主义社会，财富分配不均是常见的问题。
examples.english_sentence: In capitalist societies, unequal distribution of wealth is a common problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係資本主義社會嘅常態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 zi1 bun2 zyu2 ji6 se5 wui6 ge3 soeng4 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這是資本主義社會的常態。
examples.english_sentence: This is the norm in capitalist societies.

mandarin_meaning: 资本家
english_meaning: capitalist (owner of capital)
explanation_mandarin: 指擁有資本並以資本投資或經營企業以獲取利潤的人。在政治經濟語境中常被討論，根據語境可為中性或帶有批評意味。
explanation_english: A person who owns capital and invests or runs businesses to earn profit. In political and economic contexts it can be used neutrally or with a critical connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個資本家，經常投資唔同嘅行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 zi1 bun2 gaa1, ging1 soeng4 tau4 zi1 m4 tung4 ge3 hong4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位资本家，经常投资不同的行业。
examples.english_sentence: He is a capitalist who often invests in various industries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話資本家會剝削工人，仲會壓低人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 zi1 bun2 gaa1 wui5 bok3 se3 gung1 jan4, zung6 wui5 aat3 dai1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人說资本家會剝削工人，還會壓低工資。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say capitalists exploit workers and may push down wages.

mandarin_meaning: 資格 / 资格 (zīgé)
english_meaning: qualification; eligibility; credentials
explanation_mandarin: 表示具備從事某事、享有某權利或取得某種地位所需的條件或資歷，通常用作名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to the conditions, credentials, or eligibility required to do something or to hold a certain status; used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇資格參加比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zi1 gaak3 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒有資格參加比賽。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have the qualification to join the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請大學需要符合入學資格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 daai6 hok6 seoi1 jiu3 fu4 hap6 jap6 hok6 zi1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申請大學需要符合入學資格。
examples.english_sentence: Applying to university requires meeting the admission qualifications.

mandarin_meaning: 資歷（指一個人的工作或學習經歷、年資或資格）
english_meaning: Qualifications; work experience; years of service; professional background
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人過往在工作或學習方面的經驗、年資或資格，常用於評估聘用、升職或職務適合性。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's past work or educational experience, years of service, or qualifications; commonly used when assessing hiring, promotion, or suitability for a role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有豐富嘅教學資歷，適合教高年級學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 gaau3 hok6 zi1 lik6, sik1 hap6 gaau3 gou1 nin4 kap1 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有豐富的教學資歷，適合教高年級學生。
examples.english_sentence: He has extensive teaching qualifications and is suitable to teach senior-grade students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試時，公司會問應徵者嘅工作資歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 si4, gung1 si1 wui5 man6 jing3 zing1 ze2 ge3 gung1 zok3 zi1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試時，公司會詢問應徵者的工作資歷。
examples.english_sentence: During interviews, the company will ask applicants about their work experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好多年嘅工作資歷，所以好快升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 nin4 ge3 gung1 zok3 zi1 lik6, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有多年的工作資歷，所以很快就升職了。
examples.english_sentence: He has many years of work experience, so he was promoted quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 資深 (zīshēn)，資歷深、經驗豐富
english_meaning: senior; long-serving; experienced
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某個領域或機構中具有較長的資歷或豐富的經驗，通常指地位或資歷較高的人。
explanation_english: Indicates having long tenure or considerable experience in a field or organization; typically describes someone with higher status or seniority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司裡面最資深嘅工程師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1si1 leoi5 min6 zeoi3 zi1 sam1 ge3 gung1 cing4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司裡資歷最深的工程師。
examples.english_sentence: He is the most senior engineer in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要請一位資深市場經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jiu3 cing2 jat1 wai2 zi1 sam1 si5 coeng4 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要請一位資深市場經理。
examples.english_sentence: The company is looking to hire a senior marketing manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個行業好資深，大家都尊重佢嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 hou2 zi1 sam1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zyun1 zung6 keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這個行業很資深，大家都尊重他的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He is very senior in this industry; everyone respects his opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 资深大律师（资深辩护律师或资深律师）
english_meaning: senior barrister; senior counsel; a very experienced barrister
explanation_mandarin: 指具備多年執業經驗、在法庭擔任辯護或出庭代理的資歷較深的大律師。在香港情況下，資深大律師可指正式獲委任為「資深大律師」（Senior Counsel，簡稱 SC），或泛指經驗豐富的資深辯護律師。
explanation_english: Refers to a barrister with many years of practice and substantial courtroom experience. In Hong Kong, it can mean a barrister formally appointed as Senior Counsel (SC) or, more loosely, any very experienced barrister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位資深大律師，已經喺業界做咗廿幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai6 zi1 sam1 daai6 leot6 si1, ji5 ging1 hai2 jip6 gaai3 zou6 zo2 jaa6 gei2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位资深大律师，已经在业界工作了二十多年。
examples.english_sentence: He is a senior barrister who has been working in the profession for over twenty years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近獲委任為資深大律師（Senior Counsel）。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 wok6 wai2 jam6 wai4 zi1 sam1 daai6 leot6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近被委任为资深大律师（Senior Counsel）。
examples.english_sentence: He was recently appointed Senior Counsel.

mandarin_meaning: 資源（zīyuán）
english_meaning: resources
explanation_mandarin: 指自然界或人為的可利用物或條件，用來滿足需要或進行生產活動，例如水、石油、人力、財力等。
explanation_english: Refers to natural or man-made assets or conditions that can be used to meet needs or support production and activities, e.g., water, oil, manpower, financial resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司要好好管理資源，先可以節省成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 gun2 lei5 zi1 jyun4, sin1 ho2 ji5 zit3 sing2 caan4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司要好好管理資源，才能節省成本。
examples.english_sentence: Our company must manage resources well in order to reduce costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區自然資源唔多，主要靠旅遊業發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 zi6 jin4 zi1 jyun4 m4 do1, zyu2 jiu3 kaau3 leoi5 jau4 jip6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個地區自然資源不多，主要靠旅遊業發展。
examples.english_sentence: This region doesn't have many natural resources and mainly depends on tourism for development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開源節流係提升企業競爭力嘅重要策略，開源指增加資源或收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 jyun4 zit3 lau4 hai6 tai1 sing1 kei5 jip6 ging6 zang1 lik6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 caak3 loek6, hoi1 jyun4 zi2 zang1 gaa1 zi1 jyun4 waak6 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開源節流是提升企業競爭力的重要策略，開源指增加資源或收入。
examples.english_sentence: Increasing income and reducing expenditure is an important strategy to boost a company's competitiveness; 'increasing income' refers to adding resources or revenue.

mandarin_meaning: 资产 (zīchǎn)
english_meaning: assets; property; holdings
explanation_mandarin: 指個人、公司或機構擁有的財產或可變現的資源，包括現金、房地產、設備、投資，以及無形資產如專利、商譽等。
explanation_english: Refers to property or resources owned by an individual, company, or organization that have economic value, including cash, real estate, equipment, investments, and intangible assets like patents and goodwill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅資產有現金同房地產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 caan2 jau5 jin6 gam1 tung4 fong4 dei6 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的资产有现金和房地产业。
examples.english_sentence: The company's assets include cash and real estate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要清點所有嘅資產先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 cing1 dim2 so2 jau5 ge3 zi1 caan2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要先清点所有的资产。
examples.english_sentence: They need to inventory all the assets first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲知識都係公司嘅無形資產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zi1 sik1 dou1 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 mou4 jing4 zi1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些知识都是公司的无形资产。
examples.english_sentence: This knowledge is part of the company's intangible assets.

mandarin_meaning: 资讯 / 信息（zīxùn / xìnxī）
english_meaning: information; data; news
explanation_mandarin: 指資料、消息或數據，常用於科技、媒體或商業領域，表示有用或可傳遞的資訊內容。
explanation_english: Refers to data, news, or material; commonly used in technology, media, or business contexts to denote useful or transferable content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以畀多啲資訊我嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bei2 do1 di1 zi1 seon3 ngo5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以给我更多信息吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me more information?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網站上有最新嘅產品資訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 zaam6 soeng6 jau5 zeoi3 san1 ge3 caan2 ban2 zi1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网站上有最新的产品信息。
examples.english_sentence: The website has the latest product information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用手機App嚟睇即時資訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jung6 sau2 gei1 App lai4 tai2 zik1 si4 zi1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用手机应用来看即时信息。
examples.english_sentence: I like using mobile apps to check real-time information.

mandarin_meaning: 信息密度
english_meaning: information density
explanation_mandarin: 表示在特定文本、媒介或溝通情境中，每單位（如每段文字、每時間或每頁）所包含的信息量，常用來描述文章、報告或介面的內容豐富程度與壓縮程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount of information contained per unit (e.g., per unit of text, time, or space) in a given medium or communication context; used to describe how densely packed an article, interface, or message is with information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章嘅資訊密度好高，一次過吸收好多重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 zi1 seon3 mat6 dou6 hou2 gou1, jat1 ci3 gwo3 kap1 sau1 hou2 do1 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇文章的信息密度很高，一下子就能吸收很多要點。
examples.english_sentence: This article has a high information density; you can absorb many key points at once.

mandarin_meaning: 資訊科技 (信息技术, zīxùn kējì)
english_meaning: Information Technology (IT)
explanation_mandarin: 指與資訊的獲取、處理、儲存和傳輸相關的技術與應用，包括電腦、網絡、軟體與系統等。
explanation_english: Refers to technologies and applications related to the acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission of information, including computers, networks, software, and systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺一間資訊科技公司做IT工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 zi1 seon3 fo1 gei6 gung1 si1 zou6 IT gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在一家資訊科技公司從事IT工作。
examples.english_sentence: I work in IT at an information technology company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校有資訊科技課，教學生基本嘅電腦同網絡知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jau5 zi1 seon3 fo1 gei6 fo3, gaau3 hok6 saang1 gei1 bun2 ge3 din6 nou5 tung4 mong5 lok3 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校有資訊科技課，教學生基本的電腦和網絡知識。
examples.english_sentence: The school has IT classes that teach students basic computer and network knowledge.

mandarin_meaning: 资质；天生的才能或禀赋
english_meaning: aptitude; innate talent or natural ability
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人先天或天生具有的才能、理解力或發展潛力，常用來評估學習或從事某項工作／技能的可能性。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's innate ability, talent, or aptitude — the natural capacity or potential someone has for learning or developing a skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好好嘅資質，將來一定有出息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 hou2 ge3 zi1 zat1, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 jau5 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很好的资质，将来一定有出息。
examples.english_sentence: He has very good aptitude; he'll definitely succeed in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師話佢資質平平，要靠努力先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 waa6 keoi5 zi1 zat1 ping4 ping4, jiu3 kaau3 nou5 lik6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师说他资质一般，要靠努力才能成就。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said his aptitude is average; he'll have to rely on hard work to succeed.

mandarin_meaning: 资金
english_meaning: funds; capital; financing
explanation_mandarin: 指用於投資、經營或特定用途的金錢或資本。
explanation_english: Refers to money or capital used for investment, business operations, or specific purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要更多資金先可以發展業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 zi1 gam1 sin1 ho2 ji5 faat3 zin2 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要更多資金才能發展業務。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs more funds before it can expand its business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋籌集到足夠嘅資金，項目就可以開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cau4 zaap6 dou3 zuk1 gau3 ge3 zi1 gam1, hong6 muk6 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們籌集到足夠的資金，項目就可以開始。
examples.english_sentence: They raised enough funds, so the project can start.

mandarin_meaning: 资金流（資金的進出與流動）
english_meaning: cash flow; flow of funds (movement of capital or money)
explanation_mandarin: 指資金的進出與流動情況，常用於描述公司、金融市場或整體經濟體的現金或資本流動與變化。
explanation_english: Refers to the movement of funds — inflows and outflows of cash or capital. Commonly used to describe a company's cash flow, capital movements in financial markets, or broader economic fund flows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅資金流緊張，要搵新投資者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ge3 zi1 gam1 lau4 gan2 zoeng1, jiu3 wan2 san1 tau4zi1ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的資金流緊張，需要尋找新的投資者。
examples.english_sentence: The company's cash flow is tight and needs to find new investors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場出現大量資金流入，股價上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 ceot1 jin6 daai6 loeng6 zi1 gam1 lau4 jap6, gu2 gaa3 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場出現大量資金流入，股價上升。
examples.english_sentence: Large capital inflows into the market pushed stock prices up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情，好多資金流出香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jing4 cing4, hou2 do1 zi1 gam1 lau4 ceot1 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為疫情，很多資金流出香港。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the pandemic, a lot of capital flowed out of Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 贾（姓氏）；商人，買賣（文言或書面語）
english_meaning: Jia (surname); merchant; to trade/buy and sell (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: 「賈」為漢字，可作姓氏（贾），亦可指商人或買賣之意，常見於書面或文言表達。
explanation_english: The character 賈 is used as the surname Jia and can also mean a merchant or the act of trading/buying-and-selling; usage is mainly literary or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓賈，係我中學嘅同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaa2, hai6 ngo5 zung1 hok6 ge3 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓贾，是我中学的同学。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Jia; he was my classmate in secondary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅賈人會喺市集度做買賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 gaa2 jan4 wui5 hai2 si5 zaap6 dou6 zou6 maai5 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的賈人會在市集裡做買賣。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, merchants would trade at the market.

mandarin_meaning: 賊（小偷）；口語中可作程度副詞（表示非常）
english_meaning: thief; (colloquial) intensifier meaning 'very' or 'extremely'
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；口語時亦可作副詞
explanation_mandarin: 「賊」原指偷竊他人財物的人（小偷）。在廣東話口語中，有時放在形容詞前作程度副詞用，如「賊好」表示「非常好」。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a person who steals (thief). In Cantonese colloquial speech it can also be used before adjectives as an intensifier (e.g. '賊好' = 'really/very good').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企畀賊入咗，啲貴重嘢全部唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 bei2 zaak6 jap6 zo2, di1 gwai3 zung6 je5 cyun4 bou6 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家被賊闖進了，貴重的東西全部不見了。
examples.english_sentence: Our house was broken into by thieves; all the valuables are gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個賊畀警察捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zaak6 bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個賊被警察抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: That thief was caught by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋撻賊好食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 tat1 zaak6 hou2 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個蛋塔超好吃！
examples.english_sentence: This egg tart is really tasty!

mandarin_meaning: 賊；小偷
english_meaning: thief; robber; (colloquially) rascal
explanation_mandarin: 指偷竊的人。在廣東話中也可作口語用法，半開玩笑地稱呼搗蛋或佔了便宜的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who steals. In Cantonese it can also be used colloquially or jokingly to call someone a rascal who sneaks or takes things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有賊人入咗屋偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zaak6 jan4 jap6 zo2 uk1 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有賊人進了屋子偷東西。
examples.english_sentence: A thief broke into the house and stole things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個賊人，偷食我啲零食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 zaak6 jan4, tau1 sik6 ngo5 di1 ling4 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個賊人，偷吃我的零食！
examples.english_sentence: You thief/rascal, you ate my snacks!

mandarin_meaning: 小偷；（口語）指調皮或愛惡作劇的人
english_meaning: thief; (colloquial) little rascal or naughty kid (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「賊仔」在廣東話中主要指偷竊的人，即小偷；在口語中也可帶有半開玩笑的語氣，用來稱呼調皮或愛惡作劇的人（有時帶親暱或責備意味）。
explanation_english: "賊仔" in Cantonese primarily means a thief. Colloquially it can also be used jokingly or affectionately to call someone a little rascal who sneaks or takes things, often used for kids or friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係賊仔，偷咗我啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zaak6 zai2, tau1 zo2 ngo5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是小偷，偷了我的錢。
examples.english_sentence: He's a thief; he stole my money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哎呀，你個賊仔，成日偷我啲零食！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa3, nei5 go3 zaak6 zai2, sing4 jat6 tau1 ngo5 di1 ling4 sik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀，你這個小搗蛋，老是偷我的零食！
examples.english_sentence: Ah, you little rascal, always stealing my snacks!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細佬係個賊仔，成日拎我部電話嚟玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 lou2 hai6 go3 zaak6 zai2, sing4 jat6 ling1 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 lai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我弟弟是個小搗蛋，總是拿我的手機來玩。
examples.english_sentence: My little brother is a little rascal who always takes my phone to play with.

mandarin_meaning: 毛线帽 / 針織帽（口語，字面為「小偷的帽子」）
english_meaning: beanie / knit cap (colloquial; lit. 'thief's hat')
explanation_mandarin: 「賊仔帽」為廣東話口語，指毛線帽或針織帽。此稱呼來源於電影／現實中小偷或要掩蓋身份的人經常戴這類緊貼頭型的帽子，因此俗稱「賊仔帽」。有時帶有戲謔或貶義色彩，但日常亦可指普通的毛帽。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '賊仔帽' refers to a knit cap or beanie. The name literally means 'thief's hat' because such close-fitting caps are stereotypically worn by burglars or people hiding their identity in movies and real life. It can carry a teasing or slightly negative connotation, but is also used casually to mean an ordinary beanie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢頂賊仔帽好暖，冬天戴得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ding2 zaak6 zai2 mou6 hou2 nyun5, dung1 tin1 daai3 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这顶賊仔帽很暖，冬天可以戴。
examples.english_sentence: This beanie is very warm; it's suitable to wear in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住賊仔帽走入街市，唔想俾人認出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 zaak6 zai2 mou6 zau2 jap6 gaai1 si5, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 jing6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戴着賊仔帽走进菜市场，不想被人认出来。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a beanie into the market to avoid being recognized.

mandarin_meaning: 賊、偷竊者（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: thief; crook (colloquial, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 「賊佬」是香港廣東話的俗語，字面上指小偷或竊賊，語氣帶貶義或粗俗，用於指責或侮辱他人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese term literally meaning 'thief' or 'crook'. It is derogatory and often used to accuse or insult someone as a thief or dishonest person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個賊佬偷咗我部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zaak6 lou2 tau1 zo2 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個賊偷了我的手機。
examples.english_sentence: That thief stole my phone.

mandarin_meaning: 碰碰运气；试探能否得手/试探情况（冒险试探）
english_meaning: to test one's luck or probe a situation to see if one can get away with something; to take a chance and see what happens
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面為「賊人試一試煲」，比喻以小冒险或試探性行動來查看能否成功或不被發現，帶有碰碰運氣、試探風聲的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquialism literally meaning 'a thief tests the pot.' It figuratively describes taking a risky, probing action to see if one can succeed or escape notice—similar to 'testing one's luck' or 'probing the situation.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做係賊佬試沙煲，淨係試下公司有冇人發覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 hai6 zeik6 lou2 si3 saa1 bou1, zing6 hai6 si3 haa5 gung1 si1 jau5 mou5 jan4 faat3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這麼做是在碰碰運氣，試試公司有沒有人發覺。
examples.english_sentence: He did that to test his luck — to see if anyone at the company would notice.

mandarin_meaning: 试探、探路（先探别人的态度或反应再行动）
english_meaning: to probe or test the waters (to try out or probe someone's reaction before taking action)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，原意為小偷先試探砂煲是否安全再下手；引申為先試探別人的態度或情況，再決定是否採取行動。常用於廣東話口語中，類似「試水溫」「試探」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'a thief tests the clay pot' — originally referring to checking safety before acting. Figuratively it means to probe or test someone's reaction or the situation before taking action; similar to 'testing the waters' or 'probing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁賊佬試砂煲，直頭問佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 caak3 lou2 si3 saa1 bou1, zik6 tau4 man6 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用這麼試探，直接問他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just probe — ask him directly.

mandarin_meaning: 小偷、賊人
english_meaning: thief; crook (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，常用來貶稱偷竊或不誠實的人，帶有輕微侮辱意味。有人用於指稱小偷，也可作為罵人話語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to call someone a thief or crook. It is mildly derogatory and often used to accuse or insult someone who steals or is dishonest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個賊公，偷咗我個銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 zek3 gung1, tau1 zo2 ngo5 go3 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個小偷，偷了我的錢包。
examples.english_sentence: He's a thief — he stole my wallet.

jyutping: zek3 gung1 gai3 zong6 jyun4 coi4
mandarin_meaning: 形容計謀或手段非常巧妙、狡詐，深不可測
english_meaning: Describes a scheme or person extremely clever and cunning—so ingenious that even the smartest would find it hard to detect
explanation_mandarin: 「賊公計狀元才」用來形容某人的計謀高明、詭詐、難以看破，常帶有諷刺或貶義意味，指其狡猾程度猶如需要狀元般的才智才能設計出來。
explanation_english: Used to describe a plot or person that is extremely crafty and ingenious—so clever that even the brightest would struggle to see through it. Often carries an ironic or mildly derogatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰個騙局真係賊公計狀元才，連警方都一時無辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 go3 pin3 guk6 zan1 hai6 zek3 gung1 gai3 zong6 jyun4 coi4, lin4 ging2 fong1 dou1 jat1 si4 mou4 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那個騙局真是賊公計狀元才，連警方一時也無計可施。
examples.english_sentence: His scam was really ingenious—so cunning that even the police were temporarily helpless.

mandarin_meaning: 賊喊捉賊（用來形容為掩飾自己罪行而反過來指責或控告別人）
english_meaning: Literally 'the thief cries, "Catch the thief"' — accusing others to deflect attention from one's own guilt; a hypocrite who blames others to cover up their own wrongdoing.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做壞事或有錯的人為了掩飾自己的罪行或過失，反而大聲指責、控告或嫁禍他人，以轉移懷疑或責任。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, to hide their own misdeeds or mistakes, loudly accuses or scapegoats others to divert suspicion or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷咗嘢，仲大喊大叫話有人偷，真係賊喊捉賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 zo2 je5, zung6 daai6 haam3 daai6 giu3 waa6 jau5 jan4 tau1, zan1 hai6 caak3 haam3 zuk1 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷了東西，還大聲喊有人偷，真是賊喊捉賊。
examples.english_sentence: He stole something and then loudly accused others of stealing — it's truly a case of the thief crying 'Stop thief!'.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）調皮/討厭的小壞蛋；也可作感嘆詞表示惱怒或不滿
english_meaning: A colloquial term for a rascal/cheeky person; can also be used as a mild expletive expressing annoyance or frustration
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語／口語（形容詞／名詞／感嘆詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「賊毛」為粵語口語俚語，常用來形容某人頑皮、調皮或討人厭，也可單獨作感嘆詞表示對某事不滿或惱怒。主要在香港口語中使用，語氣屬輕微罵人或打趣。
explanation_english: “賊毛” is Cantonese slang often used to describe someone who is naughty, cheeky, or annoying. It can also be used alone as a mild expletive to express annoyance. It is primarily used in Hong Kong colloquial speech and can be teasing or mildly insulting depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你賊毛，唔好再咁玩啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaak6 mou4, m4 hou2 zoi3 gam2 waan2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個小壞蛋，別再這樣玩了！
examples.english_sentence: You little rascal, don't play like that anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係賊毛，成日呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zaak6 mou4, sing4 jat6 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個小壞蛋，老是騙人。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a rascal; always tricking people.

mandarin_meaning: 鬼鬼祟祟，表情可疑，像做了壞事或想隱瞞什麼
english_meaning: furtive; looking shifty or suspicious, as if hiding something or having done something wrong
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人的眼神或表情很鬼祟、可疑，好像做過不光彩的事或想隱瞞甚麼。
explanation_english: Describes someone's expression or demeanor as furtive and suspicious, suggesting they might be hiding something or have done something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賊眉賊眼，睇落好似做過啲唔光彩嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 caak6 mei4 caak6 ngaan5, tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 zou6 gwo3 di1 m4 gwong1 caai2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是賊眉賊眼，看起來好像做過不光彩的事。
examples.english_sentence: He always looks shifty, as if he's done something dishonorable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣佢賊眉賊眼，好似唔想講實話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6 keoi5 caak6 mei4 caak6 ngaan5, hou2 ci5 m4 soeng2 gong2 sat6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會時他賊眉賊眼，好像不想說實話。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting he acted shifty, as if he didn't want to tell the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 海盜船；（俗）比喻不正當、欺詐或危險的計劃或團體（如「上賊船」＝參與可疑/違法的行為）
english_meaning: pirate ship; colloquially (slang) a shady or risky venture/organization (as in 'get on the thief-ship' = join something dubious)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思為海盜所乘的船。2) 口語或俚語用法時，常用來比喻欺詐、不正當或有風險的計劃、團體或行為，並常見於勸阻別人不要參與的說法（如「唔好上賊船」）。
explanation_english: 1) Literally a pirate's ship. 2) In colloquial/slang usage, it metaphorically refers to a fraudulent, unethical, or risky scheme or group; often used in warnings not to get involved (e.g. "don't get on the thief-ship").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸你唔好上賊船，嗰個計劃好似係騙局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 soeng5 zak1 syun4, go2 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 ci5 hai6 pin3 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我勸你不要參與那個計劃，像是個騙局。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you not to get involved in that plan — it looks like a scam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海盜駕着賊船襲擊沿海商船，畫面好驚險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 dou6 gaa3 zoek3 zak1 syun4 zaap6 gik1 jin4 hoi2 soeng1 syun4, waa6 min6 hou2 ging1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海盗駕着賊船襲擊沿海商船，畫面很驚險。
examples.english_sentence: Pirates aboard a pirate ship attacked the coastal merchant vessel — the scene was very dramatic.

mandarin_meaning: 贓物
english_meaning: stolen goods; loot
explanation_mandarin: 指被偷竊或非法獲得的物品，即贓物，常用於法律或警方語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to items obtained by theft or other illegal means — stolen property or loot, commonly used in legal or police contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺佢屋企搜查時搵到多件賊贓，依家已經拘捕咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 keoi5 uk1 kei2 sau1 caa4 si4 wan2 dou3 do1 gin6 zaak6 zong1, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 gu1 bou6 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在他家搜查時發現多件贓物，現在已經把他逮捕了。
examples.english_sentence: The police found many stolen goods at his home during a search, and he has now been arrested.

mandarin_meaning: 相當於「賊喊捉賊」，指做了壞事的人反而指責別人或製造事端以掩蓋自己的過錯。
english_meaning: Similar to 'the thief crying 'stop thief!'' — a wrongdoer creates a commotion or accuses others to divert attention from their own misdeed.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容做了壞事的人反過來指責別人或製造混亂，藉以掩飾自己的錯誤或逃避責任。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who, having committed a wrongdoing, accuses others or stirs up trouble to cover up their own fault or evade responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，仲賊過興兵，扮受害者嚟掩飾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, zung6 zaak6-gwo3-hing1-bing1, baan6 sau6hoi6ze2 lai4 jim2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事，還賊過興兵，裝成受害者來掩飾。
examples.english_sentence: He did something wrong and even pretended to be the victim to cover it up.

mandarin_meaning: 混蛋／無賴（罵人的話）
english_meaning: a slang insult meaning 'bastard' or 'jerk' (directed at a man)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 罵人用語（感嘆詞 / 名詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「賊阿爸」是廣東話的粗俗罵語，通常用來稱呼或斥責某個男人或人很壞、卑劣或可惡。語氣粗魯，不正式，常見於香港口語。
explanation_english: “賊阿爸” is a Cantonese coarse insult typically used to call or scold a man as nasty, despicable, or a jerk. It is vulgar, informal, and common in Hong Kong colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個賊阿爸，成日呃人唔負責任！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 zaak6 aa3 baa4, sing4 jat6 ngaak1 jan4 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個混蛋，成天騙人不負責任！
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, always lying to people and never taking responsibility!

mandarin_meaning: 賑濟；救濟（向受災或貧困者提供援助）
english_meaning: to provide relief; to give disaster or welfare aid
explanation_mandarin: 表示向受災、貧困或需要幫助的人提供救濟或援助。常見用法有「賑濟」「賑災」「賑恤」。繁體為「賑」，簡體為「赈」。在書面或正式語境中常用。
explanation_english: Means to give relief or assistance to disaster victims, the poor, or those in need. Common compounds include 賑濟 (provide relief) and 賑災 (disaster relief). Traditional form is 賑, simplified is 赈. Often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會賑濟受災市民，提供食物同藥物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 zan3 zai3 sau6 zoi1 si5 man4, tai4 gung1 sik6 mat6 tung4 joek6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會賑濟受災市民，提供食物和藥品。
examples.english_sentence: The government will provide relief to disaster victims, supplying food and medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去賑災，送咗好多衣服畀災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zan3 zoi1, sung3 zo2 hou2 do1 ji1 fuk6 bei2 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們去賑災，送了很多衣物給災民。
examples.english_sentence: They went to provide disaster relief and delivered many clothes to the victims.

mandarin_meaning: 赈济 (zhènjì)，向受灾或贫困者提供物资或金钱救助
english_meaning: to provide relief; to give aid (to disaster victims or the poor)
explanation_mandarin: 指向受災、貧困或其他困難情況下的人提供物資、金錢或其他援助以減輕其困苦。
explanation_english: Refers to supplying goods, money, or other assistance to people affected by disasters or poverty to ease their hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要賑濟受災嘅市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 zan3 zai3 sau6 zoi1 ge3 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要赈济受灾的市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government should provide relief to the disaster-stricken citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 赈灾；救助因灾受害的人
english_meaning: to provide disaster relief; to give aid to disaster victims
explanation_mandarin: 向因自然災害或其他突發事件受影響的人提供食物、衣物、醫療等援助與救濟。
explanation_english: To provide assistance (food, clothing, medical supplies, money, etc.) to people affected by natural disasters or other emergencies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該盡快賑災，派發糧食同醫療物資俾災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 zeon6 faai3 zan3 zoi1, paai3 faat3 loeng4 sik6 tung4 ji1 liu4 mat6 zi1 bei2 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該儘快賑災，派發糧食和醫療物資給災民。
examples.english_sentence: The government should provide disaster relief as soon as possible, distributing food and medical supplies to the victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教堂每年都會舉辦賑災籌款活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 tong4 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 geoi2 baan6 zan3 zoi1 cau4 fun2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教堂每年都會舉辦賑災籌款活動。
examples.english_sentence: The church holds a disaster-relief fundraising event every year.

mandarin_meaning: 赊（账）；赊购
english_meaning: to buy on credit; to allow a purchase without immediate payment
explanation_mandarin: 指在未立即付款的情况下购货或记账，事后再结算或付款。
explanation_english: Refers to purchasing goods or allowing a transaction without immediate payment, with settlement or payment deferred to a later time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次買啲嘢可以賒數嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 maai5 di1 je5 ho2 ji5 se4 sou3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我买东西可以赊账吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I buy these on credit this time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話唔接受賒數，淨係收現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 m4 zip3 sau1 se4 sou3, zing6 hai6 sau1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说不接受赊账，只收现金。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said they don't accept purchases on credit; cash only.

mandarin_meaning: 赊账
english_meaning: to buy on credit; to put on a tab; to extend or take credit
explanation_mandarin: 指購買商品或接受服務時暫不付款，記入帳上日後再付，亦可指欠款或拖欠款項。
explanation_english: Refers to purchasing goods or receiving services without immediate payment, recording the debt to be paid later; also refers to owing or running up a tab.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意賒數，寧願即刻俾錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 se4 sou3, ning4 jyun6 zik1 hak1 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢赊账，宁可立刻付钱。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like buying on credit; I'd rather pay immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話可以賒數，但要記低，下次還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 ho2 ji5 se4 sou3, daan6 jiu3 gei3 dai1, haa6 ci3 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说可以赊账，但要记下来，下次还钱。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we can put it on credit, but it'll be recorded and you must pay next time.

mandarin_meaning: 賓客；客人（bīn）
english_meaning: guest; visitor
explanation_mandarin: 表示客人或來賓，常見於賓客、主賓、來賓等詞語中，語氣較正式。
explanation_english: Refers to a guest or visitor. Commonly used in compounds like 賓客 (guest) and 主賓 (guest of honor); it is a more formal term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今晚活動嘅主賓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 maan5 wut6 dung6 ge3 zyu2 ban1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是今晚活動的主賓。
examples.english_sentence: He is the guest of honor at tonight's event.

mandarin_meaning: 宾主（主人與客人）
english_meaning: host and guests; host–guest
explanation_mandarin: 指宴會或聚會中的主人與客人，也可泛指主客之間的角色或關係。
explanation_english: Refers to the host and the guests at an event; can also denote the roles or relationship between host and guest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次晚宴賓主盡歡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 maan5 jin6 ban1 zyu2 zeon6 fun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次晚宴宾主尽欢。
examples.english_sentence: At this banquet, the host and guests all enjoyed themselves.

mandarin_meaning: 菲律賓男子（俚語）
english_meaning: Filipino man (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱。由「賓」（取自「菲律賓」之最後一音）加上「佬」（表示男人、傢伙）構成，用來指稱菲律賓的男性。屬口語或俚語用法，視語境可能中性、親切或帶貶義。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term for a man from the Philippines. It combines 賓 (from 菲律賓, Philippines) with 佬 (guy/man). Usage is informal and can be neutral or perceived as derogatory depending on context and tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓下有幾個賓佬成日喺度踢波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 haa6 jau5 gei2 go3 ban1 lou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 tek3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 樓下有幾個菲律賓男子經常在那裡踢足球。
examples.english_sentence: There are a few Filipino guys downstairs who often play soccer there.

mandarin_meaning: 賓周（通常作人名或商號、地名），拼音：Bīn Zhōu
english_meaning: Bin Zhou (proper name — personal name, business name, or place name)
explanation_mandarin: 「賓周」在粵語中並非常見詞彙，多數情況下作為人名或公司／商號、地名使用。單獨出現時屬於專有名詞，沒有固定的成語或俚語含義。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '賓周' is not a common lexical item and is typically used as a personal name or as the name of a business/place. As a standalone term it functions as a proper noun and does not have an established idiomatic or slang meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賓周今日嚟咗公司開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ban1 zau1 gam1 jat6 lai4 zo2 gung1 si1 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賓周今天來公司開會。
examples.english_sentence: Bin Zhou came to the company today for a meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 梅赛德斯-奔驰（汽车品牌）
english_meaning: Mercedes-Benz (automobile brand)
explanation_mandarin: 指德国豪华汽车品牌梅赛德斯-奔驰，香港粤语中常用「賓士」称呼该品牌或其车款。
explanation_english: Refers to the German luxury automobile brand Mercedes-Benz. In Hong Kong Cantonese, 賓士 is commonly used to refer to the brand or its cars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢新買咗部賓士，好羨慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 maai5 zo2 bou6 ban1 si6, hou2 sin6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他新買了一輛奔馳，很羨慕。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new Mercedes; I'm so jealous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日開賓士去返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hoi1 ban1 si6 heoi3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常開奔馳去上班。
examples.english_sentence: He often drives a Mercedes to work.

mandarin_meaning: 女賓、女客人（口語、罕見或方言用法）
english_meaning: female guest (colloquial/rare usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「賓妹」由「賓（客人）」與「妹（女孩）」組成，字面上可理解為「女賓」或「女客人」。此詞屬口語或地方用法，較罕見，有時也可作為對年輕女性的稱呼，但並非書面常用詞。
explanation_english: Composed of 賓 (guest) and 妹 (younger female), literally 'female guest'. It is a colloquial or regional term and relatively uncommon. Occasionally used to refer to young female attendees, but not standard in formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有幾位賓妹嚟做嘉賓，大家要熱烈歡迎佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 gei2 wai2 ban1 mui6 lai4 zou6 gaa1 ban1, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 jit6 lit6 fun1 jing4 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有几位女宾来担任嘉宾，大家要热烈欢迎她们。
examples.english_sentence: There will be several female guests as speakers tonight; everyone should warmly welcome them.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見/口語）對姓「賓」的年長婦女的稱呼，相當於「賓太太」或「賓婆婆」。在香港粵語中並不常見，可能為地區性或口語用法。
english_meaning: A rare/colloquial address for an older woman with the surname 'Bin/Ban' (i.e. 'Mrs. Bin'). Not common in standard Hong Kong Cantonese; may appear in local speech.
explanation_mandarin: 「賓婆」讀作 ban1 po4，通常是把「賓」作為姓氏，後接「婆」以稱呼年長的婦女。此詞屬口語或地方性稱呼，用法稀有，亦可能因誤寫或方言變體而出現。
explanation_english: Pronounced ban1 po4. Typically formed by taking the surname 'Bin/Ban' (賓) and adding the suffix '婆' to address an older woman. It is a colloquial or regionally used term, uncommon in standard Cantonese and sometimes appears as a dialectal or informal form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隔籬有個賓婆，成日喺窗前種花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaak3 lai4 jau5 go3 ban1 po4, sing4 jat6 hai2 coeng1 cin4 zung2 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們隔壁有位賓婆，經常在窗前種花。
examples.english_sentence: There's a Mrs. Bin next door who often plants flowers by her window.

mandarin_meaning: 宾客（bīn kè）：客人，来宾
english_meaning: guest; visitor; attendee
explanation_mandarin: 指受邀或到來參加活動、宴會等的客人或來賓，較為正式的稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to guests or visitors invited to or attending events, banquets, etc.; a relatively formal term for attendees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日有好多賓客嚟參加晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 ban1 haak3 lai4 caam1 gaa1 maan5 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有很多宾客来参加晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: There are many guests coming to attend the banquet today.

mandarin_meaning: 賓州（宾州）= 宾夕法尼亚州（美国的一州）
english_meaning: Pennsylvania (U.S. state) — abbreviation
explanation_mandarin: 「賓州」是「宾夕法尼亚州」（美國的一個州）的簡稱，常在口語或新聞中作為賓夕法尼亞州的縮稱使用。
explanation_english: A short form of the U.S. state name Pennsylvania. Used in Cantonese as an abbreviated reference to Pennsylvania.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個暑假會去賓州旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 syu2 gaa3 wui5 heoi3 ban1 zau1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个暑假会去宾州旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'll travel to Pennsylvania next summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賓州其實係賓夕法尼亞州嘅簡稱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ban1 zau1 kei4 sat6 hai6 ban1 zik6 faat3 nei4 aa3 zau1 ge3 gaan2 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其实“宾州”是“宾夕法尼亚州”的简称。
examples.english_sentence: Actually, '賓州' is the short form of 'Pennsylvania.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賓州嘅費城係美國歷史好重要嘅城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ban1 zau1 ge3 fai3 sing4 hai6 mei5 gwok3 lik6 si2 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宾州的费城是美国历史上很重要的城市。
examples.english_sentence: Philadelphia in Pennsylvania is a very important city in U.S. history.

mandarin_meaning: Bintje（馬鈴薯/土豆的一個品種）
english_meaning: Bintje (a potato cultivar)
explanation_mandarin: Bintje 是一種起源於荷蘭的馬鈴薯品種，常用於製作薯條、薯片等。該品種澱粉含量較高，炸製後外脆內軟，風味好，故廣受餐飲業應用。
explanation_english: Bintje is a potato cultivar originating in the Netherlands, commonly used for making fries and chips. It has relatively high starch content and fries up crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, making it popular in food service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲薯條係用賓治整㗎，外脆內軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 syu4 tiu4 hai6 jung6 ban1 zi6 zing2 gaa3, ngoi6 ceoi3 noi6 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些薯條是用賓治（馬鈴薯品種）做的，外脆裡軟。
examples.english_sentence: These fries are made from Bintje potatoes — crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

mandarin_meaning: 宾至如归（bīn zhì rú guī）：形容主人热情招待，使客人感到像回到自己家一样舒适。
english_meaning: To make guests feel as if they are at home; to feel right at home.
explanation_mandarin: 形容主人熱情招待客人，讓客人感到舒適、自在，像回到自己家一樣。
explanation_english: Describes hospitality that makes guests feel comfortable and at ease, as if they have returned home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅服務令我真係賓至如歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ling6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ban1 zi3 jyu4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的服务让我感到宾至如归。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this hotel made me feel right at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次返屋企，媽媽都款待我，真係賓至如歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 faan1 uk1 kei5, maa4 maa1 dou1 fun2 doi6 ngo5, zan1 hai6 ban1 zi3 jyu4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次回家，妈妈都把我招待得像回到自己家一样，让我觉得宾至如归。
examples.english_sentence: Every time I go home, my mom treats me so well that I really feel at home.

jyutping: ban1 heoi1 gam2 daai6 coeng4 min6
mandarin_meaning: 擺闊、大排場；像電影《賓虛》那樣的宏大場面（口語、帶些諷刺或勸止意味）
english_meaning: to put on a big/epic scene; to make a grand, over-the-top display (colloquial, often sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容擺排場或搞得非常隆重、誇張的場面。語源可指向電影《賓虛》般的宏大場面，常帶有譏諷或勸止的語氣。
explanation_english: Describes putting on a very grand or exaggerated scene — like the epic spectacle of the film Ben‑Hur. Often used colloquially with a sarcastic or admonishing tone to tell someone not to make such a fuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賓虛咁大場面啦，我哋係屋企飯聚啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ban1 heoi1 gam2 daai6 coeng4 min6 laa1, ngo5 dei6 hai6 uk1 kei2 faan6 zeoi6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別擺那麼大排場了，我們只是家庭聚餐而已。
