examples.english_sentence: He/She is always smiling at customers in the restaurant to try to get tips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺夜店賣笑，意思係靠笑容吸引客人，甚至有賣身嘅嫌疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 je6 dim3 maai6 siu3, ji3 si1 hai6 kaau3 siu3 jung4 kap1 jan5 haak3 jan4, sam6 zi6 jau5 maai6 san1 ge3 jim4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在夜店卖笑，即靠笑容吸引客人，甚至有卖身的嫌疑。
examples.english_sentence: She/He 'sells smiles' at nightclubs — using smiles to attract customers, sometimes implying selling sexual services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係賣笑，要真心聽人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 maai6 siu3, jiu3 zan1 sam1 teng1 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是卖笑，要真心听别人说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just smile to please — listen sincerely and speak up.

mandarin_meaning: 卖肉（字面：卖肉类；俚语：卖淫、卖身）
english_meaning: sell meat (literal: sell meat; slang: to sell sex / prostitute oneself)
explanation_mandarin: “賣肉”字面意思是販售肉類。在口語或俚語中常用來指從事賣淫或出賣身體以換取金錢。意思依語境可為字面或隱喻性的性交易。
explanation_english: Literally 'to sell meat' (i.e., to sell meat products). In colloquial/slang usage it commonly means to engage in prostitution or to sell one's body for money. The meaning depends on context—literal or metaphorical for sex work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我舖頭係賣肉嘅，啲豬肉好新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pou3 tau2 hai6 maai6 juk6 ge3, di1 zyu1 juk6 hou2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的铺头是卖肉的，猪肉很新鲜。
examples.english_sentence: My shop sells meat; the pork is very fresh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔做嗰行，唔會賣肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 zou6 go2 hong4, m4 wui5 maai6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他不做那行，不会卖淫。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wouldn't go into that line of work; he won't sell his body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲女仔因為窮，要賣肉搵錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 neoi5 zai2 jan1 wai6 cung4, jiu3 maai6 juk6 wan2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些女孩因为穷，要卖淫赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: Some girls, because they're poor, have to sell sex to make money.

jyutping: maai6 faa1 zi1 jan4 caap3 zuk1 jip6
mandarin_meaning: 比喻只起襯托或點綴作用的人，非主要負責者（字面：賣花的人插入竹葉以襯托花朵）
english_meaning: Metaphor for someone who only plays a supporting or decorative role, not the main contributor or decision-maker (literally: a flower seller inserting bamboo leaves to embellish flowers).
explanation_mandarin: 「賣花之人插竹葉」字面指賣花者會在花束中插入竹葉以襯托花朵，轉喻指在某件事情或團隊中只負責點綴或配合、並非主要決策或負責的人。
explanation_english: Literally describes a flower seller inserting bamboo leaves to make bouquets look fuller; figuratively it refers to someone who serves a supporting or embellishing role rather than being the main actor or decision-maker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺嗰個項目入面，佢只係賣花之人插竹葉，主要決策都唔係佢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 go2 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6, keoi5 zi2 hai6 maai6 faa1 zi1 jan4 caap3 zuk1 jip6, zyu2 jiu3 kyut3 caak3 dou1 m4 hai6 keoi5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在那个项目里，他只是起襯托作用的人，主要决策都不是他做的。
examples.english_sentence: In that project, he only plays a supporting/ornamental role; the main decisions aren't made by him.

jyutping: mai6 faa1 gu1 neoi5 caap3 zuk6 jip6
mandarin_meaning: （直譯）賣花的姑娘插上竹葉；（習用）廣東話中的兒歌或口語用語，帶有嬉鬧、無厘頭或戲謔意味，常用來形容說話或行為很傻、無關緊要或只是閒聊的內容。
english_meaning: (literal) The girl selling flowers sticks a bamboo leaf; (usage) a Cantonese colloquial/children's-rhyme phrase often used playfully or nonsensically to tease, to describe something silly, trivial, or just idle chatter.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語短語 / 俗語（多為兒歌或戲謔用語）
explanation_mandarin: 「賣花姑娘插竹葉」本身是直譯的圖像式短語，在廣東話語境中常見於兒歌或口語玩笑。它通常不承載深刻字面意思，而是用來調侃、表現無厘頭或形容某人說話/做事很傻、無關緊要或只是閒談。並非正式語彙，較常出現在口語、民間歌謠或戲謔語境中。
explanation_english: Literally the phrase depicts a flower-selling girl sticking a bamboo leaf. In Cantonese usage it appears in children's rhymes and playful speech. The phrase is largely nonsensical and is used jokingly to tease or to label something as silly, trivial, or mere idle chatter. It is informal and typically used in familiar or cultural contexts rather than formal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日話『賣花姑娘插竹葉』噉，聽落好傻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 waa6 'mai6 faa1 gu1 neoi5 caap3 zuk6 jip6' gam2, teng1 lok6 hou2 so4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老是說「賣花姑娘插竹葉」這種話，聽起來很傻。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep saying 'mai6 faa1 gu1 neoi5 caap3 zuk6 jip6' — it sounds silly.

mandarin_meaning: 自賣自誇；自吹自擂
english_meaning: To praise one's own goods; to brag about or self-promote one's products or abilities.
explanation_mandarin: 字面是賣花的人讚揚花的香味，引申為賣東西或宣傳時誇耀自己的商品或長處，比喻自我吹噓或自誇。
explanation_english: Literally 'selling flowers and praising their fragrance.' It describes someone who advertises or praises their own goods or abilities — i.e., self-promotion or bragging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賣花讚花香，將自己嘅產品講得天花亂墜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 maai6 faa1 zaan3 faa1 hoeng1, zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 caan2 ban2 gong2 dak1 tin1 faa1 lyun6 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是自賣自誇，把自己的產品說得天花亂墜。
examples.english_sentence: He's always praising his own products, talking them up extravagantly.

mandarin_meaning: 賣萌（故意擺出可愛的樣子以獲取別人好感或注意）
english_meaning: to act cute on purpose; to play cute to get attention or affection
explanation_mandarin: 指故意擺出可愛、嬌憨的行為或表情，常用來博取他人同情、關注或認同，多見於社交媒體與口語對話中。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang verb meaning to deliberately act cute or make cute faces/behaviors to gain others' sympathy, attention, or approval; commonly used in social media and everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺Instagram度賣萌，想拎多啲讚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 Instagram dou6 maai6 mung4, soeng2 ling1 do1 di1 zaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她經常在Instagram上賣萌，想拿到更多讚。
examples.english_sentence: He/She often acts cute on Instagram to get more likes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺工作場合賣萌，要專業啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gung1 zok3 coeng4 hap6 maai6 mung4, jiu3 zyun1 jip6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在工作場合賣萌，要專業一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act cute in a professional setting; be more professional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔識得賣萌，父母就好容易寵壞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 sik1 dak1 maai6 mung4, fu6 mou5 zau6 hou2 jung4 ji6 cung5 waai6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子會賣萌，父母就很容易寵壞他們。
examples.english_sentence: Kids know how to act cute, and parents easily spoil them.

mandarin_meaning: 卖艺（表演以换取报酬或引人注目）
english_meaning: to busk; to perform (often in public) for money; to show off one's skills
explanation_mandarin: 指在街头、市场等公众场所表演以赚取报酬或引人注意，也可引申为卖弄技艺、炫耀。
explanation_english: Refers to performing (often in public places like streets or markets) to earn money or attract attention; can also be used figuratively to mean showing off one's skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街頭賣藝，吸引咗好多行人圍觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 tau4 maai6 ngai6, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 hang4 jan4 wai4 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街头卖艺，吸引了很多行人围观。
examples.english_sentence: He was busking on the street, attracting a crowd of passersby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去街市賣藝，賺啲零用錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai6 ngai6, zaan6 di1 ling4 jung6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去菜市场卖艺，赚些零用钱。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to the market to busk and earn some pocket money.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）出售血液；（引申）拼命工作、犧牲健康或尊嚴以換取金錢
english_meaning: literally 'sell blood'; figuratively, to work extremely hard or sacrifice one's health/ dignity to earn money
explanation_mandarin: 「賣血」可指實際把血液賣給需要的人或機構；在口語中常作比喻，形容為了賺錢而拼命工作、做低薪或辛苦的工作，甚至犧牲健康。
explanation_english: Literally refers to selling blood. Colloquially used as a metaphor for working extremely hard, taking degrading or unhealthy jobs, or sacrificing one's well-being to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話為咗還債，暫時要去賣血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wai6 zo2 waan4 zaai3, zaam6 si4 jiu3 heoi3 maai6 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说为了还债，暂时要去卖血。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd have to sell blood temporarily to pay off his debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲工資低到要賣血先夠交租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 gung1 zi1 dai1 dou3 jiu3 maai6 hyut3 sin1 gau3 gaau1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在工资低到要卖血才够交房租。
examples.english_sentence: Wages are so low now you'd have to 'sell blood' just to afford the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日賣血，應該重視你嘅身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 maai6 hyut3, jing1 goi1 zung6 si6 nei5 ge3 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要成天卖命（卖血），应该重视你的身体。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be constantly 'selling your blood' — you should take care of your health.

mandarin_meaning: 把人販賣（尤指把人賣到外地做苦力或不良工作）／拐賣人口
english_meaning: to sell people (human trafficking); to sell someone out / traffic someone
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，「賣豬仔」原指把人（常為貧窮者或婦女）賣到外地做苦力或被強迫從事不良工作，現亦可泛指販賣人口或出賣他人、拋棄他人。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '賣豬仔' originally referred to selling people (often the poor or women) to be sent abroad as indentured laborers or forced into illicit work. It now commonly means human trafficking or, more broadly, selling someone out or betraying them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話帶我去打工，點知係賣豬仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 daa2 gung1, dim2 zi1 hai6 maai6 zyu1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們說帶我去打工，結果是把我賣豬仔（販賣到外地做苦工/被拐賣）。
examples.english_sentence: They said they'd take me to a job, but it turned out to be selling me into trafficking.

mandarin_meaning: 卖身（出卖自己的身体或让自己处于受支配、出卖原则以换取金钱或依靠）
english_meaning: to sell one's body; to sell oneself (literally into prostitution or servitude), or figuratively to sell out one's principles for money/support
explanation_mandarin: “賣身”原义为出卖自己的身体（如卖身为娼或签卖身契成为仆人），引申义指为金钱或利益出卖原则或投靠他人。
explanation_english: Literally 'to sell one's body' — historically used for prostitution or signing away oneself into servitude; figuratively used to mean selling out one's principles or attaching oneself to someone for money/support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗還債，差啲賣身做妓女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 waan4 zai3, caa1 di1 maai6 san1 zou6 gei6 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她为了还债，差点卖身做妓女。
examples.english_sentence: She almost sold her body to become a prostitute to pay off her debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份工答應埋啲唔合理嘅要求，被人話係賣身投靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 daap3 jing3 maai4 di1 m4 hap6 lei5 ge3 jiu1 kau4, bei6 jan4 waa6 hai6 maai6 san1 tau4 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了那份工作答应了不合理的要求，被人说是卖身投靠。
examples.english_sentence: He agreed to unreasonable demands for that job and was accused of selling himself out.

mandarin_meaning: 賣身契（賣身契約）
english_meaning: contract to sell one's body; indenture; a contract of servitude (literal and figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指買賣奴隸或出賣身體為娼等的契約文書；亦可引申為為了金錢或利益而出賣自由、尊嚴或人格的契約或行為。
explanation_english: Originally a written contract for selling one's body (as a slave or prostitute). Figuratively, it refers to agreements or actions where someone sells their freedom, dignity, or principles for money or personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗還債竟然簽咗張賣身契。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 waan4 zai3 ging2 jin4 cim1 zo2 zoeng1 maai6 san1 kai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了還債竟然簽了一張賣身契。
examples.english_sentence: He actually signed a contract selling himself to pay off his debts.

mandarin_meaning: 赚钱；卖钱（字面：卖出换钱）
english_meaning: to make money; profitable; to sell for money
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指“卖出换钱”，在粤语口语中常用来表示“赚钱、好赚”或询问某物是否能卖出好价钱（能否卖到钱）。
explanation_english: Literally 'sell for money'. In Cantonese colloquial use it commonly means 'to make money' or 'be profitable', and can also be used to ask whether something can be sold for money (i.e., fetch a price).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭好賣錢，啲貨好快賣晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 hou2 maai6 cin2, di1 fo3 hou2 faai3 maai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间店很赚钱，货很快就卖完了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop makes a lot of money; the goods sell out quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意好識賣錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 hou2 sik1 maai6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意很会赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at making money in business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部舊手機賣唔到錢，可能要捐咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 gau6 sau2 gei1 maai6 m4 dou3 cin2, ho2 nang4 jiu3 gyun1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部旧手机卖不了钱，可能要捐掉它。
examples.english_sentence: That old phone can't be sold for money; we might have to donate it.

mandarin_meaning: 卖关子（故意卖关子、吊人胃口）
english_meaning: to keep someone in suspense; to withhold information to tease or build suspense
explanation_mandarin: 指故意不一次把重要訊息說清楚，慢慢透露或隱瞞部分內容，以引起對方的好奇或期待。
explanation_english: Deliberately withholding or revealing information slowly to tease someone or keep them wondering; to create suspense by not telling the full story at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再賣關子，快啲講啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 maai6 gwaan1 zi2, faai3 di1 gong2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別再卖关子了，快点说吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop keeping me in suspense, just tell me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賣關子，搞到我成日諗緊佢有咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 maai6 gwaan1 zi2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 sing4 jat6 lam2 gan2 keoi5 jau5 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是卖关子，让我老想着他怎么了。
examples.english_sentence: He always keeps things suspenseful, making me constantly wonder what's going on with him.

mandarin_meaning: 給面子／顧面子（為了維持顏面或體面而做表面功夫）
english_meaning: to save face / to give face; to put on a show or make a superficial gesture to preserve appearances
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指為了顧面子或維持表面體面而做出表面上的表示或裝樣子，常帶有虛應故事或應付場面的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to do something to save face or give someone face — often a superficial or performative gesture to maintain appearances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係賣面光，實際上冇幫到忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 maai6 min6 gwong1, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 bong1 dou3 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是為了顧面子，實際上沒有幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He only put on a show to save face; in reality he didn't help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好賣我面光啦，直接講真話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 maai6 ngo5 min6 gwong1 laa1, zik6 zip3 gong2 zan1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別給我面子了，直接說實話。
examples.english_sentence: Don't save my face—just tell the truth directly.

mandarin_meaning: 劇透；把（故事或事情）的頭尾全部說出來，洩露關鍵細節
english_meaning: to spoil (a story); to give away the beginning and the ending or reveal key details
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，指把事情或故事的開頭和結尾、重要細節全部說出來，常用於提醒別人不要洩露劇情或關鍵訊息。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to reveal the beginning and the end (or key details) of an event or story — essentially to spoil the plot or give everything away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賣頭賣尾，等我自己慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 maai6 tau4 maai6 mei5, dang2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 maan6 maan6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把頭尾都說出來，讓我自己慢慢說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give away the beginning and the end — let me tell it slowly myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 未睇電影之前，唔好俾人賣頭賣尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei6 tai2 din6 jing2 zi1 cin4, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 maai6 tau4 maai6 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沒看電影之前，不要讓別人劇透開頭和結尾。
examples.english_sentence: Before watching the movie, don't let people spoil the beginning and the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賣頭賣尾，講嘢好難信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 maai6 tau4 maai6 mei5, gong2 je5 hou2 naan4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常把事情的頭尾都說光，說話很難讓人相信。
examples.english_sentence: He always gives everything away; it's hard to trust what he says.

mandarin_meaning: 放鴿子；爽約；食飛（不赴約）
english_meaning: to stand someone up; to bail on someone; to renege on an appointment (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俗語，指答應了某事或約定後卻無故不到、爽約或放人鴿子。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to fail to show up after agreeing to meet or help someone — i.e. to stand someone up or bail on an appointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢約咗今晚一齊食飯，結果又賣飛佛，唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joek3 zo2 gam1 maan5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6, git3 gwo2 jau6 maai6 fei1 fat6, m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他約好今晚一起吃飯，結果又放我鴿子，沒來。
examples.english_sentence: He had arranged to eat with me tonight, but bailed on me again and didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日賣飛佛，講咗要幫手就要幫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 maai6 fei1 fat6, gong2 zo2 jiu3 bong1 sau2 zau6 jiu3 bong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是爽約，說要幫忙就要幫。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep flaking — if you say you'll help, then help.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俚語）裝清白、掩飾過去不光彩或可疑行為
english_meaning: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to pretend to be innocent or to whitewash/cover up past disreputable or suspicious actions
explanation_mandarin: 比喻某人做了不光彩或可疑的事情，之後試圖掩飾或裝作無辜。帶有貶義，常用來形容表面上裝清白但實際上未改變行為的人。
explanation_english: Used metaphorically for someone who has done dishonourable or dubious things and then tries to cover them up or act innocent. It is pejorative and often implies hypocrisy or attempted whitewashing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲唔合法嘅生意，宜家淨係識賣魚佬洗身，仲想攞返信任？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 m4 hap6 faat3 ge3 saang1 ji3, ji4 gaa1 zing6 hai6 sik1 maai6 jyu4 lou2 sai2 san1, zung6 soeng2 lo2 faan1 seon3 jam6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了不合法的生意，現在只會裝清白，還想拿回信任？
examples.english_sentence: He did illegal business; now he's just pretending to be innocent — does he expect to regain trust?

cantonese: 賣魚佬洗身 - 冇晒腥氣
jyutping: maai6 jyu4 lou2 sai2 san1 — mou5 saai3 sang1 hei3
mandarin_meaning: 賣魚佬洗身——冇晒腥氣（比喻本性或出身難以改變，外表改變也難掩原來的習性或痕跡）
english_meaning: A fishmonger washing himself — you can't get rid of the fishy smell (i.e., people’s nature/background or old habits are hard to change or hide)
explanation_mandarin: 這句廣東話俗語字面上指賣魚的人洗澡後仍帶有魚腥味，借以比喻人的本性、背景或習慣難以徹底改變或掩蓋，常用於評述某人雖改變外表或身份，但舊有痕跡仍明顯。
explanation_english: Literally 'a fishmonger washes himself — no more fishy smell,' used ironically. It means a person's nature, background, or ingrained habits are hard to change or hide; changing appearance or role often doesn't remove telltale traces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗新衫，話想改頭換面，但大家都話係賣魚佬洗身——冇晒腥氣，唔係咁容易改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 san1 saam1, waa6 soeng2 goi2 tau4 wun6 min6, daan6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 hai6 maai6 jyu4 lou2 sai2 san1 — mou5 saai3 sang1 hei3, m4 hai6 gam2 jung4 ji6 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他換了新衣，說想改頭換面，但大家都說「賣魚佬洗身——冇晒腥氣」，不是那麼容易改變。
examples.english_sentence: He changed into new clothes and said he wanted a fresh start, but everyone says 'a fishmonger may wash himself — you can't get rid of the fishy smell', meaning it's not that easy to change.

mandarin_meaning: 賣鹹蛋（字面：販售鹹蛋）；俚語用法：賣弄風騷、調戲或對異性放電
english_meaning: Literally 'sell salted eggs' (to vend salted eggs); slang: to act lecherous or flirtatious, to make sexual advances or ogle
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（可作字面或俚語用法）
explanation_mandarin: 「賣鹹蛋」字面意思是販賣鹹蛋，用於市集、買賣等情境；在口語俚語中常用來形容某人對異性賣弄風騷、放電或有猥褻、調戲的行為，帶貶義或戲謔意味。
explanation_english: Literally it means selling salted eggs (as a vendor). Colloquially in Cantonese slang it describes someone acting lecherous or flirtatious — making sexualized advances, ogling, or behaving in a way that makes others uncomfortable. It carries a derogatory or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺街市賣鹹蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai6 haam4 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老太太在菜市場賣鹹蛋。
examples.english_sentence: The grandmother sells salted eggs at the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺女仔面前賣鹹蛋，令人尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 neoi5 zai2 min6 cin4 maai6 haam4 daan6, ling6 jan4 gon1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在女孩面前賣弄風騷，讓人尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: He often acts lecherous in front of the girls, which makes people feel embarrassed.

mandarin_meaning: 卖咸鱼（字面：出售腌制的鱼；引申：在口语中可表示放弃、做咸鱼/当咸鱼，即无所作为）
english_meaning: to sell salted fish (literal); colloquially can imply giving up or being a 'salted fish' — i.e. being idle or without ambition
partOfSpeech_english: verb (transitive); (colloquial usage) verb/phrase expressing a state
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思：販賣經過鹽漬或風乾處理的魚，是一種食物的買賣。2) 引申/口語意思：鹹魚在粵語俗語中常用來形容對生活不抱希望、沒幹勁或放棄奮鬥的人；因此「賣鹹魚」有時會被非正式地用來表示放棄或變成“鹹魚”。
explanation_english: 1) Literal meaning: to sell salted (preserved) fish — a food trade. 2) Colloquial/figurative: in Cantonese '鹹魚' (salted fish) is used metaphorically for a person who has no ambition or has given up; therefore '賣鹹魚' can occasionally be used informally to suggest giving up or becoming a 'salted fish' (idle, resigned). The figurative use is informal and less literal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺街市賣鹹魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai6 haam4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿婆在菜市场卖咸鱼。
examples.english_sentence: The old woman sells salted fish at the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失敗咗咁多次，我都想賣鹹魚算喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 baai6 zo2 gam2 do1 ci3, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 maai6 haam4 jyu4 syun3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失败了这么多次，我都想放弃算了。
examples.english_sentence: I've failed so many times that I'm thinking of giving up.

mandarin_meaning: 卖咸鸭蛋
english_meaning: to sell salted duck eggs
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是出售鹹鴨蛋（鹹鴨蛋是一種傳統食品）。在廣東話中，這個短語主要用作字面表達，描述販賣鹹鴨蛋的行為，並無廣泛固定的比喻義（如有地區性或個別語境的轉義會另行標註）。
explanation_english: Literally means to sell salted duck eggs (a traditional food). In Cantonese this phrase is primarily used literally to describe the act of selling salted duck eggs; it does not have a widely recognized idiomatic meaning in general Cantonese usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街市賣鹹鴨蛋，做咗好多年生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai6 haam4 ngaap3 daan6, zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街市卖咸鸭蛋，做了很多年生意。
examples.english_sentence: He sells salted duck eggs at the market and has been in that business for many years.

mandarin_meaning: 賣點 (mài diǎn)
english_meaning: selling point; a feature or aspect that makes something attractive to buyers or audiences
explanation_mandarin: 指商品、服務或作品吸引顧客或觀眾的特點或亮點；口語亦可用來形容一個人或事的吸引力。
explanation_english: Refers to the feature or highlight of a product, service, or work that attracts customers or audiences; colloquially can also describe a person's attractive quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影嘅賣點係啲特效同埋緊湊嘅劇情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou2 din6 jing2 ge3 maai6 dim2 hai6 di1 dak6 haau6 tung4 maai4 gan2 cau3 ge3 kek6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影的賣點是特效和緊湊的劇情。
examples.english_sentence: The selling points of this movie are the special effects and the fast-paced plot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要強調產品嘅賣點，先至可以吸引到客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 koeng4 diu6 caan2 ban2 ge3 maai6 dim2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 hap1 jan5 dou3 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要強調產品的賣點，才能吸引顧客。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to emphasize the product's selling points to attract customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最大嘅賣點就係佢嘅幽默感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 maai6 dim2 zau6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 jau1 mak6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最大的賣點就是他的幽默感。
examples.english_sentence: His biggest selling point is his sense of humor.

mandarin_meaning: 卑賤；便宜（價格低廉）；卑劣、下流
english_meaning: cheap (low-priced); lowly, despicable, sleazy
explanation_mandarin: 「賤」可指價格低廉（便宜），亦可形容人格、行為卑劣、下流或低賤。日常廣東話中也常用作貶義形容人或言行。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 賤 can mean inexpensive or cheap in price, and also describe someone or something as lowly, despicable, or sleazy. Commonly used as a derogatory adjective for people or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好賤，質量又差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 zin6, zat1 loeng6 jau6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很便宜，质量又差。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very cheap and the quality is poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲嘢真係幾賤喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 zan1 hai6 gei2 zin6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的那些话真有点卑劣/低俗。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was pretty sleazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出賣朋友，真係好賤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 maai6 pang4 jau5, zan1 hai6 hou2 zin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出卖朋友，真是卑鄙。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed his friend; that's really despicable.

mandarin_meaning: 賤人（蔑稱、罵人的用語，形容道德低下或卑鄙的人）
english_meaning: despicable person; a derogatory term for someone mean, low, or morally contemptible
explanation_mandarin: 「賤人」是粗俗的罵人用語，用來形容行為卑鄙、刻薄或令人厭惡的人。常見於口語或情緒化的語境，帶有強烈侮辱意味。
explanation_english: A coarse insult used to call someone despicable, mean, or morally low. It appears in colloquial and emotional speech and carries a strong derogatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，真係賤人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6, zan1 hai6 zin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做，真是個賤人。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that, you're really a despicable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講人壞話，真係賤人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 zin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天說別人壞話，真是個賤人。
examples.english_sentence: He is always badmouthing others — truly a despicable person.

mandarin_meaning: 廉价；低价
english_meaning: cheap; low-priced; at a bargain price
explanation_mandarin: 「賤價」用來形容售賣價格很低，常指商品或服務的價格便宜；在某些語境下也可能暗示品質較差或被低估。
explanation_english: Used to describe something sold at a very low price; often refers to goods or services being cheap. In some contexts it can imply inferior quality or being undervalued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲衫賤價，快啲買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 saam1 zin3 gaa3, faai3 di1 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的衣服价格便宜，快点买吧。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes here are cheap; buy them quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨賤價唔代表質素差，但要小心陷阱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 zin3 gaa3 m4 doi6 biu2 zat1 sou3 caa1, daan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 haam6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商品价格低并不代表质量差，但要小心陷阱。
examples.english_sentence: Low prices don't necessarily mean poor quality, but watch out for traps.

mandarin_meaning: 賤內（jiàn nèi）— 丈夫對自己妻子的自謙稱呼
english_meaning: my wife (a humble/self-deprecating term a husband uses to refer to his own wife)
explanation_mandarin: 「賤內」為傳統書面語或口語中的謙稱，通常由丈夫用來自稱自己的妻子。現代用法有時帶幽默或書面色彩，亦可見於正式或半正式場合的自謙稱呼。
explanation_english: “賤內” is a traditional humble term used by a husband to refer to his own wife. In modern usage it can sound humorous or literary and is sometimes used in formal or self-deprecating contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我賤內今日唔舒服，唔會出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zin6 noi6 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, m4 wui5 ceot1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我賤內今天不舒服，不會出來。
examples.english_sentence: My wife isn't feeling well today and won't come out.

mandarin_meaning: 指為人卑鄙、下流或低等的人（貶義）
english_meaning: A derogatory term for a despicable, low-class, mean, or shameless person
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的貶義俚語，用來罵人卑鄙、下流或行為低劣，帶有強烈侮辱意味，常用於口語中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese derogatory slang word used to insult someone as despicable, low-class, mean, or shameless. It is informal and carries strong negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係賤格，成日呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 zin6 gaak3, seng4 jat6 ngok3 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真下賤，老是騙人錢財。
examples.english_sentence: You're really despicable, always cheating people out of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講完嘢就走，真係賤格！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 je5 zau6, zan1 hai6 zin6 gaak3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說完話就走，真是卑鄙！
examples.english_sentence: He finished speaking and left — what a despicable person!

mandarin_meaning: 被視為地位低下或受歧視的人；下賤的人（也可作侮辱用語）
english_meaning: a lowly person; pariah; someone of low social status (often used pejoratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指在社會中被視為地位低下、受排斥或歧視的人群；有時用作貶稱，或出現在描述古代階級制度的語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to people regarded as low-status, ostracized, or discriminated against; sometimes used as a derogatory term or in contexts describing historical class systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺啲古裝劇入面，底層百姓成日畀人貶稱做賤民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 di1 gu2 zong1 kek6 jap6 min6, dai2 cang4 baak3 sing3 sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 bin2 cing1 zou6 zin3 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在一些古装剧里，底层百姓常常被贬称为賤民。
examples.english_sentence: In some historical dramas, lower-class commoners are often disparagingly called '賤民'.

mandarin_meaning: 賤人；卑鄙、下流的人（貶義、口語）
english_meaning: A despicable, low, or contemptible person (derogatory slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話口語中用來罵人或形容某人卑鄙、無恥、令人厭惡。屬粗俗的貶義用語，帶有強烈情緒色彩，常用於表示憤怒或蔑視。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang insult used to label someone as despicable, shameless, or contemptible. Vulgar and derogatory, it carries strong emotional weight and is used to express anger or disdain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個賤泥，唔使理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 zin6 nai4, m4 sai2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個賤人，不要理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a despicable person; don't bother with him.

mandarin_meaning: 贱物斗穷人（俚语、贬义），用来形容品行卑劣或小气的人互相争吵、互相贬低，意指双方都很卑劣、毫无道德可言。
english_meaning: A pejorative slang phrase meaning 'scum competing with the poor' — used to describe petty, despicable people who belittle or fight each other, implying both sides are lowly or shameful.
explanation_mandarin: 形容兩方人馬互相貶低、爭吵、出賣尊嚴，帶有強烈貶義與諷刺意味，常用於評論低俗或小氣的衝突場面。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people engage in mutual belittling or petty fights; a strongly derogatory, ironic expression used to criticize tawdry, mean-spirited disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度鬧嚟鬧去，完全係賤物鬥窮人，冇意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 nou6 lai4 nou6 heoi3, jyun4 cyun4 hai6 jin6 mat6 dau3 kung4 jan4, mou4 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在这里互相骂来骂去，完全是在“贱物斗穷人”，很没意思。
examples.english_sentence: They're insulting each other back and forth; it's totally 'scum competing with the poor'—a pointless, petty spat.

mandarin_meaning: 卑鄙的人；可鄙的傢伙（貶義）
english_meaning: a despicable person; scumbag (pejorative insult)
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗的廣東話罵人用語，字面為「賤的狗」，用來侮辱對方卑鄙、下作或不值得信任。屬於非正式且冒犯性的用語，不宜在禮貌或正式場合使用。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese insult literally meaning "cheap/lowly dog." Used to call someone despicable, low, or untrustworthy. It's an informal and offensive term — inappropriate in polite or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條賤狗，唔好再搵我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 zin6 gau2, m4 hou2 zoi3 wan2 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个卑鄙的人，别再来找我！
examples.english_sentence: You despicable scumbag — don't contact me again!

mandarin_meaning: 賤種（侮辱性用語，指卑鄙、可恥或低賤的人）
english_meaning: a contemptible person; scum; low-life (pejorative insult)
explanation_mandarin: 「賤種」是粗俗的罵人說法，用來形容品行卑劣、可恥或卑鄙的人，帶強烈侮辱意味，日常口語中屬於粗俗用語。
explanation_english: “賤種” is a coarse, derogatory Cantonese insult used to describe someone who is despicable, dishonorable, or morally low. It carries strong contempt and is considered vulgar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係賤種，成日騙人攞利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zin3 zung2, seng4 jat6 pin3 jan4 lo2 lei6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個賤種，總是騙人謀取利益。
examples.english_sentence: He's such scum; he always deceives people to gain benefits.

mandarin_meaning: 愛耍小聰明、愛鬧人或愛調戲他人的機靈、厚臉皮（粵語俚語）
english_meaning: a cheeky/shameless rascal; someone who deliberately teases, flirts, or acts slyly (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「賤精」是粵語俚語，用來形容一個人愛耍小聰明、調戲、取笑或厚臉皮地惡作劇。語氣可戲謔或帶批評，常用於朋友間打趣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who is cheeky, shamelessly teasing, flirtatious, or mischievously sly. Can be used jokingly among friends or pejoratively depending on tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁賤精做咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zin3 zing1 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼賤精幹嘛？（你這麼愛耍小聰明/調皮幹嘛？）
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being such a cheeky rascal?

mandarin_meaning: 贱货（jiànhuò）——侮辱性称呼，指品行低劣或卑鄙的人，常用于骂人。
english_meaning: despicable person; derogatory insult (literally 'cheap/lowly goods'), used to demean someone.
explanation_mandarin: “賤貨”在粤语中是一种粗俗的骂人用语，用来指责或侮辱他人的品行或人格，具有明显的贬义和攻击性，使用时会冒犯对方。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '賤貨' is a coarse, insulting slang term used to denigrate someone's character or behavior. It carries strong negative connotations and is offensive when directed at a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係賤貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zin6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个贱货。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a despicable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好叫人做賤貨，太過分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 giu3 jan4 zou6 zin6 fo3, taai3 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要叫别人贱货，太过分了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call someone '賤貨' — that's too much.

mandarin_meaning: 以低價出售；貶低價值地賣出
english_meaning: to sell cheaply; to undersell or dispose of something at a low price (literal), or to devalue oneself/one's skills (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 指把商品以很低的價格賣出，常用於清貨或打折出售。也可比喻貶低自身或某物的價值，把它們“賣個很便宜”。
explanation_english: Refers to selling goods at a very low price, often used for clearance or heavy discounting. It can also be used figuratively to mean undervaluing or selling oneself/one's skills short.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖頭為咗清貨，啲衫全部賤賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau4 wai6 zo2 cing1 fo3, di1 saam1 cyun4bou6 zin6 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間店為了清貨，把衣服全部賤賣。
examples.english_sentence: The shop is clearing stock and selling all the clothes off cheaply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賤賣自己嘅技能，應該爭取更好嘅報酬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zin6 maai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gei6 nang4, jing1 goi1 zang1 ceoi2 gang3 hou2 ge3 bou3 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要貶低自己的技能，應該爭取更好的報酬。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sell your skills short; you should strive for better compensation.

mandarin_meaning: 卑鄙至極／比泥還低（形容人非常下賤、無恥）
english_meaning: Literally 'lower than mud' — extremely despicable, contemptible, or shameless
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人品行極其卑劣或無恥，表示強烈蔑視與譴責。
explanation_english: A colloquial insult used to describe someone as utterly despicable or shameless, expressing strong contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗利益乜嘢都做得出，真係賤過地底泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 lei6 jik6 mat1 je5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1, zan1 hai6 zin6 gwo3 dei6 dai2 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了利益什麼事都做得出，真是卑鄙至極。
examples.english_sentence: He would do anything for profit — he's truly despicable.

mandarin_meaning: 賤骨頭；下賤的人，貶義，指品行低下或道德敗壞、輕浮或不檢點的人。
english_meaning: A despicable or lowly person (derogatory); someone regarded as immoral, shameless, or 'cheap', often implying they'd do anything for money or advantage.
explanation_mandarin: 用來罵人，形容人卑賤、不檢點或為了利益什麼都肯做，帶有強烈貶義與侮辱意味。
explanation_english: An insulting term used to label someone as lowly, immoral, or shameless—suggesting they are willing to do anything for gain; strongly pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗啲錢乜都肯做，真係賤骨頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 di1 cin2 mat1 dou1 hang2 zou6, zan1 hai6 zin3 gwat1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了錢什麼都肯做，真是個賤骨頭。
examples.english_sentence: He'll do anything for money — what a despicable person.

mandarin_meaning: 賦（fù）：賦予、賦稅；古指賦詩、賦文
english_meaning: fu (to grant/bestow; to levy/tax; classical: rhapsody/poetic composition)
explanation_mandarin: 「賦」在古代可指一種詩體（賦），現代常見用法有「賦予」（給予、授予）和「賦稅」（徵稅、徵收）。
explanation_english: In classical usage, 賦 refers to a rhapsody or poetic form. In modern usage it's commonly used as a verb meaning to grant/bestow (賦予) or to levy/tax (賦稅).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府賦予我哋更多權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 fu3 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 gang3 do1 kyun4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府賦予我們更多權利。
examples.english_sentence: The government grants us more rights.

mandarin_meaning: 赋予（授予、给予权利、职责等）
english_meaning: to grant; to bestow; to confer; to assign (rights, duties, titles)
explanation_mandarin: 表示将某种权利、职责、名衔或事物给予他人，语体偏正式，常用于书面或正式场合。
explanation_english: Indicates giving or conferring something (rights, responsibilities, titles, etc.) to someone; a formal verb often used in written or official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司賦予佢新職務同埋更多責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 fu3 jyu5 keoi5 san1 zik1 mou6 tung4 maai4 gang1 do1 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司赋予他新的职务和更多责任。
examples.english_sentence: The company has granted him a new position and more responsibilities.

mandarin_meaning: 賦稅（fùshuì）：稅收，政府向個人或企業徵收的稅款。
english_meaning: taxes; taxation — taxes or levies imposed by the government on individuals or businesses.
explanation_mandarin: 賦稅指政府為了提供公共服務與支出，向公民或企業徵收的各類稅款與費用，是國家財政的主要來源之一。
explanation_english: Taxes imposed by the government on individuals or businesses to fund public services and expenditures; a primary source of government revenue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該公平咁徵收賦稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 gung1 ping4 gam2 zing1 sau1 fu3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該公平地徵收賦稅。
examples.english_sentence: The government should collect taxes fairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 稅務部門會調查企業有冇偷漏賦稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 mou6 bou6 mun4 wui5 diu6 caa4 kei5 jip6 jau5 mou5 tau1 lau6 fu3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 稅務部門會調查企業有沒有偷漏賦稅。
examples.english_sentence: The tax authorities will investigate whether companies have evaded taxes.

mandarin_meaning: 賦稅（赋税，fùshuì）
english_meaning: taxes; taxation
explanation_mandarin: 指政府向個人或企業徵收的稅款，用以支應公共支出、社會服務及其他國家或地方開支。
explanation_english: Refers to taxes levied by a government on individuals or businesses to fund public expenditures, social services, and other state or local expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該減輕中低收入者嘅賦稅負擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 gam2 hing1 zung1 dai1 sau1 jap6 ze2 ge3 fu3 seoi3 fu6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該減輕中低收入者的賦稅負擔。
examples.english_sentence: The government should reduce the tax burden on middle- and low-income earners.

mandarin_meaning: 賦稅；稅收
english_meaning: taxes; taxation; tax revenue
explanation_mandarin: 指國家或政府向個人或企業徵收的款項（如所得稅、消費稅等），即稅收，是政府財政收入的一部分，用於公共支出與社會服務。
explanation_english: Refers to amounts levied by the state or government from individuals and businesses (e.g., income tax, consumption tax); i.e., taxation or tax revenue. It is a main part of public finance used to fund government expenditures and services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃調整賦税制度，減輕中低收入家庭嘅負擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 tiu4 zing2 fu3 seoi3 zai3 dou6, gaam2 hing1 zung1 dai1 sau1 jap6 gaa1 ting4 ge3 fu6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府計劃調整賦稅制度，減輕中低收入家庭的負擔。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to adjust the taxation system to reduce the burden on middle- and low-income families.

mandarin_meaning: 質（zhì）：品質、本質；作動詞可表示質疑（提出疑問）或質押（當）。
english_meaning: quality; essence; (verb) to question/doubt; to pawn/pledge.
explanation_mandarin: 「質」作名詞時常指事物的品質或本質；作動詞時可表示對某事提出質疑（懷疑、詢問）或將物品抵押（質押、當）。
explanation_english: As a noun, '質' refers to the quality or essence of something. As a verb it can mean to question/doubt (to query) or to pawn/pledge an item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅質素好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zat1 sou3 hou2 gou1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的質素很高。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this restaurant is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢質疑嗰份報告嘅可信性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zat1 ji4 go2 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 ho2 seon3 sing3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他質疑那份報告的可信性。
examples.english_sentence: He questioned the credibility of that report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去當舖質咗佢嘅金錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 dong3 pou3 zat1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gam1 biu1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去當舖把他的金表當了。
examples.english_sentence: He pawned his gold watch at the pawnshop.

mandarin_meaning: 质问；责问
english_meaning: to question; to interrogate; to reproach
explanation_mandarin: 对某人提出严肃或责备性的询问，常用于正式或较强烈的质疑场合。
explanation_english: To ask someone questions in a serious or reproachful manner; often used for formal or stern interrogation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀經理質問佢點解遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 ging1 lei5 zat1 man6 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被经理质问为什么迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He was questioned by the manager about why he was late.

mandarin_meaning: 质地
english_meaning: texture; material quality (of a fabric, food, wood, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指物體或材料的觸感、結構或品質，例如衣料、木材或食物的口感與質感。
explanation_english: Refers to the tactile quality, structure, or material quality of something — for example the feel of a fabric, the grain of wood, or the texture of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅質地好柔軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 zat1 dei6 hou2 jau4 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的质地很柔软。
examples.english_sentence: The texture of this shirt is very soft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用嘅木材質地唔錯，好結實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung6 ge3 muk6 coi4 zat1 dei6 m4 co3, hou2 git3 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用的木材质地不错，很结实。
examples.english_sentence: The wood they used has good quality; it's very sturdy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個芝士蛋糕質地好幼滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi1 si6 daan6 gou1 zat1 dei6 hou2 jau1 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个芝士蛋糕的质地很幼滑。
examples.english_sentence: This cheesecake has a very smooth texture.

mandarin_meaning: 质子（原子核內帶正電的粒子）；古義：作為人質的人
english_meaning: proton (subatomic particle carrying positive charge); archaic/historical: hostage (a person held to guarantee agreements)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 在現代科學語境中，質子指原子核內帶正電的基本粒子。2) 在古代文獻中，質子可指被送去作人質的人，用以保證盟約或和平。
explanation_english: 1) In modern scientific contexts, a proton is a fundamental particle in the atomic nucleus carrying a positive charge. 2) In historical or classical usage, 質子 refers to a person sent as a hostage to guarantee treaties or alliances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺物理學入面，質子係帶正電嘅粒子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 mat6 lei5 hok6 jap6 min6, zat1 zi2 hai6 daai3 zing3 din6 ge3 lap6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在物理学中，质子是带正电的粒子。
examples.english_sentence: In physics, a proton is a positively charged particle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時候，諸侯會送質子去當人質，以保證盟約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 hau6, zyu1 hau4 wui5 sung3 zat1 zi2 heoi3 dong1 jan4 zat1, ji5 bou2 zing3 maang4 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时候，诸侯会送质子去当人质，以保证盟约。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, feudal lords would send hostages (質子) to guarantee alliances.

mandarin_meaning: 质感 (zhìgǎn)
english_meaning: tactile quality; texture; sense of quality (premium feel)
explanation_mandarin: 指物品或設計給人的質地、觸感，以及整體所傳達的品質感或高級感。
explanation_english: Refers to the tactile quality or texture of an object or design and the overall impression of quality or premium feel it conveys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件外套好有質感，睇落好高級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 hou2 jau5 zat1 gam2, tai2 lok6 hou2 gou1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件外套很有质感，看起来很高级。
examples.english_sentence: This coat has great quality; it looks very high-end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計師好注重產品嘅質感同手感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sit3 gai3 si1 hou2 zyu3 zung3 caan2 ban2 ge3 zat1 gam2 tung4 sau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 设计师很注重产品的质感和手感。
examples.english_sentence: Designers pay close attention to a product's perceived quality and tactile feel.

mandarin_meaning: 质数 (zhìshù)
english_meaning: prime number
explanation_mandarin: 质数是大于1且除了1和它本身外没有其他正因数的整数。
explanation_english: An integer greater than 1 that has no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 七係一個質數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cat1 hai6 jat1 go3 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 七是一个质数。
examples.english_sentence: 7 is a prime number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 0同1唔係質數，因為質數要大過1。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling4 tung4 jat1 m4 hai6 zat1 sou3, jan1 wai6 zat1 sou3 jiu3 daai6 gwo3 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 0和1不是质数，因为质数要大于1。
examples.english_sentence: 0 and 1 are not prime numbers because primes must be greater than 1.

mandarin_meaning: 质料；材料；（口語）人的素質、本事
english_meaning: material; quality (of a substance); (colloquial) someone's calibre or talent
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指物質或原料，例如製作衣物或傢俱所用的材料。2) 口語用法指人的素質、能力或潛力（例如「有質料」表示有本事、有前途）。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to physical material or raw materials, e.g., materials used for clothing or furniture. 2) Colloquial usage refers to a person's calibre, ability, or potential (e.g., "has the stuff" / "promising").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅質料好好，著得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 zat1 liu2 hou2 hou2, zoek3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的质料很好，穿起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The material of this garment is very good; it's comfortable to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有質料，將來一定有出息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 zat1 liu2, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 jau5 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的有本事，將來一定有出息。
examples.english_sentence: He's really promising; he'll definitely succeed in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做傢俬要揀好嘅質料，先至耐用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 gaa1 si1 jiu3 gaan2 hou2 ge3 zat1 liu2, sin1 zi3 noi6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做家具要选好的材料，才能耐用。
examples.english_sentence: When making furniture you should choose good materials so it will be durable.

mandarin_meaning: 質樸 (形容樸實、自然、不矯飾)
english_meaning: simple; unadorned; plain; sincere; unpretentious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物樸實、自然、沒有華麗裝飾，常帶有真誠、不造作的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is simple, unadorned, and sincere — not showy or pretentious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人好質樸，冇虛偽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 zat1 pok3, mou5 heoi1 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很質樸，沒有虛偽。
examples.english_sentence: He is very unpretentious and sincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條村保持住好質樸嘅風貌，好有鄉土感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 bou2 ci4 zyu6 hou2 zat1 pok3 ge3 fung1 mou6, hou2 jau5 hoeng1 tou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條村保有很質樸的風貌，很有鄉土感。
examples.english_sentence: This village retains a very simple, unadorned character; it feels very rustic.

mandarin_meaning: 质朴无华（zhì pǔ wú huá），形容朴素、不华丽、没有矫饰或浮夸的外表。
english_meaning: Plain and unadorned; simple and unpretentious.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人的性格或事物的風格很樸實，不講究華麗裝飾，給人真誠、自然的感覺。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is simple, unpretentious, and without showy decoration—giving an impression of sincerity and naturalness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人質樸無華，唔鍾意炫耀，大家都幾欣賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zat1 pok3 mou4 waa4, m4 zung1 ji3 hyun3 jiu6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gei2 jan1 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他個性質樸無華，不喜歡炫耀，大家都很欣賞他。
examples.english_sentence: He is plain and unpretentious, doesn't like to show off, and everyone admires him.

mandarin_meaning: 质疑；对某事或某人的真实性、合理性提出怀疑或疑问
english_meaning: to question; to cast doubt on; to express skepticism about the truth, validity, or credibility of something or someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事或某人提出懷疑或疑問，質疑其真實性、合理性或可信度。
explanation_english: To express doubt or raise questions about the truth, validity, or credibility of something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢份報告嘅數據有啲質疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 jau5 di1 zat1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这份报告的数据有些质疑。
examples.english_sentence: I have some doubts about the data in this report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者質疑政府嘅決定唔夠透明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 zat1 ji4 zing3 fu2 ge3 kyut3 ding6 m4 gau3 tou4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者质疑政府的决定不够透明。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters questioned that the government's decision wasn't transparent enough.

mandarin_meaning: 品質；質量
english_meaning: quality (of something, e.g., product, service, performance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或服務的品質、水平或標準，常用於評價商品、服務或表現。
explanation_english: Refers to the standard or level of something (such as a product, service, or performance); used to evaluate how good or poor something is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅相機質素好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 soeng1 gei1 zat1 sou3 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機的相機品質很好。
examples.english_sentence: The camera quality of this phone is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要提高產品嘅質素先至可以留住客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 tai4 gou1 caan2 ban2 ge3 zat1 sou3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 lau4 zyu6 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要提高產品的品質才能留住顧客。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to improve product quality to retain customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 質素同價錢未必成正比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zat1 sou3 tung4 gaa3 cin2 mei6 bat1 seng4 zing3 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 品質和價格未必成正比。
examples.english_sentence: Quality and price are not necessarily proportional.

mandarin_meaning: 质询（对某人或某项政策以正式或公开方式提出问题或追究，常见于议会、听证或媒体提问）
english_meaning: To formally question or interrogate someone or to demand an explanation, often used in legislative, official, or media contexts.
explanation_mandarin: 指以正式或公開的方式向個人或機構提出問題或要求交代，常用於議會質詢或記者向官員提問等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to asking formal or public questions of a person or institution or demanding an explanation; commonly used for legislative questioning or journalists questioning officials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議員喺立法會上向政府提出質詢，希望政府交代最新嘅房屋政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 jyun4 hai2 laap6 faat3 wui2 soeng6 hoeng3 zing3 fu2 tai4 ceot1 zat1 seon1, hei1 mong6 zing3 fu2 gaau1 doi6 zeoi3 san1 ge3 fong4 uk1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 議員在立法會上向政府提出質詢，希望政府交代最新的房屋政策。
examples.english_sentence: A legislator questioned the government at the Legislative Council, asking it to explain the latest housing policy.

mandarin_meaning: 质谱仪
english_meaning: mass spectrometer (instrument for measuring mass-to-charge ratios of ions)
explanation_mandarin: 用於測量離子質量與電荷比的分析儀器，廣泛應用於化學、蛋白質組學、藥物分析與環境檢測等領域。
explanation_english: An analytical instrument that measures the mass-to-charge ratio of ions; widely used in chemistry, proteomics, drug analysis, and environmental testing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗室啲質譜儀壞咗，要通知工程師嚟維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 sat1 di1 zat1 pou2 ji4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 tung1 zi1 gung1 cing4 si1 lai4 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 实验室的质谱仪坏了，需要通知工程师来维修。
examples.english_sentence: The mass spectrometer in the lab broke down; we need to call an engineer to repair it.

mandarin_meaning: 质量（物理上的质量）或品质
english_meaning: mass (physics) ; quality (standard)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体的质量（物理学上的质量），也可指事物的品质或优劣程度。
explanation_english: Refers to mass in physics, and can also mean the quality or standard of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅產品質量好高，客人都好滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ge3 caan2ban2 zat1 loeng6 hou2 gou1, haak3jan4 dou1 hou2 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间公司的产品质量很高，顾客都很满意。
examples.english_sentence: This company's product quality is very high; customers are very satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺物理課我哋學到質量同重量唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 mat6 lei5 fo3 ngo5 dei6 hok6 dou3 zat1 loeng6 tung4 zung6 loeng6 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在物理课我们学到质量和重量不一样。
examples.english_sentence: In physics class we learned that mass and weight are not the same.

mandarin_meaning: 账；账目；账单；欠款 (zhàng)
english_meaning: account; bill; ledger; debt; (informally) to owe or record a debt
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（有时口语中作动词）
explanation_mandarin: 表示帳目、帳單或欠款，也可指記錄財務往來。在口語中有時當作動詞使用，指欠錢或記賬。
explanation_english: Refers to an account, bill, ledger, or debt; can mean recording financial transactions. Informally used as a verb to mean owing money or to keep accounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張賬單幾時要畀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zoeng3 daan1 gei2 si4 jiu3 bei2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张账单什么时候要付？
examples.english_sentence: When does this bill need to be paid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要記低所有嘅賬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gei3 dai1 so2 jau5 ge3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把所有的账记下来。
examples.english_sentence: We need to record all the accounts/transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再拖賬喇，快啲還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 zoeng3 laa3, faai3 di1 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再拖欠账款了，快点还钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep delaying the bill; pay the money back quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 账务
english_meaning: accounts; accounting; financial affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指与账目、会计记录和处理相关的事务或工作，例如公司或机构的财务往来与记账。
explanation_english: Refers to accounts and accounting matters — financial records and their handling, such as a company's bookkeeping and related tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅賬務由會計部負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zoeng3 mou6 jau4 wui6 gai3 bou6 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的账务由会计部负责。
examples.english_sentence: The company's accounts are handled by the accounting department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年底要整好所有賬務，等審計師嚟審核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 dai2 jiu3 zing2 hou2 so2 jau5 zoeng3 mou6, dang2 sam2 gei3 si1 lai4 sam2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年底要把所有账务整理好，等审计师来审核。
examples.english_sentence: All accounts need to be prepared at year-end for the auditor to review.

mandarin_meaning: 账单
english_meaning: bill; invoice; statement of charges
explanation_mandarin: 记录应付费用或已发生费用的单据或清单，例如水电费、购物发票或服务费用明细。
explanation_english: A document or list that records charges or amounts owed, such as utility bills, purchase invoices, or statements of charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以畀條賬單我睇下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 tiu4 zoeng3 daan1 ngo5 tai2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以把账单给我看看吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me the bill so I can check it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月嘅水電賬單仲未到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 seoi2 din6 zoeng3 daan1 zung6 mei6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的水电账单还没到。
examples.english_sentence: This month's utility bill hasn't arrived yet.

mandarin_meaning: 帳戶；账户（銀行或網路服務的賬號/戶口）
english_meaning: account (e.g., bank account or online/user account)
explanation_mandarin: 指銀行、支付平台或網路服務中用來存放資金或記錄使用者資訊的帳號或戶口。
explanation_english: Refers to an account used in banking, payment services, or online platforms to hold funds or record user information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺呢間銀行開咗一個新賬戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 ngan4 hong4 hoi1 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 zoeng3 wu6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在這家銀行開了一個新帳戶。
examples.english_sentence: I opened a new account at this bank.

mandarin_meaning: 账户 (zhànghù)
english_meaning: account (e.g., bank account)
explanation_mandarin: 指在銀行或其他機構開設用於存放資金或處理交易的賬目或戶口。
explanation_english: Refers to an account held at a bank or other institution used to store funds or handle transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想開一個銀行賬戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hoi1 jat1 go3 ngan4 hong4 zoeng3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想開一個銀行賬戶。
examples.english_sentence: I want to open a bank account.

mandarin_meaning: 账目（zhàngmù），财务记录或会计账簿上的收支项目
english_meaning: accounts; financial records; ledger entries
explanation_mandarin: 指用來記錄收支、往來款項或其他會計事項的條目或清單，常見於會計帳簿或財務報表中。
explanation_english: Refers to entries or items in bookkeeping that record income, expenses, and other financial transactions; commonly found in ledgers or financial statements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每個月都要核對賬目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 hat6 deoi3 zoeng3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每个月都要核对账目。
examples.english_sentence: The company has to reconcile its accounts every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話賬目有啲唔平衡，要搵會計查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zoeng3 muk6 jau5 di1 m4 ping4 hang4, jiu3 wan2 wui6 gai3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说账目有点不平衡，要找会计查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He said the accounts were a bit unbalanced and needs to get the accountant to check.

mandarin_meaning: 帳簿 (記錄收支、交易等的簿冊)
english_meaning: ledger; account book
explanation_mandarin: 用來記錄財務往來、收支、交易明細等資料的簿冊或帳本。
explanation_english: A book or record used to register financial transactions, income and expenses; an account book or ledger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你拎咗賬簿嚟未？我要睇下上個月嘅收支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ling1 zo2 zoeng3 bou2 lai4 mei6? ngo5 jiu3 tai2 haa5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 ge3 sau1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把帳簿拿來了嗎？我要看看上個月的收支。
examples.english_sentence: Did you bring the ledger? I need to check last month's income and expenses.

mandarin_meaning: 账号/帳號 (zhànghào)
english_meaning: account; account number; user account
explanation_mandarin: 指在互联网或系統中用於識別和登入的帳戶或帳號，可能指帳號編號或用戶名。
explanation_english: Refers to an account or account number used to identify and sign in to a service or system; can mean an account ID or a username.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅帳號被鎖咗，點算好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 zoeng3 hou6 bei6 so2 zo2, dim2 syun3 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的帳號被鎖了，怎麼辦？
examples.english_sentence: My account has been locked. What should I do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用呢個帳號登入網站或者應用程式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 ni1 go3 zoeng3 hou6 dang1 jap6 mong5 zaam6 waak6 ze2 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用這個帳號登錄網站或者應用程式。
examples.english_sentence: You can use this account to log into the website or the app.

mandarin_meaning: 账面
english_meaning: on the books; on paper; recorded in the accounts
explanation_mandarin: 指帳目或帳冊上記錄的情況，也可引申為書面、表面上的情況，與實際情況可能有差異。
explanation_english: Refers to what is recorded in accounting books or on paper; can also mean the superficial or stated situation as opposed to the real/actual situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋賬面上話公司賺咗錢，但實際上冇咁多現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng3 min6 soeng6 waa6 gung1si1 zaan6 zo2 cin2, daan6 sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 gam3 do1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们账面上说公司赚钱了，但实际上没有那么多现金。
examples.english_sentence: On the books they say the company made money, but in reality there isn't that much cash.

mandarin_meaning: 赌博；打赌
english_meaning: to gamble; to bet
explanation_mandarin: 指以金钱或财物为赌注进行风险性的投机或猜测活动，如赌博、下注或打赌。
explanation_english: To engage in gambling or betting, risking money or valuables on uncertain outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賭啦，已經輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dou2 laa3, ji5 ging1 sou1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要赌博了，已经输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't gamble anymore; you've already lost a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: （男性）自慰；打手槍
english_meaning: to masturbate (male); to jerk off
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗的香港粵語俚語，用英文字母 J 做委婉或隱晦的表達，指（男性）以手刺激生殖器自行獲得性快感（自慰）。
explanation_english: A vulgar Hong Kong Cantonese slang term using the letter 'J' as an euphemism; it refers to male masturbation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚一個人喺屋企賭J。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1maan5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 uk1 kei5 dou2 J
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚一個人在家打手槍。
examples.english_sentence: He's masturbating alone at home tonight.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）打賭；冒險一試
english_meaning: slang: to bet; to gamble; to take a risky chance / try one's luck
explanation_mandarin: 「賭jer」是香港口語，用「賭」加上俗寫的「jer」(對應粵語嘢/啫的口語變體)表示打賭或冒險一試，語氣較隨意。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression combining 賭 (to bet) with a colloquial particle written as "jer" (representing 嘢/啫). It means to place a bet, gamble, or take a risk/try one's luck; informal tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波我唔想賭jer，太危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 m4 soeng2 dou2 je5, taai3 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛我不想打赌，太危险。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to gamble on this game; it's too risky.

mandarin_meaning: 賭徒；嗜賭的人（常含貶義）
english_meaning: gambler; someone who frequently gambles (often pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱，指經常賭博或有賭癮的人，帶有負面或貶義色彩，常用於口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a person who gambles frequently or has a gambling addiction; usually informal and often carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個賭仔，成日去賭場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 dou2 zai2, sing4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個賭徒，經常去賭場。
examples.english_sentence: He's a gambler; he often goes to the casino.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同賭仔借錢，佢唔會還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 dou2 zai2 ze3 cin2, keoi5 m4 wui5 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和賭徒借錢，他不會還錢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lend money to a gambler; he won't pay you back.

mandarin_meaning: 赌债；赌博产生的债务
english_meaning: gambling debt
explanation_mandarin: 指因参与赌博而产生、需要偿还的欠款，通常欠给庄家或其他赌徒，可能伴随催债或暴力风险。
explanation_english: Debt incurred from gambling — money owed because of bets. Often owed to bookies or other gamblers; may involve collection pressure or risk of violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢欠咗一大筆賭債，唔敢出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him3 zo2 jat1 daai6 bat1 dou2 zaai3, m4 gam2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠了一大笔赌债，不敢出门。
examples.english_sentence: He owes a large gambling debt and doesn't dare to go out.

mandarin_meaning: 赌具；用于赌博的器具或工具
english_meaning: gambling equipment; implements or paraphernalia used for gambling
explanation_mandarin: 指用來進行賭博的器具或工具，例如籌碼、骰子、牌具等。通常在警方查案或規管賭博活動時會提及。
explanation_english: Refers to tools or implements used for gambling, such as chips, dice, playing cards, etc. Often mentioned in contexts like police investigations or regulation of gambling activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺倉庫搵到好多賭具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 cong1 fu3 wan2 dou3 hou2 do1 dou2 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在倉庫找到很多賭具。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a lot of gambling equipment in the warehouse.

mandarin_meaning: 赌博 (dǔbó)
english_meaning: gamble; gambling; to gamble
explanation_mandarin: 指以金錢或其他財物作賭注，進行以機會或技巧為基礎的遊戲或比賽，以求輸贏的行為。可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to wagering money or valuables on games or events of chance or skill to win or lose. Can be used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去賭博，已經輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 bok3, ji5 ging1 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去赌博，已经输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes gambling and has already lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港對某啲形式嘅賭博有嚴格嘅法例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 deoi3 mau5 di1 jing4 sik1 ge3 dou2 bok3 jau5 jim4 gaak3 ge3 faat3 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港对某些形式的赌博有严格的法律。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has strict laws on certain forms of gambling.

mandarin_meaning: 赌牌；打牌赌博
english_meaning: to gamble with cards; to bet on card games
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，指以打啤牌（打牌、玩撲克牌等）進行賭博、下注。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to gamble by playing cards (e.g., poker or local card games); to bet in card games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺茶餐廳同人賭啤，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 tung4 jan4 dou2 bei1, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在茶餐廳和人賭牌，輸了很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: He often gambles with cards at the cha chaan teng and lost a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: （只是）打賭；只是猜測／我打賭
english_meaning: just a bet / just a guess; 'I bet' (colloquial)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語動詞片語（表示猜測或打賭）
partOfSpeech_english: colloquial verb phrase / interjection (expressing speculation or a bet)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，賭表示打賭，啫用作語氣詞表示「只是／僅僅」，合起來常用來表示「我打賭（只是猜測）」或「只是賭一賭，別當真」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression: 賭 means to bet and 啫 is a particle meaning 'only/just'. Together it is used to indicate 'I'm just betting/guessing' or 'just a bet, don't take it seriously.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我賭啫佢唔會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou2 ze1 keoi5 m4 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打賭他不会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: I bet he won't be late.

mandarin_meaning: 赌场／赌博场所
english_meaning: casino; gambling house
explanation_mandarin: 指供人進行賭博活動的場所，通常有賭桌、角子機等娛樂設施。
explanation_english: A place where people go to gamble, typically featuring gaming tables, slot machines, and other betting facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚想唔想去賭場試下手氣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1maan5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 dou2 coeng4 si3 haa5 sau2 hei3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚想不想去赌场试试手气？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to go to the casino tonight to try your luck?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺賭場輸咗好多錢，宜家好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou2 coeng4 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, ji4 gaa1 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在赌场输了很多钱，現在很後悔。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money at the casino and now regrets it.

mandarin_meaning: 赌大小
english_meaning: to bet on 'big' or 'small' (a form of gambling); to take a gamble/take a risk
explanation_mandarin: 指在「大小」這類賭局中押注結果為「大」或「細」；也可引申為冒險、碰碰運氣或做出賭性的決定。
explanation_english: Refers to betting on the outcome being 'big' or 'small' in games of chance (e.g., dice, baccarat variants); by extension, it means taking a gamble or risking something on chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭大細，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou2 daai6 sai3, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是赌大小，输掉了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps betting on big-or-small and has lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好淨係賭大細，計清楚先做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dou2 daai6 sai3, gai3 cing1 co2 sin1 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不要只靠赌大小，先把事情算清楚再做决定。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not just gamble on big-or-small; figure things out clearly before deciding.

mandarin_meaning: 赌客；赌徒
english_meaning: gambler
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌场或以赌博为消遣或职业的人，参与下注、玩牌等赌博活动者。
explanation_english: A person who gambles; someone who frequents casinos or participates in betting and gambling activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位賭客輸咗好多錢，依家好後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 dou2 haak3 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, ji1 gaa1 hou2 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位赌客输了很多钱，现在很后悔。
examples.english_sentence: That gambler lost a lot of money and now regrets it.

mandarin_meaning: 赌局 (一次赌博活动或下注场合)
english_meaning: a gambling game/session; a betting event or gambling den
explanation_mandarin: 指进行赌博的一次活动、场合或一局赌注，常用于描述有组织或非法的赌博场面。
explanation_english: Refers to an instance or session of gambling—a betting event or game—often used for organized or illegal gambling gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺後巷開咗一個非法賭局，警方已經捉咗幾個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 hau6 hong6 hoi1 zo2 jat1 go3 fei1 faat3 dou2 guk6, ging2 fong1 ji5 ging1 zuk1 zo2 gei2 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在后巷开了一个非法赌局，警方已经抓了几个人。
examples.english_sentence: They set up an illegal gambling den in the back alley; the police have already arrested several people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅賭局大家都好緊張，因為輸贏好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 dou2 guk6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, jan1 wai6 syu1 jing4 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的赌局大家都很紧张，因为输赢很大。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone was very tense at tonight's gambling session because the stakes were high.

mandarin_meaning: 你可以赌多少都可以 / 随便赌多少都行
english_meaning: Bet as much as you want; go ahead and bet any amount
explanation_mandarin: 常用於打賭或比喻表示對下注數額不在乎或對結果非常有把握，意思是“隨便賭多少都可以”。有時用來表示自信或輕率放手一搏。
explanation_english: Used literally in gambling or figuratively to show that the speaker doesn't care about the stake or is very confident of winning. Means "you can bet any amount" or "bet as much as you want."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇少我，我賭幾多都得！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 ngo5, ngo5 dou2 gei2 do1 dou1 dak1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別小看我，我赌多少都行！
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate me — bet whatever you want!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢單買賣會賺錢，老闆話賭幾多都得，結果虧本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 daan1 maai5 maai6 wui5 zaam6 cin2, lou5 baan2 waa6 dou2 gei2 do1 dou1 dak1, git3 gwo2 fai1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这笔买卖会赚钱，老板说“赌多少都可以”，结果亏本。
examples.english_sentence: He said the deal would make money; the boss said "bet as much as you want," but it ended up losing money.

mandarin_meaning: 赌徒 (dǔtú)
english_meaning: gambler
explanation_mandarin: 指经常赌博或以赌博为嗜好或职业的人，常带有贬义，有时也指赌博成瘾者。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who gambles habitually or professionally; often carries negative connotations and can imply gambling addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個賭徒，成日去賭場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 dou2 tou4, sing4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个赌徒，经常去赌场。
examples.english_sentence: He is a gambler; he often goes to the casino.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲賭徒成日借錢嚟賭，結果負債纍纍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dou2 tou4 sing4 jat6 ze3 cin2 lai4 dou2, git3 gwo2 fu6 zai3 leoi4 leoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些赌徒经常借钱来赌博，结果负债累累。
examples.english_sentence: Gamblers often borrow money to gamble and end up heavily in debt.

mandarin_meaning: 打賭；賭博
english_meaning: to bet; to gamble; to wager
explanation_mandarin: 指以金錢或其他籌碼下注，賭輸贏；在口語中也可泛指打賭、冒險押注某種結果。
explanation_english: To place a bet or gamble — to wager money or other stakes on an uncertain outcome. Colloquially used for making a bet or taking a risky wager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭數，最後輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou2 sou3, zeoi3 hau6 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是赌博，最後輸了很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: He gambles all the time and ended up losing a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同你賭數，唔想冒險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 dou2 sou3, m4 soeng2 mou6 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想跟你打賭，不想冒險。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to bet with you; I don't want to take the risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭數唔好亂來，輸咗記得還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 sou3 m4 hou2 lyun6 loi4, syu1 zo2 gei3 dak1 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賭博不要隨便，输了要記得還錢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't gamble recklessly; if you lose, remember to pay what you owe.

mandarin_meaning: 賭博用的本金；用來下注的資金
english_meaning: the capital/stake used for gambling; bankroll
explanation_mandarin: 指用來賭博的本金或資金，也可引申為用於下注或冒險的資金來源。
explanation_english: Refers to the principal or funds used for gambling; can also be used figuratively for money staked on a bet or risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋輸晒所有嘅賭本，依家要向親友借錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 syu1 saai3 so2 jau5 ge3 dou2 bun2, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 hoeng3 can1 jau5 ze3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們把所有的賭本都輸光了，現在得向親友借錢。
examples.english_sentence: They lost all their gambling capital and now have to borrow money from friends and family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚唔好再用我畀你嘅賭本去賭波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6 ngo5 bei2 nei5 ge3 dou2 bun2 heoi3 dou3 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚不要再用我給你的賭本去賭球了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use the bankroll I gave you to bet on matches tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買股票唔係玩賭博，唔好當佢係賭本嚟玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 gu2 piu3 m4 hai6 waan2 dou2 bok3, m4 hou2 dong3 keoi5 hai6 dou2 bun2 lai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買股票不是賭博，不要把它當作賭本來玩。
examples.english_sentence: Buying stocks isn't gambling; don't treat it as gambling capital to play with.

mandarin_meaning: 在賭桌底下暗中作弊、做手腳；泛指暗地裡的不正當交易或操作
english_meaning: to cheat or rig a gambling game (literally 'under the gambling table'); more generally, an under-the-table shady deal or covert manipulation
explanation_mandarin: 指在賭博時暗中操控牌局、做手腳或進行私下交易，使賭局不公平；也可用來形容任何暗地裡的作弊或不正當操作。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly cheating or manipulating a gambling table (e.g. dealing from under the table), or more broadly to any covert, under-the-table cheating or shady dealings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺賭枱底做手腳，最後畀人揭穿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou2 toi4 dai2 zou6 sau2 goek3, zeoi3 hau6 bei2 jan4 kit3 cyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在賭桌底下做手腳，最後被人揭穿。
examples.english_sentence: They rigged the game under the table and were eventually exposed.

mandarin_meaning: 非法赌博地点；通常指街头或住宅区的小型赌博窝点（如赌摊、赌馆）
english_meaning: an illegal gambling den; a small-scale gambling operation (often a street or residential gambling spot)
explanation_mandarin: 「賭檔」是粤语俚语，指进行赌博活动的场所，通常规模较小，常见于街头、楼宇内或隐蔽场所，往往属于非法或未经许可的赌博窝点。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '賭檔' refers to a place where gambling takes place, usually small-scale and often illegal or unlicensed — for example a street stall, room or hidden venue used for gambling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座樓上有間賭檔，成日夜晚都有人出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 lau4 soeng6 jau5 gaan1 dou2 dong3, sing4 jat6 je6 maan5 dou1 jau5 jan4 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幢樓上有一家賭檔，常常晚上有人出入。
examples.english_sentence: There's a gambling den upstairs in that building; people come and go there every night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察最近查封咗幾間賭檔，拘捕咗多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zeoi3 gan6 caa4 fung1 zo2 gei2 gaan1 dou2 dong3, kau1 bou6 zo2 do1 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察最近查封了几家赌档，拘捕了多人。
examples.english_sentence: The police recently raided and shut down several gambling dens and arrested many people.

mandarin_meaning: 赌球 / 赌球（尤指赌球）
english_meaning: to bet on football (soccer); to gamble on sports
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，指在足球或其他體育賽事上下注（賭博）。在香港日常用語中常見，用法偏向俗語或俚語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to place bets on football (soccer) or to gamble on sports events. Commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭波，輸咗幾多錢我都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou2 bo1, syu1 zo2 gei2 do1 cin2 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常赌球，输掉了多少钱我都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: He often bets on football; I don't even know how much money he's lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家大家多數喺網上賭波，方便又快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 daai6 gaa1 do1 sou3 hai2 mong5 seong6 dou2 bo1, fong1 bin6 jau6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在大家多数在网上赌球，方便又快。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays most people bet on football online; it's convenient and fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭波有風險，記住唔好賭超出自己負擔嘅能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 bo1 jau5 fung1 him2, gei3 zyu6 m4 hou2 dou2 ciu1 ceot1 zi6 gei2 fu6 daam1 ge3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赌球有风险，记住不要赌超出自己负担的能力。
examples.english_sentence: Betting on football carries risks; remember not to bet beyond what you can afford.

mandarin_meaning: 赌注
english_meaning: bet; wager; stake
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博、比赛或交易中押上的钱或物，表示赌输赢的本金或风险承担。
explanation_english: Refers to the money or items staked in gambling, a contest, or a deal; the amount risked on an outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽嘅賭注好高，唔啱就會輸好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ge3 dou2 zyu3 hou2 gou1, m4 ngaam1 zau6 wui5 syu1 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛的赌注很高，猜错就会输很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: The stakes for this match are high; if you guess wrong you'll lose a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺賭場落咗一筆好大嘅賭注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou2 coeng4 lok6 zo2 jat1 bat1 hou2 daai6 ge3 dou2 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在赌场下了很大的一笔赌注。
examples.english_sentence: They placed a very large wager at the casino.

mandarin_meaning: 赌王；赌博高手或赌场大亨
english_meaning: king of gambling; a top gambler or casino magnate
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博方面非常擅长、赢得许多人尊称的人；也可指在赌业有巨大影响力的富商或大亨（例如何鸿燊曾被称为“赌王”）。
explanation_english: Refers to someone extremely skilled at gambling or widely respected for their gambling prowess; can also denote a powerful figure or magnate in the casino/gambling industry (e.g., Stanley Ho).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺賭場成日贏錢，大家都叫佢做賭王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou2 coeng4 sing4jat6 jing4 cin2, daai6gaa1 dou1 giu3 keoi5 zou6 dou2 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在赌场经常赢钱，大家都叫他赌王。
examples.english_sentence: He wins money at the casino all the time; everyone calls him the 'king of gambling'.

mandarin_meaning: 為了贏回先前損失而繼續賭博（追賭以圖翻本）
english_meaning: To continue gambling in an attempt to win back previous losses; to chase one's losses.
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指在輸了錢或利益後，繼續下注或賭博以期贏回損失，帶有不理性、追輸的含義。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to keep betting after losing in order to try to recover losses. It carries the connotation of irrational 'chasing losses.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人呃咗啲錢，唔好再去賭番攤，會越輸越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 di1 cin2, m4 hou2 zoi6 heoi3 dou2 faan1 taan1, wui5 jyut6 syu1 jyut6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被騙了一些錢，不要再去賭博想贏回來，會越輸越多。
examples.english_sentence: He lost some money to a scam; don't gamble to try to win it back—you'll just lose more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚輸到冇晒錢，佢仲諗住賭番攤，真係唔理智。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok6 maan5 syu1 dou3 mou5 saai3 cin2, keoi5 zung6 nam2 zyu6 dou2 faan1 taan1, zan1 hai6 m4 lei5 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚輸到沒有錢，他還想賭回來，真的不理智。
examples.english_sentence: He lost all his money last night and still wanted to gamble to get it back; it's really unwise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭場嗰啲人最鍾意有啲人會賭番攤——咁佢哋先有得抽水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 coeng4 go2 di1 jan4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 dou2 faan1 taan1 -- gam2 keoi5 dei6 sin1 jau5 dak1 cau1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賭場那些人最喜歡有人會賭回來——這樣他們才有得抽水（賺錢）。
examples.english_sentence: Casino people love it when players chase losses—it's how the house makes its cut.

mandarin_meaning: 打賭（某對情侶或夫妻）能否白頭偕老
english_meaning: to bet on whether a couple will grow old together; to wager on the longevity of a relationship
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語/俚語，字面是「賭（他們）有沒有白頭片」，實際指打賭一對情侶或夫妻能否白頭偕老，常用來調侃或表示懷疑感情能否長久。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase literally meaning 'to bet the white‑head photo'; it means to wager on whether a couple will grow old together (i.e., whether their relationship will last). Often used jokingly or to express doubt about a relationship's longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲朋友成日喺茶餐廳賭白頭片，估吓邊對情侶可以一齊到老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pang4 jau5 sing4 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 dou2 baak6 tau4 pin3, gu2 haa5 bin1 deoi3 cing4 leoi5 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 dou3 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 朋友們經常在茶餐廳打賭哪一對情侶可以一起到老。
examples.english_sentence: Friends often bet at the cha chaan teng on which couple will grow old together.

mandarin_meaning: 赌神
english_meaning: god of gamblers; an extremely skilled or legendary gambler
explanation_mandarin: 指在賭博方面技藝高超、幾乎無人能敵的人；亦常作綽號或來源於電影《賭神》（1989），用作稱讚或戲稱。
explanation_english: Refers to someone exceptionally skilled at gambling, almost unbeatable; also used as a nickname and popularized by the 1989 film 'God of Gamblers'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係賭神，冇人打得贏佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dou2 san4, mou5 jan4 daa2 dak1 jeng4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是赌神，沒有人能打得赢他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a gambling god; no one can beat him.

mandarin_meaning: 自封為「賭神」的人；自以為是的賭徒或愛在賭博場合炫耀自己的人
english_meaning: a person who fancies themselves a 'God of Gamblers'; a boastful gambler or someone who puts on airs about their gambling skill
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，帶貶義，指那些在賭博場合誇耀自己、或自認為賭術高超但實際可能並非如此的人。
explanation_english: Colloquial derogatory slang for someone who brags about their gambling ability or acts like a 'God of Gamblers', often implying overconfidence or pretension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做賭神頭，唔識就唔好亂押。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 dou2 san4 tau4, m4 sik1 zau6 m4 hou2 lyun6 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別做賭神頭，不懂就別亂押注。
