examples.english_sentence: Don't act like a 'God of Gamblers' — if you don't know what you're doing, don't bet randomly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺賭場成日扮賭神頭，結果輸到清袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou2 coeng4 sing4 jat6 baan6 dou2 san4 tau4, git3 gwo2 syu1 dou3 cing1 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在賭場裡常常裝作賭神頭，結果輸光了錢。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts like a 'God of Gamblers' at the casino, and ended up losing all his money.

mandarin_meaning: 孤注一擲、冒險一搏（把所有籌碼或資源押上）
english_meaning: to go all-in; to gamble everything; to take a high-risk, make-or-break gamble
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指把所有資源或籌碼押上，一次過冒險或做出孤注一擲的決定，常用於形容行為極為冒險或下大賭注。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to go all-in or take a high-risk gamble, betting all one's resources or making a last-ditch risky decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最後決定賭纜，將所有積蓄投晒入嗰間初創公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 dou2 laam5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 zik1 zuk1 tau4 saai3 jap6 go2 gaan1 co1 cong3 gung1 si1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最後決定孤注一擲，把所有積蓄都投進那家初創公司。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to go all-in and invested all his savings into that startup.

mandarin_meaning: 賭博船／船上賭場
english_meaning: gambling boat; floating casino; gambling ship
explanation_mandarin: 指在船上進行賭博活動的船隻或以船為場地的賭場，通常指為規避法律或在離岸水域營運的浮動賭場或非法賭博設施。
explanation_english: Refers to a boat or ship used for gambling activities, a floating casino or shipboard gambling venue—often operating offshore to evade regulations or as illegal gambling operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講而家有啲人會搭賭船去離岸賭場賭博。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 ji4 gaa1 jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 daap3 dou2 syun4 heoi3 lei4 ngon6 dou2 coeng4 dou2 bok3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說現在有人會坐賭船去離岸賭場賭博。
examples.english_sentence: I've heard that some people now take gambling boats to offshore casinos to gamble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府最近加強打擊賭船，拘捕咗好幾個嫌疑人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zeoi3 gan6 gaa1 koeng4 daa2 gik1 dou2 syun4, kau1 bou6 zo2 hou2 gei2 go3 jim4 ji4 jan4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府最近加強打擊賭船，拘捕了好幾個嫌疑人。
examples.english_sentence: The government recently stepped up actions against gambling boats and arrested several suspects.

mandarin_meaning: 赌博 (賭錢)
english_meaning: to gamble (money); to bet
explanation_mandarin: 用金钱进行赌博或下注的行为，指以钱财为赌注参与赌博活动。
explanation_english: The act of gambling money or placing bets; participating in games or activities where money is wagered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔好再賭錢啦，已經輸咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2_cin2 laa1, ji5 ging1 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不要再赌博了，已经输了很多。
examples.english_sentence: I won't gamble anymore; I've already lost a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間賭場唔畀未成年入去賭錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dou2 coeng4 m4 bei2 mei6 sing4 nin4 jap6 heoi3 dou2_cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家赌场不允许未成年人进去赌博。
examples.english_sentence: This casino doesn't allow minors to go in and gamble.

mandarin_meaning: 赌馆（指進行賭博的場所，常指非法或地下賭場）
english_meaning: gambling den; gambling house (often illegal or underground)
explanation_mandarin: 指供人進行賭博活動的場所，通常指非法或地下經營的賭場，也可泛指賭博場所。
explanation_english: A place where people gamble; often refers to an illegal or underground gambling establishment, though it can be used more generally for gambling venues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街有間賭館，成日有人出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 jau5 gaan1 dou2 gun2, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街有一家赌馆，常常有人出入。
examples.english_sentence: There's a gambling den on this street; people come and go all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方最近拆咗幾個地下賭館，拘捕咗好多賭客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 fong2 zeoi3 gan6 caak3 zo2 gei2 go3 dei6 haa6 dou2 gun2, kau1 bou6 zo2 hou2 do1 dou2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方最近拆了几处地下赌馆，拘捕了许多赌客。
examples.english_sentence: The police recently shut down several illegal gambling dens and arrested many gamblers.

mandarin_meaning: 赌马（在赛马中下注）
english_meaning: to bet on horse races; gamble on horses
explanation_mandarin: 指在赛马场或通过各种渠道对赛马进行下注，是一种赌博行为。也可泛指押注或冒险下注。
explanation_english: The act of placing bets on horse races; a form of gambling. It can also be used more generally to mean placing a wager or taking a risky bet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以前成日賭馬，輸咗好多錢，依家唔賭喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 cin4 sing4 jat6 dou2 maa5, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, ji1 gaa1 m4 dou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以前常常赌马，输了很多钱，现在不赌了。
examples.english_sentence: I used to bet on horse races all the time, lost a lot of money, and now I don't gamble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次去賽馬場，你有冇諗住賭馬？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 heoi3 coi3 maa5 coeng4, nei5 jau5 mou5 lam2 zyu6 dou2 maa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次去赛马场，你有没有打算赌马？
examples.english_sentence: Are you planning to bet on the races when we go to the racetrack this time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想戒賭，唔再賭馬，因為賭輸晒啲積蓄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 gaai3 dou2, m4 zoi3 dou2 maa5, jan1 wai6 dou2 syu1 saai3 di1 zik1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想戒赌，不再赌马，因为把积蓄都输光了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to quit gambling and won't bet on horses anymore because he lost all his savings.

mandarin_meaning: 赌鬼；嗜赌成性的人
english_meaning: gambler; gambling addict (a person addicted to gambling)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，指沉迷於賭博、無法自制、經常賭錢的人，有時帶貶義或戲稱。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to someone addicted to gambling or a compulsive gambler; often used pejoratively or jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個賭鬼，成日都去賭場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 dou2 gwai2, sing4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 dou2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个赌鬼，总是去赌场。
examples.english_sentence: He's a gambling addict; he always goes to the casino.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢借錢，佢係賭鬼，唔會還你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 ze3 cin2, keoi5 hai6 dou2 gwai2, m4 wui5 waan4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要跟他借钱，他是赌鬼，不会还你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lend him money—he's a gambler and won't pay you back.

mandarin_meaning: 赖；依赖；赖账（耍赖、不承认欠款）
english_meaning: to rely on; to renege/default on a debt; to act shamelessly (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「賴」在廣東話可表示依靠（如「依賴」）、耍無賴或拒不承認（如「賴帳」、「賴皮」），可作動詞或口語形容詞使用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 賴 (laai6) can mean to rely on (as in 依賴), to renege or default on a debt (賴帳), or to act shamelessly/cheekily (賴皮). It can be used as a verb and colloquially as an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賴皮，快啲畀返人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laai6 pei4, faai3 di1 bei2 faan1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別耍無賴，快點把錢還給別人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be shameless; hurry up and pay the money back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賴帳唔肯還錢，大家都好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laai6 zoeng3 m4 hang2 waan4 cin2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赖账不肯还钱，大家都很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He reneged on paying his debt and refuses to repay; everyone is very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好依賴你嘅幫助，唔該晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ji1 laai6 nei5 ge3 bong1 zo6, m4 goi1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常依赖你的帮助，謝謝。
examples.english_sentence: I rely heavily on your help, thank you.

mandarin_meaning: 死不認錯 / 死賴不肯離開或改變（口語）
english_meaning: to stubbornly refuse to admit fault or to refuse to budge; to brazenly cling to a position (colloquial)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞片語 / 形容詞（口語）
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，用來形容一個人死不承認錯誤、死皮賴臉或固執地堅持某種立場、拒絕離開或改變。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe someone who stubbornly refuses to admit they're wrong, brazenly clings to a stance, or refuses to move/change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明錯咗，仲賴地硬唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 co3 zo2, zung6 laai6 dei6 ngaang6 m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明錯了，還死賴著不肯認錯。
examples.english_sentence: He was clearly wrong but still stubbornly refused to admit it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友扭計，賴地硬唔肯起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 nau2 gei2, laai6 dei6 ngaang6 m4 hang2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個小孩耍脾氣，賴在地上不肯起來。
examples.english_sentence: The kid was sulking and stubbornly stayed on the floor, refusing to get up.

mandarin_meaning: 膽小、遇事退縮（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to chicken out; to be cowardly (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，字面意思是「尿褲子」，引申用來形容遇到困難或危險時退縮、膽小或不敢負責。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally meaning "to wet one's pants"; figuratively used to describe someone who chickens out, is cowardly, or backs out when faced with difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到麻煩就賴尿，唔肯幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 maa4faan4 zau6 laai6 niu6 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到麻煩就退縮，不肯幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He chickens out when there's trouble and won't help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好賴尿，要勇敢面對問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 laai6 niu6, jiu3 jung5 gam2 min6 deoi3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要臨陣退縮，要勇敢面對問題。
examples.english_sentence: Don't chicken out; be brave and face the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 膽小鬼；遇事退縮的人（粵語俗稱，帶貶義）
english_meaning: a coward; someone who chickens out (Cantonese slang, pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「賴尿蝦」是香港粵語俗稱，用來罵人膽小、遇到困難或危險就退縮、不敢面對的人。字面含義帶戲謔與貶抑成分。
explanation_english: “賴尿蝦” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to insult someone as a coward — a person who panics or backs out when faced with difficulty or danger. The term is jocular but pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做賴尿蝦，一齊上去啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 laai6 niu6 haa1, jat1 cai4 soeng5 heoi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當膽小鬼，我們一起上去吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a coward — let's go up together!

mandarin_meaning: 賴皮、推卸責任、裝無辜（粗俗用法）
english_meaning: to shirk responsibility or shamelessly make excuses (vulgar/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，帶有粗俗語氣，指推卸責任、賴皮或裝無辜，不願承認錯誤或逃避應負的責任。
explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar slang term used to describe shirking responsibility, making shameless excuses, or playing innocent to avoid admitting a mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好賴屎啦，做錯嘢就要承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 laai6 si2 laa1, zou6 co3 je5 zau6 jiu3 sing4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別賴屎了，做錯事就要承認。
examples.english_sentence: Don't 'laai si'—if you made a mistake, admit it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賴屎唔做嘢，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 laai6 si2 m4 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是賴屎不做事，真是令人討厭。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks work and makes excuses—it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 赖账；拒不还钱、推卸欠款责任
english_meaning: to renege on a debt; refuse to pay or deny responsibility for a debt
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示故意不履行還款義務、拒絕償還欠款或推卸欠款責任。
explanation_english: Informal expression meaning to deliberately fail to repay a debt, refuse to pay, or deny/avoid responsibility for a debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢欠咗我啲錢，而家竟然想賴帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him3 zo2 ngo5 di1 cin2, ji4 gaa1 ging2 jin4 soeng2 laai6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠了我的钱，现在竟然想赖账。
examples.english_sentence: He owes me money and now wants to renege on the debt.

mandarin_meaning: 賴床（賴在床上，不想起床或睡過頭）
english_meaning: to stay in bed; to sleep in; to be reluctant to get out of bed
explanation_mandarin: 指在早上不想起床、賴著床上不走或睡過頭，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Refers to staying in bed in the morning unwillingly or oversleeping; commonly used in spoken language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我又賴床，遲咗返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 jau6 laai6 cong4, ci4 zo2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我又賴床，上班遲到了。
examples.english_sentence: I slept in again this morning and was late for work.

mandarin_meaning: 死賴（死賴不承認、賴皮）
english_meaning: to stubbornly deny or shirk responsibility; (colloquial) extremely shameless/obstinate
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，帶貶義。表示某人死賴、不承認錯誤或推卸責任，也可用來強調某種負面性格（如賴皮、很不講理）。可作動詞或形容詞使用，常見於香港粵語日常對話。
explanation_english: A colloquial, derogatory Cantonese expression meaning to stubbornly deny, shirk responsibility, or be shamelessly obstinate. It can be used as a verb or adjective to emphasize a negative trait and is common in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賴死唔認係佢搞壞個杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laai6 sei2 m4 jing6 hai6 keoi5 gaau2 waai6 go3 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他死賴着不承認是他弄壞了杯子。
examples.english_sentence: He stubbornly refuses to admit that he broke the cup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人賴死，好似乜嘢都唔關佢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 laai6 sei2, hou2 ci5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個人死賴，似乎什麼事都與他無關。
examples.english_sentence: This person is shamelessly stubborn — it's like nothing is ever his fault.

mandarin_meaning: 耍賴；賴皮（口語俚語）
english_meaning: to act shamelessly or play dirty; to shirk responsibility or freeload (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「賴溼*」為粵語口語俚語，用來形容一個人耍賴、不肯負責或不守規矩，帶有貶義。常與「賴皮」「耍賴」意義相近，用於非正式場合。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who shamelessly shirks responsibility, freeloads, or acts unfairly. It is informal and carries a negative connotation, similar in meaning to 'play dirty' or 'be a freeloader'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賴溼人唔肯幫手，大家都幾嬲佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 laai6 sap1 jan4 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gei2 nau1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常耍賴不肯幫忙，大家都很生他的氣。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks and refuses to help; everyone is pretty annoyed with him.

mandarin_meaning: 賴皮、推卸責任或不停找藉口（廣東話口語）
english_meaning: A Cantonese slang term meaning to shirk responsibility, make excuses, or act shamelessly to avoid blame.
explanation_mandarin: 「賴濕」是廣東話口語，帶貶義，指故意推卸責任、賴帳或不停找藉口，不願意承擔後果或負責。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression (derogatory) used to describe someone who shirks responsibility, makes excuses, or behaves shamelessly to avoid being held accountable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再賴濕啦，做嘢就要負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 laai6 sap1 laa1, zou6 je5 zau6 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再賴皮了，做事就要負責任。
examples.english_sentence: Stop making excuses — if you do the work you must take responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次有錯都賴濕，最後老闆唔信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 jau5 co3 dou1 laai6 sap1, zeoi6 hau6 lou5 baan2 m4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次出錯都賴皮，最後老闆不再相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks blame when he messes up; eventually the boss stopped trusting him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好賴濕喇，答應咗就要兌現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 laai6 sap1 laa3, daap3 jing3 zo2 zau6 jiu3 deoi3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再賴皮了，答應了就要兌現。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a shirker — if you've promised something, follow through.

mandarin_meaning: 賴床 / 睡懶覺
english_meaning: to stay in bed; to laze in bed; to oversleep
explanation_mandarin: 指在應該起床的時間繼續躺在床上不肯起來，或比預定時間多睡一會兒。常用於口語。
explanation_english: Refers to remaining in bed when one should get up, or sleeping longer than planned; to laze in bed or oversleep. Common colloquial usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好想賴牀，多訓一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 soeng2 laai6 cong4, do1 fan3 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很想賴床，多睡一會兒。
examples.english_sentence: I really feel like staying in bed today and sleeping a bit longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日賴牀，會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 laai6 cong4, wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是賴床，會遲到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep staying in bed or you'll be late.

mandarin_meaning: 耍賴；厚顏無恥（口語）
english_meaning: to act shamelessly or play the rascal; cheeky/shameless
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，指以耍賴、厚顏無恥或不負責任的方式行事，有時可用作開玩笑式的責備，也可用作嚴厲批評。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term describing someone who is shameless, plays tricks or refuses to take responsibility. It can be used teasingly among friends or as a stronger criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賴皮，唔肯還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 laai6 pei4, m4 hang2 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天耍賴，不肯還錢。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays the rascal and refuses to pay back the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賴皮，講清楚你做錯咩先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laai6 pei4, gong2 cing1 co2 nei5 zou6 co3 me1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別耍無賴，先把你做錯的說清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be shameless; first explain clearly what you did wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 推卸責任、找藉口把責任推給別人；指逃避責任或經常推卸責任的人或行為（口語）
english_meaning: To shirk responsibility / to shift the blame onto others; (noun) a person who avoids responsibility (colloquial Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「賴貓」是廣東話口語，用來形容推卸責任、找藉口把錯誤或責任歸咎於他人的行為，也可指經常這樣做的人。語氣可為責備或戲謔。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term used to describe the act of shirking responsibility or shifting blame onto others; it can also refer to a person who frequently does so. The tone can be critical or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次搞砸咗，你唔好賴貓，大家一齊諗辦法收拾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gaau2 zaak6 zo2, nei5 m4 hou2 laai6 maau1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 nam2 baan6 faat3 sau1 sap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次搞砸了，你不要推卸责任，大家一起想办法收拾。
examples.english_sentence: We messed this up this time — don't shift the blame; let's all work together to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賴貓，做錯嘢就搵人頂包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 laai6 maau1, zou6 co3 je5 zau6 wan2 jan4 ding2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是推卸责任，做错事就找人顶包。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks responsibility; when he makes a mistake he gets others to take the blame.

mandarin_meaning: 用來戲稱裝可愛、耍賴或推卸責任的人（擬人化的「賴貓」形象）
english_meaning: A playful nickname for someone who acts cute or innocent to shirk responsibility — a personified 'blame-shirking cat' persona.
explanation_mandarin: 「賴貓君」為網路俚語或戲稱，常用來形容以賣萌、裝可愛或耍賴等方式逃避責任或推諉的人，語氣通常帶有調侃意味。
explanation_english: An internet/colloquial slang term used jokingly to describe someone who plays cute or acts innocent to avoid responsibility. The tone is usually teasing or playful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，仲扮賴貓君話唔係佢嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, zung6 baan6 laai6 maau1 gwan1 waa6 m4 hai6 keoi5 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事，還裝成賴貓君說不是他的錯。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up, but still pretends to be '賴貓君', saying it's not his fault.

mandarin_meaning: 耍賴、死賴、不肯放手或推卸責任
english_meaning: to act shamelessly (shirking responsibility), to cling or persistently play cute/shirky
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，用來形容有人耍賴、不負責任、死賴不放或黏住別人不放的行為，常帶不滿或抱怨語氣。
explanation_english: An informal Cantonese slang phrase describing someone who shamelessly shirks responsibility, clings on, or persistently plays the rogue/acts clingy; often used with a critical or annoyed tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好賴賴晒晒，答應咗就要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laai6 laai6 saai3 saai3, daap3 jing3 zo2 zau6 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再耍賴了，答應了就要做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep shirking — if you promised, you should do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個細路賴賴晒晒黐住唔放，令到啲人好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 sai3 lou6 laai6 laai6 saai3 saai3 ci1 zyu6 m4 fong3, ling6 dou3 di1 jan4 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個小孩子一直黏著不放，讓人很煩。
examples.english_sentence: That kid keeps clinging on and won't let go; it's annoying people.

mandarin_meaning: 剩，剩下；剩余
english_meaning: to remain; leftover; surplus
explanation_mandarin: 表示剩下、剩余，多用于粤语或书面语，相当于普通话的“剩”。常作动词，表示留下未用或未吃完的部分。
explanation_english: Indicates something remaining or left over. Used as a verb or adjective meaning 'to remain' or 'leftover', equivalent to Mandarin '剩'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 碗入面仲有賸嘢，你要唔要？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun2 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 sang3 je5, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碗里還有剩的，你要不要？
examples.english_sentence: There's some leftover food in the bowl — do you want it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批貨賸咗唔少，要減價清貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pat1 fo3 sang3 zo2 m4 siu2, jiu3 gaam2 gaa3 cing1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這批貨剩了不少，要降價清倉。
examples.english_sentence: Quite a lot of this batch of goods remained; they need to be discounted to clear stock.

mandarin_meaning: 赚钱；获利；占便宜（口语中也可指占人便宜或欺骗）
english_meaning: to earn (money); to make a profit; to gain; (colloquial) to take advantage of or swindle someone
explanation_mandarin: “賺”常用于表示得到金钱或利益（如“賺錢”）。在口语中也可表示占便宜或被占便宜（如“被人賺咗”）。
explanation_english: “賺” primarily means to earn money or make a profit (e.g. 賺錢). Colloquially it can also mean to take advantage of someone or to swindle someone (e.g. 被人賺咗).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要賺錢就要努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zaan6 cin2 zau6 jiu3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要赚钱就要努力。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to earn money, you have to work hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次買個手袋真係賺到，打折後好平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 maai5 go3 sau2 doi2 zan1 hai6 zaan6 dou3, daa2 zit3 hau6 hou2 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次买手袋真是赚到了，打折后很便宜。
examples.english_sentence: This time the handbag was a real bargain — it was much cheaper after the discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人賺咗一筆，損失幾千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 zaan6 zo2 jat1 bat1, syun2 sat1 gei2 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了一笔，损失了几千块。
examples.english_sentence: He was cheated out of a sum of money and lost several thousand dollars.

mandarin_meaning: 赚取（通过工作、交易或其他方式获得金钱、利益或好处）
english_meaning: to earn; to obtain (usually money, profit, or advantage)
explanation_mandarin: 用于指通过工作、交易或其他方式获得金钱、利益或好处，常用于正式或书面语境。
explanation_english: Used to indicate obtaining money, profits, or benefits by work, transactions, or other means; often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力工作想賺取更多收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3 soeng2 zaan6 ceoi2 gang3 do1 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力工作想赚取更多收入。
examples.english_sentence: He works hard to earn more income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份投資有機會賺取可觀回報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 tau4 zi1 jau5 gei1 wui6 zaan6 ceoi2 ho2 gun1 wui4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這項投资有机会赚取可观的回报。
examples.english_sentence: This investment may yield considerable returns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為咗賺取利益而做違法嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 zaan6 ceoi2 lei6 jik6 ji4 zou6 wai4 faat3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要为了赚取利益而做违法的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't break the law in order to gain profit.

mandarin_meaning: 占便宜；欺騙（俚語）
english_meaning: to take advantage of someone; to trick or swindle (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「賺搞」是廣東話俚語，通常指用手段或花招占別人便宜、欺騙對方；在不同語境下可指較嚴重的詐騙或較輕鬆的戲弄、惡作劇。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to take advantage of or trick someone, often by sly tactics. Depending on context it can refer to a serious swindle or a lighter teasing/prank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾人賺搞，你要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 zaan6 gaau2, nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要讓人占你的便宜，你要小心一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let people take advantage of you; be a bit more careful.

mandarin_meaning: 倒霉、吃虧（原本以為會有利可圖，結果反而受損）
english_meaning: to end up unlucky or to lose out (expected to gain but instead suffered a loss)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語/俚語，表示本來有望得到好處或佔便宜，但結果變得倒霉或吃虧，通常用來形容最後受損或輸蝕。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning someone who expected to gain but instead ends up unlucky or disadvantaged; to be the one who loses out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來以為今次個生意會賺錢，點知最後賺衰咗，仲要蝕錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 ji5 wai6 gam1 ci3 go3 saang1 ji3 wui5 zaan6 cin2, dim2 zi1 zeoi6 hau6 zaan6 seoi1 zo2, zung6 jiu3 sik1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本來以為這次生意會賺錢，沒想到最後賺衰了，還要虧錢。
examples.english_sentence: We thought this deal would make money, but in the end we were the ones who lost out and even lost money.

mandarin_meaning: 赚钱 (zhuàn qián)
english_meaning: to earn money; to make money; to be profitable
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过工作、买卖或其他方式获得金钱；也可表示某事有利可图、能带来利润。
explanation_english: To obtain money through work, business, or other means; can also describe something that is profitable or lucrative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家做緊一份兼職，想賺多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4gaa1 zou6 gan2 jat1 fan6 gim1 zik1, soeng2 zaan6 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在做一份兼职，想赚多点钱。
examples.english_sentence: I'm doing a part-time job now; I want to earn more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份生意好賺錢，成本低、利潤高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 saang1 ji3 hou2 zaan6 cin2, sing4 bun2 dai1, lei6 jeon6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份生意很赚钱，成本低、利润高。
examples.english_sentence: This business is very profitable: low costs and high returns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為咗賺錢就做啲自己唔鍾意嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai6 zo2 zaan6 cin2 zau6 zou6 di1 zi6 gei2 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要为了赚钱就去做一些自己不喜欢的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things you dislike just to make money.

mandarin_meaning: 為了虛榮或打扮而辛苦賺錢；賺錢只是用來買漂亮的東西裝飾自己
english_meaning: To earn money just to buy flowers/pretty things to wear — i.e., working or earning for vanity or superficial adornment
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語表達，帶有揶揄或批評意味，指辛苦賺錢卻只是用來購買外表的裝飾或滿足虛榮。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used (often teasingly or critically) to say someone is working hard only to spend money on superficial decorations or vanity items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁辛苦賺錢，唔好淨係賺錢買花戴，應該儲啲錢做長遠打算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 san1 fu2 zaan6 cin2, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zaan6 cin2 maai5 faa1 daai3, jing1 goi1 cou5 di1 cin2 zou6 coeng4 jyun5 daa2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼辛苦賺錢，不要只是賺錢買花戴，應該存一些錢做長遠打算。
examples.english_sentence: You're working so hard — don't just earn money to buy pretty things; you should save some for the future.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）開始看似有利可圖，但到最後卻賠本或吃虧；前賺後賠
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to make gains at the start but suffer losses at the end; initially profitable but ultimately unprofitable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一筆買賣、投資或安排，起初看似有利可圖，但最終卻賠錢或吃虧，常用於描述交易或結果不如預期。
explanation_english: Used to describe a deal, investment, or arrangement that seems profitable at first but ends up losing money or being disadvantageous; commonly used for transactions or outcomes that turn out worse than expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰筆買賣頭先睇落有賺頭，點知最後賺頭蝕尾，蝕咗好大筆錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bat1 maai5 maai6 tau4 sin1 tai2 lok6 jau5 zaam6 tau4, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 zaam6 tau4 sik1 mei5, sik1 zo2 hou2 daai6 bat1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那筆買賣一開始看起來有利可圖，但最後卻前賺後賠，賠了很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: That deal looked profitable at first, but in the end the initial gains were wiped out and it lost a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 购买；买入
english_meaning: to purchase; to buy
explanation_mandarin: 表示購買或收購的動作，常見於複合詞如「購買」「購物」「購置」，多用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Denotes the action of purchasing or acquiring; commonly appears in compounds such as 購買 (purchase), 購物 (shopping), 購置 (procure), and is more formal/written.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺百貨公司度購物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 dou6 gou3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在百货公司购物。
examples.english_sentence: We're shopping at the department store.

mandarin_meaning: 買一下 / 買來試試
english_meaning: to buy (something briefly); to make a small purchase; to buy and try
explanation_mandarin: 「購下」是廣東話口語用法，等同「買一下」或「買來試試」，常用於表示短暫或隨意的一次購買。語氣非正式，常見於香港口語和書寫式廣東話。
explanation_english: “購下” is a Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to buy something briefly or make a small purchase (literally 'buy a bit'). It can also imply buying something to try it out. The expression is informal and commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣我去購下嘢，馬上返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 ngo5 heoi3 gau3 haa5 je5, maa5 soeng6 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下我去買東西，馬上回來。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go buy something quickly and come back soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫幾靚，不如購下試下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 gei2 leng3, bat1 jyu4 gau3 haa5 si3 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服挺漂亮，不如買來試穿看看。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is pretty; why not buy it to try on first?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去街市買菜，順便購下啲水果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 coi3, seon6 bin6 gau3 haa5 di1 seoi2 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去菜市場買菜，順便買點水果。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the market tonight to buy vegetables; might as well buy some fruit too.

mandarin_meaning: 购买
english_meaning: to purchase; to buy
explanation_mandarin: 表示购买、买入，较书面或正式用法，常用于商务或书面语。
explanation_english: Means to purchase or buy; a more formal or written term often used in business or official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算購入新設備提升生產力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 gau3 jap6 san1 cit3 bei6 tai4 sing1 saang1 caan2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算购买新设备以提高生产力。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to purchase new equipment to increase productivity.

mandarin_meaning: 購物 (gòu wù)
english_meaning: shopping; to shop
explanation_mandarin: 表示購買商品或在商店、網路上選購東西的行為或活動，可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or activity of buying goods or selecting items at stores or online; can be used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日去商場購物，買咗幾件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 soeng1 coeng4 gou3 mat6, maai5 zo2 gei2 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天去商场购物，买了几件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I went shopping at the mall today and bought a few clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多嘢可以喺網上購物，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 je5 ho2 ji5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 gou3 mat6, hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多东西可以在网上购物，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many things can be bought online; it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇購物清單？咁就唔會亂買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 gou3 mat6 cing1 daan1? gam2 zau6 m4 wui5 lyun6 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有购物清单？这样就不会乱买东西。
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a shopping list? That way you won't buy things randomly.

mandarin_meaning: 購物狂 (gòu wù kuáng)
english_meaning: shopaholic; someone addicted to shopping
explanation_mandarin: 指對購物有強烈欲望且難以自制，經常大量或頻繁購買物品的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has a strong, often uncontrollable urge to shop and frequently purchases items; a shopaholic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個購物狂，成日喺網上買嘢，買到停唔到手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 gou3 mat6 kong4, sing4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 maai5 je5, maai5 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個購物狂，總是在網上買東西，買到停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: He's a shopaholic — he's always buying things online and can't stop.

mandarin_meaning: 購置；購入（通常指較大型或較正式的採購，如設備、房產等）
english_meaning: to purchase; to acquire; to procure (often for larger or more formal items such as equipment or property)
explanation_mandarin: 表示購買或置辦，常用於指購買設備、房產、倉庫等較大型或正式的物品或設施。
explanation_english: Indicates buying or procuring, typically used for acquiring larger or more formal items or facilities such as equipment, property, or warehouses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司打算購置新嘅伺服器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 gou3 zi3 san1 ge3 si6 fuk6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司打算購置新的伺服器。
examples.english_sentence: Our company plans to purchase new servers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆計劃購置一間新倉庫儲存貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gai3 waak6 gou3 zi3 jat1 gaan1 san1 cong1 fu3 cyu5 cyun4 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆計劃購置一間新倉庫來儲存貨物。
examples.english_sentence: The boss plans to acquire a new warehouse to store goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想購置一部新電話，因為舊嗰部壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gou3 zi3 jat1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2, jan1 wai6 gau6 go2 bou6 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想購置一部新電話，因為舊的那部壞了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a new phone because the old one broke.

mandarin_meaning: 购买
english_meaning: to purchase; to buy
explanation_mandarin: 表示購買物品或商品的動作或行為。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of buying or purchasing goods or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺網上購買咗一本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 gou3 maai5 zo2 jat1 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在網上購買了一本書。
examples.english_sentence: I just purchased a book online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算購買新設備以提高產能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 gou3 maai5 san1 se3 bei6 ji5 tai4 gou1 caan2 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算購買新設備以提高產能。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to purchase new equipment to increase production capacity.

mandarin_meaning: 购买力 (gòumǎilì)
english_meaning: purchasing power
explanation_mandarin: 指消費者或一個國家／地區在一定貨幣價值下，能購買商品或服務的能力；常在經濟學中用來討論收入、物價或匯率變動對消費能力的影響。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability of consumers or an economy to purchase goods and services with a given amount of money; commonly used in economics to discuss how income, prices, or exchange rates affect consumers' capacity to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 通脹高企，大家嘅購買力都減低咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung1zoeng3 gou1kei5, daai6gaa1 ge3 gou3maai5lik6 dou1 gaam2dai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 通货膨胀高企，大家的购买力都降低了。
examples.english_sentence: With high inflation, everyone's purchasing power has decreased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 港幣升值會提升進口商嘅購買力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2bai6 sing1zik6 wui5 tai4sing1 zeon3hau2 soeng1 ge3 gou3maai5lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 港币升值会提升进口商的购买力。
examples.english_sentence: Appreciation of the Hong Kong dollar increases importers' purchasing power.

mandarin_meaning: 赛；比赛；竞技
english_meaning: competition; match; to compete
explanation_mandarin: 表示比賽、競賽的概念；作動詞時表示參加或進行競賽。常見於各類比賽相關的複合詞中，如「比賽」、「賽馬」、「賽跑」等。
explanation_english: Denotes a contest or competition; as a verb it means to compete or take part in a contest. Commonly appears in compounds related to contests, e.g. "competition", "horse race", "race".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽喺下個禮拜舉行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 hai2 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 geoi2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛在下个礼拜举行。
examples.english_sentence: The competition will be held next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽中取得第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bei2 coi3 zung1 ceot1 dak1 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中取得第一名。
examples.english_sentence: He won first place in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意參加運動比賽，尤其係賽跑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 caam1 gaa1 wan6 dung6 bei2 coi3, jau4 kei4 hai6 coi3 paau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢参加运动比赛，尤其是赛跑。
examples.english_sentence: I like participating in sports competitions, especially races.

mandarin_meaning: 賽事；比賽、競賽的活動或賽程
english_meaning: competition; sporting/event contest; tournament
explanation_mandarin: 指各種比賽或競賽的活動或賽程，常用於體育賽事、比賽安排等場合。
explanation_english: Refers to a competition or contest event (often sporting), including the matches or schedule of a tournament.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校會舉辦一場游泳賽事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 wui5 geoi2 baan6 jat1 coeng4 jau4 wing6 coi3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校會舉辦一場游泳賽事。
examples.english_sentence: The school will hold a swimming competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為落雨，今日嘅賽事要延期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5, gam1 jat6 ge3 coi3 si6 jiu3 jin4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為下雨，今天的賽事要延期。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the rain, today's event needs to be postponed.

mandarin_meaning: 比賽的規則或賽事條件
english_meaning: race conditions; rules or conditions for a competition
explanation_mandarin: 用於賽事或比賽，指該場比賽的參賽資格、條件、負重、獎金等具體規定。
explanation_english: Used in the context of competitions or races; refers to the specific rules or conditions for an event, such as eligibility, weights, and prizes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場賽例話只限四歲嘅馬參賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 coi3 lai6 waa6 zi2 han6 sei3 seoi3 ge3 maa5 caam1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本場比賽規定只限四歲的馬參賽。
examples.english_sentence: The race conditions for this event state only four-year-old horses may enter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要睇清楚賽例先決定報名唔報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 coi3 lai6 sin1 kyut3 ding6 bou3 ming4 m4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要看清楚比賽規則才決定要不要報名。
examples.english_sentence: You should read the race conditions carefully before deciding whether to register.

mandarin_meaning: 赛制；比赛的组织方式和制度
english_meaning: competition/tournament format; the system or structure of a competition
explanation_mandarin: 指比賽的組織方式和制度，例如分組賽、淘汰賽、循環賽等，決定參賽隊伍如何進行比賽和晉級。
explanation_english: Refers to the organization and system of a competition, such as group stages, knockout rounds, or round-robin play; it determines how participants compete and advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽嘅賽制改咗，改做小組循環加淘汰賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ge3 coi3 zai3 goi2 zo2, goi2 zou6 siu2 zou2 seon4 wun4 gaa1 tou4 taai3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛的赛制改了，改成小组循环加淘汰赛。
examples.english_sentence: The tournament format has been changed to group round-robin followed by knockout rounds.

mandarin_meaning: 賽場；比賽場地、競技場或賽車場
english_meaning: arena; competition venue; racetrack; contest field
explanation_mandarin: 指舉行比賽或競技的場地，包含體育場、競技場或專門的賽車場等。
explanation_english: Refers to the place where competitions are held — an arena, sports field, racetrack, or similar venue for contests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽喺下個禮拜會喺賽場舉行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 hai2 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 hai2 sai3 coeng4 geoi2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽在下個禮拜會在賽場舉行。
examples.english_sentence: The competition will be held at the arena next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賽場入面坐滿咗觀眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 coeng4 jap6 min6 co5 mun5 zo2 gun1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賽場裡面坐滿了觀眾。
examples.english_sentence: The arena was filled with spectators.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去賽場睇賽車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 sai3 coeng4 tai2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚去賽場看賽車。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the racetrack tonight to watch the car race.

mandarin_meaning: 廟會；慶典；地方性的節慶活動
english_meaning: festival; temple fair; local celebratory event
explanation_mandarin: 「賽會」在廣東話中多指村落或社區舉辦的慶典或廟會，常有戲棚、舞獅、小食攤位等民間活動。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 賽會 refers to a local festival or temple fair—usually a community celebration featuring opera stages, lion dances, food stalls, and other folk activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 村入面啲人每年都會搞賽會，有戲棚、舞獅同小食檔，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 jap6 min6 di1 jan4 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 gaau2 sai3 wui6, jau5 hei3 paang4, mou5 si1 tung4 siu2 sik6 dong3, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村里的人每年都會辦廟會，有戲棚、舞獅和小吃攤，很熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: People in the village hold a festival every year with opera stages, lion dances and food stalls — it's very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 比赛结果
english_meaning: result/outcome (of a match or competition)
explanation_mandarin: 指比賽或競賽的結果，常用於體育賽事、賽事報導與博彩相關語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the result or outcome of a match/competition; commonly used in sports reporting and betting contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估下今晚嘅賽果會係邊隊贏？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 haa5 gam1 maan5 ge3 sai3 gwo2 wui5 hai6 bin1 deoi2 jeng4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜猜今晚的比赛结果会是哪队赢？
examples.english_sentence: Guess which team will win tonight's match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賽果已經公佈，主隊贏兩比一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gwo2 ji5 ging1 gung1 bou3, zyu2 deoi2 jeng4 loeng5 bei2 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛结果已经公布，主队以2比1获胜。
examples.english_sentence: The match result has been announced: the home team won 2-1.

mandarin_meaning: 赛况
english_meaning: match status; state or progress of a competition
explanation_mandarin: 指比赛的情况、进展或概况，通常用于描述比赛过程、比分、关键时刻等信息。
explanation_english: Refers to the situation, progress, or overview of a match or competition; used to describe the course of the game, score, and key moments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場足球賽況好激烈，雙方都有幾次入球機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 zuk1 kau4 coi3 fong3 hou2 gik1 lit6, soeng1 fong1 dou1 jau5 gei2 ci3 jap6 kau4 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这场足球赛的赛况很激烈，双方都有几次进球机会。
examples.english_sentence: Today's football match was intense; both sides had several scoring opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 赛狗（指以狗进行赛跑的活动或比赛，也可指赛狗场）
english_meaning: dog racing; a dog race (the sport/activity, or a dog-racing track)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指以狗作赛跑的活动或比赛以及举行比赛的场地（赛狗、赛狗场）。在粤语口语中，字词“賽”也经常出现在粗口或感叹语中，须注意单独使用“賽狗”作为骂人或感叹词并非标准或普遍的表达。
explanation_english: Literally refers to dog racing — the sport/activity of dogs racing and the venue where such races take place (dog races, dog-racing track). Note: in Cantonese the syllable 賽 is sometimes used in coarse expletives, but using '賽狗' alone as an insult/interjection is not a standardized or universally used form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去賽狗場賭錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 sai3 gau2 coeng4 du2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去赛狗场赌博。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the dog-racing track to gamble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賽狗，今次又輸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gau2, gam1 ci3 jau6 syu1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可恶，这次又全输了。
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, I lost everything again this time.

mandarin_meaning: 賽璐珞（赛璐珞），一種早期的人造塑料（以硝化纖維素或纖維素醋酸酯為主），曾用於膠片、眼鏡框、梳子等，易燃。
english_meaning: Celluloid, an early synthetic plastic (based on nitrocellulose or cellulose acetate) used for film, eyeglass frames, combs, and decorative objects; flammable.
explanation_mandarin: 賽璐珞是一種歷史較早的可塑性材料，由經處理的纖維素製成，曾廣泛應用於電影膠片及各類飾品、器具，但因易燃和穩定性較差逐漸被其他塑料取代。
explanation_english: Celluloid is an early plastic material made from treated cellulose, widely used for film and various accessories/objects. Because it is highly flammable and less stable, it has largely been replaced by newer plastics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢副舊太陽眼鏡係賽璐珞做嘅，好懷舊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fu6 gau6 taai3 joeng4 ngaan5 geng3 hai6 sai3 lou6 lok3 zou6 ge3, hou2 waai4 gau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这副旧太阳镜是赛璐珞做的，很怀旧。
examples.english_sentence: These old sunglasses are made of celluloid; they feel very nostalgic.

mandarin_meaning: 赛程／比赛日程
english_meaning: schedule of matches; fixtures; tournament schedule
explanation_mandarin: 指比賽或競賽的安排與時間表，包含各場比賽的時間、對陣與賽事進度。
explanation_english: Refers to the schedule or timetable for competitions, listing match dates, times, fixtures, and the progression of the event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日啲賽程已經公布喇，你睇咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 di1 coi3 cing4 ji5 ging1 gung1 bou3 laa3, nei5 tai2 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的赛程已经公布了，你看过了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Today's schedule of matches has been announced — have you seen it?

mandarin_meaning: 赛跑 (跑步比赛；与他人比赛跑步)
english_meaning: race (running); to race (run competitively)
explanation_mandarin: 指以跑步速度比賽的活動；可作名詞（賽跑比賽）或動詞（互相賽跑）。
explanation_english: Refers to a running competition; can be used as a noun (a running race) or a verb (to race by running).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下個禮拜會舉行賽跑比賽，全班都會參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 geoi2 hang4 coi3 paau2 bei2 coi3, cyun4 baan1 dou1 wui5 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校下個禮拜會舉行賽跑比賽，全班都會參加。
examples.english_sentence: The school will hold a running race next week; the whole class will participate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑得好快，喺操場同我哋賽跑都贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 dak1 hou2 faai3, hai2 cou1 coeng4 tung4 ngo5 dei6 coi3 paau2 dou1 jing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑得很快，在操場和我們賽跑都贏了。
examples.english_sentence: He runs very fast; on the field he beat us in races.

mandarin_meaning: 赛车 / 赛车（驾驶汽车进行竞速活动）
english_meaning: car racing; to race cars (organized motorsport or street racing)
explanation_mandarin: 指以汽车进行竞速的活动，可以指正规的赛车运动（如赛道比赛）或非法的街头飙车。
explanation_english: Refers to the activity of driving cars competitively. It can mean organized motorsport events (track racing) or illegal street racing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係職業賽車手，成日參加唔同嘅賽車比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zik1 jip6 coi3 ce1 sau2, sing4 jat6 caam1 gaa1 m4 tung4 ge3 coi3 ce1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是职业赛车手，经常参加不同的赛车比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He is a professional racing driver and often participates in various car races.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晚上嗰條街成日有人飆車同埋賽車，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan5 soeng6 go2 tiu4 gaai1 sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 biu1 ce1 tung4 maai4 coi3 ce1, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上那条街经常有人飙车和赛车，很危险。
examples.english_sentence: There are often people street-racing on that street at night; it's very dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 赛车手
english_meaning: race car driver; racing driver
explanation_mandarin: 指參加賽車比賽或以駕駛賽車為職業的人。也可泛指參與各類競速賽的車手。
explanation_english: A person who drives racing cars in competitions or as a profession; can also refer more generally to drivers who participate in speed races.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個職業賽車手，成日去外國參加比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 zik1 jip6 coi3 ce1 sau2, sing4 jat6 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一名职业赛车手，经常到国外参加比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He is a professional race car driver and often goes abroad to compete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次賽事有好多本地賽車手參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 coi3 si6 jau5 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 coi3 ce1 sau2 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次赛事有很多本地赛车手参加。
examples.english_sentence: Many local race car drivers are taking part in this event.

mandarin_meaning: 赛道；（引申）行业赛道、競爭領域
english_meaning: racetrack; track; (figurative) competitive field or market segment
explanation_mandarin: 原指用於賽跑或賽車的道路或場地；在科技/商業語境中亦常用作比喻，指一個行業或細分市場的競爭領域。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the physical track used for races (running, motorsports). In business/tech contexts it is also used figuratively to mean an industry or competitive market segment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日比賽喺個賽道舉行，選手準備好未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 bei2 coi3 hai6 go3 coi3 dou6 geoi2 hang4, syun2 sau2 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天比賽在賽道舉行，選手準備好了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Today's competition is being held on the racetrack — are the athletes ready?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新賽道入面競爭好激烈，初創公司要快啲搶佔市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 coi3 dou6 jap6 min6 ging6 zaang1 hou2 gik1 lit6, co1 cong3 gung1 si1 jiu3 faai3 di1 coeng2 zim6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個新賽道裡面競爭非常激烈，初創公司要快速搶佔市場。
examples.english_sentence: Competition in this new sector is fierce; startups must move quickly to seize market share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚F1賽道會封路，開車要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 F1 coi3 dou6 wui5 fung1 lou6, hoi1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚F1賽道會封路，開車要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The F1 racetrack will close some roads tonight; drive carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 赛马 (sàimǎ)：指赛马比赛，也可作动词“赛马/赛跑马”，在香港语境也常指以赛马为主题的博彩活动或泛指竞争、比拼。
english_meaning: horse racing; (verb) to race horses; (informal) betting on horse races or a competition/contest (metaphorical).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: “賽馬”通常指正式的賽馬比賽或其相關的博彩活動。在香港，賽馬既是體育和娛樂活動，也與賭博密切相關；在口語中有時也用來比喻競爭或較量。
explanation_english: “賽馬” primarily means horse racing — the sport or event — and often refers to betting on those races. In Hong Kong it is both a sporting and gambling activity; colloquially it can also be used metaphorically for competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我去跑馬地睇賽馬，仲會買幾注馬票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 heoi3 paau2 maa5 dei6 tai2 coi3 maa5, zung6 wui5 maai5 gei2 zyu3 maa5 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期天我要去跑马地看赛马，还会买几注马票。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Happy Valley to watch the horse races on Sunday, and I'll also place a few bets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賽馬係一項有悠久歷史嘅運動，吸引好多馬迷同賭徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi3 maa5 hai6 jat1 hong6 jau4 gau2 lik6 si2 ge3 wan6 dung6, hap1 jan5 hou2 do1 maa5 mai4 tung4 dou2 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赛马是一项有悠久历史的运动，吸引了很多马迷和赌徒。
examples.english_sentence: Horse racing is a sport with a long history, attracting many horse fans and gamblers.

mandarin_meaning: 赛马会（指举办赛马活动的俱乐部或机构，常指香港赛马会）
english_meaning: Jockey Club / racing club (commonly refers to the Hong Kong Jockey Club)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指舉辦賽馬的俱樂部或機構，尤指香港賽馬會（香港赛马会）；該機構除辦賽馬外，亦參與博彩管理、慈善捐助及社區與體育項目。
explanation_english: Refers to a jockey club or racing organization that runs horse races — in Hong Kong it commonly denotes the Hong Kong Jockey Club, which also manages betting operations and engages in charitable, community and sporting initiatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個星期日賽馬會有場大型賽馬，我哋去馬場睇吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 sai3 maa5 wui6 jau5 coeng4 daai6 jing4 sai3 maa5, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 maa5 coeng4 tai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个星期日赛马会有一场大型赛马，我们去马场看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: This Sunday the Jockey Club has a big horse race — let's go to the racecourse to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賽馬會除咗辦賽馬，仲捐款做慈善同資助社區活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 maa5 wui6 ceoi4 zo2 baan6 sai3 maa5, zung6 gyun1 fun2 zou6 ci4 sin6 tung4 zi1 zo6 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赛马会除了举办赛马，还捐款做慈善并资助社区活动。
examples.english_sentence: Besides holding horse races, the Jockey Club also donates money for charity and supports community projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成為賽馬會會員，可以參與佢哋嘅慈善活動，亦可以使用會所設施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 wai4 sai3 maa5 wui6 wui6 jyun4, ho2 ji5 caam1 jyu5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6, jik6 ho2 ji5 si6 jung6 wui6 so2 cit3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成为赛马会会员，可以参加他们的慈善活动，也可以使用会所设施。
examples.english_sentence: Becoming a Jockey Club member allows you to join their charitable activities and use the club's facilities.

mandarin_meaning: 多餘、累贅；（用於複合詞如「贅詞」「贅述」）
english_meaning: redundant; superfluous; unnecessary
explanation_mandarin: 表示多餘或累贅的意思，常見於書寫或說話中指不必要的詞語或說明。
explanation_english: Indicates something redundant or superfluous; often used in writing or speech to refer to unnecessary words or explanations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段落入面有啲贅詞，可以刪走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 lok6 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 zeoi6 ci4, ho2 ji5 saan1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段落裡有些贅詞，可以刪掉。
examples.english_sentence: There are some redundant words in this paragraph; they can be removed.

mandarin_meaning: 赘肉
english_meaning: excess body fat; flab
explanation_mandarin: 指附著在身體表面、通常較多且難以消除的多餘脂肪，常見於腹部、大腿等部位的俗稱。
explanation_english: Refers to excess body fat (flab) that accumulates under the skin and is often hard to remove, commonly found around the belly, thighs, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想減贅肉，所以每日都做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gaam2 zeoi6 juk6, so2ji5 mui5 jat6 dou1 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想減掉贅肉，所以每天都做運動。
examples.english_sentence: I want to lose my flab, so I exercise every day.

mandarin_meaning: 赠；赠予、赠送、捐赠
english_meaning: to give as a gift; to present; to donate
explanation_mandarin: 表示把物品或榮譽無償或正式地給予他人，用於贈送禮物、捐贈或賞賜等。語氣正式，多見於書面語。
explanation_english: Indicates giving something to someone as a gift or presenting an award; can also mean donating. Formal in tone and commonly used in written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今次贈咗一批禮品俾員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 ci3 zang3 zo2 jat1 pai1 lai5 ban2 bei2 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司這次贈送了一批禮品給員工。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave a batch of gifts to the employees this time.

mandarin_meaning: 贈與，贈送；把某物或權利正式地交給他人
english_meaning: to bestow; to give; to present (something, often formally)
explanation_mandarin: 「贈予」用於較正式或書面語境，表示把物品、權利、榮譽等無償地授予他人或機構。
explanation_english: A formal/literary verb meaning to give or present something (often a gift, right, or honor) to someone or an institution, typically without payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 基金會決定將呢幅畫贈予市立美術館收藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 gam1 wui6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 ni1 fuk1 waa2 zang3 jyu5 si5 lap6 mei5 seot6 gun2 sou1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 基金會決定將這幅畫贈予市立美術館收藏。
examples.english_sentence: The foundation decided to present this painting to the municipal art museum for its collection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將自己嘅遺產贈予多間慈善機構，幫助有需要的人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 wai4 caan2 zang3 jyu5 do1 gaan1 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3, bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 dik1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他將自己的遺產贈予多間慈善機構，幫助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He bequeathed his estate to several charities to help those in need.

mandarin_meaning: 禮券；作為贈與或促銷用途的券（可用於購物或抵扣消費）
english_meaning: gift voucher; gift coupon (a voucher given as a gift or promotion that can be used for purchases or discounts)
explanation_mandarin: 指商家或個人贈送的券，可在指定商店或平台換取商品、折扣或服務。與「禮券」「代金券」意義相近。
explanation_english: A voucher given as a gift or promotional item that can be redeemed for goods, discounts, or services at specified stores or platforms. Similar to 'gift voucher' or 'coupon'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張贈券可以喺任何分店使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zang3 kyun4 ho2 ji5 hai2 jam6 ho4 fan1 dim3 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張贈券可以在任何分店使用。
examples.english_sentence: This voucher can be used at any branch.

mandarin_meaning: 赠品 (zèngpǐn) — 免费赠送的物品
english_meaning: free gift; complimentary item given as a promotion or bonus
explanation_mandarin: 商店或活动中免费赠送的物品，通常作为促销或回馈顾客的礼物。
explanation_english: An item given free of charge, often as a promotional giveaway or a complimentary bonus to customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買滿兩百蚊就有贈品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 mun5 loeng5 baak3 man1 zau6 jau5 zang3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买满两百元就有赠品。
examples.english_sentence: Spend $200 and you'll get a free gift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個贈品係限量㗎，快啲拎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zang3 ban2 hai6 haan6 loeng6 gaa3, faai3 di1 ling1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个赠品是限量的，快点拿吧。
examples.english_sentence: This freebie is limited edition — grab it quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 赠送以示庆贺；表示祝贺（多用于书面或正式场合）
english_meaning: to present gifts or offerings as a form of congratulation; to give/offer congratulations (often formal or ceremonial)
explanation_mandarin: 「贈慶」指贈送物品或以某種舉動表示慶賀或祝賀，語氣偏書面或正式，常見於儀式、慶典或公文中。
explanation_english: “贈慶” means to give gifts or make an offering to express congratulations. It is somewhat formal or literary, often used in ceremonial, celebratory or official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司向得獎嘅同事贈慶，送咗禮物畀佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hoeng3 dak1 zoeng2 ge3 tung4 si6 zang3 hing3, sung3 zo2 lai5 mat6 bei2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司向得奖的同事赠送礼物以表示祝贺。
examples.english_sentence: The company presented gifts to the award-winning colleagues to congratulate them.

mandarin_meaning: 逗弄、挑逗（為了取樂或刺激對方反應）
english_meaning: to tease or provoke someone (to amuse oneself or elicit a reaction)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，指用言語或行為逗弄、挑逗別人，可能為了取樂或激起對方反應；語氣可輕鬆也可帶挑釁意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to tease or provoke someone by words or actions, often for amusement or to get a reaction; can be playful or provocative depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁贈興佢啦，佢會嬲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zang3 hing1 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 wui5 nau5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那樣逗他了，他會生氣的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease him like that; he'll get angry.

mandarin_meaning: 赠送（将东西作为礼物或免费提供给他人）
english_meaning: to give as a gift; to present; to give away (often as a complimentary item)
explanation_mandarin: 把物品或利益作为礼物或赠与的方式给别人，常用于正式或书面语，例如商家促销时赠送样品。
explanation_english: To give something to someone as a gift or complimentary item. Often used in formal or written contexts (e.g., a company giving away promotional gifts).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗慶祝開業，向顧客贈送小禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 hing3 zuk1 hoi1 jip6, hoeng3 gu3 haak3 zang3 sung3 siu2 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司为了庆祝开业，向顾客赠送小礼物。
examples.english_sentence: To celebrate its opening, the company gives customers small gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贈送咗一本書畀我，真係好貼心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zang3 sung3 zo2 jat1 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 hou2 tip3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赠送了一本书给我，真是很贴心。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a book as a present; it was really thoughtful.

mandarin_meaning: 赠阅（免费赠送供阅读，通常指书刊的赠本或把书刊赠与某机构/个人以供阅览）
english_meaning: complimentary copy; to give a copy for reading (usually referring to giving free copies of books or periodicals for reading)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: “贈閱”可以表示把書刊免費贈送給機構或個人供閱讀，也可用作名詞指標示為贈送閱覽的贈本（如贈閱本）。在刊物上常見作為標示。
explanation_english: “贈閱” can mean donating or giving copies of books or periodicals free for reading, or as a noun it can label a complimentary copy (e.g. a gifted copy for readers). Commonly seen as a stamp or label on publications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係贈閱本，唔可以賣俾人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 zang3 jyut6 bun2, m4 ho2 ji5 maai6 bei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書是贈閱本，不可以賣給別人。
examples.english_sentence: This book is a complimentary copy and cannot be sold to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出版社贈閱咗幾本新書俾學校作教學用途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 baan2 se5 zang3 jyut6 zo2 gei2 bun2 san1 syu1 bei2 hok6 haau6 zok3 gaau3 hok6 jung6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出版社贈閱了幾本新書給學校作教學用途。
examples.english_sentence: The publisher donated a few new copies to the school for teaching purposes.

mandarin_meaning: 赠阅（把书刊等赠送给他人阅览）
english_meaning: to present (a copy) for someone's perusal; to give a complimentary copy for reading
explanation_mandarin: 表示把書籍、雜誌或樣刊等贈送給他人讓其閱覽或評閱，常用於出版社或機構向讀者、媒體或評審提供樣書的情況。
explanation_english: Means to give a publication (book, magazine, sample copy) to someone for them to read or review; often used when publishers or organizations provide complimentary copies to readers, media, or reviewers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出版社贈閲咗一本新書俾我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 baan2 se5 zang3 jyut6 zo2 jat1 bun2 san1 syu1 bei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出版社赠阅了一本新书给我们。
examples.english_sentence: The publisher presented us with a complimentary copy of the new book.

mandarin_meaning: 赞；称赞；赞成
english_meaning: to praise; to approve; to like (e.g. on social media)
explanation_mandarin: 表示称赞、赞成或赞赏，多用于口语或社交媒体按赞（点赞）。
explanation_english: Expresses praise, approval, or admiration. Commonly used in speech and on social media to mean 'like' or 'thumbs up'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個主意好贊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 zyu2 ji3 hou2 zaan3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的主意很赞！
examples.english_sentence: Your idea is great!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好贊佢嘅表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zaan3 keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很赞赏他的表现。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire his performance.

mandarin_meaning: 贊助 / 赞助 (zàn zhù)
english_meaning: to sponsor; sponsorship — to provide financial or other support
explanation_mandarin: 提供金錢、物資或其他資源以支持個人、團體或活動，可指一次性或持續性的支持（例如活動贊助、企業贊助）。
explanation_english: To provide money, goods, or other resources to support a person, group, event, or organization; can refer to a one-time or ongoing form of support (e.g., event sponsorship, corporate sponsorship).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司贊助咗我哋嘅籌款活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zan3 zo6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 cau4 fun2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司贊助了我們的籌款活動。
examples.english_sentence: This company sponsored our fundraising event.

mandarin_meaning: 赞同；同意、认可
english_meaning: to agree with; to approve; to endorse
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個意見、建議或提議表示同意或支持。
explanation_english: To express agreement with or approval of someone's opinion, suggestion, or proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好贊同你嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zaan3 tung4 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很赞同你的看法。
examples.english_sentence: I strongly agree with your point of view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司大部分同事都贊同呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daai6 bou6 fan6 tung4 si6 dou1 zaan3 tung4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司大部分同事都赞同这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: Most colleagues at the company approve of this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然有人贊同，但亦有人反對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jau5 jan4 zaan3 tung4, daan6 jik6 jau5 jan4 fan2 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然有人赞同，但也有人反对。
examples.english_sentence: Although some people agree, others oppose it.

mandarin_meaning: 赞成（表示同意或支持）
english_meaning: to approve; to agree with; to support
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個意見、提議或決定表示贊同或支持的動作或態度。
explanation_english: To express approval or agreement with an opinion, proposal, or decision; to support something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我贊成你嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 nei5 ge3 gin3 ji5
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赞成你的建议。
examples.english_sentence: I agree with your suggestion.

mandarin_meaning: 赞比亚（非洲國家）
english_meaning: Zambia (country in southern Africa)
explanation_mandarin: 赞比亚是位于非洲南部的国家，首都为卢萨卡，官方语言为英语，著名景点包括维多利亚瀑布（与津巴布韦共享）及多個國家公園。
explanation_english: Zambia is a country in southern Africa. The capital is Lusaka and the official language is English. It is known for attractions such as Victoria Falls (shared with Zimbabwe) and numerous national parks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去贊比亞旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 zaam3 bei2 aa3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去赞比亚旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Zambia next month.

mandarin_meaning: 赝，假冒、仿制品（赝品）
english_meaning: counterfeit; fake; forgery
explanation_mandarin: 表示假的、仿造的，常用于“贋品”表示伪造的物品或赝作。
explanation_english: Indicates something fake or forged; commonly used in compounds like "贋品" to mean a counterfeit item or forgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅作品可能係贋品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 zok3 ban2 ho2 nang4 hai6 ngaan6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件作品可能是赝品。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of work might be a counterfeit.

mandarin_meaning: 假貨；仿冒品
english_meaning: counterfeit; fake (goods)
explanation_mandarin: 指假冒的商品或贗作，並非正品，常用來描述仿冒品牌或偽劣商品。
explanation_english: Refers to goods that are counterfeit or forgeries; not genuine products. Commonly used to describe imitation or fake branded items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部手錶係贋品，唔好買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 sau2 biu1 hai6 ngaan6 ban2, m4 hou2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻手錶是假貨，別買。
examples.english_sentence: That watch is a counterfeit; don't buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 赡（贍）
english_meaning: to provide for; to support (esp. financially); adequate/sufficient
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（亦可作形容詞，表示充足）
explanation_mandarin: 表示供養、贍養，常指經濟上扶養父母或家人；在某些語境亦可指充足、寬裕。
explanation_english: Means to provide for or support (often financially, e.g., supporting one's parents or family). In some contexts it can also mean adequate or sufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責贍養阿媽同阿爸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 sim6 joeng5 aa3 maa1 tung4 aa3 baa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他負責贍養媽媽和爸爸。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for supporting his mother and father.

mandarin_meaning: 赡养 (shàn yǎng)
english_meaning: to provide for; to support financially; to maintain (esp. elderly relatives)
explanation_mandarin: 指提供生活费用并照顾，尤指对年迈亲属的经济或日常照顾和扶持。
explanation_english: Refers to providing financial support or care, especially for elderly family members; to maintain or support someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每個月都要贍養父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 sim6 joeng5 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每个月都要赡养父母。
examples.english_sentence: He has to support his parents every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法院判佢要支付贍養費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong2 jyun2 pun3 keoi5 jiu3 zi1 fu6 sim6 joeng5 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院判他要支付赡养费。
examples.english_sentence: The court ordered him to pay maintenance/support payments.

mandarin_meaning: 赡养费（用于供养年迈父母或离婚后对配偶的扶养费用）
english_meaning: maintenance; alimony; financial support (payments to support elderly parents or an ex-spouse)
explanation_mandarin: 指為了供養、扶助年邁父母或在離婚情況下維持配偶生活而定期支付的金錢。
explanation_english: Money paid as maintenance or support, typically regular payments to care for elderly parents or as alimony to an ex-spouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法院判佢要畀贍養費畀前妻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 jyun6 pun3 keoi5 jiu3 bei2 sim6 joeng5 fai3 bei2 cin4 cai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院判他要支付赡养费给前妻。
examples.english_sentence: The court ordered him to pay alimony to his ex-wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋每個月都要俾贍養費畀年邁嘅父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 bei2 sim6 joeng5 fai3 bei2 nin4 maai6 ge3 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每个月都要给年迈的父母赡养费。
examples.english_sentence: They have to pay their elderly parents a monthly maintenance allowance.

mandarin_meaning: 赢；获胜；获得利润
english_meaning: to win; to be victorious; to gain/profit
explanation_mandarin: 表示在比賽、對抗中取得勝利，或在交易/賭博中獲得利潤或收益。
explanation_english: Indicates achieving victory in a contest or defeating an opponent, or obtaining a gain/profit (e.g., winning money).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋贏咗場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们赢了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: We won the match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺賭場贏咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou2 coeng4 jing4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在赌场赢了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He won a lot of money at the casino.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋今次贏到，就可以去旅行慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 jing4 dou3, zau6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们这次赢了，就可以去旅行庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: If we win this time, we can go on a trip to celebrate.

mandarin_meaning: 赢得很多 / 大获全胜（口语）
english_meaning: to win big; to win by a landslide; to make a killing (often in gambling or competitions)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，字面上「贏到開巷」，表示贏很多或贏得很徹底，常用於賭博、比賽或形容獲利豐厚。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial slang phrase literally meaning "win until the lane opens." It expresses winning a lot or winning decisively, commonly used for gambling, competitions, or describing large gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次賭馬贏到開巷，返屋企都唔使煩錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 dou2 maa5 jeng4 dou3 hoi1 hong6, faan1 uk1 kei5 dou1 m4 sai2 faan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我在赛马赢得很多，回家都不用为钱烦恼了。
examples.english_sentence: I won so much on the horse race this time that I don't have to worry about money at home.

mandarin_meaning: 贏取 / 赢取 (yíngqǔ) — 透過競爭或努力獲得、取得
english_meaning: to win; to obtain; to gain (by competing or striving)
explanation_mandarin: 表示通過競爭、努力或某種手段獲得某物或某種名次、利益，例如贏取獎項、贏取支持等。
explanation_english: Indicates obtaining something (an award, support, etc.) through competition, effort, or deliberate action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於透過努力贏取咗比賽嘅冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 tau3 gwo3 nou5 lik6 jing4 ceoi2 zo2 bei2 coi3 ge3 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於通過努力贏得了比賽的冠軍。
examples.english_sentence: He finally won the championship of the competition through hard work.

jyutping: jing4 zo2 lap1 tong4, syu1 zo2 gaan1 cong2
mandarin_meaning: 得不偿失（為了小利而損失更大的利益）
english_meaning: To win something small but lose something much bigger; a small gain at great cost
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容為了一點小利而付出更大的代價，結果得不償失。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation where one gains a trivial benefit but suffers a far greater loss — ultimately not worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗追求嗰啲小利，結果贏咗粒糖，輸咗間廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zeoi1 kau4 go2 di1 siu2 lei6, git3 gwo2 jing4 zo2 lap1 tong4, syu1 zo2 gaan1 cong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了追求那些小利，結果贏了一粒糖，卻輸掉了一間工廠。
examples.english_sentence: He chased small gains and ended up winning a candy but losing a factory — a tiny gain at a huge cost.

mandarin_meaning: 赢家 (贏家)
english_meaning: winner; victor; someone who wins or gains advantage
explanation_mandarin: 指在競賽、比賽或競爭中獲勝的人，也可泛指在某方面佔上風或取得利益的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who wins in a contest, competition, or any situation; can also mean someone who gains the advantage or profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今場比賽嘅贏家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ge3 jeng4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是這場比賽的贏家。
examples.english_sentence: He is the winner of this match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意嘅時候，佢想做贏家，唔想做輸家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 soeng2 zou6 jeng4 gaa1, m4 soeng2 zou6 syu1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意的時候，他想做贏家，不想做輸家。
examples.english_sentence: When doing business, he wants to be the winner, not the loser.

mandarin_meaning: 赢得，获得
english_meaning: to win; to gain; to obtain
explanation_mandarin: 表示取得或獲得某種結果、利益、榮譽或支持，例如贏得比賽、贏得尊重。
explanation_english: A transitive verb meaning to win or obtain something (a prize, respect, time, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋終於贏得咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 jing4 dak1 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们终于赢得了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: We finally won the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏得咗大家嘅尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing4 dak1 zo2 daai6 gaa1 ge3 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢得了大家的尊重。
examples.english_sentence: He earned everyone's respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲改動可以幫我哋贏得多啲時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 goi2 dung6 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 jing4 dak1 do1 di1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些改动可以帮我们赢得更多时间。
examples.english_sentence: These changes can help us gain more time.

mandarin_meaning: 赢球
english_meaning: to win a match / to win a game (usually in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，意思是在比赛中获胜，通常指体育比赛赢得场次或比赛。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to win a game or match, typically used for sports competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚一定要贏波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jing4 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚一定要赢球。
examples.english_sentence: We must win the game tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊贏波之後，全隊好興奮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 jing4 bo1 zi1 hau6, cyun4 deoi6 hou2 hing1 fan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队赢球之后，全队很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: After the team won the match, the whole team was very excited.

jyutping: jeng4 lap1 tong4 syu1 gaan1 cong2
mandarin_meaning: 因小失大（為了小利或小便宜，結果失去更大的利益）
english_meaning: To gain a little but lose a lot; to be penny-wise and pound-foolish
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容為了微不足道的好處或小利，結果損失更大的東西。相當於普通話的「因小失大」或「得不償失」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese saying used to describe situations where someone gains a trivial advantage but ends up suffering a much larger loss — equivalent to 'penny-wise, pound-foolish' or 'to lose the forest for the trees.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係諗住即刻賺啲小利，結果贏粒糖輸間廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 lam2 zyu6 zik1 hak1 zaan6 di1 siu2 lei6, git3 gwo2 jeng4 lap1 tong4 syu1 gaan1 cong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是想着马上赚点小利，结果因小失大。
examples.english_sentence: He only wanted to make a quick small profit, but ended up gaining little and losing big.

mandarin_meaning: 總是贏／連勝，老是處於勝利的一方（口語）
english_meaning: to be on a winning streak; to win consistently (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，形容某人在賭博、比賽或其他情況下經常獲勝或一路走旺，帶有誇張或吹噓的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase meaning someone is consistently winning or on a winning streak. Often used about gambling, competitions, or boastfully describing frequent success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近賭馬贏開巷，贏咗幾十萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 dou2 maa5 jing4 hoi1 hong6, jing4 zo2 gei2 sap6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近在賭馬一直贏，贏了好幾十萬。
examples.english_sentence: He's been on a winning streak at the racetrack recently; he won several hundred thousand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己贏開巷，但其實未必咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 jing4 hoi1 hong6, daan6 kei4 sat6 mei6 bat1 gam2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常說自己總是贏，但其實不一定那麼厲害。
examples.english_sentence: He always claims he's always winning, but he's not necessarily that good.

mandarin_meaning: 有勝算；贏的可能性較大
english_meaning: chance of winning; likelihood of success; advantage
explanation_mandarin: 表示在比賽、競爭或比較中，某一方獲勝或成功的可能性較大或佔優勢。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person or side has a higher probability of winning or succeeding in a contest, competition, or comparison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場波佢哋贏面大啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bo1 keoi5 dei6 jing4 min6 daai6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛他们更有胜算。
examples.english_sentence: They have a better chance of winning this match.

mandarin_meaning: 赃（zāng）；指赃物或非法取得的财物
english_meaning: stolen goods; ill-gotten property
explanation_mandarin: 表示被盜或非法取得的財物，常出現在法律、新聞或司法語境中，如「贓物」「贓款」。
explanation_english: Refers to property obtained by theft or other illegal means; commonly used in legal, news, or judicial contexts (e.g., 'stolen goods', 'ill-gotten money').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺屋企搜到一大堆贓物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 uk1 kei2 sou1 dou3 jat1 daai6 deoi1 zong1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在屋里搜到一大堆赃物。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a large pile of stolen goods in the house.

mandarin_meaning: 赃款（zāngkuǎn）：指犯罪所得或被贪污、挪用的款项
english_meaning: Stolen or illicitly obtained money; proceeds of a crime; embezzled funds
explanation_mandarin: 指透過犯罪、貪污、挪用等非法手段取得的金錢，如盜竊變現的款項或被挪用的公款，常在司法或執法語境中出現。
explanation_english: Refers to money obtained through criminal acts, corruption, or misappropriation (e.g., proceeds from theft or embezzled public funds). Commonly used in legal and law-enforcement contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方拘捕咗嫌疑人，仲追查贓款嘅去向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gu1 bou6 zo2 jim4 ji4 jan4, zung6 zeoi1 caa4 zong1 fun2 ge3 heoi3 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方逮捕了嫌疑人，並追查赃款的去向。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested the suspect and are tracing the whereabouts of the stolen funds.

mandarin_meaning: 赃物
english_meaning: stolen goods; proceeds of crime
explanation_mandarin: 指犯罪所得或被盗的物品，例如被偷或非法取得的财物，常用于法律或治安语境。
explanation_english: Refers to items obtained through criminal activity or stolen goods — property unlawfully taken or otherwise illicitly acquired; commonly used in legal and public safety contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺嫌犯屋企搜出大量贓物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jim4 faan6 uk1 kei2 sou1 ceot1 daai6 loeng6 zong1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在嫌犯家中搜出大量赃物。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a large amount of stolen goods in the suspect's home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 贓物已經交返俾失主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 mat6 ji5 ging1 gaau1 faan1 bei2 sat1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赃物已经交还给失主。
examples.english_sentence: The stolen items have been returned to the owner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果買賣贓物，隨時會畀檢控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 maai5 maai6 zong1 mat6, ceoi4 si4 wui5 bei2 gim2 hung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果买卖赃物，随时会被检控。
examples.english_sentence: If you buy or sell stolen goods, you could be prosecuted.

mandarin_meaning: 赎；赎回、赎罪，指用钱或代价取回东西或弥补过错
english_meaning: to redeem; to ransom; to buy back; to atone
explanation_mandarin: 表示用金钱或其他代价把被占有或抵押的东西取回，或通过某种行为补偿、弥补过错（赎罪）。
explanation_english: Means to buy back or ransom something with money or another price, or to make amends/atone for wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用錢贖返當咗嘅手錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 cin2 suk6 faan1 dong3 zo2 ge3 sau2 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用钱赎回了当掉的手表。
examples.english_sentence: He used money to redeem the pawned watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想用行動贖罪，但係好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jung6 hang4 dung6 suk6 zeoi6, daan6 hai6 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想用行动赎罪，但很难。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to atone through actions, but it's difficult.

mandarin_meaning: 赎罪；补偿或弥补所犯的罪过
english_meaning: to atone for sins; to make amends for wrongdoing
explanation_mandarin: 指通过悔改、补偿或做出行为来弥补或抵消所犯的罪过或过失，常用于宗教或道德语境。
explanation_english: To perform actions (repentance, compensation, good deeds, etc.) to make up for or expiate one's sins or wrongdoings; commonly used in religious or moral contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直想贖罪，唔停做義工幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 soeng2 suk6 zeoi6, m4 ting4 zou6 ji6 gung1 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直想赎罪，不停做义工帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He has been trying to atone for his sins by continually volunteering to help people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用捐款嚟贖罪，希望可以減輕內疚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gyun1 fun2 lai4 suk6 zeoi6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 gaam2 hing1 noi6 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用捐款来赎罪，希望可以减轻内疚。
examples.english_sentence: He donated money to try to atone, hoping it would ease his guilt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺宗教儀式入面，信徒會透過祈禱同行善嚟贖罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung1 gaau3 ji4 sik1 jap6 min6, seon3 tou4 wui5 tau3 gwo3 kei4 dou2 tung4 hang4 sin6 lai4 suk6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在宗教仪式中，信徒会通过祈祷和行善来赎罪。
examples.english_sentence: In religious ceremonies, believers may atone by praying and doing good deeds.

mandarin_meaning: 赎身；买回自由
english_meaning: to ransom/ redeem one's freedom; to buy back one's release (also figuratively, to redeem oneself)
explanation_mandarin: 指用金錢或其他方式買回自己的自由，常用於被販賣或受束縛的情況；也可比喻以某種行為彌補過錯、挽回名譽。
explanation_english: To buy back one's freedom—literally to ransom oneself, often used when someone is released from bondage or sold; can also be used figuratively to mean redeeming oneself or making amends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗離開妓院，畀咗一筆錢贖身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 lei4 hoi1 gei6 jyun2, bei2 zo2 jat1 bat1 cin2 suk6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她為了離開妓院，付了一筆錢贖身。
examples.english_sentence: She paid a sum of money to redeem her freedom from the brothel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗好多善事，想用嚟贖身，洗淨自己嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 sin6 si6, soeng2 jung6 lai4 suk6 san1, sai2 zeng6 zi6 gei2 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了很多善事，想用來贖身，洗清自己的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: He did many good deeds hoping to redeem himself and clear his wrongdoing.

mandarin_meaning: 赎金
english_meaning: ransom (money paid for the release of a captive or to recover seized property)
explanation_mandarin: 指為了釋放被綁架或被扣押的人或物，而支付的金錢。常見於綁架、勒索等情況。
explanation_english: Money paid to secure the release of a kidnapped person or the return of seized property; commonly used in contexts of kidnapping or extortion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 綁匪要求一百萬贖金，否則會傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong6 fai3 jiu1 kau4 jat1 baak3 maan6 suk6 gam1, fau2 zak6 wui5 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 綁匪要求一百萬贖金，否則會傷人。
examples.english_sentence: The kidnappers demanded one million in ransom; otherwise they said they'd hurt someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家屬已經籌到贖金，準備交畀匪徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 suk6 ji5 ging1 cau4 dou3 suk6 gam1, zeon2 bei6 gaau1 bei2 fai2 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家屬已經籌到贖金，準備交給歹徒。
