english_meaning: from beginning to end; start and end (the range or duration)
explanation_mandarin: 表示一段時間或範圍的起點和終點，通常用於書面語或公文中，如「起迄日期」。
explanation_english: Indicates the start and end points of a period or range. Often used in formal or written contexts (e.g. 'start and end dates').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請列出活動的起迄日期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 lit6 ceot1 wut6 dung6 dik1 hei2 hat6 jat6 kei4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请列出活动的起迄日期。
examples.english_sentence: Please list the start and end dates of the event.

mandarin_meaning: 起重机（qǐzhòngjī）：用于吊运、搬运重物的机械，常见于工地、港口和仓库等场所。
english_meaning: Crane (lifting machine): a machine used for lifting and moving heavy objects, commonly seen on construction sites, ports, and warehouses.
explanation_mandarin: 起重机是一种用于提升和搬运重物的机械设备，包括塔式起重机、履带起重机、汽车起重机等多种类型，广泛用于建筑、港口和工业场所。
explanation_english: A crane is a piece of machinery used to lift and move heavy loads. There are various types (tower cranes, crawler cranes, truck-mounted cranes, etc.) used in construction, ports, and industrial settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工地入面有部起重機喺搬石塊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 dei6 jap6 min6 jau5 bou6 hei2 zung6 gei1 hai6 baan1 sek6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地里面有一台起重机在搬运石块。
examples.english_sentence: There's a crane on the construction site moving stone blocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起重機已經將嗰個貨櫃吊咗上卡車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 zung6 gei1 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 go2 go3 fo3 gwai6 diu3 soeng5 zo2 kaa1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起重机已经把那个货柜吊上了卡车。
examples.english_sentence: The crane has already lifted that container onto the truck.

mandarin_meaning: 挑起事端；挑釁（口語/俚語）
english_meaning: to provoke trouble; to pick a fight (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語或俚語，指故意挑起事端、挑釁或惹事，常用於形容人在公眾或小圈子內製造麻煩或衝突。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to intentionally provoke trouble or pick a quarrel, often used to describe someone stirring up trouble in public or within a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺度起釘，成日搞到大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 dou6 hei2 ding1, seng4 jat6 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡在那裡挑事，經常弄得大家不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to stir up trouble there, often making everyone unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 起锚（起锚、起航）
english_meaning: to weigh anchor; to set sail; to depart
explanation_mandarin: 指船隻把錨舉起離開停泊地，也可引申為開始出發或啟程。
explanation_english: Literally, to lift the anchor so a ship leaves its berth; can also be used figuratively to mean to set off or depart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 船已經起錨，唔好再上嚟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun4 ji5 ging1 hei2 maau4, m4 hou2 zoi6 soeng5 lai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船已经起锚了，不要再上来了！
examples.english_sentence: The ship has already weighed anchor; don't come aboard!

mandarin_meaning: 上發條（手錶）；炫耀（手錶）
english_meaning: to wind a watch; (slang) to show off an expensive watch / to flaunt
explanation_mandarin: 1) 字面意思是給機械手錶上發條或把手錶重新調好時間。2) 口語（俚語）用法指炫耀、顯擺（通常指炫耀名貴手錶或財力）。
explanation_english: 1) Literally: to wind or set a mechanical watch. 2) Colloquially (slang): to show off or flaunt, especially by displaying an expensive watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要記得起錶，唔好等佢停咗先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 gei3 dak1 hei2 biu1, m4 hou2 dang2 keoi5 ting4 zo2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要記得給手錶上發條，不要等它停了才去。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wind your watch; don't wait until it stops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度起錶，淨係識炫耀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 hei2 biu1, zing6 hai6 sik1 syun3 jiu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那邊炫耀手錶，只會顯擺。
examples.english_sentence: He's always showing off his watch; all he does is flaunt it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我面前起錶啦，低調啲好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 hei2 biu1 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別在我面前炫耀了，低調一點可以嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Don't flaunt it in front of me, could you be a bit more low-key?

mandarin_meaning: 起床（被鬧鐘或鐘聲叫醒）
english_meaning: to get up (usually when an alarm/clock rings); to wake up
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，起鐘通常指被鬧鐘或鐘聲叫醒而起床，也可泛指因時間到了而起身（例如輪班、上班）。屬口語用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 起鐘 typically means to wake up because of an alarm or clock; it can also refer more generally to getting up at a designated time (e.g., for a shift or work). It is a colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早六點起鐘，我就要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 luk6 dim2 hei2 zung1, ngo5 zau6 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上六点起床，我就要上班。
examples.english_sentence: I get up at 6 AM to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想起鐘，多訓陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 hei2 zung1, do1 fan3 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想起床，再多睡一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to get up; I'll sleep a bit longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽用鬧鐘幫我起鐘，唔使遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jung6 naau6 zung1 bong1 ngo5 hei2 zung1, m4 sai2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈用闹钟叫我起床，不会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: My mom uses an alarm clock to wake me so I won't be late.

mandarin_meaning: 惹禍 / 惹上麻煩
english_meaning: to cause trouble; to stir up trouble; to get into a mess
explanation_mandarin: 「起鑊」是廣東話口語，意思是惹是生非、引起麻煩或衝突，常用於形容某人或某事造成問題或招惹別人不滿。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to cause trouble, stir up conflict, or get into a mess — often used when someone provokes problems or brings trouble upon themselves or others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再起鑊啦，已經夠麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hei2 wok6 laa1, ji5 ging1 gau3 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別再惹事了，已經夠麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble again, it's already troublesome enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司成日起鑊，搞到大家都無心情做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 hei2 wok6, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 mou4 sam1 cing4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司老是惹事，搞得大家都沒心情工作。
examples.english_sentence: He always causes trouble at the company, making everyone lose motivation to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗一啲小事就起鑊，實在冇必要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jat1 di1 siu2 si6 zau6 hei2 wok6, sat6 zoi6 mou5 bit1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了一些小事就惹禍，實在沒必要。
examples.english_sentence: Starting trouble over small matters is really unnecessary.

mandarin_meaning: （俚语）约两人一起发生性关系（即三人行）；也可口语化指两人一同离开去幽会。
english_meaning: Slang for arranging or having a threesome (a sexual encounter involving three people); can also colloquially mean two people leaving together for a tryst.
explanation_mandarin: 「起雙飛」是香港廣東話的俚語，通常指安排三人一同發生性關係（例如一男兩女或一女兩男）。有時也泛指兩人一同離開去幽會或上酒店。該詞屬口語且偏粗俗，不適合正式場合使用。
explanation_english: This Cantonese slang phrase typically refers to arranging or taking part in a threesome (e.g., one man with two women or vice versa). It can also be used more loosely to mean two people leaving together for a tryst or to hook up. It is informal and can be crude, so it's inappropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚約咗兩個女仔，打算起雙飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 joek3 zo2 loeng5 go3 neoi5 zai2, daa2 syun3 hei2 soeng1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚約了兩個女孩，打算玩雙飛（和兩個女生一起發生性關係）。
examples.english_sentence: He arranged to meet two girls tonight and plans to have a threesome.

mandarin_meaning: 起鸡皮疙瘩
english_meaning: to get goosebumps / to get the creeps
explanation_mandarin: 表示皮肤因寒冷、害怕、震惊或厌恶等情绪而起小疙瘩，也可比喻对某事感到毛骨悚然或不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes the physical reaction of getting goosebumps (skin bumps) caused by cold, fear, awe, disgust, etc.; can also be used figuratively to mean feeling creeped out or deeply unsettled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到嗰個鬼故我起雞皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 go2 go3 gwai2 gu3 ngo5 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到那个鬼故事我起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: I got goosebumps when I heard that ghost story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到自己嗰段經歷我都起雞皮，完全唔敢諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 zi6 gei2 go2 dyun6 ging1 lik6 ngo5 dou1 hei2 gai1 pei4, jyun4 cyun4 m4 gam2 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲到自己的那段经历我都起鸡皮疙瘩，完全不敢想。
examples.english_sentence: When he talked about his experience I got goosebumps — I didn't even dare to imagine it.

mandarin_meaning: 開始；帶頭；發起
english_meaning: to start; to initiate; to take the lead; the beginning
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，表示開始或發起某件事、帶頭做某事，也可指事情的開端或起始階段。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to start or initiate something, to take the lead in doing something; it can also refer to the beginning or opening stage of an event or process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我未講完之前就起頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 mei6 gong2 jyun4 zi1 cin4 zau6 hei2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在我沒說完之前就開始（做事）。
examples.english_sentence: Don't start before I've finished speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔起頭，其他人都唔會做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 hei2 tau4, kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 m4 wui5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不帶頭，其他人也不會做。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't take the lead, others won't do it either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個工程起頭嗰陣好難處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gung1 cing4 hei2 tau4 go2 zan6 hou2 naan4 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個工程在開始時很難處理。
examples.english_sentence: The beginning of that project was hard to handle.

mandarin_meaning: 起飞；（口语）迅速上升、暴涨；（口语）迅速离开/逃走
english_meaning: to take off (plane); (slang) to soar/skyrocket; (slang) to take off/leave quickly
explanation_mandarin: “起飛”原指飞机升空起飞。粤语口语中常被引申为：1) 某事物或价格迅速上升、暴涨（如股票、人气）；2) 某人突然迅速离开或逃走（口语用法）。
explanation_english: Literally 'to take off' (as a plane). In Cantonese slang it is often extended to mean: 1) to rise rapidly or skyrocket (e.g. prices, popularity); 2) to leave or run off suddenly (colloquial).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機喺九點幾起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 hai2 gau2 dim2 gei2 hei2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机在九点多起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The plane takes off a little after nine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻股票今日開始起飛喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 gam1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 hei2 fei1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只股票今天开始起飞了（暴涨）。
examples.english_sentence: This stock started to take off (skyrocket) today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到狗就馬上起飛走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 gau2 zau6 maa5 soeng6 hei2 fei1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到狗就马上跑走了。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the dog and immediately took off/run away.

mandarin_meaning: 逃走；跑掉；溜走（俚語）
english_meaning: to run off; to flee; to make a quick exit (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語的俚語，指突然離開或逃跑，常用於為了避免麻煩、責任或付帳等情況下迅速離去。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression meaning to suddenly leave or flee, often used when someone makes a quick exit to avoid trouble, responsibility, or payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到差人就即刻起飛腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 caa1 jan4 zau6 zik1 haak1 hei2 fei1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到警察就立刻跑掉。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the police and immediately ran off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好起飛腳，等我講完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hei2 fei1 goek3, dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要逃跑，等我說完再走。
examples.english_sentence: Don't run away; wait until I finish talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯佢哋竟然起飛腳，唔埋單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 keoi5 dei6 ging2 jin4 hei2 fei1 goek3, m4 maai4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完飯他們竟然跑掉不付帳。
examples.english_sentence: After the meal they actually ran off without paying the bill.

mandarin_meaning: 起初；一开始
english_meaning: at the beginning; to begin with; initially
explanation_mandarin: 表示時間上的起始或首先發生的事，相當於「一開始」「起初」。
explanation_english: Indicates the temporal start of something or what comes first; equivalent to "at first" or "to begin with."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起首我以為佢唔會嚟，點知佢竟然到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 sau2 ngo5 ji5 wai6 keoi5 m4 wui5 lai4, dim2 zi1 keoi5 ging2 jin4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起初我以为他不会来，没想到他竟然来了。
examples.english_sentence: At first I thought he wouldn't come, but he unexpectedly arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做報告嘅時候，起首要講清楚目的同埋分工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 bou3 gou3 ge3 si4 hau6, hei2 sau2 jiu3 gong2 cing1 co2 muk6 dik1 tung4 maai4 fan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做报告的时候，首先要把目的和分工讲清楚。
examples.english_sentence: When preparing the report, first you must clarify the goals and division of responsibilities.

mandarin_meaning: 騎馬；（口語）出發、啟程
english_meaning: to mount a horse; (colloquial) to set off / get going / start moving
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思為騎上馬。在口語（尤其是香港廣東話）中，有時作俗語使用，表示出發、啟程或開始行動。
explanation_english: Literally 'to mount a horse'. In colloquial Cantonese (particularly in Hong Kong) it can be used as slang to mean 'set off', 'get going', or 'start moving'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺鄉下學起馬，騎得幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 hok6 hei2 maa5, kei4 dak1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在鄉下學騎馬，騎得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He learned to ride horses in the countryside and rides quite well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家起馬啦，時間唔多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 hei2 maa5 laa1, si4 gaan3 m4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家快點出發，時間不多了。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone, let's get going — there's not much time left.

mandarin_meaning: 去骨（把魚或肉的骨頭/刺去除）
english_meaning: to debone; to remove bones or pin bones from fish or meat
explanation_mandarin: 「起骨」在廣東話中常用於烹飪或處理食材時，指把魚或肉上的骨頭或刺挑走、去除，使食材成為無骨狀態，便於烹調或食用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "起骨" refers to the culinary action of removing bones or pin bones from fish or meat (i.e., deboning), making the ingredient boneless and easier to cook or eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條魚起骨咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 hei2 gwat1 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條魚去骨了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Has this fish been deboned yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房啲師傅而家正喺起骨隻雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 fong4 di1 si1 fu1 ji4 gaa1 zing3 hai2 hei2 gwat1 zek3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房的師傅正在把雞去骨。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen's chefs are deboning a chicken right now.

mandarin_meaning: 起哄 (qǐhòng)：鼓譟、挑起騷動或喧鬧
english_meaning: to incite a commotion; to heckle or create a noisy disturbance
explanation_mandarin: 指煽動或挑起群眾喧鬧、鼓譟或作勢鬧事，常見於演出、集會或爭論時的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to instigating or provoking a noisy disturbance or heckling, often occurring during performances, gatherings, or disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人喺演唱會度起鬨，搞到全場好亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2 dou6 hei2 hung3, gaau2 dou3 cyun4 coeng4 hou2 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在演唱会上起哄，搞得全场很乱。
examples.english_sentence: People were heckling at the concert, making the whole venue chaotic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好起鬨，佢而家已經好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hei2 hung3, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要起哄，他現在已經很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a fuss; he's already very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報道指示威者起鬨，影響了談判進行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 zi2 si6 wai1 ze2 hei2 hung3, jing2 hoeng2 liu5 taam4 pun3 zeon3 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻报道指出示威者起哄，影响了谈判的进行。
examples.english_sentence: Reports say protesters were heckling, affecting the progress of the negotiations.

mandarin_meaning: 起鸡皮疙瘩（感到寒顫、害怕或被感動）
english_meaning: to get goosebumps; to feel chills (from fear, cold, or being moved)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，字面指皮膚因寒冷或驚嚇而豎起雞皮疙瘩，也常用來形容被音樂、故事等感動或震撼時的生理反應或情緒反應。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning the skin develops goosebumps (a physiological reaction to cold or fear). It is also used figuratively for getting chills when moved, scared, or deeply affected by something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到嗰段歌我起鷄皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 go2 dyun6 go1 ngo5 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到那段歌我起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: I got goosebumps when I heard that song.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇恐怖片會起鷄皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hung2 bou3 pin3 wui5 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看恐怖片會起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: Watching horror movies gives me goosebumps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰段故仔我真係起鷄皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 dyun6 gu3 zi2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讲那段故事我真的起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: I really got goosebumps when you told that part of the story.

mandarin_meaning: 起点
english_meaning: starting point; point of departure; origin
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物開始的地點或階段，也可用作比喻，指事物的出發點或基礎。
explanation_english: Refers to the place or stage where something begins; can be used literally for a physical starting point or metaphorically for an initial stage or basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋由呢個起點開始行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau4 ni1 go3 hei2 dim2 hoi1 ci2 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从这个起点开始爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We start hiking from this starting point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅起點係政府嘅資助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 hei2 dim2 hai6 zing3 fu2 ge3 zi1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的起点是政府的资助。
examples.english_sentence: The starting point of this project is government funding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打好基礎係成功嘅起點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 hou2 gei1 co2 hai6 sing4 gung1 ge3 hei2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打好基础是成功的起点。
examples.english_sentence: Laying a solid foundation is the starting point for success.

mandarin_meaning: 挑起爭端；惹事
english_meaning: to start trouble; to pick a quarrel; to stir up a fuss (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「起𦢊」為廣東話口語用詞，字形較罕見或為俗字，常用來形容故意挑起爭端或惹事。使用上屬於俗語或香港口語範疇，有時可與「挑機」「惹事」「起事」相近。其讀音在不同說話者間可能有變異，這裡給予常見的釋讀標示。
explanation_english: “起𦢊” is a colloquial Cantonese/slang expression (rare character form). It typically means to provoke, cause trouble, or pick a quarrel. It is used in informal Hong Kong Cantonese and can be synonymous with words like “挑機” (to provoke) or “惹事” (to cause trouble). The character is uncommon and pronunciation may vary among speakers; the provided Jyutping is a common approximation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度起𦢊，搞到大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 hei2 ngaap3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡挑事，弄得大家不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps stirring up trouble there, making everyone unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日起𦢊啦，冇意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hei2 ngaap3 laa1, mou5 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是惹事了，沒意思。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep causing trouble, it's pointless.

mandarin_meaning: 趁（利用、趁着）
english_meaning: to take advantage of; to seize (an opportunity); while
explanation_mandarin: 表示利用某个时机或在某种情况下做某事，例如趁机、趁着……时。
explanation_english: Indicates using an opportunity or doing something while a certain time or situation exists (e.g., 'take advantage of', 'while').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁今日有空，我去買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 gam1 jat6 jau5 hung1, ngo5 heoi3 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁今天有空，我去买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go buy something while I have free time today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁早做啦，唔好拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 zou2 zou6 laa1, m4 hou2 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁早做吧，不要拖延。
examples.english_sentence: Do it early; don't procrastinate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁住細路瞓覺，我哋傾下計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 zyu6 sai3 lou6 fan3 gaau3, ngo5 dei6 king1 haa5 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁小孩睡覺，我們談談。
examples.english_sentence: Let's talk while the kids are sleeping.

mandarin_meaning: 趁低吸纳 / 趁低买入
english_meaning: buy on the dip; take advantage of lower prices to buy assets
explanation_mandarin: 指在價格下跌或回落時，趁機買入股票或其他資產以累積持倉或獲取潛在收益。
explanation_english: Refers to purchasing stocks or other assets when prices have fallen, taking advantage of the lower price to accumulate positions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你睇好呢隻股票，可以趁低吸納。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 tai2 hou2 ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3, ho2 ji5 can3 dai1 kap1 naap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你看好這隻股票，可以趁低吸納。
examples.english_sentence: If you believe in this stock, you can buy on the dip.

jyutping: can3 nei5 beng6, lo2 nei5 ming6
mandarin_meaning: 趁人之危；趁人虚弱时加以伤害或利用
english_meaning: To take advantage of someone when they're weak or vulnerable; to strike when someone is down; exploit or harm someone in their vulnerable state.
explanation_mandarin: 表示趁人虚弱或处于不利境地时加以伤害、利用或迫使对方做对自己不利的事，通常为口语，含贬义。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression meaning to exploit, harm, or take advantage of someone when they are weak or in a vulnerable situation; carries a negative judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司見我手頭拮据，就趁我病，攞我命，逼我簽一啲唔公平嘅條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gin3 ngo5 sau2 tau4 gik1 geoi3, zau6 can3 ngo5 beng6, lo2 ngo5 ming6, bik1 ngo5 cim1 jat1 di1 m4 gung1 ping4 ge3 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司看到我手頭拮据，就趁我虚弱，逼我签一些不公平的条款。
examples.english_sentence: The company saw I was short on money and took advantage of my weakness to force me to sign some unfair terms.

jyutping: can3 keoi5 beng6 lo2 keoi5 ming6
mandarin_meaning: 乘人之危 / 趁人有難時再下狠手
english_meaning: to take advantage of someone's weakness or misfortune to attack or exploit them; to hit someone when they're down
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，指趁別人處於病弱或困境時，對其加以攻擊、剝削或陷害，往往帶有刻意趁虛而入的惡意。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to exploit or attack someone when they are vulnerable (e.g., sick or in trouble); similar to 'to hit someone when they're down.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司趁佢病攞佢命，借故解僱佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 can3 keoi5 beng6 lo2 keoi5 ming6, ze3 gu3 gaai2 gu3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司趁他生病時乘人之危，找藉口解雇他。
examples.english_sentence: The company took advantage of his illness to make things worse for him, using an excuse to fire him.

mandarin_meaning: 趁勢（趁勢而為、藉勢）
english_meaning: to take advantage of the momentum/situation; to seize an opportunity
explanation_mandarin: 表示利用當前有利的情況或勢頭採取行動或作出決定，通常用作動詞短語。
explanation_english: Expresses using favorable circumstances or momentum to take action or make a decision; commonly used as a verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家佢好受歡迎，佢趁勢推出咗新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 keoi5 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4, keoi5 can3 sai3 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在他很受歡迎，他趁勢推出了新產品。
examples.english_sentence: He's popular right now, and he took advantage of the momentum to launch a new product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機會嚟緊，趁勢出手唔好遲疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 wui6 lai4 gan2, can3 sai3 ceot1 sau2 m4 hou2 ci4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 機會就要來了，趁勢出手不要猶豫。
examples.english_sentence: The opportunity is coming—seize the moment and act without hesitation.

mandarin_meaning: 趁人之危；在別人處於不利或困境時趁機取笑、占便宜或加以攻擊
english_meaning: to take advantage of someone when they're down; to kick someone when they're down; opportunistically exploit or mock someone in a vulnerable situation
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，字面有“趁（利用）+ 地（對方處於地位低、落難）+ 淋（比喻落井下石、落口水或加以嘲弄）”的含義。通常指在別人處於困境、尷尬或失敗時趁機嘲笑、攻擊或占便宜，含貶義，類似「趁火打劫」「落井下石」。此詞在香港俗語中可聽到，但屬非正式或地域性用法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase meaning to take advantage of someone when they are in a disadvantageous or vulnerable position. Literally composed of characters meaning 'take advantage' + 'ground' + 'pour/wet', it is used figuratively for opportunistic mocking, attacking, or exploiting someone who is down. It carries a negative connotation and is similar to English 'kick someone when they're down' or Mandarin '落井下石'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好趁地淋，佢依家最需要人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 can3 dei6 lam4, keoi5 ji1 gaa1 zeoi3 seoi1 jiu3 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要趁人落難，他現在最需要別人的幫助。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take advantage of someone when they're down — they need help the most right now.

mandarin_meaning: 趁機偷懶；利用情況放鬆、不用功
english_meaning: to take the opportunity to slack off; to loaf when the situation allows
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指趁某個時機或某人不注意時偷懶、放鬆、不做正經事。常用於工作或家居情境，帶點輕鬆或略帶責備的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to take advantage of an opportunity to slack off or be lazy. Often used in workplace or home contexts, with a slightly admonishing or casual tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁老細唔喺，公司度趁地腍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 lou5 sai3 m4 hai2, gung1 si1 dou6 can3 dei6 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁老闆不在公司時偷懶。
examples.english_sentence: He slacked off at the office while the boss was away.

mandarin_meaning: 去集市；趁機、利用時機
english_meaning: to go to the market when it's held; to take advantage of an opportunity (to do something)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，原意是趁着有墟（集市）時去買東西或遊逛；引申為利用某個場合或時機做某事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase originally meaning to go to the market when it's held (to shop or browse); figuratively it means to take advantage of an occasion or opportunity to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 禮拜日嗰度有墟，我哋去趁墟買嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai5 baai3 jat6 go2 dou6 jau5 heoi1, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 can3 heoi1 maai5 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 禮拜日那裡有集市，我們去集市買東西吧。
examples.english_sentence: There is a market there on Sunday; let's go to the market and buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趁墟順便探吓阿媽，順道買啲菜返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 can3 heoi1 seon6 bin6 taam3 haa5 aa3 maa1, seon6 dou6 maai5 di1 coi3 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我趁集市順便去看望媽媽，順道買些菜回家。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to the market and, while I'm at it, visit my mum and buy some vegetables to take home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁墟搵機會同老細傾下人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 heoi1 wan2 gei1 wui6 tung4 lou5 sai3 king1 haa5 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁機找機會跟老闆談加薪。
examples.english_sentence: He took the opportunity to find a chance to talk to his boss about a raise.

mandarin_meaning: 順手；好用；得心應手
english_meaning: handy; easy to use; convenient to handle
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物使用起來很順手、好用，或形容人做事得心應手、操作方便。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is handy or convenient to use, or that a person handles a task skillfully and comfortably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把刀好趁手，切菜切得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 dou1 hou2 can3 sau2, cit3 coi3 cit3 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這把刀很順手，切菜切得很快。
examples.english_sentence: This knife is very handy; it chops vegetables very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵個趁手嘅幫手，做嘢會順好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 go3 can3 sau2 ge3 bong1 sau2, zou6 je5 wui5 seon6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找一個順手的幫手，做事會順利很多。
examples.english_sentence: Find a handy/helper; things will go much more smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機好趁手，放喺袋度好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hou2 can3 sau2, fong3 hai2 doi6 dou6 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機很順手，放在袋裡很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is very handy; it's convenient to put in your pocket.

mandarin_meaning: 趁早 (chèn zǎo)：趁現在或在還不太遲的時候儘早去做某事
english_meaning: sooner rather than later; do something as soon as possible; before it's too late
explanation_mandarin: 表示在還不太遲的時候儘快行動，常用來提醒、勸告或催促別人趕緊做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates acting now or before it's too late; commonly used to urge, advise, or prompt someone to do something promptly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你趁早做決定，唔好再拖啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 can3 zou2 zou6 kyut3 ding6, m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你趁早做决定，不要再拖了。
examples.english_sentence: Make a decision sooner rather than later; don't keep delaying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你趁早離開現場，避開危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 can3 zou2 lei4 hoi1 jin6 coeng4, bei6 hoi1 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你趁早离开现场，避开危险。
examples.english_sentence: Leave the scene as soon as possible to avoid danger.

mandarin_meaning: 趁着机会；利用有利的时机
english_meaning: to take advantage of an opportunity; to seize the chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示利用某个顺势或有利的时机去做某事，通常含有把握机会或趁势而为的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates using a favorable or opportune moment to do something; to seize the chance or take advantage of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁機溜走，冇同我講一聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 gei1 lau4 zau2, mou5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 jat1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁機溜走，沒跟我說一聲。
examples.english_sentence: He took the opportunity to slip away without telling me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以趁機問吓佢，睇下佢有冇時間幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 can3 gei1 man6 haa5 keoi5, tai2 haa5 keoi5 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以趁機問問他，看看他有沒有時間幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: You can take the opportunity to ask him and see if he has time to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生趁老師唔留神就趁機偷懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 saang1 can3 lou5 si1 m4 lau4 san1 zau6 can3 gei1 tau1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學生趁老師不注意的時候就趁機偷懶。
examples.english_sentence: The students take advantage of the teacher not paying attention to slack off.

mandarin_meaning: 趁火打劫 (chèn huǒ dǎ jié) — 趁別人遭遇不幸或混亂時占便宜或掠奪
english_meaning: Literally 'to loot during a fire'; figuratively to take advantage of someone's misfortune or a chaotic situation to profit or plunder
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是在火災時搶劫，常用來比喻趁別人有危難或混亂時占便宜、剝削或掠奪。
explanation_english: The literal image is looting during a fire; used figuratively to describe exploiting someone else's misfortune or chaos for personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啱啱遇到危機，有啲供應商趁火打劫，抬高價錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ngaam1 ngaam1 jyu6 dou3 ngai4 gei1, jau5 di1 gung1 jing3 soeng1 can3 fo2 daa2 gip6, toi4 gou1 gaa3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司剛遇到危機，有些供應商趁火打劫，抬高價格。
examples.english_sentence: The company just ran into a crisis, and some suppliers are taking advantage of it by raising prices.

mandarin_meaning: 趁热闹；趁着热闹的气氛加入或利用热闹场面
english_meaning: to join in the fun; to take advantage of the lively atmosphere; to join the crowd
explanation_mandarin: 表示利用或跟著熱鬧的場合或氣氛一起參與，通常是隨著大家的熱鬧而行動，有時帶有湊熱鬧或順勢而為的意思。
explanation_english: Means to join or take advantage of a lively situation or atmosphere. Often used when someone participates because things are lively or popular, sometimes implying joining the crowd rather than acting for deeper reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚街市好熱鬧，不如我哋趁熱鬧出去行下街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaai1 si5 hou2 jit6 naau6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 ceon3 jit6 naau6 ceot1 heoi3 haang4 haa5 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚市场很热闹，我们趁热闹出去逛逛吧。
examples.english_sentence: The market is lively tonight; let's take advantage of the buzz and go out for a walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係趁熱鬧嚟，唔係真心幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 ceon3 jit6 naau6 lai4, m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是趁热闹来，不是真心帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He's just here to join in the fun, not really to help.

mandarin_meaning: 趁著有利的形勢行事，見勢而行；常含投機、見風轉舵的負面意思
english_meaning: to take advantage of a favorable situation; to act opportunistically or adapt one's stance to the prevailing circumstances (often with a negative connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 指在有利的條件或情勢下採取行動，常帶有見風轉舵、投機取巧的含義，用來批評人沒有立場或原則。
explanation_english: Refers to taking action when circumstances are favorable; often implies opportunism or changing one's stance to suit circumstances. Used to criticize someone for lacking principles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲政客成日趁風使𢃇，見勢好就改口，根本冇原則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 zing3 haak3 seng4 jat6 can3 fung1 si2 do6, gin3 sai3 hou2 zau6 goi2 hau2, gan1 bun2 mou5 jyun4 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些政客經常見風使舵，形勢一好就改變立場，根本沒有原則。
examples.english_sentence: Those politicians often act opportunistically; as soon as the situation favors them they change their stance — they have no principles.

mandarin_meaning: 趁（着）高兴；趁人高兴（趁对方心情好时趁机做某事）
english_meaning: to take advantage of (someone) being in a good mood; to do something while (someone) is happy
explanation_mandarin: 表示趁着某人或某个时刻心情好，抓住机会做某事，常用于口语。
explanation_english: Indicates taking advantage of someone’s good mood or a favorable moment to do something; commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁佢高興，唔好錯過請佢食飯嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 keoi5 gou1 hing3, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3 cing2 keoi5 sik6 faan6 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁他高兴，不要错过请他吃饭的机会。
examples.english_sentence: While he's in a good mood, don't miss the chance to invite him to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趁高興買咗張演唱會門票，你想一齊去嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 can3 gou1 hing3 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 mun4 piu3, nei5 soeng2 jat1 cai4 heoi3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我趁高兴买了张演唱会门票，你想一起去吗？
examples.english_sentence: I bought a concert ticket while I was in a good mood—do you want to go together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好趁高興亂答應人哋，未必做得到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 can3 gou1 hing3 lyun6 daap3 jing3 jan4 dei6, mei6 bat1 zou6 dak1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要趁高兴随便答应别人，未必能做到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't promise things on a whim while you're in a good mood; you might not be able to follow through.

mandarin_meaning: 绊倒；踉跄，失足
english_meaning: to stumble; to trip; to stagger
explanation_mandarin: 表示行走或站立時失去平衡、被絆倒或踉蹌，常用於口語表達。
explanation_english: Denotes losing balance while walking or standing — to trip, stumble, or stagger. Often used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路小心啲，唔好趄親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 lou6 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 keoi4 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路小心，不要绊倒。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when you walk — don't trip.

mandarin_meaning: 超（chāo）：超过、超出；（口语）很、特别；作前缀表示“超级-”
english_meaning: to exceed, to surpass; (colloquial) very / super; prefix meaning super-
explanation_mandarin: “超”在粤语中可作动词表示超过或超出（如：超咗預算），亦常作口语副词用来加强语气，相当于“很/特别”，还可作为前缀（如“超級”）表示程度极高。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, “超” can be a verb meaning to exceed or surpass, a colloquial adverb used as an intensifier (meaning very/super), and a prefix (as in 'super-').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅價錢超咗我嘅預算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 gaa3 cin4 ciu1 zo2 ngo5 ge3 jyu6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的价格超过了我的预算。
examples.english_sentence: The price of this shirt exceeded my budget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日超開心！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ciu1 hoi1 sam1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天特别开心！
examples.english_sentence: He's super happy today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試超難，我要溫習多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 ciu1 naan4, ngo5 jiu3 wan4 zaap6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试超难，我要多复习。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is super difficult; I need to study more.

mandarin_meaning: 超出；超過；超越（常用於「超乎……的想像/預期」）
english_meaning: to exceed; to be beyond; to surpass; often used as 'beyond one's imagination/expectation'
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出某個範圍或超過預期，常見用法如「超乎想像／超乎預期」。
explanation_english: Indicates exceeding a certain range or being beyond expectations. Commonly used in phrases like 'beyond imagination' or 'beyond expectations'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現超乎我哋嘅預期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 ciu1 fu1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyu6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表現超出我們的預期。
examples.english_sentence: His performance exceeded our expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事超乎我嘅想像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ciu1 fu1 ngo5 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事超乎我的想像。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is beyond my imagination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜嘅味道超乎尋常，好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 ge3 mei6 dou6 ciu1 fu1 cam4 soeng4, hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這道菜的味道超乎尋常，非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The flavor of this dish is unusually good — very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 超人 (chāorén)：指漫畫或電影中的超級英雄，也可指能力非常出眾的人或超越常人的存在。
english_meaning: superman; superhero; superhuman — literally the superhero character and figuratively someone with extraordinary abilities.
explanation_mandarin: “超人”一方面指像漫畫／電影裡的超級英雄（例如 Superman），另一方面可作比喻，用來形容能力、效率或體力等方面非常出色、近乎超乎常人的人。
explanation_english: “超人” refers to the superhero character (e.g., Superman) and is also used figuratively to describe someone with extraordinary abilities, stamina, or performance beyond normal human levels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超人電影好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 jan4 din6 jing2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超人電影很好看。
examples.english_sentence: The Superman movie is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢工作咁叻，簡直係個超人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 zok3 gam2 lek1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 go3 ciu1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么出色，简直是个超人。
examples.english_sentence: He's so good at his job, he's practically a superman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為每個人都係超人，大家都有極限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai6 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 hai6 ciu1 jan4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 gik6 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为每个人都是超人，大家都有极限。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume everyone is a superhuman; everyone has limits.

mandarin_meaning: 超級任天堂（指 SNES 主機）
english_meaning: Super Nintendo (SNES)
explanation_mandarin: 「超任」是「超級任天堂」的簡稱，指1990年代流行的任天堂家用遊戲主機 SNES（Super Nintendo Entertainment System），在粵語及華語圈中常作口語或俚語使用。
explanation_english: “超任” is an abbreviation of “Super Nintendo” (Super Nintendo Entertainment System, SNES). It refers to Nintendo's 1990s home console and is used colloquially in Cantonese and other Chinese varieties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日玩超任，仲記得《超級瑪利歐世界》好好玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 waan2 ciu1 jam6, zung6 gei3 dak1 《ciu1 kap1 maa5 lei5 ngau4 sai3 gaai3》hou2 hou2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常玩超任，還记得《超级马里奥世界》很好玩。
examples.english_sentence: I used to play the SNES a lot when I was a kid; I still remember how fun Super Mario World was.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）超出、超過（並強調持續處於超出狀態）
english_meaning: (colloquial) to exceed / go over (a limit), with an emphasis on remaining in that exceeded state
explanation_mandarin: 「超住」為廣東話口語用法，常用於香港，表示某項數值或限額已被超過，且強調仍處於超出的狀態。屬於非正式或口語用法，書面語通常用「超過」或「超出」。
explanation_english: “超住” is a colloquial Cantonese expression (commonly heard in Hong Kong) meaning that something has exceeded a limit and remains in that exceeded state. It is informal; the standard written equivalents are “超過” or “exceed”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近電費成日超住預算，真係唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 din6 fai3 sing4 jat6 ciu1 zyu6 jyu6 syun3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近電費常常超出預算，真的不知道怎麼辦好。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the electricity bill keeps going over the budget; I really don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 超值
english_meaning: great value; worth the price; good value for money
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物的價值超過其價格，物超所值，划算。
explanation_english: Indicates that something's value exceeds its price — it's a great deal or good value for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機真係超值，功能又多，價錢又平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 zan1 hai6 ciu1 zik6, gung1 nang4 jau6 do1, gaa3 cin2 jau6 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机真的超值，功能很多，价钱又便宜。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is really great value — lots of features and a low price.

mandarin_meaning: 超出凡俗；非凡、卓越
english_meaning: extraordinary; exceptional; surpassing the ordinary
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出凡俗、非同尋常，常用來形容才能、成就或表現卓越。
explanation_english: Indicates something that surpasses the ordinary; extraordinary or remarkable. Often used to describe talent, achievement, or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅才華真係超凡，喺樂壇好快就出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 coi4waa4 zan1 hai6 ciu1 faan4, hai2 ngok6 taan4 hou2 faai3 zau6 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的才華真是超凡，在樂壇很快就出名了。
examples.english_sentence: His talent is truly extraordinary; he became famous in the music scene quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅風格超凡脫俗，好有藝術感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 ge3 fung1 gok3 ciu1 faan4 tyut3 suk6, hou2 jau5 ngai6 seot6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫的風格超凡脫俗，很有藝術感。
examples.english_sentence: The style of this painting is exceptionally refined and unconventional; it feels very artistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現超凡，得到評審一致嘅好評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 ciu1 faan4, dak1 dou3 ping4 sam2 jat1 zi6 ge3 hou2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表現超凡，獲得評審一致的好評。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was outstanding and received unanimous praise from the judges.

mandarin_meaning: 超凡入圣 (chāofán rùshèng)：超出凡俗，达到圣人或极高境界；形容学问、技艺等达到非常高的水平。
english_meaning: To transcend the ordinary and attain a sublime or saint-like state; to reach an extraordinary degree of skill or achievement.
explanation_mandarin: 用于形容人的學問、技藝、境界等超出常人，達到極高、近乎完美的程度，帶有讚美或崇敬的語氣。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone's knowledge, skill, or attainment as far beyond ordinary—reaching an exceptionally high, almost perfect level; often used with admiration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅武功練到超凡入聖，冇幾個人可以打得過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mou5 gung1 lin6 dou3 ciu1 faan4 jap6 sing3, mou5 gei2 go3 jan4 ho2 ji5 daa2 dak1 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的武功已練到超凡入聖，沒幾個人能打得過他。
examples.english_sentence: His martial arts have been practiced to such an extent that they've transcended the ordinary—hardly anyone can beat him.

mandarin_meaning: 超出
english_meaning: to exceed; to go beyond; to surpass
explanation_mandarin: 表示超过某个范围、限度或预期，用于描述数量、程度或期望等超出原本限制的情况。
explanation_english: Indicates going beyond a certain limit, range, or expectation; used to describe quantities, degrees, or expectations that surpass their original bounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月嘅開支已經超出我嘅預算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 ge3 hoi1 zi1 ji5 ging1 ciu1 ceot1 ngo5 ge3 jyu6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的开支已经超出我的预算。
examples.english_sentence: This month's expenses have already exceeded my budget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現超出咗老師嘅期望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 ciu1 ceot1 zo2 lou5 si1 ge3 kei4 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现超出了老师的期望。
examples.english_sentence: His performance exceeded the teacher's expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅速度已經超出安全範圍，唔好再加速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 cuk1 dou6 ji5 ging1 ciu1 ceot1 on1 cyun4 faan6 wai4, m4 hou2 zoi6 gaa1 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的速度已经超出安全范围，不要再加速。
examples.english_sentence: The current speed has already gone beyond the safe range; don't accelerate further.

mandarin_meaning: 超前 (chāoqián) — 在时间、进度或观念上领先；比预期更早或更先进。
english_meaning: ahead; ahead of schedule; advanced; forward-thinking
explanation_mandarin: 表示在時間、進度或想法上比一般情況更早或更領先，常用於描述提前部署、先進的想法或走在時代前端。
explanation_english: Indicates being ahead in time, schedule, or ideas — earlier than expected, advanced, or forward-thinking. Often used to describe early preparations, progressive ideas, or being ahead of the curve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要超前部署，先預防可能嘅風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 ciu1 cin4 bou6 zeoi6, sin1 jyu6 fong4 ho2 nang4 ge3 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要超前部署，先预防可能的风险。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to prepare ahead of time to prevent possible risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅想法好超前，成日諗啲未來科技先至有嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 soeng2 faat3 hou2 ciu1 cin4, sing4 jat6 lam2 di1 mei6 loi4 fo1 gei6 sin1 zi3 jau5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很超前，常常想到只有未来才会有的科技点子。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very forward-thinking; he often thinks of tech concepts that will only exist in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋超前推行呢個計劃，可能要多啲資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ciu1 cin4 teoi1 hang4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, ho2 nang4 jiu3 do1 di1 zi1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们提前实施这个计划，可能需要更多资源。
examples.english_sentence: If we implement this plan ahead of schedule, we may need more resources.

mandarin_meaning: 跨區；到非自己常活動或居住的區域去（做某事）
english_meaning: to go cross-district; to go beyond one's usual district/area (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「超區」是香港粵語的口語用法，指前往自己常活動範圍外的行政區或地區做某事，例如跨區購物、吃飯或見人等。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "超區" means to go to a different district outside one's usual area — e.g. cross-district shopping, dining, work, or meeting someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住超區去銅鑼灣嗰間新咖啡店試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 ciu1 keoi1 heoi3 tung4 lo4 waan1 go2 gaan1 san1 kaa1 fe1 dim3 si3 haa5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算跨區去銅鑼灣那間新咖啡店試試。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to go cross-district to that new café in Causeway Bay to try it.

mandarin_meaning: 卓越；出色
english_meaning: outstanding; excellent; exceptional
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常優秀、卓越，常用來形容人的能力、表現或事物的質素。
explanation_english: Indicates very high quality or excellence; used to describe a person's ability, performance, or the quality of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現真係超卓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 zan1 hai6 ciu1 coek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表現真是非常出色。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is truly outstanding.

mandarin_meaning: 超合金（chāohéjīn）：一種高性能合金；另指日本「超合金」（Chogokin）系列的金屬壓鑄玩具或收藏品。
english_meaning: Superalloy; also refers to 'Chogokin' — die-cast metal toy robots/collectibles.
explanation_mandarin: 1) 金屬學上指性能優良、耐高溫、耐腐蝕或耐應力的合金，常用於航空與工業領域。2) 在流行文化中源自日本「超合金」（Chogokin），指用壓鑄金屬製作的機械人或玩具，為收藏類玩具的一種稱呼。
explanation_english: 1) In metallurgy: a high-performance alloy resistant to high temperature, corrosion, or stress, used in aerospace and industrial applications. 2) In pop culture: from Japanese 'Chogokin' — die-cast metal toy robots and figures; a name used for collectible metal toys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種超合金用喺飛機引擎，可以耐高溫同承受高壓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 ciu1 hap6 gam1 jung6 hai2 fei1 gei1 jan5 cing4, ho2 ji5 noi6 gou1 wan1 tung4 sing4 sau6 gou1 aat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种超合金用于飞机引擎，能够耐高温并承受高压。
examples.english_sentence: This superalloy is used in aircraft engines; it can withstand high temperatures and high pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我最鍾意玩超合金機械人，依家仲有幾件收藏住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 waan2 ciu1 hap6 gam1 gei1 haai6 jan4, ji1 gaa1 zung6 jau5 gei2 gin6 sau1 cong4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我最喜欢玩超合金机器人，现在还有几件收藏着。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child I loved playing with chogokin (die-cast) robots; I still have a few in my collection.

mandarin_meaning: 超导体 (chāodǎotǐ)
english_meaning: superconductor
explanation_mandarin: 在一定临界温度以下电阻降为零并排斥磁場的材料或物质，称为超导体。
explanation_english: A material or substance that, below a certain critical temperature, exhibits zero electrical resistance and often expels magnetic fields (Meissner effect).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種材料喺極低溫度下會變成超導體，通電嘅時候冇電阻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 coi4 liu6 hai2 gik6 dai1 wan1 dou6 haa6 wui5 bin3 sing4 ciu1 dou6 tai2, tung1 din6 ge3 si4 hau6 mou5 din6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种材料在极低温度下会变成超导体，通电时没有电阻。
examples.english_sentence: This material becomes a superconductor at extremely low temperatures and has no electrical resistance when current flows.

mandarin_meaning: 超市（超級市場）
english_meaning: supermarket
explanation_mandarin: 「超市」是「超級市場」的簡稱，指以自助式銷售為主、販售日常食品、生活用品等的大型零售商店。
explanation_english: Short for "supermarket" (超級市場); a large self-service retail store that sells groceries and everyday household items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去超市買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去超市买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the supermarket tonight to buy some things.

mandarin_meaning: 超度 / 为亡灵举行超生、超脱轮回的佛道仪式
english_meaning: to perform religious rites (usually Buddhist/Taoist) to help the deceased's spirit be delivered or transcend suffering
explanation_mandarin: 指为亡者或孤魂举行佛教、道教等宗教仪式，通过诵经、超荐、超渡等方式使亡灵得到超生或超脱轮回、减轻苦难。
explanation_english: Refers to conducting religious ceremonies (typically Buddhist or Taoist) for the deceased—such as chanting sutras or offering rites—to help the spirit be delivered, transcend the cycle of rebirth, or find peace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期要去廟裏幫阿婆超度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 miu6 leoi5 bong1 aa3 po4 ciu1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下星期要去庙里为奶奶超度。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go to the temple next week to perform rites for Grandma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家人打算幫佢做超度儀式，叫咗師父嚟主持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 jan4 daa2 syun3 bong1 keoi5 zou6 ciu1 dou6 ji4 sik1, giu3 zo2 si1 fu6 lai4 zyu2 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家人打算为他举行超度仪式，请了师父来主持。
examples.english_sentence: The family plans to hold a rite to deliver him and has invited a monk/master to officiate.

mandarin_meaning: （遊戲用語）超級必殺技、終極必殺招式
english_meaning: a super/ultimate move or finisher (gaming slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「超必」是廣東話遊戲與動漫圈的俚語，源自「超級必殺技」的縮略，指能造成大量傷害或一擊定勝負的終極技能或大招。
explanation_english: “超必” is Cantonese gaming slang, short for “super (ultimate) special/finisher move.” It refers to a powerful, often game-changing attack or special ability used as a finisher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個超必好犀利，一出就KO晒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ciu1 bit1 hou2 sai1 lei6, jat1 ceot1 zau6 KO saai3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的超必很厲害，一出手就把人KO了。
examples.english_sentence: His super move is really strong; once he uses it, it KOs everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻角色嘅超必要儲滿能量先可以放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gok3 sik1 ge3 ciu1 bit1 jiu3 cou5 mun5 nang4 loeng6 sin1 ho2 ji5 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个角色的超必需要储满能量才能释放。
examples.english_sentence: This character's super move requires filling the energy bar before it can be unleashed.

mandarin_meaning: 超支（超出预算/开销超过预算）
english_meaning: to exceed a budget; overspend
explanation_mandarin: 表示花費或支出超過了原先預定的預算或限額，常用於財務、工程或活動開支方面。
explanation_english: Indicates that expenditures have gone beyond the originally planned budget or limit; commonly used for finances, projects, or event costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次工程超支咗好多，要同上司報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gung1 cing4 ciu1 zi1 zo2 hou2 do1, jiu3 tung4 soeng5 si1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次工程超支了很多，要向上司报告。
examples.english_sentence: This project has gone way over budget; we need to report it to the supervisor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅旅行預算唔夠，已經超支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 leoi5 hang4 jyu6 syun3 m4 gau3, ji5 ging1 ciu1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的旅行预算不够，已经超支了。
examples.english_sentence: Our travel budget isn't enough; we've already exceeded it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買嘢買到超支，信用卡要還款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 je5 maai5 dou3 ciu1 zi1, seon3 jung6 kaa1 jiu3 waan4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他购物买到超支了，信用卡需要还款。
examples.english_sentence: He overspent on shopping and now has to pay off his credit card.

mandarin_meaning: 超新星（天文学术语），引申为突然走红或崛起的新星/新秀
english_meaning: supernova; (figuratively) a suddenly famous or rapidly rising star/celebrity
explanation_mandarin: 原指恆星在生命末期因劇烈爆炸而釋放大量能量的天文現象（超新星爆發）。在口語或媒體語境下，也可引申指突然走紅或迅速崛起的新人或明星。
explanation_english: Literally an astronomical event where a star explodes at the end of its life (a supernova). Figuratively, it can refer to a newly prominent or rapidly rising star/celebrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文學家話嗰粒恆星唔耐就會爆炸，會變做超新星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1 waa6 go2 lap1 hang4 sing1 m4 noi6 zau6 wui5 baau3 zaa3, wui5 bin3 zou6 ciu1 san1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文学家说那颗恒星不久后会爆炸，变成超新星。
examples.english_sentence: Astronomers say that star will explode soon and become a supernova.

mandarin_meaning: 超时（超過規定的時間）
english_meaning: overtime; past the allotted time; overdue
explanation_mandarin: 表示超過規定或允許的時間，常用於截止時間、停車、工作加班等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates exceeding the allotted or permitted time; commonly used for deadlines, parking, working overtime, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請期限係五點，遲咗交就會超時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 kei4 haan6 hai6 ng5 dim2, ci4 zo2 gaau1 zau6 wui5 ciu1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请截止时间是五点，迟交就会超时。
examples.english_sentence: The application deadline is 5:00; if submitted late it will be past the deadline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工成日要超時，實在太辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 sing4 jat6 jiu3 ciu1 si4, sat6 zoi6 taai3 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作经常需要超时，实在太辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: This job often requires working overtime; it's really too exhausting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停車過咗付費時間就會超時，要俾罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 ce1 gwo3 zo2 fu6 fai3 si4 gaan1 zau6 wui5 ciu1 si4, jiu3 bei2 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停车超过付费时间就会超时，需要付罚款。
examples.english_sentence: If you park past the paid time, you'll be over the time limit and will have to pay a fine.

mandarin_meaning: 超出標準或限額
english_meaning: to exceed a standard/limit; to go over the benchmark
explanation_mandarin: 表示超過規定的標準、限額或指標。可用於污染、開支、分數、出價等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates going beyond a prescribed standard, limit, or quota. Commonly used for pollution, expenses, scores, bids, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告顯示工廠嘅污染已經超標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hin2 si6 gung1 cong3 ge3 wu1 jim5 ji5 ging1 ciu1 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告顯示工廠的污染已經超標。
examples.english_sentence: This report shows the factory's pollution has exceeded the standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月開支超標，唔可以再買嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 hoi1 zi1 ciu1 biu1, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 maai5 je5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個月開支超標，不能再買東西了。
examples.english_sentence: This month's expenses are over the limit; we can't buy anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出價超標，其他人追唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 gaa3 ciu1 biu1, kei4 taa1 jan4 zeoi1 m4 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出價超出標準，其他人追不上他。
examples.english_sentence: He overbid (bid above the limit); others can't catch up with him.

mandarin_meaning: 超级模特儿（超模）
english_meaning: supermodel
explanation_mandarin: 口语缩略词，指“超级模特儿”，即在时尚圈非常有名或高知名度的模特。
explanation_english: A colloquial abbreviation for "supermodel" — a highly famous or high-profile fashion model.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位國際超模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 gwok3 zai3 ciu1 mou4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一位国际超模。
examples.english_sentence: She is an international supermodel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個時裝周有好多超模出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 si4 zong1 zau1 jau5 hou2 do1 ciu1 mou4 ceot1 zik6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个时装周有很多超模出席。
examples.english_sentence: Many supermodels attended that fashion week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路嗰陣真係有超模嘅氣場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 zan1 hai6 jau5 ciu1 mou4 ge3 hei3 coeng4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她走路的时候真的有超模的气场。
examples.english_sentence: When she walks she really has the aura of a supermodel.

mandarin_meaning: 超度（chāodù）：为亡灵举行超度仪式，帮助亡魂超生或升天。
english_meaning: To perform a Buddhist ritual to help the deceased's spirit cross over or be delivered from suffering.
explanation_mandarin: 在佛教或民間信仰裡，指為亡者或孤魂舉行儀式，祈求其脫離苦難、往生淨土或超生。
explanation_english: A religious action (usually Buddhist) of conducting rites for the dead so their souls can be delivered, cross over, or attain a better afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寺廟今晚會為亡靈舉行超渡法會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 miu6 gam1 maan5 wui5 wai6 mong4 ling4 geoi2 hang4 ciu1 dou6 faat3 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寺庙今晚会为亡灵举行超度法会。
examples.english_sentence: The temple will hold a ritual tonight to help the spirits pass on.

mandarin_meaning: 超然（指超脫、不受世俗影響；或形容態度淡然、不執著）
english_meaning: aloof; detached; transcendent; indifferent (not emotionally affected or attached)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對世事、得失或情緒不過分執著或受影響，保持一種超脫、淡定的態度；也可表示不受外界牽動、超越凡俗的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude of detachment or transcendence — not overly attached to outcomes or emotionally affected; maintaining a calm, indifferent, or aloof stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對成敗都好超然，唔會為咗得失煩惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 sing4baai6 dou1 hou2 ciu1 jin4, m4 wui5 wai6 zo2 dak1sat1 faan4nou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對成敗很超然，不會為得失煩惱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very detached about success and failure and doesn't worry about gains or losses.

mandarin_meaning: （加）加班；超出原定班次或時間工作
english_meaning: to work overtime; to take an extra shift; work beyond scheduled hours
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中，『超班』指超出原定的班次或工作時間繼續工作或多做一個班，相當於普通話的「加班」或「做多班」。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '超班' refers to working beyond one's scheduled shift or taking on an extra shift—i.e. doing overtime. It is equivalent to 'to work overtime' or 'to take an extra shift.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚你要唔要超班？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 ciu1 baan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚你要不要加班？
examples.english_sentence: Do you need to work overtime tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要超班，可能要做到凌晨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ciu1 baan1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 dou3 ling4 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要加班，可能要做到凌晨。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work overtime tomorrow; I might have to work until the early morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司人手唔夠，大家都要超班幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jan4 sau2 m4 gou3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 ciu1 baan1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司人手不夠，大家都要加班幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: The company is short-staffed, so everyone has to work extra shifts to help out.

mandarin_meaning: 学霸；拔尖学生；（有时指）跳级生
english_meaning: an outstanding student who outperforms classmates; an overachiever; (informal) someone who may skip a grade
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常指在學校成績特別突出、超出同班同學的學生。有時也用來形容被建議跳級或實際跳級的學生。屬於俗語／俚語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to a student who is conspicuously excellent academically and stands out from classmates. It can also be used for someone considered for or who has skipped a grade. The term has an informal/slang tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中學入面佢係超班馬，考試成績成日喺前幾名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 hok6 jap6 min6 keoi5 hai6 ciu1 baan1 maa5, haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 sing4 jat6 hai2 cin4 gei2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在中学里他是超班马，考试成绩总是名列前茅。
examples.english_sentence: In secondary school he's the standout student — his exam results are always among the top.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校話佢太叻，考慮畀佢跳級，真係有啲超班馬嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 waa6 keoi5 taai3 lek1, haau2 leoi5 bei2 keoi5 tiu3 kap1, zan1 hai6 jau5 di1 ciu1 baan1 maa5 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校说他很聪明，考虑让他跳级，确实有点像超班马。
examples.english_sentence: The school said he's very capable and is considering letting him skip a grade — he really seems like an overachiever.

mandarin_meaning: 超生（在计划生育或生育政策限制下多生子女）
english_meaning: to have extra children beyond the permitted number; to give birth in violation of birth-control policy
explanation_mandarin: 指在生育政策（如计划生育）规定的允许数量之外生育子女，超出限额的生育行为，可能会受到罚款或其他行政处罚。
explanation_english: Refers to giving birth to children beyond the limits set by birth-control policies (e.g., quota under family-planning rules). Such births may incur fines or administrative penalties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大陸超生，所以被罰咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 luk6 ciu1 saang1, so2 ji5 bei6 fat3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大陆超生，所以被罚了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He had an unauthorized additional child in the Mainland, so he was fined a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 非常優秀；上等、高級
english_meaning: very superior; top-notch; excellent
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很高，品質、能力或表現超出一般標準，屬於上等或優秀的範疇。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree; quality, ability, or performance that exceeds ordinary standards and is considered superior or excellent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現超等，值得嘉許。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 ciu1 dang2, zik1 dak1 gaa1 heoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表現非常出色，值得表揚。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is outstanding and deserves praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機嘅性能超等，用落好順暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 ge3 sing3 nang4 ciu1 dang2, jung6 lok6 hou2 seon6 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部機器的性能非常優秀，使用起來很順暢。
examples.english_sentence: This machine's performance is top-notch and runs very smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 超划算的價格；非常划算的交易
english_meaning: a super bargain price; an extremely good deal
explanation_mandarin: 「超筍價」是廣東話的口語說法，用來形容某件商品或優惠的價格非常划算、便宜到很誇張。
explanation_english: '超筍價' is Cantonese slang used to describe a price that is extremely good value — a very cheap or irresistible deal, often said about sales or promotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部手提電話而家做緊促銷，真係超筍價啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 sau2 tai4 din6 waa6 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 cuk1 siu1, zan1 hai6 ciu1 syun2 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部手机现在在打折，真的超划算！
examples.english_sentence: That phone is on sale now — it's really a super bargain!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝喺市場買到一件超筍價嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 hai2 si5 coeng4 maai5 dou2 jat1 gin6 ciu1 syun2 gaa3 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上在市场买到一件超划算的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I got a really great bargain piece of clothing at the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好錯過，呢啲超筍價只限今日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 co3 gwo3, ni1 di1 ciu1 syun2 gaa3 zi2 haan6 gam1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要错过，这些超划算的价格仅限今天。
examples.english_sentence: Don't miss out — these super bargain prices are for today only.

mandarin_meaning: 超级 (chāojí)
english_meaning: super; extremely; very (intensifier)
explanation_mandarin: “超級”在粤语中常用作程度副词，表示非常、极其，用来加强形容词或状态的程度。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, “超級” is commonly used as a degree adverb meaning 'super' or 'extremely', used to intensify adjectives or states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫超級靚！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ciu1 kap1 leng3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服超级漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is super pretty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日超級攰，想快啲返屋企瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 ciu1 kap1 gui6, soeng2 faai3 di1 faan1 uk1 kei5 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天超级累，想快点回家睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm super tired today and want to get home to sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 超级市场 / 超市 (chāojí shìchǎng / chāoshì)
english_meaning: supermarket
explanation_mandarin: 指销售各种日常用品的大型零售商店，出售食品、日用品、家居用品等。常简称为“超市”。
explanation_english: A large retail store that sells a wide range of everyday items such as food, household goods, and groceries; commonly shortened to 'supermarket'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去超級市場買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去超市买东西。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the supermarket tonight to buy some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間超級市場嘅生果好新鮮，價錢又合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 ge3 saang1 gwo2 hou2 san1 sin1, gaa3 cin4 jau6 ho4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家超市的水果很新鲜，价格也合理。
examples.english_sentence: The fruit at this supermarket is very fresh and the prices are reasonable.

mandarin_meaning: 超级月亮（近地点满月）
english_meaning: supermoon
explanation_mandarin: 指当满月发生在月球近地点附近时，月亮看起来比平常更大更亮的天文现象，也称为近地点满月。
explanation_english: A full moon that occurs when the Moon is near its closest point to Earth (perigee), making it appear larger and brighter than usual; commonly called a supermoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚會有超級月亮，唔好錯過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 wui5 jau5 ciu1 kap1 jyut6 loeng6, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚会有超级月亮，别错过了。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a supermoon tonight — don't miss it.

mandarin_meaning: 超级英雄
english_meaning: superhero
explanation_mandarin: 指具有超凡能力、為正義而行的虛構人物，常見於漫畫、電影和影視作品中。
explanation_english: A fictional character with extraordinary abilities who typically fights for justice; commonly appears in comics, films, and other media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候佢成日幻想自己係超級英雄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 keoi5 seng4 jat6 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 hai6 ciu1 kap1 jing1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小的时候，他经常幻想自己是超级英雄。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he often fantasized about being a superhero.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影講述一個普通人變成超級英雄嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 gong2 syut3 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 jan4 bin3 sing4 ciu1 kap1 jing1 hung4 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述一个普通人变成超级英雄的故事。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the story of an ordinary person becoming a superhero.

mandarin_meaning: 超級電腦 (chāojí diànnǎo)
english_meaning: supercomputer
explanation_mandarin: 指運算能力極強的電腦系統，通常用於科學計算、天氣模擬、工程仿真、密碼分析與大數據處理等高負載運算任務。
explanation_english: A computer system with extremely high computational power, typically used for scientific calculations, weather modeling, engineering simulations, cryptanalysis, and large-scale data processing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大學最近買咗部超級電腦，主要用嚟做模擬同數據分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 hok6 zeoi3 gan6 maai5 zo2 bou6 ciu1 kap1 din6 nou5, zyu2 jiu3 jung6 lai4 zou6 mou4 ji6 tung4 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大學最近買了一台超級電腦，主要用來做模擬和數據分析。
examples.english_sentence: The university recently bought a supercomputer, mainly used for simulations and data analysis.

mandarin_meaning: 超群（chāoqún）：在才能或成就上遠超他人，十分出眾。
english_meaning: outstanding; exceptional; far surpassing others
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人在才能、成就、表現等方面遠超同輩，非常出色或卓越。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is far superior to others in ability, achievement, or performance; exceptionally outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書成績超羣，將來有好大前途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 sing4 zik1 ciu1 kwan4, zoeng1 loi4 jau5 hou2 daai6 cin4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他學業成績超群，將來有很大前途。
examples.english_sentence: His academic results are outstanding; he has a great future ahead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司裏面嘅表現超羣，所以好快就升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6 ge3 biu2 jin6 ciu1 kwan4, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡面的表現超群，所以很快就升職。
examples.english_sentence: His performance in the company is outstanding, so he got promoted quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 出类拔萃；卓越，超过同类
english_meaning: outstanding; exceptional; surpassing others
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某一方面超過一般水平或同類，十分出眾。
explanation_english: Indicates someone or something surpasses the ordinary level within a group; outstanding or extraordinary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅廚藝真係超群，成日有食客排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ceoi4 ngai6 zan1 hai6 ciu1 kwan4, sing4 jat6 jau5 sik6 haak3 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的厨艺非常出众，经常有食客排队。
examples.english_sentence: His cooking skills are exceptional; customers often queue up.

mandarin_meaning: 超声波（chāoshēngbō）
english_meaning: ultrasound; ultrasonic wave
explanation_mandarin: 一种频率高于人耳听觉范围的声波，广泛用于医学影像检查（如产前超声波检查）、工业清洗、检测与测距等应用。
explanation_english: Sound waves with frequencies above the human hearing range, commonly used in medical imaging (ultrasound scans), industrial cleaning, inspection and ranging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院幫我做咗個超聲波檢查，檢查結果冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 bong1 ngo5 zou6 zo2 go3 ciu1 sing1 bo1 gim2 caa4, gim2 caa4 git3 gwo2 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院帮我做了超声波检查，检查结果没问题。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital did an ultrasound scan on me; the results were fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生用超聲波檢查胎兒發育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jung6 ciu1 sing1 bo1 gim2 caa4 toi1 ji4 faat3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生用超声波检查胎儿发育。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor used ultrasound to check the fetus's development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工廠用超聲波嚟清洗啲細小零件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cong2 jung6 ciu1 sing1 bo1 lai4 cing1 sai2 di1 sai3 siu2 ling4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂用超声波来清洗小型零件。
examples.english_sentence: The factory uses ultrasound to clean small parts.

mandarin_meaning: 超能力 (chāonénglì)：超出常人或自然法則的能力
english_meaning: superpower; supernatural or extraordinary ability
explanation_mandarin: 指超出一般人或自然規律的能力，例如讀心、飛行、念力等，常見於小說、電影或迷信語境。
explanation_english: Refers to abilities beyond normal human or natural laws, such as mind-reading, flight, or telekinesis; commonly used in fiction, movies, or supernatural contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嗰個英雄有超能力，可以飛同埋發射光束。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 go2 go3 jing1 hung4 jau5 ciu1 nang4 lik6, ho2 ji5 fei1 tung4 maai4 faat3 se6 gwong1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影裡面的那個英雄有超能力，可以飛還會發射光束。
examples.english_sentence: The hero in the movie has superpowers; he can fly and shoot beams of light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友鍾意幻想自己有超能力，例如能夠隱形或者隱身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 ji3 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 jau5 ciu1 nang4 lik6, lai6 jyu4 nang4 gau3 jan2 jing4 waak6 ze2 jan2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友喜歡幻想自己有超能力，例如能夠隱形或隱身。
examples.english_sentence: Children like to imagine they have superpowers, for example being invisible or turning invisible.

mandarin_meaning: 超级笨蛋 / 超级蠢货
english_meaning: a super idiot; someone extremely foolish
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，用來形容非常愚蠢或做事很沒腦的人，帶有貶義。字面上「膠」在粵語俗語中常指笨或沒有腦筋。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Cantonese slang for someone extremely stupid or who acts very foolishly; derogatory. Literally 'super' + 'gaau' (where 'gaau' in Cantonese slang implies stupidity).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做啲超能膠嘢，大家都唔想同佢一齊做事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 ciu1 nang4 gaau1 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4 zou6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天做些超级蠢事，大家都不想和他一起做事。
examples.english_sentence: He always does really stupid things; nobody wants to work with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁超能膠啦，諗清楚先再做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ciu1 nang4 gaau1 laa1, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 zoi3 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么蠢啦，想清楚再做决定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such an idiot; think it through before making a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 超脱（chāotuō）：超然物外、脱离世俗牵绊
english_meaning: to be detached or transcendent; free from worldly concerns or entanglements
explanation_mandarin: 表示不被世俗事務牽累或影響，心態上保持超然、淡泊或脫離俗務。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude or state of being untroubled by mundane concerns — detached, aloof, or liberated from worldly ties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都好超脫，唔會畀小事影響心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 ciu1 tyut3, m4 wui5 bei2 siu2 si6 jing2 hoeng2 sam1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是很超脱，不會讓小事影響心情。
examples.english_sentence: He is always very detached and doesn't let small things affect his mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想超脫俗世嘅牽絆，去山入面靜修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 ciu1 tyut3 zuk6 sai3 ge3 hin1 baan6, heoi3 saan1 jap6 min6 zing6 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她想超脱俗世的牽絆，去山裡静修。
examples.english_sentence: She wants to free herself from worldly ties and retreat to the mountains for meditation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畫家嘅風格帶有一種超脫塵世嘅氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 gaa1 ge3 fung1 gaak3 daai3 jau5 jat1 zung2 ciu1 tyut3 can4 sai3 ge3 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 畫家的風格帶有一種超脱塵世的氣質。
examples.english_sentence: The painter's style carries a kind of otherworldly, detached quality.

mandarin_meaning: 超然、不受俗务牵累；脱离牵挂
english_meaning: detached; aloof; free from worldly concerns; to detach oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示不為世俗所束縛、超然物外；也可作動詞，表示脫離情緒或牽掛。
explanation_english: Indicates being free from worldly attachments or concerns; can be used as an adjective or verb to describe emotionally or mentally detaching oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對啲名利睇得好超脱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 di1 ming4 lei6 tai2 dak1 hou2 ciu1 tyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对名利看得很超脱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very detached about fame and fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過嗰次失敗之後，我學識點樣超脱一啲負面情緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 go2 ci3 sat1 baai6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng6 ciu1 tyut3 jat1 di1 fu6 min6 cing4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过那次失败之后，我学会了如何超脱一些负面情绪。
examples.english_sentence: After that failure, I learned how to detach myself from some negative emotions.

mandarin_meaning: 超自然；超出自然规律或常理的，通常指神秘或不可解释的现象
english_meaning: supernatural; beyond the laws of nature; paranormal
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 名词（视用法而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指超出自然规律或普通经验、难以用科学解释的事物或现象，如幽灵、靈異事件等。
explanation_english: Refers to things or phenomena that go beyond natural laws or ordinary experience and are difficult to explain scientifically, such as ghosts or paranormal events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影講啲超自然嘅嘢，睇到我都好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 gong2 di1 ciu1 zi6 jin4 ge3 je5, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 hou2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影講述一些超自然的事情，看得我很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is about supernatural stuff; it made me very scared.

mandarin_meaning: 超英赶美（chāo yīng gǎn měi）——超越英國、趕上美國；常用作政治口號，意指追趕並超越西方先進國家。
english_meaning: Literally 'surpass Britain and catch up with America' — a political slogan/idiom meaning to catch up with and surpass leading Western countries; figuratively, to overtake one's rivals.
explanation_mandarin: 「超英趕美」起源於20世紀中期的政治口號，用來表達追趕並超越英國、美國等西方工業強國的目標。常用於描述強調快速工業化與追趕西方的政策或宣傳，有時帶有宣傳色彩或諷刺意味，視語境而定。
explanation_english: "超英趕美" originated as a mid-20th-century political slogan meaning to overtake Britain and catch up with America. It expresses a goal of rapid industrialization and surpassing Western powers. Depending on context it can be a straightforward slogan or used critically/satirically to describe ambitious catch-up efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嗰陣，政府成日講要超英趕美，結果造成好多問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 go2 zan6, zing3 fu2 sing4 jat6 gong2 jiu3 ciu1 jing1 gon2 mei5, git3 gwo2 zou6 sing4 hou2 do1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過去那段時間，政府常說要「超英趕美」，結果造成很多問題。
examples.english_sentence: Back then the government often said we must 'surpass Britain and catch up with America', and it ended up causing many problems.

mandarin_meaning: 超译 / 过度翻译（在翻译中过度发挥、加入原文没有的信息或改变原意）
english_meaning: over-translation; excessive/liberal translation that goes beyond the source text
explanation_mandarin: 在翻譯學或日常語境中，指譯者的處理超出原文字面或原意，加入額外詮釋、資訊或改變語氣與立場，通常帶有「過度自由翻譯」的含義，可能導致扭曲原意。
explanation_english: A term (used in translation studies and everyday speech) describing a translation that goes beyond the source text—adding information, interpretation, or changing tone/meaning. It often implies an excessively free rendering that may distort the original.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇譯文有啲超譯，譯者加咗好多原文冇嘅資訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 jik6 man4 jau5 di1 ciu1 jik6, jik6 ze2 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 jyun4 man4 mou5 ge3 zi1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇译文有些超译，译者添加了很多原文没有的信息。
examples.english_sentence: This translation contains some over-translation; the translator added a lot of information that wasn't in the original.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗貼近本地讀者嘅理解，佢哋有時會超譯，但要小心唔好扭曲原意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 tip3 gan6 bun2 dei6 duk6 ze2 ge3 lei5 gaai2, keoi5 dei6 jau5 si4 wui5 ciu1 jik6, daan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 nau2 kuk1 jyun4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了贴近本地读者的理解，他们有时会超译，但要小心不要扭曲原意。
examples.english_sentence: To make it more accessible to local readers, they sometimes over-translate, but they must be careful not to distort the original meaning.

mandarin_meaning: 超卖（chāomài）——售出超過實際庫存或可容納人數（如超賣機票、超賣商品）
english_meaning: oversell / overbook — to sell more goods or tickets than are actually available or than capacity allows
explanation_mandarin: 指銷售或預訂數量超過實際庫存或可容納人數，例如航空公司超賣座位或商店超賣商品，可能需要退款或補償。
explanation_english: Refers to selling or booking more than the actual stock or capacity (e.g., overbooking flights or overselling products). It can lead to refunds, compensation, or other remedies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝班機超賣，好多乘客上唔到機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 baan1 gei1 ciu1 maai6, hou2 do1 sing4 haak3 soeng5 m4 dou3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这班飞机超卖了，很多乘客上不了飞机。
examples.english_sentence: This flight was overbooked; many passengers couldn't board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網店超賣咗件衫，佢哋唯有退款同通知買家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 dim3 ciu1 maai6 zo2 gin6 saam1, keoi5 dei6 wai6 jau5 teoi3 fun2 tung4 tung1 zi1 maai5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网店把那件衣服超卖了，他们只好退款并通知买家。
examples.english_sentence: The online store oversold the shirt; they had to refund and inform the buyers.

mandarin_meaning: 超越 (chāoyuè)：超過、勝過、超出某個標準或對象
english_meaning: to surpass; to exceed; to transcend
explanation_mandarin: 表示在能力、成就、範圍或標準上超過或勝過某人或某事，也可表示超出既有界限、突破限制。
explanation_english: Used to indicate going beyond or exceeding a person, standard, limit, or expectation; can also mean to transcend or surpass existing boundaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽中超越咗所有對手，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bei2coi3 zung1 ciu1 jyut6 zo2 soeng6jau5 deoi3sau2, lo2 zo2 gun3gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中超越了所有对手，拿了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He surpassed all his opponents in the competition and won the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想超越自己嘅極限，挑戰更高嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ciu1 jyut6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gik6haan6, tiu1 zin3 gang1 gou1 ge3 muk6biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想超越自己的极限，挑战更高的目标。
examples.english_sentence: I want to surpass my own limits and challenge higher goals.

mandarin_meaning: 超车
english_meaning: to overtake; to pass (a vehicle); to surpass
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆在道路上超过前方的车辆；也可比喻在竞争或排行中超过他人。
explanation_english: Refers to a vehicle passing another on the road; can also be used metaphorically to mean surpassing someone in competition or ranking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺高速公路超車要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gou1 cuk1 gung1 lou6 ciu1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在高速公路超车要小心。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when overtaking on the highway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司俾對手超車咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 bei2 deoi3 sau2 ciu1 ce1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的公司被对手超越了。
examples.english_sentence: Our company was overtaken by a competitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺繁忙嘅路段，唔好隨便超車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 faan4 mong4 ge3 lou6 dyun6, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin6 ciu1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在繁忙的路段，不要随便超车。
examples.english_sentence: Don't overtake casually in busy sections of the road.

mandarin_meaning: 超载（超过承载能力或规定负荷）
english_meaning: to overload; overloaded; exceeding capacity or weight limit
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出允許或安全的負荷或載重，可作動詞（把東西裝得太多）或形容詞（處於超載狀態）。
explanation_english: Indicates exceeding the permitted or safe load or capacity. Can be used as a verb (to load too much) or an adjective (in an overloaded state).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架貨車超載，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 fo3 ce1 ciu1 zoi6, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆货车超载，非常危险。
examples.english_sentence: This truck is overloaded; it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電梯超載，請耐心等下一部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 tai1 ciu1 zoi6, ceng2 noi6 sam1 dang2 haa6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电梯超载，请耐心等下一部。
examples.english_sentence: The elevator is overloaded; please wait for the next one.

mandarin_meaning: 超速（超过规定的速度）
english_meaning: to exceed the speed limit; to speed
explanation_mandarin: 表示速度超过规定的限度，通常用于车辆行驶时超过道路或法规规定的限速，可能会被罚款或扣分。
