examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 daap3 jing3 bong1 sau2, ji1 gaa1 jau6 zyun2 hau2 fung1 waa6 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛答應幫忙，現在又改口說不做了。
examples.english_sentence: He just agreed to help, now he's changed his tune and says he won't do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再轉口風，講咗就做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zyun2 hau2 fung1, gong2 zo2 zau6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再改口了，說好了就要做到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't change your stance again—if you said you'd do it, do it.

mandarin_meaning: 换台 / 转台
english_meaning: change the (TV/radio) channel; switch channels
explanation_mandarin: 指在電視、收音機或其他播放設備上切換頻道。口語中也可引申為轉換話題或改變正在做的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to switching channels on a TV, radio, or other media device. Informally it can also mean changing the topic or switching to a different activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目唔啱我，轉台啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 m4 aam1 ngo5, zyun2 toi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目不合我的胃口，换台吧。
examples.english_sentence: This program isn't to my taste — change the channel.

mandarin_meaning: 向右转；（引申）政治立场向右、倾向保守
english_meaning: turn right; (figurative) shift to the right politically; become more conservative
explanation_mandarin: 「轉右」字面上表示在路上向右轉。在香港語境中，也常作比喻用，指人或團體的政治立場傾向右翼或變得更保守。
explanation_english: Literally 'turn right' (change direction to the right). In Hong Kong and political contexts it is also used figuratively to mean a person or group's political stance shifting to the right or becoming more conservative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個路口記得轉右。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 lou6 hau2 gei3 dak1 zyun2 jau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下一个路口记得向右转。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn right at the next intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年嚟佢嘅立場慢慢轉右。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 lai4 keoi5 ge3 laap6 coeng4 maan6 maan6 zyun2 jau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来他的立场慢慢转向右翼。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years his stance has gradually shifted to the right.

mandarin_meaning: 转向 (zhuǎnxiàng)，改变方向或转变取向
english_meaning: to turn (to change direction); to shift (orientation, policy, focus)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物理上改变方向（例如车辆转弯）或比喻上方向、取向的转变（例如政策、立场转变）。
explanation_english: Indicates physically changing direction (e.g., a vehicle turning) or figuratively shifting orientation or focus (e.g., policies or stance changing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個路口要轉向左邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou6 hau2 jiu3 zyun2 hoeng3 zo2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个路口要向左转。
examples.english_sentence: At this intersection you need to turn left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅政策近年轉向環保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zing3 caak3 gan6 nin4 zyun2 hoeng3 waan4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的政策近年来转向环保。
examples.english_sentence: The company's policies have shifted toward environmental protection in recent years.

mandarin_meaning: 转眼/一转眼之间
english_meaning: in the blink of an eye; in no time; suddenly
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间非常短，一瞬间就发生或完成了某事。
explanation_english: Indicates a very short span of time — something happening or completed almost instantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 轉吓眼，佢已經走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun2 haa5 ngaan5, keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 转眼间，他已经走了。
examples.english_sentence: In the blink of an eye, he had already left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我轉吓眼就做晒功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyun2 haa5 ngaan5 zau6 zou6 saai3 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一转眼就把作业做完了。
examples.english_sentence: I finished my homework in no time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 轉吓眼，個細路仔已經大咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun2 haa5 ngaan5, go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 ji5 ging1 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一转眼，孩子已经长大了很多。
examples.english_sentence: In the blink of an eye, the kid has grown a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 转告；把消息或话语从一人传达给另一人
english_meaning: to pass on a message; to inform someone on behalf of another
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人的話或訊息轉交給其他人知道，常用於請人幫忙傳話或通知別人。
explanation_english: Used to indicate conveying someone's words or information to another person; commonly used when asking someone to pass on a message or notify others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我轉告阿明，話我今晚會遲到？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zyun2 gou3 aa3 ming4, waa6 ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 ci4 dou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我轉告阿明，告訴他我今晚會遲到嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help pass a message to Ming and tell him I'll be late tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經轉告咗佢，佢話知道啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zyun2 gou3 zo2 keoi5, keoi5 waa6 zi1 dou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經轉告他了，他說知道了。
examples.english_sentence: I already told him; he said he knows.

mandarin_meaning: 轉告 / 告知、把訊息轉述給別人
english_meaning: to pass on a message; to inform someone on behalf of another
explanation_mandarin: 把某人的話或訊息告訴第三者；傳話或轉述別人的話。
explanation_english: To convey a message or information from one person to another; to pass on what someone else said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我轉告佢，我會遲到十分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 zyun2 gou3 keoi5, ngo5 wui5 ci4 dou3 sap6 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫我轉告他，我會遲到十分鐘。
examples.english_sentence: Please pass on to him that I'll be about ten minutes late.

mandarin_meaning: 換輪胎 / 換車胎
english_meaning: to change/replace a tire (on a vehicle)
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，指將車輛的輪胎拆下並更換（例如爆胎後到車房換胎）。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to remove and replace a vehicle's tire (for example, after a puncture).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車爆呔，要快啲去車房轉呔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 baau3 taai1, jiu3 faai3 di1 heoi3 ce1 fong4 zyun2 taai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 車子爆胎了，要趕快去車行換輪胎。
examples.english_sentence: The car has a flat tire; we need to hurry to the garage to change the tire.

mandarin_meaning: 转圈（字面：转动/绕圈；引申：原地打转、无进展或漫无目的地走动）
english_meaning: to spin/turn around; to go in circles (literally or figuratively: to pace aimlessly or make no progress)
explanation_mandarin: 可以表示人或物在原地或某处转动、绕圈；也可比喻做事反复却无进展、漫无目的地打转。
explanation_english: Can mean physically turning or spinning around, or figuratively doing something in circles — pacing aimlessly or making no progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公園度轉圈，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 dou6 zyun2 hyun1, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公园里转圈，很开心。
examples.english_sentence: He's spinning around in the park, very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗唔到解決方法，一直喺度轉圈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 m4 dou3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3, jat1 zik6 hai2 dou6 zyun2 hyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想不到解决方法，一直在原地转圈。
examples.english_sentence: I can't think of a solution — I'm just going around in circles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路成日喺屋企轉圈玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 zyun2 hyun1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子经常在家里转圈玩。
examples.english_sentence: The kid often spins around at home playing.

mandarin_meaning: 转型（zhuǎnxíng）：指從一種形態或模式轉變為另一種，常用於企業、行業或個人職業的轉變與升級。
english_meaning: Transformation / transition: changing from one form or mode to another, often used for companies, industries, or careers undergoing modernization or strategic change.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物、組織或個人由原有的經營模式、產業類型或角色轉換為新的模式，通常含有升級、現代化或改變方向的意味。
explanation_english: Describes the process of an entity (company, industry, or individual) shifting from its existing mode or model to a new one, typically implying upgrading, modernization, or strategic change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要轉型，由賣實體貨品改做線上服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 zyun2 jing4, cung4 maai6 sat6 tai2 fo3 ban2 goi2 zou6 sin3 soeng6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要转型，由卖实体货品改做线上服务。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to transform, shifting from selling physical goods to offering online services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推動工業轉型，重點發展高科技產業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 dung6 gung1 jip6 zyun2 jing4, zung6 dim2 faat3 zin2 gou1 fo1 gei6 caan2 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推动工业转型，重点发展高科技产业。
examples.english_sentence: The government is promoting industrial transformation, focusing on developing high-tech industries.

mandarin_meaning: 換班；換堂（把學生調到另一個班級，或結束一節課轉到下一節課）
english_meaning: to switch classes; to transfer to another class; to change/shift to the next lesson/period
explanation_mandarin: 「轉堂」是粵語口語用法，常用於學校或課程場合。主要有兩個意思：一是把學生從一個班調到另一個班（即轉班）；二是在課堂安排上結束本節課並換下一節課（即換堂、換課）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "轉堂" is a colloquial term used in school/course contexts. It has two main senses: (1) to transfer a student from one class to another (i.e., change class), and (2) to end the current lesson/period and move on to the next one (i.e., change the lesson/period).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住下年轉堂，去另一班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 haa6 nin4 zyun2 tong4, heoi3 ling6 jat1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算明年轉班，去另一個班。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to switch classes next year and go to another class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上課時間完咗，老師話轉堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 fo3 si4 gaan3 jyun4 zo2, lou5 si1 waa6 zyun2 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上課時間到了，老師說要換堂。
examples.english_sentence: Class time is up; the teacher said it's time to change classes/periods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想選更高階嘅課程，就要轉堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 syun2 gang3 gou1 gaai1 ge3 fo3 cing4, zau6 jiu3 zyun2 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想選更高階的課程，就必須轉班。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to take a higher-level course, you'll have to transfer to a different class.

mandarin_meaning: 转嫁（把责任、损失或负担转移给他人或其他对象）
english_meaning: to shift or pass on responsibility, blame, loss, or costs to someone or something else
explanation_mandarin: 指把應由自己承擔的責任、錯誤、損失或負擔轉移到別人或其他對象身上。
explanation_english: Refers to transferring responsibilities, blame, losses, or burdens that one should bear to another person or entity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔應該將自己嘅錯誤轉嫁俾下屬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 jing1 goi1 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3 ng6 zyun2 gaa3 bei2 haa6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不應該把自己的錯誤轉嫁給下屬。
examples.english_sentence: The company shouldn't shift its mistakes onto its subordinates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔好總係將責任轉嫁俾我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hou2 zung2 hai6 zoeng1 zaak3 jam6 zyun2 gaa3 bei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不應該總是把責任轉嫁給我們。
examples.english_sentence: He shouldn't always shift the responsibility onto us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府想將治理嘅成本轉嫁俾市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 soeng2 zoeng1 zi6 lei5 ge3 sing4 bun2 zyun2 gaa3 bei2 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府想把治理的成本轉嫁給市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government wants to pass the costs of governance onto the citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 转学
english_meaning: to transfer schools; to change schools
explanation_mandarin: 指學生由一所學校轉到另一所學校繼續就讀，可能因搬遷、升學或其他原因而轉校。
explanation_english: Refers to a student moving from one school to another to continue studying, often because of relocation, grade changes, or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個學期會轉學去另一間中學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 hok6 kei4 wui5 zyun2 hok6 heoi3 ling6 jat1 gaan1 zung1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个学期会转学去另一所中学。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to transfer to another secondary school next semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為屋企搬咗，佢要轉學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 uk1 kei2 bun1 zo2, keoi5 jiu3 zyun2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为家里搬了，他要转学。
examples.english_sentence: Because his family moved, he has to transfer schools.

mandarin_meaning: 由守勢轉為攻勢／由防守轉為進攻
english_meaning: to turn defense into offense; to switch from a defensive stance to an offensive one
explanation_mandarin: 表示從防守的狀態轉為進攻，主動出擊以掌握局勢或扭轉劣勢，常用於軍事、體育或比喻商業和談判場景。
explanation_english: Indicates shifting from a defensive position to an offensive one—taking the initiative to seize the advantage or reverse a disadvantage. Commonly used in military, sports, business, or negotiation contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺下半場，我哋成功轉守為攻，最終贏返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 haa6 bun3 coeng4, ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 zyun2 sau2 wai4 gung1, zeoi3 zung1 jing4 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在下半場，我們成功由守轉為攻，最終贏得比賽。
examples.english_sentence: In the second half, we successfully turned defense into offense and ultimately won the game.

mandarin_meaning: 转守为攻（从防守转为进攻；采取主动进攻）
english_meaning: To switch from defense to offense; to go on the offensive (take the initiative to attack)
explanation_mandarin: 指由被動防守轉為主動進攻的行為或策略，常用於軍事、體育或比喻在競爭中採取主動出擊以扭轉局勢。
explanation_english: Refers to shifting from a defensive posture to an offensive one; a strategy of taking the initiative to attack. Used in military, sports, or figuratively in competitions or campaigns to describe launching a counteroffensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽落後嘅時候，教練叫球隊轉守為攻，最終成功逆轉取勝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 lok6 hau6 ge3 si4 hau6, gaau1 lin6 giu3 kau4 deoi6 zyun2 sau2 wai4 gung1, zeoi3 zung1 sing4 gung1 jik6 zyun2 ceoi2 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛落后的时候，教练让球队转守为攻，最终成功逆转取胜。
examples.english_sentence: When they were behind in the match, the coach told the team to switch from defense to offense, and they ultimately managed to come from behind and win.

mandarin_meaning: 转寄 (zhuǎnjì)
english_meaning: to forward (mail, email, package)
explanation_mandarin: 把收到的信件、電郵或包裹再寄給其他人，或把郵件從一個地址轉送到另一個地址。
explanation_english: To send received mail, email, or a package on to another person or to redirect an item from one address to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱幫你轉寄咗封電郵畀佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 bong1 nei5 zyun2 gei3 zo2 fung1 din6 jau4 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚帮你转寄了一封电邮给他。
examples.english_sentence: I just forwarded an email to him for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果包裹要轉寄，要俾多啲運費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 baau1 gwo2 jiu3 zyun2 gei3, jiu3 bei2 do1 di1 wan6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果包裹要转寄，要付多一些运费。
examples.english_sentence: If the package needs to be forwarded, you'll need to pay extra shipping.

mandarin_meaning: 转写（将口语或一种文字/音系的内容转写或转录为另一种书写形式）
english_meaning: to transcribe; transcription (to render speech or one writing/phonetic system into another written form)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词；名词（指转写的动作或结果）
explanation_mandarin: 指把語音、錄音或一種書寫/音系系統的內容用另一種文字或記錄方式表達，常見於語言學、資料處理或文件轉錄。
explanation_english: Refers to rendering speech, recordings, or content from one writing/phonetic system into another written form. Common in linguistics, data processing, or document transcription.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我將錄音轉寫成文字？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 luk6 jam1 zyun2 se2 sing4 man4 zi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我把录音转写成文字吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me transcribe the recording into text?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺學術文章入面，作者會用唔同嘅系統去轉寫方言嘅發音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hok6 seot6 man4 zoeng1 jap6 min6, zok3 ze2 wui5 jung6 m4 tung4 ge3 hai6 tung2 heoi3 zyun2 se2 fong1 jin2 ge3 faat3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在学术文章中，作者会用不同的系统去转写方言的发音。
examples.english_sentence: In academic papers, authors use different systems to transcribe the pronunciations of dialects.

mandarin_meaning: 換工作 / 跳槽
english_meaning: to change jobs; to switch jobs
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示離開現有公司或職位，到另一間公司或職位任職（換工作、跳槽）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to change jobs — leave one's current employer or position and take up a job elsewhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗緊轉工，想搵份人工高啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 gan2 zyun2 gung1, soeng2 wan2 fan6 jan4 gung1 gou1 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在考虑换工作，想找一份薪水高一点的工作。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking about changing jobs; I want to find a position that pays more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上個月轉工去咗一家大公司，依家開心好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 zyun2 gung1 heoi3 zo2 jat1 gaa1 daai6 gung1 si1, ji4 gaa1 hoi1 sam1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上个月换了工作去了一家大公司，现在开心多了。
examples.english_sentence: He changed jobs last month to work at a big company; he's much happier now.

mandarin_meaning: （向）左转；已经转变／换到（另一个状态或方向）
english_meaning: turned left; (have) switched/changed (to another state or direction)
explanation_mandarin: 用来表示朝左边转向（方向性），在某些语境中也可表示已經转换、转去另一个状态或去向（如换工作、换频道等）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate turning to the left (directional). In some contexts it can also mean having switched/changed to another state or destination (e.g. changed jobs, switched channels).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺下個路口轉左就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 haa6 go3 lou6 hau2 zyun2 zo2 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在下一个路口向左转就到。
examples.english_sentence: Turn left at the next intersection and you'll arrive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉左去另一間公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 zo2 heoi3 ling6 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经转去另一家公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He has moved to work at another company.

mandarin_meaning: 轉帳 / 轉賬（把錢從一個帳戶轉到另一個帳戶）
english_meaning: to transfer money (between bank/accounts); bank transfer
explanation_mandarin: 指通過銀行或電子渠道，將資金從一個帳戶轉移到另一個帳戶的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to moving funds from one account to another via a bank or electronic payment channel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚會幫你轉帳一千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 bong1 nei5 zyun2 zoeng3 jat1 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我會幫你轉帳一千塊錢。
examples.english_sentence: I'll transfer HK$1,000 to you tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行轉帳要幾日先到？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 zyun2 zoeng3 jiu3 gei2 jat6 sin1 dou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 銀行轉帳要幾天才能到？
examples.english_sentence: How many days does a bank transfer take to arrive?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用FPS即時轉帳，好快就收到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 FPS zik1 si4 zyun2 zoeng3, hou2 faai3 zau6 sau1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用FPS即時轉帳，很快就收到。
examples.english_sentence: You can use FPS for instant transfers; you'll receive it quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 转弯；（比喻）拐弯抹角、含蓄回避
english_meaning: to turn (a corner); to change direction; (idiomatic) to be evasive or beat around the bush
explanation_mandarin: 既可表示字面意思“轉變方向、過彎”，也可作比喻用，表示說話或行為不直接、迂迴回避問題。
explanation_english: Can be used literally to mean turning a corner or changing direction. Idiomatically it means being indirect or evasive—avoiding a direct answer or approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺下一個路口要轉彎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 haa6 jat1 go3 lou6 hau2 jiu3 zyun2 waan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在下一個路口要轉彎。
examples.english_sentence: I need to turn at the next intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢問你呢個問題，你唔好轉彎，直接答啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 man6 nei5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, nei5 m4 hou2 zyun2 waan1, zik6 zip3 daap3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他問你這個問題，你不要拐彎，直接回答吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's asking you this question—don't beat around the bush, answer directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士轉彎嗰陣要小心，唔好企喺個邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 zyun2 waan1 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 go3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公交車轉彎的時候要小心，不要站在旁邊。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when the bus turns; don't stand beside it.

mandarin_meaning: 拐彎抹角
english_meaning: to beat around the bush; to speak or act indirectly
explanation_mandarin: 形容說話或做事不直接，繞圈子、不開門見山，含有迴避要點或不敢直說的意思。
explanation_english: Describes speaking or acting in an indirect, roundabout way—avoiding the main point or failing to be straightforward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講嘢轉彎抹角，唔肯直接講重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 je5 zyun2 waan1 mut6 gok3, m4 hang2 zik6 zip3 gong2 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是說話拐彎抹角，不肯直接說出重點。
examples.english_sentence: He always beats around the bush and won't directly state the main point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好轉彎抹角，同我講實情啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zyun2 waan1 mut6 gok3, tung4 ngo5 gong2 sat6 cing4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拐彎抹角，跟我說實話吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't beat around the bush; tell me the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 改變性格/變得不一樣；（口語）改變性取向（俚語用法）
english_meaning: to change one's nature/character or behaviour (to turn into a different person); (colloquial) to change one's sexual orientation
explanation_mandarin: 「轉性」為廣東話口語，常用來表示一個人性格或行為發生明顯變化（例如變得聽話或關心家庭）。在口語或俚語場合，也可用來指性取向的改變，但此用法較敏感且非正式。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, "轉性" is used to say someone has changed their nature or behaviour noticeably (e.g. becoming obedient or more family-oriented). Colloquially it can also refer to a change in sexual orientation, but that usage is informal and sensitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好似轉性咗，變得好聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 zyun2 sing3 zo2, bin3 dak1 hou2 teng1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近好像變了性格，變得很聽話。
examples.english_sentence: He/She seems to have changed recently, becoming very obedient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好話佢轉性啦，佢只係一時衝動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 waa6 keoi5 zyun2 sing3 laa1, keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別說他會改變性格了，他只是暫時衝動。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say he's changed — he's just acting on impulse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從有咗小朋友之後，佢好似轉性咗，開始重視家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 jau5 zo2 siu2 pang4 jau5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 hou2 ci5 zyun2 sing3 zo2, hoi1 ci2 zung6 si6 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從有了小孩之後，他好像變了性格，開始重視家庭。
examples.english_sentence: Since having a child, he seems to have changed and started valuing family more.

mandarin_meaning: 转战（转移战场或把活动/战线转到别处）
english_meaning: to move on to fight or operate elsewhere; to shift one's campaign/activities to another place
explanation_mandarin: 表示把戰鬥或活動從一個地方轉移到另一個地方；在軍事語境中指轉移戰場，在口語或比喻語境中可指把工作、活動或行動改到別處繼續進行。
explanation_english: A verb meaning to relocate military operations or activities to another area. Literally used for moving a battle to a different front; figuratively used to indicate shifting work, events, or efforts to a new location or arena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次活動喺灣仔做完，下一站會轉戰尖沙咀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 hai2 waan1 zai2 zou6 jyun4, haa6 jat1 zaam6 wui5 zyun2 zin3 zim1 saa1 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动在湾仔做完，下一站会转战尖沙咀。
examples.english_sentence: This event finished in Wan Chai; the next stop will move on to Tsim Sha Tsui.

mandarin_meaning: 转手（转让、转售、易手）
english_meaning: to transfer (into someone else's hands); to resell; to change hands
explanation_mandarin: 表示把物品或權利交給別人，或把東西轉售給他人；也可指事務或公司改變所有者（易手）。
explanation_english: Indicates handing something over to someone else or reselling an item; can also mean a business or asset has changed ownership (changed hands).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔會轉手呢件衫，想留番畀妹妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wui5 zyun2 sau2 ni1 gin6 saam1, soeng2 lau4 faan1 bei2 mui6 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会转手这件衬衫，想留给妹妹。
examples.english_sentence: I won't resell this shirt; I want to keep it for my younger sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司已經轉手咗，老闆同以前唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ji5 ging1 zyun2 sau2 zo2, lou5 baan2 tung4 ji5 cin4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经转手了，老板和以前不同。
examples.english_sentence: This company has changed hands; the boss is different from before.

mandarin_meaning: 轉投 (zhuǎntóu)：轉換支持或加入另一個人、組織或單位
english_meaning: to transfer to; to switch allegiance/support to; to join another organization or team
explanation_mandarin: 表示將原本的支持、所屬或工作轉移到另一個人或組織，例如轉投另一間公司、轉投新政黨或轉投對手球隊。
explanation_english: Indicates moving one's support, membership, or employment to another person or organization—e.g., transferring to another company, switching to a new political party, or joining a rival team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定轉投另一間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 zyun2 tau4 ling6 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他決定轉投另一家公司。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to transfer to another company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 支持者開始轉投新興政黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 ci4 ze2 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 tau4 san1 hing1 zing3 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 支持者開始轉投新興政黨。
examples.english_sentence: Supporters began switching to the emerging political party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位球員轉投咗對手球隊，引起好大爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 kau4 jyun4 zyun2 tau4 zo2 deoi3 sau2 kau4 deoi6, jan2 hei2 hou2 daai6 zang1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位球員轉投了對手隊，引起很大爭議。
examples.english_sentence: That player transferred to the rival team, causing a big controversy.

mandarin_meaning: 转折（转变、转机或曲折，常指情节或局势的变化）
english_meaning: turning point; twist; change or shift in a situation (e.g., plot twist, turning point)
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can also be used as a verb)
explanation_mandarin: 表示局勢、情節或發展方向出現變化或轉機，既可指具體的轉折點，也可指過程中的曲折。
explanation_english: Indicates a change, turning point, or twist in the development of events or a narrative; can refer to a specific turning point or the twists within a process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故事有好多意想不到嘅轉折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3si6 jau5 hou2 do1 ji3 soeng2 bat1 dou3 ge3 zyun2 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事有很多意想不到的转折。
examples.english_sentence: This story has many unexpected twists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係經歷咗唔少轉折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 ging1 lik6 zo2 m4 siu2 zyun2 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系经历了不少转折。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship went through many twists and turns.

mandarin_meaning: 转按（将房屋按揭转到另一家银行或重新安排按揭，即再融资）
english_meaning: remortgage; to transfer/refinance a mortgage (move a mortgage to another lender or rearrange the mortgage)
explanation_mandarin: 指把現有的房屋按揭貸款轉到另一間銀行或重新安排按揭條款，以獲得更優惠的利率或還款條件（即再按揭/轉按揭）。
explanation_english: Refers to transferring an existing mortgage to another bank or rearranging the mortgage terms to obtain a better interest rate or repayment conditions (i.e., remortgaging/refinancing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗緊要唔要轉按，宜家銀行利率低啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 gan2 jiu3 m4 jiu3 zyun3 on3, ji4 gaa1 ngan4 hong4 lei6 seot6 dai1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在考虑要不要转按，現在銀行利率低一些。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking about whether to remortgage — bank interest rates are a bit lower now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想慳啲利息，可以考慮轉按去另一間銀行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 haan1 di1 lei6 sik1, ho2 ji5 haau2 leoi6 zyun3 on3 heoi3 ling6 jat1 gaan1 ngan4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想省些利息，可以考慮把按揭轉到另一家銀行。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to save on interest, you could consider remortgaging to another bank.

mandarin_meaning: 转捩点 / 转折点 (zhuǎnliè diǎn / zhuǎnzhé diǎn)
english_meaning: turning point; critical juncture; watershed moment
explanation_mandarin: 表示发展、情况等出现重大变化或转折的时刻或节点，通常指具有决定性影响的关键点。
explanation_english: Refers to a moment or point when a development or situation undergoes a significant change or shift; a decisive turning point that alters the subsequent course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次選舉係香港政治一個重要嘅轉捩點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 zing3 zi6 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 zyun2 lit6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次选举是香港政治的一个重要转折点。
examples.english_sentence: This election is an important turning point in Hong Kong politics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病情好轉係治療過程嘅一個轉捩點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 cing4 hou2 zyun2 hai6 zi6 liu4 gwo3 cing4 ge3 jat1 go3 zyun2 lit6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病情好转是治疗过程的一个转折点。
examples.english_sentence: His improvement was a turning point in the course of treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 转接
english_meaning: to transfer/forward (a call, task, or connection)
explanation_mandarin: 指把電話、任務、連接等從一方轉給另一方接手或連接起來。
explanation_english: To hand over or route a call, task, or connection from one party to another so the latter takes over or connects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會幫你轉接個電話畀部門主管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5 zyun2 zip3 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會幫你把電話轉接給部門主管。
examples.english_sentence: I'll transfer the call to the department manager for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 客服話會幫我轉接去技術支援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 fuk6 waa6 wui5 bong1 ngo5 zyun2 zip3 heoi3 gei6 seot6 zi1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 客服說會幫我轉接到技術支援。
examples.english_sentence: Customer service said they would transfer me to technical support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經將個案轉接咗畀新同事跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 go3 on3 zyun2 zip3 zo2 bei2 san1 tung4 si6 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經把案件轉接給新同事跟進。
examples.english_sentence: He has already handed the case over to a new colleague to follow up.

mandarin_meaning: 转接头 / 适配器（用于连接或转换不同插头或接口的装置）
english_meaning: adapter; plug adapter; connector (a device used to connect or convert between different plugs or interfaces)
explanation_mandarin: 用來連接或轉換兩個不同插頭或接口的裝置，例如電源轉接頭可以使不同國家或不同規格的插頭相容。也可指各類連接介面的轉接器。
explanation_english: A device used to connect or convert between different plugs or interfaces. For example, a power plug adapter lets plugs from different countries fit a socket. It can also refer to adapters for various cable or connector types.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇帶充電器，你有冇轉接頭可以借我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 daai3 cung1 din6 hei3, nei5 jau5 mou5 zyun2 zip3 tau4 ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有带充电器，你有没有转接头可以借我？
examples.english_sentence: I didn't bring my charger. Do you have an adapter I can borrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去旅行記得帶轉接頭，唔同國家嘅插頭唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 gei3 dak1 daai3 zyun2 zip3 tau4, m4 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 caap3 tau4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去旅行记得带转接头，不同国家的插头不同。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring an adapter when you travel; plugs differ between countries.

mandarin_meaning: （把插頭）轉插；使用轉接頭/插頭轉換器
english_meaning: to replug; to plug into a different socket; to use a plug adapter
explanation_mandarin: 指把電器的插頭從一個插座移到另一個插座，或使用插頭轉接器以配合不同插座。
explanation_english: To unplug and plug into another socket, or to use a plug adapter/connector to fit a different type of socket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部風扇唔郁，試下將插頭轉插去另一個插座。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 fung1 sin3 m4 juk6, si3 haa5 zoeng1 caap3 tau4 zyun2 caap3 heoi3 ling6 jat1 go3 caap3 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電風扇不轉，試試把插頭轉插到另一個插座。
examples.english_sentence: The fan isn't running — try replugging it into a different socket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去旅行要帶轉插頭，因為唔同國家插座形狀唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 daai3 zyun2 caap3 tau4, jan1 wai6 m4 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 caap3 zo6 jing4 zong6 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去旅行要帶轉接頭，因為不同國家的插座形狀不同。
examples.english_sentence: Bring a plug adapter when traveling because countries have different socket types.

mandarin_meaning: 轉換插頭／轉接頭（插頭轉換器）
english_meaning: plug adapter; adapter plug (device that converts one plug type to another)
explanation_mandarin: 「轉插頭」為粵語口語用法，等同普通話的「轉換插頭」或「轉接頭」，指用來把不同國家或不同標準的插頭互相轉換的電源轉接器，或將某些電子設備的插頭轉換以配合插座。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "轉插頭" is a colloquial term equivalent to Mandarin "轉換插頭" or "adapter plug." It refers to a device used to convert one plug type to another (for example when traveling) or to adapt plugs between different standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去英國要帶一個轉插頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 jing1 gwok3 jiu3 daai3 jat1 go3 zyun2 caap3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要去英国，要带一个转换插头。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the UK; I need to bring a plug adapter.

mandarin_meaning: 转换 (zhuǎnhuàn)
english_meaning: to convert / to transform; conversion, transformation
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词（也可作名词，表示转换或变换的动作/过程）
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also function as a noun: conversion / transformation)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某種形式、狀態或設定改變為另一種形式或狀態，例如檔案格式、模式或心情的改變。
explanation_english: Indicates changing something from one form, state, or setting to another — e.g., file format conversion, mode switching, or shifting a mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要將檔案格式轉換成 PDF。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 zoeng1 dong2 on3 gaak3 sik1 zyun2 wun6 sing4 PDF.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要将档案格式转换成 PDF。
examples.english_sentence: I need to convert the file format to PDF.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺設定入面轉換顯示語言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 cit3 ding6 jap6 min6 zyun2 wun6 hin2 si6 jyu5 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在设置里转换显示语言。
examples.english_sentence: You can change the display language in the settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會用運動去幫手轉換心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 jung6 wan6 dung6 heoi3 bong1 sau2 zyun2 wun6 sam1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会用运动来帮忙转换心情。
examples.english_sentence: I use exercise to help shift my mood.

mandarin_meaning: 转播
english_meaning: to rebroadcast; to relay (a broadcast)
explanation_mandarin: 指把某個節目、比賽或活動透過電視、電台、網絡等媒體轉送或同步播放到其他地區或平台。
explanation_english: To transmit a program, event, or broadcast through television, radio, or online platforms to other regions or platforms (i.e., rebroadcast or relay).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台會轉播今場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 wui5 zyun2 bo3 gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台會轉播這場比賽。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station will broadcast this match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台將演唱會轉播到全球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 zyun2 bo3 dou3 cyun4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台把演唱會轉播到全球。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station broadcast the concert worldwide.

mandarin_meaning: 轉帳 / 轉款（把錢從一個賬戶轉到另一個賬戶）
english_meaning: to transfer money (electronically); to pay someone via bank transfer/instant payment
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語口語中，「轉數」多指透過銀行轉帳或即時支付系統（如轉數快）將錢轉給別人。也可作為名詞指一次轉帳的動作。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "轉數" commonly refers to transferring money to someone via bank transfer or instant payment systems (e.g., FPS). It can be used as a verb (to transfer) or noun (a transfer).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家用轉數畀你，收到記得同我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jung6 zyun2 sou3 bei2 nei5, sau1 dou3 gei3 dak1 tung4 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在用轉帳給你，收到記得跟我說。
examples.english_sentence: I'll transfer the money to you now; let me know when you receive it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家轉數好方便，即刻可以收到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zyun2 sou3 hou2 fong1 bin6, zik1 haak1 ho2 ji5 sau1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在轉帳很方便，可以立即收到錢。
examples.english_sentence: Transfers are very convenient now; you can receive money instantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯畀現金，話會轉數畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 bei2 jin6 gam1, waa6 wui5 zyun2 sou3 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不肯給現金，說會轉帳給我。
examples.english_sentence: He wouldn't give cash; he said he'd transfer the money to me.

mandarin_meaning: 调表；篡改数据／做假账（指人为修改数字以误导他人）
english_meaning: To falsify figures or data; to doctor the books; to tamper with a meter (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粤语俗语，字面意思是把计数表转动，实际指篡改数据、做假账或人为调整数字以误导他人，常用于商业、政治或比赛等情境。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'to turn the meter.' It refers to tampering with meters or manipulating figures/data — i.e., cooking the books or falsifying statistics — often used in business, politics, or competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司報表被人轉數錶，投資者好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bou3 biu2 bei2 jan4 zyun2 sou3 biu1 , tau4 zi1 ze2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司报表被人篡改数据，投资者很担心。
examples.english_sentence: The company's reports were doctored and investors are worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲政客俾人揭發轉數錶，市民好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zing3 haak3 bei2 jan4 gik6 faat3 zyun2 sou3 biu1 , si5 man4 hou2 nau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有政客被揭发篡改数据，市民很生气。
examples.english_sentence: Some politicians were exposed for manipulating figures, and citizens are angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企轉數錶偷電，最後俾罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei5 zyun2 sou3 biu1 tau1 din6 , zeoi3 hau6 bei2 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里调表偷电，最后被罚款。
examples.english_sentence: He tampered with the meter to steal electricity at home and was eventually fined.

mandarin_meaning: 转会（转队、改换所属俱乐部或会籍）
english_meaning: to transfer (to another club/team); a transfer of membership or affiliation
explanation_mandarin: 通常指運動員或成員由一個球會、俱樂部或組織轉到另一個，亦可泛指改變所屬會籍或隸屬關係。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a player or member moving from one club, team, or organization to another; can also more generally mean changing affiliation or membership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺夏天轉咗會，去咗另一間球會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 haa6 tin1 zyun2 zo2 wui6, heoi3 zo2 ling6 jat1 gaan1 kau4 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在夏天转会了，去了另一家球会/俱乐部。
examples.english_sentence: He transferred clubs in the summer; he went to another club.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果想轉會，要先同原本球會商量合約條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 zyun2 wui6, jiu3 sin1 tung4 jyun4 bun2 kau4 wui2 soeng1 loeng4 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想转会，要先与原球会商量合约条款。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to transfer, you must first negotiate contract terms with your original club.

mandarin_meaning: 转校（转到另一所学校就读）
english_meaning: to transfer schools; to move from one school to another
explanation_mandarin: 指學生從一所學校轉到另一所學校繼續就讀，常涉及辦理轉學手續。
explanation_english: To change schools as a student, i.e., move from one school to another, usually involving transfer procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個學期可能要轉校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 hok6 kei4 ho2 nang4 jiu3 zyun2 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下個學期可能要转校。
examples.english_sentence: He might have to transfer schools next semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我因為搬屋，所以要轉校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jan1 wai6 baan1 uk1, so2 ji5 jiu3 zyun2 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我因为搬家，所以要转校。
examples.english_sentence: I have to transfer schools because I'm moving house.

mandarin_meaning: 转机（可指局面或病情等好转，也可指旅途中更换航班）
english_meaning: turning point / improvement (situation gets better); transfer (flight)
explanation_mandarin: 「轉機」有兩個常見含義：一是指情況出現轉折或好轉（如局勢、病情等開始改善）；二是指旅行中更換航班（中途在某地下飛機換乘另一班機）。
explanation_english: “轉機” has two common senses: (1) a turning point or improvement (when a situation, e.g. illness or economy, begins to get better); (2) to transfer flights during a journey (to change planes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生意太差，我哋急需一個轉機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 ji3 taai3 caa1, ngo5 dei6 gap1 seoi1 jat1 go3 zyun2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生意太差，我們急需一個轉機。
examples.english_sentence: Business has been doing badly; we urgently need a turning point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我喺新加坡轉機去東京。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 hai2 san1 gaa3 bo1 zyun2 gei1 heoi3 dung1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次我在新加坡轉機去東京。
examples.english_sentence: This time I transited in Singapore to go to Tokyo.

mandarin_meaning: 變得固執/耍脾氣或變本加厲（口語）
english_meaning: to suddenly become stubborn/contrary or to start acting up (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「轉死性」是廣東話口語，指人忽然改變性情、變得固執、耍脾氣或越來越過分地做某事，帶有負面、頑固的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone suddenly changes their temperament and becomes stubborn, contrary, or starts acting up — often escalating behavior or refusing to listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再同佢爭，佢一嬲就會轉死性，愈講愈唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 tung4 keoi5 zang1, keoi5 jat1 naau1 zau6 wui5 zyun2 sei2 sing3, jyu6 gong2 jyu6 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再和他爭論了，他一生氣就會變得很固執，越說越不聽。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue with him anymore — when he gets angry he becomes stubborn and the more you say, the less he listens.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）轉台 / 傳球
english_meaning: to switch channels; to pass the ball (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「轉波」為香港粵語口語用詞，常用來表示把電視或廣播的頻道切換（相當於「轉台」、「換台」）。在體育比賽或球類語境中，也可用來表示把球傳給隊友（相當於「傳球」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese verb. It commonly means to switch TV or radio channels (similar to 'change channel'). In sports contexts it can also mean to pass the ball to a teammate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家轉波去睇足球比賽，你想唔想一齊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zyun2 bo1 heoi3 tai2 zuk1 kau4 bei2 sai3, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jat1 cai4 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在轉台去看足球比賽，你想不想一起看？
examples.english_sentence: I'm switching channels to watch the football match now. Do you want to watch together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個後衛將波轉波畀左翼，之後佢入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hau6 wai6 zoeng1 bo1 zyun2 bo1 bei2 zo2 jik6, zi1 hau6 keoi5 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 後衛把球傳給左邊的隊友，之後他進球了。
examples.english_sentence: The defender passed the ball to the left winger, and then he scored.

mandarin_meaning: 轉注（漢字六書之一），指兩個字字形或本義相近，互相註解或通用
english_meaning: Zhuanzhu (one of the Six Categories of Chinese characters): two characters that are related in form or meaning and mutually explain or substitute for each other
explanation_mandarin: 轉注是古代漢字分類（六書）的一類，表示兩個字在形義上有密切關係，常互相註解或通用，常見於《說文解字》等字書的釋字方法。
explanation_english: Zhuanzhu is one of the traditional Six Categories (liùshū) of Chinese characters. It denotes a pair (or group) of characters closely related in form or original meaning that are used to explain or substitute for one another in classical philology and character commentaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「轉注」係六書其中一種，講緊兩個字互相註解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「zyun2 zyu3」 hai6 luk6 syu1 kei4 zung1 jat1 zung2, gong2 gan2 loeng5 go3 zi6 wu6 soeng1 zyu3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “转注”是六书中的一种，指两字互相注解。
examples.english_sentence: “Zhuanzhu” is one of the Six Categories, referring to two characters that mutually explain each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代字書經常用「轉注」嚟說明某啲字嘅本義與關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 zi6 syu1 ging1 soeng4 jung6 「zyun2 zyu3」 lai4 syut3 ming4 mau5 di1 zi6 ge3 bun2 ji6 jyu5 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代字书经常用“转注”来说明某些字的本义与关系。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient character dictionaries often use 'zhuanzhu' to explain the original meanings and relations of certain characters.

mandarin_meaning: （遊戲術語）在消除類或連線類遊戲中，移動或旋轉棋盤上的寶珠/圓珠以形成連擊或匹配。
english_meaning: (gaming term) to move/rotate orbs/gems on the board in match/elimination games to create combos or matches.
explanation_mandarin: 「轉珠」常用於手機或手遊（例如類似Puzzle & Dragons的遊戲），指玩家操作棋盤上的寶珠，透過移動或旋轉來形成連鎖反應或增加combo數，是一種技術性操作的描述。
explanation_english: Used mostly in mobile or puzzle games (e.g. Puzzle & Dragons-like titles). It refers to the action of moving or rotating the orbs on the board to create chain reactions or increase combo counts — a description of a player skill/technique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識轉珠？教我點樣整到多啲連擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zyun2 zyu1? gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 zing2 dou3 do1 di1 lin4 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你會不會轉珠？教我怎麼弄出更多連擊。
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to move the orbs? Teach me how to get more combos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢練咗好耐轉珠技巧，依家連高難度關卡都過到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin6 zo2 hou2 noi6 zyun2 zyu1 gei6 haau2, ji1 gaa1 lin4 gou1 naan4 dou6 gwaan1 kaa1 dou1 gwo3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他練了很久的轉珠技巧，現在連高難度關卡都能過。
examples.english_sentence: He practiced orb-moving techniques for a long time and can now clear high-difficulty stages.

mandarin_meaning: 转生 / 转世（灵魂在死後再次投胎）
english_meaning: reincarnation; to be reborn; (in games) respawn
explanation_mandarin: 指靈魂在死亡之後再次投胎或轉世；在遊戲或奇幻語境中常用來表示角色復活（respawn）。
explanation_english: Refers to the soul being reborn after death; in games or fantasy contexts it is also used to mean a character respawning or being reborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢信轉生，覺得人死咗會再投胎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 zyun2 saang1, gok3 dak1 jan4 sei2 zo2 wui5 zoi3 tau4 toi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他信轉生，覺得人死了會再投胎。
examples.english_sentence: He believes in reincarnation; he thinks people are reborn after death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺遊戲入面，角色死咗就會轉生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6, gok3 sik1 sei2 zo2 zau6 wui5 zyun2 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在遊戲裡，角色死了就會轉生。
examples.english_sentence: In the game, characters respawn when they die.

mandarin_meaning: 转发（把信息、邮件或网上内容转交或转载）
english_meaning: to forward; to repost/share (a message, email, or online content)
explanation_mandarin: 把郵件、訊息或網上內容傳給其他人；在社交媒體上也可指將別人的貼文或影片轉載或分享。
explanation_english: To send or relay an email, message, or online content to others; on social media it can mean reposting or sharing someone else's post or video.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經幫你轉發嗰封電郵俾老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 bong1 nei5 zyun2 faat3 go2 fung1 din6 jau4 bei2 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經幫你把那封電郵轉發給老闆。
examples.english_sentence: I already forwarded that email to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺Facebook度轉發咗條片，結果有好多留言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 Facebook dou6 zyun2 faat3 zo2 tiu4 pin3, git3 gwo2 jau5 hou2 do1 lau4 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在Facebook上轉發了那條影片，結果有很多留言。
examples.english_sentence: He reposted that video on Facebook, and it got a lot of comments.

mandarin_meaning: （一）转眼；（二）转眼间
english_meaning: in the blink of an eye; in an instant
explanation_mandarin: 表示時間非常短，事情很快發生或過去，相當於「一轉眼間」或「一下子」。
explanation_english: Indicates a very short lapse of time — something happens or passes very quickly (equivalent to 'in the blink of an eye' or 'in no time').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 轉眼已經過咗五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun2 ngaan5 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 转眼已经过去五年了。
examples.english_sentence: In the blink of an eye, five years have passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你轉眼就長大喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyun2 ngaan5 zau6 zoeng2 daai6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一转眼就长大了。
examples.english_sentence: You grew up in the blink of an eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋轉眼間就完成咗份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyun2 ngaan5 gaan1 zau6 jyun4 sing4 zo2 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一转眼就完成了那份工作。
examples.english_sentence: We finished that piece of work in no time.

mandarin_meaning: 轉眼間 / 瞬間
english_meaning: in the blink of an eye; in an instant; momentarily
explanation_mandarin: 表示時間非常短，很快就發生變化或結束，常用來形容事情發生得很快或時間流逝迅速。
explanation_english: Indicates a very short span of time; used to say that something happened very quickly or that time passed swiftly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 轉眼間，已經十年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun2 ngaan5 gaan1, ji5 ging1 sap6 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 轉眼間，已經十年了。
examples.english_sentence: In the blink of an eye, it's already been ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 轉眼間，天由晴轉陰喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun2 ngaan5 gaan1, tin1 jau4 cing4 zyun2 jam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 轉眼間，天從晴變陰了。
examples.english_sentence: In a moment, the sky changed from clear to overcast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暑假轉眼間就過咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 gaa3 zyun2 ngaan5 gaan1 zau6 gwo3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暑假轉眼間就過去了。
examples.english_sentence: The summer vacation passed in the blink of an eye.

mandarin_meaning: 瞬间即逝、非常短暂
english_meaning: fleeting; transient; ephemeral — vanishing in an instant
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物非常短暫，轉眼就消失，常用來形容時間、機會或美好事物的短暫性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is extremely brief and disappears in an instant; often used to describe the transient nature of time, opportunities, or pleasant moments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美好嘅時光經常轉瞬即逝，記得珍惜眼前人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 hou2 ge3 si4 gwong1 ging1 soeng4 zyun2 seon3 zik1 sai3, gei3 dak1 zan1 sik1 ngaan5 cin4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美好的時光經常轉瞬即逝，記得珍惜眼前人。
examples.english_sentence: Beautiful moments often pass in an instant; remember to cherish the people in front of you.

mandarin_meaning: 转瞬间
english_meaning: in an instant; in the blink of an eye; momentarily
explanation_mandarin: 表示在非常短的時間內，事情瞬間發生或改變。常用作時間副詞。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens or changes in a very short amount of time; used as a temporal adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉瞬間就走咗，嚇咗我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 seon3 gaan1 zau6 zau2 zo2, haak3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他转瞬间就走了，嚇了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He left in an instant and startled me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣轉瞬間就變咗，由落雨變到出太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 zyun2 seon3 gaan1 zau6 bin3 zo2, jau4 lok6 jyu5 bin3 dou3 ceot1 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣轉瞬間就變了，從下雨到出太陽。
examples.english_sentence: The weather changed in an instant, from raining to sunshine.

mandarin_meaning: 转移
english_meaning: to transfer; to shift; to divert; (medical) to metastasize
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物、注意力或责任等从一处或一个对象转到另一处或另一个对象；在医学上也可指病变由一个部位扩散到另一个部位（转移）。
explanation_english: To move or transfer something (e.g., attention, responsibility, items) from one place or target to another; in medicine, to metastasize (spread) from one site to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將注意力轉移去下一個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 zyu3 ji3 lik6 zyun2 ji4 heoi3 haa6 jat1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把注意力转移到下一个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to shift our attention to the next project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想將責任轉移畀其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 zaak3 jam6 zyun2 ji4 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把责任转移给其他人。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to transfer the responsibility to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生擔心腫瘤可能已經轉移到其他器官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 daam1 sam1 zung2 lau4 ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 zyun2 ji4 dou3 kei4 taa1 hei3 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生担心肿瘤可能已经转移到其他器官。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor is worried the tumor may have metastasized to other organs.

mandarin_meaning: 转移视线（转移注意力、转移别人的目光或注意）
english_meaning: to divert someone's attention; to shift (someone's) gaze; to distract
explanation_mandarin: 表示把別人的注意力或視線從一個焦點移開，常用於刻意分散注意力或轉移話題的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to moving someone's attention or line of sight away from a focal point; often used when intentionally distracting or changing the subject.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講咗啲笑話嚟轉移視線，唔想大家注意到嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 zo2 di1 siu3waa6 lai4 zyun2 ji4 si6 sin3, m4 soeng2 daai6gaa1 zyu3ji3 dou3 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他講了一些笑话来转移视线，不想大家注意到那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He told some jokes to divert attention; he didn't want everyone to notice that matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攝影師叫模特兒望向遠方，轉移視線去另一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sip3jing2si1 giu3 mo4dak6ji4 mong6 hoeng3 jyun5 fong1, zyun2 ji4 si6 sin3 heoi3 ling6 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摄影师让模特儿望向远方，转移视线到另一边。
examples.english_sentence: The photographer asked the model to look into the distance, shifting her gaze to the other side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政客試圖透過娛樂新聞轉移視線，避開敏感議題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3haak3 si3tou4 tau3gwo3 jyu6lok6 san1man4 zyun2 ji4 si6 sin3, bei6hoi1 man5gam2 ji5tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政客试图通过娱乐新闻转移视线，回避敏感议题。
examples.english_sentence: Politicians try to shift public attention through entertainment news to avoid sensitive issues.

mandarin_meaning: 轉而（zhuǎn'ér）：轉換為另外一種做法或情況
english_meaning: to turn to; instead; then; subsequently (indicates a shift to another action or situation)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示從一種做法或情況轉換到另一種，常見於書面語或正式語體，作為過渡銜接。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a shift from one action or situation to another; often found in written or formal contexts as a transitional connector.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定縮減開支，轉而投資喺網上營銷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 suk1 gaam2 hoi1 zi1, zyun2 ji4 tau4 zi1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 jing4 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司決定縮減開支，轉而投資於網上營銷。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to cut expenses and instead invest in online marketing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想入大學，轉而去做學徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 jap6 daai6 hok6, zyun2 ji4 heoi3 zou6 hok6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想上大學，轉而去當學徒。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to go to university; instead he became an apprentice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師先講理論，轉而示範操作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 sin1 gong2 lei5 leon6, zyun2 ji4 si6 faan6 cou1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師先講理論，轉而示範操作。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher first explained the theory, then demonstrated the procedure.

mandarin_meaning: 变声；换声（也可指改变语气或说话口吻）
english_meaning: to change one's voice or vocal register; to alter one's tone or manner of speaking
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指改變聲線、聲調或說話口吻；可指唱歌轉換聲區或談話時改變語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to change one's voice, vocal register, or tone—used for switching vocal register in singing or altering one's manner/attitude when speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講電話嗰陣會轉聲，好似唔同一個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 din6 waa2 go2 zan6 wui5 zyun2 seng1, hou2 ci5 m4 tung4 jat1 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打电话的时候会变声，好像不是同一个人。
examples.english_sentence: He changes his voice when he's on the phone; it's like a different person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱歌到高音位要學識轉聲，先至穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 go1 dou3 gou1 jam1 wai6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 zyun2 seng1, sin1 zi3 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱到高音时要学会换声，才能稳妥。
examples.english_sentence: When singing high notes you need to learn to switch registers to be stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家見佢最近轉聲，覺得好虛偽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 gin3 keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zyun2 seng1, gok3 dak1 hou2 heoi1 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家看到他最近变了口气，觉得很虚伪。
examples.english_sentence: People see he's changed his tone recently and think it's hypocritical.

mandarin_meaning: 轉換職業／崗位；改換工作
english_meaning: to change jobs; to transfer to a different position or occupation
explanation_mandarin: 指離開原來的工作或崗位，轉到另一個職位或改換職業。可以指公司內部調動或外部跳槽。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving one's current job or position and moving to another role or occupation. It can mean an internal transfer within the company or changing jobs externally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算轉職做產品經理，因為想學多啲產品開發嘅知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 zyun2 zik1 zou6 caan2 ban2 ging1 lei5, jan1 wai6 soeng2 hok6 do1 di1 caan2 ban2 hoi1 faat3 ge3 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算轉職做產品經理，因為想學更多產品開發的知識。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to change jobs to become a product manager because I want to learn more about product development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近喺公司內部轉職，由銷售轉去人力資源部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 zyun2 zik1, jau4 siu1 sau6 zyun2 heoi3 jan4 lik6 zi1 jyun4 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近在公司內部轉職，從銷售轉到人力資源部。
examples.english_sentence: He recently transferred within the company, moving from sales to HR.

mandarin_meaning: 換台；轉台（字面）；引申為改變立場或支持對象（比喻）
english_meaning: to change the TV/radio channel (literal); to change one's stance or switch allegiance (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指在電視或收音機上換台；口語中也可比喻改變立場、轉向其他話題或支持對象。
explanation_english: Originally means to change the TV or radio channel. Colloquially it can be used figuratively to mean changing one's stance, switching allegiance, or turning to a different topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目好悶，快啲轉臺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 hou2 mun6, faai3 di1 zyun2 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個節目很悶，快點換台。
examples.english_sentence: This show is boring — quickly change the channel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺政治立場上轉臺，令我好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zing3 zi6 lap6 coeng4 soeng6 zyun2 toi4, ling6 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在政治立場上轉變立場，讓我很失望。
examples.english_sentence: He switched his political stance, which really disappoints me.

mandarin_meaning: 由虧損轉為盈利；转亏为盈
english_meaning: to turn losses into profits; to go from a deficit to a surplus
explanation_mandarin: 表示把虧損變成盈利，常用於描述企業或財務狀況由不利轉為有利的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates turning a financial loss into a profit; commonly used to describe an improvement in a company's or financial situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經過幾年重整之後，終於轉虧為盈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 cung4 zing2 zi1 hau6, zung1 jyu1 zyun2 kwai1 wai4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司經過幾年重整之後，終於轉虧為盈。
examples.english_sentence: After several years of restructuring, the company finally turned its losses into profits.

mandarin_meaning: 转亏为盈（把亏损变为盈利）
english_meaning: to turn a loss into a profit; to reverse losses into gains
explanation_mandarin: 表示由虧損的狀態轉變為有盈利，常用於形容公司或事業等財務狀況好轉。
explanation_english: Describes changing from a loss-making state to a profitable one; commonly used for companies or ventures when financial performance improves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多得新管理團隊，呢間公司好快就轉虧為盈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 dak1 san1 gun2 lei5 tyun4 deoi6, ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 faai3 zau6 zyun3 fai1 wai4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多虧新管理團隊，這間公司很快就轉虧為盈。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to the new management team, the company quickly turned a loss into a profit.

mandarin_meaning: 转行（zhuǎn háng），改行
english_meaning: to change profession; to switch careers or line of work
explanation_mandarin: 表示改變職業或行業，從一種工作轉到另一種工作或行業。
explanation_english: Refers to changing one's occupation or industry — moving from one job or line of work to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近想轉行，想做教書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 soeng2 zyun2 hong4, soeng2 zou6 gaau3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近想转行，想当老师。
examples.english_sentence: He has been wanting to change careers recently; he wants to be a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為公司裁員，我決定轉行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gung1 si1 coi3 jyun4, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 zyun2 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为公司裁员，我决定转行。
examples.english_sentence: Because the company laid off staff, I decided to switch careers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由銀行轉行去做IT，人工高啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 ngan4 hong4 zyun2 hong4 heoi3 zou6 IT, jan4 gung1 gou1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从银行转行去做IT，薪水高一些。
examples.english_sentence: He switched from banking to IT; the pay is a bit higher.

mandarin_meaning: 转角；拐角（街道或物体的角落或转弯处）
english_meaning: corner; the place where a street or path turns; (figuratively) around the corner or a turning point
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词短语（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指街道或物体的拐角处，也可表示转弯或在拐角处遇见某人。既可作实义用法，也常用作比喻（如“轉角就見到希望”）。
explanation_english: Refers to a corner (of a street or object). It can also mean the action of turning a corner or meeting someone at a corner. Used both literally and figuratively (e.g., "hope is around the corner").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺轉角等我，我即刻到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 zyun2 gok3 dang2 ngo5, ngo5 zik1 haak1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在转角等我，我马上到。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me at the corner; I'll be there right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺轉角遇到咗舊朋友，傾咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zyun2 gok3 jyu6 dou3 zo2 gau6 pang4 jau5, king1 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在转角遇到了老朋友，聊了很久。
examples.english_sentence: He met an old friend at the corner and talked for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過咗呢個難關，可能就喺轉角見到希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 zo2 ni1 go3 naan4 gwaan1, ho2 nang4 zau6 hai2 zyun2 gok3 gin3 dou3 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过了这个难关，可能就在转角看到希望。
examples.english_sentence: After getting through this difficulty, you might see hope around the corner.

mandarin_meaning: 转角处；转角位置
english_meaning: corner (a spot at the corner of a street or building); around the corner
explanation_mandarin: 表示在街道或房屋的转弯处的位置；口语中也可用于比喻意外的惊喜或人生的转折点。
explanation_english: Refers to the location at the corner of a street or building; in colloquial use it can also be a metaphor for an unexpected surprise or a turning point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖就喺轉角位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 zau6 hai6 zyun2 gok3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间店就在转角处。
examples.english_sentence: The shop is right at the corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺轉角位等我啦，我快到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 zyun2 gok3 wai6 dang2 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 faai3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在转角处等我，我快到了。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me at the corner, I'm almost there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生有時喺轉角位會遇到驚喜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 jau5 si4 hai6 zyun2 gok3 wai6 wui5 jyu6 dou3 ging1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生有时在转角处会遇到惊喜。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes life brings surprises around the corner.

mandarin_meaning: 转变 (zhuǎnbiàn)
english_meaning: change; transformation; to change; to transform
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物、情況或狀態發生改變或轉換，可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a change or transformation in things, situations, or states; can be used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會嘅轉變好快，我哋要保持彈性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 ge3 zyun2 bin3 hou2 faai3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 daan6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会的转变很快，我们要保持弹性。
examples.english_sentence: Societal changes are happening quickly; we need to stay flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅政策有好大轉變，大家要留意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zing3 caak3 jau5 hou2 daai6 zyun2 bin3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 lau4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的政策有很大转变，大家要留意。
examples.english_sentence: The company's policies have undergone major changes; everyone should pay attention.

mandarin_meaning: 转让 (把财产、权利等转移给他人)
english_meaning: to transfer (ownership, rights, interests); to assign
explanation_mandarin: 指將所有權、使用權或其他權利轉移、讓渡給他人，常用於物業、專利、股權等買賣或讓渡場景。
explanation_english: Refers to transferring ownership, usage rights, or other rights to another person; commonly used for sale or assignment of property, patents, shares, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭我諗住轉讓畀人，價錢可以再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ngo5 lam2 zyu6 zyun2 joeng6 bei2 jan4, gaa3 cin2 ho2 ji5 zoi6 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间店铺我打算转让给别人，价钱可以再谈。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to transfer this shop to someone; the price can be negotiated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算將專利權轉讓畀外國公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 zoeng1 zyun1 lei6 kyun4 zyun2 joeng6 bei2 ngoi6 gwok3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算将专利权转让给外国公司。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to transfer the patent rights to a foreign company.

mandarin_meaning: 转账 (zhuǎn zhàng)
english_meaning: to transfer money (between bank accounts); bank transfer / money transfer
explanation_mandarin: 指將錢從一個帳戶轉到另一個帳戶，通常指透過銀行或電子支付系統進行的轉帳操作。
explanation_english: To move money from one account to another, typically by bank transfer or electronic payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱已經轉咗賬畀你，查收下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 ji5 ging1 zyun2 zo2 zoeng3 bei2 nei5, caa4 sau1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛已經把錢轉給你了，查收一下。
examples.english_sentence: I just transferred the money to you; please check.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用手機銀行轉賬，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 sau2 gei1 ngan4 hong4 zyun2 zoeng3, hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用手機銀行轉賬，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: You can use mobile banking to transfer money; it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我轉賬二百蚊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zyun2 zoeng3 ji6 baak3 man1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以幫我轉賬兩百塊？
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me transfer HK$200?

mandarin_meaning: 把物品轉交／贈送給別人；轉送、轉交作為贈與
english_meaning: to pass on or give an item to someone else as a gift; to forward or donate
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某樣物品從自己或原持有人轉交、贈送給其他人，常用於捐贈或代為轉交的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates transferring or giving an item from oneself or the original owner to someone else as a gift; commonly used for donations or forwarding something on someone’s behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲書我唔睇，想轉贈畀圖書館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 syu1 ngo5 m4 tai2, soeng2 zyun2 zang3 bei2 tou4 syu1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些書我不看，想轉贈給圖書館。
examples.english_sentence: I don't read these books and want to donate/pass them on to the library.

mandarin_meaning: 轉向/趨向；變得（某種狀態）
english_meaning: to shift/turn toward; to become (a certain state); to trend toward
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示事態、情況或趨勢由一種狀態轉向另一種狀態，常與形容詞或名詞連用，語氣偏書面或正式。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that a situation or trend changes from one state to another; often followed by an adjective or noun. The expression is relatively formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟情況開始由衰退轉趨改善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 cing4 fong3 hoi1 ci2 jau4 seoi1 teoi3 zyun2 ceoi1 goi2 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經濟情況開始由衰退轉趨改善。
examples.english_sentence: The economic situation has begun to shift from recession toward improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司政策由擴張慢慢轉趨保守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing3 caak3 jau4 kwok3 zoeng1 maan6 maan6 zyun2 ceoi1 bou2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司政策由擴張慢慢轉趨保守。
examples.english_sentence: The company's policy has gradually shifted from expansion to being more conservative.

mandarin_meaning: 转身（zhuǎnshēn）——转动身体或回头；也可比喻迅速离开或改变立场/背弃。
english_meaning: to turn around (physically); to turn one's body; to turn away; figuratively, to leave quickly or to turn one's back on someone / change stance.
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體轉向或回頭看，也可用作比喻，表示馬上離開、改變立場或不再理睬對方。
explanation_english: Describes physically turning one's body or looking back; can also be used figuratively to mean leaving immediately, changing one’s stance, or turning one’s back on someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉身望咗一眼，然後行開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 san1 mong6 zo2 jat1 ngaan5, jin4 hau6 hang4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他转身看了一眼，然后走开。
examples.english_sentence: He turned around, glanced, and then walked away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢嘅話，我轉身就走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 ge3 waa6, ngo5 zyun2 san1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他的话，我转身就走。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard what he said, I turned and left immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉身唔理我，令我好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 san1 m4 lei5 ngo5, ling6 ngo5 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他转身不理我，让我很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: He turned away and ignored me, which made me very sad.

mandarin_meaning: 转车，换乘（换乘交通工具）；也可引申为改变方式或策略（口语）
english_meaning: to transfer/change vehicles (e.g., change trains or buses); figuratively, to change approach or course
explanation_mandarin: 指乘坐公共交通工具時，更換車輛或轉乘其他路線。例如在地鐵或巴士路線之間換車。口語中有時也用來比喻改變做法或策略，但此用法較為非正式。
explanation_english: Refers to changing vehicles or transferring between routes when using public transport (e.g., changing trains or buses). Informally it can be used figuratively to mean changing approach or strategy, though that use is more colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要喺旺角轉車去荔枝角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 hai2 wong6 gok3 zyun2 ce1 heoi3 lai6 zi1 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要在旺角换乘去荔枝角。
examples.english_sentence: I need to transfer at Mong Kok to get to Lai Chi Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定轉車，改用線上銷售模式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zyun2 ce1, goi2 jung6 sin3 soeng6 siu1 sau6 mou6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定转变策略，改用线上销售模式。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to change course and switch to an online sales model.

mandarin_meaning: 换乘站 / 转车站
english_meaning: transfer station; interchange station (a station where passengers change trains or lines)
explanation_mandarin: 指需要在该站换乘另一条线路或另一种交通工具的车站，常用于地铁、火车等公共交通系统中。
explanation_english: A station where passengers transfer to another line or mode of transport; commonly used for metro, train, or other public transit systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要喺呢個轉車站轉車去中環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 zyun2 ce1 zaam6 zyun2 ce1 heoi3 zung1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要在这个换乘站换乘去中环。
examples.english_sentence: I need to transfer at this station to go to Central.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個轉車站人好多，等車要等好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyun2 ce1 zaam6 jan4 hou2 do1, dang2 ce1 jiu3 dang2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个换乘站人很多，等车要等很久。
examples.english_sentence: This transfer station is very crowded; you have to wait a long time for a train.

mandarin_meaning: 转舵；改变立场或方向（改变态度、政策）
english_meaning: to change course/stance; to reverse direction or position (figuratively: backtrack or renege)
explanation_mandarin: 原指轉動車輛的方向盤；在廣東話口語中常用作比喻，表示改變立場、政策或態度，常帶有突然或反覆的含義。
explanation_english: Literally to turn a steering wheel; in Cantonese colloquial use it is a metaphor for changing one's stance, policy, or attitude — often implying a sudden, unexpected, or inconsistent reversal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話支持呢個計劃，跟住又轉軚反對，真係令人失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, gan1 zyu6 jau6 zyun2 teoi2 faan2 deoi3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說支持這個計劃，結果又改變立場反對，真讓人失望。
examples.english_sentence: He said he supported the plan, then reversed his stance and opposed it — really disappointing.

mandarin_meaning: 转载
english_meaning: to repost; to reprint; to republish
explanation_mandarin: 表示把他人或其他來源的文章、圖片或內容再次發表或轉貼到另一個媒體或平台上，通常涉及重複發布或引用來源。
explanation_english: To republish or repost content (such as articles, images, or posts) from another source onto a different media or platform, often involving reprinting or sharing with attribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以轉載我哋嘅文章，但請註明來源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 zyun2 zoi6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 man4 zoeng1, daan6 ceng2 zyu3 ming4 loi4 jyun4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以转载我们的文章，但请注明来源。
examples.english_sentence: You can repost our article, but please cite the source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺Facebook見到條貼文，想轉載俾朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 Facebook gin3 dou3 tiu4 tip3 man4, soeng2 zyun2 zoi6 bei2 pang4 jau5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在Facebook看到那条贴文，想转载给朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I saw the post on Facebook and want to repost it to my friends.

mandarin_meaning: 转述（zhuǎnshù）
english_meaning: to relay; to report; to paraphrase or retell someone else's words
explanation_mandarin: 把別人說過的話或內容用自己的話重複或轉告給第三方，常用於傳達資訊或報告事實。
explanation_english: To repeat or convey someone else's words or content to a third party, often used for passing on information or reporting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我將呢啲重點轉述畀老闆聽？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 ni1 di1 zung6 dim2 zyun2 seot6 bei2 lou5 baan2 teng1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我把這些重點轉述給老闆聽嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Could you help relay these key points to the boss for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉述話會遲一陣先到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 seot6 waa6 wui5 ci4 jat1 zan6 sin1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他轉述說會晚一會兒才到。
examples.english_sentence: He relayed that he would arrive a bit later.

mandarin_meaning: 转速 (zhuǎnsù)
english_meaning: rotational speed; revolutions per minute (RPM)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体的旋转速度，常以每分钟转数（RPM）来表示，常用于引擎、电动机或其他旋转机械的转动速度描述。
explanation_english: Refers to the speed of rotation of an object, often expressed in revolutions per minute (RPM); commonly used for engines, motors, or other rotating machinery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開車嘅時候要睇住轉速表，唔好令引擎轉速太高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 ce1 si4 jiu3 lau4 ji3 zyun2 cuk1 biu1, m4 hou2 ling6 jan5 cing4 zyun2 cuk1 taai3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车时要注意转速表，别让引擎转速太高。
examples.english_sentence: When driving, watch the tachometer; don't let the engine's RPM get too high.

mandarin_meaning: 转运；改变运势（也可指货物的转运/运输）
english_meaning: to turn one's luck around; to change fortune; (also) to transfer/transport goods
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词（在物流语境可作名词/名词短语）
explanation_mandarin: 「轉運」常用來表示運氣好轉、命運改變；在商業或物流語境中，也可指貨物的轉運或運輸。
explanation_english: Commonly means a change for the better in one's luck or fortune. In business/logistics contexts it can also mean the transfer or transportation of goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近工作唔順，希望轉運啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 zok3 m4 seon6, hei1 mong6 zyun2 wan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作不顺，希望能转运一下。
examples.english_sentence: Work hasn't been going well recently; I hope my luck will turn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵咗份新工，覺得有機會轉運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 zo2 fan6 san1 gung1, gok3 dak1 jau5 gei1 wui6 zyun2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找到一份新工作，觉得有机会转运。
examples.english_sentence: He found a new job and feels he might turn his luck around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司做轉運生意，幫客戶安排貨物轉運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zyun2 wan6 saang1 ji3, bong1 haak3 wu6 ngon1 paai4 fo3 mat6 zyun2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司做转运生意，帮助客户安排货物转运。
examples.english_sentence: This company does freight forwarding, helping clients arrange the transfer of goods.

mandarin_meaning: 转达 (zhuǎndá)
english_meaning: to convey; to pass on (a message)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把訊息、意見或要求從一個人傳給另一個人，常用於請求或報告傳遞消息。
explanation_english: To convey or pass on information, opinions, or requests from one person to another; commonly used when relaying messages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔喺，我可以幫你轉達畀佢聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 hai2, ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 zyun2 daat6 bei2 keoi5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不在，我可以幫你轉達給他聽。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not here, I can pass that on to him for you.

mandarin_meaning: 短暫轉變；等一下（口語）
english_meaning: to change briefly / for a short while; (colloquial) wait a moment
explanation_mandarin: 「轉陣」常用於粵語口語，表示某事短暫地改變（如天氣轉為陣雨），或用作請人稍等的表達（如「轉陣先」）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "轉陣" is a colloquial expression meaning a brief or temporary change (often used for weather, e.g. turning into brief showers) or used to ask someone to wait a moment (e.g. "轉陣先").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日可能會轉陣雨，記住帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 zyun2 zan6 jyu5, gei3 zyu6 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天可能會短暫下陣雨，記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: It may turn into brief showers tomorrow; remember to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你轉陣先，我去拎下啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyun2 zan6 sin1, ngo5 heoi3 ling1 haa5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你等一下，我去拿點東西。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment, I'll go grab something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝機組臨時要轉陣，班次有啲延誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 gei1 zou2 lam4 si4 jiu3 zyun2 zan6, baan1 ci3 jau5 di1 jin4 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上機組臨時要換班，班次有些延誤。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the crew had to rotate shifts temporarily, so some flights were delayed.

mandarin_meaning: 回頭／一會兒；轉動頭部
english_meaning: to turn one's head; shortly/in a moment
explanation_mandarin: 在口語中有兩個常見用法：一是作動作，表示轉動頭部；二是作時間副詞，表示不久、過一會兒或回頭（接著發生某事）。
explanation_english: Commonly used in two ways: (1) as a verb meaning to turn one's head; (2) as an adverb meaning shortly/in a moment or 'after a short while'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家走，轉頭再打畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zau2, zyun2 tau4 zoi3 daa2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們現在走，回頭再打給你。
examples.english_sentence: We're leaving now; we'll call you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉頭望住窗外，好似見到咩特別嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 tau4 mong6 zyu6 coeng1 ngoi6, hou2 ci5 gin3 dou2 me1 dak6 bit6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他轉過頭望向窗外，似乎看到了什麼特別的東西。
examples.english_sentence: He turned his head to look out the window, as if he saw something unusual.

mandarin_meaning: 车轮碾过地面留下的痕迹；比喻前人的教训或既有的模式（如“重蹈覆辙”）
english_meaning: rut; wheel track left on the ground; figuratively, a precedent or pattern (as in the idiom 'repeat the same mistake')
explanation_mandarin: 「轍」指車輪在地面上壓出來的痕跡。也常用作比喻，表示前人的失誤或可循的軌跡（如成語「重蹈覆轍」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the grooves or tracks left by wheels on the ground. It is also used metaphorically to refer to precedents or past mistakes to be avoided (e.g., the idiom 'repeat the same mistake').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度條泥路滿佈車轍，好難行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 tiu4 nei4 lou6 mun5 bou3 ce1 zek3, hou2 naan4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的泥路满是车辙，很难走。
examples.english_sentence: The dirt road here is full of ruts; it's hard to walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好重蹈覆轍，呢次要改變做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cung4 dou2 fuk1 zek3, ni1 ci3 jiu3 goi2 bin3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要重蹈覆辙，这次要改变做法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't repeat the same mistake; this time we need to change our approach.

mandarin_meaning: 轎；（合成詞）轎車（指轎子或轎型汽車）
english_meaning: sedan chair; palanquin (also appears in compounds like 'sedan car')
explanation_mandarin: 指傳統用來抬人、特別在婚禮或迎親時使用的轎子。現代亦常見於合成詞如「轎車」，指一般乘用轎型汽車。
explanation_english: Refers to a traditional sedan chair or palanquin used to carry a person, especially in weddings or ceremonial occasions. In modern usage it appears in compounds such as '轎車' (sedan car).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時結婚嗰陣，新娘會坐花轎出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 git3 fan1 go2 zan6, san1 noeng4 wui5 zo6 faa1 giu2 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前結婚的時候，新娘會坐花轎出門。
examples.english_sentence: In the past when getting married, the bride would leave seated in a flower-adorned sedan chair.

mandarin_meaning: 轎夫（抬轎子的人）
english_meaning: palanquin carrier; sedan-chair bearer (a person who carries a sedan chair)
explanation_mandarin: 指抬轎子、搬運轎子的工人或人員，常見於傳統婚禮、廟會或古代社會情境中。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who carries a palanquin/sedan chair. Commonly seen in traditional weddings, temple fairs, or historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟會上有一隊轎夫表演抬轎，好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 wui6 soeng6 jau5 jat1 deoi6 giu2 fu1 biu2 jin2 toi4 giu2 hou2 zong3 gun1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟會上有一隊轎夫表演抬轎，很壯觀。
examples.english_sentence: At the temple fair there was a team of palanquin bearers performing the carrying of a sedan chair; it was spectacular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古式婚禮，新娘會坐轎，由轎夫抬入洞房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 sik1 fan1 lai5 san1 noeng4 wui5 co5 giu2 jau4 giu2 fu1 toi4 jap6 dung6 fong4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古式婚禮上，新娘會坐轎，由轎夫抬入洞房。
examples.english_sentence: At a traditional wedding, the bride would ride in a sedan chair and be carried into the bridal chamber by palanquin bearers.

mandarin_meaning: 轿车 / 私家车（四门轿式汽车）
english_meaning: sedan; private car; automobile
explanation_mandarin: 指轎式車輛，通常是四門的私家車或乘用車，用於載人。
explanation_english: Refers to a sedan-type automobile, typically a four-door private passenger car used to transport people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一部新轎車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 bou6 san1 giu2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一輛新轎車。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new sedan.

mandarin_meaning: 拟声字，表示车轮、雷声等连续的隆隆声（如“轔轔”）
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic character representing a continuous rumbling sound (e.g. wheels rolling, thunder)
explanation_mandarin: “轔”为拟声字，常用于重复形式“轔轔”，用來形容车轮滚动或类似的连续隆隆声，常见于书面或文言用法。
explanation_english: The character is an onomatopoeic term, often doubled as "轔轔", used to describe continuous rumbling noises such as rolling wheels or thunder; typically found in literary or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架馬車轔轔咁駛過嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 maa5 ce1 lan4 lan4 gam2 sai2 gwo3 lai4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 马车轔轔地驶过来。
examples.english_sentence: The cart rumbled over here.
