examples.english_sentence: Our fans often ask the author for updates, hoping they release a new chapter soon.

mandarin_meaning: 追逐月亮；比喻追求難以實現或不切實際的目標；有時也指熬夜（在夜間活動）
english_meaning: to chase the moon (literally); figuratively, to pursue something unattainable or impractical; sometimes used to mean staying up late
explanation_mandarin: 「追月」字面意思是追逐月亮。引申為追求難以達到或不切實際的理想、夢想，有時在口語中也用來形容熬夜、在夜間外出或活動。
explanation_english: Literally 'to chase the moon.' Figuratively, it denotes pursuing unattainable or impractical goals. In colloquial use it can also refer to staying up late or being out at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路夜晚出街追月，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 je6 maan5 ceot1 gaai1 zeoi1 jyut6, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些小孩晚上出门追月，很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The kids went out at night to chase the moon and were very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日追月，成日追啲唔可能實現嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zeoi1 jyut6, sing4 jat6 zeoi1 di1 m4 ho2 nang4 sat6 jin6 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在追求不可能實現的夢想。
examples.english_sentence: He is always chasing dreams that are impossible to achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔好再追月啦，早啲訓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zeoi1 jyut6 laa1, zou2 di1 fan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚別再熬夜了，早点睡吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stay up late again tonight; go to bed earlier.

mandarin_meaning: 追本溯源 (zhuī běn sù yuán) — 追溯事物的根源或起因
english_meaning: To trace back to the origin or root cause; to investigate the source of something
explanation_mandarin: 追本溯源：追溯事物的根本、来源或起因，探究本源以便找出真正的問題或原因。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to trace something back to its origin or root cause; to investigate the fundamental source in order to find the real problem or reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，我哋要追本溯源，唔好淨係應付表面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeoi1 bun2 suk1 jyun4, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 jing3 fu6 biu2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，我们要追本溯源，不要只应付表面。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, we need to trace it back to its origins, not just deal with the surface.

mandarin_meaning: 追查（追蹤、調查）
english_meaning: to investigate; to look into; to trace (the details/origin of something)
explanation_mandarin: 指對某事或某人的來龍去脈、責任或真相進行追蹤、查證或調查。
explanation_english: To follow up on, trace, or examine the details, origins, responsibilities, or truth of an incident or matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方會繼續追查案件嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 wui5 gai3 zuk6 zeoi1 caa4 on3 gin6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方會繼續追查案件的來龍去脈。
examples.english_sentence: The police will continue to investigate the background and details of the case.

mandarin_meaning: 追杀 (zhuīshā)：追赶并杀害；也可比喻紧追不放或连续攻击（例如在游戏中）
english_meaning: to pursue and kill; to hunt down; figuratively, to pursue relentlessly or repeatedly attack (e.g., in gaming)
explanation_mandarin: 「追殺」字面意思是追赶并杀害。口語或網絡語境中常用來形容緊追不放、連續攻擊或在遊戲裡反覆擊殺對手（gank/kill）。
explanation_english: Literally 'pursue and kill.' In colloquial or online contexts it often means to pursue relentlessly, repeatedly attack, or in gaming to repeatedly kill or hunt down opponents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊戲入面我哋不停追殺對手，最後贏咗一場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 ngo5 dei6 bat1 ting4 zeoi1 saat3 deoi3 sau2, zeoi3 hau6 jing4 zo2 jat1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在遊戲裡我們不斷追殺對手，最後贏了一場。
examples.english_sentence: In the game we kept hunting down and killing the opponents, and eventually won a match.

mandarin_meaning: 追求 (zhuīqiú)
english_meaning: to pursue; to seek; to court (romantically)
explanation_mandarin: 表示努力尋求或追逐某種目標、理想、事物或感情（如追求事業、追求完美、追求愛情）。常用作動詞。
explanation_english: Indicates striving to obtain or attain something (a goal, ideal, object, or romantic interest). Commonly used as a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直追求完美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 zeoi1 kau4 jyun4 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直追求完美。
examples.english_sentence: He has always pursued perfection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢追緊嗰個女仔已經好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi1 gan2 go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 ji5 ging1 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他追求那个女孩已经很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been pursuing that girl for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺追求學術上好有熱誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zeoi1 kau4 hok6 seot6 soeng6 hou2 jau5 jit6 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在追求学术方面很有热忱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very passionate about pursuing academia.

mandarin_meaning: 追溯；追查到（某事的來源或發生時間）
english_meaning: to trace back; to investigate or trace to an origin or earlier time
explanation_mandarin: 表示回溯或追查事物的來源、根源或發生時間，常用於研究、調查或法律語境中。
explanation_english: Used to indicate tracing back or investigating the origin, source, or time of occurrence; commonly used in research, investigation, or legal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告追溯到十年前嘅事件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zeoi1 sou3 dou3 sap6 nin4 cin4 ge3 si6 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告追溯到十年前的事件。
examples.english_sentence: This report traces back to events from ten years ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要追溯呢個問題，你要睇返舊帳簿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zeoi1 sou3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, nei5 jiu3 tai2 faan1 gau6 zoeng3 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要追溯这个问题，你要查看旧账簿。
examples.english_sentence: To trace this issue, you need to look through the old ledgers.

mandarin_meaning: 追溯力 / 可追溯性
english_meaning: traceability; the ability to trace back (events, origins, history)
explanation_mandarin: 指系統、記錄或流程能夠回溯、查證過去來源或發生過程的能力，常用於供應鏈、記錄管理、法律追溯等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability of a system, record, or process to trace back and verify past origins or events; commonly used for supply chains, record-keeping, legal retroactivity, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個供應鏈系統要有高嘅追溯力，先至可以快啲搵出問題來源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 jing3 lin6 tung2 jiu3 jau5 gou1 ge3 zeoi1 suk1 lik6, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 wan2 ceot1 man6 tai4 loi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個供應鏈系統要有高的追溯力，才能快速找出問題來源。
examples.english_sentence: This supply-chain system needs strong traceability so it can quickly find the source of problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲紀錄要保持完整先有足夠嘅追溯力，否則難以查返過去發生過啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 gei3 luk6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 jyun4 zing6 sin1 jau5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 zeoi1 suk1 lik6, fau2 zik6 naan4 ji5 caa4 faan1 gwo3 heoi3 faat3 sang1 gwo3 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的紀錄要保持完整才有足夠的追溯力，否則難以查回過去發生了什麼。
examples.english_sentence: Your records must be kept complete to have sufficient traceability; otherwise it's hard to trace what happened in the past.

mandarin_meaning: 追求瘦身／變瘦
english_meaning: to pursue being thin; to try to lose weight
explanation_mandarin: 「追瘦」是粵語口語或潮語，意思是刻意追求瘦身或減重，通常指透過節食、增強運動等方法想變瘦，有時帶有過度注重外表或不健康減重的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to actively pursue being thin or to try to lose weight, usually via dieting or exercise; it can imply an excessive focus on appearance or unhealthy weight-loss behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家好追瘦，成日去做 gym 同埋節食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 zeoi1 sau3, sing4 jat6 heoi3 zou6 gym tung4maai4 zit3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在很追求瘦身，經常去健身和節食。
examples.english_sentence: He's really trying to be thin lately; he often goes to the gym and diets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日追瘦，健康先係最重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zeoi1 sau3, gin6 hong1 sin1 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要總是追求變瘦，健康才是最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't constantly chase thinness; health is the most important.

mandarin_meaning: 追究 (追查、追问、追讨责任或原因)
english_meaning: to investigate thoroughly; to pursue or hold someone/accountability; to look into the cause of something
explanation_mandarin: 表示對事情的原因進行調查或追查某人的責任，常用於追查真相或追討責任。
explanation_english: Used to indicate investigating the cause of something or holding someone responsible; commonly used for probing the truth or assigning accountability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會追究嗰位員工嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 zeoi1 gau3 go2 wai6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會追究那位員工的責任。
examples.english_sentence: The company will hold that employee accountable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再追究過去嘅錯誤，向前望啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 zeoi1 gau3 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 co3 ng6, hoeng3 cin4 mong6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再追究過去的錯誤，向前看吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep dwelling on past mistakes; look forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方會追究失竊案嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 wui5 zeoi1 gau3 sat1 cit3 on3 ge3 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方會追究失竊案件的原因。
examples.english_sentence: The police will investigate the cause of the theft case.

mandarin_meaning: 追缉（追捕、缉拿）
english_meaning: to pursue and capture (a suspect or criminal); to hunt down
explanation_mandarin: 指追捕、缉拿罪犯或嫌疑人，常用於警方對逃犯的追查行動。
explanation_english: Refers to pursuing and apprehending criminals or suspects; commonly used to describe police actions to hunt down fugitives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方繼續追緝罪犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gai3 zuk6 zeoi1 zap1 zeoi6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方繼續追缉罪犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police continue to hunt down the criminal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋而家俾警方追緝緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 bei2 ging2 fong1 zeoi1 zap1 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們現在正被警方追缉。
examples.english_sentence: They are currently being pursued by the police.

mandarin_meaning: 追討（追索、討回欠款或應得款項）
english_meaning: to demand or claim back money or items owed; to pursue collection
explanation_mandarin: 指向欠款方或相關對象追索、討回欠款或應得的款項或補償，亦可泛指要求對方償還或交付應有的東西。
explanation_english: To demand repayment or reclaim money or items owed; commonly used for pursuing debt collection or asking someone to return what they owe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 債主已經開始追討佢嘅欠債。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaai3 zyu2 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 zeoi1 tou2 keoi5 ge3 him3 zaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 債主已經開始追討他的欠債。
examples.english_sentence: The creditor has already started to demand repayment of his debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司追討逾期未交嘅款項。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 zeoi1 tou2 jyu4 kei4 mei6 gaau1 ge3 fun2 hong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司追討逾期未交的款項。
examples.english_sentence: The company is collecting overdue unpaid payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔還錢，我哋會追討。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 waan4 cin2, ngo5 dei6 wui5 zeoi1 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不還錢，我們會追討。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't repay, we will pursue collection.

mandarin_meaning: 追认（事后承认或批准）
english_meaning: to ratify or approve retroactively; to confirm something after the fact
explanation_mandarin: 指對已經發生的行為、決定或事實在事後加以承認或批准，具有追溯效果，常見於法律或行政語境。
explanation_english: Refers to acknowledging or approving an action, decision, or fact after it has occurred; to ratify something retroactively. Commonly used in legal or administrative contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議會最終追認咗嗰項政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 wui6 zeoi3 zung1 zeoi1 jing6 zo2 go2 hong6 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 议会最终追认了那项政策。
examples.english_sentence: The council ultimately ratified that policy.

mandarin_meaning: 追赶（zhuīgǎn），追逐、赶上
english_meaning: to chase; to pursue; to catch up with
explanation_mandarin: 表示追逐或趕上。既可指實際的追趕（例如追人或追車），也可用於比喻（例如追趕進度、追趕別人的成就）。
explanation_english: Indicates chasing or trying to catch up. Can refer to a literal pursuit (e.g., chasing a person or vehicle) or a figurative one (e.g., catching up with progress or others' achievements).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺公園追趕隻狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 gung1 jyun4 zeoi1 gon2 zek3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在公園追趕那隻狗。
examples.english_sentence: They're chasing that dog in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家要努力追趕進度，唔想落後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 nou5 lik6 zeoi1 gon2 zeon3 dou6, m4 soeng2 lok6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在要努力追趕進度，不想落後。
examples.english_sentence: I need to work hard to catch up with the schedule; I don't want to fall behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士開咗，我追趕唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 hoi1 zo2, ngo5 zeoi1 gon2 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 巴士開了，我追不上了。
examples.english_sentence: The bus left; I couldn't catch up.

mandarin_meaning: 追踪（跟踪、追查）
english_meaning: to track; to follow; to trace (including following on social media or tracking shipments)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事進行跟蹤或追查，可以指線上在社交媒體上關注／跟隨，也可以指實體上追查、追蹤貨件或可疑人員。
explanation_english: Means to follow or trace someone or something. Can refer to following on social media or tracking/ tracing physically (e.g., shipment tracking or surveillance).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺 Instagram 上追蹤咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 Instagram soeng6 zeoi1 zung1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在 Instagram 上追蹤了他。
examples.english_sentence: I followed him on Instagram.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用追蹤號碼查你個包裹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 zeoi1 zung1 hou6 maa5 caa4 nei5 go3 baau1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用追踪号码查询你的包裹。
examples.english_sentence: You can use the tracking number to check your package.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺街度追蹤可疑嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zeoi1 zung1 ho2 ji4 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在街上跟踪可疑的人。
examples.english_sentence: The police were tracking the suspicious person on the street.

mandarin_meaning: 跟車太近；緊跟在車輛後面（也可比喻趕進度、追趕落後的進程）
english_meaning: to tailgate (follow a vehicle too closely); figuratively, to rush to catch up or try to make up lost ground
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指駕車時緊貼前車的車尾，屬於危險駕駛行為；引申為趕進度、急於追趕落後的工作或事項。
explanation_english: Literally to follow another vehicle very closely (tailgating), a dangerous driving behavior; figuratively used to mean rushing to catch up or making up for something you're behind on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行高速嗰陣唔好追車尾，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 gou1cuk1 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 zeoi1 ce1 mei5, hou2 ngai4him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在高速公路上不要跟車太近，很危險。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tailgate on the highway; it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家追車尾緊，要完成幾日落後嘅功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4gaa1 zeoi1 ce1 mei5 gan2, jiu3 jyun4sing4 gei2 jat6 lok6hau6 ge3 gung1fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在在趕進度，要把落後幾天的功課補完。
examples.english_sentence: I'm rushing to catch up now; I have to finish the homework I'm behind on.

mandarin_meaning: 追述（zhuīshù）：回溯並敘述、陳述過去的事情
english_meaning: to recount; to narrate or state past events (often by tracing back over what happened)
explanation_mandarin: 表示回顧過去並將發生的事逐一敘述或陳述，常用於報告或記錄中。
explanation_english: Refers to looking back and narrating past events, often used in reports or records to give an account of what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺報告入面追述咗當日嘅經過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 zeoi1 seot6 zo2 dong1 jat6 ge3 ging1 gwo3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在報告中追述了當天的經過。
examples.english_sentence: He recounted the events of that day in the report.

mandarin_meaning: 追赶；追求（可以是字面或比喻用法）
english_meaning: to chase; to pursue (literally or figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 表示追赶某人或某物，或比喻为达成目标、追求利益、理想等而努力。可用于字面或比喻语境。
explanation_english: Indicates chasing someone or something physically, or figuratively pursuing goals, fame, profit, dreams, etc. Used both literally and figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個小朋友喺公園追逐蝴蝶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 zeoi1 zuk6 wu4 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个小朋友在公园追逐蝴蝶。
examples.english_sentence: Two kids are chasing butterflies in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日追逐名利，冇時間享受生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zeoi1 zuk6 ming4 lei6, mou5 si4 gaan3 hoeng2 sau6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在追逐名利，没时间享受生活。
examples.english_sentence: He is always chasing fame and fortune and has no time to enjoy life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年輕人應該勇敢追逐自己嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 heng1 jan4 jing1 goi1 jung5 gam2 zeoi1 zuk6 zi6 gei2 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人应该勇敢追逐自己的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: Young people should bravely pursue their dreams.

mandarin_meaning: 追随（zhuīsuí），跟随、附和、追赶并追随某人或某种潮流
english_meaning: to follow; to follow closely; to accompany; to emulate
explanation_mandarin: 表示跟着、追赶或附和某人、某種觀點或潮流，常用於描述追趕潮流、追隨領袖或模仿他人的行為。
explanation_english: Means to follow, accompany, or adhere to someone, a viewpoint, or a trend; commonly used to describe following trends, leaders, or imitating others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鐘意追隨潮流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 zeoi1 ceoi4 ciu4 lau4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢追随潮流。
examples.english_sentence: He likes following trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想成日追隨人哋嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sing4 jat6 zeoi1 ceoi4 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想总是追随别人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to always follow others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人會追隨領袖嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 zeoi1 ceoi4 ling5 zau6 ge3 kyut3 ding6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人会追随领袖的决定。
examples.english_sentence: Some people follow the leader's decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 追風（字面：追趕風；口語：追求刺激或追潮流）
english_meaning: literally 'chase the wind'; colloquially, to seek thrills, ride fast, or chase trends/fashions
explanation_mandarin: 「追風」字面意思是追趕風。在口語或俚語中常用來形容追求刺激、騎車飛馳、或追潮流與新鮮事物。
explanation_english: Literally 'to chase the wind.' Colloquially used to describe seeking thrills, riding fast (e.g., on motorcycles/bikes), or chasing trends and fashions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日騎電單車出街追風，次次都嚇到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 kei4 din6 daan1 ce1 ceot1 gaai1 zeoi1 fung1, ci3 ci3 dou1 haak3 dou3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常騎摩托車出去追風，每次都讓我嚇一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He often rides his motorcycle out to race; every time he scares me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係追風，諗下將來嘅計劃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zeoi1 fung1, lam2 haa5 zoeng1 loi4 ge3 gai3 waak6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只追風，要想想未來的計劃。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just chase trends/thrills; think about your future plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 追風其實有兩個意思：字面上係追趕風，口語上係追求刺激或潮流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi1 fung1 kei4 sat6 jau5 loeng5 go3 ji3 si1: zi6 min6 soeng6 hai6 zeoi1 gon2 fung1, hau2 jyu5 soeng6 hai6 zeoi1 kau4 cik1 gik1 waak6 ciu4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 追風其實有兩層意思：字面上是追趕風，口語上是追求刺激或潮流。
examples.english_sentence: '追風' actually has two meanings: literally chasing the wind, and colloquially pursuing thrills or trends.

mandarin_meaning: 吸食海洛英（用錫紙燒熱後吸入毒品蒸氣）；亦可指香港電影《追龍》
english_meaning: to inhale heroin fumes (chasing the dragon); also the title of a Hong Kong crime film ('Chasing the Dragon')
explanation_mandarin: 「追龍」為俚語，原指用錫紙燒熱海洛英並吸入蒸氣以吸食毒品；在日常語境亦可因電影名稱被引用為專有名詞。
explanation_english: A slang term meaning to inhale heroin vapour by heating it on foil ('chasing the dragon'); it is also known as the title of a Hong Kong crime film and may appear as a proper noun in that context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人捉到喺屋企追龍，結果畀警察拘捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3 hai2 uk1 kei5 zeoi1 lung4, git3 gwo2 bei2 ging2 caat3 kau1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人發現於家中吸毒（追龍），結果被警方拘捕。
examples.english_sentence: He was found using drugs (chasing the dragon) at home and was arrested by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去睇咗套電影《追龍》，演員表現得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 zo2 tou3 din6 jing2 "zeoi1 lung4", jin2 jyun4 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去看了電影《追龍》，演員表現得很好。
examples.english_sentence: We went to see the movie 'Chasing the Dragon'; the actors performed very well.

jyutping: N/A (罕見，現代廣東話中無常用讀音)
mandarin_meaning: 罕見字，現代粵語中少用，含義與用法不詳，主要見於古文或人名地名中
english_meaning: A rare/archaic Chinese character; not used in modern Cantonese; meaning and usage uncertain (mostly appears in classical texts or in proper names)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 無固定詞性（罕見字符／文言用字）
partOfSpeech_english: rare/archival character (no fixed part of speech)
explanation_mandarin: 「迾」為一個較罕見的漢字，現代粵語口語和書面語中很少使用。此字多出現在古文、方志或作人名、地名用字，缺乏穩定的現代發音與常見語義，使用時需依上下文或參考古籍。
explanation_english: The character "迾" is rare and largely archaic. It is seldom used in modern Cantonese speech or writing. The character typically appears in classical texts or as part of personal/place names. It lacks a stable modern pronunciation or widely agreed meaning; interpretation depends on context or historical sources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「迾」喺現代廣東話好少見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 '迾' hai6 jin6 doi6 gwong2 dung1 waa6 hou2 siu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“迾”在现代粤语中很少见。
examples.english_sentence: The character "迾" is rarely seen in modern Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 退 (tuì)：後退、撤退、退還（錢或物）、退出、退學等
english_meaning: to retreat, to withdraw, to return (goods/money), to refund, to quit/leave
explanation_mandarin: 表示向後移動或撤回，也可表示退還貨款、退出某個職位或學校等行為。用於物理動作（退後）、商業行為（退貨、退錢）或狀態改變（退學、退出）。
explanation_english: Indicates moving back or withdrawing; can also mean returning goods or money, quitting or leaving (e.g. dropping out). Used for physical retreat, refunds/returns, or leaving a position or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫唔啱，我想退貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 m4 aam1, ngo5 soeng2 teoi3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件襯衫不合適，我想退貨。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt doesn't fit; I want to return it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔滿意，可以退錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 mun5 ji3, ho2 ji5 teoi3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不滿意，可以退款。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied, you can get a refund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定退學，唔再喺嗰間大學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 teoi3 hok6, m4 zoi6 hai2 go2 gaan1 daai6 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他決定退學，不再在那所大學讀書。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to drop out; he's no longer studying at that university.

mandarin_meaning: 退一步（让步；后退一步）
english_meaning: to take a step back; to make a concession; to compromise
explanation_mandarin: 表示在争执或冲突中让步、妥协，也可指字面上后退一步。常用于劝人收敛立场以求和解或避免冲突。
explanation_english: Indicates making a concession or stepping back (literally or figuratively) to ease a conflict or reach a compromise. Commonly used to advise someone to soften their stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家唔好再爭啦，退一步，講吓和氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 m4 hou2 zoi3 zang1 laa1, teoi3 jat1 bou6, gong2 haa5 wo4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家不要再争了，退一步，讲点和气吧。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone stop arguing — take a step back and be a bit more conciliatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你肯退一步，我哋就可以達成協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hang2 teoi3 jat1 bou6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 ho2 ji5 daat6 sing4 hip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你肯退一步，我们就可以达成协议。
examples.english_sentence: If you're willing to give a little, we can reach an agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向後退一步先，等我行過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 hau6 teoi3 jat1 bou6 sin1, dang2 ngo5 hang4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他先往后退一步，让我过去。
examples.english_sentence: He stepped back first so I could pass.

mandarin_meaning: 退一步說；就算讓步
english_meaning: for the sake of argument; conceding a worst-case scenario; even if we make a big concession
explanation_mandarin: 表示作出極大讓步或假設最不利的情況，常用來引出讓步性的評述或結論，相當於“退一步說”或“就算如此”。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a concession or a hypothetical worst-case scenario—'even if we concede that...' or 'for the sake of argument.' It signals a tentative allowance before making a point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退一萬步講，你都唔應該咁樣講佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 jat1 maan6 bou6 gong2, nei5 dou1 m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 joeng6 gong2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算退一步說，你也不應該這樣說他。
examples.english_sentence: Even if we concede that, you still shouldn't speak to him like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退一萬步講，如果真係咁，我哋都要諗清楚後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 jat1 maan6 bou6 gong2, jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 gam2, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退一步說，如果真是這樣，我們也要想清楚後果。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of argument, if that's really the case, we still need to think through the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退一萬步講，就算佢講得啱，你都未必要支持佢嘅做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 jat1 maan6 bou6 gong2, zau6 syun3 keoi5 gong2 dak1 aap3, nei5 dou1 mei6 bat1 jiu3 zi1 ci4 keoi5 ge3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退一步說，就算他說得對，你未必要支持他的做法。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of argument, even if he's right, you don't necessarily have to support his approach.

mandarin_meaning: 退伍 (tuì wǔ)：退出现役、解除兵役或离开部队
english_meaning: to be discharged from military service; to leave the armed forces
explanation_mandarin: 指軍人完成服役或因其他原因離開部隊、不再擔任現役軍人的狀態或動作。
explanation_english: Refers to a service member leaving active duty—finishing compulsory service or being formally discharged from the military.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經退伍咗，唔使返營啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 teoi3 ng5 zo2, m4 sai2 faan1 jing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經退伍了，不用回營了。
examples.english_sentence: He has already been discharged and doesn't have to return to the barracks.

mandarin_meaning: 退伍军人病（比喻）
english_meaning: veteran syndrome / "glory days" syndrome
explanation_mandarin: 「退伍军人病」原指退役軍人退役後仍保有軍中思維或行為，延伸為形容某人固守過去的光榮經歷或權威，不願接受改變或聽取他人意見，導致人際或適應上的問題（多為比喻用法）。
explanation_english: Originally referring to discharged soldiers who continue to act with military mindset, the term is used figuratively to describe someone who clings to past glories or authority, resists change, and refuses to listen to others — causing interpersonal or adaptation problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退役咗幾年，仲有啲退伍軍人病，成日以往嘅經驗自居，唔肯聽人意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3jik6 zo2 gei2 nin4, zung6 jau5 di1 teoi3 mou6 gwan1 jan4 beng6, sing4 jat6 ji5 wong6 ge3 ging1 jim6 zi6 geoi1, m4 hang2 teng1 jan4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退役好幾年，還有點退伍軍人病，總是以往日的經驗自居，不肯聽別人意見。
examples.english_sentence: He was discharged years ago but still has a bit of 'veteran syndrome' — he keeps relying on his past experience and refuses to listen to others.

mandarin_meaning: 俗稱，指退役或離開某團體後，因懷念過去、抗拒改變、誇耀往事或常提舊經驗而出現的心理或行為模式。
english_meaning: Colloquial term 'veteran syndrome' — a behavioral/psychological pattern after leaving a service or long-term group, marked by nostalgia, resistance to change, or frequently boasting about past experiences; often used jokingly or pejoratively.
explanation_mandarin: 用於非正式語境，形容退伍或離開某個長期身分的人仍沉迷於過去經歷、常念舊或不願接受新作法的言行表現。
explanation_english: Used informally to describe someone who, after leaving a long-term role (often military or another tight-knit group), clings to past experiences, frequently mentions former achievements, or resists new ways of doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講以前當兵幾勁，成日提起舊日經驗，真係有啲退伍軍人症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 ji5 cin4 dong3 bing1 gei2 ging6, sing4 jat6 tai4 hei2 gau6 jat6 ging1 jim6, zan1 hai6 jau5 di1 teoi3 ng5 gwan1 jan4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常說以前當兵多了不起，老是提起過去的經驗，真的有點退伍軍人症。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps talking about how impressive he was in the military and constantly brings up old experiences — he really has a bit of 'veteran syndrome'.

mandarin_meaning: 退休
english_meaning: to retire; retirement
explanation_mandarin: 指離開工作崗位，不再從事有薪職務，通常因年齡或工齡達到規定而停止工作，也可指退休這一狀態或行為。
explanation_english: To leave one's job and stop paid employment, typically after reaching a certain age or length of service; can refer to the act of retiring or the state of retirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年已經退休喇，打算環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1nin4 ji5ging1 teoi3jau1 laa3, daa2syun3 waan4jau4 sai3gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年已經退休了，打算環遊世界。
examples.english_sentence: He already retired this year and plans to travel around the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會為長期員工提供退休金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 wui5 wai6 coeng4kei4 jyun4gung1 tai4gung1 teoi3jau1gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會為長期員工提供退休金。
examples.english_sentence: The company will provide pensions for long-term employees.

mandarin_meaning: 退休金（tuìxiū jīn）
english_meaning: pension; retirement pay
explanation_mandarin: 指個人退休後由政府、公司或保險機構按期或一次性支付的金錢，用以保障退休生活。
explanation_english: Money paid to a person after retirement by the government, an employer, or an insurance scheme—typically periodic payments or a lump sum to support living expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗三十年，公司畀咗佢豐厚嘅退休金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 saam1 sap6 nin4, gung1 si1 bei2 zo2 keoi5 fung1 hau6 ge3 teoi3 jau1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作了三十年，公司給了他可觀的退休金。
examples.english_sentence: He worked for thirty years; the company gave him a substantial pension.

mandarin_meaning: 退位 / 让位（放弃君位或职务）
english_meaning: to abdicate; to step down (from a throne, position, or office)
explanation_mandarin: 表示放棄君位或正式職務，將權力或位置交給他人。可用於君主退位，也可用作比喻，指高層離職或讓位。
explanation_english: Means to give up a throne or an official position and hand power or the post to someone else. Used for monarchs abdicating and metaphorically for leaders stepping down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 國王被逼退位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwok3 wong4 bei6 bik1 teoi3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 国王被逼退位。
examples.english_sentence: The king was forced to abdicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司主席宣布退位，由副主席接任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zyu2 zik6 syun1 bou3 teoi3 wai6, jau4 fu3 zyu2 zik6 zip3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司主席宣布退位，由副主席接任。
examples.english_sentence: The company's chairman announced he would step down, and the vice chairman took over.

mandarin_meaning: 退位让贤
english_meaning: to abdicate/step down in favor of a wiser or more competent successor
explanation_mandarin: 指君主或掌權者退讓自己的位子，把權力讓給有德或有才能的人，常用於古代或比喻性語境。
explanation_english: Refers to a monarch or person in power relinquishing their position and handing authority to a more virtuous or capable individual; often used historically or metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果皇帝退位讓賢，國家會更加穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 wong4 dai3 teoi3 wai6 joeng6 jin4, gwok3 gaa1 wui5 gang1 gaa1 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果皇帝退位让贤，国家会更加稳定。
examples.english_sentence: If the emperor abdicates in favor of a wiser successor, the country will be more stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司董事長決定退位讓賢，將位子交畀年輕人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 dung2 si6 zoeng2 kyut3 ding6 teoi3 wai6 joeng6 jin4, zoeng1 wai2 zi2 gaau1 bei2 nin4 hing1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司董事长决定退位让贤，把位子交给年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: The company chairman decided to step down and let a younger person take over.

mandarin_meaning: 退修 (tuìxiū) — 進行靜修、培訓或調養的退隱活動
english_meaning: retreat (for study, training, spiritual reflection, or recuperation); to go on a retreat
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或團體暫時離開日常生活或工作環境，進行靜修、反思、訓練或休養的活動；可作動詞（去退修）或名詞（一次退修）使用。
explanation_english: Refers to an activity in which an individual or group temporarily withdraws from daily life or work to engage in quiet study, reflection, training, or recuperation; can be used as a verb ('to go on a retreat') or a noun ('a retreat').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排員工去山上退修，加強團隊合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 jyun4 gung1 heoi3 saan1 soeng6 teoi3 sau1, gaa1 koeng4 tyun4 deoi2 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司安排员工去山上退修，加强团队合作。
examples.english_sentence: The company arranged for staff to go on a retreat in the mountains to strengthen teamwork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教會每年都會舉辦退修營，讓大家反思信仰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau1 wui6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 geoi2 baan6 teoi3 sau1 jing4, joeng6 daai6 gaa1 faan2 si1 seon3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教会每年都会举办退修营，让大家反思信仰。
examples.english_sentence: The church holds a retreat every year to let people reflect on their faith.

mandarin_meaning: 退出 (tuìchū)
english_meaning: to withdraw; to quit; to exit; to leave
explanation_mandarin: 表示從某個組織、活動、職務、比賽或系統中離開或停止參與，也可指結束程式或登出帳戶。
explanation_english: Indicates withdrawing from an organization, activity, position, competition, or leaving/stopping participation; can also mean exiting a program or logging out of an account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我決定退出嗰個討論組。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 teoi3 ceot1 go2 go3 tou2 leon6 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我決定退出那個討論組。
examples.english_sentence: I've decided to leave that discussion group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要退出程式，請按右上角嘅「退出」鍵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 teoi3 ceot1 cing4 sik1, cing2 on3 jau6 soeng6 gok3 ge3 teoi3 ceot1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要退出程式，請按右上角的「退出」鍵。
examples.english_sentence: To exit the application, please press the 'Exit' button at the top right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為私人理由退出比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 si1 jan4 lei5 jau6 teoi3 ceot1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為私人理由退出比賽。
examples.english_sentence: He withdrew from the competition for personal reasons.

mandarin_meaning: 退化 (tuìhuà)：功能、能力或狀態變差或倒退
english_meaning: degenerate; regress; deteriorate; atrophy
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種功能、能力、結構或發展方向出現下降或倒退，可用於生物學上的退化（如器官或肌肉）或比喻技能、水平、社會現象等變差。
explanation_english: Indicates a decline or regression in function, ability, structure, or development. Can refer to biological degeneration (e.g., atrophy of organs or muscles) or metaphorically to skills, levels, or social phenomena deteriorating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲技術如果唔更新，就會退化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gei6 seot6 jyu4 gwo2 m4 gung1 san1, zau6 wui5 teoi3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些技术如果不更新，就会退化。
examples.english_sentence: These skills/technologies will deteriorate if they are not updated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人嘅肌肉如果唔鍛鍊會退化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 ge3 gei1 juk6 jyu4 gwo2 m4 dyun3 lin6 wui5 teoi3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人的肌肉如果不锻炼会退化。
examples.english_sentence: An elderly person's muscles will atrophy if they don't exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢嘅英文水平退化咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 jing1 man4 seoi2 ping4 teoi3 faa3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他的英文水平退化了。
examples.english_sentence: I feel his English level has deteriorated.

mandarin_meaning: 退却 / 退缩；（有时）拒绝（提议或请求）
english_meaning: to retreat; to shrink back; to decline (an offer)
explanation_mandarin: 表示退后、退缩或婉拒某個提議或要求，也可指在困難或威脅面前不前進。
explanation_english: Expresses retreating or shrinking back, or politely declining an offer or request; can also mean not advancing in the face of difficulty or threat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到隻狗就退卻咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 zek3 gau2 zau6 teoi3 koek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到那只狗就退缩了。
examples.english_sentence: He recoiled when he saw the dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我退卻咗呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teoi3 koek3 zo2 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拒绝了这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: I turned down the job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺賽場上，佢毫不退卻，勇敢面對挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 coi3 coeng4 soeng6, keoi5 hou4 bat1 teoi3 koek3, jung5 gam2 min6 deoi3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在赛场上，他毫不退缩，勇敢面对挑战。
examples.english_sentence: On the field, he did not shrink back and bravely faced the challenge.

mandarin_meaning: 退讓；退縮；放棄立場
english_meaning: to back down; to give ground; to retreat from one's position
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，表示在爭論、談判或衝突中放棄原有立場或向對方退讓、後退。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to give up one's position or step back/retreat, commonly used in arguments, negotiations, or conflicts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好退地，堅持你嘅立場！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teoi3 dei6, gin1 ci4 nei5 ge3 laap6 coeng4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要退讓，堅持你的立場！
examples.english_sentence: Don't back down — stand your ground!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺談判期間，公司唔可以輕易退地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taam4 pun3 kei4 gaan1, gung1 si1 m4 ho2 ji5 hing1 ji6 teoi3 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在談判期間，公司不能輕易退讓。
examples.english_sentence: During negotiations, the company shouldn't easily back down.

mandarin_meaning: 退场；离开舞台或活动现场；（比喻）退出、下台
english_meaning: to exit (a stage or venue); to bow out; to withdraw or step down (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 表示離開舞台或活動現場，也可比喻被迫或自願退出某個職位或場合。
explanation_english: Indicates leaving a stage or venue; can also be used figuratively to mean withdrawing or stepping down from a position or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會接近尾聲，歌手逐一退場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui6 zip3 gan6 mei5 seng1, go1 sau2 zuk6 jat1 teoi3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会接近尾声，歌手逐一退场。
examples.english_sentence: The concert was nearing its end; the singers left the stage one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個老闆做錯嘢，終於被迫退場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lou5 baan2 zou6 co3 je5, zung1 jyu1 bei6 bok3 teoi3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板做错事，终于被迫退场。
examples.english_sentence: That boss made mistakes and was finally forced to step down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一旦發生火警，場內觀眾要有秩序退場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 daan6 faat3 saang1 fo2 ging2, coeng4 noi6 gun1 zung3 jiu3 jau5 zat1 cuk1 teoi3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一旦发生火警，场内观众要有秩序退场。
examples.english_sentence: If a fire breaks out, the audience should exit the venue in an orderly manner.

mandarin_meaning: 退婚（解除婚约/取消订婚）
english_meaning: to break off an engagement; to call off a betrothal
explanation_mandarin: 指在正式結婚前解除婚約或取消訂婚，有時也指因故退回聘禮或終止婚事的行為。
explanation_english: To terminate an engagement or cancel a betrothal before marriage; sometimes involves returning dowry items or formally ending the proposed marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為性格唔合，就退婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 sing3 gaak3 m4 hap6, zau6 teoi3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为性格不合，就退婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They broke off their engagement because their personalities didn't match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對方做咗啲唔忠誠嘅事，家人會要求退婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 fong1 zou6 zo2 di1 m4 zung1 sing4 ge3 si6, gaa1 jan4 wui5 jiu1 kau4 teoi3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果对方做了不忠诚的事，家人会要求退婚。
examples.english_sentence: If the other party was unfaithful, the family would ask to call off the engagement.

mandarin_meaning: 退学（退出學校，不再繼續上學）
english_meaning: to withdraw from or be dismissed from school; to drop out
explanation_mandarin: 從學校退出，不再繼續上學；可指學生自願退學或被學校退學（如被開除）。
explanation_english: Leaving school and no longer continuing studies; can refer to voluntarily withdrawing or being dismissed/expelled by the school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為成績差畀學校退學咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sing4 zik1 caa1 bei6 hok6 haau6 teoi3 hok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為成績差被學校退學了。
examples.english_sentence: He was expelled from school because of poor grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想讀書，打算下學期退學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 duk6 syu1, daa2 syun3 haa6 hok6 kei4 teoi3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想念書，打算下學期退學。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to study; I plan to withdraw from school next semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要退學，要先去辦理退學手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 teoi3 hok6, jiu3 sin1 heoi3 baan6 lei5 teoi3 hok6 sau2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要退學，要先去辦理退學手續。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to withdraw from school, you must first complete the withdrawal procedures.

mandarin_meaning: 退居、退到次要位置或幕後（例如退居二線）
english_meaning: to withdraw to a secondary/behind-the-scenes position; to step back from a primary role
explanation_mandarin: 表示從主要或公開的位置退下，轉為次要或幕後角色，常用於職位、名人或領導者減少公開露面或卸下部分職責的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates stepping back from a primary or public position into a secondary or behind-the-scenes role; often used when someone (e.g., a leader or celebrity) reduces public appearances or offloads responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢年紀大咗，就退居幕後，唔再出嚟做決策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nin4 gei3 daai6 zo2, zau6 teoi3 geoi1 mok6 hau6, m4 zoi6 ceot1 lai4 zou6 kyut3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年紀大了，就退居幕後，不再出面做決策。
examples.english_sentence: He's gotten older and has retreated to the background, no longer making decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲明星過咗巔峰之後，會選擇退居二線，專注幕後工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 ming4 sing1 gwo3 zo2 din1 fung1 zi1 hau6, wui5 syun2 zaak6 teoi3 geoi1 ji6 sin3, zyun1 zyu3 mok6 hau6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些明星过了巅峰之后，会选择退居二线，专注幕后工作。
examples.english_sentence: Some celebrities, after passing their peak, choose to step back to the second line and focus on behind-the-scenes work.

mandarin_meaning: 退席 / 离席、退出会议或场合
english_meaning: to leave one's seat; to withdraw/leave (a meeting, event, or stage)
explanation_mandarin: 「退席」字面意思是離開座位；在廣東話和口語中常用來表示在會議、辯論、表演或社交場合中因不滿、抗議或身體不適而離開或退出場面。可作為正式或非正式的行為描述。
explanation_english: Literally 'to withdraw from a seat.' In Cantonese it commonly means leaving or withdrawing from a meeting, debate, performance, or social event — often because of dissatisfaction, protest, or discomfort. It can be used in both formal and informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議進行到一半，佢因為唔滿意就退席咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 zeon3 hang4 dou3 jat1 bun3, keoi5 jan1 wai6 m4 mun5 ji3 zau6 teoi3 zik6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议进行到一半，他因为不满意就退席了。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting was halfway through when he, unhappy with the proceedings, walked out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 表演者覺得安排唔妥，最後退席，唔再上台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: biu2 jin2 ze2 gok3 dak1 on1 paai4 m4 to2, zeoi3 hau6 teoi3 zik6, m4 zoi3 soeng5 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 表演者觉得安排不妥，最后退席，不再上台。
examples.english_sentence: The performer found the arrangements inappropriate and ultimately left, refusing to go on stage again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺派對上話唔舒服就退席，大家都覺得尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 paai3 deoi6 soeng6 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6 zau6 teoi3 zik6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 gaan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在派对上说不舒服就离席，大家都觉得尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wasn't feeling well and left the party, which made everyone feel awkward.

mandarin_meaning: 退出法庭 / 離開庭審
english_meaning: to withdraw from the courtroom; to walk out of a trial/hearing
explanation_mandarin: 在法庭或庭審過程中，當事人、律師或其他參與者離開法庭或退出庭審程序，常用以表示抗議、不滿或放棄繼續出席。
explanation_english: In a courtroom context, it means that a party, lawyer, or participant leaves the courtroom or withdraws from the proceedings, often as a form of protest, objection, or to stop participating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師覺得法官有偏頗，於是帶同當事人退庭抗議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 si1 gok3 dak1 faat3 gun1 jau5 pin1 po2, jyu1 si6 daai3 tung4 dong1 si6 jan4 teoi3 ting4 kong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律師覺得法官有偏頗，於是帶同當事人退庭抗議。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer felt the judge was biased, so he led the client to walk out of the courtroom in protest.

mandarin_meaning: 退役（從軍隊或某職務退下，不再服役或不再從事該職業）
english_meaning: to retire or be discharged from service (especially military); to retire from a profession or role
explanation_mandarin: 表示結束服役或從某個職務、崗位退下，不再繼續擔任該職務或參與該行業。
explanation_english: Means to end one's service or step down from a position—commonly used for leaving military service or retiring from a professional role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年宣佈退役，唔會再打職業比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1nin4 syun1bou3 teoi3jik6, m4 wui5 zoi3 daa2 zik1jip6 bei2coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年宣佈退役，不會再打職業比賽。
examples.english_sentence: He announced his retirement this year and will no longer play in professional competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係退役軍人，宜家做保安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 teoi3jik6 gwan1jan4, ji4gaa1 zou6 bou2on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是退役軍人，現在做保安。
examples.english_sentence: He is a retired soldier and now works as a security guard.

mandarin_meaning: 退后；后退；退让
english_meaning: to step back; to move backward; to retreat; to back down
explanation_mandarin: 表示在空間上向後移動，或在立場、態度上退讓、後退或退縮。
explanation_english: Indicates moving backward in space, or retreating/backing down in terms of position, stance, or attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你退後一點，唔好企得太近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teoi3 hau6 jat1 dim2, m4 hou2 kei5 dak1 taai3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你退后一点，不要站得太近。
examples.english_sentence: Step back a little, don't stand too close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺談判時退後咗，接受咗對方嘅條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 taam4 pun3 si4 teoi3 hau6 zo2, zip3 sau6 zo2 deoi3 fong1 ge3 tiu4 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在谈判时退让了，接受了对方的条件。
examples.english_sentence: He backed down during the negotiations and accepted the other side's terms.

mandarin_meaning: 退房 (tuìfáng) — 退還房間、辦理退房手續；在房地產語境下也可指取消或解除購房/租房的交易
english_meaning: to check out (of a hotel); to vacate a room; (in some real-estate contexts) to cancel/withdraw from a property transaction
explanation_mandarin: 通常指在酒店或租住房屋時辦理離開手續、退還房間並結清費用的行為。在房地產或買賣語境中，有時也用來指取消購房或解除合約（需視合約條款而定）。
explanation_english: Commonly means to check out: complete the formalities to return a room (hotel or rented accommodation) and settle the bill. In real-estate contexts it can also be used to mean cancelling or withdrawing from a property transaction, depending on contract terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早十點要退房，仲未執好行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1zou2 sap6 dim2 jiu3 teoi3 fong4, zung6 mei6 zap1 hou2 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明早十點要退房，還沒整理好行李。
examples.english_sentence: I have to check out at 10 AM tomorrow; I haven't packed my luggage yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓之後發現有問題，如果想退房要睇返合約條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau4 zi1 hau6 faat3 jin6 jau5 man6 tai4, jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 teoi3 fong4 jiu3 tai2 faan1 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買房之後發現問題，如果想退房要看合約條款。
examples.english_sentence: After buying the flat we found issues; if you want to cancel the purchase you need to check the contract terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到期我會退房，唔會續租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 kei4 ngo5 wui5 teoi3 fong4, m4 wui5 zuk6 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到期我會退房，不會續租。
examples.english_sentence: When the lease expires I'll move out; I won't renew the lease.

mandarin_meaning: 退换（货）/退货并换货
english_meaning: to return and exchange (goods); to return or exchange items
explanation_mandarin: 表示把已購買的商品退回給賣方，並換取其他商品或要求退款。
explanation_english: To return purchased goods to the seller and either exchange them for other items or request a refund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有問題，我要去退換。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 man6 tai4, ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 teoi3 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫有问题，我要去退换。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has a problem; I need to go return/exchange it.

mandarin_meaning: 退款 (tuìkuǎn)：退还已支付的款项
english_meaning: refund; to refund (money returned to a buyer)
explanation_mandarin: 指将已收取的款项退还給顧客，既可作動詞（退還錢款），亦可作名詞（退還的金額）。
explanation_english: To return money that was previously paid; can be used as a verb (to refund) or as a noun (the refunded amount).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件貨有問題，我想申請退款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 fo3 jau5 man6 tai4, ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 teoi3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件货有问题，我想申请退款。
examples.english_sentence: This item has a problem; I want to apply for a refund.

mandarin_meaning: 退步 (tuìbù)，能力、水平或情況變差或後退
english_meaning: to regress; to deteriorate; to fall behind; (literally) to step back
explanation_mandarin: 表示能力、水平或情況比之前惡化或退後，也可指字面上的向後退。
explanation_english: Indicates a decline or regression in ability, level, or situation; can also be used literally to mean stepping backward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢幾年打波嘅水平有啲退步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 gei2 nin4 daa2 bo1 ge3 seoi2ping4 jau5 di1 teoi3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这几年打篮球的水平有些退步。
examples.english_sentence: His basketball skills have declined somewhat over the past few years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔努力學，中文會退步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4gwo2 m4 nou5lik6 hok6, zung1man4 wui5 teoi3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不努力学习，中文会退步。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't study hard, your Chinese will get worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅效率比去年退步咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ge3 haau6leot6 bei2 heoi3nin4 teoi3 bou6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的效率比去年退步了。
examples.english_sentence: The company's efficiency has declined compared to last year.

mandarin_meaning: 退潮 / 潮退；（比喻）衰退、減弱
english_meaning: ebb tide; to ebb; decline or waning (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指海水由漲潮到水位下降的現象（退潮），也常用作比喻，表示事物人氣、景氣或影響力等由盛轉衰、減弱。
explanation_english: Literally the tide receding (ebb tide). Figuratively used to describe a decline or waning of popularity, activity, or economic conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海水開始退潮，我哋可以行去嗰啲礁石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 seoi2 hoi1 ci2 teoi3 ciu4, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 haang4 heoi3 go2 di1 giu1 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海水開始退潮，我們可以走到那些礁石去。
examples.english_sentence: The tide is going out; we can walk out to those rocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新產品一開始好多人買，但隨住宣傳減少，銷量開始退潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 caan2 ban2 jat1 hoi1 ci2 hou2 do1 jan4 maai5, daan6 ceoi4 zyu6 syun1 cyun4 gaam2 siu2, siu1 loeng6 hoi1 ci2 teoi3 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新產品剛開始很多人買，但隨著宣傳減少，銷量開始退潮。
examples.english_sentence: The new product sold well at first, but as promotion decreased, sales began to wane.

mandarin_meaning: 退热贴 / 降温贴 (贴在额头等处的降温敷贴)
english_meaning: cooling/fever-relief patch (adhesive gel patch applied to forehead/body to provide temporary cooling and relieve fever discomfort)
explanation_mandarin: 一種貼在額頭或身體其他部位的降溫敷貼，通常含有水凝膠或吸熱材料，通過蒸發或吸熱來短暫降低體表溫度，常用於緩解發熱或不適，但不能替代醫療處理。
explanation_english: An adhesive cooling patch applied to the forehead or other body areas; typically contains hydrogel or endothermic materials that provide temporary cooling via evaporation or heat absorption to relieve fever discomfort. It is for symptomatic relief and not a substitute for medical treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬發燒，媽咪幫佢貼咗退熱貼喺額頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 faat3 siu1, maa4 mi1 bong1 keoi5 tip3 zo2 teoi3 jit6 tip3 hai2 ngok6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟發燒，媽媽幫他在額頭上貼了退熱貼。
examples.english_sentence: My little brother had a fever; mom put a cooling patch on his forehead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退熱貼只係暫時降溫，如果發燒持續要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 jit6 tip3 zi2 hai6 zaam6 si4 gong3 wan1, jyu4 gwo2 faat3 siu1 ci4 zuk6 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退熱貼只是暫時降溫，如果發燒持續要看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: Cooling patches only lower temperature temporarily; if the fever persists you should see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 退烧（指发烧时体温下降，症状缓解）
english_meaning: to have a fever subside; to reduce a fever
explanation_mandarin: 指發燒時體溫下降或症狀緩解，也可作比喻用，形容某事的熱度或關注度下降。
explanation_english: Refers to a fever subsiding or body temperature decreasing; can also be used figuratively to describe waning interest or hype.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢食咗退燒藥之後，個人退咗燒，舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik6 zo2 teoi3 siu1 joek6 zi1 hau6, go3 jan4 teoi3 zo2 siu1, syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吃了退烧药之后，烧退了，舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: After taking antipyretic medicine, his fever went down and he felt better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅熱度慢慢退燒，大家唔再討論咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 jit6 dou6 maan6 maan6 teoi3 siu1, daai6 gaa1 m4 zoi6 tou2 leon6 gam2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事的熱度慢慢退燒，大家不再討論那麼多。
examples.english_sentence: The hype around this matter is dying down; people aren't discussing it as much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢仲未退燒，要繼續觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 zung6 mei6 teoi3 siu1, jiu3 gai3 zuk6 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他還沒退燒，要繼續觀察。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his fever hasn't subsided yet; he needs to be monitored.

mandarin_meaning: 退税 (tuìshuì)
english_meaning: tax refund; refund of paid tax (e.g., VAT/sales tax)
explanation_mandarin: 指將已繳納的稅款退還給納稅人的行為或金額，常見於旅客在境外購物後申請增值稅/消費稅退還。
explanation_english: The refund of tax that has been paid (e.g., VAT or sales tax), commonly issued when shoppers—often tourists—apply to have taxes returned after purchases abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺日本買嘢可以喺機場辦理退稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 jat6 bun2 maai5 je5 ho2 ji5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 baan6 lei5 teoi3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在日本購物可以在機場辦理退稅。
examples.english_sentence: We can handle tax refunds at the airport when shopping in Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得買嘢要索取發票先至可以申請退稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 maai5 je5 jiu3 sok3 ceoi2 faat3 piu3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 san1 cing2 teoi3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記得購物要索取發票才能申請退稅。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to ask for the receipt when shopping; only then can you apply for a tax refund.

mandarin_meaning: 退税
english_meaning: tax refund; tax rebate
explanation_mandarin: 退稅指按規定將已繳納的稅款退還給符合條件的個人或機構。常見於遊客購物退稅或出口退稅等情況。
explanation_english: A tax refund is the return of tax paid to an individual or entity that qualifies under regulations. Common contexts include VAT refunds for tourists and export tax rebates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺機場可以辦理退稅手續嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gei1 coeng4 ho2 ji5 baan6 lei5 teoi3 seoi3 sau2 zuk6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在机场可以办理退税手续吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I process a tax refund at the airport?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你係遊客，喺指定商店買滿金額可以申請退稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 jau4 haak3, hai2 zi6 ding6 soeng1 dim3 maai5 mun5 gam1 ngok6 ho2 ji5 san1 cing2 teoi3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你是游客，在指定商店消费达到金额可以申请退税。
examples.english_sentence: If you're a tourist, you can apply for a tax refund at designated stores when your purchases reach the required amount.

mandarin_meaning: 退税 (tuìshuì)
english_meaning: tax refund; to refund tax
explanation_mandarin: 退税是指将已缴纳的税款（如增值税、消费税）退还给符合条件的人或单位，常见于游客离境时退还购物税款或企业申请税款退还。
explanation_english: A tax refund — returning paid taxes (e.g., VAT) to eligible persons or entities. Commonly refers to refunds for tourists on purchases or to entities reclaiming overpaid taxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你係遊客，喺機場記得去辦理退稅手續。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 jau4 haak3, hai2 gei1 coeng4 gei3 dak1 heoi3 baan6 lei5 teoi3 seoi3 sau2 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你是游客，在机场记得去办理退税手续。
examples.english_sentence: If you're a tourist, remember to go to the airport to process your tax refund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間舖有時會要求你出示護照先可以退稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 jau5 si4 wui5 jiu1 kau4 nei5 ceot1 si6 wu6 ziu3 sin1 ho2 ji5 teoi3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商店有时会要求你出示护照才能退税。
examples.english_sentence: Some shops may require you to show your passport before you can get a tax refund.

mandarin_meaning: 退缩 (tuìsuō)
english_meaning: to shrink back; to recoil; to balk; to hesitate to face something out of fear or lack of confidence
explanation_mandarin: 表示因害怕、膽怯或缺乏信心而退後、不敢面對或採取行動。
explanation_english: Indicates withdrawing or backing away due to fear, timidity, or lack of confidence; not daring to confront or take action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一見有困難就會退縮，唔敢再試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gin3 jau5 kwan3 naan4 zau6 wui5 teoi3 suk1, m4 gam2 zoi3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一遇到困难就退缩，不敢再尝试。
examples.english_sentence: He backs down when he encounters difficulties and doesn't dare to try again.

mandarin_meaning: 放棄最佳或首選，轉而選擇次佳的選擇（退而求其次）
english_meaning: To give up the best option and settle for the second best; to make do with an inferior choice (settle for second best).
explanation_mandarin: 表示放棄最理想的選擇，改而選擇次好的方案，含有妥協或退讓的意思，常用於描述不得已的折衷選擇。
explanation_english: Expresses giving up the ideal choice and opting for a less ideal alternative; implies compromise or concession, often used to describe a pragmatic, second-best decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果申請唔到心儀嘅大學，就只好退而求其次，報讀其他學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 san1 cing2 m4 dou2 sam1 ji4 ge3 daai6 hok6, zau6 zi2 hou2 teoi3 ji4 kau4 kei4 ci1, bou3 duk6 kei4 taa1 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果申請不到心儀的大學，就只好退而求其次，報讀其他學校。
examples.english_sentence: If you can't get into your preferred university, you have to settle for the second-best option and enroll in another school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來我想做市場部，但唔夠經驗，最後唯有退而求其次，從行政部做起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 ngo5 soeng2 zou6 si5 coeng4 bou6, daan6 m4 gau3 ging1 jim6, zeoi3 hau6 wai4 jau5 teoi3 ji4 kau4 kei4 ci1, cung4 hang4 zing3 bou6 zou6 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本來我想做市場部，但經驗不足，最後只好退而求其次，從行政部做起。
examples.english_sentence: I wanted to work in marketing, but lacking experience I had to settle for second best and start in the administration department.

mandarin_meaning: 退出股份 / 退出投資
english_meaning: to withdraw one's shares; to pull out of an investment; to quit a partnership
explanation_mandarin: 原意為退出所持有的股份或停止對某項投資的出資；在口語中常用來表示放棄合夥、抽身或退出某個項目或安排。此詞常見於香港粵語語境。
explanation_english: Originally means to withdraw owned shares or stop contributing to an investment; colloquially used to indicate giving up a partnership, pulling out of a project, or removing oneself from a commitment. Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講阿明決定退股，因為公司最近經營得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 aa3 ming4 kyut3 ding6 teoi3 gu2, jan1 wai6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 ging1 jing4 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说阿明决定退出股份，因为公司最近经营得不好。
examples.english_sentence: I heard Ah Ming decided to withdraw his shares because the company has been performing poorly recently.

mandarin_meaning: 褪色，顏色變淡或消失
english_meaning: to fade (in color); to lose color; (figuratively) to lose influence or appeal
explanation_mandarin: 指顏色逐漸變淡或褪去，常用於衣物、照片、顏料等場合；也可比喻人氣、影響力等下降。
explanation_english: Refers to a color gradually becoming lighter or disappearing, commonly used for clothes, photos, dyes, etc.; can also be used figuratively to mean a decline in popularity or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫洗咗幾次已經退色啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 sai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 ji5 ging1 teoi3 sik1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件衣服洗了幾次就退色了。
examples.english_sentence: That shirt faded after a few washes.

mandarin_meaning: 退让 (tui4rang4)，让步、放弃部分利益或立场
english_meaning: to yield; to give way; to concede; to make a concession
explanation_mandarin: 表示在争执、谈判或冲突中主动放弃部分要求或立场，以避免冲突或达成和解。
explanation_english: To voluntarily give up part of one's demands or position in an argument, negotiation, or conflict in order to avoid confrontation or reach a settlement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗保持友誼，你要學識退讓一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bou2 ci4 jau5 ji4, nei5 jiu3 hok6 sik1 teoi3 joeng6 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了维持友谊，你应该退让一次。
examples.english_sentence: To preserve the friendship, you should yield once.

mandarin_meaning: 退货 (tuìhuò)
english_meaning: to return goods; to return an item to the seller (often for a refund or exchange)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把已購買的商品退回給商家，通常以換貨或要求退款為目的。
explanation_english: A verb meaning to give back purchased goods to the seller, usually to obtain a refund or an exchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想退貨，因為件衫有洞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 teoi3 fo3, jan1wai6 gin6 saam1 jau5 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想退货，因为这件衬衫有洞。
examples.english_sentence: I want to return it because the shirt has a hole.

mandarin_meaning: 退赛 (tuì sài) — 在比赛中退出或放弃参赛
english_meaning: to withdraw from a competition; to forfeit a match; to drop out of a contest
explanation_mandarin: 表示在體育賽事、比賽或競賽中宣布退出、不再參賽，可能因受傷、狀態不佳、戰術安排或抗議等原因。
explanation_english: Used to indicate announcing a withdrawal from a contest—ceasing to participate in a match or competition. Reasons can include injury, poor condition, strategic choice, or protest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為受傷只好退賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 sau6 soeng1 zi2 hou2 teoi3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她因为受伤只好退赛。
examples.english_sentence: He/She had to withdraw from the competition because of an injury.

mandarin_meaning: 退选（退出候选或撤回参选资格）
english_meaning: to withdraw from an election; to withdraw one's candidacy
explanation_mandarin: 指候選人宣布放棄參選資格或退出選舉活動，不再競逐該職位或席次。
explanation_english: To announce or decide to give up candidacy and stop participating in an election or race for a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢宣佈會退選，唔再競選市長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syun1 bou3 wui5 teoi3 syun2, m4 zoi6 ging6 syun2 si5 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他宣佈會退選，不再競選市長。
examples.english_sentence: He announced he would withdraw from the election and would no longer run for mayor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為健康問題，佢決定退選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gin6 hong1 man6 tai4, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 teoi3 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為健康問題，他決定退選。
examples.english_sentence: Because of health issues, he decided to withdraw from the election.

mandarin_meaning: 退让、避让以避免冲突或争端
english_meaning: to yield or withdraw to avoid confrontation; to give way temporarily to prevent conflict
explanation_mandarin: 出自古文，原意為退讓三舍以示避让。現用來表示為避免衝突而主動退讓或暫時退撤。
explanation_english: A classical idiom meaning to retreat three houses; now used to indicate yielding, making concessions, or temporarily withdrawing to avoid conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗保持和平，佢決定退避三舍，暫時唔再同對方爭辯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bou2 ci4 wo4 ping4, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 teoi3 bei6 saam1 se3, zam6 si4 m4 zoi3 tung4 deoi3 fong1 zang1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了保持和平，他决定退避三舍，暂时不再与对方争辩。
examples.english_sentence: To keep the peace, he decided to give way and temporarily stop arguing with the other party.

mandarin_meaning: 退還 (tuìhuán)：把物品或款項歸還、返還或償還給原來的擁有人或機構。
english_meaning: to return; to give back; to refund; to reimburse.
explanation_mandarin: 表示把東西或錢款交還給原持有人或機構，也可用於退還款項或歸還借用品。
explanation_english: Indicates giving an item or money back to the original owner or institution; also used for refunds or returning borrowed items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔滿意，可以要求退還貨款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 mun5 ji3, ho2 ji5 jiu1 kau4 teoi3 waan4 fo3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不滿意，可以要求退還貨款。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied, you can request a refund for the goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借咗我嘅相機，記得要退還畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 zo2 ngo5 ge3 soeng1 gei1, gei3 dak1 jiu3 teoi3 waan4 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你借了我的相機，記得要還給我。
examples.english_sentence: You borrowed my camera—remember to return it to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會退還多收嘅稅款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 teoi3 waan4 do1 sau1 ge3 seoi3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會退還多收的稅款。
examples.english_sentence: The government will refund the overcollected taxes.

mandarin_meaning: 退钱，退款；把钱退回
english_meaning: to refund; to return money; to give someone their money back
explanation_mandarin: 表示要求或把已付的錢退回給對方，常用於購物退款、退貨或要求收回付出的款項（口語亦可指要回借出的錢）。
explanation_english: Means to return money or give a refund. Commonly used for refunds or returns after a purchase, or to ask someone to give back money paid or lent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔滿意呢件衫，想退錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 mun5 ji3 ni1 gin6 saam1, soeng2 teoi3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不满意这件衣服，想退钱。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not satisfied with this piece of clothing and want a refund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢欠我一百蚊，唔肯退錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him3 ngo5 jat1 baak3 man1, m4 hang2 teoi3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠我一百块，不肯还钱。
examples.english_sentence: He owes me a hundred dollars and refuses to pay me back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機壞咗，佢哋話會退錢或者換新機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 waai6 zo2, keoi5 dei6 waa6 wui5 teoi3 cin2 waak6 ze2 wun6 san1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机坏了，他们说会退钱或者换新机。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is broken; they said they would refund the money or replace it with a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 送 (sòng)：赠送、寄送、送别、派送、护送等
english_meaning: to give; to send; to deliver; to see off; to escort
explanation_mandarin: “送”是一个动词，常用来表示把东西给予别人（赠送、寄送、派送），或陪同、送别某人（送行、送去某地），也可表示护送或交付。
explanation_english: “送” is a verb used to mean giving something to someone (give/present/send), delivering goods, escorting or seeing someone off, or handing something over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我送你去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sung3 nei5 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我送你去机场。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take you to the airport / see you off to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送咗本書俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 zo2 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送了我一本书。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貨品已經送到倉庫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo3 ban2 ji5 ging1 sung3 dou3 cong1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货品已经送到仓库。
examples.english_sentence: The goods have been delivered to the warehouse.

mandarin_meaning: 送上门（sòng shàngmén）
english_meaning: to deliver to someone's door; (figurative) an opportunity or benefit handed to someone without effort
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把東西送到家門口；引申義指機會、好處或麻煩等不費力地送到某人面前，等同於「送到門口」或「奉上」。
explanation_english: Literally 'to deliver to the door'. Figuratively it means an opportunity, benefit, or problem is presented to someone without effort on their part — i.e., handed to them on a silver platter or landing on their doorstep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個機會係人送上門俾你，唔好錯過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei1 wui6 hai6 jan4 sung3 soeng5 mun4 bei2 nei5, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个机会是别人送上门给你，不要错过。
examples.english_sentence: This opportunity is being handed to you by someone—don't miss it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將禮物送上門，唔使我出門去拎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 lai5 mat6 sung3 soeng5 mun4, m4 sai2 ngo5 ceot1 mun4 heoi3 ling1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把礼物送到门口，不用我出门去拿。
examples.english_sentence: He delivered the gift to my door, so I don't need to go out to pick it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲麻煩真係自動送上門嚟，點算好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 maa4 foon4 zan1 hai6 zi6 dung6 sung3 soeng5 mun4 lei4, dim2 syun3 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些麻烦真是自动送上门来，怎么办？
examples.english_sentence: These problems really landed on my doorstep by themselves—what should I do?

mandarin_meaning: 既然要帮就帮到底；把事情做到最后、不半途而废。有时含有做得过头或帮人帮到自己吃亏的意思。
english_meaning: To see something through to the end; to go all the way. Can also imply going overboard in helping or helping to one's own detriment.
explanation_mandarin: 一句廣東話俗語，字面為「把佛送到西」；常用來表示既然開始幫忙或做某事，就應該做到最後，但有時也帶有幫得過頭、幫到自己吃虧的負面含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning 'send the Buddha to the west.' It commonly means if you start helping or doing something, you should carry it through to the end; sometimes it also carries the nuance of overdoing it or helping to your own disadvantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你既然幫人，就送佛送到西，唔好半路放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 jin4 bong1 jan4, zau6 song3 fat6 song3 dou3 sai1, m4 hou2 bun3 lou6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你要帮人就帮到底，不要半途而废。
examples.english_sentence: Since you're helping someone, see it through; don't give up halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫晒所有嘢，真係送佛送到西，搞到自己好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 saai3 so2 jau5 je5, zan1 hai6 song3 fat6 song3 dou3 sai1, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有事情都帮了，真是帮到底，结果弄得自己很累。
examples.english_sentence: He helped with everything—really went all the way—and ended up exhausted.

mandarin_meaning: 送你一程（陪某人走一段路、送行；也可作委婉或威脅語，意指送某人上路/除掉某人）
english_meaning: to see someone off for a short distance / to give someone a ride; colloquially can mean to 'send someone on their last journey' (euphemism for killing) or used as a threat
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法。字面意思是陪伴或送某人走一段路（如送到車站）；引申或俚語上可作委婉說法，表示送人上路、把人除掉，或作威脅語使用。語境決定含義，通常以粵語口語中出現較多。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase. Literally it means to accompany or see someone off for a short distance (e.g., to the station). Figuratively or in slang it can be a euphemism meaning to 'send someone on their last journey' (i.e., kill) or used as a threat. Context determines which meaning is intended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我送你一程到地鐵站，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sung3 nei5 jat1 cing4 dou3 dei6 tit3 zaam6, m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我送你一程到地铁站，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: I'll see you to the subway station — don't mention it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢威脅話要送你一程，大家要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai1 hip3 waa6 jiu3 sung3 nei5 jat1 cing4, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他威胁说要“送你一程”，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: He threatened he'd 'send you on a trip' (i.e., get rid of you); everyone should be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 送他一程 / 送別（陪同送行）；委婉指送終（最後一程）；俚語可指殺死或除掉某人
english_meaning: to send someone off (see someone off); to give someone a final send-off (euphemism for funeral); colloquially/slang: to do someone in / get rid of someone (kill)
explanation_mandarin: 「送佢一程」字面意為陪伴或送別某人，可用於一般送行或機場送別；在提到死亡或葬禮時常指「送最後一程」。在口語或黑話中，也可作委婉或威脅性說法，表示要殺死或除掉對方。
explanation_english: Literally 'send him/her one journey.' Used to mean seeing someone off (e.g. at the airport) or giving a final send-off (funeral). In colloquial or criminal contexts it can be a euphemistic/threatening way to say to kill or get rid of someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個星期我會去機場送佢一程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 wui5 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 sung3 keoi5 jat1 cing4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下個星期我會去機場送他一程。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to the airport next week to see him off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日要去送佢最後一程，大家一齊去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 sung3 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 cing4, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 laa1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天要去為他送最後一程，大家一起去吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to give him his final send-off today; let's all go together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話如果有人出賣佢，就會送佢一程，唔係講笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 ceot1 maai6 keoi5, zau6 wui5 sung3 keoi5 jat1 cing4, m4 hai6 gong2 siu3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說如果有人出賣他，就會把對方送一程，不是在開玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: He said if someone betrays him, he'd 'send them off' (i.e., kill them) — he's not joking.

mandarin_meaning: 送信 / 送信（把信件或消息交付給別人）
english_meaning: to deliver/send a letter or message; to pass on information
explanation_mandarin: 指把信件或消息交付、傳遞給對方。有時也用於口語，表示幫忙帶話或通知別人。
explanation_english: Refers to delivering or handing over a letter or message to someone. In colloquial use it can also mean passing on a message or notifying someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去公司送信俾客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gung1 si1 sung3 seon3 bei2 haak3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去公司给客户送信。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the office today to deliver a letter to the client.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我送信去樓下阿姨？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sung3 seon3 heoi3 lau4 haa6 aa3 ji4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我把信送到楼下的阿姨吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you deliver this letter to the aunt downstairs for me?

mandarin_meaning: 送别 (sòng bié)：为离别的人送行；道别或为离别举行的仪式/场合。
english_meaning: to see someone off; to bid farewell; (noun) a farewell or send-off event/ceremony.
explanation_mandarin: 表示把即將離開的人送行或舉行相關的告別活動；也可指送別的場合或儀式，語氣可正式或書面。
explanation_english: Refers to seeing someone off or holding a farewell; can mean the action of sending someone off or the farewell event/ceremony. Used in both formal and colloquial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去車站送別佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 ce1 zaam6 sung3 bit6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去车站送别他。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the station tonight to see him off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 校長為畢業生舉行送別會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau6 zoeng2 wai6 bat1 jip6 saang1 geoi2 hang4 sung3 bit6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 校长为毕业生举行送别会。
examples.english_sentence: The principal held a farewell ceremony for the graduates.

mandarin_meaning: 挑衅、用言语刺激或挑逗别人
english_meaning: to provoke or bait someone verbally; to mouth off/instigate
explanation_mandarin: 口語、俚語用法，指用言語挑釁或刺激別人，故意說話令對方反應或生氣。
explanation_english: Colloquial/slang usage meaning to provoke or bait someone with words—deliberately saying things to elicit a reaction or to insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再送口佢啦，佢一聽就會反擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 sung3 hau2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 jat1 teng1 zau6 wui5 faan2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再挑衅他了，他一听就会反击。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bait him anymore; he'll retaliate as soon as he hears it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意送口，搞到大家好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 sung3 hau2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是喜欢出口伤人，弄得大家很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to mouth off, making everyone uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時候佢係故意送口俾人，想睇下有冇反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 hau6 keoi5 hai6 gu3 ji3 sung3 hau2 bei2 jan4, soeng2 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候他故意挑衅别人，想看有没有反应。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes he purposely provokes people to see if there's any reaction.

mandarin_meaning: （香港俚語，罕見/不確定）可能表示挑釁或說些惹事的話（需視語境而定）
english_meaning: (Hong Kong slang, rare/uncertain) possibly to provoke by speaking, to talk smack or stir up trouble (context-dependent)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語／口語（可能為動詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: 「送口果」為香港地區非正式俚語，使用頻率低且含義不夠穩定。字面可拆作「送（給）口（嘴）＋果（字面助詞）」，在不同語境下有人把它用來形容「說挑釁性或惹事的話」、也可能有戲謔或調侃的語氣。由於詞義不明確，遇到此詞應以具體語境來判斷。
explanation_english: “送口果” is a rare, informal Hong Kong slang term with an unstable/uncertain meaning. Literally composed of characters meaning “send/deliver + mouth + (particle)”, it has been used in some contexts to mean “to utter provocative or troublemaking remarks” or jokingly to tease someone. Because its usage is uncommon and context-dependent, interpret it based on the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度送口果啦，會惹事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sung3 hau2 gwo2 laa1, wui5 je5 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別在這裡『送口果』了，會惹事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't '送口果' here — you'll stir up trouble.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）等於「找死／送死」，表示做某事很危險，可能會出事或喪命
english_meaning: Colloquial expression meaning to do something extremely dangerous or reckless — 'asking for death' / 'a death wish'.
explanation_mandarin: 「送命」是廣東話口語用語，常用來形容某個行為非常危險或愚蠢，可能導致嚴重後果或喪命，相當於普通話的「找死」或「送死」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase used to describe an action that is extremely dangerous or reckless, likely to cause serious harm or death — equivalent to 'asking for death' or 'looking for trouble'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚一個人行去偏僻小巷真係送命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 heoi3 pin1 bik1 siu2 hong6 zan1 hai6 sung3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上一个人去偏僻的小巷真的是在送命。
examples.english_sentence: Going alone to a secluded alley at night is asking for death.

mandarin_meaning: 送走客人；（口語）趕走或解僱某人
english_meaning: to see guests off; to send someone away; (colloquial) to dismiss/fire someone
explanation_mandarin: “送客”常指把來訪的客人送走或送出門。在口語中也可以指把人趕走或解僱（例如說某人被公司送客）。
explanation_english: “送客” normally means to see guests off or to send visitors away. Colloquially it can also mean to drive someone out or to dismiss/fire someone (e.g., someone was 'sent off' by the company).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你哋今晚嚟，我哋送客喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 gam1 maan5 lei4，ngo5 dei6 sung3 haak3 laa3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你们今晚来，我们送你们。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for coming tonight; we'll see you out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近要縮減人手，阿強被送客咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 jiu3 suk1 gim2 jan4 sau2，aa3 koeng4 bei6 sung3 haak3 zo2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近要缩减人手，阿强被解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is cutting staff lately; Ah Keung was let go.

mandarin_meaning: 送暖 (sòng nuǎn)：給予溫暖、慰問或幫助
english_meaning: to give warmth or comfort (literally or figuratively); to offer care/support
explanation_mandarin: 指用實際行動或關懷來給人溫暖、安慰或幫助。既可指字面上送去暖和（例如送熱食、送被褥），也可用作比喻，表示關心、慰問或支援。
explanation_english: To provide warmth, comfort, or assistance through actions or care. It can be literal (e.g., bringing hot food or blankets) or figurative, meaning to show concern, sympathy, or support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚟探我，仲帶埋一籃熱湯嚟送暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lei4 taam3 ngo5, zung6 daai3 maai4 jat1 laam4 jit6 tong1 lei4 sung3 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他來看我，還帶了一籃熱湯來送暖。
examples.english_sentence: He came to visit me and even brought a basket of hot soup to bring me warmth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司搞慈善活動，員工一齊去送暖畀有需要嘅家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gaau2 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6, jyun4 gung1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sung3 nyun5 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司舉辦慈善活動，員工一起去為有需要的家庭送暖。
examples.english_sentence: The company organized a charity event; staff went together to bring warmth to families in need.

mandarin_meaning: 送机 (sòngjī)，到机场为离开的人送行
english_meaning: to see someone off at the airport; to accompany someone to board a plane
explanation_mandarin: 表示到機場陪伴並送某人上飛機，為離別時在機場為出發者送行的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to going to the airport to accompany someone and see them off, usually helping or accompanying them onto the plane at departure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我要去機場送阿妹，陪佢上飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 sung3 aa3 mui6, pui4 keoi5 soeng5 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我要去机场送妹妹，陪她上飞机。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow I'll go to the airport to see my sister off and accompany her onto the plane.

mandarin_meaning: 去機場為人送行（常含匆忙或只是短暫陪同的意思）
english_meaning: To see someone off at the airport; often implies a brief or perfunctory send-off, accompanying someone only until shortly before departure.
explanation_mandarin: 「送機尾」是香港粵語俗語，指到機場為人送別。語氣上常帶有只陪到最後一刻或匆匆來送、不長時間停留的含義。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase meaning to see someone off at the airport. It often carries the nuance of a brief or perfunctory send-off — accompanying someone only until shortly before they depart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我要去送機尾，送到上機就返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 sung3 gei1 mei5, sung3 dou3 soeng5 gei1 zau6 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要去機場送別，送到登機就回來。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I'm going to the airport to see someone off; I'll come back after they board.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係嚟送機尾，留埋幫手拎行李啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 lai4 sung3 gei1 mei5, lau4 maai4 bong1 sau2 ling1 hang4 lei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是匆匆來送機尾，要留下來幫忙拿行李。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just come for a perfunctory send-off — stay and help carry the luggage.

mandarin_meaning: 送检：将样品或物品送去检验、检测或化验
english_meaning: to submit (something) for inspection/testing; to send for laboratory analysis
explanation_mandarin: 「送檢」指把樣本、產品或物品交給有關部門或實驗室進行檢查、檢測或化驗，以確定安全性、品質或病理結果。
explanation_english: “送檢” means sending samples, products, or items to the relevant authority or laboratory for inspection, testing, or analysis to determine safety, quality, or diagnostic results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批食品要送檢先可以賣。
