english_meaning: Cantonese slang for being extremely unlucky or in a disastrous situation
explanation_mandarin: 「透爐」是廣東話口語俚語，用來形容人或事情非常倒霉、運氣極差或情況很糟糕，常用作感嘆或評價。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone or something that is extremely unlucky or in a really bad situation. Often used as an exclamation or to comment on misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝開會遲到，仲唔記得帶文件，真係透爐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hoi1 wui6 ci4 dou3, zung6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 man4 gin2, zan1 hai6 tau3 lou4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上開會遲到，還忘了帶文件，真是倒霉透頂。
examples.english_sentence: I was late for a meeting this morning and even forgot to bring the documents — really unlucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲股票跌晒，啲錢都蝕晒，真係透爐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gu2 piu3 dit3 saai3, di1 cin2 dou1 sik1 saai3, zan1 hai6 tau3 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的股票全都跌了，錢也都賠光了，真是倒霉透頂。
examples.english_sentence: His stocks all crashed and he lost all his money — he's really out of luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日成日事都唔順，手機仲畀人偷咗，真係透爐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 si6 dou1 m4 seon6, sau2 gei1 zung6 bei2 jan4 tau1 zo2, zan1 hai6 tau3 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天一整天事情都不順，手機還被人偷了，真是倒霉透頂。
examples.english_sentence: Everything went wrong all day and my phone was even stolen — really unlucky.

mandarin_meaning: 薄而透光；（比喻）態度冷淡或輕薄
english_meaning: thin and translucent; (figuratively) cold, dismissive, or insubstantial
explanation_mandarin: 「透薄」可用來形容物件很薄且有透光性，也可以比喻人的態度冷淡、輕薄或不重視他人。
explanation_english: "透薄" can describe something physically thin and somewhat see-through; figuratively it describes an attitude that is cold, dismissive, or superficial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好透薄，冬天唔啱著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 tau3 bok6, dung1 tin1 m4 ngaam1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很薄透，冬天不適合穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very thin and sheer; not suitable to wear in winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我嘅態度好透薄，感覺好唔受重視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 tau3 bok6, gam2 gok3 hou2 m4 sau6 zung6 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對我的態度很冷淡，感覺不被重視。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude toward me was very cold and dismissive, making me feel unvalued.

mandarin_meaning: 透视 (tòushì)：看穿、看透；用X光等方式檢查內部；繪畫中的透視（透視圖）。
english_meaning: to see through; X-ray (examination); perspective (in drawing); x-ray vision; see-through.
explanation_mandarin: 「透視」可作動詞，表示看穿或用X光等方式檢查內部；亦可作名詞，指透視（如透視圖）或X光透視的影像。
explanation_english: “透視” can be a verb meaning to see through (literally or figuratively) or to examine internally with X-ray; as a noun it can refer to perspective (in drawing) or an X-ray image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生用X光機透視佢隻手，檢查有冇骨折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jung6 X gwong1 gei1 tau3 si6 keoi5 zek3 sau2, gim2 caa4 jau5 mou5 gwat1 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生用X光机透视他的手，检查有没有骨折。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor used an X-ray machine to examine his hand to check for fractures.

mandarin_meaning: 透過 / 通過（藉由某種途徑或方法）
english_meaning: through; via; by means of
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示藉著某個途徑、方法或媒介去達成或得知某事，常用於正式或書面語。
explanation_english: Used to indicate doing something by means of a particular channel, method, or medium; common in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我透過朋友知道呢個消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau3 gwo3 pang4 jau5 zi1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我透過朋友知道這個消息。
examples.english_sentence: I learned this news through a friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會透過視像會議討論項目進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 tau3 gwo3 si6 zoeng6 wui6 ji5 tou2 leon6 hong6 muk6 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們會透過視像會議討論項目進度。
examples.english_sentence: We will discuss the project's progress via video conference.

mandarin_meaning: 透镜 (指用來折射或聚焦光線的光學鏡片，例如相機鏡片或顯微鏡鏡片)
english_meaning: lens (an optical element that refracts or focuses light, e.g., camera lens or microscope lens)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於折射或聚焦光線的光學元件，常見於相機、顯微鏡、望遠鏡等設備，用來改變光路或放大影像。
explanation_english: An optical component used to refract or focus light, commonly found in cameras, microscopes, telescopes, etc., used to alter light paths or magnify images.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部相機嘅透鏡好靚，影相好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 soeng2 gei1 ge3 tau3 geng3 hou2 leng3, jing2 soeng2 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台相機的透鏡很好，拍照很清晰。
examples.english_sentence: The lens of this camera is great; photos come out very clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 顯微鏡嘅透鏡可以放大細胞，方便做實驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hin2 mei4 geng3 ge3 tau3 geng3 ho2 ji5 fong3 daai6 sai3 baau1, fong1 bin6 zou6 sat6 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 顯微鏡的透鏡可以放大細胞，便於做實驗。
examples.english_sentence: The microscope lens can magnify cells, which makes experiments easier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光學課上我哋學咗凸透鏡同凹透鏡嘅分別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 hok6 fo3 seong6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zo2 dat1 tau3 geng3 tung4 ngau1 tau3 geng3 ge3 fan1 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在光學課上我們學了凸透鏡和凹透鏡的區別。
examples.english_sentence: In optics class we learned the difference between convex and concave lenses.

mandarin_meaning: 透露 (tòulù) — 把事情或消息泄露出来
english_meaning: to reveal or disclose information that was meant to be kept secret; to let slip
explanation_mandarin: 表示把本來想保密的事情、消息或情報等泄露出來，常用作動詞，也可用於口語中表示無意中說出部分內容。
explanation_english: To disclose or let out information, details, or secrets that were intended to be kept private. Commonly used as a verb and can imply accidental or intentional revelation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心透露咗啲秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 tau3 lou6 zo2 di1 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心透露了些秘密。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally revealed some secrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢透露咗佢將會辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau3 lou6 zo2 keoi5 zoeng1 wui5 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他透露了他將會辭職。
examples.english_sentence: He revealed that he will resign.

mandarin_meaning: 走漏風聲；洩露消息；（字面）通風
english_meaning: to leak information or tip someone off; (literal) to ventilate
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語常用詞，指把內部或機密的消息洩露出去、讓外人知道；在字面上也可指讓空氣流通（通風）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to leak information or tip someone off. Literally it can also mean to let air in or ventilate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾人透風，呢個係機密計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 tau3 fung1, ni1 go3 hai6 gei1 mat6 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別讓人透風，這是機密計劃。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let anyone leak this—it's a confidential plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人喺內部透風，所以要加強保密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geng2 fong4 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 hai2 noi6 bou6 tau3 fung1, so2 ji5 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 bou2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方懷疑內部有人透風，因此要加強保密。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect an internal leak, so confidentiality must be tightened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱到爆，開窗透風啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 dou3 baau3, hoi1 coeng1 tau3 fung1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太熱了，開窗通風吧！
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot—open a window and let some air in!

mandarin_meaning: 逐 (zhú)：可表示“逐一、每一”（如“逐个、逐一”），也可表示“驱逐、赶走、开除”等动作（如“驱逐、逐出”），并见于合成词如“逐渐”。
english_meaning: ‘逐’ in Cantonese has two common senses: (1) each/one by one; (2) to expel, drive away, or fire. It appears in compounds meaning 'gradually' in Mandarin-derived words as well.
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语里，“逐”常有兩個主要讀音與詞義：zuk1 表示“逐一、每一”，常見於“逐個、逐一”等用法；zuk6 表示“驱逐、赶走、开除”等動作，例如“逐走、逐出、逐咗佢”。視語境也可與其他字合成表示“逐渐”一類意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '逐' has two main pronunciations and senses: zuk1 meaning 'each' or 'one by one' (e.g. 逐個, 逐一), and zuk6 meaning 'to expel/drive away or to fire' (e.g. 逐走, 逐出). It also appears in compound words with meanings related to 'gradually' in Mandarin-origin expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋逐個解釋俾佢聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zuk1 go3 gaai2 sik1 bei2 keoi5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们逐个向他解释。
examples.english_sentence: We explain to him one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細逐咗佢，話佢唔啱份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 zuk6 zo2 keoi5, waa6 keoi5 m4 ngaam1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板把他开除了，说他不适合这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: The boss fired him, saying he's not suitable for the job.

mandarin_meaning: 逐一 (逐个、一个接一个)
english_meaning: one by one; individually; in turn
explanation_mandarin: 表示按順序、一個接一個地進行或處理某事。
explanation_english: Indicates doing or dealing with things in order, one after another; individually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要逐一檢查所有文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zuk6 jat1 gim2 caa4 so2 jau5 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要逐一检查所有文件。
examples.english_sentence: We need to check all the documents one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師逐一為學生改作文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 zuk6 jat1 wai6 hok6 saang1 goi2 zok3 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师逐一为学生改作文。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher corrected each student's composition one by one.

mandarin_meaning: 逐个 / 逐一
english_meaning: one by one; each; individually
explanation_mandarin: 表示逐一、逐个地进行或处理，强调每一次分别进行，而不是同时进行。
explanation_english: Indicates doing things one by one or individually, emphasizing handling items or actions separately rather than all at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要逐個檢查定係一齊檢查？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zuk6 go3 gim2 caa4 ding6 hai6 jat1 cai4 gim2 caa4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要逐个检查还是一起检查？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to check them one by one or all at once?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我逐個講畀你聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zuk6 go3 gong2 bei2 nei5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会逐个跟你说。
examples.english_sentence: I'll tell you one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋逐個上車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zuk6 go3 soeng5 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们逐个上车。
examples.english_sentence: They boarded the bus one by one.

mandarin_meaning: 驱逐；赶出（把某人或某物从某处赶走或排除）
english_meaning: to expel; to evict; to drive out
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人或某物從某個地方或群體中驅趕或排除，不再准許其留在原處。
explanation_english: To force someone or something out of a place or group; to remove or evict so that they are no longer allowed to remain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司因為佢嘅行為，要將佢逐出團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai6, jiu3 zoeng1 keoi5 zuk6 ceot1 tyun4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司因為他的行為，將他逐出團隊。
examples.english_sentence: The company expelled him from the team because of his behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 房東因為佢唔交租，將佢逐出咗屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 dung1 jan1 wai6 keoi5 m4 gaau1 zou1, zoeng1 keoi5 zuk6 ceot1 zo2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房東因為他不交房租，把他逐出了房子。
examples.english_sentence: The landlord evicted him from the apartment for not paying rent.

mandarin_meaning: 逐漸；慢慢地；一點一點地
english_meaning: gradually; little by little; slowly
explanation_mandarin: 「逐啲」是廣東話口語用法，表示動作或變化不是一次完成，而是逐步、慢慢地進行，常用於提醒放慢節奏或分階段處理。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adverb meaning that something happens step by step rather than all at once — gradually, little by little. Often used to tell someone to slow down or to take things in stages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁急，逐啲做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 gap1, zuk6 di1 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那麼急，慢慢做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hasty; do it slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要逐啲嚟，唔好一次過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zuk6 di1 lai4, m4 hou2 jat1 ci3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要逐漸來，不要一次全部做完。
examples.english_sentence: Take it step by step; don't do it all at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾日，宜家要逐啲好返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 jat6, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zuk6 di1 hou2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了幾天，現在要慢慢康復。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for a few days; now he needs to recover gradually.

mandarin_meaning: 逐家逐戶 / 每家每户
english_meaning: every household; house to house; door-to-door
explanation_mandarin: 表示逐一、逐戶每一個家庭，常用來強調覆蓋範圍全面或形容逐門逐戶的行動（例如逐家逐戶派發、逐家逐戶檢查）。
explanation_english: Indicates each and every household; used to emphasize comprehensive coverage or actions carried out house-to-house (e.g., distributing or checking door-to-door).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府逐家逐戶派發口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zuk6 gaa1 zuk6 wu6 paai3 fat3 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府逐家逐户派发口罩。
examples.english_sentence: The government distributed masks to every household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴雨後，義工逐家逐戶檢查有冇人需要幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 jyu5 hau6, ji6 gung1 zuk6 gaa1 zuk6 wu6 gim2 caa4 jau5 mou5 jan4 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴雨过后，义工逐家逐户检查有没有人需要帮助。
examples.english_sentence: After the heavy rain, volunteers went door-to-door to check if anyone needed help.

mandarin_meaning: 逐家逐户；家家户户
english_meaning: every household; house-to-house; door-to-door
explanation_mandarin: 表示逐一走入或涉及每一個家庭或住戶，強調全面性或逐戶進行的行動，相當於「家家戶戶」或「逐戶逐家」。
explanation_english: Indicates going from one household to another or including each and every household; emphasizes thoroughness or door-to-door action, equivalent to 'each and every household' or 'door-to-door'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 志願者逐家逐戶巡查，了解有冇需要幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi3 jyun6 ze2 zuk6 gaa1 zuk6 wu6 syun4 caa4, liu5 gaai2 jau5 mou5 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 志愿者逐家逐户巡查，了解有没有需要帮助的地方。
examples.english_sentence: Volunteers went door-to-door to check and see if anyone needed help.

mandarin_meaning: 每家每户；挨家挨户
english_meaning: each and every household; house-to-house; door-to-door
explanation_mandarin: 表示挨家挨户、逐一到每一戶的意思，可用作副詞或名詞短語，常用於描述逐戶拜訪或逐戶發放物資等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates going to or referring to each household one by one (house-to-house). Often used to describe door-to-door visits or distributing items to every family; functions as an adverbial or noun phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社工逐家逐戶探訪長者，確保佢哋冇困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 gung1 zuk1 gaa1 zuk1 wu6 taam3 fong2 zoeng2 ze2, kok3 bou2 keoi5 dei6 mou5 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社工挨家挨户探访长者，确保他们没有困难。
examples.english_sentence: Social workers visit elderly people house-to-house to make sure they have no difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，義工會逐家逐戶送口罩同防疫宣傳單張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing6 kei4 kei4 gaan1, ji6 gung1 wui5 zuk1 gaa1 zuk1 wu6 sung3 hau2 zau3 tung4 fong4 jik6 syun1 cyun1 daan1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，志愿者会挨家挨户送口罩和防疫宣传单。
examples.english_sentence: During the outbreak, volunteers go door-to-door delivering masks and public health leaflets.

mandarin_meaning: 逐漸；慢慢地；一點一點地
english_meaning: gradually; little by little; bit by bit
explanation_mandarin: 「逐少」用來表示事情或動作慢慢進行，一點一點地改變或累積，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Used to indicate something happening gradually or incrementally, little by little. Commonly used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢逐少嚟，唔好心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 zuk6 siu2 lai4, m4 hou2 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事慢慢來，不要心急。
examples.english_sentence: Do things little by little; don't be impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家逐少儲錢，準備去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4gaa1 zuk6 siu2 co5 cin2, zeon2bei6 heoi3 leoi5hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在慢慢存錢，準備去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm saving money little by little to prepare for a trip.

mandarin_meaning: 逐步 (zhúbù)
english_meaning: step by step; gradually
explanation_mandarin: 表示按步驟、慢慢地進行或變化，強調循序漸進。
explanation_english: Indicates proceeding or changing step by step; emphasizes gradual, sequential progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要逐步完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zuk6 bou6 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要逐步完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to complete this project step by step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該逐步減少食糖，唔好一鋪清光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 goi1 zuk6 bou6 gaam2 siu2 sik6 tong4, m4 hou2 jat1 pou3 cing1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该逐步减少吃糖，不要一下子全部戒掉。
examples.english_sentence: You should gradually cut down on sugar; don't quit everything all at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅病情逐步好轉，醫生都話有進展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 beng6 cing4 zuk6 bou6 hou2 zyun3, ji1 sang1 dou1 waa6 jau5 zeon3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的病情逐步好转，医生也说有进展。
examples.english_sentence: His condition is gradually improving; the doctor says there's progress.

mandarin_meaning: 逐渐
english_meaning: gradually; progressively; by degrees
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情或情況隨著時間慢慢發生變化或朝某個方向發展。
explanation_english: Indicates that something changes or develops slowly over time or in stages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣逐漸變冷，記得加件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 zuk6 zim6 bin3 laang5, gei3 dak1 gaa1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣逐漸變冷，記得多穿一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is gradually getting colder; remember to put on another layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅病情逐漸好轉，家人都放心咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 beng6 cing4 zuk6 zim6 hou2 zyun3, gaa1 jan4 dou1 fong3 sam1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的病情逐渐好转，家人都放心了。
examples.english_sentence: His condition is gradually improving, and the family is relieved.

mandarin_meaning: 途（道路、旅程、途徑）
english_meaning: way; route; path; journey
explanation_mandarin: 表示道路、旅程或方法、途徑，也常作複合詞的一部分，如「路途」「途徑」「途中」。
explanation_english: Refers to a road, route, journey, or a means/way; often appears in compounds such as 'route', 'journey', or 'on the way'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 路途遙遠，要準備足夠嘅水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou6 tou4 jiu4 jyun5, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 zuk1 gau3 ge3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路途遙遠，要準備足夠的水。
examples.english_sentence: The journey is long; you should prepare enough water.

mandarin_meaning: 在途中；在路上（未到達目的地）
english_meaning: on the way; en route; during a journey
explanation_mandarin: 表示在行程或路程之中，尚未到達目的地，可用於具體的實體行程或抽象過程中。
explanation_english: Indicates being in the middle of a journey or on the way to a destination; can be used for literal travel or figurative processes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺途中停咗一陣買杯咖啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 to4 zung1 ting4 zo2 jat1 zan6 maai5 bui1 gaa3 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在途中停了一会儿买杯咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: We stopped for a bit on the way to buy a cup of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺去機場途中突然收到通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 to4 zung1 dat6 jin4 sau1 dou3 tung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在去机场的途中突然收到通知。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly received a notification while on the way to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋途中遇到颱風，行程被迫取消。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 to4 zung1 jyu6 dou3 toi4 fung1, hang4 cing4 bei6 baak3 ceoi2 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在途中遇到台风，行程被迫取消。
examples.english_sentence: We encountered a typhoon en route and the itinerary had to be canceled.

mandarin_meaning: 路人
english_meaning: passerby; bystander
explanation_mandarin: 指在路上或場地經過的人，通常指不相識且未參與事件的旁觀者或過路人。
explanation_english: A person passing by or a bystander—usually someone unfamiliar and not involved in the event or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有個途人見到我跌倒，就幫手扶我起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 go3 tou4 jan4 gin3 dou2 ngo5 dit3 dou2, zau6 bong1 sau2 fu4 ngo5 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有個路人看到我摔倒，就幫忙扶我起來。
examples.english_sentence: A passerby saw me fall and helped me up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察向途人了解事情經過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hoeng3 tou4 jan4 liu5 gaai2 si6 cing4 ging1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察向路人了解事情經過。
examples.english_sentence: The police questioned passersby to find out what happened.

mandarin_meaning: 途径 (tújìng)：方法、渠道或路徑，指達到目的或解決問題的方式。
english_meaning: A route, channel, or means — a way or method to achieve something or solve a problem.
explanation_mandarin: 表示達成目的或處理事情時所採用的路徑或方式，可以是實際的路線，也可以是抽象的渠道或方法。
explanation_english: Refers to the route or method used to accomplish something or handle an issue. It can denote a physical route or an abstract channel/means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇其他途徑可以解決呢個問題？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 tou4 ging3 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有其他途径可以解决这个问题？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any other ways to solve this problem?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司透過不同嘅途徑招募新員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tou3 gwo3 bat1 tung4 ge3 tou4 ging3 ziu1 mou6 san1 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司通过不同的途径招募新员工。
examples.english_sentence: The company recruits new employees through different channels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想透過正當嘅途徑改善生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tou3 gwo3 zeng3 dong1 ge3 tou4 ging3 goi2 sin6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想通过正当的途径改善生活。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to improve his life through legitimate means.

mandarin_meaning: 途经（經過）
english_meaning: to pass by; to pass through; via
explanation_mandarin: 表示經過某個地點或走過某條路線，屬於動作動詞，用於描述行經或途徑。
explanation_english: Indicates passing by or passing through a place or along a route; a verb used to describe going via or through a location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日返屋企會途經旺角，可以順路接你嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 uk1 kei2 wui5 tou4 ging1 wong6 gok3, ho2 ji5 seon6 lou6 zip3 nei5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天回家的路上会经过旺角，可以顺路接你吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm going home today via Mong Kok — can I pick you up on the way?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路會途經好幾個村落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 wui5 tou4 ging1 hou2 gei2 go3 cyun1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路会经过好几个村落。
examples.english_sentence: This road passes through several villages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我途經佢公司時見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tou4 ging1 keoi5 gung1 si1 si4 gin3 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经过他公司时看见了他。
examples.english_sentence: I saw him when I passed by his company.

mandarin_meaning: 径，逕自（jìng）：直接；径直；小路（书面或文言）
english_meaning: directly; straight; a path or track (literary/formal)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 名词（书面或文言）
explanation_mandarin: 「逕」常作「逕自」表示直接、不經過他人而行動；亦可作名詞，指小路、徑道。多見於書面或文言用法。
explanation_english: The character 逕 is often used in the adverbial phrase 逕自 meaning 'directly' or 'without consulting others'. It can also mean a small path or track as a noun. Usage is mostly literary or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢逕自離開會場，冇同我哋講一聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging3 zi6 lei4 hoi1 wui2 coeng4, mou5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 gong2 jat1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他径自离开会场，没和我们说一声。
examples.english_sentence: He left the meeting on his own without telling us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園裏有條小逕，可以直達湖邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 leoi5 jau5 tiu4 siu2 ging3, ho2 ji5 zik6 daat6 wu4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里有一条小径，可以直达湖边。
examples.english_sentence: There is a small path in the park that leads straight to the lakeside.

mandarin_meaning: 径自 / 直接 (不经他人同意或不经商量，独自去做)
english_meaning: directly; on one's own accord; without consulting or seeking permission
explanation_mandarin: 表示不經他人同意或不與他人商量，直接自己去做某事，語氣偏正式或書面。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something directly or on one's own initiative without consulting others; the tone is somewhat formal or literary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢逕自走咗入去會議室，開始講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging3 zi6 zau2 zo2 jap6 heoi3 wui6 ji5 sat1, hoi1 ci2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他径自走进会议室，开始讲话。
examples.english_sentence: He went straight into the meeting room and started speaking (without asking).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好逕自決定，要先同我哋傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ging3 zi6 kyut3 ding6, jiu3 sin1 tung4 ngo5 dei6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要径自决定，应该先跟我们商量。
examples.english_sentence: Don't decide on your own; consult with us first.

mandarin_meaning: 逗（逗弄、戲弄；有趣、好笑）
english_meaning: to tease or make fun of; (can also mean) amusing, funny
explanation_mandarin: 表示逗弄、戲弄別人，也可以用來形容某人或事物令人發笑、有趣。
explanation_english: Used to indicate teasing or making fun of someone; can also describe someone or something as amusing or funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好逗我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dau6 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要逗我啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好逗，成日講啲笑話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 dau6, sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 siu3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很逗，成天講笑話。
examples.english_sentence: He's very funny; always telling jokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係逗你玩啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 dau6 nei5 wan2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是逗你玩而已。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just teasing you.

mandarin_meaning: 逗取利是 / 戲弄或撒嬌索要紅包
english_meaning: to tease/plead for a red envelope (lai see); playfully cajole someone into giving a red packet
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指以逗弄、撒嬌或玩笑的方式向長輩或他人索要利是（紅包），多見於農曆新年或有利是習俗的場合。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase meaning to tease, plead, or playfully cajole someone into giving a red envelope (lai see). Common during Lunar New Year or occasions when red packets are customary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔淨係識逗利是，唔識講多謝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dau6 lei6 si6 , m4 sik1 gong2 do1 ze6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子只會逗利是，不會說謝謝。
examples.english_sentence: The kids only know how to tease for red envelopes; they don't say thank you.

mandarin_meaning: 停留、逗留（短暫停在某地）
english_meaning: to stay, to linger, to stop over (for a short time)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某地暫時停留、不立即離開，常用於描述短時間停留或過境停留。
explanation_english: Indicates remaining at a place for a short time or delaying departure; often used for short stays or stopovers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺香港逗留咗兩日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dau6 lau4 zo2 loeng5 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在香港逗留了兩天。
examples.english_sentence: I stayed in Hong Kong for two days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺機場逗留等轉機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 dau6 lau4 dang2 zyun2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在機場逗留等轉機。
examples.english_sentence: He stayed at the airport waiting for a connecting flight.

mandarin_meaning: 逗号 (dòuhào)
english_meaning: comma (punctuation mark used to indicate a short pause and separate elements in a sentence)
explanation_mandarin: 表示句子內短暫停頓的標點符號，用來分隔詞語、片語或分句，幫助理解句意。
explanation_english: A punctuation mark indicating a short pause within a sentence, used to separate words, phrases, or clauses to clarify meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫句子嘅時候要記得加逗號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 geoi3 zi6 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 gei3 dak1 gaa1 dau6 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写句子的时候要记得加逗号。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to add commas when writing sentences.

mandarin_meaning: 这 (zhè)
english_meaning: this (demonstrative)
explanation_mandarin: 「這」用來指示靠近說話者的人或事物，常見於書面語或較正式的表達。粵語口語裡通常用「呢」或「呢個」來表達相同意思。粵語讀音一般為 ze2。
explanation_english: 「這」 is a demonstrative used to indicate something close to the speaker. It appears often in written or formal contexts in Cantonese; in colloquial speech speakers typically use 「呢」 or 「呢個」. Pronounced ze2 in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這個問題好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is very complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下這張相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ze2 zoeng1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看这张照片。
examples.english_sentence: Take a look at this photo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這樣做唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 joeng6 zou6 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做不对。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this is not right.

mandarin_meaning: 这些 (zhèxiē)
english_meaning: these; these ones; these things
explanation_mandarin: 表示靠近说话者的复数事物或人，用于指示多个事物或人。
explanation_english: A demonstrative pronoun used to indicate multiple items or people near the speaker — 'these'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這些我唔需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 se1 ngo5 m4 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些我不需要。
examples.english_sentence: I don't need these.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日買咗這些嘢嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 ze5 se1 je5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天买了这些东西吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did you buy these things today?

mandarin_meaning: 这个
english_meaning: this; this one
explanation_mandarin: 表示靠近说话者的事物或人。口語廣東話通常用「呢個」(ni1 go3) 發音，書面或文白讀時有時寫作/讀作「這個」(ze5 go3)。此外在口語中也常用作猶豫或填充語（相當於“這個……/那个……”）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate something or someone near the speaker ('this'/'this one'). In spoken Cantonese the common form is 呢個 (ni1 go3); the written character 這個 can be read with a literary pronunciation (ze5 go3). It can also function as a hesitation filler in casual speech ('um.../well...').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个很贵。
examples.english_sentence: This is expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下呢個相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 go3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看这个照片。
examples.english_sentence: Take a look at this photo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個...我唔記得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3... ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个...我不记得了。
examples.english_sentence: Um... I don't remember.

mandarin_meaning: 這裡 / 这里
english_meaning: here; this place
explanation_mandarin: 用來指示說話者所指的地方，相當於普通話的「這裡/这里」。在粵語中有時會被「呢度」替代，但「這兒」仍可理解為「這個地方」。
explanation_english: A demonstrative pronoun used to indicate the place near the speaker (i.e., 'here'). In Cantonese, speakers often use '呢度' instead, but '這兒' is understood as 'this place'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺這兒等我啦，我好快返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 ze2 ji4 dang2 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 hou2 faai3 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在這兒等我吧，我很快回來。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me here; I'll be back soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這兒唔係好安全，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 ji4 m4 hai6 hou2 on1 cyun4, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡不太安全，你小心一點。
examples.english_sentence: This place isn't very safe; be a bit careful.

mandarin_meaning: 这样
english_meaning: like this; in this way; so
explanation_mandarin: 表示方式、程度或結果，相當於“如此/像這樣”。可作代詞指示事物或作副詞說明方式。
explanation_english: Indicates manner, degree, or result; means 'in this way' or 'like this'. Can function as a pronoun pointing to something or as an adverb describing how something is done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你這樣做會唔會有問題？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ze2 joeng6 zou6 wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 man6 tai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做會不會有問題？
examples.english_sentence: Will there be a problem if you do this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想事情就這樣結束。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 si6 cing4 zau6 ze2 joeng6 git3 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想事情就這樣結束。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want things to end like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果係咁，我就唔會接受這樣的提議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 gam2, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 zip3 sau6 ze2 joeng6 dik1 tai4 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果是這樣，我就不會接受這樣的提議。
examples.english_sentence: If that's the case, I won't accept such a proposal.

mandarin_meaning: 這裡 / 這兒 (zhèlǐ)
english_meaning: here (indicating a location near the speaker)
explanation_mandarin: 用來指示靠近說話者的地點，相當於普通話的「這裡/這兒」。在口語廣東話中更常用「呢度」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a location near the speaker (equivalent to Mandarin 'zhèlǐ' and English 'here'). In spoken Cantonese, the colloquial form '呢度' is more common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這裏好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 leoi5 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This place is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你住喺這裏嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyu6 hai2 ze2 leoi5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你住在這裡嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you live here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲嚟這裏！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 lei4 ze2 leoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快點來這裡！
examples.english_sentence: Come here quickly!

mandarin_meaning: 这里 (zhè lǐ)
english_meaning: here; at this place
explanation_mandarin: 表示說話者或談話雙方所指的地點，相當於「在這個地方」。
explanation_english: Indicates a place near the speaker or a location being referred to; means 'at this place' or 'here'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺這裡等我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 ze2 leoi5 dang2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里等我。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for me here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這裡嘅風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 leoi5 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的风景很美。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery here is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺這裡可以停車嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ze2 leoi5 ho2 ji5 ting4 ce1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里可以停车吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I park here?

mandarin_meaning: 这里；在这里
english_meaning: here; in this place
explanation_mandarin: 表示在说话者所指或靠近说话者的地点，常作地点副词使用。书面语或较正式的场合常用“这里”，口语粤语中常用“呢度”。
explanation_english: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'here', indicating a location near the speaker. '這裡' is more formal/written in Cantonese; colloquial Cantonese often uses '呢度'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這裡有間好出名嘅茶餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 leoi5 jau5 gaan1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 caa4 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有一家很有名的茶餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: There is a famous cha chaan teng here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺這裡等我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 ze2 leoi5 dang2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在这里等我。
examples.english_sentence: You can wait for me here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這裡唔使買票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 leoi5 m4 sai2 maai5 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里不用买票。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to buy a ticket here.

mandarin_meaning: 這陣子 / 最近 / 這段時間
english_meaning: recently; these days; in this period
explanation_mandarin: 表示最近一段時間，與「最近」或「這段時間」意義相近，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Indicates a recent period of time (recently, these days). Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這陣子我好忙，冇咩時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 zan6 zi2 ngo5 hou2 mong4, mou5 me1 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這陣子我很忙，沒什麼時間休息。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very busy recently and haven't had much time to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這陣子天氣好冷，記得著多啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 zan6 zi2 tin1 hei3 hou2 laang5, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這陣子天氣很冷，記得多穿點衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's been very cold these days; remember to wear more clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這陣子我學緊廣東話，希望可以快啲進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 zan6 zi2 ngo5 hok6 gan2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這陣子我在學廣東話，希望可以快點進步。
examples.english_sentence: These days I'm learning Cantonese; I hope I can improve quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 這麼 / 這樣 / 如此
english_meaning: so; this (much/way); to this extent
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示程度或方式，表示某事達到某個程度或如此地、這樣地。
explanation_english: Used as an adverb to indicate degree or manner — meaning 'so', 'this (much)', or 'in this way'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解會這麼晚？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 wui5 ze5 mo1 maan5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為什麼會這麼晚？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so late?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我沒有想到事情會這麼複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 soeng2 dou3 si6 cing4 wui5 ze5 mo1 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒想到事情會這麼複雜。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect things to be this complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫這麼貴？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ze5 mo1 gwai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服這麼貴嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Is this shirt really that expensive?

mandarin_meaning: 通、通行、通晓、了解、连通、联络
english_meaning: to pass through; to be open/connected; to understand or be proficient; to contact
explanation_mandarin: 表示通行、连通、了解或熟悉某事物，也可表示与人联络或联系。
explanation_english: Indicates passing through or being open/connected, understanding or being proficient in something, or contacting someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路而家通喇，車可以過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 ji4 gaa1 tung1 laa3, ce1 ho2 ji5 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路現在通了，車可以通行/通過。
examples.english_sentence: The road is clear now; cars can pass through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢已經通咗電話，傾咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 tung1 zo2 din6 waa2, king1 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經和他通了電話，談了很久。
examples.english_sentence: I've already spoken to him on the phone; we talked for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢方面好通曉，成日幫人解答問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 fong1 min6 hou2 tung1 hiu2, sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 gaai2 daap3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這方面很通曉，經常幫人解答問題。
examples.english_sentence: He's very knowledgeable in this area and often helps people answer questions.

mandarin_meaning: 通便；缓解便秘，使大便通畅
english_meaning: to relieve constipation; to promote bowel movements
explanation_mandarin: 指使大便顺畅或缓解便秘的动作或方法，常用于医学或日常生活中讨论排便问题。
explanation_english: Refers to making bowel movements regular or relieving constipation; used in medical contexts or everyday talk about bowel function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經便秘兩日，醫生俾咗藥我食，終於通便喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 bin6 mat6 loeng5 jat6, ji1 sang1 bei2 zo2 joek6 ngo5 sik6, zung1 jyu1 tung1 bin6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经便秘两天，医生给了我药吃，终于通便了。
examples.english_sentence: I've been constipated for two days; the doctor gave me medicine and I finally relieved my constipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多飲水同食高纖食物可以幫助通便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 jam2 seoi2 tung4 sik6 gou1 sim1 sik6 mat6 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 tung1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多喝水和吃高纤维食物可以帮助通便。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking more water and eating high-fiber foods can help relieve constipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻通便藥幾好，用完冇咩不適。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 tung1 bin6 joek6 gei2 hou2, jung6 jyun4 mou5 me1 bat1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款通便药挺好，吃了没有什么不适。
examples.english_sentence: This laxative works well; after taking it I didn't feel any discomfort.

mandarin_meaning: 通俗（易懂、平易近人）
english_meaning: common; popular; plain and easy to understand; accessible
explanation_mandarin: 表示語言或風格簡單明瞭，容易被大多數人理解，常用於形容文字、講話或表達方式。
explanation_english: Describes language or style that is simple, plain, and easy for most people to understand; often used to describe writing, speech, or presentation style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書好通俗，人人都睇得明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hou2 tung1 zuk6, jan4 jan4 dou1 tai2 dak1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书很通俗，人人都能看懂。
examples.english_sentence: This book is very accessible; everyone can understand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好通俗，唔會用太多專業術語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 tung1 zuk6, m4 wui5 jung6 taai3 do1 zyun1 jip6 seot6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很通俗，不会用太多专业术语。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks plainly and doesn't use a lot of technical terms.

mandarin_meaning: 通信 / 通讯
english_meaning: correspondence; communication; to correspond
explanation_mandarin: 通信指通過書信、電郵、電話或電子訊息等方式進行聯絡或信息傳遞，也可指通訊系統或通信技術相關事務。
explanation_english: Communication or correspondence by letters, email, phone, or electronic messages; can also refer to communication systems or related technologies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋用電郵通信，咁樣比較方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jung6 din6 jau4 tung1 seon3, gam2 joeng6 bei2 gaau3 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们用电邮通信，这样比较方便。
examples.english_sentence: We correspond by email; it's more convenient this way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一直有通信，但未見面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 zik6 jau5 tung1 seon3, daan6 mei6 gin3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直有通信，但未见面。
examples.english_sentence: They've been corresponding, but they haven't met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅內部通信系統需要升級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 noi6 bou6 tung1 seon3 hai6 tung2 seoi1 jiu3 sing1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的内部通信系统需要升级。
examples.english_sentence: The company's internal communication system needs an upgrade.

mandarin_meaning: 通力（如：通力合作），表示共同出力、密切合作
english_meaning: to work together closely; to pool efforts; to cooperate closely
explanation_mandarin: 「通力」常與「合作/配合」等詞連用，表示各方共同出力、緊密協作以達成某個目標。
explanation_english: Used often with words like 'cooperate' or 'coordinate', it means to combine efforts and work closely together to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家通力合作，完成呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 tung1 lik6 hap6 zok3, jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家通力合作，完成这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone worked together to complete this project.

mandarin_meaning: 通力合作（tōng lì hé zuò）：大家齊心協力、一起合作完成某項任務或目標。
english_meaning: to cooperate closely; to work together with combined effort to achieve a goal.
explanation_mandarin: 表示各方共同出力、互相配合，集中力量去完成某件事或達成某個目標。
explanation_english: Indicates multiple parties working together, pooling effort and coordinating closely to accomplish a task or achieve an objective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要通力合作，先至可以完成呢個工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung1 lik6 hap6 zok3, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要通力合作，才能完成這個工程。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work together closely to complete this project.

mandarin_meaning: 通胜（通书、黄历、皇历）：中国传统的择日年历，记载节气、吉日与宜忌，用于选择嫁娶、入宅、动土等事项的吉日
english_meaning: Tongsheng (Chinese almanac): a traditional Chinese lunar almanac listing solar terms, auspicious and inauspicious days, and recommendations for selecting dates for events like weddings, moving house, and ground-breaking
explanation_mandarin: 通勝是一本傳統的中文年曆或擇日書，除了農曆日期和節氣外，還標示每日宜忌、吉凶、星宿等資訊，供人選擇做事、結婚、搬屋、開業等的好日子。
explanation_english: The tongue sheng is a traditional Chinese almanac that, besides lunar dates and solar terms, marks daily auspices and taboos, star positions, and recommendations for which activities are favorable or unfavorable — commonly used to pick dates for weddings, moving, openings, and other events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗本通勝，想睇下邊日宜嫁娶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bun2 tung1 sing3, soeng2 tai2 haa5 bin1 jat6 ji4 gaa3 ceoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一本通勝，想看看哪天適合結婚。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a Tongsheng almanac to check which days are auspicious for getting married.

mandarin_meaning: 通勤（上下班往返）
english_meaning: commute (travel between home and workplace)
explanation_mandarin: 指经常在家与工作地点之间往返；也可指上下班所需的行程或时间。
explanation_english: Refers to regularly traveling between home and the workplace; can denote the action of commuting or the time/distance involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都要由屋企通勤去中環，成日塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 jau4 uk1 kei2 tung1 kan4 heoi3 zung1 waan4, seng4 jat6 dou1 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要从家里通勤去中环，经常堵车。
examples.english_sentence: I have to commute from home to Central every day; there are often traffic jams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多公司提供在家工作，通勤次數減少咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gung1 si1 tai4 gung1 zoi6 gaa1 gung1 zok3, tung1 kan4 ci3 sou3 gim2 siu2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多公司提供在家工作，通勤次数减少了。
examples.english_sentence: Many companies now offer work-from-home, so the number of commutes has decreased.

mandarin_meaning: 通向；通往；連接到某處
english_meaning: to lead to; to connect to; to go through to
explanation_mandarin: 表示道路、通道或連線等連接並通往某處；也可用來表示某處可通行或通達。
explanation_english: Indicates that a road, passage, or connection leads to a place; can also mean that something is passable or connected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條小徑通去海邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 siu2 ging3 tung1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條小徑通往海邊。
examples.english_sentence: This path leads to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條樓梯唔通去頂層，頂層要搭電梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lau4 tai1 m4 tung1 heoi3 ding2 cang4, ding2 cang4 jiu3 daap3 din6 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段樓梯不通往頂層，去頂層要坐電梯。
examples.english_sentence: This staircase doesn't go up to the top floor; you need to take the elevator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橋通去對岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kiu4 tung1 heoi3 deoi3 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座橋通向對岸。
examples.english_sentence: The bridge goes to the opposite bank.

mandarin_meaning: 通史 (tōngshǐ)，指對某一地區或某一主題的全面、概括性的歷史記述或著作。
english_meaning: general history; a comprehensive history covering the full span of a region or topic
explanation_mandarin: 指概述或全面記述某一地區、時期或主題整體發展脈絡的歷史著作或史學體裁，通常覆蓋較長時間範圍而非專題細化研究。
explanation_english: Refers to a comprehensive historical account or historiographical genre that covers the overall development of a region, period, or topic across a long timespan, rather than a narrow specialist study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近喺圖書館借咗本中國通史嚟睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 ze3 zo2 bun2 zung1 gwok3 tung1 si2 lai4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近在圖書館借了一本中國通史來看。
examples.english_sentence: I recently borrowed a general history of China from the library to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史課程通常會教世界通史同各國通史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 fo3 cing4 tung1 soeng4 wui5 gaau3 sai3 gaai3 tung1 si2 tung4 gok3 gwok3 tung1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歷史課程通常會教授世界通史和各國通史。
examples.english_sentence: History courses generally teach world general history and the histories of various countries.

mandarin_meaning: 通告；通知；公告
english_meaning: announcement; notice; to announce
explanation_mandarin: 表示公開發布的消息或通知，告知一群人某項事項或變動。可作名詞（如一則通告）或動詞（通吿大家）。
explanation_english: An announcement or notice issued publicly to inform a group of people about an event, change, or information. Can be used as a noun (a notice) or a verb (to announce).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經發出通吿，話下星期放假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 faat3 ceot1 tung1 gou3, waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 fong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经发出通告，说下星期放假。
examples.english_sentence: The company has issued a notice saying there will be a holiday next week.

mandarin_meaning: 通知；公告
english_meaning: notice; announcement; to notify/announce
explanation_mandarin: 表示公開的通知或公告，作名詞指公告內容，作動詞指發出通知或公告。
explanation_english: A public notice or announcement. As a noun it refers to the announcement itself; as a verb it means to announce or notify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經喺大堂貼出通告，通知大家停水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 ji5ging1 hai2 daai6tong4 tip3 ceot1 tung1gou3, tung1zi1 daai6gaa1 ting4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经在大堂贴出通告，通知大家停水。
examples.english_sentence: The company has posted a notice in the lobby informing everyone of a water shutdown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校張貼咗通告，話下星期有家長會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 zoeng1 tip3 zo2 tung1gou3, waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 gaa1 zoeng2 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校张贴了通告，说下星期有家长会。
examples.english_sentence: The school has posted a notice saying there will be a parent-teacher meeting next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市政府發出通告，要求市民留喺屋企，避免外出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zing3 fu2 faat3 ceot1 tung1gou3, jiu1kau4 si5man4 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2, bei6min5 ngoi6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市政府发出通告，要求市民留在家里，避免外出。
examples.english_sentence: The city government issued a notice asking citizens to stay at home and avoid going out.

mandarin_meaning: 建立貿易關係；進行商業往來
english_meaning: to establish trade relations; to engage in commercial trade between entities (e.g., countries)
explanation_mandarin: 「通商」通常指國家或地區之間建立、恢復或維持貿易關係，進行商品與商業往來。
explanation_english: “通商” refers to establishing, resuming, or maintaining commercial/trade relations between countries or regions, allowing exchange of goods and commercial activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩國已經通商，貿易往來愈來愈頻繁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gwok3 ji5 ging1 tung1 soeng1, mau6 jik6 wong5 loi4 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 pan4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩國已經通商，貿易往來愈來愈頻繁。
examples.english_sentence: The two countries have established trade relations; commercial exchanges are becoming increasingly frequent.

mandarin_meaning: 疏通下水道；清理下水管道的堵塞
english_meaning: to unblock/clear a drain or sewer; to clear a clogged drain
explanation_mandarin: 「通坑渠」是廣東話的動詞短語，指清除坑渠（下水道、排水管）內的堵塞，使水流恢復暢通。常用於廁所、廚房或街道排水阻塞時的描述或請人處理。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "通坑渠" is a verb phrase meaning to clear or unblock a drain/sewer. It refers to removing blockages in toilets, kitchen drains, or street drains so water can flow freely, and is commonly used when asking for or describing drain-clearing work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所塞咗，叫人嚟通坑渠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 sak1 zo2, giu3 jan4 lai4 tung1 haang1 keoi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廁所堵了，叫人來疏通下水道吧。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet is clogged; call someone to clear the drain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雨之後，街上啲坑渠塞住，要請市政人員嚟通坑渠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 j zi1 hau6, gaai1 soeng6 di1 haang1 keoi4 sak1 zyu6, jiu3 cing2 si5 zing3 jan4 jyun4 lai4 tung1 haang1 keoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雨之後，街上的下水道堵住了，要請市政人員來疏通下水道。
examples.english_sentence: After heavy rain the street drains are blocked; we need to ask municipal workers to clear them.

mandarin_meaning: 通报（通知、報告）
english_meaning: to notify; to report; a notification or bulletin
explanation_mandarin: 表示向相關人士或公眾傳達消息或情況，既可作動詞（通知、報告），亦可作名詞（通告、報告）。
explanation_english: To inform or report information to relevant people or the public. Can be used as a verb (to notify/report) or as a noun (a notification/bulletin).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經通報咗所有員工有關呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 tung1 bou3 zo2 so2 jau5 jyun4 gung1 jau5 gwaan1 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經通報了所有員工有關這件事。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already notified all employees about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方會通報市民最新嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 wui5 tung1 bou3 si5 man4 zeoi3 san1 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方會向市民通報最新情況。
examples.english_sentence: The police will inform the public of the latest situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到通報之後，我哋要即刻跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 tung1 bou3 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到通報之後，我們要立即跟進。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the notification, we need to follow up immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 通天；非常厲害或離譜、厚顏無恥（視語境而定）
english_meaning: literally 'reach the heavens'; used to describe something extraordinary, extremely skilled, or outrageously brazen/shameless
explanation_mandarin: 口語或成語用法。可用來形容本領高到驚人（如「本領通天」），也可形容行為離譜、厚顏無恥（如「厚顏到通天」）。視語境可帶正面或負面含義。
explanation_english: An idiomatic adjective. Can describe someone whose skill or ability is astonishingly high, or describe conduct that is outrageous or shameless. The connotation (positive or negative) depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係通天，做咁嘅嘢都唔會覺得丟臉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 tung1 tin1, zou6 gam2 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 diu1 lim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是通天（厚顏無恥），做這種事都不覺得丟臉。
examples.english_sentence: He's really shameless; he doesn't even feel embarrassed doing that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一手通天嘅廚藝，個餸好味到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 sau2 tung1 tin1 ge3 ceoi4 ngai6, go3 sung3 hou2 mei6 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的廚藝非常高超，菜好吃得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: His cooking skills are extraordinary; the dishes are unbelievably good.

mandarin_meaning: 通天巴士（俚語）比喻能通達各方、幫人牽線搭橋或有廣泛人脈的人或渠道；也可幽默地指一種能直達很多地方的「特快」交通工具。
english_meaning: Literally 'sky-reaching bus'. Slang/jocular term for an all-purpose/express bus that seems to reach everywhere, or metaphorically for a person or channel with wide connections who can get things done.
explanation_mandarin: 「通天巴士」常用作比喻，指某人或某渠道有廣泛關係或資源，能幫助聯絡各方、辦妥事情；也可用於誇張地形容某條交通線路非常快捷、覆蓋面廣。
explanation_english: Used figuratively to describe a person or channel with extensive connections who can reach many people or get things done. It can also be used jokingly to describe a very fast or widely covering transport route.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵佢幫手啦，佢係我哋嘅通天巴士，可以幫我哋搵到所有人脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2 laa1, keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 tung1 tin1 baa1 si2, ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 wan2 dou3 so2 jau5 jan4 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找他幫忙吧，他是我們的「通天巴士」，可以幫我們找到所有人脈。
examples.english_sentence: Ask him for help — he's our '通天巴士'; he can help us reach all the contacts we need.

mandarin_meaning: 無所不知；自以為什麼都懂
english_meaning: to think oneself all‑knowing; to act as if one knows everything
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，帶有貶義，形容某人自以為認識很多、無所不知，常用於嘲諷或提醒不要自大。
explanation_english: A colloquial, often pejorative expression describing someone who acts as if they know everything; used to mock or warn against being overconfident about one's knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自以為通天曉，乜嘢都要教人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 ji5 wai4 tung1 tin1 hiu2, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 gaau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自以為無所不知，什麼事都要教別人。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he's all‑knowing and has to tell everyone how to do everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為識少少就通天曉，大家都有唔識嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 sik1 siu2 siu2 zau6 tung1 tin1 hiu2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 m4 sik1 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別以為懂一點就無所不知，大家都有不懂的地方。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you know a little you're all‑knowing; everyone has things they don't know.

mandarin_meaning: 通天老手／關係很廣、手段高明的人（含褒貶）
english_meaning: an old hand with extensive connections and crafty skills; someone who can get things done through deep contacts (can be admiring or pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「通天老倌」是粵語俗稱，指在某一領域經驗老到、手段高明且關係廣泛的人。視語境可帶有敬佩意味（資深、能幹）或貶義（圓滑、靠關係辦事、見不得光）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a veteran who is very skilled and has wide connections. Depending on context it can be complimentary (experienced, effective) or pejorative (slick, relying on connections or shady methods).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個通天老倌，乜嘢關係都有人幫手搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 tung1 tin1 lou5 gun1, mat1 je5 gwaan1 hai6 dou1 jau5 jan4 bong1 sau2 gaau2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个通天老倌，什么关系都有，能有人帮忙搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He's a '通天老倌' — he has connections everywhere and can get things done.

mandarin_meaning: 通奸 (tōngjiān) — 指已婚者與配偶以外的人發生性關係或維持婚外情
english_meaning: adultery; to commit adultery; extramarital affair
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: 法律及社會用語，指已婚者與配偶以外的人發生性關係或維持婚外情，某些司法管轄區會將其視為可訴行為。
explanation_english: A legal and social term referring to a married person having sexual relations with someone other than their spouse or maintaining an extramarital affair; in some jurisdictions it is a punishable or actionable act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人控告通姦，太太因此提出離婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 hung3 gou3 tung1 gaan1, taai3 taai2 jan1 ci2 tai4 ceot1 lei4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人控告通奸，妻子因此提出离婚。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of adultery, and his wife filed for divorce as a result.

mandarin_meaning: 两群体或不同姓氏、民族之间结婚（通婚、联姻）
english_meaning: to intermarry; marriage between different groups (e.g., clans, ethnicities, families)
explanation_mandarin: 「通婚」指不同群体、家族、姓氏或民族之間通過婚姻結合。常用於書面或學術語境，描述群體之間的婚配情況。
explanation_english: “通婚” refers to marriage between different groups, families, surnames, or ethnicities. It is often used in formal or descriptive contexts to denote intermarriage between groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個村入面，唔同姓氏嘅人都會通婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 cyun1 jap6 min6, m4 tung4 seng3 si6 ge3 jan4 dou1 wui5 tung1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩個村裡，不同姓氏的人都會通婚。
examples.english_sentence: In the two villages, people of different surnames often intermarry.

mandarin_meaning: 通宵（整晚、不睡覺或整晚進行某事）
english_meaning: overnight; all night; to stay up all night
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 名词 / 动词短语
explanation_mandarin: 表示整晚、通宵不睡或整晚進行某事。可作副詞（通宵工作）、名詞（通宵）或動詞短語（通宵趕工）。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something all night or staying up through the night. Can function as an adverb (e.g. work all night), a noun (an all-nighter), or a verb phrase (to stay up all night).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋要通宵趕功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung1 siu1 gon2 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们要通宵赶功课。
examples.english_sentence: We have to pull an all-nighter to finish our homework tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 整夜到天亮；通宵不眠
english_meaning: all night long; through the night until dawn (stay up all night)
explanation_mandarin: 表示整晚到天亮，常用以形容通宵不睡或整夜做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates staying up all night until dawn; commonly used to describe not sleeping or doing something throughout the night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋通宵達旦溫書，第二日好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung1 siu1 daat6 daan6 wan1 syu1, dai6 ji6 jat6 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们通宵达旦复习，第二天很累。
examples.english_sentence: We stayed up all night studying and were very tired the next day.

mandarin_meaning: 通常 / 一般
english_meaning: usually; generally; normally
explanation_mandarin: 表示在大多数情况下或习惯上发生的事，含義相當於「一般情況下」或「平時」，常用作副詞。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens in most cases or habitually; equivalent to 'usually' or 'generally'. Commonly used as an adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我通常朝早七點起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 ziu1zou2 cat1 dim2 hei2san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我通常早上七点起床。
examples.english_sentence: I usually get up at 7 a.m.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣好嘅時候，我通常會落街行下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1hei3 hou2 ge3 si4hau6, ngo5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 lok6 gaai1 haang4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气好的时候，我通常会出去走走。
examples.english_sentence: When the weather is good, I usually go out for a walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳通常好多人，要排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 tung1 soeng4 hou2 do1 jan4, jiu3 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅通常人很多，要排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is usually very crowded and you have to queue.

mandarin_meaning: 通往 / 通向 / 前往
english_meaning: to lead to; to head toward; to go to
explanation_mandarin: 表示从某处通向某地，说明方向或目的地，可作动词或介词性短语使用。
explanation_english: Indicates that something leads to or goes toward a place; used to express direction or destination, functioning as a verb or prepositional phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路通往市中心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 tung1wong5 si5 zung1sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路通往市中心。
examples.english_sentence: This road leads to the city center.

mandarin_meaning: 通情達理；懂得體貼、容易相處、彼此心意相通
english_meaning: understanding; considerate; on the same wavelength; easy to get along with
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話口語中，『通心』用來形容一個人很通情達理、體貼或與人相處融洽，亦可指彼此心意相通、容易互相理解。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adjective meaning someone is understanding or considerate, gets along easily with others, or that two people are on the same wavelength and understand each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好通心，成日幫我諗辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tung1 sam1, seng4 jat6 bong1 ngo5 nam2 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很通心，常常幫我想辦法。
examples.english_sentence: He's very understanding; he often helps me come up with solutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個好通心，講嘢好快就明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 tung1 sam1, gong2 je5 hou2 faai3 zau6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們倆很合得來，說話很快就能互相理解。
examples.english_sentence: We get along well — we understand each other quickly when we talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔通心，成日唔諗人感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 tung1 sam1, seng4 jat6 m4 lam2 jan4 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不體貼，常常不顧及別人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He's not considerate; he often doesn't think about other people's feelings.

mandarin_meaning: 通心粉（義大利通心粉/通心麵）；俚語：比喻頭腦空洞或容易受騙的人
english_meaning: macaroni (pasta); slang: someone who is airheaded or gullible
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（可作食物名；俚語比喻用時亦為名詞）
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指一種意大利通心粉（pasta）；在香港粵語口語中有時用作俚語，比喻某人頭腦空洞、容易受騙或不太聰明。
explanation_english: Literally refers to macaroni pasta. In Hong Kong Cantonese slang it can be used metaphorically to describe someone as airheaded, hollow-headed, or easily fooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋煮通心粉食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 zyu2 tung1 sam1 fan2 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們煮通心粉吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's cook and eat macaroni tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁容易受騙，真係通心粉一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gam2 jung6 ji6 sau6 pin3, zan1 hai6 tung1 sam1 fan2 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是這麼容易上當，真是個容易受騙的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's so easily fooled; he's such an airhead.

mandarin_meaning: 通情达理；通情達理（形容人通情達理，懂得體諒和講道理）
english_meaning: understanding and reasonable; sensible and considerate
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人很通情達理，懂得體諒別人、有道理且容易相處。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is understanding, reasonable, considerate, and easy to get along with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好通情達理，大家都鍾意同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tung1 cing4 daat6 lei5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很通情達理，大家都喜歡和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is very understanding and reasonable; everyone likes chatting with him.

mandarin_meaning: 聯覺；（修辭上）指感官互相轉換或混合的表現手法
english_meaning: Synesthesia (the blending of senses); also a rhetorical device that describes one sense in terms of another
explanation_mandarin: 指一種感官互相混合或互相影響的現象（如聽到聲音會見到顏色，亦稱聯覺）；在文學或修辭中，亦可指把一種感覺描寫成另一種感覺的表現手法。
explanation_english: Refers to synesthesia — a phenomenon where stimulation of one sense evokes another (e.g., hearing colors). In literature, it can also mean a rhetorical device that mixes sensory descriptions to create vivid imagery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢試過有通感，聽到音樂會見到顏色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 gwo3 jau5 tung1 gam2, teng1 dou2 jam1 ngok6 wui5 gin3 dou2 ngaan4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有通感，聽音樂會看到顏色。
examples.english_sentence: He has synesthesia; when he hears music he sees colors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺文學創作入面，作家會用通感作為修辭手法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 man4 hok6 cong3 zok3 jap6 min6, zok3 gaa1 wui5 jung6 tung1 gam2 zok3 wai4 sau1 ci4 sau2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在文學創作中，作家會把通感作為修辭手法。
examples.english_sentence: In literary writing, authors use synesthesia as a rhetorical device.

mandarin_meaning: 通才（通晓多种领域或技能的人；全才）
english_meaning: generalist; all-rounder; versatile person
explanation_mandarin: 指在多個領域或多種技能方面都有所涉獵和能力的人，能擔任不同類型的工作或任務。
explanation_english: A person skilled in multiple fields or tasks; an all-rounder who can handle various kinds of work or roles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個通才，識得做行政、設計同埋市場推廣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 tung1 coi4, sik1 dak1 zou6 hang4 zing3, cit3 gai3 tung4 maai4 si5 coeng4 teoi1 gwong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個通才，既會做行政，又會設計和市場推廣。
examples.english_sentence: He's an all-rounder who can handle administration, design, and marketing.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）搞定；解決；可以了
english_meaning: All sorted; sorted out; done; OK; it works
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示事情已經解決或安排好，或者表示某事可行、沒問題，也可用來說對方同意或通過。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that something is settled, sorted, or OK. It can indicate a problem has been resolved, that something is acceptable/works, or that someone has agreed/approved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗去問佢，佢話一切通掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 heoi3 man6 keoi5, keoi5 waa6 jat1 cai3 tung1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打電話去問他，他說一切都搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: I called him to ask; he said everything's sorted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 項目已經完成晒，全部通掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hong6 muk6 ji5 ging1 jyun4 sing4 saai3, cyun4 bou6 tung1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 項目已經全部完成了，一切都搞定。
examples.english_sentence: The project is completely finished; everything's sorted.

mandarin_meaning: 广为人知；传得很广，无法隐藏
english_meaning: widely known; out in the open; can't be hidden
explanation_mandarin: 「通晒天」是廣東話口語，用來表示某件事已經傳遍、大家都知道，沒法再隱瞞或掩蓋。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning that something has spread everywhere or become widely known — it can no longer be hidden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事而家已經通晒天，冇得再瞞住佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 tung1 saai3 tin1, mou5 dak1 zoi3 maan4 zyu6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事现在已经传得很广，没法再瞒着他们。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is already widely known now; you can't hide it from them anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲想悄悄處理？啲嘢早就通晒天啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 soeng2 ciu1 ciu1 cyu2 lei5? di1 je5 zou2 zau6 tung1 saai3 tin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还想悄悄处理？这些东西早就已经传遍了。
examples.english_sentence: You still want to handle it quietly? That stuff has long since been out in the open.

mandarin_meaning: 通畅
english_meaning: smooth; unimpeded; fluent
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有阻礙、通行或運作順利，也可指言語或思路流暢。常用於交通、體內通道或思路等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is unimpeded, flowing smoothly, or fluent (e.g., traffic, bodily passages, speech or train of thought).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝交通好通暢，巴士準時到站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 gaau1 tung1 hou2 tung1 coeng3, baa1 si2 zeon2 si4 dou3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上交通很通畅，公交车准时到站。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic was smooth this morning and the bus arrived on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要保持鼻竇通暢，先可以減少頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 bou2 zi6 bei6 dau6 tung1 coeng3, sin1 ho2 ji5 gam2 siu2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要保持鼻窦通畅，才能减少头痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said to keep the sinuses clear to reduce headaches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫作時如果思路通暢，文章會更易完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 zok3 si4 jyu4 gwo2 si1 lou6 tung1 coeng3, man4 zoeng1 wui5 gang3 ji6 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写作时如果思路通畅，文章会更容易完成。
examples.english_sentence: When ideas flow smoothly while writing, the composition is easier to finish.

mandarin_meaning: 通晓：精通、熟悉某一领域或事物
english_meaning: to be well-versed in; to have a thorough understanding of
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個領域或事物有深入的了解或熟悉，能運用相關知識或技能。
explanation_english: Indicates a deep understanding or familiarity with a field or subject, able to apply the related knowledge or skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢通曉多國語言，經常幫公司翻譯文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung1 hiu2 do1 gwok3 jyu5jin4, ging1 soeng4 bong1 gung1si1 faan1jik6 man4gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他通晓多种语言，经常帮公司翻译文件。
examples.english_sentence: He is well-versed in multiple languages and often helps the company translate documents.

mandarin_meaning: 通书 / 通胜（黄历）——列出每日宜忌、吉日与节气的传统历书
english_meaning: almanac; traditional Chinese almanac listing auspicious/inauspicious days, solar terms, and folk calendar information
explanation_mandarin: 通書是華人傳統的曆書（又稱通勝或黃曆），通常記載農曆日期、節氣、每日宜忌、吉日良辰，以及民間的占卜和習俗指引，常用於擇日嫁娶、開市、動土等活動。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese almanac (also called tong sheng or huangli) that records lunar calendar dates, solar terms, daily auspices and prohibitions, and guidance for folk rituals. People consult it to pick auspicious dates for weddings, openings, ground-breaking, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇過今年嘅通書未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 gwo3 gam1 nin4 ge3 tung1 syu1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看过今年的通书了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you checked this year's almanac?

mandarin_meaning: （香港零售/餐飲業用語）把貨物或物資從一個櫃位或分店調撥到另一處
english_meaning: (HK retail/hospitality jargon) to transfer stock/items from one counter/branch to another
explanation_mandarin: 「通櫃」多用於香港的商業語境，指把貨品或物資由一個櫃位、櫃台或分店調撥、轉移到另一個櫃位或分店。屬行話/口語用法。
explanation_english: "通櫃" is commonly used in Hong Kong business contexts to mean transferring goods or supplies from one counter, cabinet, or branch to another. It is trade jargon/informal usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋可以幫我通櫃啲貨去其他分店嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 tung1 gwai6 di1 fo3 heoi3 kei4 taa1 fan1 dim3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们可以帮我把货调到其他分店吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help transfer my stock to other branches?

mandarin_meaning: 通吃 / 橫掃 / 無往不勝
english_meaning: to sweep all opponents; to dominate; to be universally appealing
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，表示能擊敗所有對手或對各類群體都有吸引力，相當於“通吃”“橫掃”或“無往不勝”。
explanation_english: Slang meaning to defeat all opponents or to dominate; can also mean something or someone is universally appealing to many groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽佢通殺晒，冇人可以贏到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 keoi5 tung1 saat3 saai3, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 jeng4 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次比賽他橫掃全場，沒有人能贏他。
examples.english_sentence: He swept the competition this time; nobody could beat him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰種笑容真係男女都通殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 zung2 siu3 jung4 zan1 hai6 naam4 neoi5 dou1 tung1 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那種笑容真的是對男女都很有吸引力。
examples.english_sentence: That smile of his really appeals to both men and women.

mandarin_meaning: 通知；通风（使空气流通）
english_meaning: to inform/give someone a heads-up; to ventilate (let air circulate)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中“通氣”常用作动词，主要有两种用法：1）把消息告诉别人、提醒或打招呼（例如：幫我通氣）；2）使空间有空气流通，即通风（较书面可用“通风”表示）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, “通氣” is commonly used as a verb with two main senses: 1) to inform someone / give a heads-up (e.g., ask someone to notify others); 2) to ventilate / allow air to circulate (i.e., ventilate a room).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我通氣，叫佢哋準時嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 tung1hei3, giu3 keoi5 dei6 zeon2 si4 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以幫我通個氣，叫他們準時來？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give them a heads-up and tell them to come on time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房冇窗，無法通氣，成日好焗促。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong4 mou5 coeng1, mou4 faat3 tung1hei3, seng4 jat6 hou2 guk1 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間沒有窗，沒法通風，經常很悶。
examples.english_sentence: The room has no windows and can't be ventilated, it's always very stuffy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同我通氣話老闆今晚唔返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 tung1hei3 waa6 lou5 baan2 gam1 maan5 m4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他告訴我說老闆今晚不來上班。
examples.english_sentence: He let me know that the boss won't be coming in tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 接通水源；（俚語）打通關係、走後門或行賄
english_meaning: to connect the water supply; (slang) to grease someone's palm, use connections or bribe to get approval
explanation_mandarin: 「通水」在粵語中可作字面意思，指接通或疏通水喉、供水；在香港口語中亦常作俚語，指透過關係、賄絡或打點，使事情得以通過或獲批。
explanation_english: Literally, 'to connect or unblock the water supply'. Colloquially in Hong Kong Cantonese, it's slang for using connections, bribery, or influence to get something approved or to 'grease the wheels'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師父今日幫間屋通水，依家有得沖涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu6 gam1 jat6 bong1 gaan1 uk1 tung1 seoi2, ji1 gaa1 jau5 dak1 cung1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 師父今天幫那間房子接通了水，現在可以沖澡了。
examples.english_sentence: The technician connected the house's water supply today; now we can shower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程係因為有人通水先過到關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 hai6 jan1 wai6 jau5 jan4 tung1 seoi2 sin1 gwo3 dou3 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個工程是因為有人打通關係才通過的。
examples.english_sentence: This project was approved because someone greased the wheels / used connections.

mandarin_meaning: 男妓／男伴（陪侍或提供性服務以賺取報酬的年輕男性）
english_meaning: male escort / gigolo (young men who provide companionship or sexual services for pay)
explanation_mandarin: 「通波仔」是香港的俚語，通常指以陪伴或性服務為職業、為女性（尤其是有錢或年長女性）提供陪伴或性交易的年輕男性。此詞帶有口語與貶義色彩。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong slang term referring to young men who work as escorts or gigolos, providing companionship and sometimes sexual services to women (often wealthy or older women). The term is informal and can be pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係通波仔，專門陪啲有錢阿姨食飯、睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 tung1 bo1 zai2, zyun1 mun4 pui4 di1 jau5 cin2 aa3 ji4 sik6 faan6, tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是通波仔，專門陪有錢的阿姨吃飯、看電影。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be a '通波仔' — a male escort who accompanies wealthy older women to meals and movies.

mandarin_meaning: 疏通下水道；清理堵塞的下水道或排水管
english_meaning: to unclog/unblock drains or pipes; to clear a blocked sewer or drainage
explanation_mandarin: 指用工具或化學方法清理堵塞的下水道、馬桶或排水管，讓水流恢復暢通。在香港日常用語中常用來描述請人來處理下水道堵塞的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to clearing blockages in drains, toilets, or pipes using tools or chemicals so that water can flow freely again. Commonly used in Hong Kong to describe calling someone to deal with clogged drains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所堵咗，叫人嚟通渠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 dou2 zo2, giu3 jan4 lai4 tung1 keoi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所堵住了，叫人来通渠吧。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet is blocked — call someone to unblock the drain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 洗手盆有嘢卡住，今晚要搵人通渠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 sau2 pun4 jau5 je5 kaa1 zyu6, gam1 maan5 jiu3 wan2 jan4 tung1 keoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洗手盆有东西卡住，今晚要找人通渠。
examples.english_sentence: Something is stuck in the sink; we need to get someone to unclog it tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 疏通下水道的工人、通渠工人
english_meaning: a drain cleaner / a worker who unblocks drains and sewers (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指專門疏通下水道、馬桶等堵塞的工人或技工。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a worker or tradesman who clears blockages in drains, sewers, or toilets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所塞咗，叫咗個通渠佬上嚟疏通一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 sak1 zo2, giu3 zo2 go3 tung1 keoi4 lou2 soeng5 lai4 so1 tung1 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所堵了，叫了个通渠工来疏通一下。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet is clogged; I called a drain cleaner to come and unblock it.

mandarin_meaning: 下水道疏通剂 / 通渠剂
english_meaning: drain cleaner; drain unblocker (chemical liquid used to clear clogged drains)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來疏通下水道或排水管的化学药水，通常具有腐蚀性或刺激性，用於溶解或分解堵塞物，使用及處理時需小心。
explanation_english: A chemical liquid used to unclog drains or pipes. It is often caustic or irritating and is used to dissolve or break down blockages. Handle and dispose of it with care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所塞咗，買啲通渠水嚟通下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 sak1 zo2, maai5 di1 tung1 keoi4 seoi2 lai4 tung1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所堵了，买一些通渠水来疏通一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The toilet is clogged; buy some drain cleaner to clear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 通渠水好刺激，唔好畀細路接觸到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung1 keoi4 seoi2 hou2 zik1 gik1, m4 hou2 bei2 sai3 lou6 zip3 cuk1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 通渠剂很刺激，不要让小孩子接触到。
examples.english_sentence: Drain cleaner is very caustic; don't let children come into contact with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將通渠水倒落水渠，會污染環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 tung1 keoi4 seoi2 dou3 lok6 seoi2 keoi4, wui5 wun6 jim5 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把通渠水倒入水沟，会污染环境。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pour drain cleaner into the gutter; it will pollute the environment.

mandarin_meaning: 爽快、直率、豪爽（口語）
english_meaning: frank; straightforward; easygoing; refreshingly candid
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容人或說話、行為直爽、不拘謹，讓人覺得舒服或痛快。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adjective describing someone or their speech/behavior as frank, straightforward, and unpretentious — often making others feel comfortable or refreshed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好通爽，成日都講真心話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tung1 song2, sing4 jat6 dou1 gong2 zan1 sam1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她很通爽，經常說真心話。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very straightforward and often speaks from the heart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得好通爽，大家都舒服晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 hou2 tung1 song2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 syu1 fuk6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說得很爽快，大家都覺得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: You spoke very frankly — everyone felt comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 通用 / 普遍适用
english_meaning: general-purpose; universal; commonly used; applicable across different situations
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物在多种情況或多個系統中都能使用或適用；也可以作動詞，指使某物成為通行使用。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is broadly applicable or usable across different situations or platforms; can also be used as a verb meaning to make something commonly used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款軟件係通用嘅，可以喺唔同平台使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 jyun5 gin6 hai6 tung1 jung6 ge3, ho2 ji5 hai2 m4 tung4 ping4 toi4 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款软件是通用的，可以在不同平台使用。
examples.english_sentence: This software is general-purpose; it can be used on different platforms.

mandarin_meaning: 普遍存在的缺點或毛病
english_meaning: a common problem or recurring fault; a typical weakness
explanation_mandarin: 指在多個人、事物或系統中常見、普遍出現的缺陷或問題。
explanation_english: Refers to a defect, flaw, or problem that commonly appears across many people, items, or systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅通病係員工流失率高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ge3 tung1beng6 hai6 jyun4 gung1 lau4 sat1 leot6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家公司的通病是員工流失率高。
examples.english_sentence: A common problem in this company is a high staff turnover rate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部手機相機嘅色差係一種通病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau2 gei1 soeng1 gei1 ge3 sik1 caa1 hai6 jat1 zung2 tung1beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手機相機的色差是一種通病。
examples.english_sentence: Chromatic aberration in phone cameras is a common problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將小問題放大，嗰啲其實屬於系統嘅通病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 siu2 man6 tai4 fong3 daai6, go2 di1 kei4 sat6 suk6 jyu1 hai6 tung2 ge3 tung1beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把小問題誇大，那些其實屬於系統的通病。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blow small issues out of proportion; those actually belong to the system's common problems.

mandarin_meaning: 通知（告知、發佈消息或公告）
english_meaning: notify; inform; notice; announcement
explanation_mandarin: 向某人告知訊息或發出正式的公告或通知。
explanation_english: To inform or make someone aware of something; can also mean a notice or announcement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經用電郵通知所有員工開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 jung6 din6 jau4 tung1 zi1 so2 jau5 jyun4 gung1 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經用電子郵件通知所有員工開會。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already notified all employees of the meeting by email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校會提前通知家長放假安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 wui5 tai4 cin4 tung1 zi1 gaa1 zoeng2 fong3 gaa3 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校會提前通知家長有關放假的安排。
examples.english_sentence: The school will notify parents in advance about the holiday arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到一則通知，話下星期要停水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 jat1 zak1 tung1 zi1 waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 ting4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到一則通知，說下星期要停水。
examples.english_sentence: I received a notice saying the water will be shut off next week.

mandarin_meaning: 通知书 (书面通知、函件)
english_meaning: notice; notification letter; written notice
explanation_mandarin: 以書面或函件形式發出的通知，常由學校、公司或政府機構等發出，用以告知入學、處分、罰款、面試、會議等正式事項。
