examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋週末會去郊外參加造林義工活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zau1 mut6 wui5 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 caam1 gaa1 zou6 lam4 ji6 gung1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们周末会去郊外参加造林义工活动。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the outskirts this weekend to join an afforestation volunteer event.

mandarin_meaning: 草率；鲁莽；匆忙
english_meaning: hasty; rash; careless
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事匆忙、草率或鲁莽，常用以形容行為不慎重。
explanation_english: Indicates acting hastily, carelessly, or rashly; often describes behavior lacking caution or deliberation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁造次，慢慢嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6 ci3, maan6 maan6 lai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么草率，慢慢来！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hasty; take your time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太造次，結果搞到件事更亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 zou6 ci3, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 gin6 si6 gang3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太鲁莽，结果把事情弄得更乱。
examples.english_sentence: He was too rash and ended up making the situation worse.

mandarin_meaning: 造物主（zàowùzhǔ）：指創造萬物的神或上帝，也可泛指創造者。
english_meaning: The Creator — the divine being who created the universe; can also mean a creator or originator.
explanation_mandarin: 指創造萬物的神或上帝；也可泛指任何創造者或起源者，常出現在宗教、哲學和文學語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to a being who creates all things (often God); may be used more generally for any creator or originator. Common in religious, philosophical, and literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺好多宗教入面，造物主被視為宇宙嘅創造者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hou2 do1 zung1 gaau3 jap6 min6, zou6 mat6 zyu2 bei6 si6 wai4 jyu5 zau6 ge3 cong3 zou6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在很多宗教中，造物主被视为宇宙的创造者。
examples.english_sentence: In many religions, the Creator is regarded as the originator of the universe.

mandarin_meaning: 把某人或某事神化；过度偶像化
english_meaning: to idolize; to deify; to mythologize someone
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示把某人或某事捧得像神一样，过度美化或偶像化，常用于批评媒体、经纪公司或粉丝对名人、公众人物的夸大宣传。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to prop someone up as a godlike figure — to excessively glorify or idolize a person or thing. Often used critically about media, promoters, or fans who exaggerate someone's qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲傳媒成日造神啲明星，令到佢哋承受好大壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cyun4 mui4 sing4 jat6 zou6 san4 di1 ming4 sing1, ling6 dou3 keoi5 dei6 sing4 sau6 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体总是把明星神化，导致他们承受很大压力。
examples.english_sentence: The media keeps idolizing celebrities, causing them to bear a lot of pressure.

mandarin_meaning: 造福 (zàofú)：給人或群體帶來利益或福祉
english_meaning: to bring benefits; to confer blessings or welfare on someone or a group
explanation_mandarin: 表示為某些人或群體帶來好處、利益或福祉，常用於「為……造福」的結構，例如政府或機構實施措施以改善民生。
explanation_english: Indicates bringing advantages, benefits, or welfare to people or a group. Commonly used in structures like 'to bring benefits to ...', often referring to policies, projects, or actions intended to improve people's well-being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府呢個新政策係為市民造福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3 hai6 wai6 si5 man4 zou6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府這個新政策是為市民造福。
examples.english_sentence: This new government policy is meant to benefit the citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院引入新技術可以為病人造福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jan5 jap6 san1 gei6 seot6 ho2 ji5 wai6 beng6 jan4 zou6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院引入新技術可以為病人造福。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital's adoption of new technology can benefit patients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生都致力為人民造福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sang1 dou1 zi3 lik6 wai6 jan4 man4 zou6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生都致力為人民造福。
examples.english_sentence: He devoted his life to benefiting the people.

mandarin_meaning: 造福人群（造福人民、造福群眾）
english_meaning: to benefit the people; to bring benefits to the masses
explanation_mandarin: 指为广大人民或特定群体带来好处、福利或改善生活条件的行为、政策或措施。
explanation_english: Refers to actions, policies, or measures that bring benefits, welfare, or improved living conditions to a broad group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新政策真係可以造福人羣，改善大家嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3 zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 zou6 fuk1 jan4 kwan4, goi2 sin6 daai6 gaa1 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個新政策真的可以造福人群，改善大家的生活。
examples.english_sentence: This new policy can truly benefit the people and improve everyone's lives.

mandarin_meaning: 造福人民／使大眾受益
english_meaning: to benefit people; to bring advantages or welfare to a group of people
explanation_mandarin: 表示通過行動、政策或措施為社會或特定群體帶來利益或福祉。
explanation_english: Refers to actions, policies, or measures that bring benefits, welfare, or advantages to society or a specific group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出呢個新政策，目的係造福人群，特別係低收入嘅家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3, muk6 dik1 hai6 zou6 fuk1 jan4 kwan4, dak6 bit6 hai6 dai1 sau1 jap6 ge3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出這個新政策，目的是造福人群，特別是低收入的家庭。
examples.english_sentence: The government launched this new policy aimed at benefiting the people, especially low-income families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成立基金會，長期目標係造福人群同支援弱勢社群。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 laap6 gei1 gam1 wui6, coeng4 kei4 muk6 biu1 hai6 zou6 fuk1 jan4 kwan4 tung4 zi1 wun6 joek6 sai3 se5 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們成立基金會，長期目標是造福人群並支援弱勢社群。
examples.english_sentence: They established a foundation whose long-term goal is to benefit the people and support vulnerable communities.

mandarin_meaning: 造访（zàofǎng）— 访问、拜访
english_meaning: to visit; to pay a visit (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 表示前往拜訪某人或到某地參觀／訪問，語氣較正式，常用於官方或書面語境。
explanation_english: Indicates going to visit someone or a place; a formal term often used in official or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去日本造訪朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 zou6 fong2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去日本造访朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I'll visit a friend in Japan next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總理上週造訪咗本地嘅慈善機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 lei5 soeng6 zau1 zou6 fong2 zo2 bun2 dei6 ge3 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总理上周造访了本地的慈善机构。
examples.english_sentence: The premier visited a local charity last week.

mandarin_meaning: 造诣（在学问、艺术或技艺上达到的程度与成就）
english_meaning: level of attainment; depth of accomplishment or proficiency in a particular field (e.g., art, scholarship, skill)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一领域（如学问、艺术、技艺）上所达到的造访、造就或精深程度。
explanation_english: Refers to the degree of achievement, skill, or depth someone has reached in a particular domain such as scholarship, art, or technique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺書法方面嘅造詣好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 syu1faat3 fong1min6 ge3 zou6 ji6 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在書法方面的造詣很深。
examples.english_sentence: His level of attainment in calligraphy is very deep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位教授喺中醫方面嘅造詣好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 gaau3sau6 hai2 zung1 ji1 fong1min6 ge3 zou6 ji6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位教授在中醫方面的造詣很高。
examples.english_sentence: This professor has a very high level of expertise in traditional Chinese medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想提升烹飪嘅造詣，就要多試新食譜同練習技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 tai1sing1 paang1jam6 ge3 zou6 ji6, zau6 jiu3 do1 si3 san1 sik6 pou2 tung4 lin6 zaap6 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想提升烹飪的造詣，就要多嘗試新食譜並練習技巧。
examples.english_sentence: To improve your culinary skill level, you need to try new recipes and practice techniques.

mandarin_meaning: 造谣 (zàoyáo)
english_meaning: to fabricate or spread rumors; to spread false information
explanation_mandarin: 捏造或散布沒有根據的消息，以誤導或中傷他人。
explanation_english: To fabricate or spread unverified or false information (rumors) that misleads or harms others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂造謠，會害死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 zou6 jiu4, wui5 hoi6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要隨便造謠，會害人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spread rumors; they can hurt people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人為咗出名而造謠，真係唔應該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wai4 zo2 ceot1 ming4 ji4 zou6 jiu4, zan1 hai6 m4 jing1 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人為了出名而造謠，真的不應該。
examples.english_sentence: Some people fabricate rumors to get famous; that's really wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 散播或造謠可能犯法，會畀人告你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan3 bo3 waak6 zou6 jiu4 ho2 nang4 faat3 faat3, wui5 bei2 jan4 gou3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 散播或造謠可能違法，會被人告你。
examples.english_sentence: Spreading or fabricating rumors may be illegal; you could be sued.

mandarin_meaning: 造谣生事（散布謠言並挑起事端）
english_meaning: to spread rumors and stir up trouble; to fabricate rumors to cause trouble
explanation_mandarin: 指散佈謠言、挑起事端或故意引發衝突，通常帶有誹謗或煽動性質。
explanation_english: Refers to spreading rumors and provoking trouble or conflicts, often with defamatory or inflammatory intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂造謠生事，會害到無辜嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 zou6 jiu4 saang1 si6, wui5 hoi6 dou3 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要亂造謠生事，會害到無辜的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't recklessly spread rumors and stir up trouble; it can harm innocent people.

mandarin_meaning: 酿酒；制造酒类（也可口语指去喝酒、聚饮）
english_meaning: to brew/distill alcohol; to make liquor. (Informally: to drink alcohol or go drinking)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指製造或釀造酒類（如米酒、白酒等）。在口語或俚語中，有時也用來表示去喝酒、聚飲或大吃大喝（非正式用法）。
explanation_english: Usually means to manufacture or ferment alcoholic beverages. Informally, it can also be used to mean going out to drink or drinking heavily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺鄉下自家造酒做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 zi6 gaa1 zou6 zau2 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在乡下自家酿酒做生意。
examples.english_sentence: They brew alcohol at home in the countryside as a business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔好講工作，去酒吧造酒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 m4 hou2 gong2 gung1 zok3, heoi3 zau2 baa1 zou6 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚别谈工作，去酒吧喝酒吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about work tonight; let's go to the bar and drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話係用傳統方法造酒，味道好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 hai6 jung6 cyun4 tung2 fong1 faat3 zou6 zau2, mei6 dou6 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说是用传统方法酿酒，味道很香。
examples.english_sentence: He said they brew the liquor using traditional methods; it tastes very fragrant.

mandarin_meaning: 造謠；編造（謠言、故事）；製造事端、炒作
english_meaning: to fabricate or spread rumors; to make up stories; to create drama or stir up trouble
explanation_mandarin: 口語、俚語用法，指捏造並散播沒有根據的事情或謠言，也可指刻意製造矛盾或炒作、搞事。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term meaning to invent and spread baseless rumors or stories. It can also mean deliberately creating conflict or stirring up drama.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上造馬，講啲冇根據嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 zou6 maa5, gong2 di1 mou5 gan1 geoi3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成日在網上造謠，說些沒有根據的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is always making up rumors online and saying things without any basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再造馬啦，大家都唔想被你搞到有事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi6 zou6 maa5 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 bei6 nei5 gaau2 dou3 jau5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再造謠了，大家也不想因為你被搞出事端。
examples.english_sentence: Stop stirring up drama — nobody wants trouble because of you.

mandarin_meaning: 遇到；每逢（表示每当）
english_meaning: to meet; to encounter; whenever (as in 'whenever' or 'on the occasion of')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 介詞（常見於短語如「每逢」）
explanation_mandarin: 「逢」表示遇到或碰上，常用於「每逢⋯⋯」表示每當某個時候或場合。
explanation_english: Used to mean 'to meet' or 'to encounter'. Often appears in the fixed expression '每逢...' to mean 'whenever' or 'on the occasion of'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每逢新年，屋企人都會返嚟團聚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 fung4 san1 nin4, uk1 kei5 jan4 dou1 wui5 faan1 lai4 tyun4 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每逢新年，家人都会回家团聚。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever it's the New Year, family members always return home to reunite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我逢星期一有中文堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fung4 sing1 kei4 jat1 jau5 zung1 man4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每逢星期一有中文课。
examples.english_sentence: I have Chinese class every Monday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每逢考試前我都好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 fung4 haau2 si3 cin4 ngo5 dou1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每逢考试前我都很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I always get very nervous before exams.

mandarin_meaning: 逢凶化吉（féng xiōng huà jí）：遇到凶險或不利情況，最後化解危機，轉為平安或有利。
english_meaning: To avert disaster and turn misfortune into good fortune; to turn a dangerous or unfavorable situation into a safe or favorable outcome.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容在遭遇不利或危險時，最終化解險情，轉為平安或順利。
explanation_english: An idiom describing the outcome where a perilous or unfavorable situation is resolved and becomes safe or favorable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幸好最後只係一個誤會，件事先至逢凶化吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang6 hou2 zeoi3 hau6 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 ng6 wui6, gin6 si6 sin1 zi3 fung4 hung1 faa3 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好最後只是一个误会，事情才得以逢凶化吉。
examples.english_sentence: Fortunately it turned out to be only a misunderstanding in the end, and the matter was averted and resolved safely.

mandarin_meaning: 逢十進一（十進位制中的進位規則）；也可泛指每滿十個就增加一個或提升一級。
english_meaning: The 'carry one at ten' rule in base-10 arithmetic; metaphorically, for every ten items/units add one or move up one level.
explanation_mandarin: 指十進位制的進位規則：當某位數達到十時，向更高一位進一。日常語境也可用來比喻每滿十就增加一個或升一級的做法。
explanation_english: Refers to the carry-over rule in base-10 arithmetic: when a digit reaches ten, carry one to the next higher place. It can also be used metaphorically to mean 'for every ten, add one' or 'promote one for every ten'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 計數時要記住逢十進一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 sou3 si4 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 fung4 sap6 zeon3 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算數時要記住逢十進一。
examples.english_sentence: When calculating, remember to carry one at ten (the base-10 carry rule).

mandarin_meaning: 逢场作戏（表示把感情或事情當作玩笑或過場，不認真）
english_meaning: to treat something as a game; to play along casually; a fling or going through the motions
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對感情、事情或應酬不認真，只是隨便應付、玩玩或走過場。
explanation_english: Used to describe treating a relationship, matter, or social situation lightly — not being serious, merely playing along or going through the motions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己只係逢場作戲，唔想認真交往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 zi2 hai6 fung4 coeng4 zok3 hei3, m4 soeng2 jing6 zan1 gaau1 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己只是逢场作戏，不想認真交往。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's just playing around and doesn't want a serious relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再當佢講嗰啲係真心，可能淨係逢場作戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 dong3 keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 hai6 zan1 sam1, ho2 nang4 zing6 hai6 fung4 coeng4 zok3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再把他說的當真，可能只是逢场作戏。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take what he says seriously — it might just be a fling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工我只係逢場作戲，真正嘅志向係創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ngo5 zi2 hai6 fung4 coeng4 zok3 hei3, zan1 zeng3 ge3 zi3 hoeng3 hai6 cong3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作我只是逢场作戏，真正的志向是創業。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just going through the motions in this job; my real ambition is to start a business.

mandarin_meaning: 逢场作兴：一时兴起，随兴而为，图一时之乐
english_meaning: To do something on a whim for temporary pleasure; to go along for the fun of it without serious intent
explanation_mandarin: 原指在戲場遇到機會即興表演，現多用來形容為了一時的興致或享樂而隨便做某事，通常不打算認真或長期投入。
explanation_english: Originally referred to improvising performances in a show; now commonly used to describe doing something on impulse for short-lived enjoyment, usually without serious or long-term commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係逢場作興，唔想認真拍拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 fung4 coeng4 zok3 hing3, m4 soeng2 jing6 zan1 paak3 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是逢场作兴，不想认真谈恋爱。
examples.english_sentence: He's just fooling around; he doesn't want a serious relationship.

mandarin_meaning: 遇見或探望親戚；拜訪親人（尤指節日或團聚時）
english_meaning: to meet or visit relatives; to see family (often used for visits during festivals or family gatherings)
explanation_mandarin: 「逢親」在廣東話中常指與親戚見面或探訪親人，尤其在節日或家庭聚會時使用，可指拜年、探親等行為。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "逢親" refers to meeting or visiting relatives, commonly used for family visits during festivals or gatherings (e.g., paying New Year calls, visiting kin).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年我哋要返屋企逢親拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faan1 uk1 kei5 fung4 can1 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過年我們要回家拜年、見親戚。
examples.english_sentence: At Lunar New Year we go home to visit relatives and offer New Year greetings.

mandarin_meaning: 奉承、迎合（以討好他人以取得好處）
english_meaning: to flatter; to ingratiate oneself; to pander to someone
explanation_mandarin: 以奉承或迎合的言行討好他人，通常為了取得好感或某種利益。
explanation_english: To flatter or cater to someone’s wishes in order to gain favor or advantage; to ingratiate oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日向上司逢迎，大家都覺得好反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hoeng3 soeng5 si1 fung4 jing4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常向上司逢迎，大家都覺得很反感。
examples.english_sentence: He often flatters his boss; everyone finds it really off-putting.

mandarin_meaning: 連（lián）：連接、包含；也用作副詞/連詞表示“連…都/也（even）”
english_meaning: connect; include; even (as an adverb/conjunction)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 副詞 / 連詞 / 介詞
explanation_mandarin: 「連」可作動詞，表示把事物連接或聯繫；也可作副詞/連詞，用於「連…都／也」表示強調或意外性；有時用作表示包含（相當於「包括」）。
explanation_english: „連‟ can be a verb meaning to connect or link; it can also function as an adverb/conjunction in constructions like „連...都/也‟ to mean „even...‟, and sometimes as a preposition meaning „including‟.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連細路都識用智能電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 sai3 lou6 dou1 sik1 jung6 zi6 nang4 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 連小孩都會使用智能電話。
examples.english_sentence: Even children know how to use smartphones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條橋連埋兩邊嘅路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 kiu4 lin4 maai4 loeng5 bin1 ge3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座橋把兩邊的路連起來。
examples.english_sentence: This bridge connects the roads on both sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 價錢已經連埋稅喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 cin2 ji5 ging1 lin4 maai4 seoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 價格已經包含稅金了。
examples.english_sentence: The price already includes tax.

mandarin_meaning: 連中三元
english_meaning: to achieve three consecutive top honors / to win three times in a row
explanation_mandarin: 原指古代科舉考試中連續考中狀元、榜眼、探花等名次，後來引申為在三次重要比賽或事件中接連獲得勝利或重要成就。
explanation_english: Originally referred to achieving the top ranks in the three levels of the imperial examinations; now used figuratively for attaining three consecutive major successes or winning three times in a row.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺三次比賽都奪冠，真係連中三元。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 saam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 dou1 dyut6 gun1, zan1 hai6 lin4 zung1 saam1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在三次比賽都奪冠，真是連中三元。
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship in three consecutive competitions — truly a case of 'three-time top winner'.

mandarin_meaning: 一連串（通常指接連發生的一系列事件，常含負面）
english_meaning: a string/series (of events); a succession (often of problems or incidents)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容接連發生的一系列事情或事件，常指一連串的問題或麻煩。
explanation_english: Used to describe a succession or series of events or incidents, often referring to multiple problems or setbacks occurring one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近公司出咗連串嘅問題，搞到大家好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 si1 ceot1 zo2 lin4 cyun3 ge3 man6 tai4, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司出了一連串的問題，弄得大家很頭痛。
examples.english_sentence: Recently the company had a string of problems, which has given everyone a headache.

mandarin_meaning: （非標準用法）可能為「連任」的誤寫，亦可能為人名或地名。若作「連任」解，意為繼續擔任同一職務或再次當選。
english_meaning: (Nonstandard) possibly a misspelling of '連任' (to be re-elected / to continue in the same post), or a personal/name form.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 專有名詞（人名）或（誤寫時）動詞
partOfSpeech_english: proper noun (personal name) or (when a misspelling of '連任') verb
explanation_mandarin: 「連仁」並非常見廣東話詞語。常見情況有兩種：一是作為人名或地名使用，讀作 lin4 jan4；二是印刷或輸入錯誤，把「連任」寫成「連仁」。若本意為「連任」，正確寫法應為「連任」（jyutping: lin4 jam6），意思是繼續擔任同一職位或再次當選。
explanation_english: “連仁” is not a common Cantonese lexical item. Two typical uses: as a personal/place name pronounced lin4 jan4, or as a typographical/mistaken writing of '連任'. If intended as '連任' (jyutping: lin4 jam6), it means to continue in the same post or to be re-elected. Use the correct form '連任' for that meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿叔個名叫連仁，佢住喺屯門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 suk1 go3 meng4 giu3 lin4 jan4, keoi5 zyu6 hai2 tyun4 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我舅父（或叔父）叫連仁，他住在屯門。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle's name is Lian Ren; he lives in Tuen Mun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報道寫錯，將「連任」寫成「連仁」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou3 se2 co3, zoeng1 'lin4 jam6' se2 seng4 'lin4 jan4'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻报道写错，把“連任”写成“連仁”。
examples.english_sentence: The news report made a typo, writing '連仁' instead of '連任'.

mandarin_meaning: 连任 (liánrèn)
english_meaning: to be re-elected; to continue in office
explanation_mandarin: 指继续担任原来的职务，通常指通过选举或任命再次担任公职或职位。
explanation_english: To continue holding the same office, typically by being re-elected or reappointed to the position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次成功連任市長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 sing4 gung1 lin4 jam6 si5 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次成功连任市长。
examples.english_sentence: He was successfully re-elected as mayor this time.

mandarin_meaning: 連續假期；連休
english_meaning: consecutive holidays; extended holiday (e.g., long weekend)
explanation_mandarin: 指連續幾天的假期，通常因週末或公眾假期連在一起而形成較長的休假，台灣與華語圈常用詞。
explanation_english: Refers to consecutive days off or holidays (often when weekends and public holidays join), creating an extended break; commonly used in Taiwan and other Chinese-speaking areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月有四日連假，我哋去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 jau5 sei3 jat6 lin4 gaa3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下個月有四天連假，我們去旅行吧。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a four-day consecutive holiday next month; let's go on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為放連假，公司改咗星期一先返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 fong3 lin4 gaa3, gung1 si1 goi2 zo2 sing1 kei4 jat1 sin1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為放連假，公司改到星期一才上班。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the extended holiday, the company moved the return-to-work day to Monday.

mandarin_meaning: 連同 / 一起、與…一同（包含、帶上）
english_meaning: together with; along with; including
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某人或某物與其他人或物一同包含或帶上，常用於正式或書面語，例如在文件或通知中表示「和……一起」包含在內。
explanation_english: Indicates including or bringing someone/something together with others; often used in formal or written contexts (e.g., in documents or notices meaning 'together with' or 'including').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我連同屋企人一齊去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lin4 tung4 uk1 kei5 jan4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我連同家人一起去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a trip together with my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請將申請表連同所需文件一併遞交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 zoeng1 san1 cing2 biu2 lin4 tung4 so2 seoi1 man4 gin6 jat1 bing6 dai6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請將申請表連同所需文件一併遞交。
examples.english_sentence: Please submit the application form along with the required documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會連同薪酬通知一同發出合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 lin4 tung4 san1 cau4 tung1 zi1 jat1 tung4 faat3 ceot1 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會連同薪酬通知一同發出合約。
examples.english_sentence: The company will issue the contract together with the salary notification.

mandarin_meaning: 连坐（连带责任、株连）
english_meaning: guilt by association; collective responsibility; joint/collective punishment
explanation_mandarin: 指因一人或少數人的過失或罪行，而牽連其他相關或無關的人承受懲罰或責任的制度或行為。歷史上常見於某些社會或司法制度中，現代多帶貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to holding others (often relatives, neighbors, or associates) responsible or punished because of one person's wrongdoing — a system or practice of collective responsibility. Historically used in some societies; today the term usually has negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時有連坐制度，一個人犯法可能會牽連成個家族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 jau5 lin4 co5 zai3 dou6, jat1 go3 jan4 faan6 faat3 ho2 nang4 wui5 hin1 lin4 sing4 go3 gaa1 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时有连坐制度，一个人犯法可能会牵连整个家族。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times there was the system of collective punishment; one person's crime could implicate the whole family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用連坐去懲罰無辜嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 lin4 co5 heoi3 cing4 fat6 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用连坐来惩罚无辜的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use collective punishment to punish innocent people.

mandarin_meaning: 连同；包括
english_meaning: including; together with; along with
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示把某人或某物包含在內或與…一起。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese coverb/preposition used to indicate inclusion — 'including' or 'together with'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我邀請咗幾個朋友，連埋你一齊嚟得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu1 cing2 zo2 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5, lin4 maai4 nei5 jat1 cai4 lai4 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我邀请了几个朋友，连你一起可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: I've invited a few friends — can I include you too?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個價錢連埋服務費都已經包咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gaa3 cin2 lin4 maai4 fuk6 mou6 fai3 dou1 ji5 ging1 baau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格连服务费都已经包括了。
examples.english_sentence: The price already includes the service charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔喺到，連埋其他人都未到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai2 dou6, lin4 maai4 kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 mei6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不在，连其他人也还没到。
examples.english_sentence: He's not here; even the others haven't arrived.

mandarin_meaning: 连夜（在当晚或通宵进行）
english_meaning: overnight; that same night; through the night
explanation_mandarin: 表示在同一夜间或當晚進行某事，常用以強調在夜間加緊處理或立即行動。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something during the same night or overnight; often used to emphasize working intensively or taking immediate action through the night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我連夜趕工，終於趕完份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 lin4 je6 gon2 gung1, zung1 jyu1 gon2 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我连夜赶工，终于赶完了那份报告。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked me to work overnight, and I finally finished that report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連夜離開咗香港，唔再返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 je6 lei4 hoi1 zo2 hoeng1 gong2, m4 zoi3 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连夜离开了香港，不再回来。
examples.english_sentence: He left Hong Kong that very night and didn't come back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護人員連夜搶救受傷嘅病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 lin4 je6 coeng2 gau3 sau6 seong1 ge3 beng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医护人员连夜抢救受伤的病人。
examples.english_sentence: Medical staff worked through the night to save the injured patients.

mandarin_meaning: 包工包料（價格包括人工和材料費）
english_meaning: Labour and materials included (price covers both labour and materials)
explanation_mandarin: 表示報價或合約包含人工和材料費用，常用於裝修、修理等勞務行業，意即不用另付材料或人工額外費用。
explanation_english: Indicates that a quoted price or contract covers both labour and materials. Commonly used in services like renovation or repairs to mean no extra charge for materials or labour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間裝修公司話價錢連工包料，唔使再俾其他費用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zong1 sau1 gung1 si1 waa6 gaa3 cin2 lin4 gung1 baau1 liu6, m4 sai2 zoi3 bei2 kei4 taa1 fai3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間裝修公司說價格是連工包料，不用再支付其他費用。
examples.english_sentence: The renovation company said the price includes labour and materials, so we don't need to pay any other fees.

mandarin_meaning: 连带 (liándài)
english_meaning: together; jointly; concomitantly; linked (often in legal/causal sense)
explanation_mandarin: 表示与主要事物一并牵连或共同承担（如“连带责任”），也可用作副词表示一并、同时牵连。
explanation_english: Indicates being implicated or included together with something else, often used for joint responsibility (e.g. "joint liability"); can also act as an adverb meaning "together/along with."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要負連帶責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu3 fu6 lin4 daai3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他要负连带责任。
examples.english_sentence: He must bear joint (or joint-and-several) responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事連帶影響到我哋嘅工作安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 lin4 daai3 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 zok3 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事连带影响到我们的工作安排。
examples.english_sentence: This matter also affected our work arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連帶自己嘅利益都唔顧，想幫手幫到大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 daai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei6 jik6 dou1 m4 gu3, soeng2 bong1 sau2 bong1 dou3 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连带自己的利益都不顾，想帮大家的忙。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't even consider his own interests and wanted to help everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 连年
english_meaning: for consecutive years; year after year
explanation_mandarin: 表示連續好幾年，常用於書面或較正式的語境，用來描述某種情況或事件持續多年，可指好事或壞事。
explanation_english: Indicates that something occurs for several years in a row; often used in formal or written contexts to describe a situation or event persisting across multiple years (can describe positive or negative occurrences).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年連年乾旱，農夫損失好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 lin4 nin4 gon1 hon6, nung4 fu1 syun2 sat1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年连年干旱，农民损失很大。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, consecutive droughts have caused great losses to farmers.

mandarin_meaning: 连忙
english_meaning: hastily; hurriedly; promptly; immediately
explanation_mandarin: 表示迅速地、匆忙地去做某事，常用作副詞，表示立刻或趕緊的反應或動作。
explanation_english: An adverb meaning to do something quickly or hurriedly; indicates a prompt or immediate reaction or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到消息，連忙出門幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 siu1 sik1, lin4 mong4 ceot1 mun4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到消息，連忙出門幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard the news, he hurriedly went out to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到小朋友跌倒，媽媽連忙衝過去扶起佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 siu2 pang4 jau5 dit3 dou2, maa4 maa1 lin4 mong4 cung1 gwo3 heoi3 fu4 hei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到小朋友跌倒，媽媽連忙衝過去扶起他。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the child fall, the mother quickly rushed over to help him up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣有緊急嘅事，佢連忙停止報告去處理問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6 jau5 gan2 gap1 ge3 si6, keoi5 lin4 mong4 ting4 zi2 bou3 gou3 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會的時候有緊急的事情，他連忙停止報告去處理問題。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting there was an urgent matter, so he promptly stopped the report to deal with the issue.

mandarin_meaning: 連續演出／連場演出
english_meaning: to perform/appear in consecutive shows or episodes; back-to-back performances
explanation_mandarin: 指演員或節目在短時間內接連上場或連續播出，多用於表示連續演出或接連播出的集數或場次。
explanation_english: Refers to actors or programs appearing in successive performances or episodes without a break; used to describe back-to-back shows or consecutive broadcasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個星期要連戲三日，搞到冇時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 sing1 kei4 jiu3 lin4 hei3 saam1 jat6, gaau2 dou3 mou5 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這個星期要連續演出三天，沒時間休息。
examples.english_sentence: He has to perform three days in a row this week, so he has no time to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 連續掃蕩；連續獲勝或連續奪得（比賽或獎項）
english_meaning: to sweep consecutively; to win or take several times in a row (e.g., matches or awards)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常見於體育、比賽或頒獎場合，表示連續取得勝利或奪得多個獎項，也可指接連清掃或掃蕩（比喻性）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb used mainly in sports, competitions, or award contexts to indicate achieving consecutive wins or taking multiple awards in a row; can also be used figuratively to mean sweeping/clearing repeatedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今季球隊連掃五場，球迷好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gwai3 kau4 deoi2 lin4 sou3 ng5 coeng4, kau4 mai4 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今季球隊連掃五場，球迷很高興。
examples.english_sentence: This season the team swept five matches in a row; the fans are very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺頒獎禮連掃三個獎，大家都好替佢開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baan1 zoeng2 lai5 lin4 sou3 saam1 go3 zoeng2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 tai3 keoi5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在頒獎典禮上連掃三個獎，大家都為他高興。
examples.english_sentence: He swept three awards at the ceremony; everyone is happy for him.

mandarin_meaning: 連接 (liánjiē)
english_meaning: connect; link; join; connect to
explanation_mandarin: 表示把兩個或多個物體、系統、裝置或地點互相連成一體或使其相互通訊、相連通。
explanation_english: To join or link two or more objects, systems, devices, or places so that they are connected or can communicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦連接唔到 Wi‑Fi。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 lin4 zip3 m4 dou3 Wi‑Fi
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台電腦連接不上 Wi‑Fi。
examples.english_sentence: This computer can't connect to the Wi‑Fi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座橋連接咗兩個島嶼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 kiu4 lin4 zip3 zo2 loeng5 go3 dou2 jyu5
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座橋連接了兩個島嶼。
examples.english_sentence: This bridge connects two islands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要用電纜連接兩個裝置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 jung6 din6 laam4 lin4 zip3 loeng5 go3 zong1 zi3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要用電纜連接兩個裝置。
examples.english_sentence: You need to use a cable to connect the two devices.

mandarin_meaning: 連詞 / 連接詞（用來連接詞語、短語或句子的詞）
english_meaning: conjunction (a word that connects words, phrases, clauses, or sentences)
explanation_mandarin: 連接詞是用來連接詞語、短語、從句或句子的詞，表示關係如並列、轉折、因果等。
explanation_english: A conjunction is a word used to connect words, phrases, clauses, or sentences, indicating relationships such as coordination, contrast, cause, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連接詞可以用嚟連接兩個句子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 zip3 ci4 ho2 ji5 jung6 lei4 lin4 zip3 loeng5 go3 geoi3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 連詞可以用來連接兩個句子。
examples.english_sentence: Conjunctions can be used to connect two sentences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 例如：但係、而且、因為都係連接詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lai6 jyu4 daan6 hai6, ji4 ce2, jan1 wai6 dou1 hai6 lin4 zip3 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 例如：「但是」、「而且」、「因為」都是連詞。
examples.english_sentence: For example: 'but', 'and', and 'because' are all conjunctions.

mandarin_meaning: 连日（连续多日）
english_meaning: for consecutive days; day after day; continuously for several days
explanation_mandarin: 表示连续多日，常用作时间状语，描述某事在多日内持续发生。
explanation_english: Indicates multiple consecutive days; used as a temporal adverbial to describe something happening continuously over several days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排連日落雨，啲街都積水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 lin4 jat6 lok6 jyu5, di1 gaai1 dou1 zik1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段时间连日下雨，街上都积水。
examples.english_sentence: It has been raining for days recently; the streets are flooded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我連日發燒，要返醫院覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 lin4 jat6 faat3 siu1, jiu3 faan1 ji1 jyun2 fuk1 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我连日发烧，需要回医院复诊。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I've had a fever for several consecutive days and need to return to the hospital for a follow-up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連日忙住做報告，我冇時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 jat6 mong4 zyu6 zou6 bou3 gou3, ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连日忙着做报告，我没有时间休息。
examples.english_sentence: I've been busy doing reports for days and haven't had time to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 连本带利
english_meaning: principal plus interest; to repay or receive the original amount together with interest
explanation_mandarin: 表示連同本金和利息一起付出或收回，常用於借貸、還款等情況；也可比喻把原有的加上附加的東西一併拿回或討回。
explanation_english: Indicates returning or receiving both principal and interest; commonly used in contexts of loans and repayments. It can also be used metaphorically to mean taking back the original plus any additional gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔還，佢會要求你連本帶利賠返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 waan4, keoi5 wui5 jiu1 kau3 nei5 lin4 bun2 daai3 lei6 pui4 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不還，他會要求你连本带利赔回来。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't repay, he'll demand you pay back the principal plus interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係好講信用，上次借我錢都唔肯連本帶利還我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 gong2 seon3 jung6, soeng6 ci3 ze3 ngo5 cin2 dou1 m4 hang2 lin4 bun2 daai3 lei6 waan4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不太守信用，上次向我借的錢也不肯连本带利還我。
examples.english_sentence: He's not very trustworthy; last time he borrowed money from me, he refused to repay me with interest.

mandarin_meaning: 連根拔起（连根拔起），徹底根除、根本消滅
english_meaning: to uproot completely; to eradicate root and branch; to eliminate something entirely
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把不良事物或問題徹底根除，不留後患。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to remove or eliminate something completely and thoroughly so nothing remains to cause trouble later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決心連根拔起貪污文化，唔會放過一個貪官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 sam1 lin4 gan1 bat6 hei2 taam1 wu1 man4 faa3, m4 wui5 fong3 gwo3 jat1 go3 taam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府決心連根拔起貪污文化，不會放過任何貪官。
examples.english_sentence: The government is determined to uproot the culture of corruption and won't spare any corrupt officials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵樹已經死晒，要連根拔起先可以避免有病害再傳播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 syu6 ji5 ging1 sei2 saai3, jiu3 lin4 gan1 bat6 hei2 sin1 ho2 ji5 bei6 min5 jau5 beng6 hoi6 zoi3 cyun4 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這棵樹已經死透了，要連根拔起才能避免病害再傳播。
examples.english_sentence: This tree is completely dead; it must be uprooted to prevent the disease from spreading again.

mandarin_meaning: 一文不值；毫无价值（粗俗用语，表示极度轻蔑）
english_meaning: Not worth a damn; worthless (vulgar slang expressing strong contempt)
explanation_mandarin: 「連毛監屎」是廣東話粗俗的俚語，用以形容某物或某人毫無價值、極其可鄙。字面帶有污衊與下流成分，不適合正式場合使用，常用於強烈貶低或斥責的語境中。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang phrase used to describe something or someone as utterly worthless. Literally crude and insulting, it conveys strong contempt and is inappropriate in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲垃圾作品連毛監屎都唔值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 laat6 saap3 zok3 ban2 lin4 mou4 gaam3 si2 dou1 m4 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些垃圾作品连一根屎毛都不值。
examples.english_sentence: These trash works aren't worth a damn.

mandarin_meaning: 連續地；接連地
english_meaning: continuously; consecutively; in succession
explanation_mandarin: 表示動作或情況連續不斷、接連發生，屬口語用法，常在句中作狀語使用。
explanation_english: Indicates actions or states occurring continuously or one after another; a colloquial Cantonese adverb often used as an adverbial modifier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連氣講咗三句嘢，我都聽唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lyun4 hei3 gong2 zo2 saam1 geoi3 je5, ngo5 dou1 teng1 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他連續說了三句話，我都聽不及。
examples.english_sentence: He said three sentences in a row; I couldn't keep up.

mandarin_meaning: 连汤带水都一起捞走；把所有东西一并拿走（含贪取每一点好处的意味）
english_meaning: to scoop up everything including the sauce; to take every last bit or grab every possible benefit
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，字面上是把連同汁一起撈走。引申為把所有東西或利益全部攬盡，不放過任何一點好處。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese phrase literally meaning to scoop up even the sauce. Figuratively it means to take everything or to grab every possible benefit, leaving nothing behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到碗入面仲有汁，就想連汁撈埋拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 wun2 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 zap1, zau6 soeng2 lin4 zap1 laau1 maai4 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到碗里還有湯汁，就想連湯一起舀走。
examples.english_sentence: He saw there was still sauce in the bowl and wanted to scoop everything up, sauce included.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）連湯汁也一起舀走；（引申）形容很貪心，連最不起眼的東西也要占為己有
english_meaning: (literal) even scoop up the sauce/gravy; (figurative) so greedy as to take everything, not leaving even the sauce
explanation_mandarin: 「連汁都撈埋」原是指把食物上的汁液也一併撈起來。引申用法用來形容人很小氣或貪心，連看似微不足道的東西也不放過。
explanation_english: Originally refers to scooping up the sauce/gravy as well. Figuratively used to describe someone being greedy or stingy, not leaving even the smallest things for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好小氣，連汁都撈埋唔畀人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu2 hei3, lin4 zap1 dou1 lou1 maai4 m4 bei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很小氣，連湯汁都要撈走，不給別人。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy; he even scoops up the sauce and doesn't leave any for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你用麵包撈碟上嘅醬，連汁都撈埋，太誇張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jung6 min6 baau1 lou1 dip6 soeng5 ge3 zoeng3, lin4 zap1 dou1 lou1 maai4, taai3 kwaa1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你用麵包把盤上的醬都擦乾淨，連湯汁也一起撈走，太誇張了。
examples.english_sentence: You used bread to mop up the sauce on the plate — even scooping up the gravy; that's over the top.

mandarin_meaning: 把相關的人或事一併處理、徹底清除或嚴厲處罰（含有連累或連帶處理的意思）
english_meaning: to deal with something decisively and comprehensively, eliminating or punishing the person(s) involved and any associated elements; to wipe out or take down everything related
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，表示把問題或責任連帶處理，通常指徹底清除、懲罰或一併追究相關的人或事，常帶有嚴厲或不留後路的含義。
explanation_english: A colloquial idiom meaning to handle an issue by dealing with all related parties or elements together, often implying thorough elimination or harsh punishment without leaving loose ends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司發現有員工偷嘢，老闆即刻連消帶打，將啲涉事人都炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 faat3 jin6 jau5 jyun4 gung1 tau1 je5, lou5 baan2 zik1 hak1 lin4 siu1 daai3 daa2, zoeng1 di1 sip3 si6 jan4 dou1 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司發現有員工偷東西，老闆立刻連消帶打，把涉事的人都炒了。
examples.english_sentence: When the company discovered an employee was stealing, the boss immediately dealt with it harshly and fired all those involved.

mandarin_meaning: 连珠炮发（连珠炮式地连续发出言语或问题）
english_meaning: to fire off a rapid succession of remarks/questions; rapid-fire delivery
explanation_mandarin: 形容說話或發問像連珠炮一樣接連不斷、迅速而密集，常用於描述連續提出問題或評論的情況。
explanation_english: Describes speaking or questioning in a rapid, continuous, and concentrated way — like a barrage. Often used when someone fires off many questions or remarks in quick succession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上連珠炮發，提出咗十幾個問題，令大家都無言以對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 lin4 zyu1 paau3 faat3, tai4 ceot1 zo2 sap6 gei2 go3 man6 tai4, ling6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 mou4 jin4 ji5 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在會議上連珠炮發，提出了十幾個問題，讓大家都無言以對。
examples.english_sentence: At the meeting he fired off a rapid succession of questions — over a dozen — leaving everyone speechless.

mandarin_meaning: 连珠炮发（连珠炮式地连续发言或发问）
english_meaning: to fire off a rapid series of remarks or questions; to speak in rapid succession (rapid-fire)
explanation_mandarin: 形容连续、快速地发表言论或提出问题，像一连串炮弹或子弹接连射出，常用于形容口头上的连续攻击或密集提问。
explanation_english: Describes speaking or asking questions rapidly and continuously, like a volley of cannon shots; often used for rapid-fire remarks, a barrage of questions, or continuous verbal attacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者對佢連珠砲發問題，佢都好冷靜回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 deoi3 keoi5 lin4 zyu1 paau3 faat3 man6 tai4, keoi5 dou1 hou2 laang5 zing6 wui4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者连珠炮发地提问，他都很冷静地回应。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters fired off a barrage of questions at him, and he responded calmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺聚會上連珠砲發，好多無謂嘅八卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zeoi6 wui5 soeng6 lin4 zyu1 paau3 faat3, hou2 do1 mou4 wai6 ge3 baat3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在聚会上连珠炮发，说了很多无谓的八卦。
examples.english_sentence: He was spouting off a rapid stream of gossip at the party.

mandarin_meaning: 连环（连续、相连、成链的）
english_meaning: serial; successive; linked; chain-like
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（用作構詞成分或前綴，表示連續、相連）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (often used as a prefix/modifier in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物相互連接、接連發生或呈鏈狀關係。常見於複合詞，如「連環畫」「連環殺手」「連環計」等。
explanation_english: Indicates things that are connected in a chain, successive, or occurring one after another. Frequently used as a modifier in compounds (e.g., '连环画' = comics, '连环 killer' = serial killer).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近發生咗幾宗連環盜竊案，警方好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 faat3 sang1 zo2 gei2 zung1 lin4 waan4 dou6 caak6 on3, ging2 fong1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近发生了几起连环盗窃案，警方很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: There have been several linked thefts recently; the police are very tense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路鍾意睇連環畫，成日拎住本唔放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zung1 ji3 tai2 lin4 waan4 waa2, seng4 jat6 ling1 zyu6 bun2 m4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子喜歡看连环画，總是拿著不放。
examples.english_sentence: Kids like reading comic books and often hold onto them without putting them down.

mandarin_meaning: 连环图 / 连环画（指以一系列连续图画叙述故事的图像形式）
english_meaning: comic strip; sequence of illustrations telling a story; picture-story
explanation_mandarin: 指由多幅連續圖畫組成、用來敘述故事或情節的圖像形式，類似漫畫或連環畫，常見於報刊、書籍或兒童讀物。
explanation_english: Refers to a series of consecutive illustrations used to tell a story or depict scenes, similar to comic strips or picture storybooks; commonly found in newspapers, books, and children's publications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日鍾意睇連環圖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 seng4 jat6 zung1 ji3 tai2 lin4 waan4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子經常喜歡看連環圖。
examples.english_sentence: Kids often like to read comic strips.

mandarin_meaning: 連續、接連、屢次
english_meaning: repeatedly; consecutively; one after another
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情接連發生或屢次出現，強調連續性或重複性。
explanation_english: Indicates that events occur repeatedly or consecutively, emphasizing continuity or repetition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排公司連番加班，大家都好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gung1 si1 lin4 faan1 gaa1 baan1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司連番加班，大家都很累。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the company has been repeatedly having overtime; everyone is very tired.

mandarin_meaning: LIHKG（香港的網上討論區），也常指該論壇的用戶或在該平台發表的討論／帖文
english_meaning: LIHKG (a Hong Kong online discussion forum); also refers to the forum itself, its users, or posts/discussions on the platform
explanation_mandarin: 「連登」是香港流行的討論平台 LIHKG 的音譯或簡稱，常用來指該論壇、其用戶或在上面發表的討論與消息，屬於網絡用語／俗稱。
explanation_english: “連登” is the Cantonese name/abbreviation for LIHKG, a popular Hong Kong online forum. It commonly refers to the site itself, its users, or posts/discussions on the platform; it is an internet slang term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人喺連登討論緊呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 hai2 lin4 dang1 tou2 leon6 gan2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家在連登正在討論這件事。
examples.english_sentence: People on LIHKG are discussing this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 连笔（书写方式），笔画连在一起的写法；连笔字，草写
english_meaning: cursive/connected handwriting; to write without lifting the pen (i.e., joining strokes)
explanation_mandarin: 指書寫時把筆畫連在一起的寫法（連筆字），也可以指動作“把字寫成連筆”的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to writing where strokes are connected (cursive/connected handwriting). Can be used as a noun (connected handwriting) or a verb (to write in a connected/cursive style).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲字成日連筆，好多人睇唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 zi6 sing4 jat6 lyun4 bat1, hou2 do1 jan4 tai2 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的字经常连笔，很多人看不懂。
examples.english_sentence: My handwriting is often cursive, and many people can't read it.

mandarin_meaning: 连累 (使他人受到牵连或连带受害)
english_meaning: to implicate; to involve someone in trouble; to cause someone to suffer because of one's actions
explanation_mandarin: 指由于自己的行为或失误，使别人受到牵连、遭受麻烦或损害。常见用法有“连累到/被连累/不要连累别人”。
explanation_english: To cause someone else to be implicated, harmed, or suffer consequences because of one's actions or mistakes. Commonly used as 'to implicate', 'to get someone involved in trouble'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想連累你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 lin4 leoi6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想连累你。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to get you involved / I don't want to cause you trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做會連累成個團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 wui5 lin4 leoi6 seng4 go3 tyun4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做会连累整个团队。
examples.english_sentence: If you do that, you'll end up implicating the whole team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為我而被連累咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ngo5 ji4 bei6 lin4 leoi6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为我而被连累了。
examples.english_sentence: He got implicated because of me.

mandarin_meaning: 連結；連接；關聯（liánjié）
english_meaning: to link; to connect; a link or connection
explanation_mandarin: 表示把兩個事物或概念連在一起，或指兩者之間的關聯或鏈接，可以指實體、系統或抽象關係。
explanation_english: Indicates linking or connecting two things or concepts, or the relationship/connection between them; can refer to physical links, system connections, or abstract relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個系統之間冇連結。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 go3 hai6 tung2 zi1 gaan1 mou5 lin4 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這兩個系統之間沒有連結。
examples.english_sentence: There is no connection between these two systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要建立更好嘅連結同合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gin3 laap6 gang3 hou2 ge3 lin4 git3 tung4 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們需要建立更好的連結與合作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to establish better connections and cooperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發咗個連結俾你，快啲開睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 zo2 go3 lin4 git3 bei2 nei5, faai3 di1 hoi1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我發了一個連結給你，快點打開看看。
examples.english_sentence: I sent you a link—open it quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 连绵
english_meaning: continuous; uninterrupted; stretching on
explanation_mandarin: 表示持续不断、延绵不绝的状态，可用来形容山脉、雨势或事物连续不断的情形；亦常见于成语「連綿不絕」。
explanation_english: Indicates something continuous and uninterrupted; used to describe things like mountain ranges, persistent rain, or any unbroken sequence. Often appears in the idiom "連綿不絕" (unceasing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連綿嘅山脈望唔到盡頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 min4 ge3 saan1 mak6 mong6 m4 dou2 zeon6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连绵的山脉看不到尽头。
examples.english_sentence: The continuous mountain ranges seem to have no end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排成日落雨，連綿幾日都冇停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 sing4 jat6 lok6 jyu5, lin4 min4 gei2 jat6 dou1 mou5 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近老是下雨，连续好几天都没停。
examples.english_sentence: It's been raining continuously lately for several days without stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅來電連綿不絕，打擾到我做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 loi4 din6 lin4 min4 bat1 zyut6, daa2 jiu2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的来电连绵不绝，打扰到我做事。
examples.english_sentence: Their calls kept coming one after another, disturbing me at work.

mandarin_meaning: 連綿不絕 / 綿延不斷（连续不断）
english_meaning: continuous; unceasing; uninterrupted; in an endless succession
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物連續不斷、沒有間斷，常用於描述天氣、聲音、事件等長時間持續的情況。
explanation_english: Describes something that continues without interruption; commonly used for weather, sounds, events, etc., to indicate a long, unbroken sequence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排落雨連綿不絕，行山都唔方便，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 lin4 min4 bat1 zyut6, haang4 saan1 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近下雨連綿不絕，爬山都不方便，很危險。
examples.english_sentence: It has been raining continuously lately; hiking is inconvenient and very dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 连线；联网、建立连接或进行远程连线（例如视像会议、直播连线、远程连线采访）。
english_meaning: to connect/link up (a network or communication line); to go online; to patch in a remote feed (e.g., video conference or live broadcast connection).
explanation_mandarin: 指透過網路或通訊設備建立連接，或把現場與遠端透過線路或網絡接通，用於視訊會議、直播、遠端訪問等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to establishing a connection via a network or communication equipment, linking a local and remote endpoint. Commonly used for video conferences, live broadcast links, remote interviews, or general network connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家要連線開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 lin4 sin3 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在要连线开会。
examples.english_sentence: We need to connect for a meeting now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網絡唔好，連線成日斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 lok3 m4 hou2, lin4 sin3 sing4 jat6 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网络不好，连线总是断。
examples.english_sentence: The network is bad; the connection keeps dropping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電台今晚要連線訪問外地專家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 toi4 gam1 maan5 jiu3 lin4 sin3 fong2 man6 ngoi6 dei6 zyun1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电台今晚要连线访问外地专家。
examples.english_sentence: The station will connect tonight to interview an overseas expert.

mandarin_meaning: 聯繫 / 聯系（联系，liánxì）
english_meaning: to contact; to connect; contact; connection
explanation_mandarin: 表示建立或保持聯絡、接觸或關係。可用作動詞（聯絡、聯系）或名詞（聯繫、關係）。
explanation_english: Indicates establishing or maintaining contact or a connection. Can be used as a verb (to contact/connect) or as a noun (a contact/connection).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要保持連繫，咁先可以互相幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 lin4 hai6, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 wu6 soeng1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要保持联系，这样才能互相帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: We should keep in touch so we can help each other.

mandarin_meaning: 连续
english_meaning: continuous; consecutive; successive
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物不間斷地持續或接連發生，可作形容詞或動詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates that something continues without interruption or occurs successively; can function as an adjective or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近佢連續加班好幾日，都攰到喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 keoi5 lin4 zuk6 gaa1 baan1 hou2 gei2 jat6, dou1 gui6 dou3 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近他连续加班好几天，都累到要哭了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working overtime for several consecutive days lately and is so tired he could cry.

mandarin_meaning: 连声（连续不断地说或发出声响）
english_meaning: repeatedly; continuously; in quick succession (often used with verbs like apologize, praise, cheer)
explanation_mandarin: 表示连续不断地说话或发出声响，常用于“连声道歉”、“连声称赞”等场合，强调次数多或持续。
explanation_english: Indicates doing or saying something repeatedly or continuously; often used with verbs such as apologize, praise, or cheer to emphasize repeated or continuous action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連聲道歉，求我原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 sing1 dou6 hip3, kau4 ngo5 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连声道歉，求我原谅。
examples.english_sentence: He kept apologizing, begging me to forgive him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 觀眾連聲叫好，掌聲不斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gun1 zung3 lin4 sing1 giu3 hou2, zoeng2 sing1 bat1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 观众连声叫好，掌声不断。
examples.english_sentence: The audience kept cheering; the applause never stopped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆見到孫女，連聲讚佢乖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po5 gin3 dou3 syun1 neoi5, lin4 sing1 zaan3 keoi5 gwaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶见到孙女，连声夸她乖。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma, upon seeing her granddaughter, kept praising how well-behaved she was.

mandarin_meaning: 连词（表示连接词语或句子的词类）
english_meaning: conjunction (a word that connects words, phrases, or clauses)
explanation_mandarin: 連詞是語法上的一類詞，用來連接詞語、短語或子句，例如「和」、「但是」、「因為」等。
explanation_english: A conjunction is a grammatical word class used to link words, phrases, or clauses (e.g., "and", "but", "because").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連詞喺語法入面用嚟連接詞語或者子句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 ci4 hai2 jyu5faat3 jap6min6 jung6 lai4 lin4 zip3 ci4 jyu5 waak6 ze2 zi2 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连词在语法中用来连接词语或子句。
examples.english_sentence: In grammar, conjunctions are used to connect words or clauses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 英文入面，"and"同"but"都係連詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 man4 jap6 min6, "and" tung4 "but" dou1 hai6 lin4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在英语中，"and"和"but"都是连词。
examples.english_sentence: In English, "and" and "but" are both conjunctions.

mandarin_meaning: 连贯
english_meaning: coherent; continuous; connected
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can also be used as a verb)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物前後銜接、沒有中斷，內容或結構一致且有條理。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is connected or continuous without breaks; describes coherence, consistency, or logical linkage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅理由前後連貫，令人信服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 lei5 jau4 cin4 hau6 lin4 gwaan3, ling6 jan4 seon3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的理由前後連貫，令人信服。
examples.english_sentence: His reasons are coherent and convincing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段影片剪接得唔好，節奏唔連貫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 jing2 pin2 zin2 zip3 dak1 m4 hou2, zit3 zau2 m4 lin4 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段影片剪輯得不好，節奏不連貫。
examples.english_sentence: This clip was edited poorly; the pacing is not coherent.

jyutping: lin4 jeng4 (亦可讀作 lyun4 jeng4)
mandarin_meaning: 連勝 / 接連贏
english_meaning: to win consecutively; to have a winning streak
explanation_mandarin: 表示連續取得勝利，常用於體育比賽或強調接連獲勝的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates winning repeatedly in succession; commonly used in sports or contexts emphasizing a string of victories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊今季已經連贏三場，士氣好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi6 gam1 gwai3 ji5 ging1 lin4 jeng4 saam1 coeng4, si6 hei3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球隊本賽季已經連贏三場，士氣很高。
examples.english_sentence: The team has already won three games in a row this season; morale is high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近運氣好，連贏好幾次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 wan6 hei3 hou2, lin4 jeng4 hou2 gei2 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近運氣不錯，連贏好幾次。
examples.english_sentence: He's been lucky lately, winning several times in a row.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果可以連贏兩場，晉級就有望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 lin4 jeng4 loeng5 coeng4, zeon3 kap1 zau6 jau5 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果可以連贏兩場，就有望晉級。
examples.english_sentence: If we can win two matches consecutively, advancement is likely.

mandarin_meaning: 连身裙（连衣裙，liánshēnqún）
english_meaning: one-piece dress; dress
explanation_mandarin: 指上身與下擺連為一體的裙裝，通常用來指女性穿的單件裙子。
explanation_english: A skirt or dress in which the top and skirt are joined as a single piece, typically referring to a woman's one-piece dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一條新嘅連身裙，準備去婚禮穿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 tiu4 san1 ge3 lin4 san1 kwan4, zeon2 bei6 heoi3 fan1 lai5 cyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她買了一條新的連身裙，準備在婚禮上穿。
examples.english_sentence: She bought a new dress to wear to the wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天啲人鍾意著輕薄嘅連身裙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 di1 jan4 zung1 ji3 zoek3 hing1 bok6 ge3 lin4 san1 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天人們喜歡穿輕薄的連身裙。
examples.english_sentence: People like to wear lightweight dresses in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢試咗好多件連身裙，但係冇一件啱佢身材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 zo2 hou2 do1 gin6 lin4 san1 kwan4, daan6 hai6 mou5 jat1 gin6 aam1 keoi5 san1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她試了很多件連身裙，但沒有一件合適她的身材。
examples.english_sentence: She tried on many dresses, but none suited her figure.

mandarin_meaning: 连载（把小说、漫画、专栏等分期刊登或发表；也指连载的作品或连载形式）
english_meaning: to serialize; serialization (publishing a story, comic, column, etc., in installments); a serialized work
explanation_mandarin: 指把小說、漫畫、專欄等分期刊載或發表；也可作名詞，表示正在連載的作品或連載的形式。
explanation_english: Refers to publishing a story, comic, column, etc., in installments. Can be used as a verb (to serialize) or as a noun (a serialization/the serialized series).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套漫畫喺報章連載緊，讀者每星期都好期待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ne1 tou3 maan6 waa2 hai2 bou3 zoeng1 lin4 zoi6 gan2, duk6 ze2 mui5 sing1 kei4 dou1 hou2 kei4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部漫畫在報章上連載，讀者每週都很期待。
examples.english_sentence: This comic is being serialized in the newspaper; readers eagerly await each week's installment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作者決定分十期連載呢個故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 ze2 kyut3 ding6 fan1 sap6 kei4 lin4 zoi6 ni1 go3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作者決定分十期連載這個故事。
examples.english_sentence: The author decided to serialize this story over ten installments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇專欄會喺網站度連載，讀者可以留言討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 zyun1 lyun4 wui5 hai2 mong5 zaam6 dou6 lin4 zoi6, duk6 ze2 ho2 ji5 lau4 jim4 tou2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇專欄會在網站上連載，讀者可以留言討論。
examples.english_sentence: This column will be serialized on the website; readers can leave comments and discuss.

mandarin_meaning: 連連 (liánlián) — 不斷、連續、接連發生或重複發生
english_meaning: repeatedly; continuously; time and again; incessantly
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情持續發生或動作反覆出現，常用來修飾動詞，如「連連點頭」、「連連道謝」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that events occur continuously or actions are repeated; commonly modifies verbs (e.g., "nod repeatedly", "apologize repeatedly").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連連點頭，表示同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 lin4 dim2 tau4, biu2 si6 tung4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他連連點頭，表示同意。
examples.english_sentence: He nodded repeatedly, indicating agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排天氣連連落雨，出街要帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai4 tin1 hei3 lin4 lin4 lok6 jyu5, ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天氣連續下雨，出門要帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: It's been raining continuously lately; remember to bring an umbrella when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試失敗後，佢連連道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 sat1 baai6 hau6, keoi5 lin4 lin4 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試失敗後，他連連道歉。
examples.english_sentence: After failing the exam, he apologized repeatedly.

mandarin_meaning: 连锁（相互连接或成链的；连锁店）
english_meaning: chain; linked; chain (as in chain store or chain reaction)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物互相連接或成一系列相互影響的狀態，常用於「連鎖店」（多家分店屬同一品牌）或「連鎖反應」（相互影響的反應）。
explanation_english: Refers to things that are linked together or form a series of mutually affecting elements; commonly used for 'chain' (e.g., chain stores) or 'chain reaction'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間係一間連鎖餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hai6 jat1 gaan1 lin4 so2 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一家连锁餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: This is a chain restaurant.

mandarin_meaning: 连锁反应 (lián suǒ fǎn yìng)
english_meaning: chain reaction; a sequence of events in which one event causes others to happen
explanation_mandarin: 描述一個事件引發另一個或多個相關事件，形成連續反應的現象。此詞既可用於科學（如化學、物理）情境，也常用於社會、政治或日常情況，表示連帶影響。
explanation_english: Refers to a phenomenon where one event triggers one or more related events, creating a sequence of reactions. Used in scientific contexts (e.g., chemistry, physics) and metaphorically in social, political, or everyday situations to indicate cascading effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅一個舉動引起咗連鎖反應，其他人都跟住改變咗做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jat1 go3 geoi2 dung6 jan5 hei2 zo2 lin4 so2 faan2 jing3, kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 gan1 zyu6 goi2 bin3 zo2 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一個舉動引起了連鎖反應，其他人也跟著改變了做法。
examples.english_sentence: His action triggered a chain reaction; others also changed their approach.

mandarin_meaning: 连锁店 (liánsuǒdiàn)
english_meaning: chain store
explanation_mandarin: 由同一家公司擁有或以加盟方式經營，在多個地點設有分店、品牌與經營模式大致相同的商店。
explanation_english: A retail store that is part of a group of stores owned or franchised by the same company, sharing the same brand, products, and operating model across multiple locations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋附近開咗一間新嘅連鎖店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 fu6 gan6 hoi1 zo2 jat1 gaan1 san1 ge3 lin4 so2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们附近开了一家新的连锁店。
examples.english_sentence: A new chain store opened near us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間連鎖店嘅產品質素都幾穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 lin4 so2 dim3 ge3 caan2 ban2 zat1 sou3 dou1 gei2 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家连锁店的产品质量都挺稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The products at this chain store have fairly consistent quality.

mandarin_meaning: 連同；跟隨；隨著
english_meaning: together with; along with; to follow or accompany
explanation_mandarin: 表示與某人或某事物一同、隨著或跟隨，既可作介詞用（表示「連同、與……一起」），亦可作動詞用（表示「跟隨、陪同」）。在粵語書面與口語中均可見。
explanation_english: Indicates being together with or following someone/something. It can function as a prepositional phrase (meaning "together with/along with") or as a verb (meaning "to follow/accompany"). Commonly used in Cantonese in both spoken and written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排我連隨團隊出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 ngo5 lin4 seoi4 tyun4 deoi6 ceot1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司安排我隨團隊出差。
examples.english_sentence: The company arranged for me to go on a business trip along with the team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好連隨佢做啲危險嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lin4 seoi4 keoi5 zou6 di1 ngai4 him2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要跟隨他做一些危險的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't follow him in doing dangerous things.

mandarin_meaning: 连体；连接在一起（常指连体婴或一体成型的衣物）
english_meaning: conjoined; joined together; one-piece (e.g., conjoined twins or one-piece garments)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩個或多個個體連在一起，常用於「連體嬰」（連體雙胞胎）或指一件成型不分開的衣物（如連體泳衣）。
explanation_english: Indicates two or more bodies joined together. Commonly used for 'conjoined twins' (連體嬰) or to describe one-piece garments (e.g., one-piece swimsuit).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰對連體嬰需要接受分離手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 deoi3 lin4tai2 jing1 seoi1 jiu3 zip3 sau1 fan1 lei4 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那對連體嬰需要接受分離手術。
examples.english_sentence: The conjoined infants need to undergo separation surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗件連體泳衣去沙灘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 lin4tai2 wing6 ji1 heoi3 saa1 taan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她穿了一件連體泳衣去沙灘。
examples.english_sentence: He/She wore a one-piece swimsuit to the beach.

mandarin_meaning: 连体婴（连体婴儿 / 联体婴）
english_meaning: conjoined twins
explanation_mandarin: 指在子宮內發育時身體相連、分離後仍可能共用某些器官的兩個嬰兒。屬於罕見的先天畸形，需要醫學評估是否可行分離手術及相關照護安排。
explanation_english: Refers to two infants who are physically joined to each other from birth due to incomplete separation during development. It is a rare congenital condition that often requires medical evaluation to determine if separation surgery and specific care are possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話嗰對BB係連體嬰，可能要做分離手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 go2 deoi3 bi1 bi1 hai6 lin4 tai2 jing1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 fan1 lei4 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说那对婴儿是连体婴，可能要做分离手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that pair of babies are conjoined twins; they might need separation surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 逮（逮捕、抓住）
english_meaning: to catch; to seize; to arrest
explanation_mandarin: 表示抓住、逮捕某人或物，可用於法律語境（如逮捕嫌疑人）或口語中表示抓住、捉到。
explanation_english: Means to catch, seize, or arrest someone or something. Used in legal contexts (e.g., arresting a suspect) and colloquially to mean 'catch'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方終於逮住嗰個小偷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 daai6 zyu6 go2 go3 siu2 tau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方終於逮住那個小偷。
examples.english_sentence: The police finally caught that thief.

mandarin_meaning: 逮捕（dài bǔ）
english_meaning: to arrest; to apprehend (someone suspected of a crime)
explanation_mandarin: 指警方或司法机关依法拘留或控制涉嫌犯罪的人，以便进一步调查或移交审判。
explanation_english: Refers to police or judicial authorities detaining or taking into custody a person suspected of committing a crime for investigation or prosecution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方今日逮捕咗兩名疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gam1 jat6 daai6 bou6 zo2 loeng5 ming4 ji4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方今天逮捕了两名疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested two suspects today.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/方言）被警方帶走問話或短暫拘留
english_meaning: (colloquial) to be taken in by the police for questioning; to be temporarily detained
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語或地區性用法，指被警方或有關當局帶走審問或短暫拘留。此詞偏口語，屬非正式用語，使用範圍較局限（例如香港或廣東地區口語）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be taken away by police/authorities for questioning or briefly detained. It is informal and regionally used rather than a formal legal term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴晚喺街上俾警察逮解咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 maan5 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 bei2 ging2 caat3 daai6 gaai2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天晚上在街上被警察逮解了。
examples.english_sentence: He was taken away by the police for questioning on the street last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢因為示威嘅事被逮解過兩次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 jan1 wai6 si6 wai1 ge3 si6 bei2 daai6 gaai2 gwo3 loeng5 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說他因為示威的事情被逮解過兩次。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he has been taken in for questioning twice because of the protests.

mandarin_meaning: 周（週）；星期、周期
english_meaning: week; cycle; period
explanation_mandarin: 「週」常用於表示一週、週期或某段時間（如每週、週末、週期）。與「周」「星期」意義接近，在書面語和部分詞彙中常用「週」字。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a week, a cycle, or a period of time (e.g. every week, weekend, cycle). It is equivalent to '周'/'星期' and appears in compounds like '週末' and '週期'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每週去跑步三次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 zau1 heoi3 paau2 bou6 saam1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每周去跑步三次。
examples.english_sentence: I go running three times every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個週末我想去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个周末我想去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel this weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個週期嘅工作好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zau1 kei4 ge3 gung1 zok3 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个周期的工作很忙。
examples.english_sentence: Work during this cycle is very busy.

mandarin_meaning: 周刊
english_meaning: weekly (periodical); weekly magazine/journal
explanation_mandarin: 指每週出版一次的刊物，如雜誌或報紙的週期性刊物，通常報導新聞、專題或評論。
explanation_english: A periodical published once a week, such as a weekly magazine or journal, typically covering news, features, or commentary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個禮拜都買嗰份週刊，睇吓最新嘅娛樂新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 maai5 go2 fan6 zau1 hon1, tai2 haa5 zeoi3 san1 ge3 juk6 lok6 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个礼拜都买那份周刊，看看最新的娱乐新闻。
examples.english_sentence: I buy that weekly magazine every week to catch up on the latest entertainment news.

mandarin_meaning: 周到（zhōudào）：周詳、體貼、考慮周全
english_meaning: thorough; attentive; considerate; thoughtful
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人或事情照顧得很周詳、細心體貼，常用來形容安排或待人處事很周全。
explanation_english: Indicates being thorough and considerate—attentive to details. Often used to describe arrangements or conduct that are thoughtful and meticulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對客人好週到，大家都好滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 haak3 jan4 hou2 zau1 dou3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對客人很周到，大家都很滿意。
examples.english_sentence: He is very attentive to guests; everyone is very satisfied.

mandarin_meaning: 周围；附近；四周
english_meaning: around; surrounding; nearby
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 方位词（也可作副词用）
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一地點的周邊或附近範圍，可作名詞指「周圍、附近」，也可用於表示動作的環境（在……週圍）。
explanation_english: Refers to the area surrounding a place or nearby vicinity. Can be used as a noun meaning 'surroundings' or adverbially to indicate location ('around').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你屋企週圍有冇便利店？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 uk1 kei5 zau1 wai4 jau5 mou5 bin6 lei6 dim3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你家周围有没有便利店？
examples.english_sentence: Are there any convenience stores around your home?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行下，睇下週圍有咩食嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 haa5, tai2 haa5 zau1 wai4 jau5 me1 sik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走走看看周围有什么好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's walk around and see what's nearby to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 周密；缜密；考虑周到
english_meaning: meticulous; thorough; well-considered
explanation_mandarin: 表示考虑周到、缜密、没有疏漏，常用来形容计划或做事的方式。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is meticulous, thorough, and free of oversights; often used for plans or ways of working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好週密，連細節都諗得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zau1 mat6, lin4 sai3 git3 dou1 nam2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很周密，连细节都想得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He is very meticulous in his work; even the details are thought out clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 周年（zhōunián），意指每年一次的紀念日或與年度週期有關的事
english_meaning: anniversary; annual anniversary; yearly commemoration
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示每年一次的紀念日、慶祝活動或與年份週期相關的事項，例如公司週年、結婚週年等。
explanation_english: Refers to the annual recurrence of a date or event — an anniversary or yearly commemoration (e.g., company anniversary, wedding anniversary).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月係公司嘅週年派對，我哋要準備禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 zau1 nin4 paai3 deoi3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下個月是公司的週年派對，我們要準備禮物。
examples.english_sentence: The company's anniversary party is next month; we need to prepare gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚係我哋嘅四週年紀念，記得訂餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sei3 zau1 nin4 gei2 nim6, gei3 dak1 deng6 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚是我們的四週年紀念，記得訂餐廳。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight is our fourth anniversary; remember to book a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場嘅週年慶有好多折扣，大家去掃貨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 ge3 zau1 nin4 hing3 jau5 hou2 do1 zit3 kau3, daai6 gaa1 heoi3 sou3 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商場的週年慶有很多折扣，大家去掃貨吧。
examples.english_sentence: The mall's anniversary sale has many discounts — everyone go shopping.

mandarin_meaning: 周年帶來好運、慶祝活動以祈求興旺
english_meaning: an anniversary (event) meant to bring good luck/prosperity; a prosperous anniversary celebration
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞短語 / 形容詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，通常用於描述周年慶祝活動或用來祝願周年帶來好運與生意興旺，帶有慶祝和祈求興旺的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression combining 'anniversary' and 'prosperous appearance/fortune.' It refers to an anniversary celebration intended to bring good luck or to describe that an anniversary will be auspicious and boost business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司做咗個週年旺相嘅活動，生意即刻好返好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 go3 zau1 nin4 wong6 soeng2 ge3 wut6 dung6, saang1 ji3 zik1 haak1 hou2 faan1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司舉辦了周年旺相的活動，生意立刻好轉很多。
examples.english_sentence: Our company held an anniversary prosperity event, and business immediately improved a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 周日 / 星期日 / 星期天
english_meaning: Sunday
explanation_mandarin: 表示一周的第七天，即星期日/星期天，常用於口語和書面語，指週末的最後一天（部分地區也視為一周的第一天）。
explanation_english: Refers to the seventh day of the week, Sunday. Commonly used in speech and writing to denote the weekend day (in some regions considered the first day of the week).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我週日有空，可以見你嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zau1 jat6 jau5 hung1, ho2 ji5 gin3 nei5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我周日有空，可以见你吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm free on Sunday; can I meet you?

mandarin_meaning: 周期
english_meaning: period; cycle
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物重複出現的時間長度或循環，例如經濟週期、月經週期或機械運行的週期。
explanation_english: Refers to the duration or interval of a recurring cycle or the repetition of events, e.g. an economic cycle, menstrual cycle, or a machine's operating period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個機器嘅運行有固定嘅週期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei1 hei3 ge3 wan6 hang4 jau5 gu3 ding6 ge3 zau1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個機器的運行有固定的周期。
examples.english_sentence: This machine's operation has a fixed cycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢嘅月經週期唔太穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ge3 jyut6 ging1 zau1 kei4 m4 taai3 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她說她的月經周期不太穩定。
examples.english_sentence: She said her menstrual cycle is not very regular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟有起有落，係正常嘅經濟週期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 jau5 hei2 jau5 lok6, hai6 zing3 soeng4 ge3 ging1 zai3 zau1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經濟有起有落，這是正常的經濟周期。
examples.english_sentence: The economy has ups and downs; it's a normal economic cycle.

mandarin_meaning: 周末
english_meaning: weekend
explanation_mandarin: 指一星期的末兩天（通常為星期六及星期日），通常是休息或外出活動的時間。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of the week (usually Saturday and Sunday), typically a time for rest or leisure activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個週末我冇工，可以出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 mou5 gung1, ho2 ji5 ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个周末我没有工作，可以出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have work this weekend, I can go out and have fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期六同星期日都叫做週末。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 luk6 tung4 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 giu3 zou6 zau1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期六和星期日都叫做周末。
examples.english_sentence: Saturday and Sunday are both called the weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你週末有咩計劃？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zau1 mut6 jau5 me1 gai3 waak6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你周末有什么计划？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

mandarin_meaning: 周界（邊界、界線；多用於書面或技術語境）
english_meaning: boundary; perimeter; the limits or borders of an area (often used in formal/technical contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某個區域或物件的邊界或周圍的界線。此詞語感偏書面或技術性，口語中多用「邊界」或「界線」。
explanation_english: Refers to the boundary or perimeter of an area or object. This term is more formal/technical; in everyday speech people usually use 'boundary' or 'border'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幅地嘅週界未清楚劃定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fuk1 dei6 ge3 zau1 gaai3 mei6 cing1 co2 waak6 ding6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊地的周界還沒劃清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The boundary of that plot hasn't been clearly defined.

mandarin_meaning: 週而復始 / 周而复始：不斷循環、反覆發生。
english_meaning: To recur again and again; to continue in cycles; to repeat continuously.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物循環反覆、周而復始，常用於描述季節、歷史、習慣或例行性事務的反覆發生。
explanation_english: An idiom describing things that occur in cycles or repeat continuously. Often used for seasons, history, routines, or recurring events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 季節週而復始，春去秋來，萬物循環不息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gai3 zit3 zau1 ji4 fuk6 ci2, ceon1 heoi3 cau1 loi4, maan6 mat6 ceon4 waan4 bat1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 季節週而復始，春去秋來，萬物循環不息。
examples.english_sentence: The seasons come round again and again — spring passes and autumn arrives; all things keep cycling without end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲工作係週而復始嘅例行公事，做嚟做去都係嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gung1 zok3 hai6 zau1 ji4 fuk6 ci2 ge3 lai6 hang4 gung1 si6, zou6 lai4 zou6 heoi3 dou1 hai6 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些工作是週而復始的例行公事，一做再做都是那些事情。
examples.english_sentence: Some jobs are repetitive routines — you do the same tasks over and over.

mandarin_meaning: 周處（東晉人物），以「除三害」的傳說著稱，講述他從一個惡名昭彰的地方惡少悔改並除去猛虎與蛟龍等害獸，成為正面典範。
english_meaning: Zhou Chu (a historical figure of the Eastern Jin), famous for the legend of 'removing the three harms' — a story about a former local bully who reforms, kills dangerous beasts, and becomes a positive example.
