examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng2 maai5 di1 hou2 je5, bat1 jyu4 noi6 sam1 dang2 haa5, jyu6 ngaam1 sin1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果想買到好東西，不如耐心等一下，碰巧遇到合適的再買。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to buy something good, be patient and only buy when you come across the right one.

mandarin_meaning: 遭到杀害；被人杀死
english_meaning: to be murdered; to fall victim to homicide
explanation_mandarin: 表示遭到殺害或被殺的狀態，常見於新聞報導或正式書面語。
explanation_english: Indicates being killed or murdered; commonly used in news reports or formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚有一名男子喺屋企遇害，警方而家正調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan5 jau5 jat1 ming4 naam4 zi2 hai2 uk1 kei5 jyu6 hoi6, ging2 fong1 ji4 gaa1 zing3 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚有一名男子在家中遇害，警方正在调查。
examples.english_sentence: Last night a man was murdered at home; the police are investigating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旅行團有兩個遊客喺山林遇害，當局呼籲市民注意安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 hang4 tyun4 jau5 loeng5 go3 jau4 haak3 hai2 saan1 lam4 jyu6 hoi6, dong1 guk6 fu1 jyu5 si5 man4 zyu3 ji3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旅行团有两名游客在山林遇害，当局呼吁市民注意安全。
examples.english_sentence: Two tourists in the tour group were killed in the mountains; authorities urge the public to be cautious.

mandarin_meaning: 溺水；遇到溺水的情況
english_meaning: to drown; to be in danger of drowning
explanation_mandarin: 遇溺：指人在水中發生溺水，無法正常呼吸或被水淹沒，需要救援的情況。
explanation_english: To experience drowning or be in danger of drowning — being unable to breathe normally in water or being submerged and needing rescue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺海邊遇溺，幸好有漁夫即刻救咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoi2 bin1 jyu6 nik6, hang6 hou2 jau5 jyu4 fu1 zik1 hak1 gau3 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在海边遇溺，幸好被渔夫及时救起。
examples.english_sentence: He was drowning at the seaside; fortunately a fisherman rescued him in time.

mandarin_meaning: 遭到袭击
english_meaning: to be attacked; to suffer an assault
explanation_mandarin: 指受到突然的攻击或袭击，通常用于人或目标被人或武器袭击的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to being subjected to a sudden attack or assault, typically used when a person or target is attacked by someone or by weapons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢昨晚喺街度俾人遇襲，依家住院緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zok6 maan5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 bei2 jan4 jyu6 zaap6, ji4 gaa1 zyu6 jyun2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚在街上被人袭击，现在住院。
examples.english_sentence: He was attacked on the street last night and is now hospitalized.

mandarin_meaning: 遇见 (yùjiàn)
english_meaning: to meet; to encounter (often by chance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示與人或事物相遇或碰見，常用於指偶然見到某人或某事。
explanation_english: Indicates meeting or encountering a person or thing, often implying a chance or unexpected meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街上遇見咗佢，真係幾驚喜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 jyu6 gin3 zo2 keoi5, zan1 hai6 gei2 ging1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上遇见了他，真的很惊喜。
examples.english_sentence: I met him on the street; it was really a pleasant surprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺旅行期間，我喺火車站遇見咗一位好熱心嘅本地人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 leoi5 hang4 kei4 gaan1, ngo5 hai2 fo2 ce1 zaam6 jyu6 gin3 zo2 jat1 wai2 hou2 jit6 sam1 ge3 bun2 dei6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在旅行期间，我在火车站遇见了一位很热心的当地人。
examples.english_sentence: During my trip, I met a very helpful local at the train station.

mandarin_meaning: 遇险 (yùxiǎn)：遭遇危险，处于危险境地
english_meaning: to encounter danger; to be in peril or a hazardous situation
explanation_mandarin: 表示遭遇危險或陷入險境，常用於交通、登山、航海等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates encountering danger or being in a perilous situation; commonly used for accidents or emergencies in contexts like travel, sailing, or climbing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰艘船喺暴風中遇險，船上嘅人被救咗上岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 sou1 syun4 hai2 bou6 fung1 zung1 jyu6 him2, syun4 soeng5 ge3 jan4 bei6 gau3 zo2 soeng5 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那艘船在暴风中遇险，船上的人被救上了岸。
examples.english_sentence: That ship encountered danger in the storm; the people on board were rescued ashore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 登山隊遇險，幸好有直升機嚟救援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 saan1 deoi6 jyu6 him2, hang6 hou2 jau5 zik6 sing1 gei1 lai4 gau3 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 登山队遇险，幸好有直升机来救援。
examples.english_sentence: The climbing team was in danger; luckily a helicopter came to rescue them.

mandarin_meaning: 遇难（遭遇灾难或不幸、丧生）
english_meaning: to meet with disaster; to perish in an accident (e.g., shipwreck, fatal accident); to be a victim of a calamity
partOfSpeech_english: verb (intransitive); can also be used as a noun (victim of a disaster)
explanation_mandarin: 表示遭遇災難或不幸，常用於指船難、車禍等意外中喪生或遇到重大危險。
explanation_english: Indicates suffering a disaster or fatal accident; commonly used for situations like shipwrecks, traffic accidents, or other catastrophic events resulting in death or severe danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰艘船喺暴風雨入面遇難咗，唔知仲有冇生還者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 sou1 syun4 hai2 bou6 fung1 jyu5 jap6 min6 jyu6 naan6 zo2, m4 zi1 zung6 jau5 mou5 saang1 waan4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那艘船在暴風雨中遇難了，不知道還有沒有生還者。
examples.english_sentence: That ship was wrecked in the storm; I don't know if there are any survivors.

mandarin_meaning: 遇难者：在灾难或事故中受害的人。
english_meaning: victim(s) (of a disaster, accident, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指在灾难、事故或意外中受伤、被困或死亡的人，常用于官方报道与统计。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are injured, trapped, killed, or otherwise harmed in a disaster, accident, or similar incident; commonly used in news reports and official counts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇難者已經被送到醫院救治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 naan6 ze2 ji5 ging1 bei6 sung3 dou3 ji1 jyun2 gau3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇难者已经被送到医院救治。
examples.english_sentence: The victims have already been taken to the hospital for treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇難者名單仲喺統計緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 naan6 ze2 ming4 daan1 zung6 hai2 tung2 gai3 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇难者名单还在统计中。
examples.english_sentence: The list of victims is still being compiled.

mandarin_meaning: 游；游览、旅行、漫游；（也可指游泳或玩耍）
english_meaning: to tour/travel; to roam; to play; to swim
explanation_mandarin: 「遊」常作動詞，表示遊覽、旅行或遊玩，也可指漫遊或游泳；常見於複合詞如旅遊、遊戲、遊覽等。
explanation_english: The character '遊' (jau4) is a verb meaning to tour, travel, roam, play, or swim. It frequently appears in compounds such as 旅遊 (travel) and 遊戲 (game).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假我想出去遊下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 ngo5 soeng2 ceot1 heoi3 jau4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假我想出去玩一玩。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go out and hang out/play during the holiday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意旅遊，已經去過十幾個國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 leoi5 jau4, ji5 ging1 heoi3 gwo3 sap6 gei2 go3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡旅遊，已經去過十幾個國家。
examples.english_sentence: He loves traveling and has already been to over a dozen countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喺遊樂場成日玩遊戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 jau4 lok6 coeng4 seng4 jat6 waan2 jau4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子在游乐场总是玩游戏。
examples.english_sentence: Children always play games at the playground.

mandarin_meaning: 遊客；參觀者
english_meaning: visitor; tourist; passerby (depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 指前往或逗留某地的人，常用來指觀光客或到訪的參觀者，也可泛指路過的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who visit or linger at a place, commonly meaning tourists or visitors; can also broadly mean passersby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個古蹟每日都有好多遊人來參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 zik1 mui5 jat6 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 jau4 jan4 loi4 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個古蹟每天都有很多遊人來參觀。
examples.english_sentence: This historic site has many visitors coming to see it every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係本地人，只係個遊人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 bun2 dei6 jan4, zi2 hai6 go3 jau4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是本地人，只是一個遊人。
examples.english_sentence: He isn't a local, just a visitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旺季嘅時候，遊人多到塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong6 gwai3 ge3 si4 hau6, jau4 jan4 do1 dou3 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旺季的時候，遊人多到塞車。
examples.english_sentence: In peak season, there are so many visitors that traffic gets jammed.

mandarin_meaning: 游侠；行侠仗义的侠客，常指浪迹江湖的武侠人物
english_meaning: a wandering knight-errant; a chivalrous swordsman or hero who roams and upholds justice
explanation_mandarin: 指在江湖間行俠仗義、四處遊走的武俠人物，也可泛指有俠義精神的人。
explanation_english: Refers to martial figures who roam around fighting injustice—chivalrous wanderers or swordsmen; can also generically mean a person with a chivalrous spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自稱係個遊俠，成日四圍幫人解決麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cing1 hai6 go3 jau4 hap6, sing4 jat6 sei3 wai4 bong1 jan4 gaai2 kyut3 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自稱是個遊俠，總是四處幫人解決麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: He calls himself a wandering knight-errant, always helping people solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古裝小說入面經常有遊俠出現，行俠仗義、劍術高強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 zong1 siu2 syut3 jap6 min6 ging1 soeng4 jau5 jau4 hap6 ceot1 jin2, hang4 hap6 zoeng6 ji6, gim3 seot6 gou1 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古裝小說裡常常出現遊俠，行俠仗義、劍術高強。
examples.english_sentence: Period novels often feature wandering heroes who uphold justice and are skilled swordsmen.

mandarin_meaning: 游刃有余 (yóu rèn yǒu yú)：形容處理事務熟練，從容不迫，應付自如。
english_meaning: to handle matters with skill and ease; to be adept and cope with something effortlessly.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人在某個領域或某項工作上非常熟練，處理問題時輕鬆自如，顯得從容且有餘裕。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is very skilled in a field or task, handling problems easily and calmly with apparent surplus capacity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年廚師，依家切魚都遊刃有餘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 ceoi4 si1, ji1 gaa1 cit3 jyu4 dou1 jau4 jan6 jau5 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了幾年廚師，現在切魚都游刃有余。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked as a chef for several years; now he can fillet fish with ease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣佢好冷靜，應付問題遊刃有餘，最後攞咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 go2 zan6 keoi5 hou2 laang5 zing6, jing3 fu6 man6 tai4 jau4 jan6 jau5 jyu4, zeoi3 hau6 lo2 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候他很冷靜，應對問題游刃有余，最後得到了那份工作。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview he was very calm and handled the questions with ease, and in the end he got the job.

mandarin_meaning: 游刑（古代刑罰之一，指流放、充軍或遊街示眾等處罰）
english_meaning: An archaic form of punishment such as exile/banishment, forced labour away from home, or public parading as a form of humiliation
explanation_mandarin: 遊刑為古代的處罰方式之一，通常指將罪人流放、充軍或以遊街示眾等手段予以懲罰。現代多見於史書或文獻記載，日常語境中較少使用。
explanation_english: A historical/legal term for certain punishments in earlier times, typically meaning banishment/exile, sending someone to forced labour away from home, or parading them publicly as punishment. Now mainly encountered in historical texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時犯事可能會被判遊刑，逐出家鄉或者遊街示眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 faan6 si6 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei6 pun3 jau4 jing4, zuk6 ceot1 gaa1 hoeng1 waak6 ze2 jau4 gaai1 si6 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时犯事可能会被判游刑，被驱逐出家乡或者游街示众。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, committing crimes could lead to being sentenced to '遊刑' — being exiled from one's hometown or paraded through the streets as public punishment.

mandarin_meaning: 到外地／到別的城市（旅遊或出差）
english_meaning: to go out of town; to travel to another city (for leisure or business)
explanation_mandarin: 「遊埠」是廣東話（香港粵語）的口語用法，原指到其他埠（城市／港口）活動，現常用來表示到外地旅遊或出差，離開本地一段時間。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to go to another city or out of town (originally 'visit a port/city'); commonly used for traveling or being away on business for a period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個禮拜我會去廣州遊埠幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 ngo5 wui5 heoi3 gwong2 zau1 jau4 fau6 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下個星期我要去廣州到外地玩幾天。
examples.english_sentence: I'll be going to Guangzhou out of town for a few days next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去深圳遊埠，可能返唔到嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 sam1 zan3 jau4 fau6, ho2 nang4 faan1 m4 dou2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去深圳出差／到外地，可能回不來。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Shenzhen out of town tomorrow and might not be able to come back.

mandarin_meaning: 游子（離鄉在外的人）
english_meaning: a person away from home; wanderer; traveler; emigrant
explanation_mandarin: 指離開家鄉、在外漂泊或旅居他鄉的人，常見於古典文學或詩詞中，用以表達思鄉或漂泊之情。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who has left their hometown and lives or travels away from home. Often used in classical literature and poetry to convey longing or the hardships of wandering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊子返唔到屋企，心裡好掛住家人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 zi2 faan1 m4 dou3 uk1 kei2, sam1 leoi5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 gaa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 離家在外的人回不了家，很想念家人。
examples.english_sentence: A person away from home can't return and misses their family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古詩常用「遊子」來形容離鄉的人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si1 soeng4 jung6 「jau4 zi2」 loi4 jing4 joeng4 lei4 hoeng1 dik1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古詩常用「遊子」來形容離鄉的人。
examples.english_sentence: Classical poetry often uses 'youzi' to describe someone who has left their hometown.

mandarin_meaning: 游学（到外地短期學習或參觀）
english_meaning: study tour; to go on a study trip (short-term travel for learning)
explanation_mandarin: 指到其他地方短期學習或參觀，以增長見識、練習語言或學習專業技能。可作動詞（去遊學）或名詞（一次遊學）。
explanation_english: Refers to traveling to another place for a short period to learn, observe, or improve language or professional skills. It can function as a verb (to go on a study trip) or a noun (a study tour).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個暑假會去日本遊學，想提高日語會話能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 syu2 gaa3 wui5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 jau4 hok6, soeng2 tai4 gou1 jat6 jyu5 wui6 waa6 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個暑假會去日本遊學，想提高日語會話能力。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Japan on a study trip next summer; I want to improve my conversational Japanese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校組織咗一個歐洲遊學團，參觀博物館同埋上語言課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 zou2 zik1 zo2 jat1 go3 au1 zau1 jau4 hok6 tyun4, caam1 gun1 bok3 mat6 gun2 tung4 maai4 soeng5 jyu5 jin4 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校組織了一個歐洲遊學團，參觀博物館並上語言課。
examples.english_sentence: The school organized a study tour to Europe; we visited museums and attended language classes.

mandarin_meaning: 游学团（由学校或机构组织的教育性质的旅游团，通常带学生到外地或国外实地学习、参观）
english_meaning: study tour (group); an organized educational trip where students travel to another place, often abroad, to learn and visit
explanation_mandarin: 指學校、教育機構或旅行社為學生或年輕人安排的結合學習與觀光的旅行團，通常在校外或海外進行短期學習交流。
explanation_english: A group organized by a school, educational institution, or agency that combines learning and sightseeing, usually taking students or young people on a short-term study visit outside their local area or abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下個暑假會組織一個日本遊學團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 syu2 gaa3 wui5 zou2 zik1 jat1 go3 jat6 bun2 jau4 hok6 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校下个暑假会组织一个日本游学团。
examples.english_sentence: The school will organize a study tour to Japan next summer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想報名下年嘅英國遊學團，畢業後可以留多啲外國經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 bou3 ming4 haa6 nin4 ge3 jing1 gwok3 jau4 hok6 tyun4, bat1 jip6 hau6 ho2 ji5 lau4 do1 di1 ngoi6 gwok3 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想报名明年的英国游学团，毕业后可以多留一些国外经验。
examples.english_sentence: I want to sign up for next year's study tour to the UK; after graduation I can gain more overseas experience.

mandarin_meaning: 游客
english_meaning: tourist; visitor
explanation_mandarin: 指到某地观光、旅游或短期停留的访客。
explanation_english: A person who visits a place for sightseeing, travel, or a short stay; a tourist or visitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家呢度有好多遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这里有很多游客。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of tourists here right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊客要排隊買門票先可以入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 haak3 jiu3 paai4 deoi6 maai5 mun4 piu3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游客要排队买门票才能进去。
examples.english_sentence: Tourists have to queue to buy tickets before they can enter.

mandarin_meaning: 游山玩水（到處遊覽山水景色，泛指外出遊玩、觀光）
english_meaning: to go sightseeing; to travel around and enjoy scenic spots; to go on an outing
explanation_mandarin: 「遊山玩水」原指遊覽山水風景，現多用來表示外出旅遊、觀光、放鬆心情。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to travel about and enjoy natural scenery; commonly used to describe going out for leisure, sightseeing, or relaxation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個週末我哋去遊山玩水，放鬆下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jau4 saan1 waan4 seoi2, fong3 sung1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個週末我們去遊山玩水，放鬆一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go on an outing this weekend to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意遊山玩水，對大自然好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 jau4 saan1 waan4 seoi2, deoi3 daai6 zi6 jin4 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常喜歡遊山玩水，對大自然很有興趣。
examples.english_sentence: He often enjoys going out to appreciate nature and is very interested in the outdoors.

mandarin_meaning: 游戏 (yóu xì)
english_meaning: game; play; amusement
explanation_mandarin: 指供消遣或娛樂的活動或系統，包含桌上遊戲、體育遊戲、電子遊戲等。
explanation_english: Refers to activities or systems for amusement and entertainment, including board games, sports games, and video games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意玩邊款遊戲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 waan2 bin1 fun2 jau4 hei3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢玩哪种游戏？
examples.english_sentence: Which kind of games do you like to play?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個遊戲好好玩，大家一齊嚟玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 hou2 hou2 waan2, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 lai4 waan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游戏很好玩，大家一起来玩吧。
examples.english_sentence: This game is really fun, let's all play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺電腦上下載咗一個新遊戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 din6 nou5 soeng6 haa6 zoi6 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 jau4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在電腦上下載了一個新遊戲。
examples.english_sentence: I downloaded a new game on my computer.

mandarin_meaning: 把人世當作遊戲；對世事採取玩世不恭或逍遙的態度
english_meaning: to treat life/the world as a game; to adopt a carefree, nonchalant, or playfully detached attitude toward worldly matters
explanation_mandarin: 形容把人生或人世當作一場遊戲來看，對煩惱與責任採取輕鬆、不太放在心上的態度；有時帶有玩世不恭或超然的意味。
explanation_english: Describes viewing life or the human world as a game, taking a relaxed, carefree, or not-too-serious attitude toward troubles and responsibilities. It can convey playful detachment or a cynical, laissez‑faire stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遊戲人間，工作總係唔認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jau4 hei3 jan4 gaan1, gung1 zok3 zung2 hai6 m4 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是遊戲人間，做事總是不認真。
examples.english_sentence: He always treats life like a game and is never serious about his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生短暫，何不遊戲人間，享受當下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 saang1 dyun2 zaam6, ho4 bat1 jau4 hei3 jan4 gaan1, hoeng2 sau6 dong1 haa6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生短暫，何不遊戲人間，享受當下？
examples.english_sentence: Life is short—why not take it lightly and enjoy the moment?

mandarin_meaning: 游戏机 (yóuxìjī)
english_meaning: video game console; game machine
explanation_mandarin: 指用來玩電子或機械遊戲的機器，泛指家用主機、掌上遊戲機或街機等裝置。
explanation_english: Refers to a machine used to play electronic or mechanical games, generally including home consoles, handheld consoles, and arcade machines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗部遊戲機，今晚試吓新遊戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 bou6 jau4 hei3 gei1, gam1 maan5 si3 haa5 san1 jau4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛買了一台遊戲機，今晚試試新遊戲。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a game console; I'll try the new game tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭有好多遊戲機同配件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 jau5 hou2 do1 jau4 hei3 gei1 tung4 pui3 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店有很多遊戲機和配件。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has many game consoles and accessories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路成日喺度玩遊戲機，唔可以畀佢哋玩太耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 waan2 jau4 hei3 gei1, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 waan2 taai3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友經常在玩遊戲機，不可以讓他們玩太久。
examples.english_sentence: Kids are always playing game consoles; you shouldn't let them play for too long.

mandarin_meaning: 游戏规则
english_meaning: rules of the game; rules and procedures governing an activity
explanation_mandarin: 指游戏或活动中约定的规矩和玩法，也可以比喻为某种活动、体系或场景下的运作规范和约束条件。
explanation_english: Refers to the agreed rules and procedures for how a game or activity is played. It can also be used metaphorically to mean the norms or constraints that govern any situation or system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺開始玩之前，我哋要先了解遊戲規則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoi1 ci2 waan2 zi1 cin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 liu5 gaai2 jau4 hei3 kwai1 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在开始玩之前，我们要先了解游戏规则。
examples.english_sentence: Before we start playing, we need to understand the rules of the game.

mandarin_meaning: 游手好闲（yóu shǒu hào xián），形容懒散、不务正业或游荡无所事事
english_meaning: idle; fond of idleness; loafing around; not willing to work
explanation_mandarin: 形容人懶散、不願工作或勞動，整天閒著或無所事事，多帶貶義。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is idle and unwilling to work or be productive; loafs around and does nothing; usually has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遊手好閒，唔肯搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jau4 sau2 hou2 haan4, m4 hang2 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是游手好閒，不肯找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is always idle and won't look for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企人擔心佢遊手好閒，於是叫佢去做義工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jan4 daam1 sam1 keoi5 jau4 sau2 hou2 haan4, jyu1 si6 giu3 keoi5 heoi3 zou6 ji6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家人擔心他游手好閒，所以叫他去做義工。
examples.english_sentence: The family worried he's idle, so they asked him to do volunteer work.

mandarin_meaning: 游乐 (yóulè)：娱乐、消遣；指供人玩耍的活动或设施
english_meaning: amusement; recreation; entertainment; activities or facilities for play and enjoyment
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「遊樂」指供人娛樂、玩耍的活動或設施，也可泛指玩樂、消遣的行為。常見於「遊樂場」「遊樂設施」等詞語。
explanation_english: Refers to activities or facilities intended for amusement and play; can also mean the act of having fun or recreation. Commonly found in compounds like '遊樂場' (amusement park) and '遊樂設施' (play equipment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去遊樂場玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jau4 lok6 coeng4 waan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去遊樂場玩吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the amusement park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家商場有新嘅遊樂設施，啱晒細路仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 soeng1 coeng4 jau5 san1 ge3 jau4 lok6 cit3 si1, ngaam1 saai3 sai3 lou6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在商場有新的遊樂設施，很適合小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: The mall now has new amusement facilities—perfect for kids.

mandarin_meaning: 游乐园 (yóu lè yuán)
english_meaning: amusement park; theme park
explanation_mandarin: 提供遊樂設施、遊戲和娛樂活動的公園或場地，通常有過山車、摩天輪、旋轉木馬等，適合家庭和遊客前往娛樂。
explanation_english: A park or venue that offers rides, games, and entertainment activities—typically including roller coasters, Ferris wheels, carousels, etc.—popular for families and visitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜去遊樂園玩，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 jau4 lok6 jyun4 waan2, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个星期去游乐园玩，好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to the amusement park next week?

mandarin_meaning: 游乐场
english_meaning: playground; amusement park
explanation_mandarin: 供兒童遊玩或公眾娛樂的場所，常有滑梯、鞦韆等遊樂設施；有時也可指較大型的遊樂園或主題樂園。
explanation_english: A place for children (or the public) to play and be entertained, typically equipped with slides, swings and other play equipment; can also refer to larger amusement parks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喺遊樂場玩得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 jau4 lok6 coeng4 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在游乐场玩得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The children are having a great time playing at the playground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我帶仔去附近嘅遊樂場玩滑梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai3 zai2 heoi3 fu6 gan6 ge3 jau4 lok6 coeng4 waan2 waat6 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我带孩子去附近的游乐场玩滑梯。
examples.english_sentence: I took my child to the nearby playground to play on the slide.

mandarin_meaning: 游历；到各地旅行、考察或遊覽
english_meaning: to travel around; to tour or journey to different places (often for sight-seeing, study, or experience)
explanation_mandarin: 指到各地旅行、觀察或考察，常帶有見聞與經驗累積的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to traveling to various places for sightseeing, observation, or study, often implying gaining experience and knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我暑假去歐洲遊歷咗兩個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 syu1 gaa3 heoi3 au1 zau1 jau4 lik6 zo2 loeng5 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我暑假去歐洲遊歷了兩個月。
examples.english_sentence: I traveled around Europe for two months during summer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意到處遊歷，學識咗好多野。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 dou3 cyu3 jau4 lik6, hok6 sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡到處遊歷，學到了很多東西。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to travel around and has learned a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書記錄咗作者遊歷世界嘅經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 gei3 luk6 zo2 zok3 ze2 jau4 lik6 sai3 gaai3 ge3 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書記錄了作者遊歷世界的經歷。
examples.english_sentence: This book records the author's experiences traveling around the world.

mandarin_meaning: 游湖（在湖上乘船或划船遊覽）
english_meaning: to go boating on a lake; to take a boat tour/cruise on a lake
explanation_mandarin: 指在湖上乘船或划船遊覽，通常為休閒或觀光活動。
explanation_english: Refers to taking a boat or rowing on a lake for leisure or sightseeing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個週末我哋去西湖遊湖，順便睇睇風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sai1 wu4 jau4 wu4, seon6 bin6 tai2 tai2 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个周末我们去西湖游湖，顺便看看风景。
examples.english_sentence: This weekend let's go boating on West Lake and enjoy the scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假期我同屋企人去公園遊湖，租咗隻小船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 kei4 ngo5 tung4 uk1 kei5 jan4 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 jau4 wu4, zou1 zo2 zek3 siu2 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假期我和家人去公园游湖，租了一只小船。
examples.english_sentence: During the holiday I went boating on the park lake with my family and we rented a small boat.

mandarin_meaning: 游牧 (yóumù) — 以迁徙放牧为生；游牧式的
english_meaning: nomadic; to herd livestock; pastoralism (nomadism); nomadic-style
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 形容词 / 名词
explanation_mandarin: 指以迁徙放牧为生的生活方式或相关行为；也可作形容词表示“游牧的”或“游牧式的”。
explanation_english: Refers to the lifestyle or practice of moving seasonally to graze livestock (pastoralism); can also be used adjectivally to mean 'nomadic' or 'nomadic-style'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊牧民族會按季節遷徙，搵草原畀牲畜覓食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 muk6 man4 zuk6 wui5 on3 gwai3 zit3 cin1 cai4, wan2 cou2 jyun4 bei2 sang1 cuk1 mak6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游牧民族会按季节迁徙，寻找草原让牲畜觅食。
examples.english_sentence: Nomadic peoples migrate according to the seasons, seeking grasslands for their livestock to graze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現代有人實行遊牧式嘅生活，喺唔同城市之間短暫移居同工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 doi6 jau5 jan4 sat6 hang4 jau4 muk6 sik1 ge3 sang1 wut6, hai2 m4 tung4 sing4 si5 zi1 gaan1 dyun2 zaam6 ji4 geoi1 tung4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现代有人实行游牧式的生活，在不同城市之间短暂迁居并工作。
examples.english_sentence: Some people today adopt a nomadic-style lifestyle, moving temporarily between different cities for living and work.

mandarin_meaning: 游玩；遊覽；玩耍
english_meaning: to play; to have fun; to go sightseeing
explanation_mandarin: 表示外出遊覽、玩耍或消遣的動作，語氣可正式或口語，常用於描述休閒活動。
explanation_english: Indicates going out to play, have fun, or go sightseeing; can be used in both formal and colloquial contexts to describe leisure activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六去公園遊玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 jau4 waan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期六去公園遊玩吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the park to hang out on Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暑假我想同朋友去海邊遊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 gaa3 ngo5 soeng2 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 jau4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暑假我想和朋友去海邊游玩。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the beach with friends during the summer break.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市有好多地方可以遊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 ho2 ji5 jau4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市有很多地方可以游玩。
examples.english_sentence: This city has many places to visit and have fun.

mandarin_meaning: 走神／發呆／偷懶（俚語）
english_meaning: to zone out / to daydream / to slack off (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「遊糊」為香港粵語口語用法，指人在做事時走神、發呆或偷懶，不能專心或敷衍了事。一般用於非正式對話或抱怨的語境。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to zone out, daydream, or slack off — to be inattentive or careless while doing something. Used in informal speech to criticize lack of focus or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日遊糊，做嘢認真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 jau4 wu4, zou6 je5 jing6 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是走神，做事認真一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep zoning out — be more serious about your work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上堂嗰陣佢成日遊糊，結果考試唔及格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 tong4 go2 zan6 keoi5 sing4 jat6 jau4 wu4, git3 gwo2 haau2 si3 m4 kap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上課時他總是走神，結果考試不及格。
examples.english_sentence: He kept daydreaming in class and ended up failing the exam.

mandarin_meaning: 玩繩／玩繩子（有時指跳繩或以繩子遊戲）
english_meaning: to play with a rope; (sometimes) to skip/jump rope
explanation_mandarin: 「遊繩」是廣東話口語用法，泛指用繩子玩耍的行為。在不同語境下可以指用繩子做遊戲、玩繩子，或與跳繩相關的活動。此詞並非標準書面語，使用較口語化或地方性（粵語）色彩。
explanation_english: “遊繩” is a Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to play with a rope. Depending on context it can refer to general rope play or activities like skipping/jump rope. It is informal and regionally Cantonese rather than a standard written term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路喺屋企用繩仔遊繩，玩得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 hai2 uk1 kei2 jung6 sing4 zai2 jau4 sing4, waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩在家用小绳玩繩子，玩得很開心。
examples.english_sentence: The child played with a small rope at home and had a lot of fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日同同學喺街市後面遊繩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 tung4 tung4 hok6 hai2 gai1 si5 hau6 min6 jau4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候常常和同學在菜市場後面玩繩子。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little I often played with a rope behind the market with my classmates.

mandarin_meaning: 乘船遊覽 / 坐船游玩
english_meaning: to go on a boat ride; to take a pleasure cruise
explanation_mandarin: 指乘船作為休閒活動去遊覽或觀光。在香港口語中常用來表示在海港、河道或湖上乘船出遊。
explanation_english: Refers to taking a boat for leisure or sightseeing. In Hong Kong Cantonese it commonly means going on a pleasure boat trip in a harbour, river, or lake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去維港遊船河，夜景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 wai4 gong2 jau4 syun4 ho4, je6 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期日去維港乘船遊覽，夜景很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: We're going for a boat ride in Victoria Harbour on Sunday — the night view is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司團建今次安排咗遊船河同晚飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tyun4 gin3 gam1 ci3 on1 paai4 zo2 jau4 syun4 ho4 tung4 maan5 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司這次團建安排了坐船遊覽和晚餐。
examples.english_sentence: The company team-building this time includes a boat trip and dinner.

mandarin_meaning: 游艇
english_meaning: yacht
explanation_mandarin: 供娛樂或休閒使用的船隻，通常用於巡遊或海上活動，設備可能較舒適或豪華。
explanation_english: A boat used for recreation or leisure, often for cruising or sea activities, typically outfitted with comfortable or luxurious amenities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋暑假租咗一艘遊艇去海上玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 syu1 gaa3 zou1 zo2 jat1 sou3 jau4 teng5 heoi3 hoi2 soeng5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們暑假租了一艘遊艇去海上玩。
examples.english_sentence: We rented a yacht during summer vacation to go out on the sea.

mandarin_meaning: 敷衍地參加葬禮／走過場（假裝悼念）
english_meaning: to pay perfunctory respects at a funeral; to go through the motions of mourning
explanation_mandarin: 「遊花圈」是廣東話俗語，字面意義為「繞著花圈走」，引申指人們敷衍或表面上參加葬禮、悼念，並非出於真心，多帶有譏諷或批評的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "to walk around the wreath." It refers to attending a funeral or offering condolences in a perfunctory, insincere way — essentially going through the motions rather than mourning genuinely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係真係傷心，淨係嚟遊花圈啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 soeng1 sam1, zing6 hai6 lei4 jau4 faa1 hyun1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是真的難過，只是來走走形式而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's not really grieving; he's just here to pay lip service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人淨係去遊花圈，冇真心悼念，只係為咗面子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zing6 hai6 heoi3 jau4 faa1 hyun1, mou5 zan1 sam1 dou3 nim6, zi2 hai6 wai4 zo2 min6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人只是去走花圈，沒有真心哀悼，只是為了面子。
examples.english_sentence: Some people only go to pay perfunctory respects; they don't truly mourn — it's just for appearances.

mandarin_meaning: 游花园；去花园或公园游玩、散心（也可泛指外出闲逛、休闲）
english_meaning: to visit a garden/park; to go out for a leisurely stroll or outing; to relax and unwind
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是去花园遊覽。口語中常用作外出遊玩、散心或閒逛的表達，有時可泛指為了消遣而外出。
explanation_english: Literally 'visit a flower garden.' Commonly used to mean going out for leisure, a stroll, or to relax—can also broadly mean hanging out or taking a recreational outing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我哋去遊花園散吓心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jau4 faa1 jyun4 saan3 haa5 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期天我們去花園散散心吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the garden to relax on Sunday.

mandarin_meaning: 游荡、徘徊、漫无目的地四处走动
english_meaning: to wander; to roam; to loiter (aimlessly)
explanation_mandarin: 表示無特定目的或方向地在某處來回走或停留，常帶有閒逛或徘徊的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates moving about without a specific purpose or direction; to wander or loiter, often implying aimless walking or lingering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夜晚成日喺商場遊蕩，淨係四圍行睇嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 je6maan5 sing4jat6 hai2 soeng1coeng4 jau4 dong6, zing6 hai6 sei3 wai4 haang4 tai2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他晚上常常在商场游荡，只是在四处走走看看。
examples.english_sentence: He often wanders around the mall at night, just walking around and looking at things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友無嘢做就唔好喺街度遊蕩，可能危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 mou4 je5 zou6 zau6 m4 hou2 hai2 gaai1 dou6 jau4 dong6, ho2 nang4 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子没事别在街上游荡，可能会有危险。
examples.english_sentence: Kids shouldn't wander around the streets for no reason; it can be dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 流浪罪；（法律上的）遊蕩或流浪行為被視為罪行
english_meaning: vagrancy (the criminal offence of vagrancy/loitering)
explanation_mandarin: 法律術語，指將無業、流浪或在公共場所徘徊且無明顯謀生手段者定為犯罪的罪名。歷史上多用以懲治流浪者、乞討者或無固定住所的人。
explanation_english: A legal term referring to the criminalization of vagrancy — being unemployed, homeless, or loitering in public without visible means of support. Historically used to punish vagrants, beggars, or people without a fixed residence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前香港有遊蕩罪，無家可歸嘅人有時會因此被捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 jau5 jau4 dong6 zeoi6, mou4 gaa1 ho2 gwai1 ge3 jan4 jau5 si4 wui5 jan1 ci2 bei6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前香港有遊蕩罪，無家可歸的人有時會因此被捕。
examples.english_sentence: In the past Hong Kong had the offence of vagrancy; homeless people were sometimes arrested because of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單純遊蕩未必構成犯罪，要視乎情況而定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 seon4 jau4 dong6 mei6 bat1 gau3 sing4 faan6 zeoi6, jiu3 si6 fu1 cing4 fong3 ji4 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 單純遊蕩未必構成犯罪，要視乎情況而定。
examples.english_sentence: Purely wandering does not necessarily constitute a crime; it depends on the circumstances.

mandarin_meaning: 游行（示威或慶祝的隊列行進）
english_meaning: march; parade; demonstration (a public procession, often for protest or celebration)
explanation_mandarin: 指人群在街上成列行進，通常用以示威、抗議或慶祝。可作動詞（去遊行）或名詞（舉辦遊行）。
explanation_english: Refers to a public procession on streets, often organized as a demonstration, protest, or parade. Can be used as a verb (to march) or a noun (a march/parade).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六去遊行，爭取更多權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 jau4 hang4, zang1 ceoi2 gang1 do1 kyun4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期六去遊行，爭取更多權利。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to march on Saturday to demand more rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次遊行和平進行，冇發生暴力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jau4 hang4 wo4 ping4 zeon3 hang4, mou5 faat3 saang1 bou6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次遊行和平進行，沒有發生暴力。
examples.english_sentence: This march proceeded peacefully with no violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市有遊行就會塞車，大家要預早安排路線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 jau5 jau4 hang4 zau6 wui5 sak1 ce1, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 jyu6 zou2 on1 paai4 lou6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市有遊行就會塞車，大家要預早安排路線。
examples.english_sentence: When there's a march in the city, traffic gets congested, so people should plan their routes in advance.

mandarin_meaning: 游览
english_meaning: to tour; to go sightseeing; to visit scenic spots
explanation_mandarin: 指外出参观、观光或浏览景点、风景名胜。
explanation_english: To go on a tour or sightseeing trip; to visit and look around places of interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去遊覽公園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jau4 laam5 gung1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去遊覽公園。
examples.english_sentence: We went to visit the park.

mandarin_meaning: 游记；記述旅行見聞與經歷的文字記錄
english_meaning: travelogue; a written account or journal of travels and experiences
explanation_mandarin: 記述旅行過程、見聞、感受和印象的文章或書籍，通常包含地點、人物和經歷的描述。
explanation_english: A written account of a person's travels that describes places visited, experiences, observations, and impressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想寫一本遊記，紀錄我去歐洲嘅旅程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 se2 jat1 bun2 jau4 gei3, gei3 luk6 ngo5 heoi3 au1 zau1 ge3 leoi5 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想寫一本遊記，記錄我去歐洲的旅程。
examples.english_sentence: I want to write a travelogue to record my trip to Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一本遊記，講佢去日本嘅經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 bun2 jau4 gei3, gong2 keoi5 heoi3 jat6 bun2 ge3 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫了一本遊記，講述他去日本的經歷。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a travelogue about his experiences in Japan.

mandarin_meaning: 游說（向他人說服、拉攏或遊說以取得支持）
english_meaning: to persuade; to lobby; to canvass (often used for political lobbying or persuading someone to support a position)
explanation_mandarin: 向他人陳述理由或利益以改變其意見或行為，常用於為了促成某項決定、獲得支持或取得同意而進行的說服行為，亦可指政治上對議員或決策者進行的遊說活動。
explanation_english: To present arguments or incentives to someone in order to change their opinion or behavior. Commonly used for efforts to gain support for a decision, policy, or position, and often used in the context of political lobbying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派咗人去遊說議員，希望佢哋支持呢項新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 zo2 jan4 heoi3 jau4 seoi6 ji5 jyun4, hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 zi1 ci4 ni1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府派人去遊說議員，希望他們支持這項新政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent people to lobby the legislators, hoping they would support this new policy.

mandarin_meaning: 游说 (說服、拉攏他人以支持某事或採取某行動)
english_meaning: to lobby; to persuade or convince someone to support something or take a particular action
explanation_mandarin: 指透過陳述理由、施加影響或交涉，說服個人或團體接受某觀點、支持某政策或採取行動，常見於政治、商務或公關場景。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of presenting arguments, exerting influence, or negotiating to persuade an individual or group to accept a viewpoint, support a policy, or take action; commonly used in political, business, or public relations contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司派代表去遊說議員支持新修例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 paai3 doi6 biu2 heoi3 jau4 seot3 ji5 jyun4 zi1 ci4 san1 sau1 lai6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司派代表去游说议员支持新修例。
examples.english_sentence: The company sent representatives to lobby legislators to support the new amendment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗爭取訂單，佢哋不停打電話去遊說潛在客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zang1 ceoi2 deng6 daan1, keoi5 dei6 bat1 ting4 daa2 din6 waa2 heoi3 jau4 seot3 cim4 zoi6 haak3 wu6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了爭取訂單，他們不停打電話去游說潛在客戶。
examples.english_sentence: To win the contract, they kept calling to persuade potential clients.

mandarin_meaning: 游说 (yóushuì)：劝说、说服（常指为某项主张或利益而游说他人或机构）
english_meaning: to persuade; to lobby; to canvass (especially to persuade individuals or organizations for a cause or support)
explanation_mandarin: 「遊説」指到處或針對特定對象進行說服或勸說，常用於政治、籌款或爭取支持的情境。
explanation_english: “遊説” means to go about persuading or lobbying people or groups, often used in contexts like politics, fundraising, or seeking support for a proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去議會遊說政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 ji5 wui6 jau4 syut3 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常到議會游說政府。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the council to lobby the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗籌款，我哋喺大街遊說路人捐錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 cau4 fun2, ngo5 dei6 hai2 daai6 gaai1 jau4 syut3 lou6 jan4 gyun1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了籌款，我們在大街上遊說路人捐錢。
examples.english_sentence: To raise funds, we canvassed people on the street for donations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘗試遊說董事會接受呢個計劃，但未成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng4 si3 jau4 syut3 dung2 si6 wui2 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, daan6 mei6 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他嘗試遊說董事會接受這個計劃，但未成功。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to persuade the board to accept the project, but was unsuccessful.

mandarin_meaning: 游走（往來、徘徊或在不同地方/團體之間移動）
english_meaning: to roam; to move about; to go around; to frequent (places or groups)
explanation_mandarin: 「遊走」表示在不同地方或團體之間來回移動、徘徊或活動。可用於字面上的走動（如四處逛）或比喻的活動（如在各部門間穿梭、在法律灰色地帶活動）。
explanation_english: “遊走” means to move about or roam between places or groups. It can describe literal wandering (e.g., strolling around) or figurative movement (e.g., operating between departments or in a legal gray area).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺唔同酒吧遊走，識唔少人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 m4 tung4 zau2 baa1 jau4 zau2, sik1 m4 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在不同的酒吧游走，認識不少人。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes around different bars and meets a lot of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理要喺各部門之間遊走，協調工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 jiu3 hai2 gok3 bou6 mun4 zi1 gaan1 jau4 zau2, hip3 tiu4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經理要在各部門之間游走，協調工作。
examples.english_sentence: The manager has to move between departments to coordinate work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司成日喺法律灰色地帶遊走，好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 hai2 faat3 leot6 fui1 sik1 dei6 daai3 jau4 zau2, hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司經常在法律的灰色地帶游走，很危險。
examples.english_sentence: That company often operates in a legal gray area, which is risky.

mandarin_meaning: 兜風；開車閒逛
english_meaning: to go for a drive (to cruise around with no particular destination)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語/俚語，指開車或坐車沒有特定目的地地閒逛、兜風，也可泛指開車散心。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase meaning to go for a drive or cruise around (usually leisurely and without a specific destination); to go for a spin to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 週末不如去遊車河，順便吹吹海風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 mut6 bat1 jyu4 heoi3 jau4 ce1 ho4, seon6 bin6 ceoi1 ceoi1 hoi2 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 週末不如去兜風，順便吹吹海風。
examples.english_sentence: Why not go for a drive this weekend and enjoy the sea breeze?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意夜晚出外遊車河，放鬆心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 je6 maan5 ceot1 ngoi6 jau4 ce1 ho4, fong3 sung1 sam1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡在晚上出去兜風，放鬆心情。
examples.english_sentence: He likes going out for a drive at night to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次只係遊車河，無目的，淨係想散心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zi2 hai6 jau4 ce1 ho4, mou5 muk6 dik1, zing6 hai6 soeng2 saan3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次只是隨便開車兜風，沒有目的，只是想散心。
examples.english_sentence: This time it's just a casual drive with no destination, just to clear one's mind.

mandarin_meaning: 悠閒地閒逛；閒蕩、消磨時間
english_meaning: to hang about leisurely; to laze around or take a relaxed stroll
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語 / 副詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，用來形容無所事事、悠閒地走動或消磨時間，有時帶輕鬆散步、閒逛的意思。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to spend time idly or stroll around in a relaxed, leisurely way. It conveys lazing about or casual hanging out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日冇嘢做，不如出街遊遊閒，行下街買杯嘢飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 mou5 je5 zou6, bat1 jyu4 ceot1 gaai1 jau4 jau4 haan4, haang4 haa5 gaai1 maai5 bui1 je5 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天沒事做，不如出門閒逛一下，走走街買杯東西喝。
examples.english_sentence: There's nothing to do today—let's go out and hang around for a bit, walk the streets and get a drink.

mandarin_meaning: 走神；心不在焉；精神恍惚
english_meaning: absent-minded; spaced out; in a daze (literally 'wandering soul')
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人精神不集中、走神，好像靈魂離開身體。可作名詞或形容詞使用，屬口語表達。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is mentally absent or in a daze, as if their 'soul' is wandering. Used colloquially as a noun or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日點解咁似遊魂，發生咩事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1jat6 dim2gaai2 gam3 ci5 jau4 wan4, faat3 sang1 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天為什麼看起來這麼走神？發生什麼事？
examples.english_sentence: Why do you look so absent-minded today? What happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣佢成日遊魂，差啲答錯晒啲題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2si3 go2 zan6 keoi5 sing4jat6 jau4 wan4, caa1 di1 daap3 co3 saai3 dik1 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試的時候他老是走神，差點把題都答錯了。
examples.english_sentence: He kept spacing out during the exam and almost answered the questions incorrectly.

mandarin_meaning: 魂不守舍 / 走神 / 出神
english_meaning: absent-minded; zoning out; dazed (literally 'wandering souls and wild ghosts')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語/片語（形容詞性用法）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人心不在焉、走神或神情恍惚，好像遊魂般無目的遊蕩，常用於口語中責備或描述注意力不集中。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is absent-minded, distracted, or dazed — as if a wandering spirit. Commonly used colloquially to scold or describe lack of attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做遊魂野鬼，專心啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 jau4 wan4 je5 gwai2, zyun1 sam1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別走神，專心一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be absent-minded — focus a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日出神，好似遊魂野鬼咁，做嘢冇效率。

examples.english_sentence: He's been zoning out a lot lately, like a wandering ghost — his work is inefficient.

mandarin_meaning: 不明／未確定（此詞語未在常見詞典或語料中找到，可能為錯別字、罕見異體字或地區性用語）
english_meaning: Unknown / Unattested (the term is not found in common references; it may be a typo, a rare variant character, or a regional expression)
explanation_mandarin: 「遊𨋢河」中的字形「𨋢」為不常見或罕用字，主流粵語詞典與語料庫中未見此整詞的明確記錄。這可能是：1）印刷或輸入時的錯別字；2）某地區（族群）口語或方言詞彙；或3）古字/異體字的殘存形式。建議提供詞彙的來源（出處、句子或錄音）以便進一步確認讀音與含義。
explanation_english: The character 𨋢 in this phrase is an uncommon or rare glyph, and the full expression '遊𨋢河' does not appear in mainstream Cantonese dictionaries or corpora. Please provide the source (context, sentence, or audio) so the pronunciation and meaning can be verified.

examples.english_sentence: The term '遊𨋢河' is not commonly seen; it may be a typo or a dialectal expression.

mandarin_meaning: 运 (yùn)：運氣、運輸、運動、運行等意思
english_meaning: luck; fortune; to transport; movement; motion
explanation_mandarin: 「運」可表示運氣、命運（如運氣好壞），也可表示運輸或運動等動作，常見於複合詞如運氣、貨運、運動。
explanation_english: “運” can mean luck or fortune, and can also denote transport or movement; it commonly appears in compounds like "運氣" (luck), "貨運" (freight), and "運動" (exercise/motion).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日運唔運呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 wan6 m4 wan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天運氣好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you lucky today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貨運公司依家仲未到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo3 wan6 gung1 si1 ji1 gaa1 zung6 mei6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 貨運公司現在還沒到。
examples.english_sentence: The freight company hasn't arrived yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都會運動半個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 wan6 dung6 bun3 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都會運動半個小時。
examples.english_sentence: I exercise for half an hour every day.

mandarin_meaning: 运作 (yùnzuò)：运转、运行、发挥作用
english_meaning: to operate; to function; to run (a system, machine, plan, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某個系統、機構、機器或計劃等開始或持續運行、運轉或正常工作的狀態或動作。
explanation_english: Refers to the action or state of a system, organization, machine, or plan operating, running, or functioning properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機冇正常運作，可能要送去維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 mou5 zing3 soeng4 wan6 zok3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 sung3 heoi3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器没有正常运作，可能要送去维修。
examples.english_sentence: This machine isn't functioning properly; it may need to be sent for repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅新系統已經開始運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 san1 hai6 tung2 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的新系统已经开始运作。
examples.english_sentence: The company's new system has started operating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃要點樣先可以順利運作？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jiu3 dim2 joeng2 sin1 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 wan6 zok3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划要怎样才能顺利运作？
examples.english_sentence: How can this plan operate smoothly?

mandarin_meaning: 运动 (yùndòng)
english_meaning: exercise; sport; physical activity
explanation_mandarin: 指身體的活動或體育競技，也用來表示為了強身健體而進行的鍛鍊。
explanation_english: Refers to physical activity, sports, or exercise; can mean doing activities to improve fitness or taking part in sports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都去做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 heoi3 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都去做运动。
examples.english_sentence: I exercise every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個學校嘅運動會好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hok6 haau6 ge3 wan6 dung6 wui6 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个学校的运动会很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The school's sports day is very lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要多做運動，對身體有益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 do1 zou6 wan6 dung6, deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要多做运动，对身体有益。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said to exercise more; it's good for your health.

mandarin_meaning: 运动场
english_meaning: sports ground; athletic field; stadium
explanation_mandarin: 供体育活动、训练或比赛使用的场地，比如田径场、足球场或综合运动场。
explanation_english: An area or facility used for sports activities, training, or competitions, such as an athletic field, soccer pitch, or stadium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六去運動場踢波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 wan6 dung6 coeng4 tek3 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期六去运动场踢足球吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the sports field to play soccer on Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個學校有一個好大嘅運動場，仲有跑道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hok6 haau6 jau5 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 wan6 dung6 coeng4, zung6 jau5 paau2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校有一个很大的运动场，还有跑道。
examples.english_sentence: This school has a very large sports field and also a running track.

mandarin_meaning: 运动细胞（指有运动天赋或喜欢运动的人）
english_meaning: Having athletic ability or a natural inclination for sports; 'sporty gene'.
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法的詞語，字面為「運動細胞」，用來比喻某人天生或習得對運動有興趣、擅長或容易上手，帶有調侃或稱讚的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning 'sports cell'. It describes someone who naturally has athletic talent or a strong interest in sports — used to compliment or tease that a person is sporty or has a 'sports gene'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有運動細胞，乜運動都學得幾快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 wan6 dung6 sai3 baau1, mat1 wan6 dung6 dou1 hok6 dak1 gei2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有运动细胞，什么运动都学得挺快。
examples.english_sentence: He has athletic ability — he picks up any sport quite quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇乜運動細胞，跑步一陣就攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 mat1 wan6 dung6 sai3 baau1, paau2 bou6 jat1 zan6 zau6 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没什么运动细胞，跑步一会儿就累。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really have athletic talent; I get tired after running for a short while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你細佬真係有運動細胞，成日約人打波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai3 lou2 zan1 hai6 jau5 wan6 dung6 sai3 baau1, seng4 jat6 joek3 jan4 daa2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你弟弟真有运动细胞，总是约人打球。
examples.english_sentence: Your younger brother really is sporty — he's always arranging to play ball games.

mandarin_meaning: 運動褲（运动裤）
english_meaning: sweatpants; tracksuit pants; athletic pants
explanation_mandarin: 指用於運動或休閒穿着的寬鬆長褲，通常由棉或合成纖維製成，穿着舒適，常見於健身、慢跑或日常休閒場合。
explanation_english: Refers to loose-fitting long pants worn for sports or casual wear, typically made of cotton or synthetic fabrics; comfortable and commonly used for gym, jogging, or everyday leisure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落街我想著條運動褲，舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 gaai1 ngo5 soeng2 zoek3 tiu4 wan6 dung6 fu3, syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天出門我想穿運動褲，會舒服一點。
examples.english_sentence: I want to wear sweatpants when I go out today; they'll be more comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著運動褲去健身房做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 wan6 dung6 fu3 heoi3 gin6 san1 fong4 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常穿運動褲去健身房運動。
examples.english_sentence: He often wears sweatpants to the gym to work out.

mandarin_meaning: 运势（某人在某段时间的运气、吉凶走向）
english_meaning: fortune; luck; the trend/strength of one's luck over a period
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或事物在某段時間內的運氣或吉凶走向，常見於占卜、命理、風水、星座等語境，表示好運或壞運的狀況及趨勢。
explanation_english: Refers to a person’s or thing’s luck or the trend of good/bad fortune over a period. Commonly used in contexts like divination, fortune-telling, feng shui, and astrology to describe how lucky someone is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月我嘅運勢唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 ngo5 ge3 wan6 si3 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月我的运势不错。
examples.english_sentence: My luck is pretty good this month.

mandarin_meaning: 走運 / 幸運
english_meaning: to be lucky; to have good luck
explanation_mandarin: 「運吉」是香港廣東話的口語/俚語，用來表示某人遇上幸運的事或運氣較好，相當於普通話的「走運」或「幸運」。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning someone is lucky or has good fortune; equivalent to Mandarin '走运' or 'fortunate'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞咗全班最高分，運吉晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 lo2 zo2 cyun4 baan1 zeoi3 gou1 fan1, wan6 gat1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考試拿了全班最高分，真走運。
examples.english_sentence: He got the highest score in the class on the exam — really lucky.

mandarin_meaning: 运毒
english_meaning: to traffic/smuggle drugs; drug trafficking

explanation_english: Refers to illegally transporting or smuggling illegal drugs from one place to another for distribution or sale; a criminal activity involving drug trafficking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人懷疑運毒，已經畀警方拘捕。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人怀疑运毒，已经被警方拘捕。
examples.english_sentence: He was suspected of trafficking drugs and has already been arrested by the police.

mandarin_meaning: 运气（好运或坏运）
english_meaning: luck; fortune (good or bad)
explanation_mandarin: 表示個人遇到好事或壞事的機遇，常用來形容好運或厄運。
explanation_english: Refers to the chance of experiencing good or bad outcomes; commonly used to describe good luck or bad luck.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1jat6 wan6hei3 hou2, dei6tit3 mou5 sak1ce1, zeon2si4 faan1 dou3 gung1si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天运气好，地铁没有塞车，准时到公司。
examples.english_sentence: I'm lucky today; the subway wasn't congested and I arrived at the office on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣我運氣差，撞正全部都係難題。

examples.english_sentence: I had bad luck during the exam; it just so happened that all the questions were difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔可以淨係靠運氣，仲要有策略同努力。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不可以只靠运气，还要有策略和努力。
examples.english_sentence: You can't run a business relying only on luck; you also need strategy and hard work.

mandarin_meaning: 运河
english_meaning: canal
explanation_mandarin: 由人工或天然形成的水道，通常用於航運、灌溉或排水，有時也成為城市景觀的一部分。
explanation_english: A waterway, natural or man-made, dug or constructed for navigation, irrigation, or drainage; often part of a city's landscape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋沿住運河散步，風景好靚。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们沿着运河散步，风景很美。
examples.english_sentence: We walked along the canal; the scenery was beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 運勢不順；運氣不好
english_meaning: bad luck; unlucky; having a run of misfortune; luck stalled
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示近期運氣不好、事情不順利或遇到阻滯。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning one's luck is poor or things are not going smoothly — a period of misfortune or stalled fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近真係運滯，做乜嘢都唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 zan1 hai6 wan6 zai3, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近運氣很差，做什麼都不順利。
examples.english_sentence: I've been really unlucky lately; nothing I do goes smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 運用；使用、利用
english_meaning: to use; to apply; to make use of
explanation_mandarin: 表示使用或應用某種方法、工具、知識或原則於特定情況或目的上。
explanation_english: Indicates using or applying a method, tool, knowledge, or principle for a particular situation or purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法可以運用喺唔同嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1faat3 ho2 ji5 wan6 jung6 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個方法可以運用在不同的情況。
examples.english_sentence: This method can be applied in different situations.

examples.english_sentence: The teacher taught me how to apply these grammar rules to write essays.

mandarin_meaning: 运程；运势（指一段时间内的运气和吉凶）
english_meaning: fortune; luck; the course of one's luck over a period of time
explanation_mandarin: 指個人在某段時間內的運氣、好壞、吉凶走向，常在占卜、星座或命理語境中使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's luck or fortune during a certain period and how it may change; commonly used in contexts like fortune-telling, astrology, or discussing prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今年嘅運程點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 nin4 ge3 wan6 cing4 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今年的运程怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: How is your fortune this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 占星師話我下半年嘅運程會改善。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 占星师说我下半年的运程会改善。
examples.english_sentence: The astrologer said my fortune will improve in the second half of the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔信算命，但間中都會睇下自己嘅運程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 seon3 syun3 ming6, daan6 gaan1 zung1 dou1 wui5 tai2 haa5 zi6 gei2 ge3 wan6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不信算命，但有時也會看看自己的运程。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't believe in fortune-telling, but he sometimes checks his own fortune.

mandarin_meaning: 运算 (yùn suàn)
english_meaning: calculation; computation; to compute
explanation_mandarin: 指進行計算的操作或計算的過程與結果，常用於數學、統計與計算機科學等領域。
explanation_english: Refers to performing calculations or the process/results of computation; commonly used in mathematics, statistics, and computer science.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式負責大量運算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 fu6 zaak3 daai6 loeng6 wan6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序负责大量运算。
examples.english_sentence: This program handles heavy computations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要先做一啲基礎運算，先至可以開始下一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 zou6 jat1 di1 gei1 co2 wan6 syun3, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 haa6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先做一些基础运算，才能开始下一步。
examples.english_sentence: We need to perform some basic calculations before moving on to the next step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人工智能可以加快數值運算嘅速度。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 人工智能可以加快数值运算的速度。
examples.english_sentence: AI can speed up numerical computations.

mandarin_meaning: 在幕後制定策略、指揮全局；謀劃和掌控全局
english_meaning: to plan strategies and direct operations from behind the scenes; to manage and command overall strategy
explanation_mandarin: 形容在後方制定計劃、謀略並指揮全局，通常指有謀略、善於策劃並掌控全局的人。
explanation_english: Describes making strategic plans and directing overall operations from behind the scenes; often refers to someone adept at planning and controlling the big picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺幕後運籌帷幄，先令個項目順利完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mok6 hau6 wan6 cau4 wai4 ngok6, sin1 ling6 go3 hong6 muk6 seon6 lei6 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在幕後運籌帷幄，才使這個項目順利完成。
examples.english_sentence: He was strategizing behind the scenes, which enabled the project to be completed smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 活動/鍛鍊腿部；踢腿（練習）
english_meaning: to move/exercise the legs; to practice kicking (e.g., in sports or martial arts); to go for a walk/use one's legs
explanation_mandarin: 「運腳」指活動或鍛鍊腿部肌肉、練習踢腿，或泛指用腿走動、散步以活動身體。
explanation_english: “運腳” means to move or exercise the legs (e.g., stretch, train, or kick); it can also be used more generally to refer to walking or moving around to get the legs active.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱坐咗成日，出嚟運下腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 co5 zo2 sing4 jat6, ceot1 lai4 wan6 haa5 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛坐了一整天，出來活動一下腿。
examples.english_sentence: I just sat all day; I'm coming out to move my legs a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打足球要多運腳，先可以踢得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zuk1 kau4 jiu3 do1 wan6 goek3, sin1 ho2 ji5 tek3 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 踢足球要多鍛鍊腿部，才能踢得好。
examples.english_sentence: To play football well, you need to train your legs a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 运行 (yùnxíng)
english_meaning: to run; to operate; to be in motion
explanation_mandarin: 表示系統、機器、列車等在運轉或運作；也可指事物處於運動或運作狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that a system, machine, train, etc. is running or operating; can also mean being in motion or functioning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家部電腦運行得好順暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 bou6 din6 nou5 wan6 hang4 dak1 hou2 seon6 coeng3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这台电脑运行得很顺畅。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is running smoothly now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵維修期間列車暫停運行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 wai4 sau1 kei4 gaan1 lit6 ce1 zaam6 ting4 wan6 hang4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁维修期间列车暂停运行。
examples.english_sentence: Trains are temporarily suspended during subway maintenance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式喺舊版本上唔能夠運行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 hai2 gau6 baan2 bun2 soeng6 m4 nang4 gau3 wan6 hang4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序在旧版本上无法运行。
examples.english_sentence: This program cannot run on the old version.

mandarin_meaning: 运送货物；运输货物 (yùn huò)
english_meaning: to transport or deliver goods; haul cargo
explanation_mandarin: 指用车辆或其他方式将货物从一地运送到另一地，常用于物流、送货等情境。
explanation_english: To move or deliver goods from one place to another, typically using vehicles; commonly used in logistics and delivery contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今晚要運貨去深圳，記得準時返廠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 wan6 fo3 heoi3 sam1 zan3, gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4 faan1 cong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今晚要运货去深圳，记得准时回厂。
examples.english_sentence: They need to transport goods to Shenzhen tonight; remember to return to the factory on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運貨司機要小心路面情況，尤其係落雨天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 fo3 si1 gei1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 lou6 min6 cing4 fong3, jau1 kei4 hai6 lok6 jyu5 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运输货物的司机要注意路况，尤其是在下雨天。
examples.english_sentence: The driver transporting goods should watch the road conditions, especially on rainy days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次遲到係因為貨車塞車，運貨花咗兩個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ci4 dou3 hai6 jan1 wai6 fo3 ce1 sak1 ce1, wan6 fo3 faa1 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次迟到是因为货车塞车，运货花了两个小时。
examples.english_sentence: This delay was because the truck was stuck in traffic; transporting the goods took two hours.

mandarin_meaning: 运费
english_meaning: shipping fee; freight charge
explanation_mandarin: 指運送貨物或包裹所需支付的費用，包含快遞、貨運或郵寄等運輸成本。
explanation_english: The fee charged for transporting goods or parcels, covering costs for courier, freight, or postage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件貨嘅運費要幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 fo3 ge3 wan6 fai3 jiu3 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件貨的運費要多少？
examples.english_sentence: How much is the shipping fee for that item?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賣家話買滿二百蚊就免運費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai6 gaa1 waa6 maai5 mun5 ji6 baak3 man1 zau6 min5 wan6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賣家說買滿200元就免運費。
examples.english_sentence: The seller said shipping is free for purchases over $200.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要快啲寄嘅話，運費會貴啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 faai3 di1 gei3 ge3 waa6, wan6 fai3 wui5 gwai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要快一點寄的話，運費會貴一點。
examples.english_sentence: If you want it sent faster, the shipping cost will be higher.

mandarin_meaning: 运气；运程（口语）
english_meaning: luck; fortune (especially one's streak of good or bad luck)
explanation_mandarin: 「運路」是粵語口語，意思接近普通話的「運氣」或「運程」，用來形容一個人近期的好壞運或整體運勢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term equivalent to 'luck' or 'fortune' (similar to Mandarin 運氣). It refers to a person's recent streak of good or bad luck or overall fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好灰心，運路會好返嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, wan6 lou6 wui5 hou2 faan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要灰心，运气会好起来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be discouraged; your luck will get better.

mandarin_meaning: 运气用光/走了，走霉运
english_meaning: to have one's luck run out; to be unlucky
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，表示運氣不再好、走霉運，最近做什麼事情都不順利。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning someone's luck has run out or they are experiencing bad luck; used when things stop going well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近好似運路走，做乜嘢都唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 wan6 lou6 zau2, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近好像走霉运，做什么都不顺。
examples.english_sentence: I seem to have run out of luck recently; nothing I do goes smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次面試我準備得好好，但公司揀咗其他人，真係運路走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 min6 si3 ngo5 zeon2 bei6 dak1 hou2 hou2, daan6 gung1 si1 gaau2 zo2 kei4 taa1 jan4, zan1 hai6 wan6 lou6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次面试我准备得很好，但公司选了别人，真是走霉运。
examples.english_sentence: I prepared well for this interview, but the company chose someone else — my luck has really run out.

mandarin_meaning: 运载（运输、装载并运送）
english_meaning: to carry; to transport; to convey; (can refer to carrying capacity)
explanation_mandarin: 指用交通工具或其他方式將貨物或人裝載並運送，或指某載具的承載能力。
explanation_english: Refers to loading and transporting goods or people by a vehicle or other means; can also denote the carrying capacity of a vessel or vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢艘貨船可以運載二千噸貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sou1 fo3 syun4 ho2 ji5 wan6 zoi3 ji6 cin1 deon6 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這艘貨船可以運載兩千噸貨物。
examples.english_sentence: This cargo ship can carry two thousand tons of goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部貨車嘅運載能力好高，適合長途運輸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 fo3 ce1 ge3 wan6 zoi3 nang4 lik6 hou2 gou1, sik1 hap6 coeng4 tou4 wan6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這輛貨車的運載能力很高，適合長途運輸。
examples.english_sentence: This truck has a high carrying capacity and is suitable for long-distance transport.

mandarin_meaning: 运输 (yùnshū) — 把人或货物从一地运到另一地；运输业
english_meaning: transport; transportation; to transport (people or goods)
explanation_mandarin: 指把人員或貨物從一個地方運送到另一個地方的活動或相關行業。
explanation_english: Refers to the activity or industry of moving people or goods from one place to another; can be used as a noun or verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司主要做貨物運輸生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyu2 jiu3 zou6 fo3 mat6 wan6 syu1 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司主要从事货物运输生意。
examples.english_sentence: This company mainly engages in freight transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府投資改善公共運輸網絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tau4 zi1 goi2 sin3 gung1 gung6 wan6 syu1 mong5 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府投资改善公共运输网络。
examples.english_sentence: The government is investing to improve the public transportation network.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班車主要負責工人運輸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 ce1 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 gung1 jan4 wan6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这班车主要负责运送工人。
examples.english_sentence: This shuttle primarily transports workers.

mandarin_meaning: 输送带 / 传送带（运输带）
english_meaning: conveyor belt
explanation_mandarin: 指用來搬運物品、在生產線或機場等處自動輸送貨物的長條機械設備。
explanation_english: A long mechanical belt used to transport items automatically, commonly found on production lines, in factories, or at airports for luggage handling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工廠入面有一條自動運輸帶，專門用嚟搬運貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cong2 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 tiu4 zi6 dung6 wan6 syu1 daai3, zyun1 mun4 jung6 lai4 bun1 wan6 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂里面有一条自动输送带，专门用来搬运货物。
examples.english_sentence: There's an automatic conveyor belt in the factory used specifically to transport goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場嘅行李運輸帶壞咗，啲旅客要等多陣先拎到行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 ge3 hang4 lei5 wan6 syu1 daai3 waai6 zo2, di1 leoi5 haak3 jiu3 dang2 do1 zan6 sin1 ling1 dou3 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场的行李运输带坏了，旅客要多等一会儿才拿到行李。
examples.english_sentence: The airport's baggage conveyor belt broke, so passengers have to wait a while before they can get their luggage.

mandarin_meaning: 运转；转动、运行；（比喻）局势或运气开始好转
english_meaning: to turn/rotate; to operate or run (a machine or system); (figuratively) to take a turn, as in fortunes or situations improving
explanation_mandarin: 指機械、系統等轉動或運行。在抽象用法上可表示形勢、運氣等開始發生變化或好轉。
explanation_english: Refers to a machine, mechanism, or system turning or operating. Figuratively, it can describe situations or luck beginning to change or improve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器運轉唔正常，要叫師傅嚟修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 wan6 zyun2 m4 zing3 soeng4, jiu3 giu3 si1 fu1 lai4 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部機器運轉不正常，要叫師傅來修理。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is not operating properly; we need to call a technician to repair it.

mandarin_meaning: 运送 (yùnsòng)
english_meaning: to transport; to deliver; to convey
explanation_mandarin: 把貨物或人從一個地方移動到另一個地方，或指負責遞送物品的行為。
explanation_english: To move or carry goods or people from one place to another; also refers to the act of delivering items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快遞公司會負責運送包裹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 dai6 gung1 si1 wui5 fu6 zaak3 wan6 sung3 baau1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快递公司会负责运送包裹。
examples.english_sentence: The courier company will be responsible for delivering the packages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會運送傢俬到你屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 wan6 sung3 gaa1 si1 dou3 nei5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会运送家具到你家。
examples.english_sentence: We will deliver the furniture to your home.

mandarin_meaning: （量词/副词）表示动作的次数，相当于“次、回”；也可作副词表示“遍及、全部、整个”
english_meaning: A measure word indicating number of times (e.g., 'once', 'three times'); also used adverbially to mean 'throughout' or 'all over'.
explanation_mandarin: “遍”常用于计数动作发生的次数，如“做一遍、看三遍”。有时作为副词表示整个范围或全部过程，如“掃一遍”表示把整个地方都掃過一次。
explanation_english: Used as a counter for how many times an action occurs (e.g., 'do it one time', 'three times'). It can also be used adverbially to indicate the whole extent or that something has been done throughout (e.g., 'cleaned the entire room once').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做咗三遍啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 zo2 saam1 bin6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做了三遍了。
examples.english_sentence: I've done it three times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以再試多一遍？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 si3 do1 jat1 bin6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以再試一遍嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you try one more time?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經將成間屋掃咗一遍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 sing4 gaan1 uk1 sou3 zo2 jat1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經把整間房子掃了一遍。
examples.english_sentence: I've already cleaned the whole room once.

mandarin_meaning: 遍布 (biàn bù)
english_meaning: to be spread all over; to be distributed throughout
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某種情況散佈到各處、充斥於整個範圍。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is spread across or distributed throughout an area or range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病毒已遍佈全球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 duk6 ji5 pin3 bou3 cyun4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病毒已遍布全球。
examples.english_sentence: The virus has spread across the globe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個品牌嘅門店已經遍佈全港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ban2 paai4 ge3 mun4 dim3 ji5 ging1 pin3 bou3 cyun4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个品牌的门店已经遍布全港。
examples.english_sentence: The brand's stores are already spread throughout Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 森林裏遍佈各種野花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 lam4 leoi5 pin3 bou3 gok3 zung2 je5 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 森林里遍布各种野花。
examples.english_sentence: The forest is covered with all kinds of wildflowers.

mandarin_meaning: 遍及；遍布，分布到各處
english_meaning: to be spread throughout; to pervade; to extend over
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或情況分布到各個地方、到處都有。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is distributed or present everywhere; to spread or extend throughout an area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個消息已經遍及整個社區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 ji5 ging1 bin3 kap6 zing2 go3 se5 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個消息已經遍及整個社區。
examples.english_sentence: This news has already spread throughout the whole community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 污染問題已遍及全球，唔可以忽視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 jim5 man6 tai4 ji5 bin3 kap6 cyun4 kau4, m4 ho2 ji5 fat1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 污染問題已遍及全球，不可以忽視。
examples.english_sentence: Pollution problems have spread across the globe and cannot be ignored.

mandarin_meaning: 到处；处处都是
english_meaning: everywhere; all over the place
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某種現象在某個地方廣泛存在，到處都可以看到。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is widespread in a place and can be found everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋天到，街頭遍地落葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 tin1 dou3, gaai1 tau4 bin3 dei6 lok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋天到了，街头到处都是落叶。
examples.english_sentence: In autumn, the streets are covered with fallen leaves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家網上遍地都係廣告，真係煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mong5 soeng6 bin3 dei6 dou1 hai6 gwong2 gao3, zan1 hai6 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在网上到处都是广告，真烦。
examples.english_sentence: There are ads all over the internet now; it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 遍地開花（比喻事物大量出現、迅速擴散）
english_meaning: to spring up everywhere; to proliferate widely; to be found everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 原指花朵遍布各地，現常用來比喻某種現象、事業或活動在很多地方迅速出現或發展。
explanation_english: Originally describes flowers blooming everywhere; now used figuratively to mean a phenomenon, business, or activity appearing or spreading rapidly and widely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業潮令呢區遍地開花，越嚟越多新公司成立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 ciu4 ling6 ni1 keoi1 bin3 dei6 hoi1 faa1, jyut6 lei4 jyut6 do1 san1 gung1 si1 sing4 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 創業潮讓這一帶遍地開花，越來越多新公司成立。
examples.english_sentence: The start-up wave has caused this area to spring up everywhere; more and more new companies are being established.

mandarin_meaning: 遍地黄金（biàn dì huáng jīn）：到处都是黄金，形容财富或赚钱的机会很多。
english_meaning: Literally 'gold all over the ground' — used to describe a place rich in wealth or where opportunities to make money are abundant; 'money-making opportunities everywhere.'
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是到處都是黃金，常用來形容某地富饒、商機多或容易獲利，也可用來提醒不要盲目投資。
explanation_english: Literally means 'gold is everywhere.' Commonly used to describe a place that is very prosperous or full of business opportunities — often implying it's easy to make money there; can also be used cautinarily to warn against assuming easy profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年呢區發展快，遍地黃金，大家都想入市投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 ni1 keoi1 faat3 zin2 faai3, bin3 dei6 wong4 gam1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 soeng2 jap6 si5 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年這區發展很快，遍地黃金，大家都想入市投資。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years this area has developed rapidly and is like gold all over — everyone wants to invest in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為遍地黃金，其實風險都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai6 bin3 dei6 wong4 gam1, kei4 sat6 fung1 him2 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以為遍地黃金，其實風險也很高。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume there is gold everywhere; actually the risks are high.

mandarin_meaning: 遍體鱗傷（全身受傷，傷痕累累）
english_meaning: covered with wounds and bruises all over; severely battered; badly injured
explanation_mandarin: 形容全身多處受傷或傷痕累累，也可用來比喻遭受嚴重打擊或挫敗。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose body is covered with wounds and bruises; can also be used metaphorically to mean severely battered or badly hurt (physically or figuratively).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車禍之後佢遍體鱗傷，要住院休養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 fo2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 pin3 tai2 leon4 soeng1, jiu3 zyu6 jyun2 jau1 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 車禍之後他遍體鱗傷，需要住院休養。
examples.english_sentence: After the car accident, he was covered in injuries and had to be hospitalized to recover.

mandarin_meaning: 过 (guò)：经过、越过、度过；作助词表示经历过或完成
english_meaning: to pass/cross; to exceed; to spend (time); (particle) indicates past experience or completion
explanation_mandarin: 「過」在廣東話可作動詞，表示穿過、經過、超過或度過（例如過馬路、過年、過咗嗰道）；亦常作經驗或完成助詞，用於動詞後表示曾經做過某事（例如試過、見過）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "過" is used as a verb meaning to pass, cross, exceed, or spend (time) (e.g. 過馬路, 過年). It is also an experiential/completive particle placed after a verb to indicate having done something (e.g. 試過, 睇過).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試過嗰間餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 gwo3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我試過那家餐廳。
examples.english_sentence: I've tried that restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要過馬路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gwo3 maa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要过马路。
examples.english_sentence: We need to cross the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做過頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 gwo3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做过头。
examples.english_sentence: Don't overdo it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每年都一齊過年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 jat1 cai4 gwo3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每年都一起过年。
examples.english_sentence: Our family celebrates the New Year together every year.

mandarin_meaning: 過一會兒 / 過一陣子 / 等一下
english_meaning: wait a bit; after a while
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來表示讓某事或某人稍微等待一會兒，或表示某情況在一段短時間後會改變。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning 'after a short while' or 'wait a bit'; used to ask someone to wait or to indicate that something will change after some time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使擔心，過一戙就會好返。
