explanation_english: Refers to sending or delivering letters, parcels, etc., via the postal service or mail delivery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會負責文件嘅郵遞工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 fu6 zaak3 man4 gin6 ge3 jau4 dai6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司会负责文件的邮递工作。
examples.english_sentence: The company will be responsible for the postal delivery of the documents.

mandarin_meaning: 邮政和电信（邮政与通信服务）
english_meaning: postal and telecommunications (postal and telecommunication services)
explanation_mandarin: 指与邮政和电信有关的部门或业务，包含寄送邮件、电话、电报及其他通信服务的机构与服务。
explanation_english: Refers to departments or services related to postal and telecommunications, including mail delivery, telephone, telegraph, and other communication services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要去郵電局寄一封信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 heoi3 jau4 din6 guk6 gei3 jat1 fung1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要去邮电局寄一封信。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the post and telecommunication bureau to mail a letter.

mandarin_meaning: 都 (dōu)
english_meaning: all / both / also / even
explanation_mandarin: 用作副词，表示「全部、都」、「也/也會」或用來強調（相當於「甚至」）。通常放在主語或動詞前以表示包含性或強調。
explanation_english: An adverb used to indicate 'all' or 'both', to mean 'also'/'too', or to add emphasis (similar to 'even'). It usually appears before verbs or adjectives to show inclusiveness or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們都去。
examples.english_sentence: We are all going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日都冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 dou1 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天也沒來。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come today either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁講，我都唔信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 dou1 m4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這樣說，我也不相信。
examples.english_sentence: Even if he says that, I don't believe it.

mandarin_meaning: 好像；似乎
english_meaning: seems; appears; looks like
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示根據外在跡象或印象作出推測，相當於普通話的「好像、似乎」。可單獨使用，也常與「係」連用（如「都似係」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate conjecture or appearance based on evidence or impression—equivalent to 'seems' or 'appears'. It can be used alone or with 'hai6' (係) as in 'dou1 ci5 hai6'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日冇返工，都似病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1, dou1 ci5 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天沒去上班，似乎生病了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't go to work today; he seems to be sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢咁講，都似有啲唔妥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 keoi5 gam2 gong2, dou1 ci5 jau5 di1 m4 to2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽他這麼說，好像有些不妥。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, it seems something's off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件事都似係佢做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 si6 dou1 ci5 hai6 keoi5 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件事好像是他做的。
examples.english_sentence: That thing seems to have been done by him.

mandarin_meaning: 還是；仍然；都是
english_meaning: still; (it's) still the case; anyway; all are
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語用法，表示某種情況依然成立或用來總結、強調某個觀點；有時帶無奈或讓步的語氣，相當於普通話的「還是／仍然／都是」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate that something remains the case, to summarize or emphasize a point, or to express resignation/ concession. Comparable to Mandarin "háishì/ réngrán" or English "still/ anyway/ it's just".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都係唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 hai6 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他還是不來。
examples.english_sentence: He's still not coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我都係覺得呢件事冇得救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 hai6 gok3 dak1 ni1 gin6 si6 mou5 dak1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我還是覺得這件事沒救。
examples.english_sentence: I still think this matter is hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買唔買都係你決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 m4 maai5 dou1 hai6 nei5 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買不買都由你決定。
examples.english_sentence: Whether to buy it or not is up to you.

mandarin_meaning: 也算是 / 可以算作
english_meaning: can be considered; may be regarded as; is sort of
explanation_mandarin: 「都叫」是廣東話口語用法，用來表示某事物或情況達到可被歸類或接受的程度，相當於普通話的「也算是」或「可以算作」。常用於評價或作出保留性的肯定。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate that something can be regarded as or counts as a certain thing; equivalent to Mandarin '也算是' or English 'can be considered'. Often used to give a tentative or moderate affirmation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都叫係我朋友啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 giu3 hai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他也算是我的朋友了。
examples.english_sentence: He can be considered my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試成績都叫可以啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 dou1 giu3 ho2 ji5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試成績也算可以了。
examples.english_sentence: This exam result is passable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳都叫幾好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 dou1 giu3 gei2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳也算蠻好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is pretty good.

mandarin_meaning: 都城 / 首都（指國家或政權的行政、政治中心）
english_meaning: capital city; the seat of government (historically may refer to a walled capital)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個國家或政權的政治、行政中心；在歷史語境中常指有城牆的首都或都邑。
explanation_english: Refers to the capital of a state or polity—the political and administrative center. In historical contexts, it often denotes a walled capital city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 北京係中國嘅都城。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bak1 ging1 hai6 zung1 gwok3 ge3 dou1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 北京是中国的都城。
examples.english_sentence: Beijing is the capital of China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時候，都城通常有城牆用嚟防禦外敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 hau6, dou1 sing4 tung1 soeng4 jau5 sing4 coeng4 jung6 lai4 fong4 jyu6 ngoi6 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时候，都城通常有城墙用来防御外敌。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, the capital usually had city walls to defend against external enemies.

mandarin_meaning: 已经长大 / 都长大了
english_meaning: already grown up; grown
explanation_mandarin: 「都大」是廣東話口語用法，表示某人或某些人已經長大或成熟，可用來說明年齡、能力或不再需要照顧。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning someone or a group has already grown up or matured; used to indicate age, capability, or that someone no longer needs looking after.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都大喇，唔使你擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 daai6 laa3, m4 sai2 nei5 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都大了，不需要你担心。
examples.english_sentence: He's already grown up; you don't need to worry about him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路都大咗，唔好再玩啲危險嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 dou1 daai6 zo2, m4 hou2 zoi3 waan2 di1 ngai4 him2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些小孩子都长大了，不要再玩危险的东西。
examples.english_sentence: The kids have grown up; don't let them play with dangerous things anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都大㗎啦，自己處理啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 daai6 gaa3 laa1, zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都大了，自己处理吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're grown up; handle it yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 都可以 / 都好（表示兩者都可接受，或表示也不錯）
english_meaning: either is fine; both are okay; it's all good; also fine
explanation_mandarin: 「都好」常用於表示對多個選項都可以接受（相當於「都可以」「無所謂」），也可用來表示對某事的肯定或讚許（相當於「也不錯」）。語氣可中性、隨意或帶有讓步意味，廣泛出現在口語對話中。
explanation_english: „都好” is commonly used to indicate indifference between choices (equivalent to "either is fine" / "both are okay"), and can also express approval or that something is fine. The tone can be neutral, casual, or concessive; it is widely used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食麵定飯都好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 min6 ding6 faan6 dou1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃面还是吃饭都可以。
examples.english_sentence: Either noodles or rice is fine tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個主意都好，我哋試下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 dou1 hou2, ngo5 dei6 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个主意也好，我们试试看吧。
examples.english_sentence: This idea is fine too — let's give it a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想出街，我哋留喺屋企都好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1, ngo5 dei6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei5 dou1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想出去，我们待在家里也可以。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't feel like going out, staying at home is fine too.

mandarin_meaning: 都市 / 大城市
english_meaning: metropolis; city; urban area
explanation_mandarin: 指大型城市或都会区，人口密集，商业、交通和各类设施较为发达的区域。
explanation_english: Refers to a metropolis or urban area with dense population and developed commercial and transportation facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意住喺都市入面，方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 zyu6 hai2 dou1 si5 jap6 min6, fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢住在都市里，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: I like living in the city; it's very convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 都市传说
english_meaning: urban legend; urban myth
explanation_mandarin: 指在都市中流傳的未經證實、通常帶有驚悚或奇異成分的傳聞或故事，常被當作真實事件口耳相傳。
explanation_english: A story or rumor circulated as true within urban communities, often unverified and featuring sensational or strange elements; commonly referred to as an urban legend or urban myth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲都市傳說大多係口耳相傳，未必可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dou1 si5 cyun4 syut3 daai6 do1 hai6 hau2 ji5 soeng1 cyun4, mei6 bat1 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些都市传说大多是口耳相传，未必可信。
examples.english_sentence: Those urban legends are mostly passed around by word of mouth and aren't necessarily credible.

mandarin_meaning: 城市傳說 (dūshì chuánshuō)
english_meaning: urban legend; urban myth
explanation_mandarin: 指在現代城市中流傳、未經證實但廣為流傳的故事或傳聞，通常帶有神秘或驚悚成分，反映都市民間信仰與恐懼。
explanation_english: Stories or rumors circulating in modern cities that are unverified but widely spread; often mysterious or scary tales reflecting urban folklore and common fears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多都市傳說都係杜撰出嚟，唔需要太當真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 dou1 si5 cyun4 syut3 dou1 hai6 dou6 zyun3 ceot1 lai4, m4 seoi1 jiu3 taai3 dong1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多都市傳說都是杜撰出來的，不需要太當真。
examples.english_sentence: Many urban legends are fabricated; you don't need to take them too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人講呢度有鬼，可能只係都市傳說嚟啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 gong2 ni1 dou6 jau5 gwai2, ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 dou1 si5 cyun4 syut3 lai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說這裏有鬼，可能只是都市傳說而已。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say there's a ghost here, but it might just be an urban legend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽過一個都市傳說，話深夜打電話打唔通會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gwo3 jat1 go3 dou1 si5 cyun4 syut3, waa6 sam1 je6 daa2 din6 waa2 daa2 m4 tung1 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我聽過一個都市傳說，說深夜打電話打不通會出事。
examples.english_sentence: I heard an urban legend that if your phone call won't go through late at night, something bad will happen.

mandarin_meaning: 都市傳說 (指在城市中流傳、真偽難辨的傳聞或故事)
english_meaning: urban legend (a widely circulated story or rumor, of doubtful truth, often with frightening or ironic elements)
explanation_mandarin: 指在都市中流傳、真實性存疑的傳聞或故事，通常帶有恐怖、奇異或警示意味，屬於口耳相傳的民間傳說類型。
explanation_english: Refers to rumors or stories circulated in urban environments whose truth is doubtful; they often contain frightening, bizarre, or cautionary elements and are passed along orally as modern folklore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事聽落好似都市傳説，但係冇證據證明係真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 teng1 lok6 hou2 ci5 dou1 si5 cyun4 syut3, daan6 hai6 mou5 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 hai6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事聽起來像都市傳說，但沒有證據證明是真的。
examples.english_sentence: This sounds like an urban legend, but there is no evidence proving it's true.

mandarin_meaning: （某事）已经成问题 / 变成问题
english_meaning: becomes a problem; already problematic; this is a problem
explanation_mandarin: 用于表示某件事或某种情况已经变得有问题或会造成麻烦，常用来强调情况会变得难处理或影响正常进行。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something has become a problem or will cause trouble; often used to emphasize that a situation is becoming difficult to handle or will affect normal progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔早啲準備，考試都成問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 zou2 di1 zeon2 bei6, haau2 si3 dou1 sing4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不早点准备，考试就会成问题。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't prepare earlier, the exam will become a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家冇車去，出門都成問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mou5 ce1 heoi3, ceot1 mun4 dou1 sing4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在没有车去，出门都成问题。
examples.english_sentence: There's no car now; even going out is a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲資料唔齊，做報告都成問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zi1 liu2 m4 cai4, zou6 bou3 gou3 dou1 sing4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的资料不齐，做报告都成问题。
examples.english_sentence: His materials are incomplete, so doing the report is problematic.

mandarin_meaning: 都会（表示将来/可能）；（名词）大都会、都会区
english_meaning: will/would (auxiliary indicating future or likelihood); metropolis (noun)
explanation_mandarin: “都會”在粤语中可作副词，表示“都会/会（也）”，用于表示将来或可能性；也可作名词，表示“大都会、都会区”这样的城市概念。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "都會" can function as an adverb meaning "will/would" or "also will" to indicate future action or likelihood; it can also be a noun meaning "metropolis" or "urban area."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日都會去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天都会去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We will all go on a trip tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個大都會，資訊同文化好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 dou1 wui5，zi1 seon3 tung4 man4 faa3 hou2 fung1 fu3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个大都会，信息和文化很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a metropolis; information and culture are very rich.

mandarin_meaning: 都会大学 / 都市大學（指位於都會區的大学，或作为某些院校的名称）
english_meaning: metropolitan university; city university (a university located in a metropolitan area or used as an institution name)
explanation_mandarin: “都會大學”字面意思是位於都市或都會區的大学，既可以泛指重視城市研究或服務都市社區的高校，也可作為某些院校的名稱或口語稱呼。視語境可指具體學校或一類型的大學。
explanation_english: Literally 'metropolitan university' — a university located in a metropolitan/urban area. It can refer generically to universities focused on urban issues or community engagement, or be used as the proper name/short form of a specific institution depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺都會大學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 dou1 wui6 daai6 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在都會大學讀書。
examples.english_sentence: I study at the Metropolitan University.

mandarin_meaning: （音譯）常用作外來人名或專有名詞的音譯，詞義依語境而定，屬較少見用法
english_meaning: A transliteration used as a foreign proper name; meaning depends on context (uncommon usage)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（專有名詞 / 音譯）
explanation_mandarin: 「都柏文」在粵語中並非常用詞彙，通常作為外來人名或專有名詞的音譯。具體所指需依上下文判斷（例如作為人名、姓氏或其他英語詞的音譯）。
explanation_english: “都柏文” is not a common Cantonese lexical item; it is typically used as a transliteration of a foreign proper name. Its exact reference depends on context (e.g., a personal name, surname, or other English proper noun).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢叫都柏文，係我公司嘅新同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 giu3 dou1 baak3 man4, hai6 ngo5 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他叫都柏文，是我公司的新同事。
examples.english_sentence: His name is Dou Bak Man; he's a new colleague at my company.

mandarin_meaning: 都柏林（愛爾蘭首都）
english_meaning: Dublin (capital city of Ireland)
explanation_mandarin: 都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都，位於島的東岸，是該國的政治、文化與經濟中心。
explanation_english: Dublin is the capital city of Ireland, located on the east coast of the island; it is the political, cultural, and economic center of the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去都柏林旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 dou1 baak3 lam4 leoi5 hang4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個月會去都柏林旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'll travel to Dublin next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都柏林係愛爾蘭嘅首都。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 baak3 lam4 hai6 oi3 ji5 laan4 ge3 sau2 dou1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都。
examples.english_sentence: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.

mandarin_meaning: 鄂（È）——常作湖北省的簡稱，也作姓氏；在古代亦有地名等用法。
english_meaning: È — used as the abbreviation for Hubei province; also a Chinese surname and historical place name.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（專有名詞／地名／姓氏）
explanation_mandarin: 字面上常見用作湖北省的簡稱「鄂」，亦為漢族姓氏之一。在地圖、車牌或文獻中常見用「鄂」來代指湖北。
explanation_english: The character is commonly used as the abbreviation for Hubei province and is also a Chinese surname. You’ll see '鄂' used on maps, official abbreviations, and historical documents to represent Hubei.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個姓係鄂，係湖北人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 go3 sing3 hai6 Ngok3, hai6 Wu4 bak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的姓氏是鄂，是湖北人。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is È; he is from Hubei.

mandarin_meaning: 鄂圖曼帝國（又稱奧斯曼帝國）
english_meaning: Ottoman Empire
explanation_mandarin: 指約1299年至1922年間由鄂圖曼土耳其人建立並統治，橫跨歐洲、亞洲和非洲部分地區的歷史帝國。
explanation_english: The historical state founded by the Ottoman Turks (c. 1299–1922) that at its height spanned parts of southeastern Europe, western Asia, and North Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺歷史課學過鄂圖曼帝國嘅興衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 lik6 si2 fo3 hok6 gwo3 ngok3 tou4 maan6 dai3 gwok3 ge3 hing1 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在歷史課上學過鄂圖曼帝國的興衰。
examples.english_sentence: I learned about the rise and fall of the Ottoman Empire in history class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄂圖曼帝國曾經統治過東南歐、亞洲西部同北非嘅部分地區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngok3 tou4 maan6 dai3 gwok3 cang4 ging1 tung2 zi6 gwo3 dung1 naam4 au1, aa3 zau1 sai1 bou6 tung4 bak1 fei1 ge3 bou6 fan6 dei6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鄂圖曼帝國曾經統治過東南歐、亞洲西部和北非的部分地區。
examples.english_sentence: The Ottoman Empire once ruled parts of Southeast Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉／家鄉；鄉村、農村，或指故鄉、籍貫
english_meaning: village; hometown; countryside; native place
explanation_mandarin: 「鄉」常用以指鄉村、農村或家鄉、故鄉，也可見於複合詞如「鄉下」「鄉村」「家鄉」。
explanation_english: The character denotes a village, the countryside, or one's hometown/native place. It commonly appears in compounds such as 鄉下 (countryside), 鄉村 (village), 家鄉 (hometown).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好掛住鄉下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 hoeng1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想念家鄉。
examples.english_sentence: I miss my hometown a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度係一個靚嘅鄉村，風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 hai6 jat1 go3 leng3 ge3 hoeng1 cyun1, fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那裡是一個漂亮的鄉村，風景很美。
examples.english_sentence: That's a beautiful village with lovely scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係鄉下人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 haa6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是鄉下人。
examples.english_sentence: He's from the countryside.

mandarin_meaning: 乡下；乡村；农村
english_meaning: countryside; rural area (can also mean 'unsophisticated' or 'rustic' colloquially)
explanation_mandarin: 指鄉村、農村的地區；口語上亦可用作貶義，形容人或舉止土氣、不夠時髦或沒有都市經驗。
explanation_english: Refers to the countryside or rural areas. Informally it can be used pejoratively to describe someone or something as unsophisticated, rustic, or lacking urban manners/experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個喺鄉下長大，日日都同鄰居一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 zoeng2 daai6, jat6 jat6 dou1 tung4 leon4 geoi1 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候在乡下长大，每天都和邻居一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: I grew up in the countryside and used to play with the neighbors every day.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉下人；土裡來的人（多指來自鄉村或外地、缺乏城市經驗的人）
english_meaning: country bumpkin; rustic person; someone from the countryside (often implies lacking urban sophistication)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄉下仔」是廣東話口語，字面意思是來自鄉下的人。用法可中性、戲謔或貶義，常用來形容樸實、不諳世故或缺乏城裡經驗的人，視語境可帶親暱或輕視意味。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "鄉下仔" literally means a person from the countryside. It is an informal noun that can be neutral, teasing, or derogatory depending on context. It often describes someone rustic, unsophisticated, or unfamiliar with urban ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個鄉下仔，第一次嚟香港，唔識路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hoeng1 haa6 zai2, dai6 jat1 ci3 lai4 hoeng1 gong2, m4 sik1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個鄉下仔，第一次來香港，不認路。
examples.english_sentence: He's a country boy; it's his first time in Hong Kong and he doesn't know his way around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁睇低人，話人係鄉下仔好唔尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 tai2 dai1 jan4, waa6 jan4 hai6 hoeng1 haa6 zai2 hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那麼看不起人，說人是鄉下仔很不尊重。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on people like that; calling someone a 'country boy' is disrespectful.

jyutping: hoeng1 haa6 lou2 jat1 goek3 ngau4 si2
mandarin_meaning: 鄉下佬／土包子（帶有貶義，形容粗俗、不懂行或土氣的人）
english_meaning: a country bumpkin (pejorative slang likening someone to a rustic person who has stepped in cow dung) — used to call someone unsophisticated, awkward, or vulgar
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來貶稱某人土氣、粗俗或沒見識，字面上形容鄉下人一腳踏到牛屎，帶有嘲弄意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang insult used to describe someone as rustic, unsophisticated, or awkward. Literally describes a country person who has stepped in cow dung; carries a mocking/derogatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲衫好土，講嘢又無禮貌，大家覺得佢似個鄉下佬一腳牛屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 saam1 hou2 tou2, gong2 je5 jau6 mou4 lai5 maau6, daai6 gaa1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ci5 go3 hoeng1 haa6 lou2 jat1 goek3 ngau4 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他衣著很土，說話又沒禮貌，大家覺得他像個鄉下佬一腳牛屎。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are very rustic and he speaks rudely; everyone thinks he's like a 'country bumpkin who stepped in cow dung.'

mandarin_meaning: 乡下话（乡村方言）；有时带贬义指土气或落后、愚昧的说法
english_meaning: country talk; rural dialect; rustic speech — sometimes used pejoratively to mean unsophisticated or backward talk
explanation_mandarin: 指來自鄉村的口語或方言表達；在口語中也可用來貶義，暗指言論土氣、老套或落後。
explanation_english: Refers to speech or dialect from the countryside; colloquially can be used pejoratively to imply something sounds unsophisticated, old-fashioned, or backward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講，聽落好似鄉下話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2, teng1 lok6 hou2 ci5 hoeng1 haa6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那樣說，聽起來像鄉下話。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that; it sounds like country talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係鄉下人，成日講啲鄉下話，城裡人未必聽得明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 haa6 jan4, sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 hoeng1 haa6 waa6, sing4 leoi5 jan4 mei6 bat1 teng1 dak1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是鄉下人，經常說鄉下話，城裡人未必聽得懂。
examples.english_sentence: He's from the countryside and often speaks rural dialect; city people may not understand.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉事委員會（代表鄉村或鄉鎮事務的委員會，常見於香港新界等地）
english_meaning: Rural Committee; a committee that represents village/rural affairs (commonly refers to the Rural Committees in Hong Kong's New Territories)
explanation_mandarin: 指處理或代表鄉村事務的組織或委員會。在香港，鄉事委員會（Rural Committee）代表鄉村或原居民，並作為與政府溝通的橋樑，關注土地、建設與社區事務。
explanation_english: Refers to a committee or organization that handles or represents village/rural affairs. In Hong Kong, Rural Committees represent villages or indigenous inhabitants in the New Territories and act as a bridge to the government on matters like land, development, and community affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新界嘅鄉事委員會通常代表村民，向政府反映鄉村嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 gaai3 ge3 hoeng1 si6 wai2 jyun4 wui6 tung1 soeng4 doi6 biu2 cyun1 man4, hoeng3 zing3 fu2 faan2 jing6 hoeng1 cyun1 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新界的鄉事委員會通常代表村民，向政府反映鄉村的需要。
examples.english_sentence: The Rural Committees in the New Territories usually represent villagers and convey the villages' needs to the government.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉事會（處理鄉里或村務的組織）
english_meaning: rural committee / hometown affairs association (an organization handling local village/hometown affairs)
explanation_mandarin: 指處理鄉村或同鄉事務的組織，常見於香港新界或其他地方的鄉里社群，代表村民或同鄉利益，處理社區事務、糾紛和公共事務。
explanation_english: Refers to an organization that handles village or hometown affairs. Commonly found in Hong Kong's New Territories and other local communities, it represents villagers or people from the same hometown and deals with community matters, disputes, and public affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係鄉事會主席，成日要處理村入面嘅大小事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 si6 wui2 zyu2 zik6, sing4 jat6 jiu3 cyu2 lei5 cyun1 jap6 min6 ge3 daai6 siu2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是鄉事會主席，經常要處理村裡的大小事。
examples.english_sentence: He is the chairman of the rural committee and often has to handle the village's various affairs.

mandarin_meaning: 指由本地鄉紳或鄉村勢力組成、處理鄉里事務且在地區有影響力的派別
english_meaning: a rural/local faction — a clique of local gentry or village leaders who handle village affairs and exert influence in the area
explanation_mandarin: 通常指由鄉里、鄉紳或新界村代表組成的派系，主要關注並主導鄉村或社區的事務與利益分配，對地區決策有一定影響。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a faction made up of village gentry or local representatives (especially in rural or New Territories contexts) that focus on and control village/community affairs and influence local decision-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲鄉事派喺地區上好有影響力，決定晒好多鄉郊嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hoeng1 si6 paai3 hai2 dei6 keoi1 soeng6 hou2 jau5 jing2 hoeng2 lik6, kyut3 ding6 saai3 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gaau1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些乡事派在地区上很有影响力，决定了很多乡郊的事务。
examples.english_sentence: Those rural-faction groups are very influential in the area and decide many rural/suburban affairs.

mandarin_meaning: 乡土；与故乡、乡村或本地有关的事物或风俗
english_meaning: relating to one's native land or the countryside; local, rural, rustic
explanation_mandarin: 表示與故鄉或鄉村有關的事物、風俗或文化，也可用來形容具有地方特色、樸實或傳統風貌的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to things connected with one's native place or the countryside; can describe local or rural characteristics, traditional or rustic qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館展示咗好多鄉土文物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 si6 zo2 hou2 do1 hoeng1 tou2 man4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間博物館展示了很多鄉土文物。
examples.english_sentence: This museum displays many local/rural artifacts.

mandarin_meaning: 乡村 (xiāngcūn)
english_meaning: countryside; rural area; village
explanation_mandarin: 指位于城市之外、以农业或自然环境为主、人口密度较低且环境较为宁静的地区。
explanation_english: Refers to areas outside cities, typically rural or agricultural communities with lower population density and a more tranquil environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家住喺鄉村，生活好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 hoeng1 cyun1, sang1 wut6 hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家住在乡村，生活很宁静。
examples.english_sentence: They live in the countryside; life is very peaceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄉村嘅景色好靚，適合去放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 cyun1 ge3 ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3, sik1 hap6 heoi3 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乡村的景色很漂亮，适合去放松。
examples.english_sentence: The countryside scenery is beautiful, suitable for relaxation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少人細個喺鄉村長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 jan4 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 cyun1 coeng4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少人小时候在乡村长大。
examples.english_sentence: Many people grew up in the countryside.

mandarin_meaning: 旅行车；泛指乡下常见的老式或乡村用车（有时特指带木质饰板的老式旅行车或用于农村的货车/皮卡）
english_meaning: country car; colloquial term for a station wagon or rustic vehicle (sometimes an old wagon with wood paneling or a rural pickup/utility vehicle)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄉村車」是廣東話的俗稱，通常用來指舊式的旅行車（有時帶木紋飾板）或在鄉村常見的實用型貨車／皮卡。語氣可帶描述性或戲謔、貶義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '鄉村車' is an informal term typically referring to an old-style station wagon (sometimes with wood-panel trim) or a utilitarian pickup/vehicle commonly seen in rural areas. The tone can be descriptive, joking, or mildly derogatory depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿叔有部舊鄉村車，去郊遊成日用佢載晒啲行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 suk1 jau5 bou6 gau6 hoeng1 cyun1 ce1, heoi3 gaau1 jau4 sing4 jat6 jung6 keoi5 zoi3 saai3 di1 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叔叔有一辆旧的鄉村車，去郊游时经常用它来载行李。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle has an old country car; we often use it to carry luggage when we go on outings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲老式有木紋飾嘅旅行車，有啲人會叫做鄉村車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lou5 sik1 jau5 muk6 man4 sik1 ge3 leoi5 hang4 ce1, jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 giu3 zou6 hoeng1 cyun1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些带木纹装饰的老式旅行车，有些人会称之为鄉村車。
examples.english_sentence: Those old station wagons with wood-panel trim are sometimes called 'country cars' by people.

mandarin_meaning: 網路上的群體／論壇使用者（網民）；原指鄉下的百姓或村民
english_meaning: netizens; forum users; the online crowd (originally 'villagers')
explanation_mandarin: 「鄉民」原本指鄉下的百姓或村民，但在網路語境中常作俚語使用，指網路上的群體或論壇、討論區內的使用者或留言者（即網民）。在臺灣的PTT等社群常見此用法，用來稱呼匿名或集體的網路群眾。
explanation_english: Originally meaning 'villagers' or rural inhabitants, in internet slang '鄉民' refers to netizens — the collective users or commenters on forums and discussion boards. Commonly used to mean the online crowd or forum users, especially in contexts like PTT.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單新聞一出，討論區嘅鄉民已經炸開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 jat1 ceot1, tou2 leon6 keoi1 ge3 hoeng1 man4 ji5 ging1 zaa3 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這則新聞一出，討論區的鄉民已經炸開了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as this news broke, the forum's netizens went wild (started discussing intensely).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄉民都話要查清楚件事，唔可以就咁算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 man4 dou1 waa6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2 gin6 si6, m4 ho2 ji5 zau6 gam2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鄉民都說要查清楚這件事，不能就這樣算了。
examples.english_sentence: Netizens are saying we need to investigate this thoroughly; we can't just let it go.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉約（xiāngyuē）：村民之間訂立的規約或公約，作為村社自治和約束行為的準則。
english_meaning: village covenant or local charter — a set of rules or agreements among villagers to regulate behavior and manage local affairs.
explanation_mandarin: 鄉約指村落或鄉里居民共同制定的規章或約定，通常用以維持治安、風俗與公共秩序，歷史上常作為村社自治的依據。
explanation_english: A village covenant (鄉約) is a set of rules or agreements made by villagers or local residents to regulate conduct, maintain order, and manage communal affairs; historically used as a basis for local self-governance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份鄉約係由村民簽名制訂嘅，大家要遵守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hoeng1 joek3 hai6 jau4 cyun1 man4 cim1 ming4 zai3 deng6 ge3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zeon1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份鄉約是由村民簽名制訂的，大家要遵守。
examples.english_sentence: This village covenant was drafted and signed by the villagers; everyone must abide by it.

mandarin_meaning: 乡绅（指在乡里拥有土地、财富和社会影响力的地方绅士或豪绅）
english_meaning: local gentry; landed elites; local notable
explanation_mandarin: 指在地方拥有土地、財產或社會影響力的紳士或豪紳，通常在村落或鄉里事務中扮演重要角色，歷史上常指封建或半殖民時期的地方士紳階層。
explanation_english: Refers to local gentry or landed elites who hold land, wealth, or social influence in a community; they often play key roles in local affairs. Historically used for the rural gentry class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄉紳喺呢度有好大影響力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 san1 hai6 ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 daai6 jing2 hoeng2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乡绅在这里有很大的影响力。
examples.english_sentence: The local gentry have a lot of influence here.

mandarin_meaning: 同鄉；鄉里的人；同一地區或家鄉出身的人
english_meaning: fellow townspeople; fellow villagers; people from the same hometown
explanation_mandarin: 用來稱呼或指代與自己來自同一鄉里、家鄉或地區的人，常用以表示親近或團結之意。在口語中也可用作對觀眾或鄉里人的招呼語。
explanation_english: Used to address or refer to people from the same village, hometown, or region; it conveys a sense of kinship or shared origin. In colloquial use it can also be an address to an audience of fellow locals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺鄉下出世，成日同啲鄉親一齊打麻雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1haa6 ceot1 saang1, sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 hoeng1can1 jat1 cai4 daa2 maa4zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在鄉下出生，經常和那些鄉親一起打麻將。
examples.english_sentence: I was born in the countryside and often play mahjong with the fellow villagers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各位鄉親，今晚嘅籌款晚會，多謝你哋嚟支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 wai6 hoeng1can1, gam1 maan5 ge3 cau4 fun2 maan5 wui2, do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 lai4 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各位鄉親，今晚的籌款晚會，謝謝你們來支持。
examples.english_sentence: Fellow townspeople, thank you for coming to support tonight's charity fundraiser.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉試（xiāngshì）——古代科舉制度中的省級考試
english_meaning: Xiangshi (provincial examination) — the provincial-level exam in imperial China's civil service examination system
explanation_mandarin: 指古代中國科舉制度中的省級公開考試，通過可獲得舉人名號，為參加會試、殿試的前置資格。
explanation_english: Refers to the provincial-level public examination in the imperial Chinese civil service exam system. Passing it conferred the juren (舉人) degree and qualified candidates to sit for higher-level exams (metropolitan and palace exams).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前科舉制度入面，讀書人要先考鄉試，攞到舉人資格先可以去考會試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 fo1 geoi2 zai3 dou6 jap6 min6, duk6 syu1 jan4 jiu3 sin1 haau2 hoeng1 si3, lo2 dou3 geoi2 jan4 zi1 gaak3 sin1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 haau2 wui6 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前在科举制度下，读书人要先考乡试，取得举人资格才能去参加会试。
examples.english_sentence: In the old imperial examination system, scholars had to first take the provincial exam (xiangshi); only after obtaining the juren title could they sit for the metropolitan exam (huishi).

mandarin_meaning: 鄉間或地方性的閒聊、鄉土風味的談話，或指鄉間的俚語、地方話題（相當於“鄉間閒談”或“鄉土談話”）
english_meaning: rural/local talk; folksy conversation; local gossip or talk with a strong hometown/folk flavor
explanation_mandarin: 「鄉談」通常指帶有鄉土氣息的談話，可能是鄉間的閒聊、講故鄉往事或使用地方俚語。語感上偏口語、帶有地方特色。
explanation_english: “鄉談” refers to conversation with a rural or local flavor — casual chat about hometown matters, reminiscing about the past, or using local colloquialisms. It is informal and folksy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班老人家喺茶樓度傾鄉談，講返以前嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 hai2 caa4 lau4 dou6 king1 hoeng1 taam4, gong2 faan1 ji5 cin4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些老人家在茶樓裡聊天，談起以前的事。
examples.english_sentence: These elderly people are chatting at the teahouse, talking about things from the past.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉議局（香港一個代表新界原居民及鄉村利益的法定諮詢機構）
english_meaning: Heung Yee Kuk — a statutory advisory body in Hong Kong representing the interests of indigenous inhabitants and rural villages of the New Territories
explanation_mandarin: 鄉議局是香港專門代表新界原居民及鄉村利益的法定諮詢機構，負責就新界事務向政府提出意見並協調鄉村事務。
explanation_english: The Heung Yee Kuk is a statutory advisory body in Hong Kong that represents the interests of indigenous inhabitants and rural villages in the New Territories, advising the government on rural affairs and coordinating village matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄉議局喺新界好有影響，主要代表新界原居民同鄉村嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 ji5 guk6 hai6 san1 gaai3 hou2 jau5 jing2 hoeng2, zyu2 jiu3 doi6 biu2 san1 gaai3 jyun4 geoi1 man4 tung4 hoeng1 cyun1 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鄉議局在新界很有影響，主要代表新界原居民和鄉村的利益。
examples.english_sentence: The Heung Yee Kuk has significant influence in the New Territories and mainly represents the interests of indigenous residents and rural villages.

mandarin_meaning: 乡郊，郊外，乡村或城镇外的地区
english_meaning: countryside; outskirts; rural/suburban area
explanation_mandarin: 指城镇或市区之外的农村或郊区，通常用来表示远离市中心的地区。
explanation_english: Refers to rural areas or the outskirts outside towns and cities; used to indicate areas away from the urban center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋週末去鄉郊行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zau1 mut6 heoi3 hoeng1 gaau1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们周末去乡郊爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We go hiking in the countryside on weekends.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉里；鄉村、家鄉的居民或鄰里
english_meaning: villagers; fellow townspeople; the local community or neighborhood
explanation_mandarin: 指同一鄉村或家鄉的居民或鄰里關係，常用來描述地方性的人際或社會關係。
explanation_english: Refers to people from the same village or hometown — villagers or the local community; often used to describe neighborhood or local social ties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺鄉里好出名，人人都識佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 lei5 hou2 ceot1 ming4, jan4 jan4 dou1 sik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在鄉里很出名，人人都認識他。
examples.english_sentence: He is well-known in the village; everyone knows him.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）偷偷摸摸、鬼鬼祟祟；行為可疑、暗中做壞事或打算不光明的事
english_meaning: colloquial expression for acting furtive or suspicious; behaving sneaky or shifty (often implying hidden, not‑straightforward intentions)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人在社區或某個場合表現得偷偷摸摸、鬼祟、可疑，通常帶有貶義，暗示行為不光明或有企圖。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone acting furtive or suspicious in a neighborhood/setting. It is colloquial and often derogatory, implying secretive or shady behaviour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度鄉里鬼鬼，講清楚你究竟想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 hoeng1 lei5 gwai2 gwai2, gong2 cing1 co2 nei5 gau3 ging2 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在這裡鬼鬼祟祟，說清楚你到底想怎麼樣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act all sneaky here—say clearly what you actually want.

mandarin_meaning: 乡镇（行政区划中的乡和镇，指乡村或小城镇）
english_meaning: township; rural town; village-level town
explanation_mandarin: 鄉鎮指行政區劃中的鄉和鎮，通常為人口較少或較偏遠的村鎮級單位，也用來泛指鄉村小鎮地區。
explanation_english: Refers to township-level administrative units (towns and rural townships). It denotes small towns or village areas in the countryside and is used to refer to rural towns or townships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個喺鄉鎮長大，生活比較簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 zan3 coeng4 daai6, sang1 wut6 bei2 gaau3 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候在乡镇长大，生活比较简单。
examples.english_sentence: I grew up in a township; life was relatively simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個鄉鎮每年都有好多傳統節慶，好有地方特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hoeng1 zan3 mui5 nin4 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 cyun4 tung2 zit3 hing3, hou2 jau5 dei6 fong1 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个乡镇每年都有很多传统节庆，很有地方特色。
examples.english_sentence: This township holds many traditional festivals every year and has strong local character.

mandarin_meaning: 鄉鎮（指鄉、鎮等行政或地理單位）
english_meaning: towns; townships; rural towns
explanation_mandarin: 指鄉、鎮等較小的行政或聚居地，常用來表示偏遠或人口較少的城鎮地區。
explanation_english: Refers to towns or townships — smaller administrative or residential settlements, often rural or less urbanized areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返鄉鎮探親，每隔幾個月就會返一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 hoeng1 zan3 taam3 can1, mui5 gok3 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 wui5 faan1 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他回鄉鎮探親，每隔幾個月就會回去一次。
examples.english_sentence: He goes back to his hometown/township to visit relatives; he returns once every few months.

mandarin_meaning: 乡音，家乡的口音或方言腔调
english_meaning: hometown accent; the accent or dialectal sound of one's native place
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人來自家鄉的口音或方言腔調，有時也帶有鄉愁或親切感，用來說明語音特徵或能辨別出籍貫。
explanation_english: Refers to the accent or dialectal sound characteristic of a person's hometown. It can denote pronunciation features, identify regional origin, and often evokes feelings of nostalgia or familiarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢嘅鄉音，我覺得好親切，彷彿返到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 ge3 hoeng1 jam1, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 can1 cit3, fong2 fat6 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他的乡音，我觉得很亲切，好像回到了家。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing his hometown accent makes me feel very warm and nostalgic, as if I've returned home.

mandarin_meaning: 家鄉；老家；鄉下
english_meaning: hometown; native village; the countryside
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話口語中常用，指一個人出生或長大的村鎮或老家，有時泛指鄉下地方。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to one's hometown or native village; can also mean the countryside or native area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿公住喺鄉頭，星期日我哋返去探佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 gung1 zyu6 hai2 hoeng1 tau4, sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 faan1 heoi3 taam3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爺爺住在老家，星期日我們回去看他。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather lives in the hometown; we go back on Sundays to visit him.

mandarin_meaning: 姓氏（邹，拼音 zōu）；中国古代的鄒国（地名）
english_meaning: Surname Zou (Chinese surname); the ancient State of Zou (toponym)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄒」（简体：邹）主要作姓氏使用，也可指中国古代的鄒国。粤语读作 zau1，常见于人名或历史地名中。
explanation_english: The character 鄒 (simplified: 邹) is mainly used as the surname Zou and can also refer to the ancient State of Zou. In Cantonese it is pronounced 'zau1' and commonly appears in personal names and historical place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班有個姓鄒嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 jau5 go3 sing3 zau1 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们班有个姓邹的学生。
examples.english_sentence: There is a student surnamed Zou in our class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄒國係春秋時期一個細小嘅諸侯國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 gwok3 hai6 ceon1 cau1 si4 kei4 jat1 go3 sai3 siu2 ge3 zyu1 hau4 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 邹国是春秋时期的一个小诸侯国。
examples.english_sentence: The State of Zou was a small feudal state during the Spring and Autumn period.

mandarin_meaning: 乡／鄉（xiāng）：村庄、农村；故乡、家乡
english_meaning: village; countryside; hometown; native place
explanation_mandarin: 「鄕」是「鄉」的異體字，表示村莊、鄉村或一個人的故鄉、家鄉等概念，常見於複合詞如「故鄕」「鄉村」等。
explanation_english: 鄕 is a variant form of 鄉 (hoeng1). It refers to a village or the countryside, and by extension to one's hometown or native place. Commonly appears in compounds like '故鄕' or '鄉村'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好掛住我個故鄕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 ngo5 go3 gu3 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想念我的故乡。
examples.english_sentence: I miss my hometown very much.

mandarin_meaning: 鄙（bǐ）：轻视、鄙夷；亦有粗陋、卑俗之意（如“鄙视”、“鄙陋”）。
english_meaning: to despise; to disdain; contemptible; vulgar (used mainly in compounds like '鄙視' or '鄙陋').
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞（多見於複合詞）
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對他人或事物的輕視、蔑視；在某些詞中也用於描述粗俗或卑劣的性質。多為書面語或出現在合成詞中，如“鄙視”、“鄙陋”。
explanation_english: Expresses contempt or disdain toward a person or thing; in some compounds it describes something shabby or vulgar. It is mainly used in written language or as part of compound words (e.g., '鄙視', '鄙陋').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係好鄙視佢嗰啲說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 bei2 si3 keoi5 go2 di1 syut3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的是很鄙视他那些话。
examples.english_sentence: I really despise those things he said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲行為好鄙陋，唔應該咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hang4 wai6 hou2 bei2 lau6, m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些行为很鄙陋，不应该这样做。
examples.english_sentence: This behavior is contemptible; it shouldn't be done.

mandarin_meaning: 鄙人（自謙的第一人稱，表示「我」，常用於書面或謙稱，有時帶幽默或諷刺）
english_meaning: a humble first-person pronoun meaning 'I' or 'this humble one' (used to refer to oneself modestly or ironically)
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語詞彙，現代粵語或書面語中用作自稱的謙稱，表示自謙或在正式/幽默語境中稱自己。
explanation_english: Originally a classical term, used as a humble first-person pronoun in Cantonese and written contexts to refer to oneself modestly; can also be used ironically or humorously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄙人今日有啲意見，想同大家講一講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jan4 gam1 jat6 jau5 di1 ji3 gin3, soeng2 tung4 daai6 gaa1 gong2 jat1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天有一些意見，想跟大家說一說。
examples.english_sentence: I have some opinions today that I'd like to tell everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄙人以為，呢個方案未必最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jan4 ji5 wai4, ni1 go3 fong1 on3 mei6 bat1 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我認為，這個方案未必最好。
examples.english_sentence: I think this proposal may not be the best.

mandarin_meaning: 鄙视；轻视；蔑视
english_meaning: to despise; to disdain; contempt; to look down on
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事抱有輕視、看不起的態度，帶有強烈負面評價。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of contempt or disdain toward someone or something; to look down on or regard as inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對嗰啲人流露出明顯嘅鄙夷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 go2 di1 jan4 lau4 lou6 ceot1 ming4 hin2 ge3 bei2 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對那些人流露出明顯的鄙夷。
examples.english_sentence: He showed obvious contempt for those people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以貌取人，唔好輕易咁鄙夷其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 mou6 ceoi2 jan4, m4 hou2 hing1 ji6 gam2 bei2 ji4 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以貌取人，不要輕易鄙夷其他人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge people by appearances; don't lightly despise others.

mandarin_meaning: 鄙视（看不起、轻视）
english_meaning: to despise; to look down on; to hold in contempt
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事抱有輕蔑、不屑或看不起的態度，屬於負面評價的情感或行為表現。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling or attitude of contempt or scorn toward someone or something; a negative evaluative stance indicating one considers the target inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鄙視啲冇經驗嘅新人，成日唔肯教人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bei2 si6 di1 mou5 ging1 jim6 ge3 san1 jan4, sing4 jat6 m4 hang2 gaau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常鄙视没有经验的新员工，不愿意教别人。
examples.english_sentence: He often looks down on inexperienced new employees and refuses to teach them.

mandarin_meaning: 邓（姓）
english_meaning: Deng (Chinese surname)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄧」是中文的姓氏（繁體字），普通話拼音為 Dèng，粵語讀作 dang6。常見於香港、廣東及其他華人社群，著名人物如鄧小平。
explanation_english: “鄧” is a Chinese surname (traditional character). In Cantonese it is pronounced dang6 and in Mandarin Dèng. It is a common family name; a well-known bearer is Deng Xiaoping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓鄧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 dang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓邓。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Deng.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄧小平係中國嘅重要領導人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang6 siu2 ping4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 ge3 zung6 jiu3 ling5 dou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 邓小平是中国的重要领导人。
examples.english_sentence: Deng Xiaoping was an important leader of China.

mandarin_meaning: 鄭（姓氏）；（古代）郑国（地名/国名）
english_meaning: Zheng (Chinese surname); the State of Zheng (ancient)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄭」是中文常見姓氏之一，亦指古代的鄭國。在粵語中讀作 zeng6。
explanation_english: “鄭” is a common Chinese surname and can refer to the ancient State of Zheng. In Cantonese it is pronounced zeng6.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朋友姓鄭，叫鄭小明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 sing3 zeng6, giu3 zeng6 siu2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我朋友姓郑，叫郑小明。
examples.english_sentence: My friend’s surname is Zheng; his name is Zheng Xiaoming.

mandarin_meaning: 郑州（中国河南省省会）
english_meaning: Zhengzhou (capital city of Henan Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 郑州是中国河南省的省会，位于中原地区，是重要的交通枢纽和工业城市，历史悠久。
explanation_english: Zhengzhou is the capital of Henan Province in central China. It is an important transportation hub and industrial city with a long history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去鄭州出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 zeng6 zau1 ceot1 caai1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去郑州出差。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Zhengzhou on a business trip tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 郑重（嚴肅、莊重、認真）
english_meaning: serious; solemn; earnest
explanation_mandarin: 表示態度或語氣的嚴肅、莊重或認真，多用於正式場合或發表重要聲明時。
explanation_english: Indicates a solemn, serious, or earnest attitude; often used in formal contexts or when making important statements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想鄭重宣布一件事：公司下個月會搬遷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zeng6 zung6 syun1 bou3 jat1 gin6 si6: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 bun1 cin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想鄭重宣布一件事：公司下個月會搬遷。
examples.english_sentence: I would like to solemnly announce something: the company will relocate next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鄭重表態，會支持呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeng6 zung6 biu2 taai3, wui5 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他鄭重表態，會支持這個計劃。
examples.english_sentence: He made a solemn statement and will support this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你鄭重考慮呢個提議，唔好太草率決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 zeng6 zung6 haau2 leoi6 ni1 go3 tai4 ji5, m4 hou2 taai3 cou2 seot1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請你鄭重考慮這個提議，不要太草率決定。
examples.english_sentence: Please consider this proposal seriously; don't decide too hastily.

mandarin_meaning: 邻；邻居；邻近 (lín)
english_meaning: neighbor; adjacent; nearby
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（在複合詞中亦可表示「鄰近」，相當於形容詞用法）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used attributively in compounds to mean 'adjacent' or 'nearby')
explanation_mandarin: 表示與自己相鄰的人或位置，常見於複合詞如「鄰居」「鄰近」，用來指代隔壁或附近的事物或人。
explanation_english: Denotes a neighbor or proximity. Commonly appears in compounds such as '鄰居' (neighbor) and '鄰近' (nearby), used to refer to adjoining people or places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隔離嗰個鄰居成日都幫手照顧我哋屋企嘅狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaak3 lei4 go2 go3 leon4 geoi1 sing4 jat6 dou1 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我隔壁的邻居经常帮忙照顾我们家的狗。
examples.english_sentence: My neighbor next door often helps take care of our dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區鄰近好多商場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 leon4 gan6 hou2 do1 soeng1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地区邻近很多商场。
examples.english_sentence: This area is close to many shopping malls.

mandarin_meaning: 邻国
english_meaning: neighboring country; neighboring state
explanation_mandarin: 指與本國接壤或相鄰的國家，常在地理或外交語境中使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a country that borders or is adjacent to another country; commonly used in geographical or diplomatic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋同鄰國有好多文化交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung4 leon4 gwok3 jau5 hou2 do1 man4 faa3 gaau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们与邻国有很多文化交流。
examples.english_sentence: We have a lot of cultural exchanges with neighboring countries.

mandarin_meaning: 邻家（住在附近的家庭或房屋；亦可指“邻家女孩/邻家男孩”这种亲切、邻近的形象）
english_meaning: neighbor's home; neighbors; (in compounds) 'girl/boy next door' — a friendly, approachable person
explanation_mandarin: 指住在附近的家庭或住户，也常用於構成詞語如「鄰家女孩/鄰家男孩」，形容親切、鄰家的形象或類型。
explanation_english: Refers to a neighboring household or the neighbors. Also used in compounds like 'girl/boy next door' to describe a wholesome, approachable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋鄰家有個細路成日喺樓下玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 leon4 gaa1 jau5 go3 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 hai2 lau4 haa6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们邻居有个小孩经常在楼下玩。
examples.english_sentence: Our neighbors have a child who often plays downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我借下鄰家啲工具？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 je3 haa5 leon4 gaa1 di1 gung1 geoi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能帮我向邻居借一下工具？
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me borrow some tools from the neighbors?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個鄰家女孩，性格好親切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 leon4 gaa1 neoi5 zai2, sing3 gaak3 hou2 can1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是个邻家女孩，性格很亲切。
examples.english_sentence: She's a 'girl next door' — very friendly.

mandarin_meaning: 邻居 (línjū) — 住在你附近或隔壁的人
english_meaning: neighbor — a person who lives near you (e.g., next door or in the same building)
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在你附近、同一棟樓或隔壁的人，可用於日常稱呼與描述社區關係。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who lives nearby, such as next door or in the same building; used to describe people in your local community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隔離嘅鄰居好好人，成日幫手照顧我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaak3 lei4 ge3 leon4 geoi1 hou2 hou2 jan4, seng4 jat6 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们隔壁的邻居很好，经常帮忙照顾我们。
examples.english_sentence: Our neighbors next door are very kind; they often help take care of us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識隔籬嗰位鄰居？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gaak3 lai4 go2 wai6 leon4 geoi1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你认识隔壁那位邻居吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know the neighbor next door?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄰居之間要互相尊重，保持安靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leon4 geoi1 zi1 gaan1 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 zyun1 zung6, bou2 ci4 on1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 邻居之间要互相尊重，保持安静。
examples.english_sentence: Neighbors should respect each other and keep noise to a minimum.

mandarin_meaning: 邻座；坐在你旁边的座位或那个人
english_meaning: seatmate; the person or seat next to you
explanation_mandarin: 指坐在你旁邊的座位或坐在該座位的人，常用於教室、劇院、交通工具等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to the seat next to you or the person occupying that seat; commonly used in classrooms, theaters, or on transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個鄰座好熱情，成日同我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 leon4 zo6 hou2 jit6 cing4, sing4 jat6 tung4 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我旁边坐的人很热情，总是和我说话。
examples.english_sentence: My seatmate is very outgoing and always talks to me.

mandarin_meaning: 邻居
english_meaning: neighbor; someone who lives nearby
explanation_mandarin: 指住在附近的住戶或人，與你相鄰的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or household living nearby; a neighbor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同鄰舍相處幾好，佢哋有需要嘅時候會幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 leon4se2 soeng1 cyu3 gei2 hou2, keoi5 dei6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 si4 hau6 wui5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和邻居相处得不错，他们有需要的时候会帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I get along well with my neighbors; they help out when needed.

mandarin_meaning: 邻近（línjìn）— 在附近、靠近
english_meaning: near; nearby; close to; in the vicinity of
explanation_mandarin: 表示與某地點距離較近、在附近。可作形容詞或介詞使用，語氣較中性、正式。
explanation_english: Indicates being close to a place or in the vicinity. Can function as an adjective or preposition; neutral and relatively formal in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企鄰近一個公園，行路五分鐘就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 leon4 gan6 jat1 go3 gung1 jyun4, haang4 lou6 ng5 fan1 zung1 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家邻近一个公园，走路五分钟就到。
examples.english_sentence: My home is near a park; it's a five-minute walk there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊樓鄰近地鐵站，交通方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 lau4 leon4 gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6, gaau1 tung1 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧楼邻近地铁站，交通方便。
examples.english_sentence: The old building is close to the MTR station, so transportation is convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 邻边 / 隔壁
english_meaning: next door; neighboring; beside
explanation_mandarin: 表示緊鄰、在旁邊的位置，可用來指人或地方，語域偏口語。
explanation_english: Indicates being next to or neighboring; used to refer to a person or place located beside something. Common in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺你鄰邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 nei5 leon4 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在你隔壁。
examples.english_sentence: I live next door to you.

mandarin_meaning: 邻里；邻居；社区
english_meaning: neighbors; neighborhood; community
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在相近地區的居民或鄰居，強調地緣關係與相互往來。
explanation_english: Refers to people living in the same nearby area—neighbors or the local community—emphasizing geographic ties and interpersonal interactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄰里之間應該互相幫忙，特別係有需要嗰陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leon4 lei5 zi1 gaan1 jing1 goi1 wu6 soeng1 bong1 mong4, dak6 bit6 hai6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 go2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 邻里之间应该互相帮助，特别是在有需要的时候。
examples.english_sentence: Neighbors should help one another, especially when someone is in need.

mandarin_meaning: 鄲（古地名、罕見姓氏）
english_meaning: Dān (ancient place name; rare surname)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄲」多用作古代城鎮名稱，如鄲城，也可作為罕見的姓氏。
explanation_english: The character 鄲 is mainly an ancient place name (e.g., Dancheng) and can also be a rare surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄲城係中國古代一個城鎮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Daan1 sing4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 gu2 doi6 jat1 go3 sing4 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鄲城是中国古代的一个城镇。
examples.english_sentence: Dancheng was an ancient town in China.

mandarin_meaning: 姓氏（鄒的異體字），罕見漢字
english_meaning: A rare Chinese character, used as a surname (variant of 鄒 / 邹)
explanation_mandarin: 「鄹」為較罕見的漢字，常用作姓氏，為「鄒」的異體字。粵語讀音為 zau1。主要作人名、姓氏使用，日常書寫不常見。
explanation_english: “鄹” is a rare Chinese character mainly used as a surname and is a variant of 鄒 (simplified: 邹). In Cantonese it is pronounced zau1. It is chiefly encountered in personal names and historical/ancestral contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朋友姓鄹，叫鄹先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 sing3 zau1, giu3 zau1 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的朋友姓鄹，他叫鄹先生。
examples.english_sentence: My friend's surname is Zou; he is called Mr. Zou.

mandarin_meaning: 中文姓氏，讀作 Kuàng（第四聲）。
english_meaning: A Chinese surname (Kuang in Mandarin; Kwong in Cantonese).
explanation_mandarin: 「鄺」是漢字姓氏，粵語一般讀作「Kwong」，普通話讀作「Kuàng」。在廣東、香港等地較常見。
explanation_english: The character 鄺 is a Chinese family name. In Cantonese it is pronounced 'Kwong' (kwong3) and in Mandarin 'Kuang' (Kuàng). It is commonly found in Guangdong and Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姓鄺，嚟自廣東。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing3 kwong3, lai4 zi6 gwong2 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姓鄺，來自廣東。
examples.english_sentence: My surname is Kuang; I'm from Guangdong.

mandarin_meaning: 地支的第十位（酉），指时辰酉时（17:00–19:00），对应生肖鸡；也是表示与酒器、酿造有关的部首
english_meaning: The tenth Earthly Branch (You), representing the You hour (5–7 PM) and the Rooster zodiac; also a Chinese character radical related to wine/alcohol
explanation_mandarin: 「酉」是十二地支之一，排列第十位，常用于表示时辰（酉时约为下午五点到七点）、地支方位或对应生肖（鸡）。作为偏旁（酉部），常见于与酒、酿造有关的字，如酒、酿。
explanation_english: “酉” is one of the twelve Earthly Branches (the tenth). It denotes the You hour (about 5–7 PM), corresponds to the Rooster in the Chinese zodiac, and as a radical (酉) appears in characters related to wine or fermentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家係酉時，天色開始暗落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hai6 jau5 si4, tin1 sik1 hoi1 ci2 am3 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在是酉时，天色开始暗下来。
examples.english_sentence: It's now the You hour (5–7 PM); the sky is starting to get dark.

mandarin_meaning: （1）小酒器，古代盛酒的小罐；（2）酩酊、醉酒（文言）
english_meaning: 1) a small jar for wine (archaic); 2) to be intoxicated, tipsy (literary/archaic).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（書面/文言）
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語詞，既可指盛酒的小罐，也可作動詞表示喝醉或酩酊。現代口語罕用，多見於書面或古文。
explanation_english: An archaic/literary Chinese character meaning either a small wine jar (noun) or to be intoxicated (verb). Rare in modern spoken Cantonese; mainly appears in written or classical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 書面講：佢飲酒酊到失去知覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 min6 gong2: keoi5 jam2 zau2 ding2 dou3 sat1 heoi3 zi1 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 書面說：他因為喝酒酩酊大醉而失去知覺。
examples.english_sentence: Written/formal: He drank himself into a stupor and lost consciousness.

mandarin_meaning: 酋（qiú）：通常指酋长、首领，部落或集团的领袖
english_meaning: chieftain; tribal chief; leader
explanation_mandarin: 漢字“酋”多見於“酋長”等詞，指部落或群體的首領。該字多出現在歷史、民族學或古文語境中，也可構成複合詞使用。
explanation_english: '酋' is commonly seen in compounds like '酋長' (chieftain) and denotes the leader of a tribe or group. It appears mainly in historical, ethnographic, or classical contexts and in compound terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊時，酋長係部落嘅最高領袖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 si4, cau4 zoeng2 hai6 bou6 lok6 ge3 zeoi3 gou1 ling5 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在过去，酋长是部落的最高领袖。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, the chieftain was the highest leader of the tribe.

mandarin_meaning: 酋长；部落首领
english_meaning: chieftain; tribal chief
explanation_mandarin: 指部落或族群的首領，負責領導、決策與代表族群的人。亦可作比喻，用來稱呼某些團體或組織中的領導者。
explanation_english: Refers to the leader of a tribe or clan who is responsible for leadership, decision-making, and representing the group. Can also be used figuratively to refer to a leader of a group or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個部落嘅酋長好受人尊敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 bou6 lok6 ge3 cau4 zoeng2 hou2 sau6 jan4 zyun1 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个部落的酋长很受人尊敬。
examples.english_sentence: The chieftain of that tribe is highly respected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺原住民社群入面，酋長通常負責領導部落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jyun4 zyu6 man4 se5 kwan4 jap6 min6, cau4 zoeng2 tung1 soeng4 fu6 zaak3 ling5 dou6 bou6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在原住民社群里，酋长通常负责领导部落。
examples.english_sentence: In indigenous communities, the chieftain usually is responsible for leading the tribe.

mandarin_meaning: 斟、倒酒；引申为斟酌、考虑
english_meaning: to pour or sip (wine); to deliberate or consider
explanation_mandarin: 本字原指斟酒、倒酒，也用于「斟酌」表示衡量、考虑、依情况处理。
explanation_english: Originally refers to pouring or sipping wine; also used in compounds like '斟酌' to mean weighing options, deliberating, or considering circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要好好斟酌先好決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zam1 zoek3 sin1 hou2 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事要好好斟酌才能决定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter should be carefully considered before making a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 酌情：视具体情况而定；根据情形适当处理或决定。
english_meaning: According to the circumstances; as appropriate; at one's discretion — to decide or act based on the specific situation.
explanation_mandarin: 表示根据具体情形酌量处理或决定，常用于正式或书面语场合，如“酌情处理”、“酌情考虑”。
explanation_english: Indicates that a decision or action will be made based on the specific circumstances. Commonly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., 'handle as appropriate', 'consider as appropriate').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官會酌情判刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 wui5 zoek3 cing4 pun3 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官会酌情判刑。
examples.english_sentence: The judge will sentence according to the circumstances (exercise discretion in sentencing).

mandarin_meaning: 酌情權（指在具體情況下可自行決定的權力）
english_meaning: discretion; discretionary power — the authority to make decisions based on the circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 指根據具體情況，自行衡量並作出決定的權力，常用於法律、行政或管理情境。
explanation_english: Refers to the authority to weigh circumstances and make decisions accordingly; commonly used in legal, administrative, or managerial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺決定津貼標準嘅時候有一定嘅酌情權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 kyut3 ding6 zeon1 tip3 biu1 zeon2 ge3 si4 hau6 jau5 jat1 ding6 ge3 zoek3 cing4 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在決定津貼標準時有一定的酌情權。
examples.english_sentence: The government has a certain degree of discretion when deciding subsidy standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官喺量刑嘅時候有酌情權，可以考慮被告嘅悔意同埋態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 hai2 loeng4 hang4 ge3 si4 hau6 jau5 zoek3 cing4 kyun4, ho2 ji5 haau2 leoi6 bei6 gou3 ge3 fui2 ji3 tung4 maai4 taai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官在量刑時有酌情權，可以考慮被告的悔意和態度。
examples.english_sentence: Judges have discretion during sentencing and can consider the defendant's remorse and attitude.

mandarin_meaning: 酌情考虑、斟酌处理；视情况而定。
english_meaning: to consider; to weigh options; to handle or decide according to the circumstances.
explanation_mandarin: 表示根据具体情况进行斟酌、衡量后再作决定或处理，常用于书面或正式场合。
explanation_english: To deliberate or weigh circumstances before making a decision or taking action; often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要酌量處理，唔好草率決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 zoek3 loeng4 cyu2 lei5, m4 hou2 cou2 seot3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事要酌量处理，不要草率决定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter should be handled with consideration; don't make a hasty decision.

mandarin_meaning: 配 (pèi)：搭配、匹配、分配、配药等
english_meaning: to match; to pair; to be compatible; to allocate; to prepare/prescribe (medicine)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中，「配」(pui3) 常用作動詞，表示搭配、相稱或配合，也可指配藥、分配或配備等意思，根據語境可有不同用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "配" (pui3) is commonly used as a verb meaning to match, be compatible, or pair. It can also mean to allocate/equip or to prepare/prescribe (medication), depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫同條褲好配。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 tung4 tiu4 fu3 hou2 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫和那条裤子很搭配。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt and those pants match well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好配，大家覺得佢哋好登對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 pui3, daai6 gaa1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 hou2 dang1 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人很配，大家觉得他们很登对。
examples.english_sentence: They are a great match; everyone thinks they look good together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 藥房而家幫你配藥，請等一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 fong4 ji4 gaa1 bong1 nei5 pui3 joek6, cing2 dang2 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 药房现在帮你配药，请等一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: The pharmacy is preparing your medication; please wait a moment.

mandarin_meaning: 配上；搭配；配合
english_meaning: to pair with; to match with; to add on
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物或某元素與另一物品搭配或加上，使兩者形成合適或更好的組合。
explanation_english: Indicates pairing or matching one item or element with another, or adding something on to create a suitable or improved combination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我配上咗啲醬汁，仲好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pui3 soeng5 zo2 di1 zoeng3 zap1, zung6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我配上了些醬汁，還更好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I paired it with some sauce; it's even tastier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件裙配上條腰帶會更靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 kwan4 pui3 soeng5 tiu4 jiu1 daai3 wui5 gang3 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件裙子搭配腰帶會更漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This dress will look nicer when paired with a belt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將新產品配上宣傳海報，希望吸引更多客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 san1 caan2 ban2 pui3 soeng5 syun1 cyun4 hoi2 bou3, hei1 mong6 kap1 jan5 gang3 do1 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們把新產品配上宣傳海報，希望吸引更多顧客。
examples.english_sentence: They paired the new product with promotional posters, hoping to attract more customers.

mandarin_meaning: 配件 (pèijiàn)
english_meaning: accessory; component; spare part
explanation_mandarin: 指用来搭配、替换或补充主体物品的附属零件或饰品，既可指电子产品的零件，也可指服饰上的配饰等。
explanation_english: Refers to auxiliary parts or accessories used to complement, replace, or repair a main item; can mean components for electronics or fashion accessories, among others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要買啲手機配件，例如電話殼同充電線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 di1 sau2 gei1 pui3 gin6, lai6 jyu4 din6 waa6 hok3 tung4 cung1 din6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要买些手机配件，例如手机壳和充电线。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy some phone accessories, such as cases and charging cables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦少咗一個配件，開唔到機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 siu2 zo2 jat1 go3 pui3 gin6, hoi1 m4 dou3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑缺少一个配件，无法开机。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is missing a component and won't boot.

mandarin_meaning: 配偶 (pèi'ǒu)：配偶指婚姻關係中的另一半，通常指丈夫或妻子。
english_meaning: Spouse; the partner in a marital relationship (husband or wife).
explanation_mandarin: 指婚姻或法律關係中的另一方，常用於正式或法律語境，涵蓋丈夫或妻子等配偶身份。
explanation_english: Denotes the other person in a marriage or legally recognized partnership; commonly used in formal or legal contexts to refer to a husband or wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅配偶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pui3 ngau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我的配偶。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my spouse.

mandarin_meaning: 配备 / 装备（提供或具备必要的器材、人员或条件）
english_meaning: equipment; to equip; to provide with necessary equipment or resources
explanation_mandarin: 指提供或具備必要的器材、設備、人員或條件；作名詞時可指設備、裝備本身。
explanation_english: Refers to providing or having necessary equipment, personnel, or conditions. As a noun it can mean the equipment or gear itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要為全體職員配備新嘅電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 wai4 cyun4 tai2 zik1 jyun4 pui3 bei6 san1 ge3 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要為全體職員配備新的電腦。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to equip all staff with new computers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部隊已經配備咗最新型嘅武器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 deoi6 ji5 ging1 pui3 bei6 zo2 zeoi3 san1 jing4 ge3 mou5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 部隊已經配備了最新型的武器。
examples.english_sentence: The troops have already been equipped with the latest weapons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間醫院嘅配備好先進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 ge3 pui3 bei6 hou2 sin1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間醫院的配備很先進。
examples.english_sentence: This hospital's equipment is very advanced.

mandarin_meaning: 配（鑰匙）；複製鑰匙
english_meaning: to have a key duplicated; to cut/make a spare key
explanation_mandarin: 指到鎖匠或有關店舖把一把鑰匙復制或製作成備用的鑰匙。
explanation_english: Refers to getting a key copied or having a locksmith cut an extra key for use as a spare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去配匙，多配一把作備用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 pui3 si4, do1 pui3 jat1 baa2 zok3 bei6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去配鑰匙，多配一把作備用。
examples.english_sentence: I want to get a key duplicated — make an extra copy as a spare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖可以即日配匙，幾方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ho2 ji5 zik1 jat6 pui3 si4, gei2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間舖可以當日配鑰匙，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This shop can cut keys the same day — very convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 配合 (pèi hé)：合作、協調，使行動相互配搭或一致
english_meaning: to cooperate; to coordinate; to match or fit together
explanation_mandarin: 表示多方一起協作或彼此協調，使事情能順利進行；也可表示兩者之間相互搭配或相稱。
explanation_english: Indicates working together or coordinating with others so that something proceeds smoothly; can also mean two things fitting or matching each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你配合我哋嘅安排，準時到場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 pui3 hap6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 on1 paai4, zeon2 si4 dou3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請你配合我們的安排，準時到場。
examples.english_sentence: Please cooperate with our arrangements and arrive on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告需要大家互相配合先完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 pui3 hap6 sin1 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告需要大家互相配合才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This report requires everyone to coordinate with each other in order to finish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫同條褲配合得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 tung4 tiu4 fu3 pui3 hap6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件上衣和褲子很搭配。
examples.english_sentence: The shirt and trousers match very well.

mandarin_meaning: 配售（配发、分配证券）
english_meaning: allotment; allocation (of shares or securities)
explanation_mandarin: 指在新股或证券发行时，将股票或份额按一定比例或方式分配给不同投资者的行为或结果，常用于公开发售或配股过程中。
explanation_english: The allocation or allotment of shares or securities during an offering; the act or result of distributing shares to different investors according to a prescribed ratio or method, commonly used in IPOs or share placements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今次新股會有部分配售畀現有股東。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 ci3 san1 gu2 wui5 jau5 bou6 fan6 pui3 sau6 bei2 jin6 jau5 gu2 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司这次新股会有部分配售给现有股东。
examples.english_sentence: The company will allot part of the new shares to existing shareholders this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果認購超額，配售通常會用抽籤決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jing6 gou1 ciu1 ngok6, pui3 sau6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jung6 cau1 cim1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果认购超额，配售通常会用抽签决定。
examples.english_sentence: If subscriptions exceed the offering, allotment is usually decided by ballot.

mandarin_meaning: 配图 (为文章或帖子添加图片)
english_meaning: to add/attach an image or illustration to a text/post
explanation_mandarin: 指在文章、帖子或報導等內容中配上圖片以輔助說明或吸引讀者。
explanation_english: Refers to adding images or illustrations to articles, posts, or reports to illustrate content or attract readers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我喺篇文章入面配張圖呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 hai2 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jap6 min6 pui3 zoeng1 tou4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我在文章裡配張圖嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me add an image to the article?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個帖文冇配圖，好難吸引到讀者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tip3 man4 mou5 pui3 tou4, hou2 naan4 kap1 jan5 dou3 duk6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這則帖文沒有配圖，很難吸引讀者。
examples.english_sentence: This post has no image; it's hard to attract readers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 編輯已經幫新產品頁面配好圖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 zik6 ji5 ging1 bong1 san1 caan2 ban2 jip6 min6 pui3 hou2 tou4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 編輯已經為新產品頁面配好圖了。
examples.english_sentence: The editor has already added images to the new product page.

mandarin_meaning: 配套 (pèi tào)：配合主體的設施、措施或成套的安排
english_meaning: supporting facilities/measures; complementary package; matched set
explanation_mandarin: 指与某一主体相配合的设施、措施或物品的组合与安排，常用于描述房屋、政策、服务或产品的配套设施或配备，例如配套措施、配套福利或配套设备。
explanation_english: Refers to supporting or complementary facilities, measures, or items that accompany and match a main entity; commonly used to describe infrastructure, policies, services, or bundled products (e.g., supporting measures, benefit packages, or bundled equipment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新樓盤嘅配套唔夠完善，好多住戶都投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lau4 pun2 ge3 pui3 tou3 m4 gau3 jyun4 sin6, hou2 do1 zyu6 wu6 dou1 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新楼盘的配套不够完善，很多住户都在投诉。
examples.english_sentence: The new housing development's supporting facilities are not adequate, and many residents are complaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司提供嘅配套福利幾好，例如醫療保險同額外假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tai4 gung1 ge3 pui3 tou3 fuk1 lei6 gei2 hou2, lai6 jyu4 ji1 liu4 bou2 him2 tung4 ngaak6 ngoi6 gaa3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司提供的配套福利很好，例如医疗保险和额外假期。
examples.english_sentence: The company offers good benefit packages, such as health insurance and extra leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦冇附帶配套嘅軟件，要另行購買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 mou5 fu6 daai3 pui3 tou3 ge3 jyun5 gin6, jiu3 ling6 hang4 gau3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑没有附带配套的软件，需要另行购买。
examples.english_sentence: This computer doesn't come with the bundled software; you'll need to buy it separately.

mandarin_meaning: 配对 (pèiduì) — 把两者配成一对；匹配
english_meaning: to pair; pairing; to match two people or things together
explanation_mandarin: 表示將兩個人或物配成一對，或指配成對的動作或結果。可用於分組、配對裝置或婚戀撮合等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to pairing two people or items together or the act/result of matching. Used for grouping people, pairing devices, matchmaking, or pairing items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次分組，我哋要配對兩個人一組。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 fan1 zuk6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 pui3 deoi3 loeng5 go3 jan4 jat1 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次分组，我们要配对，两个人一组。
examples.english_sentence: For this grouping, we need to pair up: two people per group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有個系統會自動幫會員配對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 go3 hai6 tung2 wui5 zi6 dung6 bong1 wui6 jyun4 pui3 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有个系统会自动帮会员配对。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a system that automatically matches members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想配對隻藍牙耳機同部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 pui3 deoi3 zek3 laam4 ngaa4 ji5 gei1 tung4 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把蓝牙耳机和手机配对。
examples.english_sentence: I want to pair the Bluetooth headphones with my phone.

mandarin_meaning: 佩戴
english_meaning: to wear; to put on (accessories, badges, insignia)
explanation_mandarin: 表示佩戴飾物、徽章或標識等，多用於較正式或書面語境。
explanation_english: Means to wear or adorn accessories, badges, or insignia; typically used in more formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺典禮上配戴住一枚紀念章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 din2 lai5 soeng5 pui3 daai3 zyu6 jat1 mui4 gei2 nim6 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在典禮上佩戴著一枚紀念章。
examples.english_sentence: They wore a commemorative badge at the ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你上班要唔要配戴公司發嘅工作證？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng5 baan1 jiu3 m4 jiu3 pui3 daai3 gung1 si1 faat3 ge3 gung1 zok3 zing3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你上班要不要佩戴公司發的工作證？
examples.english_sentence: Do you need to wear the company-issued staff ID at work?

mandarin_meaning: 搭配 / 配合
english_meaning: to match; to pair; combination/coordination (e.g., clothes, colors, ingredients)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示把不同的物件、顏色或食材等進行搭配或組合，常用於服裝、裝飾、料理等情境，強調協調或互補的效果。
explanation_english: Refers to matching or coordinating different items, colors, or ingredients; commonly used for clothing, décor, food combinations, etc., emphasizing a harmonious or complementary pairing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件上衣同條褲好配搭，成套望落去好夾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 gin6 soeng6 ji1 tung4 tiu4 fu3 hou2 pui3 daap3, sing4 tou3 mong6 lok6 heoi3 hou2 gaap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件上衣和那条裤子很配搭，整套看起来很合得来。
examples.english_sentence: This top and those pants match well; the whole outfit looks very coordinated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜嘅配搭用咗幾種香料，好特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei1 dou6 coi3 ge3 pui3 daap3 jung6 zo2 gei2 zung2 hoeng1 liu6, hou2 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜的配搭用了几种香料，很特别。
examples.english_sentence: The dish's combination of spices uses several different spices; it's very distinctive.

mandarin_meaning: 配料（pèiliào）：用於烹飪或製作食品的材料、配菜或調味品
english_meaning: ingredients; components, toppings or seasonings used in cooking or food preparation
explanation_mandarin: 指在烹調、製作食品時加入的各種材料或配菜，例如蔬菜、肉類、香料等；也可泛指原料。
explanation_english: Refers to the materials, components, toppings or seasonings added when cooking or preparing food (e.g., vegetables, meats, spices); can also mean raw materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去超市買配料，準備今晚落廚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 pui3 liu6, zeon2 bei6 gam1 maan5 lok6 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去超市買配料，準備今晚下廚。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the supermarket to buy ingredients to cook tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯嘅配料好豐富，有冬菇、豬骨同紅蘿蔔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 ge3 pui3 liu6 hou2 fung1 fu3, jau5 dung1 gu1, zyu1 gwat1 tung4 hung4 lo4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗湯的配料很豐富，有冬菇、豬骨和紅蘿蔔。
examples.english_sentence: This soup has rich ingredients: shiitake mushrooms, pork bones, and carrots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整蛋糕嘅時候，配料要先過篩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 daan6 gou1 ge3 si4 hau6, pui3 liu6 jiu3 sin1 gwo3 saai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做蛋糕的時候，配料要先過篩。
examples.english_sentence: When making the cake, the ingredients need to be sifted first.

mandarin_meaning: 配方（配製產品或藥物的處方或配比）
english_meaning: formula; recipe; formulation (the specific mixture or prescription used to make a product or medicine)
explanation_mandarin: 指製作某種產品、藥物或食品時所使用的成分比例和配製方法，也可指配方本身。
explanation_english: Refers to the specific mixture of ingredients and proportions used to make a product, medicine, or food; essentially the recipe or formulation itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改良奶粉嘅配方，令佢更易吸收。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 loeng4 naai5 fan2 ge3 pui3 fong1, ling6 keoi5 gang1 ji6 kap1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要改良奶粉的配方，讓它更容易吸收。
examples.english_sentence: We need to reformulate the infant formula to make it easier to absorb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻護膚品嘅配方含有天然成分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 wu6 fu1 ban2 ge3 pui3 fong1 ham4 jau5 tin1 jin4 sing4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個護膚品的配方含有天然成分。
examples.english_sentence: This skincare product's formula contains natural ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廠方唔肯公開藥物嘅配方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong2 fong1 m4 hang2 gung1 hoi1 joek6 mat6 ge3 pui3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廠方不肯公開藥物的配方。
examples.english_sentence: The manufacturer refuses to disclose the drug's formula.

mandarin_meaning: 配有 / 裝有
english_meaning: to be equipped with; to come with; to be fitted with
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物配備或裝有某種設備、功能或配件，常用於描述物品或場所的配置。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is equipped with or fitted with a certain device, feature, or accessory; commonly used to describe what an item or place includes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部手機配有雙鏡頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau2 gei1 pui3 jau5 soeng1 geng6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手機配有雙鏡頭。
examples.english_sentence: The phone is equipped with dual cameras.
