examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 zi3 gin1 jyu4 gam1 gong1, mou5 je5 ho2 ji5 daa2 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意志坚如金刚，没什么可以打倒他。
examples.english_sentence: His will is as firm as a vajra; nothing can defeat him.

mandarin_meaning: 金卡（銀行或商家發行的高級會員卡或金色信用卡）
english_meaning: gold card; a premium-level credit card or membership card
explanation_mandarin: 通常指銀行或商家發行的金級會員卡或金色信用卡，代表較高等級的福利與優惠，例如折扣、積分或貴賓室使用權。
explanation_english: Refers to a gold-tier membership or credit card issued by a bank or merchant, indicating higher-level benefits and privileges such as discounts, rewards, or lounge access.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱拎到張銀行嘅金卡，可以有折扣同機場貴賓室待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 ling1 dou2 zoeng1 ngan4 hong4 ge3 gam1 kaat1, ho2 ji5 jau5 zit3 kau3 tung4 gei1 coeng4 gwai3 ban1 sat1 doi6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛拿到銀行的金卡，可以享受折扣和機場貴賓室待遇。
examples.english_sentence: I just got the bank's gold card — it offers discounts and access to the airport lounge.

mandarin_meaning: 金句／值得引用的精彩語句、經典語錄
english_meaning: a memorable or quotable line; a catchy/witty remark
explanation_mandarin: 指精彩、精闢或容易被引用的句子，常用來形容電影台詞、演講或社交媒體上引起共鳴的短句。
explanation_english: Refers to a striking, pithy, or easily quotable sentence—often used for memorable lines in films, speeches, or short phrases that resonate on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺訪問入面講咗句金句，網友不停轉發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 man6 jap6 min6 gong2 zo2 geoi3 gam1 geoi3, mong5 jau5 bat1 ting4 zyun2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在訪談中說了一句值得引用的話，網友不斷轉發。
examples.english_sentence: He said a quotable line during the interview, and netizens kept sharing it.

mandarin_meaning: 無通用意義（可能是人名、地名或外來語音譯）
english_meaning: No common meaning (possibly a proper name, place name, or a transliterated foreign word)
explanation_mandarin: 「金叵羅」在常見的粵語詞典與語料中極少見或未收錄。根據字形可作為人名或地名的書寫，或是某外來語的音譯。若要確定含義需更多上下文資料，如出處或使用場景。
explanation_english: "金叵羅" is not found in common Cantonese dictionaries or corpora and appears to be very rare or unattested as a lexical item. Based on the characters it could be a proper name (person/place) or a transliteration of a foreign term. Determining a precise meaning requires more context (source or usage).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知「金叵羅」係邊個/邊度？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 "gam1 po2 lo4" hai6 bin1 go3 / bin1 dou6 ?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知不知道「金叵羅」是誰/哪裡？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know who/where "金叵羅" is?

mandarin_meaning: 金卡（銀行或會員的高級卡）
english_meaning: gold card (a premium bank or membership card offering privileges)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指銀行或商戶發行的「金卡」，通常代表較高等級的信用卡或會員卡，享有額外優惠或禮遇。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a 'gold card' — a premium bank or membership card that usually confers extra benefits, discounts, or privileges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我申請咗張銀行嘅金咭，宜家買機票同訂酒店都有折扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 cing2 zo2 zoeng1 ngan4 hong4 ge3 gam1 kaat1, ji4 gaa1 maai5 gei1 piu3 tung4 ding6 zau2 dim3 dou1 jau5 zit3 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我申請了一張銀行的金卡，現在買機票和訂酒店都有折扣。
examples.english_sentence: I applied for a gold card from the bank; now I get discounts on plane tickets and hotel bookings.

mandarin_meaning: 金唱片（指唱片銷量達到「金唱片」認證或獲得金唱片獎的專輯或單曲）
english_meaning: Gold record — an album or single certified for reaching a sales threshold; a marker of commercial success
explanation_mandarin: 指達到一定銷量標準而獲頒的「金唱片」認證或獎項，用來表示專輯或單曲的商業成功。
explanation_english: Refers to a 'gold record' certification or award granted when an album or single reaches a specified sales threshold; denotes commercial success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張專輯賣得好好，已經攞到金唱片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zyun1 zaap6 maai6 dak1 hou2 hou2, ji5 ging1 lo2 dou3 gam1 coeng3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張專輯賣得很好，已經拿到金唱片。
examples.english_sentence: This album is selling very well; it has already earned a gold record.

mandarin_meaning: 金埕（字面：金色的埕，埕指小院、空地或古代的器皿）；常作地名或詩詞用語，現代口語中較少使用
english_meaning: Jincheng (literally 'golden ceng' — ceng can mean a small courtyard, open yard, or an ancient vat); often used as a place name or poetic term, rare in everyday speech
partOfSpeech_english: noun (proper noun / toponym or poetic noun)
explanation_mandarin: 「金埕」是一個較少見的詞組，字面由「金」（金色）和「埕」（古義可指小院、空地或盛器）組成。現代多見於地名、書面或詩詞表達，口語中不常作一般詞彙使用。
explanation_english: “金埕” is an uncommon compound: 金 means 'gold' (golden) and 埕 historically can mean a small courtyard, open yard, or an ancient container. It appears mainly as a place name or in literary/poetic contexts and is not common in everyday spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個村叫金埕，個名有幾百年歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cyun1 giu3 gam1 cing4, go3 meng2 jau5 gei2 baak3 nin4 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个村庄叫金埕，名字有几百年历史。
examples.english_sentence: This village is called Jincheng; the name has a history of several hundred years.

mandarin_meaning: 金色的塔；通常指覆有金箔或呈金色的佛塔、舍利塔等，也可作為建築物或地名
english_meaning: golden pagoda/stupa; a tower or religious monument covered in gold or gold-colored; also used as a building or place name
explanation_mandarin: 「金塔」一般指寺廟或宗教建築中以金色為特徵的塔（如佛塔、舍利塔），在東南亞和漢傳佛教地區常見，也可能作為景點或建築名稱使用。
explanation_english: "金塔" refers to a pagoda or stupa that is gold-colored or covered with gold leaf. It is commonly found in temples and religious sites (especially in Southeast Asia and Buddhist contexts) and can also be used as the name of a landmark or building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座寺廟入面有一座金塔，夜晚閃晒金光，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 ci3 miu6 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 zo6 gam1 taap3, je6 maan5 sim2 saai3 gam1 gwong1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座寺庙里面有一座金塔，晚上闪耀着金光，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: There is a golden pagoda inside that temple; at night it gleams with golden light—very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）彩金／頭獎；大量意外之財；亦可為彩券或商業產品名稱
english_meaning: slang for jackpot/prize money; a large windfall; also used as a brand/name for lottery tickets or products
explanation_mandarin: 「金多寶」在廣東話中常作俚語使用，指頭獎、彩金或突然得到的一大筆錢；同時這個詞亦常被用作彩券、刮刮樂或商業產品的名稱。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '金多寶' is commonly used colloquially to refer to a jackpot, prize money, or a sudden large windfall. It is also frequently used as a brand/name for lottery tickets or related products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我買張金多寶刮刮卡，希望中獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 maai5 zoeng1 gam1 do1 bou2 gwaat3 gwaat3 kaat1, hei1 mong6 zung1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我要買一張金多寶刮刮卡，希望能中獎。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to buy a '金多寶' scratchcard tomorrow; hope I win a prize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似中咗金多寶，成日買嘢都唔驚錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 zung1 zo2 gam1 do1 bou2, sing4 jat6 maai5 je5 dou1 m4 ging1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像中了金多寶，整天買東西都不怕花錢。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have hit the jackpot; he's always spending money without worry.

mandarin_meaning: 金奖（在比赛或评选中授予的最高等奖项）
english_meaning: gold award; top prize; gold medal
explanation_mandarin: 指在比賽、影展或各類評選中授予的最高等級獎項，通常相當於第一名或金牌。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest-level award given in a competition, festival, or selection process, typically equivalent to first prize or a gold medal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺影展攞到個金奬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jing2 zin2 lo2 dou3 go3 gam1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在影展獲得了金獎。
examples.english_sentence: He/She won the gold award at the film festival.

mandarin_meaning: 金婚（结婚五十周年）
english_meaning: golden wedding anniversary; fiftieth wedding anniversary
explanation_mandarin: 指婚姻满五十周年的纪念，也称金婚周年或金婚纪念。
explanation_english: Refers to the 50th wedding anniversary, often called the golden wedding anniversary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結咗婚五十年，快要慶祝金婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 zo2 fan1 ng5 sap6 nin4, faai3 jiu3 hing3 zuk1 gam1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚五十年，要庆祝金婚。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for fifty years and are going to celebrate their golden wedding anniversary.

mandarin_meaning: 金子（jīnzi）——黄金；贵重的金属，也可指珍贵的东西或财富。
english_meaning: gold; (the metal) gold; something valuable or precious
explanation_mandarin: 指黄金這種貴金屬，或泛指貴重、珍貴的物品或財產，在口語中也可比喻有價值的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the metal gold, or more generally to valuable or precious items. Can also be used figuratively to describe something or someone of great value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲金子好值錢，要保管好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gam1 zi2 hou2 zik6 cin2, jiu3 bou2 gun2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些金子很值钱，要好好保管。
examples.english_sentence: These gold pieces are very valuable; keep them safe.

mandarin_meaning: 金字塔
english_meaning: pyramid (architectural structure); pyramid-shaped or hierarchical structure
explanation_mandarin: 金字塔原指古代（如古埃及）的錐形建築，外形像三角錐；引申為呈金字塔形的結構或比喻上下分層、層級分明的組織或體系（如金字塔式結構）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the ancient pyramidal structures (e.g., Egyptian pyramids). Also used figuratively for pyramid-shaped or hierarchical structures, describing layered organizations or systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座金字塔好宏偉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 gam1 zi6 taap3 hou2 wang4 wai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座金字塔很宏偉。
examples.english_sentence: That pyramid is very magnificent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅組織係一個金字塔式嘅階級結構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zou2 zik1 hai6 jat1 go3 gam1 zi6 taap3 sik1 ge3 gaai1 kap1 git3 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家公司是金字塔式的階級結構。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a pyramid-style hierarchical structure.

mandarin_meaning: 帶金邊；華而不實的門面或裝飾
english_meaning: gold-trimmed edge; gilded border; figuratively, a flashy or superficial decoration/appearance
explanation_mandarin: 原指物件上鑲有金邊或金色裝飾，現常用作比喻，形容只重表面、華麗但缺乏實質內容的裝飾或門面。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a gold-edged or gilded trim on an object. Figuratively used to describe something that is flashy or decorative on the surface but lacks real substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫有金字邊，睇落好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 jau5 gam1 zi6 bin1, tai2 lok6 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服有金邊，看起來很貴。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her shirt has gold trim and looks expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司淨係做金字邊，冇實際內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 zing6hai6 zou6 gam1 zi6 bin1, mou5 sat6zai3 noi6jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司只是做表面功夫，沒有實際內容。
examples.english_sentence: This company only focuses on appearances and has no real substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 招牌上面有金字邊，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1paai4 soeng6min6 jau5 gam1 zi6 bin1, hou2 coeng2ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 招牌上有金邊，很醒目。
examples.english_sentence: The sign has gold trim and is very eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 金属
english_meaning: metal; metals
explanation_mandarin: 指具有导电性、延展性和光泽等性质的元素或合金的统称，常用于材料与工程领域。
explanation_english: A term for elements or alloys characterized by properties such as electrical conductivity, malleability/ductility, and luster; commonly used in materials and engineering contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手錶嘅殼係金屬做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2biu1 ge3 hok3 hai6 gam1suk6 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手表的表壳是金属做的。
examples.english_sentence: The case of this watch is made of metal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金屬通常導電，同埋有光澤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1suk6 tung1soeng4 dou6din6, tung4maai4 jau5 gwong1zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金属通常具有导电性，并且有光泽。
examples.english_sentence: Metals usually conduct electricity and have luster.

mandarin_meaning: 金属疲劳（材料在反复应力作用下发生损伤或破坏的现象）
english_meaning: Metal fatigue (the weakening and failure of metal due to repeated cyclic stresses)
explanation_mandarin: 金屬疲勞是指金屬材料在反復載荷或應力作用下，逐漸產生微小裂紋並最終導致破壞的現象，常見於橋樑、飛機和機械構件的失效分析中。
explanation_english: Metal fatigue is the phenomenon where metal components develop microscopic cracks and eventually fail after repeated cyclic loading or stress. It is a common failure mode in bridges, aircraft, and mechanical parts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橋因為金屬疲勞出現裂紋，工程師要檢查同埋維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kiu4 jan1 wai6 gam1 seot6 pei4 lou4 ceot1 jin2 lit6 man4, gung1 cing4 si1 jiu3 gim2 caa4 tung4 maai4 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座橋因為金屬疲勞出現裂紋，工程師需要檢查並維修。
examples.english_sentence: The bridge developed cracks due to metal fatigue; engineers need to inspect and repair it.

mandarin_meaning: 金山（jīnshān）：字面為「金子山」，歷史上華人對美國加州（尤指舊金山）的稱呼；也用作地名或比喻「賺錢的地方/金礦」。
english_meaning: Gold Mountain: literally a mountain of gold; historically used by Chinese to refer to California (especially San Francisco) during the Gold Rush; also a place name or a metaphor for a source of wealth.
explanation_mandarin: 「金山」一詞可指具體地名（如舊金山或其他名為金山的地區），亦常作比喻，表示能帶來大量財富的地方或機會。歷史上19世紀華人移民常稱加州為「金山」。
explanation_english: The term can denote an actual place name (e.g., San Francisco or other places called 'Jinshan') or be used metaphorically for a source of wealth. Historically, 19th-century Chinese migrants referred to California as the 'Gold Mountain'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢年輕嗰陣就去金山搵工，希望賺多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nin4 hing1 go2 zan6 zau6 heoi3 gam1 saan1 wan2 gung1, hei1 mong6 zaan6 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年輕的時候去金山找工作，希望賺更多錢。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young he went to San Francisco to find work, hoping to earn more money.

mandarin_meaning: （舊稱）前往美國（金山）謀生的華工或移民
english_meaning: an old Cantonese term for Chinese laborers/immigrants who went to the United States (the 'Gold Mountain')
explanation_mandarin: 「金山丁」為廣東話的舊稱，指前往美國（俗稱「金山」）謀生的華工或移民，常用於描述十九至二十世紀初期外出打工或淘金的廣東人。
explanation_english: A historical Cantonese slang term referring to Chinese laborers or immigrants who went to the United States (commonly called the 'Gold Mountain') to seek work, especially during the 19th and early 20th centuries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺係金山丁，聽佢講當年好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 gam1 saan1 ding1, teng1 keoi5 gong2 dong1 nin4 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷是金山丁，听他说当年很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather was a 'Gold Mountain' immigrant; he said it was very hard back then.

mandarin_meaning: 有錢人；出資支持者（俚語）
english_meaning: a wealthy person; a rich backer or patron (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「金山伯」是廣東話俚語，用來形容有很多錢的人，或是會出錢扶持、資助別人的富有靠山，通常帶有「有錢、闊綽」的意思。
explanation_english: "金山伯" is a Cantonese slang term for someone who is very wealthy or a rich patron/backer who funds or supports others. It often implies generosity or having deep pockets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背後有個金山伯，做乜都唔驚冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 hau6 jau5 go3 gam1 saan1 baak3, zou6 mat1 dou1 m4 ging1 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背後有個金山伯，做什麼都不怕沒錢。
examples.english_sentence: He has a wealthy backer, so he's not afraid of running out of money for anything.

mandarin_meaning: 赴金山（舊指美國/加州）謀生或淘金的人；赴海外謀生的移民
english_meaning: a 'Gold Mountain' migrant — someone who went to the (historical) Gold Mountain (i.e., the US/California) to seek fortune or work; an emigrant who went overseas to make a living
explanation_mandarin: 「金山客」原指19世紀淘金時期或其後前往美國（俗稱「金山」）謀生的華人。現可泛指赴海外（尤指北美）打工或定居以謀生的人，帶有歷史與社會文化色彩，屬口語或書面皆可用的稱呼。
explanation_english: Originally referred to Chinese who went to the California Gold Rush or later emigrated to the US (colloquially called the 'Gold Mountain') to seek fortune or work. It can now broadly denote people who went overseas (especially to North America) to make a living; the term has historical and socio-cultural connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺年輕嗰陣係金山客，去美國做工十幾年先返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 nin4 hing1 go2 zan6 hai6 gam1 saan1 haak3, heoi3 mei5 gwok3 zou6 gung1 sap6 gei2 nin4 sin1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爺爺年輕時是金山客，去美國做工十多年才回來。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa was a 'Gold Mountain' migrant when he was young — he went to the US to work for over ten years before coming back.

mandarin_meaning: 金山橙（指產自「金山」或俗稱金山的地區的橙子，常指加州橙等進口橙）
english_meaning: Jinshan orange (literally 'golden-mountain orange' — an orange from 'Jinshan', often used for California/or imported oranges)
explanation_mandarin: 「金山橙」多為口語用法，字面指來自「金山」（歷史上常指美國加州等地）的橙子或以「金山」命名的柑橘品種。並非普遍的成語，通常按字面用來描述產地或品種。
explanation_english: Primarily a literal term meaning oranges from 'Jinshan' (historically a name for places like California) or a citrus variety named after such a place. It is not a common idiom; typically used to describe origin or type of orange (e.g., imported/Californian oranges).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺市場買咗啲金山橙，幾新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 si5 coeng4 maai5 zo2 di1 gam1 saan1 caang2, gei2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在市場買了些金山橙，很新鮮。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some Jinshan oranges at the market; they're quite fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 賺大錢的機會、搖錢樹（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: a lucrative opportunity; a cash cow (colloquial slang)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，常用來形容某個行業、項目或機會能輕易帶來大量利潤或穩定高收益。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term used to describe an industry, project, or opportunity that yields easy or large profits — essentially a cash cow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家呢個項目係真正嘅金山翅，入貨少但回報高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hai6 zan1 zing3 ge3 gam1 saan1 cik1, jap6 fo3 siu2 daan6 wui4 bou3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在這個項目真的是金山翅，投入少但回報高。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a real cash cow—small investment but high returns.

mandarin_meaning: 金属加工；珠宝/金饰制作（如金银首饰的制作工艺或课程、工作坊）
english_meaning: metalwork; goldsmithing/jewellery-making (the craft, workshop, or course of making metal or jewellery pieces)
explanation_mandarin: 指與金屬加工、鑲嵌、打磨、焊接等相關的工藝或課程，常用於珠寶製作或金屬手工藝的範疇。
explanation_english: Refers to the craft or practice of working with metal — including shaping, joining, polishing, and making jewellery. It can denote the craft itself, workshops, or courses on jewellery/metalworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺學院選修咗金工堂，依家識整簡單嘅銀戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hok6 jyun6 syun2 sau1 zo2 gam1 gung1 tong4, ji4 gaa1 sik1 zing2 gaan2 daan1 ge3 ngan4 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在学院选修了金工课程，现在会做简单的银戒指。
examples.english_sentence: I took a metalworking class at college; now I can make a simple silver ring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間金工舖專門做訂製首飾，手工好細緻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gam1 gung1 pou3 zyun1 mun4 zou6 ding6 zai3 sau2 sik1, sau2 gung1 hou2 sai3 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家金工铺专门做订制首饰，手工很细致。
examples.english_sentence: This jewellery/metalwork shop specializes in custom-made pieces; the craftsmanship is very meticulous.

mandarin_meaning: 金币；金制的硬币或作为货币、道具的币
english_meaning: gold coin; coin (often gold); in-game or virtual currency (gold coins)
explanation_mandarin: 指由金属（尤其是金）製成的圓形貨幣，或指遊戲、應用內作為購買或升級用途的虛擬貨幣。
explanation_english: Refers to a coin made of metal (especially gold), or to gold coins used as in-game or virtual currency for purchases and upgrades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢儲咗好多金幣，準備買新嘅裝備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cou4 zo2 hou2 do1 gam1bai6, zeon2bei6 maai5 san1 ge3 zong1bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他存了很多金币，准备买新的装备。
examples.english_sentence: He saved a lot of gold coins to buy new gear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 博物館展出一枚古代嘅金幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bok3mat6gun2 zin2ceot1 jat1mui2 gu2doi6 ge3 gam1bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆展出一枚古代金币。
examples.english_sentence: The museum displayed an ancient gold coin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打機入面嘅金幣可以用嚟升級角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2gei1 jap6min6 ge3 gam1bai6 ho2ji5 jung6lai4 sing1kap1 gok3sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游戏里的金币可以用来升级角色。
examples.english_sentence: The gold coins in the game can be used to level up characters.

mandarin_meaning: 金戈铁马（jīn gē tiě mǎ）：原指兵器與戰馬，常用來形容戰爭場面或軍旅氣勢，也可比喻社會動盪或英雄豪情。
english_meaning: Originally refers to weapons and warhorses; commonly used to describe scenes of warfare or military might, and metaphorically denotes turbulent times or heroic martial spirit.
explanation_mandarin: 「金戈鐵馬」字面上是金屬武器與戰馬，出自古文，用來描寫戰爭的景象或軍隊氣勢；在現代語境下也常用作比喻，指戰亂時期或豪邁英勇的氛圍。
explanation_english: Literally 'metal spears and iron horses.' A classical idiom depicting the sights of war or military force. In modern usage it can be literal—referring to warfare—or figurative—describing turbulent times or heroic, martial atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰場上金戈鐵馬，場面好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 coeng4 soeng6 gam1 gwo1 tit3 maa5, coeng4 min6 hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戰場上金戈鐵馬，場面很壯觀。
examples.english_sentence: The battlefield was full of armored soldiers and horses; the scene was magnificent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嗰個年代係金戈鐵馬，家家戶戶都受戰火影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 go2 go3 nin4 doi6 hai6 gam1 gwo1 tit3 maa5, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 sau6 zin3 fo2 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前那個年代是金戈鐵馬，家家戶戶都受戰火影響。
examples.english_sentence: In those earlier years it was an era of war; every household was affected by the flames of conflict.

mandarin_meaning: 金手指（可指遊戲中的作弊碼或作弊器；比喻有點石成金／投資經商特別靈光的人；也指電路板上鍍金的接觸片）
english_meaning: “Gold finger” — can mean cheat codes/devices in games; metaphorically someone with the Midas touch (always succeeds); also the gold-plated connector contacts on circuit boards.
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法多樣：一是指遊戲或電子產品中的作弊碼、作弊器，能讓玩家獲得優勢；二是比喻某人在某方面非常有一套，做什麼都成功（類似「點石成金」）；三是電子零件術語，指主板等設備上鍍金的接觸端子。
explanation_english: Colloquial term with multiple senses: (1) cheat codes or cheat devices in games/electronics that give an advantage; (2) figuratively, a person with a Midas touch who succeeds easily; (3) a technical term for the gold-plated contact fingers on circuit boards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個遊戲有金手指，可以攞無限金幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 jau5 gam1 sau2 zi2, ho2 ji5 lo2 mou4 han6 gam1 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游戏有金手指，可以拿到无限金币。
examples.english_sentence: This game has cheat codes; you can get unlimited coins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係金手指，做咩生意都賺到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gam1 sau2 zi2, zou6 me1 sang1 ji3 dou1 zaan6 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是有金手指，做什么生意都能赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: He really has the Midas touch; any business he does makes money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張主板啲金手指氧化咗，要用酒精清潔先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zyu2 baan2 di1 gam1 sau2 zi2 joeng5 faa3 zo2, jiu3 jung6 zau2 zing1 cing1 git3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主板上的金手指氧化了，需要用酒精清洁才行。
examples.english_sentence: The gold fingers on the motherboard have oxidized; you need to clean them with alcohol.

jyutping: gam1 sau2 zi2 —— duk6 jan4 bui3 zek3
mandarin_meaning: 金手指（指電玩或系統的作弊器/作弊手段）；篤人背脊（在背後出賣或陷害別人，背叛）——合起來形容用陰險或作弊手段在背後陷害、出賣別人
english_meaning: “Golden finger — poke someone's back”: 'golden finger' = cheat/mod; '篤人背脊' = backstab/betray. Together it describes using underhanded or cheating methods to betray or harm others behind their backs.
explanation_mandarin: 這是一個廣東話口語表達，前半部“金手指”常指遊戲或系統的作弊器、作弊手段，亦可泛指暗中有利的招數；後半部“篤人背脊”字面為用手指篤別人的背，慣用來比喻在背後陷害或出賣別人。合起來用來形容用陰險、作弊或暗中操作的方式去背叛、陷害別人。
explanation_english: This Cantonese colloquial phrase combines 'golden finger' (cheat code/mod or an underhand trick) and 'duk jan bui zek' (literally 'poke someone's back', idiomatically 'to backstab' or betray). Used to describe betraying or harming someone by underhanded, deceitful, or cheating methods behind their back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用金手指——篤人背脊，先攞到個位，大家都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gam1 sau2 zi2 —— duk6 jan4 bui3 zek3, sin1 lo2 dou3 go3 wai6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用金手指（作弊／陰險手段）在背後出賣別人，才得到那個位子，大家都不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He used 'golden finger' tricks and backstabbed others to get that position; nobody's happy about it.

mandarin_meaning: 捞钱；趁机赚钱（通常含投机或见利忘义的意思）
english_meaning: to cash in; to make money opportunistically (often quick profit, sometimes by dubious means)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指透過投機、利用機會或不正當手段快速賺取金錢或利益，常帶有負面或見利忘義的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to make money quickly or opportunistically, often by taking advantage of situations or through dubious means; carries a somewhat negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上次靠嗰單投資金撈咗一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng5 ci3 kaau3 go2 daan1 tau4 zi1 gam1 lou1 zo2 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次靠那筆投資撈到一筆錢。
examples.english_sentence: He cashed in on that investment last time and made a sum of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲政黨喺新政策出台時會金撈，攞到好多資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 zing3 dong2 hai2 san1 zing3 cek3 ceot1 toi4 si4 wui5 gam1 lou1, lo2 dou3 hou2 do1 zi1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些政黨在新政策出台時會趁機撈錢，拿到很多資源。
examples.english_sentence: Some parties cash in when new policies come out and obtain a lot of resources.

mandarin_meaning: 金文（jīn wén）——青铜器上的铭文，亦称钟鼎文，用以记载祭祀、封赐、战争等历史事件，是古代汉字的重要形态之一。
english_meaning: Bronze inscriptions (Jinwen) — inscriptions cast on bronze vessels, also called bell-and-tripod inscriptions, used to record rites, grants, wars and other historical events; an important early form of Chinese writing.
explanation_mandarin: 金文指铸刻在青铜器上的文字，多见于商周时期，用于记录重大事项、祭祀或铭功，研究金文有助于考古与古文字学研究。
explanation_english: Refers to characters inscribed on bronze objects, mostly from the Shang and Zhou periods, used to record significant events, rituals, or commemorations. Studying bronze inscriptions is important for archaeology and paleography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書主要講金文嘅歷史同解讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 zyu2 jiu3 gong2 gam1 man4 ge3 lik6 si2 tung4 gaai2 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书主要讲金文的历史和解读。
examples.english_sentence: This book mainly discusses the history and interpretation of bronze inscriptions.

mandarin_meaning: 金星（行星：金星）；在粤语口语中常见于短语“撞到金星”，表示走运、遇上好事
english_meaning: Venus (the planet); in Cantonese idiomatic usage appears in the phrase "撞到金星" meaning to be lucky or have a fortunate coincidence
explanation_mandarin: 一是天文学上的行星“金星”；二是在粤语口語中，常見於短語「撞到金星」，用來形容非常幸運或遇上罕見的好事。
explanation_english: Primarily the planet Venus. In Cantonese colloquial speech it appears in the idiom "撞到金星" (literally "hit Venus"), meaning to be unexpectedly lucky or to have a rare fortunate coincidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚可以見到金星，用望遠鏡睇得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ho2 ji5 gin3 dou3 gam1 sing1, jung6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 tai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚可以看到金星，用望远镜看得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: You can see Venus tonight; with a telescope it looks very clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日真係撞到金星，中咗頭獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 zong6 dou3 gam1 sing1, zung1 zo2 tau4 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天真是撞到了好运，中了头奖。
examples.english_sentence: I was really lucky today — I won the top prize.

mandarin_meaning: 金曲（指流行或經典的好歌／熱門歌曲，亦常出現在獎項名稱，如「金曲獎」）
english_meaning: golden song; a hit or classic song (also used in award names, e.g. "Golden Melody Awards")
explanation_mandarin: 「金曲」用來指非常受歡迎或具經典地位的歌曲，有時也用在獎項或活動名稱中，代表優秀或著名的歌曲。
explanation_english: Refers to a very popular or classic song — a hit — and is sometimes used in names of awards or events to indicate outstanding or well-known songs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗰張專輯入面有幾首真係金曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go2 zoeng1 zyun1 zaap6 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 sau2 zan1 hai6 gam1 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那张专辑里有好几首真的是金曲。
examples.english_sentence: There are several real hits on their album.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌已經成為金曲，大家都識唱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 gam1 kuk1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 sik1 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌已经成为金曲，大家都会唱。
examples.english_sentence: This song has become a classic hit; everyone can sing it.

mandarin_meaning: 金、木、水、火、土（五行）
english_meaning: The Five Elements (metal, wood, water, fire, earth) in Chinese philosophy
explanation_mandarin: 指中国传统五行学说中的五种基本元素：金、木、水、火、土，常用于中医、风水、命理等领域，表示相生相克的关系与平衡。
explanation_english: Refers to the five basic elements in Chinese philosophy—metal, wood, water, fire, and earth—used in traditional medicine, feng shui, astrology, etc., representing generating and restraining relationships and balance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水師話，要睇屋企嘅金木水火土有冇平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 si1 waa6, jiu3 tai2 uk1 kei5 ge3 gam1 muk6 seoi2 fo2 tou2 jau5 mou5 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 風水師說，要看家裡的金木水火土是否平衡。
examples.english_sentence: The feng shui master said you need to check whether the five elements in the home are balanced.

mandarin_meaning: 出身高貴（尤指女子）；形容女子嬌美、氣質高雅。原義為皇族貴女。
english_meaning: Literally "golden branches and jade leaves." Refers to someone of noble birth (especially a woman) or a woman of delicate beauty and refined manners.
explanation_mandarin: 四字成語，原指皇室或貴族的女性，後用來形容出身顯赫、家世高貴，或形容女子嬌美、舉止高雅、有氣質。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom originally referring to women of the royal family. It is used to describe someone from a distinguished or noble family, or to praise a woman as delicate, beautiful, and having refined manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係金枝玉葉，講嘢舉止好有氣派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gam1 zi1 juk6 jip6, gong2 je5 geoi2 zi2 hou2 jau5 hei3 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是金枝玉葉，說話舉止很有氣派。
examples.english_sentence: She really is of noble birth — her speech and manners are very dignified.

mandarin_meaning: 金条（指由金属制成的长方形贵重物；也可指作投资或储藏的黄金单位）
english_meaning: gold bar (a rectangular piece of refined gold, often used as a store of value or investment)
explanation_mandarin: 指由純金或含金量高的金屬鑄造成的長方形或塊狀貴重物，一般用作儲藏、投資或交易媒介。在口語中可泛指大筆金錢或高價值的實物資產。
explanation_english: A bar of gold — a rectangular or block-shaped piece of refined gold used for storage of wealth, investment, or trade. In colloquial usage it can also figuratively refer to a large sum of money or a high-value physical asset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行保險箱入面鎖住幾條金條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 bou2 him2 soeng1 jap6 min6 so2 zyu6 gei2 tiu4 gam1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 銀行的保險箱裡鎖著幾條金條。
examples.english_sentence: A few gold bars are locked in the bank's safe deposit box.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗一條金條嚟保值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 jat1 tiu4 gam1 tiu4 lai4 bou2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了一條金條來保值。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a gold bar as an investment to preserve value.

mandarin_meaning: 金毛；常指金毛尋回犬，也可指金色頭髮的人（口語用法）
english_meaning: golden-furred; commonly refers to the Golden Retriever; colloquially can mean a person with blond hair
explanation_mandarin: 「金毛」字面上指金黃色的毛。通常在日常語言中用來指代金毛尋回犬（Golden Retriever）。在少數口語情境下也可用來形容頭髮呈金色的人，但較常用詞為「金髮」。
explanation_english: Literally 'golden fur.' Commonly used to refer to the Golden Retriever (a dog breed with golden fur). Occasionally used colloquially to describe someone with blond hair, though 'blond' is more common for that meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企養咗隻金毛，成日去公園同佢散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 joeng5 zo2 zek3 gam1 mou4, seng4 jat6 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 tung4 keoi5 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家养了一只金毛（尋回犬），经常带它去公园散步。
examples.english_sentence: I have a Golden Retriever at home and often take it to the park for walks.

mandarin_meaning: 回扣；賄賂；佣金（粵語俗稱）
english_meaning: bribe; kickback; commission (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指為了促成某事或作為仲介而給予的回扣或賄賂；在賭場、地下交易或公職貪污情況中常見。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term referring to bribes, kickbacks, or commissions paid to intermediaries; commonly used in contexts like gambling, underground dealings, or corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗金水畀官員，先至批咗個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 gam1 seoi2 bei2 gun1 jyun4, sin1 zi3 pai1 zo2 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了官员回扣，项目才获批。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a bribe/kickback to the officials before the project was approved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲地下賭檔成日要俾金水先可以繼續營業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dei6 haa6 dou2 dong3 sing4 jat6 jiu3 bei2 gam1 seoi2 sin1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 jing4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些地下赌场常常要付回扣/贿赂才可以继续营业。
examples.english_sentence: These underground gambling dens often have to pay kickbacks/bribes in order to keep operating.

mandarin_meaning: 金沙排骨；裹有鹹蛋黃（金沙）調味的炸豬骨或排骨
english_meaning: Salted egg yolk pork ribs (deep-fried ribs coated with a 'golden sand' salted egg yolk sauce)
explanation_mandarin: 一道在香港及廣東常見的菜式：將豬骨或排骨油炸後，以鹹蛋黃醬（俗稱「金沙」）拌勻，外脆內香，味道鹹香滑腴。
explanation_english: A popular Hong Kong/Cantonese dish where deep-fried pork ribs are coated with a salted egg yolk ('golden sand') sauce; crispy and savory with a rich, slightly creamy coating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我買咗啲金沙骨，啲味道好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 gam1 saa1 gwat1, di1 mei6 dou6 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我買了些金沙骨，味道很好。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some salted-egg yolk ribs tonight; they taste great.

mandarin_meaning: 金黃的油條；（口語）形容油條呈現金黃色澤
english_meaning: golden youtiao (fried dough stick); describing a youtiao that is golden and crispy
explanation_mandarin: 「金油條」多用於描述油條外觀呈金黃色、炸得香脆，屬於口語或食物描述用語。並非一個固定成語或廣泛的俚語，主要為形容詞性名詞用法。
explanation_english: “金油條” literally means a golden youtiao (fried dough stick). It is used to describe a youtiao that has a golden color and is crispy. This is a food-description term rather than a widely established idiom or slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條金油條炸得好金黃，好香好脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gam1 jau4 tiu4 zaa3 dak1 hou2 gam1 wong4, hou2 hoeng1 hou2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这根金黄的油条炸得很好，很香很酥脆。
examples.english_sentence: This golden youtiao is fried to a nice golden color — it smells great and is very crispy.

mandarin_meaning: 這一波啦／這次啦（指當下這一回、這一輪，常作語氣詞，用於提醒、驚訝或評論）
english_meaning: "this round" / "here we go (this time)" — a colloquial marker referring to the current wave/round or emphasising that something is happening now
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 語助詞／感嘆詞（口語用法）
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語用法，常在香港粵語中作為句末或句中語氣詞，指「這一波／這一回」，可用來提醒大家注意、表達驚訝、或評論當前趨勢／情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used as a marker for the current "wave" or "round" (e.g. trend, event, game round). It functions as an interjection or discourse particle to highlight that something is happening now, to warn, or to comment with surprise or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金波囉，今次唔同，大家小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 bo1 lo1, gam1 ci3 m4 tung4, daai6 gaa1 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這一波啦，這次不一樣，大家小心一點。
examples.english_sentence: This round — it's different this time. Everyone be a bit careful.

mandarin_meaning: 金牌；第一名；頂尖、最優秀的（引申義）
english_meaning: gold medal; champion; top-notch (figurative: the best or most outstanding)
explanation_mandarin: 原指競賽中頒給第一名的金牌；在口語中也常用作引申義，表示在某個領域或行業中最優秀、最受認可或最受歡迎的人、團隊或產品。
explanation_english: Literally the gold medal awarded to first place in a competition; figuratively used to describe someone or something that is the best, top-rated, or most outstanding in a field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺奧運攞咗金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ou3 wan6 lo2 zo2 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在奧運會獲得了金牌。
examples.english_sentence: He won a gold medal at the Olympics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋學校嘅金牌老師，所有學生都好鍾意佢嘅教學方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 ge3 gam1 paai4 lou5 si1, so2 jau5 hok6 saang1 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5 ge3 gaau3 hok6 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們學校的金牌老師，所有學生都很喜歡他的教學方法。
examples.english_sentence: He is our school's star teacher; all the students like his teaching methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳攞過金牌，服務同食物都非常出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 lo2 gwo3 gam1 paai4, fuk6 mou6 tung4 sik6 mat6 dou1 fei1 soeng4 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳曾獲金牌，服務和食物都非常出色。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has won a gold award; its service and food are excellent.

mandarin_meaning: 金牌打手 / 頂級打手
english_meaning: top enforcer; top-tier thug (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「金牌打仔」是香港廣東話的俗語，字面意思為「金牌的打仔」。通常指幫派或黑社會中技術高、最受倚重的打手或打手頭目；有時也可誇張地用來形容某人在某方面非常厲害（非正式用法）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "金牌打仔" literally means "gold-medal hitman." It usually refers to a highly skilled, top-rated enforcer or thug employed by a gang; informally it can also be used hyperbolically to praise someone's prowess in a particular area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋幫入面嘅金牌打仔，出手一向快狠準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 bong1 jap6 min6 ge3 gam1 paai4 daa2 zai2, ceot1 sau2 jat1 hoeng3 faai3 han2 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們幫裡的金牌打手，下手向來又快又狠又準。
examples.english_sentence: He's the gang's top enforcer — his strikes are always fast, ruthless and precise.

mandarin_meaning: 金牛；可指金色的牛、金牛座（黃道十二宮之一），或比喻能帶來穩定收益的賺錢來源
english_meaning: golden ox / golden bull; can refer to the Taurus zodiac sign (short for Taurus) or figuratively a moneymaker/cash cow
explanation_mandarin: 「金牛」字面上指金色或黃銅的牛。在天文/占星語境中常作「金牛座」的簡稱（即西方星座 Taurus）。在商業或俗語用法中，也可比喻為能帶來穩定利潤或大量收入的產品、事業或資產（類似「搖錢樹」或 cash cow）。
explanation_english: Literally 'golden ox' or 'golden bull.' In astrology it is commonly short for the Taurus zodiac sign. Figuratively it can mean a moneymaker or cash cow — a product, business, or asset that generates steady profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係金牛座，通常都幾穩重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 gam1 ngau4 zo6, tung1 soeng4 dou1 gei2 wan2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是金牛座，通常都很穩重。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a Taurus; I'm usually quite steady.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻產品係公司嘅金牛，每個月都有穩定收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 caan2 ban2 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 gam1 ngau4, mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jau5 wan2 ding6 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個產品是公司的金牛，每個月都有穩定收入。
examples.english_sentence: This product is the company's cash cow; it generates steady income every month.

mandarin_meaning: 金牛座（黃道十二宮之一）
english_meaning: Taurus (the astrological zodiac sign)
explanation_mandarin: 黃道十二宮之一，日期約為4月20日至5月20日。金牛座常被描述為務實、穩定且有點固執，象徵耐心和可靠。
explanation_english: One of the twelve astrological zodiac signs (Taurus), roughly April 20–May 20. Taurus is often described as practical, steady, and sometimes stubborn, symbolizing patience and reliability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係金牛座，通常好踏實同埋固執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 gam1 ngau4 zo6, tung1 soeng4 hou2 daap6 sat6 tung4 maai4 gu3 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是金牛座，通常很踏實而且有點固執。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a Taurus — usually very down-to-earth and a bit stubborn.

mandarin_meaning: 金狮
english_meaning: golden lion; (also a name/title like for businesses or awards)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思為「金色的獅子」，常用作實物（如銅像、裝飾）或專有名稱，也可作為獎項名稱（如「金獅獎」的簡稱）。
explanation_english: Literally "golden lion." Used for literal objects (e.g., a gold lion statue or decoration) and as a proper name for businesses, venues, or awards (e.g., shorthand for the Golden Lion prize).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街入面嘅金獅銅像好顯眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 jap6 min6 ge3 gam1 si1 tung4 zoeng6 hou2 hin2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上的金狮铜像很显眼。
examples.english_sentence: The golden lion statue on the street is very eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳叫「金獅」，佢哋嘅點心好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 giu3 『gam1 si1』, keoi5 dei6 ge3 dim2 sam1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅叫“金狮”，他们的点心很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is called 'Golden Lion'; their dim sum is famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電影喺威尼斯影展攞咗金獅獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 jing2 hai6 wai1 nei4 si1 jing2 zin2 lo2 zo2 gam1 si1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影在威尼斯电影节获得了金狮奖。
examples.english_sentence: The film won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival.

mandarin_meaning: 金奖（指比赛或评选中的最高等级奖项，通常相当于金牌或第一名）
english_meaning: gold award; gold medal; first prize
explanation_mandarin: 指在比賽、評選或活動中授予的最高等級獎項，通常代表第一名或金牌榮譽。
explanation_english: The highest-level award given in a competition, selection, or event, typically representing first place or a gold medal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽贏咗金獎，大家都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2coi3 jeng4 zo2 gam1 zoeng2, daai6gaa1 dou1 hou2 hoi1sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比賽中獲得金獎，大家都很高興。
examples.english_sentence: He won the gold award in the competition; everyone was very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影攞咗金獎，導演上台去領獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6jing2 lo2 zo2 gam1 zoeng2, dou6jin2 soeng5 toi4 heoi3 ling5 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影獲得了金獎，導演上台領獎。
examples.english_sentence: The film won the gold award, and the director went on stage to accept it.

jyutping: gam1 juk6 kei4 ngoi6, baai6 seoi6 kei4 zung1
mandarin_meaning: 外表光鮮亮麗而內裡敗壞；徒有其表
english_meaning: Superficially splendid but rotten on the inside; all show and no substance
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 形容外表華麗，而內在品質或實際情況很差，徒有虛名或表面光鮮。
explanation_english: Describes something that looks impressive on the outside but is corrupt, poor in quality, or hollow on the inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司外面廣告寫得好靚，但入面管理亂，真係金玉其外，敗絮其中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ngoi6min6 gwong2gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 leng3, daan6 jap6min6 gun2lei5 lyun6, zan1 hai6 gam1 juk6 kei4 ngoi6, baai6 seoi6 kei4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司外表广告做得很漂亮，但内部管理混乱，真是金玉其外，败絮其中。
examples.english_sentence: This company's ads make it look great on the outside, but its internal management is chaotic — truly splendid outside, rotten inside.

mandarin_meaning: 金玉良言 (jīn yù liáng yán) — 珍貴的忠告或至理名言
english_meaning: words of wisdom; valuable or salutary advice
explanation_mandarin: 「金玉良言」原指像金玉一樣寶貴的話，現用來形容珍貴、有益、有啟發性的忠告或箴言。
explanation_english: Literally "gold and jade good words"; an idiom meaning precious, wise, or salutary advice — words of wisdom worth remembering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅金玉良言，我會記住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 gam1 juk6 loeng4 jin4, ngo5 wui5 gei3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你的金玉良言，我会记住。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your words of wisdom — I'll remember them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅畀咗幾句金玉良言，令我改變咗諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 bei2 zo2 gei2 geoi3 gam1 juk6 loeng4 jin4, ling6 ngo5 goi2 bin3 zo2 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师父给了几句金玉良言，使我改变了想法。
examples.english_sentence: The master gave a few words of wisdom that changed my way of thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 金玉黄（颜色）
english_meaning: golden yellow (a shade of yellow resembling gold or egg-yolk)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述一種偏金色、偏黃的顏色，常用於服裝、布料、花卉或設計配色中。
explanation_english: A color term describing a golden-yellow hue, often used for clothing, fabrics, flowers, or design palettes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係金玉黃，好襯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 gam1 juk6 wong4, hou2 can3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是金玉黄，很适合你。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is golden yellow; it suits you well.

mandarin_meaning: 弃恶从善；不再从事以前（尤指违法或不光彩的）行业或行为，洗手不干
english_meaning: To give up a former (often illicit or disreputable) life or occupation; to renounce wrongdoing; to retire or quit one's old ways
explanation_mandarin: 用来表示某人決定放棄以前的行當或不光彩的行為，改過自新或退休，不再從事此前的事情。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning someone decides to abandon their previous profession or disreputable behavior, reform or retire, and stop engaging in their former activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想金盆洗手，唔再做啲非法嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 gam1 pun4 sai2 sau2, m4 zoi6 zou6 di1 fei1faat3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想金盆洗手，不再做违法的事。
examples.english_sentence: He says he wants to give it up and stop doing illegal things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話佢年紀大，打算金盆洗手，將公司交畀後生接手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 keoi5 nin4 gei3 daai6, daa2 syun3 gam1 pun4 sai2 sau2, zoeng1 gung1si1 gaau1 bei2 hau6 saang1 zip3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说他年纪大，打算金盆洗手，把公司交给年轻人接手。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he's getting older and plans to retire, handing the company over to the younger generation.

mandarin_meaning: 金盆洗手（比喻放棄惡習或退出某種職業/行業，尤指放棄犯罪或不正當活動）
english_meaning: To give up a career or habit (especially criminal activity); to retire or quit — equivalent to 'to hang up one's gloves' or 'to wash one's hands of it'.
explanation_mandarin: “金盤洗手”多用來比喻放棄從事的惡習或不當行業、退出江湖或犯罪活動，意思是決定不再繼續做那類事。正寫法通常為「金盆洗手」，「金盤洗手」常被視為俗寫或誤寫，但在口語或新聞中也會見到。
explanation_english: This idiom means to give up a former life or habit—often used for quitting criminal or disreputable activities. The standard form is '金盆洗手' (golden basin wash hands); '金盤洗手' is a common colloquial or variant spelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁耐黑幫嘢，依家話要金盤洗手，唔再做返嗰啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam2 noi6 hak1 bong1 je5, ji1 gaa1 waa6 jiu3 gam1 pun4 sai2 sau2, m4 zoi3 zou6 faan1 go2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了那麼久黑幫的事，現在說要金盤洗手，不再做那些事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been involved in gang activities for so long; now he says he'll quit — that he'll give it up and not do those things anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 火眼金睛；目光敏銳，能看透虛實
english_meaning: sharp-eyed; keen-sighted — able to see through deception or discern the truth quickly
explanation_mandarin: 成語，形容目光敏銳、辨別能力強，能一眼看穿事物的真相。此語與《西遊記》中孫悟空的「火眼金睛」意義相近。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone with keen eyesight or sharp perception who can quickly see through deception or discern the truth; related in meaning to the legendary 'fire-eyed, golden-pupilled' sight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係金睛火眼，一眼就睇穿嗰個騙局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gam1 zing1 fo2 ngaan5, jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 cyun1 go2 go3 pin3 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的火眼金睛，一眼就看穿那個騙局。
examples.english_sentence: He really has sharp eyes — he saw through that scam at a glance.

mandarin_meaning: 金属与石头；比喻坚固、不易改变（常见于成语或固定搭配，如“金石之交”）
english_meaning: literally 'metal and stone'; used metaphorically to mean very firm, unchangeable, or enduring (appears in idioms like '金石之交')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；用作比喻時可作形容詞或構成成語的一部分
partOfSpeech_english: noun; used metaphorically as an adjective or as part of an idiom
explanation_mandarin: “金石”原指金屬與石頭，常用於成語中表示堅固、牢不可破或關係長久不變，例如“金石之交”形容堅定的友情。
explanation_english: Originally refers to metal and stone. Commonly used in idioms to express solidity, permanence, or unbreakable bonds (e.g. '金石之交' for an enduring friendship).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係金石之交，幾十年都冇變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 gam1 sek6 zi1 gaau1, gei2 sap6 nin4 dou1 mou5 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是金石之交，几十年都没变。
examples.english_sentence: They are friends as firm as metal and stone; it hasn't changed in decades.

mandarin_meaning: （相當於）金玉良言；中肯而有價值的忠告
english_meaning: sound, valuable advice; sincere and lasting counsel
explanation_mandarin: 「金石良言」指如金石般堅定、有分量且值得珍視的忠告或勸告，通常用來形容非常有價值、應該謹記的話。
explanation_english: “金石良言” refers to advice that is as solid and weighty as metal and stone — lasting, sincere, and worth remembering. It denotes valuable, trustworthy counsel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲金石良言我會銘記喺心，多謝你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 gam1 sek6 loeng4 jin4 ngo5 wui5 ming4 gei3 hai2 sam1, do1 ze6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的金石良言我會銘記在心，謝謝你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll keep your invaluable advice in mind — thank you.

mandarin_meaning: 金碧辉煌（形容富麗堂皇、光彩奪目的樣子）
english_meaning: Resplendent; splendid and richly ornamented; dazzlingly magnificent
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容建築、裝飾或場面極為華麗輝煌，常帶有金碧（黃金與美玉）般的富麗感。
explanation_english: Used to describe buildings, decorations, or scenes that are extremely lavish and brilliantly ornate, suggesting the splendor of gold and jade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間古廟金碧輝煌，好多人嚟參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gu2 miu6 gam1 bik1 fai1 wong4, hou2 do1 jan4 lei4 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座古廟金碧輝煌，很多人來參觀。
examples.english_sentence: The old temple is resplendent; many people come to visit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新開嘅酒店大堂裝修得金碧輝煌，但我覺得有啲俗氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 hoi1 ge3 zau2 dim3 daai6 tong4 zong1 sau1 dak1 gam1 bik1 fai1 wong4, daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新開的酒店大堂裝修得金碧輝煌，但我覺得有點俗氣。
examples.english_sentence: The newly opened hotel's lobby is lavishly decorated, but I think it's a bit tacky.

mandarin_meaning: 金矿（指含金的矿藏；比喻有利可图的来源）
english_meaning: gold mine (a mine containing gold); figuratively, a rich source of profit or valuable resource
explanation_mandarin: 指地下含有金屬金的礦床或採掘場所；在比喻用法中指帶來大量利益或價值的來源。
explanation_english: Refers to a deposit or mine that contains gold and the site where it is mined. Metaphorically, it denotes a source that yields substantial profit or value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度有座金礦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 jau5 zo6 gam1 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那裡有一座金礦。
examples.english_sentence: There is a gold mine over there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司真係個金礦，賺好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zan1 hai6 go3 gam1 kwong3, zaan6 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家公司真是一個金礦，賺了很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: This company is truly a goldmine; it makes a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發現咗金礦之後，村民就搬嚟住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 jin4 zo2 gam1 kwong3 zi1 hau6, cyun1 man4 zau6 bun1 lai4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 發現金礦之後，村民就搬過來居住。
examples.english_sentence: After the gold mine was discovered, villagers moved in to live.

mandarin_meaning: 金禧（通常指五十周年纪念，也可作慶典或品牌名稱，含金色、喜慶之意）
english_meaning: golden jubilee (typically a 50th anniversary); a golden celebration; also used as a name/brand
explanation_mandarin: 「金禧」常用來指五十周年紀念（例如公司或婚姻的五十周年），亦常見於活動、慶典或商號名稱，帶有喜慶、隆重的含義。
explanation_english: “金禧” typically refers to a golden jubilee (the 50th anniversary) and is used for anniversaries, celebrations, or as part of event/brand names, conveying a festive and prestigious tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司下個月要慶祝金禧，會搞個盛大晚會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 hing3 zuk1 gam1 hei1, wui5 gaau2 go3 sing6 daai6 maan5 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司下个月要庆祝金禧，会举办一个盛大的晚会。
examples.english_sentence: The company will celebrate its golden jubilee next month and hold a grand evening event.

mandarin_meaning: 金秋（jīnqiū）：金色的秋天，秋季，尤指收获的季节。
english_meaning: Golden autumn; the autumn season, especially the harvest season with pleasant weather and golden colors.
explanation_mandarin: 指秋季，通常带有丰收、金黄景象和气候宜人的含义，多用于书面或诗意的表达。
explanation_english: Refers to the autumn season, often evoking imagery of harvest, golden colors, and pleasant weather; commonly used in literary or poetic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金秋係收成嘅季節，農夫好忙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 cau1 hai6 sau1 sing4 ge3 gwai3 zit3, nung4 fu1 hou2 mong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金秋是收成的季节，农民很忙。
examples.english_sentence: The golden autumn is the harvest season; farmers are very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺金秋推出咗幾款新產品，希望業績可以更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hai2 gam1 cau1 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 gei2 fun2 san1 caan2 ban2, hei1 mong6 jip6 zik1 ho2 ji5 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在金秋推出了几款新产品，希望业绩能够更好。
examples.english_sentence: The company launched several new products in the golden autumn, hoping for better results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金秋時節天氣清爽，最啱去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 cau1 si4 zit3 tin1 hei3 cing1 soeng2, zeoi3 aam1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金秋时节天气清爽，最适合去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: During the golden autumn the weather is crisp—perfect for travel.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻被視為至高無上的規章或準則，不可違反的鐵律
english_meaning: a golden rule; an inviolable law or strict rule regarded as sacrosanct
explanation_mandarin: 原指至高無上的法規或條文，後用來形容被嚴格遵守、不可違犯的規矩或準則。
explanation_english: Originally referred to supreme laws; now used to describe rules or principles treated as strict, inviolable standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將公司嘅規則當成金科玉律，冇得商量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 gwai1 zak1 dong3 sing4 gam1 fo1 juk6 leot6, mou5 dak1 soeng1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把公司的規則當成金科玉律，沒有商量的餘地。
examples.english_sentence: He treats the company's rules as golden rules that cannot be questioned; there's no room for discussion.

mandarin_meaning: 金童玉女 (jīn tóng yù nǚ) — 用來形容年輕貌美、情投意合的一對男女；也可指廟宇中陪侍神祇的童男童女像。
english_meaning: Literally "golden boy and jade girl" — an idealized young, attractive couple; also refers to youthful attendant statues in temples.
explanation_mandarin: 常用來形容一對年輕、外貌姣好且十分般配的男女，或指廟中成對的童男童女雕像，帶有美好、純潔的意象。
explanation_english: Often describes a young, attractive, and well-matched couple; can also refer to paired statues of youthful attendants in temples, carrying connotations of beauty and purity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對新人真係金童玉女，好配。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 san1 jan4 zan1 hai6 gam1 tung4 juk6 neoi5, hou2 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這對新人真是金童玉女，很般配。
examples.english_sentence: This newlywed couple really are a perfect match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟裡供奉住金童玉女像，雕得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 leoi5 gung1 fung3 zyu6 gam1 tung4 juk6 neoi5 zoeng6, diu1 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡供奉著金童玉女像，雕刻得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The temple enshrines statues of golden boys and jade girls; they are beautifully carved.

mandarin_meaning: 金色的笸籮（用來盛載或篩洗食材的籮/瀝水器）
english_meaning: a golden colander/basket (a basket or sieve used for washing or draining food)
explanation_mandarin: 「笸籮」指傳統用來盛載或篩洗蔬菜、米等的籮或篩，前面加上「金」即指金色或形容外觀的說法。日常多用於字面意思，也可作為形容某物外觀的比喻用法。
explanation_english: “笸籮” refers to a traditional basket or sieve used for holding or rinsing vegetables, rice, etc. Adding “金” simply describes it as golden (or gold-colored). It is typically used literally, and occasionally as a descriptive metaphor for appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽用個金笸籮洗菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 jung6 go3 gam1 po2 lo4 sai2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽用金色的笸籮洗菜。
examples.english_sentence: Mom uses a golden colander to wash vegetables.

mandarin_meaning: 金笔；（比喻）擅長寫作或具有影響力的作者/記者
english_meaning: gold pen; (figurative) an outstanding writer or influential columnist
explanation_mandarin: 「金笔」字面意思是金製或金色的筆；在口語或新聞語境中，有時比喻某位寫作或採訪能力特別強、文章有影響力的人，類似「王牌作者」或「社內名記」。
explanation_english: Literally a pen made of gold or a gold-colored pen. Figuratively, it can refer to an outstanding writer or influential columnist whose writing is highly regarded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用緊一支金筆，好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gan2 jat1 zi1 gam1 bat1, hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在用一支金笔，很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He's using a gold pen — looks really stylish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支金筆係真金做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 gam1 bat1 hai6 zan1 gam1 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支金笔是真金做的。
examples.english_sentence: This pen is made of real gold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫稿好勁，係我哋報社嘅金筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 gou2 hou2 ging6, hai6 ngo5 dei6 bou3 se5 ge3 gam1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫稿很厲害，是我們報社的金筆。
examples.english_sentence: He writes very well; he's the paper's star columnist.

mandarin_meaning: 金箔（薄金片，用於鎏金、裝飾或食品點綴）
english_meaning: gold leaf / gold foil (very thin sheets of gold used for gilding, decoration, or as edible decoration)
explanation_mandarin: 由純金或鍍金金屬製成的極薄片，常用於宗教神像鎏金、建築或工藝裝飾，以及高級糕點的點綴。
explanation_english: A very thin sheet of gold (or gold-plated metal) used for gilding statues, architectural and craft decoration, and as an ornamental edible garnish on high-end foods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面啲神像上面貼咗金箔，閃閃發亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 di1 san4 zoeng6 soeng6 min6 tip3 zo2 gam1 bok3, sim2 sim2 faat3 loeng6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庙里的神像上贴着金箔，闪闪发亮。
examples.english_sentence: The temple's statues are covered with gold leaf and sparkle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕鋪咗一層金箔，好高級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 pou1 zo2 jat1 cang4 gam1 bok3, hou2 gou1 kap1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕铺了一层金箔，很高级。
examples.english_sentence: This cake is topped with a layer of gold leaf — very luxurious.

mandarin_meaning: 香港金融管理局
english_meaning: Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA)
explanation_mandarin: 香港金融管理局（HKMA），負責香港的貨幣政策、銀行監管、外匯儲備及維護金融穩定。
explanation_english: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA), the institution responsible for monetary matters, banking supervision, foreign exchange reserves, and maintaining financial stability in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金管局宣布加息，以應對通脹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gun2 guk6 seon3 bou3 gaa1 sik1, ji5 jing3 deoi3 tung1 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金管局宣布加息，以應對通脹。
examples.english_sentence: The HKMA announced a rate hike to deal with inflation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果銀行出現流動性問題，金管局會介入協助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngan4 hong4 ceot1 jin6 lau4 dung6 sing3 man6 tai4, gam1 gun2 guk6 wui5 gaai3 jap6 hip3 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果銀行出現流動性問題，金管局會介入協助。
examples.english_sentence: If a bank faces liquidity problems, the HKMA will intervene to provide assistance.

mandarin_meaning: 金丝猫（字面）；引申為愛慕虛榮、注重名牌與物質享受的人（通常指女性，帶貶義）
english_meaning: Literally "golden-thread cat"; Cantonese slang for a person (usually a woman) who is ostentatious, materialistic, and fond of designer brands (derogatory).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容外表華麗、愛慕虛榮、重視名牌與物質享受的人，常帶貶義，用法多指女性或刻意打扮的人。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang describing someone who shows off wealth or fashion—materialistic and fond of designer labels. Often used pejoratively and commonly refers to women or people who deliberately dress ostentatiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮金絲貓，成日買名牌袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 baan6 gam1 si1 maau1, sing4 jat6 maai5 ming4 paai4 daai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她老是裝作金絲貓，總是買名牌包。
examples.english_sentence: She always acts like a "golden-cat" — always buying designer bags.

mandarin_meaning: 金丝雀；（俚语）被供養的女子、靠他人生活的“保養女/花瓶”
english_meaning: canary; (slang) a kept woman or 'trophy' partner who is financially supported and often pampered
explanation_mandarin: 原指一種小鳥（金絲雀）；在口語或俚語中常用來形容被富有伴侶或他人供養、生活被安排、主要作為陪伴或裝飾的女子，含有被動受制或失去自由的貶義。
explanation_english: Literally a canary (a small bird). Colloquially used to describe a woman who is financially supported or kept by a partner, often pampered but with limited independence — similar to 'kept woman' or 'trophy girlfriend.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀個男人養，完全唔使做嘢，大家都話佢係金絲雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 naam4 jan4 joeng5, jyun4 cyun4 m4 sai2 zou6 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 gam1 si1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被男人養著，完全不用工作，大家都說她是金絲雀。
examples.english_sentence: She is kept by a man and doesn't need to work at all; everyone calls her a 'golden canary' (a kept woman).

mandarin_meaning: 金脚链；脚踝上的金饰
english_meaning: gold anklet; a gold piece of jewelry worn around the ankle
explanation_mandarin: 指戴在腳踝上的金質飾品，即金制的腳鏈或腳鐲。在廣東話語境中常見於婚嫁或慶祝場合，象徵富貴或吉祥。
explanation_english: A piece of gold jewelry worn around the ankle (a gold anklet). In Cantonese-speaking contexts it is often seen at weddings or celebrations and can symbolize wealth or good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿妹生日，我送咗條金腳帶畀佢做禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 mui6 saang1 jat6, ngo5 sung3 zo2 tiu4 gam1 goek3 daai3 bei2 keoi5 zou6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妹妹生日，我送了一条金脚链给她作为礼物。
examples.english_sentence: For my sister's birthday, I gave her a gold anklet as a gift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚嗰陣，新娘會戴金腳帶表示富貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 go2 zan6, san1 noeng4 wui5 daai3 gam1 goek3 daai3 biu2 si6 fu3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚的时候，新娘会戴金脚链以示富贵。
examples.english_sentence: At weddings, brides may wear gold anklets to signify wealth.

mandarin_meaning: 金店；售賣金飾或珠寶的店鋪
english_meaning: gold shop; jewellery store that sells gold items
explanation_mandarin: 指專門出售金飾、黃金器物或珠寶的店舖，常見於購物區或市街，亦可泛指以金器交易為主的商店。
explanation_english: A shop that specializes in selling gold jewelry, gold items, or related jewelry; commonly found in shopping districts and often refers to stores focused on gold merchandise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去金舖買隻金戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 gam1 pou3 maai5 zek3 gam1 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去金店買一枚金戒指。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the gold shop to buy a gold ring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺金舖做銷售員，識好多款式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam1 pou3 zou6 siu1 sau6 jyun4, sik1 hou2 do1 fun2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在金店做銷售員，熟悉很多款式。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a salesperson at a jewelry shop and knows many designs.

mandarin_meaning: 金色（jīnsè）——像黄金的颜色，金黄色
english_meaning: golden; gold-colored
explanation_mandarin: 表示像黃金的顏色，也可引申為華麗、富貴或閃亮的感覺，用於描述顏色或裝飾風格。
explanation_english: Describes the color of gold; can also imply a luxurious, rich, or shiny appearance. Used for colors or decorative styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係金色，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 gam1 sik1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是金色的，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is gold-colored and very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅布置多用金色同紅色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 bou3 zi3 do1 jung6 gam1 sik1 tung4 hung4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的布置多用金色和红色。
examples.english_sentence: New Year decorations often use gold and red.

mandarin_meaning: 金针菇（通常口语简称）
english_meaning: enoki mushroom (colloquial name)
explanation_mandarin: 「金菇」是粵語中對金针菇（学名：金针菇，Enoki mushroom）的口語简称，常用于火鍋、湯或快炒等菜式中。
explanation_english: “金菇” is a Cantonese colloquial name for enoki mushrooms (Flammulina velutipes). Commonly used in hotpot, soups, and stir-fries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚煮火鍋，要買啲金菇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zyu2 fo2 wo1, jiu3 maai5 di1 gam1 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚煮火锅，要买些金针菇。
examples.english_sentence: We're making hotpot tonight; we need to buy some enoki mushrooms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金菇好易吸湯，放落去好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gu1 hou2 ji6 kap1 tong1, fong3 lok6 heoi3 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金针菇很容易吸汤，放进去很有味道。
examples.english_sentence: Enoki mushrooms soak up the broth easily and add great flavor.

mandarin_meaning: 金华火腿 (Jīn huá huǒ tuǐ) — 一种产自浙江金华的传统腌制干火腿。
english_meaning: Jinhua ham — a dry‑cured ham from Jinhua, Zhejiang, used in Chinese cuisine for soups, braises, stir‑fries and as a flavoring ingredient.
explanation_mandarin: 金华火腿是浙江金华地区的传统干制火腿，经过腌制、风干和短期发酵，味道咸香鲜美，常用于煲汤、炖菜、炒饭或切片直接食用，也是中国烹饪中的重要风味材料。
explanation_english: Jinhua ham is a traditional dry‑cured ham from Jinhua in Zhejiang province. It is made by salting, air‑drying and brief fermentation, producing a savory, umami flavor. It is commonly used to flavor soups, stews, fried rice, or served sliced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋食金華火腿炒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 sik6 gam1 waa4 fo2 teoi2 caau2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃金华火腿炒饭。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight we're having Jinhua ham fried rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有塊金華火腿，用嚟煲湯好夠味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 faai3 gam1 waa4 fo2 teoi2, jung6 lai4 bou1 tong1 hou2 gau3 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里面有一块金华火腿，用来煲汤很有味道。
examples.english_sentence: There's a piece of Jinhua ham in the kitchen; it adds great flavor to soups.

synonyms: 金华火腿 (Jīn huá huǒ tuǐ)

mandarin_meaning: 金兰姐妹（指结拜或关系非常亲密、像姐妹一样的女性朋友）
english_meaning: sworn sisters; women who are extremely close friends with a sister-like bond
explanation_mandarin: 指关系非常亲密、感情深厚的女性朋友，常用于形容结拜或情同手足的姐妹关系。
explanation_english: Refers to women who share an extremely close, sister-like friendship—often sworn sisters or friends who consider each other as close as family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個由細就係金蘭姊妹，無論開心定唔開心都會支持對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jau4 sai3 zau6 hai6 gam1 laan4 ze2 mui6, mou4 leon6 hoi1 sam1 ding6 m4 hoi1 sam1 dou1 wui5 zi1 ci4 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两个从小就是金兰姐妹，无论开心还是不开心都会支持对方。
examples.english_sentence: They've been sworn sisters since childhood; whether happy or sad they always support each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢請咗佢啲金蘭姊妹做婚禮嘅伴娘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceng2 zo2 keoi5 di1 gam1 laan4 ze2 mui6 zou6 fan1 lai5 ge3 bun6 noeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她请了她的金兰姐妹当婚礼的伴娘。
examples.english_sentence: She invited her sworn sisters to be bridesmaids at the wedding.

mandarin_meaning: 金蛇郎君（字面：金色的蛇之郎君）——常作為外號或雅稱，尤其出現在武俠小說、戲曲或流行文化中，用來指稱行蹤、武藝或氣質獨特的男性人物。
english_meaning: “Golden Snake Young Lord” — an epithet or nickname (literally 'golden snake young lord') used in wuxia fiction, opera, or popular culture to refer to a dashing, skilled, or exotic male figure.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（專有名詞 / 綽號）
explanation_mandarin: 一個帶有文學與戲劇色彩的稱呼，常見於武俠小說或戲曲中，既可表示人物武藝高強，也可帶有浪漫、神秘或戲謔的意味，通常作為人物的外號或雅稱。
explanation_english: A literary/dramatic epithet often seen in wuxia novels or opera. It can connote a character's martial prowess, enigmatic or alluring qualities, and is typically used as a nickname or honorific with romanticized or playful overtones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人稱為金蛇郎君，喺武俠小說圈好有名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 cing1 wai4 gam1 se4 long4 gwan1, hai2 mou5 hap6 siu2 seot3 hyun1 hou2 jau5 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被稱為金蛇郎君，在武俠小說界很有名。
examples.english_sentence: He is called 'Golden Snake Young Lord' and is very famous in the world of wuxia fiction.

mandarin_meaning: 金融 (jīnróng)：与货币、银行、投资、保险等有关的经济活动与体系。
english_meaning: Finance; matters related to money, banking, investment, insurance, and financial services.
explanation_mandarin: 指涉及資金流動、金融機構、金融市場以及相關金融產品和服務的經濟領域與活動。
explanation_english: Refers to the economic field and activities involving the flow of funds, financial institutions, markets, and related financial products and services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅金融業好發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gam1 jung4 jip6 hou2 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的金融業很發達。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's financial industry is very developed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺銀行做金融分析師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngan4 hong4 zou6 gam1 jung4 fan1 sik1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在銀行做金融分析師。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a financial analyst at a bank.

mandarin_meaning: 金蝉脱壳
english_meaning: to escape by deception/diversion; to make a narrow escape
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用假象或計策掩護自己脫身，逃避追查或責任，像蟬脫下殼子離開一樣。
explanation_english: A figurative idiom meaning to escape or evade responsibility/pursuit by using deception or a diversion, like a cicada shedding its shell and flying away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用金蟬脫殼嘅伎倆，成功脫身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gam1 sim4 tyut3 hok3 ge3 gei6 loeng6, sing4 gung1 tok3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用金蝉脱壳的伎俩，成功脱身。
examples.english_sentence: He used the 'golden cicada shedding its shell' trick and managed to get away.

mandarin_meaning: 金蝉脱壳
english_meaning: to escape by a ruse; to leave a decoy or diversion to mislead pursuers
explanation_mandarin: 原指蝉脱去旧壳，后来比喻用计谋或假象迷惑对方，从而逃脱或脱身。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a cicada leaving its old shell; metaphorically, it means to escape or extricate oneself by using a ruse, diversion, or decoy to mislead pursuers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用金蟬脫殼嘅招數，偷咗啲款之後就易咗身份走佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gam1 sim4 tyut3 hok3 ge3 ziu1 sou3, tau1 zo2 di1 fun2 zi1 hau6 zau6 ji6 zo2 san1 fan6 zau2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用金蝉脱壳的伎俩，偷了些款項之後就改了身份逃走。
examples.english_sentence: He used a 'golden cicada sheds its shell' trick — after embezzling some funds he changed his identity and fled.

mandarin_meaning: 金猪；象徵財運的吉祥物；也可指突然發財的人或出生於金豬年的人
english_meaning: Golden pig — a lucky/wealth symbol; can refer to someone who suddenly comes into wealth or someone born in a 'Golden Pig' year
explanation_mandarin: 「金豬」字面上指金色的豬，常作為農曆新年或招財擺設的吉祥物。在口語中也可作俚語，指突然發大財的人，或指屬於「金豬年」出生的人（結合生肖與五行）。
explanation_english: Literally 'golden pig'. Commonly a lucky/wealth charm used during Lunar New Year. Colloquially it can mean someone who has come into sudden wealth or someone born in the 'Golden Pig' year (zodiac + element).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企擺咗個金豬，希望新一年有好運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 baai2 zo2 go3 gam1 zyu1, hei1 mong6 san1 jat1 nin4 jau5 hou2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡擺了一個金豬，希望新的一年有好運。
examples.english_sentence: We put a golden pig at home, hoping for good luck in the new year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗大獎，依家真係變咗個金豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 zo2 daai6 zoeng2, ji1 gaa1 zan1 hai6 bin3 zo2 go3 gam1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了大獎，現在真的變成了個金豬（發了大財）。
examples.english_sentence: He won the jackpot and really became a 'golden pig' (i.e., very rich).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係金豬年出世，人哋成日話佢好有運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 zyu1 nin4 ceot1 saang1, jan4 dei6 sing4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 hou2 jau5 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是金猪年出生，人們常說他很有運氣。
examples.english_sentence: He was born in the Year of the Golden Pig; people often say he's lucky.

mandarin_meaning: 金边（柬埔寨首都）
english_meaning: Phnom Penh (capital city of Cambodia)
explanation_mandarin: 指柬埔寨的首都金边，為一個城市名稱，常用作地名或指涉相關地區與事務。
explanation_english: Refers to Phnom Penh, the capital city of Cambodia. Used as a place name to denote the city or related matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會去金邊旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 gam1 bin1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天會去金边旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Phnom Penh tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 金邊（柬埔寨首都）風味的米粉；指源自或模仿柬埔寨金邊的米粉菜餚
english_meaning: Phnom Penh-style rice noodles; a rice noodle dish associated with Phnom Penh, Cambodia
explanation_mandarin: 「金邊粉」通常指源自或受金邊（柬埔寨）影響的米粉料理。在香港的餐館或小吃店菜單上，有時會用此名稱標示帶有金邊／柬埔寨風味的米粉湯或炒粉。
explanation_english: “金邊粉” refers to rice noodles in the style of Phnom Penh, Cambodia. On menus in Hong Kong and elsewhere it can denote a Cambodian-style rice noodle soup or stir-fried rice noodle dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間小食店嘅金邊粉好出名，湯底香而且唔太鹹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 siu2 sik6 dim3 ge3 gam1 bin1 fan2 hou2 ceot1 ming4, tong1 dai2 hoeng1 ji4 ce2 m4 taai3 haam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家小吃店的金邊粉很有名，湯底香，而且不太鹹。
examples.english_sentence: The Phnom Penh rice noodles at this snack shop are famous; the broth is flavorful and not too salty.

mandarin_meaning: 金针 (jīnzhēn) — 常指金针花/金针菜（干燥的百合科花蕾，食材），也可指金色的针或比喻用法
english_meaning: golden needle — commonly refers to dried daylily buds used in cooking (also called lily flowers or 'golden needles'); literally 'golden needle' (can refer to a needle or be used figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 「金针」通常指可食用的金针花或晒乾的花蕾，常用作煲湯、炒菜或配料；在字面上也可指「金色的针」或在特定语境下作比喻。
explanation_english: Usually refers to the edible daylily buds (dried lily flowers) used in soups, stir-fries, and other dishes. Literally it can mean a 'golden needle' and may appear in other contexts metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚用金針煲湯，好滋味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jung6 gam1 zam1 bou1 tong1, hou2 zi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚用金针煲汤，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm using (dried) golden needles to make soup tonight — it's delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有金針賣，但金針同金針菇係唔同嘅食材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 gam1 zam1 maai6, daan6 gam1 zam1 tung4 gam1 zam1 gu1 hai6 m4 tung4 ge3 sik6 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有金针卖，但金针和金针菇是不同的食材。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells 'jinzhen', but jinzhen and enoki mushrooms are different ingredients.

mandarin_meaning: 金针菇 (一种细长的可食用蘑菇)
english_meaning: enoki mushroom (enokitake)
explanation_mandarin: 一種細長、白色或米色的食用菇類，常用於火鍋、湯和拌炒等料理，口感爽脆。
explanation_english: A long, thin, white or light-colored edible mushroom (enoki/enokitake), commonly used in hot pot, soups, and stir-fries; it has a crisp texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚煮火鍋，買咗啲金針菇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 zyu2 fo2 wo1, maai5 zo2 di1 gam1 zam1 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚煮火锅，买了些金针菇。
examples.english_sentence: I'm making hot pot tonight; I bought some enoki mushrooms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲金針菇好新鮮，口感脆脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gam1 zam1 gu1 hou2 san1 sin1, hau2 gam2 ceoi3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些金针菇很新鲜，口感脆脆的。
examples.english_sentence: These enoki mushrooms are fresh and have a crisp texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金針菇唔好煮得太耐，會爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 zam1 gu1 m4 hou2 zyu2 dak1 taai3 noi6, wui5 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金针菇不要煮太久，会烂。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cook enoki mushrooms for too long or they'll get mushy.

mandarin_meaning: 金针菜（通常指干燥的萱草花蕾，也称黄花菜，可作为食材）
english_meaning: daylily (especially dried daylily buds used as a vegetable; also called golden needle or dried lily buds)
explanation_mandarin: 金针菜一般指萱草的花蕾（干燥後稱为金针或黄花菜），常在中式烹饪中使用，如煲汤、炒菜或素食菜肴中。烹調前常需浸軟回水。
explanation_english: Refers to the daylily flower buds (often dried) used as a culinary ingredient. Common in Chinese cooking for soups, stir-fries, and vegetarian dishes; usually rehydrated before cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚買咗啲金針菜，煲湯用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 gam1 zam1 coi3, bou1 tong1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚买了些金针菜，用来煲汤。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some dried daylily buds tonight to use in soup.

mandarin_meaning: 金釵（古代或傳統髮飾，金製髮簪）
english_meaning: gold hairpin (a traditional hair ornament made of gold)
explanation_mandarin: 「金鈪」為較少見或為「金釵」的異體字，指用金屬（通常為金）製作的髮簪或髮插，常作為裝飾品，常見於古裝或傳統服飾中。
explanation_english: “金鈪” is a less common form (often an alternate character for 金釵) referring to a gold hairpin — a traditional hair ornament made of metal, typically used as decorative accessory in historical or traditional dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住一支金鈪，望落好古典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 jat1 zi1 gam1 caai1, mong6 lok6 hou2 gu2 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴着一支金釵，看起來很古典。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a gold hairpin and looks very classical.

mandarin_meaning: 有利可圖；賺錢、發財
english_meaning: lucrative; profitable; able to make money
explanation_mandarin: 口語說法，用來形容某件事、某行業或生意可以帶來不少金錢利益，頗為賺錢。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing something (a business, deal, or activity) that brings in considerable money or profit — i.e., lucrative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢舖生意好好，真係金銀潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pou3 sang1 ji3 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 gam1 ngan4 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家店生意很好，真的很有利可圖。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's business is doing very well — it's really lucrative.

mandarin_meaning: 金银财宝；财富、钱财
english_meaning: riches; wealth; money and valuables
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來指代金錢或貴重財物，常用來形容富有或談論財產。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to money and valuables; used to denote wealth or valuable possessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講自己有金銀膶，實際上冇乜錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 zi6 gei2 jau5 gam1 ngan4 lon6, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 mat1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老說自己有金银膶，实际上没多少钱。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying he has riches, but in reality he doesn't have much money.

mandarin_meaning: 金银花 (jīnyínhuā)
english_meaning: honeysuckle (a plant used in traditional Chinese medicine and herbal tea)
explanation_mandarin: 金银花为忍冬科植物的花朵，常用于中药和草本茶，具有清热解毒、消炎的功效。
explanation_english: The flowers of the honeysuckle plant (Lonicera), commonly used in traditional Chinese medicine and herbal teas for clearing heat, detoxifying, and reducing inflammation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚用金銀花煲水，俾啲喉嚨痛嘅朋友飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jung6 gam1 ngan4 faa1 bou1 seoi2, bei2 di1 hau4 lung4 tung3 ge3 pang4 jau5 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚用金银花煮水，给喉咙痛的朋友喝。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I brewed honeysuckle water for my friend who has a sore throat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金銀花屬於一種中藥，常用嚟清熱解毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ngan4 faa1 suk6 jyu1 jat1 zung2 zung1 joek6, soeng4 jung6 lei4 cing1 jit6 gaai2 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金银花属于一种中药，常用于清热解毒。
examples.english_sentence: Honeysuckle is a type of traditional Chinese medicine commonly used to clear heat and detoxify.

mandarin_meaning: 金钱、财物
english_meaning: money and material possessions; material wealth
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指金錢與物質財產，常用來形容為了物質利益而行事或追求利益。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase referring to money and material possessions; often used to describe acting or pursuing things for material gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗金銀衣紙，乜嘢都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gam1 ngan4 ji1 zi2, mat1 je5 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了金錢財物，什麼都做得出。
examples.english_sentence: He would do anything for money and possessions.

mandarin_meaning: 各式各樣／各色人等／各種東西
english_meaning: all sorts; every kind (of people or things)
explanation_mandarin: 由多種金屬名組成的俗語，用來表示各種各樣的人或事物，含義接近「各式各樣」或「各色人等」。通常用於口語。
explanation_english: A colloquial phrase literally listing metals; used to mean all kinds or every variety of people or things — similar to 'all sorts' or 'people from every walk of life.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去街市睇下，金銀銅鐵錫都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 gaai1 si5 tai2 haa5, gam1 ngan4 tung4 tit3 sek3 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去市場看看，各種人都有。
examples.english_sentence: Go check the market — you'll find all sorts of people there.

mandarin_meaning: 金店；賣黃金或珠寶的店
english_meaning: gold shop; jewelry shop (a store that sells or buys gold and jewelry)
explanation_mandarin: 指專門買賣黃金、首飾或珠寶的商店，香港口語常用「金鋪」來稱呼賣金飾或回收舊金的店舖。注意與「當舖」（pawnshop）不同，當舖主要做質押借款。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop that sells or buys gold and jewelry. In Cantonese, '金鋪' commonly denotes stores that sell gold ornaments or purchase old gold. It is distinct from a pawnshop ('當舖'), which provides pawn loans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去嗰間金鋪買結婚戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 go2 gaan1 gam1 pou3 maai5 git3 fan1 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去那間金店買結婚戒指。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to that gold shop to buy wedding rings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲舊金賣咗畀金鋪換現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 gau6 gam1 maai6 zo2 bei2 gam1 pou3 wun6 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把舊金賣給金店換現金。
examples.english_sentence: He sold his old gold to the gold shop to get cash.

mandarin_meaning: 金钱 (jīn qián)；指貨幣或財富
english_meaning: money; funds; currency
explanation_mandarin: 指用作交易、購買或衡量價值的貨幣或財富，也泛指金錢相關的資源。
explanation_english: Refers to money or wealth used for transactions, purchases, or as a measure of value; generally denotes monetary resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 金錢唔係人生最緊要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 cin2 m4 hai6 jan4 sang1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 金钱不是人生最重要的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Money isn't the most important thing in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗賺金錢，佢日日加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zaan6 gam1 cin2, keoi5 jat6 jat6 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赚钱，他每天都加班。
examples.english_sentence: To earn money, he works overtime every day.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）小肚腩、突出的肚子；在某些地區亦可指作為食材的動物肚部（區域性用法）
english_meaning: potbelly; paunch (colloquial); regionally can also refer to edible stomach of an animal used in Cantonese cuisine
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，通常用來形容腹部突出、長出小肚腩的情況，語氣可帶玩笑或親暱。有時在飲食語境中可指某些用作菜餚的肚類（如豬/牛肚），屬區域性用法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a protruding belly (potbelly/paunch), often used jokingly or affectionately. In some regional culinary contexts it can also refer to stomach (tripe) used as food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日食宵夜，搞到有個金錢肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 sik6 siu1 je6, gaau2 dou3 jau5 go3 gam1 cin4 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近经常吃宵夜，結果長了個小肚腩。
