explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to chat or talk for a long time. It often implies spending a lot of time chatting (sometimes with a complaint that someone talks too much or wastes time).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日長傾電話，工作做唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 coeng4 king1 din6 waa2, gung1 zok3 zou6 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們經常長時間打電話聊天，工作忙不過來。
examples.english_sentence: We always talk on the phone for ages and can't keep up with work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話佢喺公司度長傾，影響生產力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 coeng4 king1, jing2 hoeng2 sang1 caan2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆說他在公司裡一直聊天，影響了生產力。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he's always chatting at the office and it's affecting productivity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺茶餐廳傾咗成晚，真係長傾唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 king1 zo2 sing4 maan5, zan1 hai6 coeng4 king1 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在茶餐廳聊了一整晚，真是聊個不停。
examples.english_sentence: We talked at the cafe all evening; we really couldn't stop chatting.

mandarin_meaning: 长凳；长椅
english_meaning: bench (long bench for multiple people)
explanation_mandarin: 指供多人坐的长型凳子，常见于公园、广场或其他公共场所。
explanation_english: A long bench designed for multiple people to sit on, commonly found in parks, plazas, and other public spaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有好多長凳，大家可以坐低休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 coeng4 dang3, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 co5 dai1 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里有很多长凳，大家可以坐下休息。
examples.english_sentence: There are many benches in the park; everyone can sit down and rest.

mandarin_meaning: 长出；长出来
english_meaning: to grow out; to sprout; to emerge
explanation_mandarin: 表示从某物表面或体内生长出来的动作，例如头发、芽、指甲长出来；也可引申为某事物逐渐出现或产生。
explanation_english: Indicates something growing out from a surface or body (e.g., hair, buds, nails); can also be used figuratively for something that emerges or appears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲頭髮長出咗好多白髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tau4 faat3 coeng4 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 baak6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的头发长出了很多白发。
examples.english_sentence: His hair has grown a lot of white hairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天，樹上長出咗好多新芽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1, syu6 soeng6 coeng4 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天，树上长出了很多新芽。
examples.english_sentence: In spring, many new buds sprout on the trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲指甲長出咗，應該剪返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 zi2 gaap3 coeng4 ceot1 zo2, jing1 goi1 zin2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的指甲长出来了，应该剪掉。
examples.english_sentence: My nails have grown out; I should cut them.

mandarin_meaning: 长周末（延长的周末，通常因公共假期或调休而形成）
english_meaning: long weekend (a weekend extended by an extra day or public holiday)
explanation_mandarin: 指由於遇上公眾假期或調休，而使週末延長，多出一日或多日休息的情況。例如週五或週一放假，形成一個較長的週末。
explanation_english: Refers to a weekend extended by an extra day or days, often because of a public holiday or adjusted work schedule (e.g., having Friday or Monday off, creating a longer weekend).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個長周末我哋去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 coeng4 zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个长周末我们去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a trip this long weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為放埋一日假，呢個禮拜有個長周末。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 fong3 maai4 jat1 jat6 gaa3, ni1 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 go3 coeng4 zau1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为多放了一天假，这个礼拜有个长周末。
examples.english_sentence: Because we have an extra day off, there's a long weekend this week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排咗一個長周末俾員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ngon1 paai4 zo2 jat1 go3 coeng4 zau1 mut6 bei2 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给员工安排了一个长周末。
examples.english_sentence: The company arranged a long weekend for the employees.

mandarin_meaning: 长命（長壽；活得久）
english_meaning: long-lived; to have a long life; longevity
explanation_mandarin: 表示长寿、活得久。常用作祝福语（如“长命百岁”），也可用来描述某人寿命长。
explanation_english: Indicates longevity or living a long life. Often used as a blessing (e.g. "live to a hundred") or as a descriptive adjective for someone who lives long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你長命百歲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 coeng4 ming6 baak3 seoi3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你长命百岁！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a long life (may you live to a hundred)!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身體好，應該可以長命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 tai2 hou2, jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 coeng4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身体好，应该可以长命。
examples.english_sentence: He has good health; he should live a long life.

jyutping: coeng4 ming6 zaai3 coeng4 ming6 waan4
mandarin_meaning: 有因必有果／善惡有報（俗語）
english_meaning: What goes around comes around; people will eventually reap what they sow (karma).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面意思是「長壽的債要用長壽來還」，引申為因果報應的觀念：做了的事遲早會有相應的結果，善有善報、惡有惡報。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb literally meaning "a long-life debt is repaid with a long life." It refers to the idea of karmic retribution: actions will eventually bring corresponding consequences — people will get what they deserve in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日欺負人，長命債長命還，遲早會還返畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hei1 fu6 jan4, coeng4 ming6 zaai3 coeng4 ming6 waan4, ci4 zou2 wui5 waan4 faan1 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是欺负别人，長命債長命還，迟早会还给你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep bullying others — what goes around comes around; sooner or later it will come back to you.

mandarin_meaning: 結婚證／婚姻登記證（俗稱）
english_meaning: marriage certificate (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱，字面為「長命契」，用來指結婚時領取的結婚證或婚姻登記文件，帶有幽默或戲稱的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning "long-life contract," used jokingly or informally to refer to the marriage certificate or official marriage registration document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今日去民政處攞長命契。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 man4 zing3 cyu3 lo2 coeng4 ming6 kai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們今天去民政事務處領結婚證。
examples.english_sentence: They went to the marriage registry today to get their marriage certificate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋開個小派對慶祝簽咗長命契。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoi1 go3 siu2 paai3 deoi6 hing3 zuk1 cim1 zo2 coeng4 ming6 kai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們辦了個小派對慶祝領了結婚證。
examples.english_sentence: They had a small party to celebrate getting their marriage certificate.

jyutping: coeng4 ming6 gung1 fu1 coeng4 ming6 zou6
mandarin_meaning: 要有耐心、以長久打算來做事情（不要急於求成）
english_meaning: A proverb advising patience and taking the long view — things that last require time and steady effort.
explanation_mandarin: 這句廣東話俗語用來提醒人做事要有耐性、按長期計劃來做，慢工出細活，不要急躁追求短期成果。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb reminding people to be patient and think long-term: durable or good results take time and steady work, so don't rush for quick gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔好心急，長命工夫長命做，慢慢嚟先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2 sam1 gap1, coeng4 ming6 gung1 fu1 coeng4 ming6 zou6, maan6 maan6 lai4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不要心急，長命工夫長命做，慢慢來才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush doing business; take the long view — things that last take time; go slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 長壽；活得久
english_meaning: long-lived; longevity; to live a long life
explanation_mandarin: 「長命斜」是粵語俗語或口語表達，表示某人長壽或有福氣可以活很久，常用來稱讚老人長壽或祝願人健康長命。
explanation_english: “長命斜” is a Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone is long-lived or has longevity. It’s often used to praise an elderly person's long life or to wish someone continued health and a long life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿伯真係長命斜，已經九十三歲仲好健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 baak3 zan1 hai6 coeng4 ming6 ce4, ji5 ging1 gau2 sap6 saam1 seoi3 zung6 hou2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我伯父真是長壽，已經九十三歲還很健康。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle is really long-lived; he's already 93 and still very healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁早訓、飲食有節制，應該會長命斜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou2 fan3, jam2 sik6 jau5 zit3 zai3, jing1 goi1 wui5 coeng4 ming6 ce4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼早睡、飲食有節制，應該會長壽。
examples.english_sentence: You go to bed so early and eat with restraint; you should live a long life.

mandarin_meaning: 长命百岁（长寿，祝人长寿的祝福）
english_meaning: Live to a hundred years; a wish for long life and good health
explanation_mandarin: 表示祝願對方長壽、健康，常用於賀壽或祝福場合。
explanation_english: A traditional blessing wishing someone a long life and good health; commonly used in birthday greetings or auspicious occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你長命百歲，身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 coeng4 ming6 baak3 seoi3, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你长命百岁，身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you a long life and good health.

mandarin_meaning: 綿綿細雨 / 持續下的毛毛雨
english_meaning: persistent drizzle; light rain that lasts a long time
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容持續不斷、細密而綿長的雨，類似普通話的「綿綿細雨」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing a light, continuous rain or drizzle that lasts for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日成日落長命雨，出街記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 lok6 coeng4 ming6 jyu5, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天整天都在下綿綿細雨，出門記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: It's been drizzling all day today—remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 指李嘉誠旗下或與長江和記相關的企業集團
english_meaning: The Cheung Kong & Hutchison corporate group (companies affiliated with Li Ka-shing)
explanation_mandarin: 「長和系」是香港口語和媒體常用的稱呼，指長江實業、和記等相關或屬於李嘉誠旗下的企業體系。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong term referring to the corporate group centered on Cheung Kong and Hutchison (companies affiliated with Li Ka-shing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺長和系做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 coeng4 wo4 hai6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在長和系工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently working at the Cheung Kong & Hutchison group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞話長和系又收購咗一間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 mun4 waa6 coeng4 wo4 hai6 jau6 sau1 gou3 zo2 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞說長和系又收購了一間公司。
examples.english_sentence: The news said the CK Hutchison group acquired another company.

mandarin_meaning: 長吁短嘆（不停地嘆息、感嘆或抱怨）
english_meaning: to sigh repeatedly; to lament or express sorrow and regret
explanation_mandarin: 形容不停地長嘆短嘆、感嘆或抱怨，多用來表示傷感、無奈或惋惜的情緒。
explanation_english: Describes repeatedly sighing and lamenting; used to express sadness, resignation, or regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失業之後，佢日日長嗟短嘆，唔想面對現實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jat6 jat6 coeng4 ze1 dyun2 taan3, m4 soeng2 min6 deoi3 jin6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失业之后，他整天长吁短叹，不想面对现实。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job, he sighed and lamented all day, unwilling to face reality.

mandarin_meaning: 長吁短嘆（长吁短叹），形容反覆歎氣，表示悲傷、惋惜或無奈。
english_meaning: to sigh repeatedly; to heave long and short sighs — used to express sorrow, regret, or helplessness.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人不停地歎氣，通常表示心情沉重、感到惋惜或無可奈何。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone sighing over and over, usually conveying heaviness of heart, regret, or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從被公司裁員後，阿強成日長嗟短歎，對前路冇乜信心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 bei6 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 hau6, aa3 koeng4 sing4 jat6 coeng4 ze1 dyun2 taan3, deoi3 cin4 lou6 mou5 mat1 seon3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從被公司裁員後，阿強整天長吁短嘆，對前途沒有什麼信心。
examples.english_sentence: Since being laid off by the company, Ah Keung has been sighing constantly and has little confidence about the future.

mandarin_meaning: 被埋葬；長眠（口語、俗語用法），引申為「永遠消失／不要再提」
english_meaning: to be buried; to lie in eternal rest (colloquial/slang); can figuratively mean 'to disappear forever' or 'to let something/someone be'
explanation_mandarin: 「長埋」是廣東話口語／俗語用法，通常指被埋葬、長眠，亦可引申為某人或某事物永遠消失或不再提起。用法多見於口語、地方俗語或非正式語境。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "長埋" is a colloquial/slang expression typically meaning to be buried or to lie in eternal rest. It can also be used figuratively to mean that someone or something has disappeared for good or should be left alone. Common in informal speech and regional usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺幾年前過身，宜家長埋喺鄉下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je5 gei2 nin4 cin4 gwo3 san1, ji4 gaa1 coeng4 maai4 hai2 hoeng1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他祖父幾年前過世了，現在葬在鄉下。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather passed away several years ago; he is buried in the countryside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔好再講啦，算啦，長埋佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3, syun3 laa3, coeng4 maai4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事不要再說了，算了，就讓它過去吧（別再提了）。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring this up again. Forget it — let it be.

mandarin_meaning: 长城（Chángchéng），通常指中国的万里长城或一般意义上的防御性长墙
english_meaning: The Great Wall (of China); a long defensive wall
explanation_mandarin: 长城主要指中国古代在北方修筑的防御性长城，尤指“万里长城”，是重要的历史遗迹与世界文化遗产。
explanation_english: Refers primarily to the Great Wall of China, an ancient series of defensive walls built in northern China; an important historical monument and UNESCO World Heritage site.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月去北京旅遊，想去參觀長城。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 bak1 ging1 leoi5 jau4, soeng2 heoi3 caam1 gun1 coeng4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月去北京旅游，想去参观长城。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Beijing next month and want to visit the Great Wall.

mandarin_meaning: 长寿
english_meaning: longevity; long life; long-lived
explanation_mandarin: 表示活得壽命長、年歲高。也常用作祝福語，祝願他人長命百歲、身體健康。
explanation_english: Refers to living a long life or having a long lifespan. Often used as a blessing to wish someone long life and good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你長壽，身體健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 coeng4 sau6, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你长寿，身体健康。
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you longevity and good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長壽係好多人人追求嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 sau6 hai6 hou2 do1 jan4 zeoi1 kau4 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长寿是很多人追求的目标。
examples.english_sentence: Longevity is a goal many people pursue.

mandarin_meaning: 长寿香（用于祈求长寿的香）
english_meaning: longevity incense (incense burned to pray for long life)
explanation_mandarin: 指在廟宇或宗教／民間祭祀場合使用、祈求長命百歲或保佑健康長壽的香，通常較長或特別標示為「長壽」用途。
explanation_english: Refers to incense used in temples or ritual settings to pray for long life or to bless someone's longevity; often longer-burning or labeled for longevity purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面有長壽香，大家上香祈求長命百歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 jau5 coeng4 sau6 hoeng1, daai6 gaa1 soeng5 hoeng1 kei4 kau4 coeng4 ming6 baak3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡供著長壽香，大家上香祈求長命百歲。
examples.english_sentence: The temple offers longevity incense; everyone burns incense to pray for a long life.

mandarin_meaning: 长寿面 (chángshòu miàn)
english_meaning: longevity noodles (noodles eaten to wish someone a long life, often on birthdays)
explanation_mandarin: 長壽麪指在生日或其他祝壽場合食用的麵條，寓意祝賀壽命長久。是一種具有文化和吉祥象徵意義的食品。
explanation_english: Longevity noodles are noodles eaten on birthdays or celebratory occasions to symbolize wishes for a long life. They carry cultural and auspicious meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生日嗰日我哋會食長壽麪，代表祝福長命百歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sang1 jat6 go2 jat6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 sik6 coeng4 sau6 min6, doi6 biu2 zuk1 fuk1 coeng4 ming4 baak3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生日那天我们会吃长寿面，代表祝福长命百岁。
examples.english_sentence: On birthdays we eat longevity noodles, which represent wishes for a long life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽整咗碗長壽麪畀我，話要保佑我健康長壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zing2 zo2 wun2 coeng4 sau6 min6 bei2 ngo5, waa6 jiu3 bou2 jau6 ngo5 gin6 hong1 coeng4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈给我做了一碗长寿面，说要保佑我健康长寿。
examples.english_sentence: Mom made me a bowl of longevity noodles, saying it would bless me with health and a long life.

mandarin_meaning: 长寿面（chángshòu miàn）
english_meaning: longevity noodles (long noodles served to wish someone a long life)
explanation_mandarin: 指在生日或祝壽等場合食用的長面條或一道菜，面條通常不切斷，象徵長壽與福祉。
explanation_english: Noodles served at birthdays or longevity celebrations; the long, uncut noodles symbolize long life and good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚幫爸爸買咗長壽麵嚟慶祝佢生日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 bong1 baa4 baa1 maai5 zo2 coeng4 sau6 min6 lai4 hing3 zuk1 keoi5 saang1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚帮爸爸买了长寿面来庆祝他的生日。
examples.english_sentence: I bought longevity noodles for Dad tonight to celebrate his birthday.

mandarin_meaning: 漫長的夜晚；也可引申為艱難或痛苦的漫長時期
english_meaning: a long night; (figurative) a prolonged period of difficulty, suffering, or sorrow
explanation_mandarin: 指時間上延長的夜晚，常用來描述黑夜漫長或難熬的時刻；在比喻義上可表示一段艱難、痛苦或煎熬的時期。
explanation_english: Refers to a prolonged night; often used to describe a literal long or unbearable night. Figuratively, it denotes a long period of hardship, sorrow, or suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰晚真係長夜，我成晚都訓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 maan5 zan1 hai6 coeng4 je6, ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那晚真是漫長的夜晚，我整晚都睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: That night was truly a long night; I couldn't sleep the whole night.

mandarin_meaning: 长大；成长
english_meaning: to grow up; to grow (become bigger or mature)
explanation_mandarin: 表示從小逐漸發育、成熟，變得比較大或成為成年人。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of growing from childhood to a larger size or to maturity (becoming an adult).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺香港長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zoeng2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在香港長大。
examples.english_sentence: I grew up in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋個仔仲未長大，仲係細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 go3 zai2 zung6 mei6 zoeng2 daai6, zung6 hai6 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們的兒子還沒長大，還是小孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Your son hasn't grown up yet; he's still a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢長大之後想做醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng2 daai6 zi1 hau6 soeng2 zou6 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他長大之後想當醫生。
examples.english_sentence: When he grows up, he wants to be a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 长大成人；成为成年人、成熟
english_meaning: to grow up into an adult; to become mature
explanation_mandarin: 表示由小孩長大，成為成年人或趨於成熟，常用於描述人成長或獨立。
explanation_english: Indicates growing up into adulthood or becoming mature; commonly used to describe a person's growth or gaining independence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經長大成人，可以自己做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 zoeng2 daai6 sing4 jan4, ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经长大成人，可以自己做决定。
examples.english_sentence: He has grown up into an adult and can make his own decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 长女
english_meaning: eldest daughter
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭中年紀最大的女孩子，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the eldest daughter in a family; commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅長女，要幫手照顧弟妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 zoeng2 neoi5, jiu3 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 dai6 mui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是家裡的長女，要幫忙照顧弟妹。
examples.english_sentence: She is the eldest daughter in the family and has to help take care of her younger siblings.

mandarin_meaning: 長子（家中年紀或輩分最大的男性子嗣）
english_meaning: eldest son
explanation_mandarin: 指家中年紀或輩分最長的男性子嗣，傳統上常被期望承擔較多家庭責任或繼承事務。
explanation_english: Refers to the eldest male child in a family; traditionally expected to bear greater family responsibilities or inheritance duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅長子，負責照顧弟妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei5 ge3 zoeng2 zi2, fu6 zaak3 ziu3 gu3 dai6 mui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家裡的長子，負責照顧弟妹。
examples.english_sentence: He is the eldest son in the family and is responsible for looking after his younger siblings.

mandarin_meaning: 长子的嫡孙；指嫡系、正统的孙子，常指正统继承人
english_meaning: the eldest son's legitimate son; a legitimate male grandson in the main line (often the rightful heir)
explanation_mandarin: 由「長子」和「嫡孫」組成，指長子一脈之嫡出的孫子，常用於宗法社會表示正統的繼承人或嫡系後嗣。
explanation_english: A compound of 'eldest son' and 'legitimate grandson.' It refers to the eldest son's legitimate male descendant in the main line and is often used in patriarchal contexts to denote the rightful heir.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊日，屋企如果有長子嫡孫，佢就有優先繼承嘅權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 jat6, uk1 kei2 jyu4 gwo2 jau5 zoeng2 zi2 dik6 syun1, keoi5 zau6 jau5 jau1 sin1 gai3 sing4 ge3 kyun4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在舊時，如果家裡有長子嫡孫，他就有優先繼承的權利。
examples.english_sentence: In old times, if a family had an eldest son's legitimate son, he would have priority rights to inherit.

mandarin_meaning: 长存（chángcún）：长久存在，永不消失
english_meaning: to endure; to remain forever; to be everlasting
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或某種記憶、精神長時間存在、不消失，常用於書面或莊重語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that something (e.g., memory, spirit, name) continues to exist for a long time or forever; often used in formal or solemn contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做過嘅好事會長存喺大家心入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gwo3 ge3 hou2 si6 wui5 coeng4 cyun4 hai2 daai6 gaa1 sam1 jap6 min6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做过的好事会长存在大家心里。
examples.english_sentence: The good deeds he did will live on in everyone's hearts.

mandarin_meaning: 长孙
english_meaning: eldest grandson
explanation_mandarin: 指兒子的長子，即孫輩中排行最年長的男孩；常用於家族稱謂或正式場合。
explanation_english: Refers to the eldest grandson (typically the eldest son of one's son); used as a familial term, often in formal or traditional contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅長孫，已經十歲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 coeng4 syun1, ji5 ging1 sap6 seoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的长孙，已经十岁了。
examples.english_sentence: He is my eldest grandson; he's already ten years old.

mandarin_meaning: 长安（古代都城名，今西安古称）
english_meaning: Chang'an (ancient capital of China; historical name for present-day Xi'an)
explanation_mandarin: 長安是中國歷史上多個朝代的重要都城，尤以漢唐時期著名。現代常作為詩文中的典故或地名使用。
explanation_english: Chang'an was an important imperial capital in Chinese history, especially during the Han and Tang dynasties. It is often referenced in poetry and historical texts and is the historical name for present-day Xi'an.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長安係中國古代一個重要嘅都城。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 on1 hai6 zung1 gwok3 gu2 doi6 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 dou1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长安是中国古代一个重要的都城。
examples.english_sentence: Chang'an was an important ancient capital of China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詩人經常喺詩句裏提到長安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 jan4 ging1 soeng4 hai2 si1 geoi3 leoi5 tai4 dou3 coeng4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 诗人经常在诗句里提到长安。
examples.english_sentence: Poets often mention Chang'an in their verses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅西安以前叫長安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 sai1 on1 ji5 cin4 giu3 coeng4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的西安以前叫长安。
examples.english_sentence: The modern city of Xi'an used to be called Chang'an.

mandarin_meaning: 長官（上級官員、指揮或管理職務的官員）
english_meaning: senior officer; commanding officer; superior; boss
explanation_mandarin: 指擔任指揮或管理職務的上級官員，常用於軍隊、警察或政府機構，也可用作對上司的稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to a superior or commanding official — often used for someone in authority in the military, police, or government; can also be used to address a boss or superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長官，我想向你匯報一件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 gun1, ngo5 soeng2 hoeng3 nei5 wui6 bou3 jat1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 長官，我想向您匯報一件事。
examples.english_sentence: Sir, I'd like to report something to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家已經升咗做長官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 sing1 zo2 zou6 coeng4 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在已經升任長官。
examples.english_sentence: He has now been promoted to a senior officer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有長官嚟視察，我哋要準備好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 coeng4 gun1 lai4 si6 caat3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有長官來視察，我們要準備好。
examples.english_sentence: A senior officer will come to inspect tomorrow; we need to be prepared.

mandarin_meaning: 長崎（日本九州西部的城市）
english_meaning: Nagasaki (a city in western Kyushu, Japan)
explanation_mandarin: 長崎是日本九州西部的一個港口城市，歷史上為重要的對外貿易港口，二戰末期曾遭受原子彈轟炸（長崎市）。
explanation_english: Nagasaki is a port city in western Kyushu, Japan. It has historical significance as an international trading port and was one of the two Japanese cities devastated by an atomic bomb in World War II.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去長崎旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 coeng4 kei4 leoi5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去长崎旅游。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Nagasaki next month.

mandarin_meaning: 長期受僱的工人；長期僱員（可指家庭傭工或在同一單位長期工作的人）
english_meaning: long-term worker; long-term employee; hired hand (often implying a long-standing or permanent employee, sometimes a domestic helper)
explanation_mandarin: 「長工」指受僱於某處並長期工作的員工或工人，語境上可指在家庭或公司長期受僱的人，相對於短期工或臨時工。
explanation_english: Refers to a worker employed on a long-term or ongoing basis. It can mean a permanent or long-serving employee, and in some contexts may refer to a long-term domestic helper or hired hand (as opposed to temporary workers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢間公司做咗十年長工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4 coeng4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這家公司做了十年長工。
examples.english_sentence: He has been a long-term employee at this company for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有個長工，佢每日嚟做飯同埋執屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 go3 coeng4 gung1, keoi5 mui5 jat6 lai4 zou6 faan6 tung4 maai4 zap1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有個長工，他每天來做飯和打掃。
examples.english_sentence: We have a long-term helper at home; she comes every day to cook and clean.

mandarin_meaning: 長平公主（歷史/戲曲人物）
english_meaning: Princess Changping (a historical/fictional character often appearing in Chinese history, legends and Chinese opera)
explanation_mandarin: 長平公主是中國歷史與戲曲中常見的人物名稱，通常指與明朝末年相關的傳說或戲劇角色；在粵劇與其他傳統戲曲中經常出現並被演繹為悲劇性的人物。
explanation_english: Princess Changping is a name of a figure that appears in Chinese history, legends, and traditional drama. She is often associated with late-Ming stories and is a recurring tragic role in Cantonese opera and other theatrical traditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去睇粵劇，係講長平公主嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 jyut6 kek6, hai6 gong2 coeng4 ping4 gung1 zyu2 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去看粵劇，是講述長平公主的故事。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to see a Cantonese opera tonight; it's about the story of Princess Changping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上飾演長平公主，演得好感人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 sik1 jin6 coeng4 ping4 gung1 zyu2, jin2 dak1 hou2 gam2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在舞台上飾演長平公主，演得很感人。
examples.english_sentence: She played Princess Changping on stage and delivered a very moving performance.

mandarin_meaning: 长期；多年
english_meaning: for many years; long-standing; long-term
explanation_mandarin: 表示持續很長時間、多年以來一直如此，可作副詞或形容詞使用，常用來形容習慣、職業、狀況等的長期性。
explanation_english: Indicates a long duration of time (for many years); can be used as an adverb or adjective to describe long-term or long-standing situations, habits, jobs, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢長年喺醫院做護理工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng4 nin4 hai2 ji1 jyun2 zou6 wu6 lei5 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长期在医院从事护理工作。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked in nursing at the hospital for many years.

mandarin_meaning: 长年累月（多年來；長時間）
english_meaning: for many years; over a long period; year in, year out
explanation_mandarin: 表示經過很長時間、多年累積下來的狀態或情況，常用來強調時間的長久。
explanation_english: Indicates a long period of time or something accumulated over many years; used to emphasize duration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢長年累月都喺呢間公司做工程師，積累咗好多經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng4 nin4 leoi6 jyut6 dou1 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 gung1 cing4 si1, zik1 leoi6 zo2 hou2 do1 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他多年來一直在這家公司做工程師，積累了很多經驗。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked as an engineer at this company for many years, accumulating a lot of experience.

mandarin_meaning: 长幼有序（表示长幼之间有明确的次序，应尊重长辈、照顾晚辈）
english_meaning: There is an orderly relationship between elders and juniors; seniority is observed and elders are respected
explanation_mandarin: 表示在社會或家庭等場合中，長輩與晚輩之間有秩序和次序，應該尊重長者、照顧晚輩。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that elders and youngsters have an established order; one should respect seniors and observe hierarchical order in social or familial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面，長幼有序好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1si1 jap6 min6, coeng4 jau3 jau5 zeoi6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司裡，長幼有序很重要。
examples.english_sentence: In a company, observing seniority is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家族聚會時，大家都要長幼有序，尊重長輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zuk6 zeoi6 wui6 si4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 coeng4 jau3 jau5 zeoi6, zyun1 zung6 coeng4 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家族聚會時，大家都要長幼有序，尊重長輩。
examples.english_sentence: At family gatherings, everyone should observe seniority and respect the elders.

mandarin_meaning: 长度 (chángdù)
english_meaning: length
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體或範圍的長短、距離或尺度，是一種度量概念。
explanation_english: Refers to the measurement of how long something is, i.e., the distance from one end to another or a dimension/extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條繩嘅長度係兩米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sing4 ge3 coeng4 dou6 hai6 loeng5 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条绳子的长度是两米。
examples.english_sentence: The length of this rope is two meters.

mandarin_meaning: 長久的感情；對人或事忠誠、專一
english_meaning: long-lasting affection; faithful/loyal; enduring feelings
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can also be used as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對某人或某事的情感持久、不易改變，或形容人對感情專一、忠誠。常見於粵語口語及香港語境。
explanation_english: Describes feelings or commitment that endure over a long time; someone who is faithful or loyal. Commonly used in Cantonese/Hong Kong contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我真係好長情，一直記得我嘅生日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 coeng4 cing4, jat1 zik6 gei3 dak1 ngo5 ge3 saang1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她對我真的很長情，一直記得我的生日。
examples.english_sentence: They are really loyal/long‑lasting in their feelings for me; they always remember my birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好長情嘅人，拍拖多年都唔會輕易放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 coeng4 cing4 ge3 jan4, paak3 to1 do1 nin4 dou1 m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是一個很長情的人，談了很多年戀愛也不會輕易放手。
examples.english_sentence: They're a very faithful person — after dating for many years they wouldn't easily let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對公司好長情，做咗十幾年都仲留喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 hou2 coeng4 cing4, zou6 zo2 sap6 gei3 nin4 dou1 zung6 lau4 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她對公司很有忠誠，做了十幾年還留在這裡。
examples.english_sentence: They're very loyal to the company — they've worked there for over ten years and still stay.

mandarin_meaning: 長大、發展成（某種狀態）
english_meaning: to grow up; to grow into; to develop into
explanation_mandarin: 表示由小變大或由一種狀態發展成另一種狀態，常用於人或植物的成長或事物的形成。
explanation_english: Indicates growing up or developing into another state; commonly used for people or plants growing, or something forming into a particular state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣佢好內向，長大咗之後就長成咗一個好開朗嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 keoi5 hou2 noi6 hoeng3, coeng4 daai6 zo2 zi1 hau6 zau6 coeng4 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 hoi1 long5 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候他很內向，長大之後變成了一個很開朗的人。
examples.english_sentence: He was very introverted as a child; after growing up he became a very outgoing person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵植物要三年先至可以長成一棵大樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo2 zik6 mat6 jiu3 saam1 nin4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 coeng4 sing4 jat1 fo2 daai6 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這株植物要三年才能長成一棵大樹。
examples.english_sentence: This plant takes three years to grow into a big tree.

mandarin_meaning: 長時間駕駛；（口語）長時間拿著或持有（某物）
english_meaning: to drive for a long time; (colloquial) to hold or keep something for a long time
explanation_mandarin: 「長揸」是廣東話口語，常用來形容長時間開車或長期持有、拿著某物的情況。常見搭配為「長揸車」。
explanation_english: “長揸” is Cantonese colloquial speech, typically used to describe driving for long periods or, more generally, holding/keeping something for a long time. Often appears as “長揸車” (drive for a long time).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呢排做外勤，要成日長揸車，好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ni1 paai4 zou6 ngoi6 kan4, jiu3 sing4 jat6 coeng4 zaa1 ce1, hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近做外勤，要常常開很長時間的車，很累。
examples.english_sentence: I've been doing fieldwork recently and have to drive for long periods; I'm really tired.

mandarin_meaning: 總是猶豫不決／坐立不安（口語）
english_meaning: always fidgeting or hesitating; restless (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容人經常坐立不安、東摸西撓或猶豫不決、不肯立即表態。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who is frequently fidgety, restless, or hesitant — often scratching, squirming, or unwilling to make an immediate decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢長撓撓，唔肯即刻答應我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng4 naau4 naau4, m4 hang2 zik1 hak1 daap3 jing6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是猶豫不決，不肯立刻答應我。
examples.english_sentence: He's always hesitating and won't immediately agree to me.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语口语）长期分散、彻底分手或解散，难以再复合或重聚
english_meaning: (Cantonese colloquial) a long-term split or permanent breakup/dispersion; people or a group parting ways with little chance of reuniting
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语用词，用来形容人际关系或团体彻底解散、分开且持续较长时间，暗示不太可能再恢复原状。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe a relationship or group that has broken up or dispersed for a long time, implying it's unlikely to be reunited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知佢同阿珍長散咗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 keoi5 tung4 aa3 zan1 coeng4 saan3 zo2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道他和阿珍已经彻底分手、各奔东西了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did you know he and Ah Jan have long since split up and gone their separate ways?

mandarin_meaning: 长方形 (chángfāngxíng)
english_meaning: rectangle
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種四邊且對邊相等、四角為直角的平面幾何圖形。
explanation_english: A quadrilateral whose opposite sides are equal and all four angles are right angles; a rectangle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地毯係長方形，啱放喺客廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 tan2 hai6 coeng4 fong1 jing4, aam1 fong3 hai2 haak3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊地毯是長方形，適合放在客廳。
examples.english_sentence: This rug is rectangular and fits well in the living room.

mandarin_meaning: 长春（中国吉林省省会城市名）；也可指“长久的春天”或“青春长存”，常用作地名、人名或企业名
english_meaning: Changchun (capital city of Jilin province, China); also figuratively 'long spring' or 'everlasting youth', used as a place name, personal name, or company name
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（专有名词；也可作普通名词或比喻用法）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (proper noun; can be used metaphorically as a common noun)
explanation_mandarin: “长春”主要指中国东北的城市长春，也可在文学或口语中表示“长久的春天”或“青春常在”。此外常见于人名、企业名或地名引用。
explanation_english: “長春” primarily denotes the city Changchun in northeastern China. It can also be used metaphorically to mean 'long-lasting spring' or 'everlasting youth'. It appears as a place name, personal name, or brand name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個假期去長春旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 gaa3 kei4 heoi3 coeng4 ceon1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个假期去长春旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Changchun on our next holiday.

mandarin_meaning: 长期 (chángqī)
english_meaning: long-term; lasting for a long period
explanation_mandarin: 表示持續很長一段時間，常用作形容詞或副詞，例如「長期計劃」、「長期患病」。
explanation_english: Indicates lasting for a long period of time; used as an adjective or adverb (e.g., long-term plan, long-term illness).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期飲酒會傷肝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 jam2 zau2 wui5 soeng1 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期饮酒会损害肝脏。
examples.english_sentence: Long-term drinking can damage the liver.

mandarin_meaning: 长期的经济来源；能够提供长期经济保障的人或关系
english_meaning: a long-term source of income/support; someone or something that reliably provides financial security
explanation_mandarin: 指能长期提供生活或经济保障的来源（例如老公、雇主等），常带有俚语或贬义色彩，表示依赖对方获得稳定收入。
explanation_english: Refers to a long-term source of financial support (e.g., a spouse, an employer). It's colloquial and sometimes pejorative, implying dependence on that source for steady income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嫁咗畀個有錢人，等於攞住一張長期飯票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 zo2 bei2 go3 jau5 cin2 jan4, dang2 jyu1 lo2 zyu6 jat1 zoeng1 coeng4 kei4 faan6 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她嫁给了一个有钱人，相当于拿到了一张长期饭票。
examples.english_sentence: She married a rich man, which is equivalent to getting a long-term source of financial support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀咗佢個固定職位，算係佢嘅長期飯票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 zo2 keoi5 go3 guk6 ding6 zik1 wai6, syun3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 coeng4 kei4 faan6 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给了他一个固定职位，可以算是他的长期饭票。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave him a permanent position, which can be considered his long-term source of income.

mandarin_meaning: 長凳（長椅）
english_meaning: long bench; bench (a long seat for multiple people)
explanation_mandarin: 指較長的凳子，通常供多人並排坐的家具，常見於公園、車站或家居等地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a long bench — a seat long enough for multiple people to sit side by side, commonly found in parks, stations, or homes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有好多長櫈，啱晒大家坐低傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 coeng4 dang2, aam1 saai3 daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有很多長凳，很適合大家坐下聊天。
examples.english_sentence: There are many long benches in the park, perfect for everyone to sit down and chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊長櫈擺喺門口，坐上去有啲唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 coeng4 dang2 baai2 hai2 mun4 hau2, co5 soeng5 heoi3 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舊長凳放在門口，坐上去有點不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The old bench is by the doorway; it's a bit uncomfortable to sit on.

mandarin_meaning: 如果事情繼續這樣發展 / 長此以往
english_meaning: if this continues; if things go on like this; if this situation persists
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對目前情況繼續發展的假設或警告，通常引出可能的後果或推論。語氣可用於口語或書面，偏正式或中性。
explanation_english: Used to express a conditional or warning about the continuation of a current situation; it introduces likely consequences or inferences. It can be used in both speech and writing and is somewhat neutral to formal in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長此下去，經濟會出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 ci2 haa6 heoi3, ging1 zai3 wui5 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果長此下去，經濟會出問題。
examples.english_sentence: If this continues, the economy will run into problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣唔運動，長此下去身體會出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 m4 wan6 dung6, coeng4 ci2 haa6 heoi3 san1 tai2 wui5 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣不運動，長此下去身體會出問題。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep not exercising like this, your health will suffer if it continues.

mandarin_meaning: 如果事情照現在這樣持續下去；長期來看
english_meaning: if things continue like this; in the long run; over time
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞短語 / 連詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示若事態保持目前的狀況繼續下去，通常暗示會有不良或需要注意的後果，相當於「如果繼續這樣」「久而久之」。
explanation_english: Indicates that if the current situation continues, (usually) undesirable or notable consequences will follow; equivalent to 'if this continues', 'in the long run'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長此以往，公司嘅財政會出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 ci2 ji5 wong5, gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 zing3 wui5 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果長此以往，公司的財政會出問題。
examples.english_sentence: If things continue like this, the company's finances will run into trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 長毛；（香港人名綽號）梁國雄的綽號
english_meaning: long hair/long fur; nickname 'Cheung Mao' for Leung Kwok-hung
explanation_mandarin: 「長毛」字面意思是毛很長，可用於描述動物或人的長髮/長毛；在香港亦是社運人士梁國雄的綽號，有時在政治語境中被用作指稱或代稱。
explanation_english: Literally 'long hair' or 'long fur' (used for people or animals). In Hong Kong it is also the nickname of activist/politician Leung Kwok-hung; the term can be used neutrally as a name or in political contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻貓係長毛貓，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 maau1 hai6 coeng4 mou4 maau1, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這隻貓是長毛貓，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: This cat is a long-haired cat, very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢留咗長頭髮，睇落好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lau4 zo2 coeng4 tau4 faat3, tai2 lok6 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他留了長頭髮，看起來很不一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He grew long hair; looks very different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長毛係梁國雄嘅綽號，佢係泛民主派嘅政治人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 mou4 hai6 loeng4 gwok3 hung4 ge3 coek3 hou6, keoi5 hai6 faan6 man4 zuk6 paai3 ge3 zing3 zi6 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「長毛」是梁國雄的綽號，他是泛民主派的政治人物。
examples.english_sentence: 'Cheung Mao' is Leung Kwok-hung's nickname; he is a pro-democracy political figure.

mandarin_meaning: 囉唆、說話冗長或愛唠叨
english_meaning: long-winded; nagging; tiresomely talkative
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容說話冗長、纏綿不休或對人嘮叨讓人覺得煩厭。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who is long-winded, nags, or talks on and on in a way that becomes annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好長氣，一講就停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 coeng4 hei3, jat1 gong2 zau6 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很長氣，一說就停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: He is very long-winded; once he starts talking he can't stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁長氣，講重點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 coeng4 hei3, gong2 zung6 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那麼囉唆，講重點吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so long-winded; get to the point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對老婆長氣，令佢好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 lou5 po4 coeng4 hei3, ling6 keoi5 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是對老婆嘮叨，讓她很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He nags his wife all the time, which really annoys her.

mandarin_meaning: 愛嘮叨、說話冗長的人（貶義）
english_meaning: A long-winded or nagging person; someone who talks too much (pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容一個人說話冗長、嘮叨或不停講話，通常帶有貶義或半開玩笑的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who talks excessively or is long-winded. Often used pejoratively or jokingly to describe a nagging or chatty person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係個長氣袋，成日講到我哋好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 go3 coeng4 hei3 doi6, sing4 jat6 gong2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是個愛嘮叨的人，總是讓我們很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He's always a long-winded person and always annoys us.

mandarin_meaning: 长江（Cháng Jiāng）
english_meaning: Yangtze River (the longest river in China and Asia)
explanation_mandarin: 長江是中国最长的河流，发源于青藏高原，向东流经中国中部和东部，注入东海。
explanation_english: The Yangtze River is the longest river in China and Asia; it originates on the Tibetan Plateau, flows east across central and eastern China, and empties into the East China Sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長江係中國最長嘅河流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 gong1 hai6 zung1 gwok3 zeoi3 coeng4 ge3 ho4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长江是中国最长的河流。
examples.english_sentence: The Yangtze River is the longest river in China.

jyutping: coeng4 gong1 hau6 long6 teoi1 cin4 long6
mandarin_meaning: 比喻後來者超越或取代先前的一代或人物（新一代勝過舊一代）。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning the younger generation will surpass or replace the older generation; literally 'the waves behind on the Yangtze push the waves ahead.'
explanation_mandarin: 此成語用河川波浪作比喻，表示新一代或後起之秀不斷出現，會超越或取代前輩，常用以形容人才更替或世代進步。
explanation_english: This idiom uses the image of waves to illustrate how newcomers continually emerge and surpass or replace their predecessors; commonly used to describe generational succession or the rise of new talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺科技界，長江後浪推前浪，啲新人好快就超越咗前輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fo1 gei6 gaai3, coeng4 gong1 hau6 long6 teoi1 cin4 long6, di1 san1 jan4 hou2 faai3 zau6 ciu1 jyut6 zo2 cin4 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在科技界，长江后浪推前浪，新人很快就超越了前辈。
examples.english_sentence: In the tech world, the new waves push the old — newcomers quickly surpass their predecessors.

mandarin_meaning: 长沙（湖南省省会）
english_meaning: Changsha (capital of Hunan Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 湖南省的省会城市，位于中国中南部，以岳麓山、橘子洲与辛辣的湖南菜闻名，具有丰富的历史与文化。
explanation_english: The capital city of Hunan Province in south-central China, known for Yuelu Mountain, Orange Isle, and spicy Hunan cuisine; a city with rich history and culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長沙係湖南省嘅省會，係一個有好多歷史同美食嘅城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 saa1 hai6 wu4 naam4 saang2 ge3 saang2 wui6, hai6 jat1 go3 jau5 hou2 do1 lik6 si2 tung4 mei5 sik6 ge3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长沙是湖南省的省会，是一个有很多历史和美食的城市。
examples.english_sentence: Changsha is the capital of Hunan Province, a city with lots of history and delicious food.

mandarin_meaning: 长沙湾（香港九龙的一个地区/地名）
english_meaning: Cheung Sha Wan (a neighborhood in Kowloon, Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 位於香港九龍深水埗區西部的地名，過去以工業區為主，現今為住宅與商業混合區，交通便利並有地鐵站。
explanation_english: A neighborhood in Kowloon, Hong Kong, located in the western part of Sham Shui Po District. Historically an industrial area, it is now a mixed residential and commercial district with convenient transport including an MTR station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺長沙灣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 coeng4 saa1 waan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在长沙湾。
examples.english_sentence: I live in Cheung Sha Wan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長沙灣站喺荔枝角同深水埗之間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 saa1 waan1 zaam6 hai2 lai6 zi1 gok3 tung4 sam1 seoi2 bou3 zi1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长沙湾站位于荔枝角和深水埗之间。
examples.english_sentence: Cheung Sha Wan station is located between Lai Chi Kok and Sham Shui Po.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長沙灣以前有好多工廠，宜家起咗好多住宅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 saa1 waan1 ji5 cin4 jau5 hou2 do1 gung1 cong3, ji4 gaa1 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 zyu6 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长沙湾以前有很多工厂，现在建了很多住宅。
examples.english_sentence: Cheung Sha Wan used to have many factories; now many residential buildings have been built.

mandarin_meaning: 长期和平稳定；长久的社会安定（拼音：cháng zhì jiǔ ān）
english_meaning: long-term peace and stability; lasting social order
explanation_mandarin: 「長治久安」為四字成語，表示長期的政治安定與社會和平，常用於描述國家或社會維持長久穩定的狀態。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom meaning long-term peace and stable governance; often used to describe a country or society maintaining sustained stability and order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長治久安係社會穩定嘅重要目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 zi6 gau2 on1 hai6 se5 wui6 wan2 ding6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长治久安是社会稳定的重要目标。
examples.english_sentence: Long-term peace and stability is an important goal for society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府努力發展經濟，期望帶嚟長治久安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 nou5 lik6 faat3 zin2 ging1 zai3, kei4 mong6 daai3 lai4 coeng4 zi6 gau2 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府努力发展经济，期望带来长治久安。
examples.english_sentence: The government is working to develop the economy, hoping to bring long-term peace and stability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史上，只有國家實現長治久安，人民先可以安居樂業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 soeng6, zi2 jau5 gwok3 gaa1 sat6 jin6 coeng4 zi6 gau2 on1, jan4 man4 sin1 ho2 ji5 on1 geoi1 lok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史上，只有国家实现长治久安，人民才能安居乐业。
examples.english_sentence: Historically, only when a country attains lasting peace can people live and work in peace.

mandarin_meaning: 长洲（香港一个小岛）
english_meaning: Cheung Chau (a small island in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 長洲是香港的離島之一，位於新界以南海域，著名於長洲太平清醮（包山節）、海鮮、海灘與無汽車街道，通常以渡輪與香港本島及其他離島連接。
explanation_english: Cheung Chau is one of Hong Kong's outlying islands, noted for the Cheung Chau Bun Festival (Tai Ping Ching Chiu), seafood, beaches, car-free streets, and ferry connections to Hong Kong Island and other islands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去長洲玩，坐渡輪大約三十分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 coeng4 zau1 waan2, co5 dou6 leon4 daai6 joek3 saam1 sap6 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期日去长洲玩，坐渡轮大约三十分钟。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Cheung Chau on Sunday; the ferry takes about 30 minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長洲冇車，大家都行路或者租單車遊覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 zau1 mou5 ce1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 haang4 lou6 waa6 ze2 zou1 daan1 ce1 jau4 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长洲没有汽车，大家都走路或者租单车游览。
examples.english_sentence: There are no cars on Cheung Chau; people walk or rent bicycles to get around.

mandarin_meaning: 长时间持续的火/持续加热；（烹调中）慢火、长时间炖煮
english_meaning: a long-lasting/sustained fire; prolonged heat; (in cooking) simmering for a long time
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語/名詞（烹調術語）
explanation_mandarin: 「長火」字面意為持續很久的火勢或加熱方式。在烹調語境常用來表示用持續、較低或中小火長時間燉煮，以釋出食材風味。口語中也可引申為事情持續進行或持續存在的狀態。
explanation_english: Literally “long fire.” In cooking contexts it refers to maintaining heat for a long time—simmering or slow-cooking over a sustained flame so flavors develop. Informally it can be extended to describe something that continues or persists for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲湯要用長火慢煲，先會出味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 tong1 jiu3 jung6 coeng4 fo2 maan6 bou1, sin1 wui5 ceot1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煲汤要用长火慢煲，才会出味。
examples.english_sentence: To make soup, you need to simmer it over a long/low heat so the flavor develops.

mandarin_meaning: 长篇大论；滔滔不绝（俚语），指说话冗长、唠叨或长时间训斥/讲个不停
english_meaning: to talk at length; long-winded; to give someone a long lecture; (slang) to ramble on or nag
explanation_mandarin: 「長炮」為港式粵語俚語，用來形容一個人說話冗長、滔滔不絕，或對別人大篇幅地說教或數落（有時含貶義）。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term describing someone who speaks at length or is long‑winded; can mean giving a long lecture, rambling on, or nagging (often derogatory).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好長炮，講重點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 coeng4 paau3, gong2 zung6 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要長篇大論，講重點吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ramble—get to the point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺大家面前長炮，講好多廢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 daai6 gaa1 min6 cin4 coeng4 paau3, gong2 hou2 do1 fai3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在大家面前長篇大論，說很多廢話。
examples.english_sentence: He often talks at length in front of everyone, saying a lot of nonsense.

mandarin_meaning: 永远不死、长生不老
english_meaning: to live forever; immortality; ageless
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示永遠不會死亡或保持青春，常見於神話或比喻用法，也可指追求不老的方法或願望。
explanation_english: Means never dying or remaining forever young; commonly used in myths or figuratively to express the wish for immortality or agelessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 神話入面嘅仙人可以長生不老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san4 waa6 jap6 min6 ge3 sin1 jan4 ho2 ji5 coeng4 saang1 bat1 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 神话里面的仙人可以长生不老。
examples.english_sentence: In myths, immortals can live forever.

mandarin_meaning: 长寿/保健商店（卖补品、中草药等，主打养生延年益寿）
english_meaning: longevity/health shop (a shop selling tonics, Chinese herbs and health products aimed at promoting long life)
explanation_mandarin: 「長生店」在廣東話中常用來指賣補品、滋補中藥或保健品的商店，側重於養生、補身或延年益壽的商品。有時也可作口語用法，泛指專售保健類產品的店舖。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "長生店" is commonly used to refer to shops that sell tonics, Chinese medicinal herbs, and health products focused on promoting longevity or general wellness. Colloquially it can refer to any shop specializing in health-preserving goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日去長生店買人參同補品話可以養身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 heoi3 coeng4 saang1 dim3 maai5 jan4 sam1 tung4 bou2 ban2 waa6 ho2 ji5 joeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈经常去长生店买人参和补品，说可以养身。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often goes to the longevity shop to buy ginseng and tonics, saying they help keep her healthy.

mandarin_meaning: 长生板（字面：長壽的板）
english_meaning: Literally "long-life board"; an obscure/rare Cantonese term with no widely recognized meaning (may appear as niche slang or a coined expression)
explanation_mandarin: 此詞在粵語中屬於罕見或地域性用法，字面意思為「長生的板」。沒有普遍公認的固定涵義，若出現通常為圈內俚語或個別創用詞，含義需視語境判斷。
explanation_english: This is a rare or regional Cantonese expression meaning literally "long-life board." It has no widely recognized, fixed meaning; when used it tends to be niche slang or a coined term whose sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個詞「長生板」好少見，大部分人未聽過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 'coeng4 saang1 baan2' hou2 siu2 gin3, daai6 bou6 fan6 jan4 mei6 teng1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个词“长生板”很少见，大部分人没听过。
examples.english_sentence: The term "長生板" is rare; most people haven't heard of it.

mandarin_meaning: 花生
english_meaning: peanut; groundnut
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，意指花生。字面為「長生果」，在節慶或招待客人時常見作零食或供奉用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for the peanut (groundnut). Literally "longevity fruit," peanuts are commonly served as a snack or offered during festivals and gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年我哋會買好多長生果嚟招待客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 maai5 hou2 do1 coeng4 saang1 gwo2 lai4 ziu1 doi6 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年我们会买很多花生来招待客人。
examples.english_sentence: During Lunar New Year we buy lots of peanuts to serve guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意一邊睇戲一邊食長生果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jat1 bin1 tai2 hei3 jat1 bin1 sik6 coeng4 saang1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢一边看电影一边吃花生。
examples.english_sentence: I like to snack on peanuts while watching movies.

mandarin_meaning: 流口水；垂涎
english_meaning: to drool; mouth-watering; to covet something (colloquially)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，字面為「長久的唾液」，用來形容看到或想到美食（或令人垂涎的事物）而流口水、非常想要的狀態。較口語、非正式用法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning “long-lasting saliva.” It describes salivating or being mouth-watering at the sight or thought of delicious food, or figuratively coveting something. Informal usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到燒鵝就流長生津，忍唔住要試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 siu1 ngo4 zau6 lau4 coeng4 saang1 zan1, jan2 m4 zyu6 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到燒鵝就流口水，忍不住想試一試。
examples.english_sentence: He drools when he sees roast goose and can't help wanting to try it.

jyutping: coeng4 tung3 bat1 jyu4 dyun2 tung3
mandarin_meaning: 长痛不如短痛（与其长期忍受痛苦，不如及早承受短暂的痛苦）
english_meaning: Better a short, sharp pain than prolonged suffering; it's often wiser to endure a brief hardship to avoid longer-term problems.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是与其长期持续忍受痛苦或困境，不如尽快采取措施，承受短暂的痛苦以尽早解决问题，避免更长久的折磨。
explanation_english: This idiom advises that enduring a brief, concentrated pain (or taking decisive action now) is preferable to suffering over a long period; it recommends resolving an issue quickly even if it's temporarily unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話最好快啲做手術，長痛不如短痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 zeoi3 hou2 faai3 di1 zou6 sau2 seot6, coeng4 tung3 bat1 jyu4 dyun2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说最好快点做手术，长痛不如短痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said it's best to have the surgery soon — better a short pain than prolonged suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同佢分手啦，長痛不如短痛，拖落去只會更辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 keoi5 fan1 sau2 laa1, coeng4 tung3 bat1 jyu4 dyun2 tung3, to1 lok6 heoi3 zi2 wui5 gang1 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跟他分手吧，长痛不如短痛，拖下去只会更辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Break up with them — it's better to have a short pain than drag it out and make things worse.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦長、細高的樣子（口語）
english_meaning: tall and lanky; long and scrawny (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，形容人或物顯得又長又瘦、瘦高的樣子，帶有輕微口語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone or something that appears long and thin (tall and lanky). Informal usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔愈大愈長癩癩喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 jyu6 daai6 jyu6 coeng4 laai6 laai6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他兒子越長越瘦長了。
examples.english_sentence: His son is getting taller and lankier.

mandarin_meaning: 长相厮守
english_meaning: to stay together for life; to remain together and never part
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人长期在一起、彼此相伴不分离，常用于夫妻或情侣之间表示相守一生。
explanation_english: Describes two people remaining together for a long time or for life, often used for spouses or lovers to express lifelong companionship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發誓要長相廝守一世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 sat1 jiu3 coeng4 soeng1 si1 sau2 jat1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发誓要长相厮守一生。
examples.english_sentence: They vowed to stay together for life.

mandarin_meaning: 长眠（chángmián）：作为“去世/死亡”的委婉说法
english_meaning: to sleep permanently; a euphemism for 'to die'
explanation_mandarin: 「長眠」是指永遠沉睡，用作「去世」的委婉說法，常見於較正式或文雅的語境。
explanation_english: A euphemistic verb literally meaning 'to sleep long'; used to indicate someone has died in a more gentle or formal manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經長眠咗，家人都好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 coeng4 min4 zo2, gaa1 jan4 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經長眠了，家人都很傷心。
examples.english_sentence: He has passed away; his family is very sad.

mandarin_meaning: 长矛
english_meaning: spear (long spear)
explanation_mandarin: 一种长柄带尖端的冷兵器，主要用于刺击、格挡或投掷，常见于古代战场和狩猎场景。
explanation_english: A long-handled pointed weapon (spear) used for stabbing, parrying, or throwing, commonly seen on ancient battlefields and in hunting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代戰士通常用長矛打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 zin3 si6 tung1 soeng4 jung6 coeng4 maau4 daa2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代战士通常用长矛打仗。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient warriors usually used spears in battle.

mandarin_meaning: 长短（长度；也指长处与短处、的是非或优缺点）
english_meaning: length; (colloquial) merits and demerits, faults; (in phrase 講長短) to criticize/gossip about someone's faults
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指物體的長度。2) 口語中指人的長處或短處、是非；常見用法如「講長短」，意為在背後說別人的壞話或挑人短處。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to physical length. 2) Colloquially refers to someone's merits and faults or rights and wrongs; in the phrase "講長短" it means to criticize or gossip about someone behind their back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人背後講長短。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 gong2 coeng4 dyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在別人背後說別人的壞話或挑人短處。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about other people's faults behind their backs.

mandarin_meaning: 長短週（交替的長週與短週工作/上課安排）
english_meaning: alternating long-and-short week schedule (alternating longer and shorter work/school weeks)
explanation_mandarin: 指公司、學校或機構將工作或上課安排成長週與短週交替出勤或上課的制度，即有些週工作/上課時間較長，有些週較短。
explanation_english: Refers to a scheduling system where organizations alternate between 'long' weeks and 'short' weeks for work or school, meaning some weeks have longer hours/days and others have shorter ones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今年開始實行長短週，隔一個星期就會係長週，跟住就係短週。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 hoi1 ci2 sat6 hang4 coeng4 dyun2 zau1, gaak3 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4 zau6 wui5 hai6 coeng4 zau1, gan1 zyu6 zau6 hai6 dyun2 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今年開始實行長短週，隔一個星期就是長週，接著就是短週。
examples.english_sentence: The company started implementing an alternating long-short week schedule this year; one week is a long week, then a short week follows.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俚語）喋喋不休、長篇大論；不停發表意見或吹噓、胡說
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for talking at length; to rant or be long-winded; to spout off or boast
explanation_mandarin: 「長砲」是廣東話俚語，指某人持續、冗長地講話，常帶抱怨、批評或誇張吹噓的語氣。可用作動詞（例如：長砲個人／喺度長砲）。
explanation_english: “長砲” is Cantonese slang used as a verb meaning to speak at length—often in a repetitive, ranting, or boastful way. It describes someone who keeps talking without stopping or going on long tangents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度長砲啦，我聽唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 coeng4 paau3 laa3, ngo5 teng1 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在這裡喋喋不休，我聽不下去。
examples.english_sentence: Stop rambling here — I can't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺會議度長砲，拖延咗成個進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 wui6 ji5 dou6 coeng4 paau3, to1 jin4 zo2 sing4 go3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在會議上長篇大論，拖延了整個進度。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes on at meetings and delayed the whole schedule.

mandarin_meaning: 長距離；長途；長程（例如長程航班、長程通訊）
english_meaning: long-distance; long-range; long-haul; long-term
explanation_mandarin: 表示距離、時間或範圍較長，常用於組合詞如「長程航班」「長程通訊」，表示長距離或長期性質。
explanation_english: Indicates greater distance, duration, or range. Commonly used in compounds like "long-haul flight" or "long-range communication."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭長程航班要早啲去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 coeng4 cing4 hong4 baan1 jiu3 zou2 di1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們搭長程航班要早點去機場。
examples.english_sentence: We have a long-haul flight, so we should get to the airport earlier.

mandarin_meaning: 長笛（指西洋橫吹的笛子）
english_meaning: flute (Western transverse flute)
explanation_mandarin: 指西洋橫吹的長笛，屬於木管樂器，音色明亮且可柔和，常見於管弦樂隊、室內樂與獨奏中。
explanation_english: Refers to the Western transverse flute, a woodwind instrument with a bright yet mellow timbre, commonly used in orchestras, chamber ensembles, and as a solo instrument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學吹長笛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 ceoi1 coeng4 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想學吹長笛。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn to play the flute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係樂團嘅長笛手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngok6 tyun4 ge3 coeng4 dik6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是樂團的長笛手。
examples.english_sentence: He is the orchestra's flutist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長笛嘅聲音好柔和。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 dik6 ge3 sing1 jam1 hou2 jau4 wo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 長笛的聲音很柔和。
examples.english_sentence: The sound of the flute is very mellow.

mandarin_meaning: 長篇 (chángpiān)，指篇幅較長的文章、小說或報導等。
english_meaning: long piece (of writing); long-form (e.g., long article, long novel)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容篇幅較長的書面作品或報導，例如「長篇小說」「長篇報導」。
explanation_english: Refers to a written work of considerable length, such as a long article, long report, or novel (e.g., "long-form article", "long novel").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本係一本長篇小說，唔容易一日睇完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 hai6 jat1 bun2 coeng4 pin1 siu2 syut3, m4 jung4 ji6 jat1 jat6 tai2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本是一本長篇小說，不容易一天看完。
examples.english_sentence: This is a long novel; it's not easy to finish in one day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一篇長篇文章，講述佢十年嘅生活經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 pin1 coeng4 pin1 man4 zoeng1, gong2 seot6 keoi5 sap6 nin4 ge3 sang1 wut6 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他寫了一篇長篇文章，講述他十年的生活經歷。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a long article describing his ten years of life experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者發表咗一篇長篇報道，深入揭露事件來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 faat3 biu2 zo2 jat1 pin1 coeng4 pin1 bou3 dou3, sam1 jap6 kit3 lou6 si6 gin6 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記者發表了一篇長篇報導，深入揭露事件的來龍去脈。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter published a long report that delves into the background of the incident.

mandarin_meaning: 长篇大论（指冗长、篇幅很长或言辞繁复的讲话或文章）
english_meaning: a long-winded discourse; a lengthy, verbose speech or piece of writing
explanation_mandarin: 指篇幅或講話內容很長且冗長繁複，常帶貶義，形容說話或寫作沒有重點、拖沓。
explanation_english: Refers to a lengthy and verbose piece of speech or writing; often pejorative, describing something long, tedious, and lacking focus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日長篇大論，講到冇重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 coeng4 pin1 daai6 leon6, gong2 dou3 mou5 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話總是長篇大論，講得沒有重點。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes on at length, speaking without any focus.

mandarin_meaning: 长篇小说 (chángpiān xiǎoshuō)
english_meaning: long novel; full-length novel
explanation_mandarin: 指篇幅较长、情节较为复杂的小说，通常比短篇小说篇幅更长、人物和情节更为详尽。
explanation_english: A long-form novel — a work of fiction with extended length and typically more complex plot and character development than a short story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近喺寫緊一部長篇小說，打算年尾出書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 se2 gan2 jat1 bou6 coeng4 pin1 siu2 syut3, daa2 syun3 nin4 mei5 ceot1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近正在写一部长篇小说，打算年底出版。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently writing a long novel and plans to publish it by the end of the year.

mandarin_meaning: 長篇小說
english_meaning: novel; long fictional prose narrative
explanation_mandarin: 指篇幅較長的小說作品，通常情節較為完整或複雜、人物較多，與短篇小說相對。
explanation_english: A long-form fictional prose work (a novel), typically longer and more complex than a short story, often with multiple characters and interwoven plots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近睇咗一本長篇小說，內容好吸引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 tai2 zo2 jat1 bun2 coeng4 pin1 siu2 syut3, noi6 jung4 hou2 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近看了一本長篇小說，內容很吸引。
examples.english_sentence: I recently read a novel; the content is very engaging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫緊一部長篇小說，估計要幾年先寫完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 gan2 jat1 bou6 coeng4 pin1 siu2 syut3, gu2 gai3 jiu3 gei2 nin4 sin1 se2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在寫一部長篇小說，估計要好幾年才能寫完。
examples.english_sentence: He's writing a novel now — it's expected to take several years to finish.

mandarin_meaning: 穩定收入 / 固定薪水
english_meaning: steady income; regular pay (from a stable job)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指穩定或長期可獲得的收入、薪水，常用來形容有固定工作的收入來源。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to steady or long-term income/salary, typically from a stable job or regular employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想搵份有長糧嘅工，唔想做零散兼職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 wan2 fan6 jau5 coeng4 loeng4 ge3 gung1, m4 soeng2 zou6 ling4 saan3 gim1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想找一份有穩定收入的工作，不想做零散兼職。
examples.english_sentence: I want to find a job with steady income; I don't want to do piecemeal part-time work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從轉咗正職之後，佢先有長糧，生活穩定咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 zyun3 zo2 zing3 zik1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 sin1 jau5 coeng4 loeng4, saang1 wut6 wan2 ding6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從轉了正式職位後，他才有了穩定收入，生活穩定了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he moved to a full-time position, he finally has a steady income and his life has stabilized.

mandarin_meaning: 长久受欢迎；持续走红；生意兴隆
english_meaning: to remain popular or prosperous for a long time; to enjoy lasting success
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人、某物或某生意長期受歡迎或持續走紅、興旺不衰。
explanation_english: Describes a person, product, or business that stays popular or successful over a long period; to continue being 'hot' or prosperous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳開咗十年都仲長紅，成日要排長龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 hoi1 zo2 sap6 nin4 dou1 zung6 coeng4 hung4, seng4 jat6 jiu3 paai4 coeng4 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間茶餐廳開了十年還是長紅，經常要排長隊。
examples.english_sentence: This cha chaan teng has been open for ten years and is still very popular; there's often a long queue.

mandarin_meaning: 长线（长期、长远）
english_meaning: long-term; long haul
explanation_mandarin: 通常指涉及較長時間的安排、計劃或投資方式，例如「長線投資」表示長期持有，不以短期波動為主導。
explanation_english: Refers to something over a long period of time (plans, investments, strategies). For example, "long-term investment" implies holding for the long haul rather than reacting to short-term fluctuations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資要有長線眼光，唔好淨係睇短期波動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 jiu3 jau5 coeng4 sin3 ngaan5 gwong1, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 dyun2 kei4 bo1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资要有长远眼光，不要只看短期波动。
examples.english_sentence: Investing requires long-term vision; don't focus only on short-term fluctuations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目係長線項目，需要長時間發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hai6 coeng4 sin3 hong6 muk6, seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目是长期项目，需要较长时间发展。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a long-term one and requires extended time to develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係長線投資者，唔會因為股價短期下跌就賣出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 coeng4 sin3 tau4 zi1 ze2, m4 wui5 jan1 wai6 gu2 gaa3 dyun2 kei4 haa6 dit3 zau6 maai6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是长线投资者，不会因为股价短期下跌就卖出。
examples.english_sentence: He is a long-term investor and won't sell just because of short-term price drops.

mandarin_meaning: 长老 (zhǎnglǎo)：宗教團體、氏族或組織中年長且有權威的人；亦可泛指年長者或資深人士。
english_meaning: elder; senior member (in a church, clan, or organization); an elder person or senior advisor
explanation_mandarin: 「長老」常用來稱呼教會、氏族或其他組織中具有地位與決策權的年長成員，也可泛指家庭或社區中的長者或資深顧問。
explanation_english: “長老” refers to an elder — a senior, authoritative member in a church, clan, or organization. It can also be used more generally for an elder or senior advisor in a family, community, or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教會嘅長老今日要開會討論教堂翻新嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 wui6 ge3 coeng4lou5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 hoi1 wui6 tou2 leon6 gaau3 tong4 faan1 san1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教会的长老今天要开会讨论教堂翻新的事。
examples.english_sentence: The church elders are meeting today to discuss renovating the church.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿公喺屋企係長老，大家都會聽佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 gung1 hai6 uk1 kei2 hai6 coeng4lou5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 wui5 teng1 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爺爺在家是長老，大家都會聽他說話。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather is the elder of the household; everyone listens to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有幾位長老負責做顧問，提供經驗同建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 gei2 wai2 coeng4lou5 fu6 zaak3 zou6 gu3 man6, tai4 gung1 ging1 jim6 tung4 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有幾位長老負責做顧問，提供經驗和建議。
examples.english_sentence: The company has several senior elders serving as consultants, providing experience and advice.

mandarin_meaning: 长者；老年人
english_meaning: elderly person; senior; elder
explanation_mandarin: 用來指稱年紀較大或處於老年階段的人，常用於正式或禮貌語境（如醫療、社會服務、公共場所的標示）。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is elderly or of the senior generation. Commonly used in formal or polite contexts such as healthcare, social services, or public signage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請讓位畀長者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceng2 joeng6 wai6 bei2 coeng4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给长者让座。
examples.english_sentence: Please give up your seat to the elderly.

mandarin_meaning: 長者卡 / 老人卡
english_meaning: senior citizen card; elderly concession card
explanation_mandarin: 在香港常見的用語，指發給長者的識別或優惠卡，可用於乘車、購物或享受專屬折扣與優惠。
explanation_english: A card commonly used in Hong Kong issued to elderly people; used as identification or to receive concessions/discounts for transport, shopping, and other services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有長者咭可以喺多啲地方享受優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 coeng4 ze2 kaat1 ho2 ji5 hai2 do1 di1 dei6 fong1 hoeng2 sau6 jau1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有長者卡可以在很多地方享受優惠。
examples.english_sentence: Having a senior card allows you to enjoy discounts in many places.

mandarin_meaning: 長臂猿（Chángbìyuán）
english_meaning: gibbon (a small arboreal ape with very long arms)
explanation_mandarin: 長臂猿是靈長目的一類小型樹棲猿類，特徵是前肢特別長，擅長在樹間盪動（臂擺運動）。有些物種受保護且數量稀少。
explanation_english: A gibbon is a small arboreal ape (family Hylobatidae) characterized by very long arms adapted for brachiation (swinging through trees). Some species are protected and have declining populations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺動物園見到長臂猿，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dung6 mat6 jyun4 gin3 dou2 coeng4 bei3 jyun4, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在動物園看到長臂猿，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: We saw gibbons at the zoo; they were very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長臂猿擅長用長臂盪樹，移動好靈活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 bei3 jyun4 sin6 coeng4 jung6 coeng4 bei3 dong6 syu6, ji4 dung6 hou2 ling4 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 長臂猿善於用長臂在樹間蕩來蕩去，移動很靈活。
examples.english_sentence: Gibbons are skilled at using their long arms to swing through the trees; they move very nimbly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長臂猿係受保護嘅動物，數量越嚟越少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 bei3 jyun4 hai6 sau6 bou2 wu6 ge3 dung6 mat6, sou3 loeng6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 長臂猿是受保護的動物，數量越來越少。
examples.english_sentence: Gibbons are protected animals, and their numbers are declining.

mandarin_meaning: 爱说闲话或多嘴多舌的女人（含贬义）
english_meaning: a gossipy woman; a chatterbox; a woman who talks too much and spreads gossip
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容喜歡講閒話、搬弄是非或多嘴多舌的女性，常帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A pejorative term for a woman who gossips, meddles, or talks excessively about others' affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做長舌婦，呢啲私事唔好亂講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 coeng4 sit3 fu5, ni1 di1 si1 si6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當長舌婦，這些私事不要亂講。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a gossip; don't spread these private matters.

mandarin_meaning: 长处 / 長處 (chángchù)：擅长、优点或有利的方面
english_meaning: strength; strong point; advantage; good point
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事物擅長或具有優勢的方面，也可指優點。
explanation_english: Refers to someone's or something's strengths, advantages, or positive aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該發揮你嘅長處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 goi1 faat3 fai1 nei5 ge3 coeng4 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你應該發揮你的長處。
examples.english_sentence: You should make use of your strengths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅長處係識得溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 coeng4 cyu3 hai6 sik1 dak1 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的長處是善於溝通。
examples.english_sentence: His strength is being good at communicating.

mandarin_meaning: 长衫（長袍、長式服裝）
english_meaning: long gown / long robe (traditional Chinese long robe)
explanation_mandarin: 指傳統的長款衣服，常指中國傳統的長衫或長袍；在廣東話中也可泛指長款的連衣裙或長外衣。
explanation_english: Refers to a long garment—commonly the traditional Chinese long robe (changshan/long gown). In Cantonese it can also be used more generally for long dresses or long outer garments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日著住件長衫，好有古典味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 coeng4 saam1, hou2 jau5 gu2 din2 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常穿着长衫，很有古典味道。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often wears a long gown; it has a very classical feel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺婚禮上著咗件傳統嘅長衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fan1lai5 soeng6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 cyun4 tung2 ge3 coeng4 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在婚礼上穿了一件传统的长衫。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a traditional long gown at the wedding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲男士出門會著長衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 naam4 si6 ceot1 mun4 wui5 zoek3 coeng4 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过去男性出门会穿长衫。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, men would wear long gowns when going out.

mandarin_meaning: 长衫与马褂（传统男性服饰）
english_meaning: Changshan and magua (traditional Chinese men's attire: long gown and short jacket)
explanation_mandarin: 指男子的傳統中式服裝組合──長衫（長袍）配馬褂（短外衣/短馬甲），多見於清朝至民國時期，現多用於婚慶、戲曲或懷舊場合，亦可泛指中式傳統男裝。
explanation_english: Refers to the traditional Chinese male outfit consisting of a long gown (changshan) paired with a magua (short jacket). Common historically from the Qing dynasty to the early Republic; today it appears in weddings, opera, or as nostalgic/traditional dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著長衫馬褂去參加婚禮，好有傳統風味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 coeng4 saam1 maa5 gwaa3 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 fan1 lai5, hou2 jau5 cyun4 tung2 fung1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿着长衫马褂去参加婚礼，很有传统风味。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a changshan and magua to the wedding today, looking very traditional.

mandarin_meaning: 长袍（chángpáo）：一种传统的长款袍服
english_meaning: long robe; gown; traditional long garment
explanation_mandarin: 指傳統的長袍式衣服，通常為寬鬆的長款外衣，長度可及膝或及踝，常見於歷史服飾、儀式或傳統場合。
explanation_english: A traditional long robe — a loose, long outer garment reaching the knee or ankle, commonly seen in historical dress, ceremonies, or traditional contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗件長袍，好有古典氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 coeng4 pou4, hou2 jau5 gu2 din2 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿了一件長袍，很有古典氣質。
examples.english_sentence: He was wearing a long robe, looking very classical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舞台劇入面，演員着住長袍扮古人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 toi4 kek6 jap6 min6, jin2 jyun4 zoek3 zyu6 coeng4 pou4 baan6 gu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在舞台劇裡，演員穿著長袍扮古人。
examples.english_sentence: In the stage play, the actor wore a long robe to portray an ancient person.

mandarin_meaning: 长袖（衣服的袖子较长）
english_meaning: long sleeve; long-sleeved (garment)
explanation_mandarin: 指衣服上袖子較長的款式或用來描述有長袖的衣物。也可作衣物類型的簡稱，如「長袖衫」。
explanation_english: Refers to clothing with sleeves that are long (typically extending to the wrist); used to describe garments with long sleeves or as a short form for long-sleeved tops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家天氣涼，記得著長袖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 tin1 hei3 loeng4, gei3 dak1 zoek3 coeng4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在天气凉，记得穿长袖。
examples.english_sentence: It's cool now, remember to wear long sleeves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著長袖，唔鍾意露手臂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 coeng4 zau6, m4 zung1 ji3 lou6 sau2 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿长袖，不喜欢露出手臂。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears long sleeves; he doesn't like showing his arms.

mandarin_meaning: 長袖善舞（成語），形容善於交際、應酬或憑藉關係周旋，常含圓滑或投機取巧的意味。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning skilled at socializing, currying favor, or maneuvering through relationships—often implying slickness or opportunism.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞（用來形容人）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom / adjective (describing a person's social skillfulness)
explanation_mandarin: 字面為「長袖會舞」，比喻人擅長交際、善於應酬或憑關係活動，常帶有圓滑、善於處理人際關係的含義，有時暗示不夠正直或投機。
explanation_english: Literally 'long sleeves good at dancing'; figuratively describes someone adept at social maneuvering, networking, or currying favor. It often suggests a polished, flexible social skill and can carry a mildly negative sense of being opportunistic or unscrupulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺政界好長袖善舞，識得同各方周旋，唔怕得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zing3 gaai3 hou2 coeng4 zau6 sin6 mou5 sik1 dak1 tung4 gok3 fong1 zau1 syun4 m4 paa3 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在政界很會應酬，善於與各方周旋，不怕得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: He's very adept at networking in the political arena, skillful at maneuvering among different parties and not afraid of offending people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意長袖善舞，識得拉攏投資者，搵到好嘅合作機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 coeng4 zau6 sin6 mou5 sik1 dak1 laai1 lung5 tau4 zi1 ze2 wan2 dou3 hou2 ge3 hap6 zok3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意善於應酬，懂得拉攏投資者，找到好的合作機會。
examples.english_sentence: He's skillful at social maneuvering in business, knows how to woo investors and secure good partnership opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 长裙 (chángqún)
english_meaning: long skirt; maxi skirt
explanation_mandarin: 覆蓋腿部較長的裙子，通常到小腿或腳踝位置，可作日常或正式場合穿著。
explanation_english: A skirt that is longer in length, typically reaching mid-calf or the ankle; worn as everyday or formal wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁熱，我想著條長裙去行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam2 jit6, ngo5 soeng2 zoek3 tiu4 coeng4 kwan4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1.
