explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression meaning to put quotation marks around a word or phrase (i.e. use 'scare quotes') to indicate irony, doubt, distancing, or to label something as not to be taken literally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺 WhatsApp 成日閂引號，好似好諷刺咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 WhatsApp sing4 jat6 saan1 jan5 hou6, hou2 fung6 cik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在 WhatsApp 上老是打引号，听起来很讽刺。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep using quotation marks on WhatsApp; it sounds very sarcastic.

mandarin_meaning: 關上括弧（比喻）
english_meaning: to close the parentheses (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是「關上括弧」，在香港口語或網絡用法中作比喻，表示結束插話或附帶說明、把題外話收起，回到正題或不再追究。
explanation_english: Literally 'to close the parentheses.' In Hong Kong colloquial/online usage it's a figurative expression meaning to end an aside or side comment, put away a parenthetical remark, and return to the main topic or stop pursuing an issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，閂括弧啦，我哋返正題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa3, saan1 kwaat3 wu4 laa1, ngo5 dei6 faan1 zing3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好啦，收起括弧（比喻收起插話），我們回到正題。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, close the parentheses — let's get back to the main topic.

mandarin_meaning: 關上括號／結束插入語（比喻結束題外話）
english_meaning: close the parenthesis; finish a parenthetical remark (figuratively: end an aside and return to the main topic)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把括號關上，用於書寫或口語中表示結束插入的補充說明。在粵語口語和網絡用語中，也常用作比喻，表示結束題外話或收尾，回到主要話題。
explanation_english: Literally 'close the parentheses.' Used in writing or speech to mark the end of a parenthetical remark. In Cantonese colloquial and online usage it is also used figuratively to mean finishing an aside or wrapping up a digression and returning to the main topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，閂括號，返正題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa3, saan1 kwaat3 hou6, faan1 zing3 tai4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，閉上括號，回到正題吧。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, close the parentheses — let's get back to the main topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先講番個例子，閂括號之後再講結論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 gong2 faan1 go3 lai6 zi2, saan1 kwaat3 hou6 zi1 hau6 zoi3 gong2 git3 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先說一個例子，結束插入語之後再講結論。
examples.english_sentence: I'll give an example first; after closing the parenthesis I'll state the conclusion.

mandarin_meaning: 把（門、窗等）關得很緊 / 鎖死；（口語）徹底隔絕或封堵
english_meaning: to shut/close something completely or lock it tight; (colloquial) to cut off or block someone/something completely
explanation_mandarin: 「閂死」是廣東話口語，原義指把門窗等關得很緊或鎖上；引申義可表示把人或渠道徹底隔絕、封殺。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '閂死' literally means to shut or lock something completely. Figuratively it can mean to cut someone off or block access completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前記住閂死晒啲窗同門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 zyu6 saan1 si2 saai3 di1 coeng1 tung4 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门前记得把窗和门都关紧。
examples.english_sentence: Before leaving, remember to shut the windows and doors tight.

mandarin_meaning: 關燈／熄燈；結束、收舖（口語）
english_meaning: to turn off the lights; (colloquially) to close up/finish an event or business
explanation_mandarin: 「閂燈」字面意思是把燈關掉，在粵語口語中也常用來表示結束活動、收舖或關門。例如商店收工時會說「閂燈收舖」。
explanation_english: Literally 'to switch off the lights.' In Cantonese it is also used colloquially to mean ending an event, closing up shop, or shutting down for the day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚出門前記得閂燈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 dak1 saan1 dang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上出門前記得關燈。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn off the lights before you go out tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋十二點閂燈收舖，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sap6 ji6 dim2 saan1 dang1 sau1 pou3, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們十二點關燈收店，別遲到。
examples.english_sentence: We'll close the shop at 12 o'clock; don't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽完咗，場館閂燈，大家走人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 jyun4 zo2, coeng4 gun2 saan1 dang1, daai6 gaa1 zau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽結束後，場館關燈，大家離開。
examples.english_sentence: After the match ended, the venue turned off the lights and everyone left.

mandarin_meaning: 关门 / 把门关上
english_meaning: to close/shut the door (often implying to bolt or secure it)
explanation_mandarin: 「閂門」是廣東話動詞，意思是把門關上或閂上（有時含上閂或鎖的意思）。在香港口語中常用來表示出門前或離開時關好門。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 閂門 means to close or shut the door (and can imply bolting or securing it). Frequently used in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese to remind someone to shut the door when leaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前記得閂門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 dak1 saan1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出门前记得关门。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to close the door before going out.

mandarin_meaning: 躲開、避開；閃光
english_meaning: to dodge/avoid; to flash (light); (colloquial) to leave quickly
explanation_mandarin: 表示把身體或物件移開以避開碰撞或接觸（如閃躲、閃開、閃避），也可指瞬間發出光亮（閃光）。在口語中有時用作匆忙離開或躲避責任的意思。
explanation_english: Means to move aside or avoid contact (to dodge, to sidestep), and can also mean a brief flash of light. Colloquially it can mean to leave quickly or to shirk/avoid responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你閃一邊，我行過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sim2 jat1 bin1, ngo5 haang4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讓開一下，我要過。
examples.english_sentence: Move aside, I'll pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日閃避責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sim2 bei6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是逃避責任。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車衝嚟，我閃唔切！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 cung1 lai4, ngo5 sim2 m4 cit3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 車衝過來，我閃不及！
examples.english_sentence: The car rushed over; I couldn't dodge in time!

mandarin_meaning: 闪亮；明亮，光彩夺目
english_meaning: shiny; bright; sparkling; eye-catching
explanation_mandarin: 形容物體表面發出光或反光，也可比喻某事物吸引人、顯眼。
explanation_english: Describes something that emits or reflects light; can also be used metaphorically for something eye-catching or glamorous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙好閃亮，喺派對上好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 hou2 sim2 loeng6, hai2 paai3 deoi3 soeng6 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條裙子很閃亮，在派對上很搶眼。
examples.english_sentence: That dress is very shiny and stands out at the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新手機嘅屏幕好閃亮，睇相好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 ge3 ping4 mok6 hou2 sim2 loeng6, tai2 soeng2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部新手機的屏幕很亮，看照片很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The new phone's screen is very bright; photos look great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢閃亮登場，攞到一陣掌聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sim2 loeng6 dang1 coeng4, lo2 dou3 jat1 zan6 zoeng2 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他閃亮登場，贏得一陣掌聲。
examples.english_sentence: He made a sparkling entrance and received a round of applause.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）溜走／離開
english_meaning: to slip away; to leave suddenly or quietly (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「閃人」是粵語口語或俚語，指悄悄或突然離開某處或離席，通常有想避開某情況或不想久留的含義。
explanation_english: “閃人” is Cantonese colloquial/slang meaning to slip away or leave suddenly/quietly, often to avoid a situation or not stay any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聚會啱啱開始，阿明就話有事先閃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi6 wui2 aam1 aam1 hoi1 ci2, aa3 ming4 zau6 waa6 jau5 si6 sin1 sim2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聚會剛開始，阿明就說有事先離開了。
examples.english_sentence: The gathering had just started; Ah Ming said he had something to do and left early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果情況唔舒服，你可以閃人先，冇人會怪你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 cing4 fong3 m4 syu1 fuk6, nei5 ho2 ji5 sim2 jan4 sin1, mou5 jan4 wui5 gwaai3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果情況不舒服，你可以先溜走，沒人會怪你。
examples.english_sentence: If you're uncomfortable, you can leave first; nobody will blame you.

mandarin_meaning: 闪闪发亮；耀眼、抢眼
english_meaning: sparkling; glittering; dazzling; eye-catching
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，形容物件表面很亮、閃爍，也可用來形容人或事物很搶眼、顯眼或誇張地光鮮亮麗。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing something that sparkles or glitters; can also describe a person or thing that is flashy, eye-catching, or ostentatiously bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個電話殼閃令令，行街成日會有人望佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 din6 waa6 hok3 saan2 ling6 ling6, haang4 gaai1 seng4 jat6 wui5 jau5 jan4 mong6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手机壳闪闪发亮，逛街时总有人看他。
examples.english_sentence: His phone case is sparkly; when he walks around people often stare at him.

mandarin_meaning: 闪光（闪光灯；闪烁的光）
english_meaning: flash; flashing light; to flash or emit a brief bright light
explanation_mandarin: 指短暫強烈的光亮（如相機閃光燈、閃電等），也可作動詞表示發出短促的光。
explanation_english: Refers to a brief, intense burst of light (e.g., camera flash, lightning). Can be used as a noun for the light or a verb meaning to emit such a flash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部相機閃光好勁，影到我閉埋眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 soeng1 gei1 sim2 gwong1 hou2 ging6, jing2 dou3 ngo5 bai3 maai4 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 相机的闪光很强，把我照得闭上眼睛。
examples.english_sentence: The camera flash was so strong it made me close my eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舞台嘅閃光配合音樂，氣氛好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 toi4 ge3 sim2 gwong1 pui3 hap6 jam1 ngok6, hei3 fan1 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舞台的闪光配合音乐，气氛很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The stage's flashing lights matched the music and made the atmosphere lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天空突然閃光，跟住落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hung1 dat6 jin4 sim2 gwong1, gan1 zyu6 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天空突然闪了一下，随后下起大雨。
examples.english_sentence: The sky suddenly flashed, then it started pouring.

mandarin_meaning: 閃光彈 (shǎnguāngdàn)：一種能發出強光和爆音以致暫時致盲或致暈的非致命爆裂物；也比喻用來轉移注意力或吸引注意的手段或言論。
english_meaning: Flashbang (stun grenade): a non-lethal explosive that emits a blinding flash and loud bang to disorient people; figuratively, a diversionary tactic or remark used to distract attention.
explanation_mandarin: 原指一種用於制服或驅散的非致命爆裂物，會發出強光與巨響使人暫時失明或失聰。引申為在談話或媒體中用來轉移或吸引注意力的言辭或手段。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a non-lethal explosive used to disorient people by producing a bright flash and loud bang. Figuratively, it denotes a comment or tactic intended to divert or attract attention away from the main issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方擲咗閃光彈，制伏咗嫌疑人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zaak3 zo2 sim2 gwong1 daan6, zai3 fuk6 zo2 jim4 ji4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方投擲了閃光彈，制伏了嫌疑人。
examples.english_sentence: The police threw a flashbang and subdued the suspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺辯論嗰陣放咗個閃光彈，想轉移話題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 leon6 go2 zan6 fong3 zo2 go3 sim2 gwong1 daan6, soeng2 zyun2 ji4 waa6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辯論中放了一個閃光彈，想轉移話題。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped a 'flashbang' in the debate to divert the topic.

mandarin_meaning: 閃光燈（shǎn guāng dēng）——相機、攝影或舞台等用來發出強烈短暫光脈的裝置
english_meaning: flash (camera flash); strobe light — a device that emits bright bursts of light used in photography or on stages
explanation_mandarin: 指相機內置或外置用以在拍照時發出短促強光的裝置；在舞台或演唱會上也可指用來製造閃爍效果的聚光燈。
explanation_english: Refers to a device, built-in or external, that emits brief intense bursts of light for photography; can also mean strobe/spotlights used on stages to create flashing effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影相嘅時候記得開閃光燈，張相會清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing2 soeng2 ge3 si4 hau6 gei3 dak1 hoi1 sim2 gwong1 dang1, zoeng1 soeng2 wui5 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍照的時候記得開閃光燈，照片會清楚一些。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn on the flash when taking photos; the picture will be clearer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 台上嗰啲閃光燈不停閃，好刺眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 soeng6 go2 di1 sim2 gwong1 dang1 bat1 ting4 sim2, hou2 ci3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台上的那些閃光燈不停閃，很刺眼。
examples.english_sentence: The strobe lights on the stage keep flashing; they're very dazzling.

mandarin_meaning: 闪动（shǎndòng）：光线或物体忽明忽暗地变化，或快速移动以躲避
english_meaning: to flicker; to flash; to make a quick movement to dodge or avoid
explanation_mandarin: 指光線、物體等忽明忽暗地變化（如燈光閃動），或指身體快速移動以閃避或躲開（如閃躲別人）。
explanation_english: Refers to light or an object momentarily brightening and dimming (flickering), or to a quick movement made to dodge or avoid something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街燈閃動，好似快壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 dang1 sim2 dung6, hou2 ci5 faai3 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路灯在闪动，好像快要坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The streetlight is flickering; it seems about to break.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次有人影相，佢都閃動，唔鍾意俾人影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 jau5 jan4 jing2 soeng2, keoi5 dou1 sim2 dung6, m4 zung1 ji3 bei2 jan4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次有人拍照，他都会闪躲，不喜欢让别人拍照。
examples.english_sentence: Every time someone takes a photo, he dodges; he doesn't like being photographed.

mandarin_meaning: 闪卡（抽认卡、记忆卡片）
english_meaning: flashcard (study card used for memorization)
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used as a verb)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來背誦或記憶的卡片（正反面分別寫問題與答案），也常指以此為核心的應用程式或記憶法（例如 Anki 閃卡）。可用作名詞或動詞（用閃卡背單字）。
explanation_english: Refers to a study card used for memorization (question on one side, answer on the other). It also commonly denotes apps or spaced-repetition systems based on such cards (e.g., Anki). Used as a noun and can be used informally as a verb (to flashcard/via flashcards).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用閃卡背英文單字，每日複習幾次就記得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 sim2 kaa1 bei6 jing1man4 daan1zi6, mui5 jat6 fuk1 zaap6 gei2 ci3 zau6 gei3 dak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用闪卡背英文单词，每天复习几次就全记住了。
examples.english_sentence: I use flashcards to memorize English vocabulary; repeating them a few times each day helps me remember everything.

mandarin_meaning: 找藉口推脱、逃避（責任或應做的事）
english_meaning: to dodge or shirk (responsibility/obligation) by making an excuse
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，指用藉口或托詞來迴避應承做的事或推卸責任，相當於“找藉口不做”或“推脫”。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to avoid or shirk a duty/obligation by using an excuse — i.e., to pull an "avoidance card" to get out of doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝老闆叫佢做報告，佢又閃咭話病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lou5 baan2 giu3 keoi5 zou6 bou3 gou3, keoi5 jau6 sim2 kaat1 waa6 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天老板叫他做报告，他又找借口說自己病了。
examples.english_sentence: This morning the boss asked him to do the report; he dodged it again saying he was sick.

mandarin_meaning: 失誤；疏失；一時的錯誤或意外
english_meaning: a lapse, mistake, mishap; a temporary error or oversight
explanation_mandarin: 指一時的錯誤、疏忽或意外，常用來形容因小錯誤而引致不良後果或影響進度。
explanation_english: Refers to a temporary mistake, oversight, or mishap, often used to describe a small error that leads to negative consequences or affects progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次呢單工程出咗啲閃失，成個進度都受影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ni1 daan1 gung1 cing4 ceot1 zo2 di1 sim2 sat1, sing4 go3 zeon3 dou6 dou1 sau6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这项工程出现了一些失误，整个进度都受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: This project had some mishaps this time and the whole schedule was affected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢一時閃失講漏咗重要資料，後果可能好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 jat1 si4 sim2 sat1 gong2 lau6 zo2 zung6 jiu3 zi1 liu2, hau6 gwo2 ho2 nang4 hou2 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他一时失误把重要资料说漏，后果可能很严重。
examples.english_sentence: If he slips up and leaks/omits important information, the consequences could be serious.

mandarin_meaning: 闪婚（在短時間內迅速結婚）
english_meaning: flash marriage; marrying quickly after a short period of dating
explanation_mandarin: 指在短時間內迅速結婚，通常是在交往時間很短或突發情況下匆促結婚。
explanation_english: Refers to getting married very quickly, usually after a short courtship or in a rushed/impulsive situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋閃婚，之前淨係拍拖咗幾個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sim2 fan1, zi1 cin4 zing6 hai6 paak3 to1 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们闪婚，之前只交往了几个月。
examples.english_sentence: They had a flash marriage; they had only been dating for a few months.

mandarin_meaning: 溜走不付账；逃避付款或责任（俚語）
english_meaning: to slip away without paying (one's share); to dodge payment or avoid responsibility (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，通常指吃完飯或參與某活動後逃避付款或責任，帶有負面含義，口語常見。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to slip away after an event (often a meal) without paying or to avoid responsibility/payment. It is informal and carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢約咗大家食飯，最後食完就閃水唔埋單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joek3 zo2 daai6 gaa1 sik6 faan6, zeoi3 hau6 sik6 jyun4 zau6 sim2 seoi2 m4 maai4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他約大家吃飯，最後吃完就溜走不付帳。
examples.english_sentence: He invited everyone to dinner; after eating he slipped away without paying the bill.

mandarin_meaning: 闪闪发光；炫耀、招摇（俗）
english_meaning: to sparkle/flash; flashy, showy (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「閃炩炩」是一個粵語口語擬聲詞，常用來形容光亮閃爍或打扮、裝飾很招搶、很浮誇的樣子。有時帶有貶義，指過分浮華或愛炫耀的人或物。
explanation_english: “閃炩炩” is a Cantonese colloquial onomatopoeic term used to describe things that sparkle or flash, or people/appearances that are flashy and showy. It can carry a mildly pejorative sense of being overly ostentatious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著到成身閃炩炩，好搶鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dou3 sing4 san1 sim2 bing2 bing2, hou2 coeng2 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿得全身闪闪发亮，很抢镜。
examples.english_sentence: He's dressed all flashy and attention-grabbing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕樹上啲燈閃炩炩，氣氛好溫馨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 syu6 seong6 di1 dang1 sim2 bing2 bing2, hei3 fan1 hou2 wan1 hang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞树上的灯闪闪发光，气氛很温馨。
examples.english_sentence: The lights on the Christmas tree are sparkling and the atmosphere is very cozy.

mandarin_meaning: 闪灯；开启或让车辆灯光闪烁以示警告或提醒
english_meaning: to flash (vehicle) lights; to use hazard/headlights as a warning or signal
explanation_mandarin: 指開啟或使車輛的燈光閃爍（例如雙閃或閃頭燈），用以示警、提醒其他道路使用者或示意減速。在香港口語中常用於駕駛情境，也可泛指用燈光作提示。
explanation_english: Refers to turning on or flashing a vehicle's lights (e.g., hazard lights or flashing headlights) to warn or notify other road users or to signal a message (such as slow down). Commonly used in driving contexts in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面有車撞車，大家都閃燈示意要慢駛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 jau5 ce1 zong6 ce1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 sim2 dang1 si6 ji3 jiu3 maan6 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面发生车祸，大家都闪灯示意要慢行。
examples.english_sentence: There was a crash ahead, so everyone flashed their lights to signal to slow down.

mandarin_meaning: 闪烁 (shǎnshuò)
english_meaning: to flicker; to twinkle; to flash; (figuratively) to be evasive or inconsistent
explanation_mandarin: 描述光亮忽明忽暗、明灭不定，也可比喻言語、目光或態度不穩定、含糊其詞。
explanation_english: Describes light that flickers or twinkles (turning on and off or changing brightness). Can also be used figuratively for speech, looks, or attitudes that are evasive or inconsistent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚街燈閃爍，睇落好唔穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 gaai1 dang1 sim2 seok3, tai2 lok6 hou2 m4 wan5 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜晚路灯闪烁，看起来很不稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The streetlights were flickering at night; it looked very unstable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講話閃爍其詞，唔想直接答我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 waa6 sim2 seok3 kei4 ci4, m4 soeng2 zik6 zip3 daap3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他言辞闪烁其词，不想直接回答我。
examples.english_sentence: He was being evasive in his words, not wanting to answer me directly.

mandarin_meaning: 臨時放鴿子、臨陣脫逃；臨時不赴約或不履行承諾（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to bail; to flake out; to stand someone up — to back out at the last minute (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「閃筆」是香港粵語的口語/俚語，指原本答應參加、幫忙或履行某項約定，但在最後一刻臨時不出現或脫身，帶有不可靠、放鴿子的意味。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, '閃筆' means to bail on a plan or commitment at the last minute — i.e., to flake out or stand someone up. It is informal and implies unreliability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話會幫手，但到時又閃筆唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wui5 bong1 sau2, daan6 dou3 si4 jau6 sim2 bat1 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說會幫忙，但到時又臨陣脫逃沒來。
examples.english_sentence: He said he'd help, but he bailed and didn't show up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚大家食飯，你唔好閃筆喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 daai6 gaa1 sik6 faan6, nei5 m4 hou2 sim2 bat1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚大家吃飯，你不要臨時放我們鴿子。
examples.english_sentence: We're all having dinner tonight — don't bail on us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講到做，但最後就閃筆，真係唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 dou3 zou6, daan6 zeoi6 hau6 zau6 sim2 bat1, zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說要做，但最後就臨時放鳥，真的不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks about doing things, but in the end he flakes — really unreliable.

mandarin_meaning: 亮粉；化妝用的閃光粉或珠光粉
english_meaning: glitter; shimmer powder (cosmetic glitter or pearlescent powder)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於化妝或美甲的細小閃光顆粒或珠光粉，用來增加光澤和閃亮效果。
explanation_english: Refers to small glittery or pearlescent particles used in makeup or nail art to add shine and a sparkling effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢盒眼影好靚，入面有閃粉，化出嚟好有光澤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 hap6 ngaan5 jing2 hou2 leng3, jap6 min6 jau5 sim2 fan2, faa3 ceot1 lei4 hou2 jau5 gwong1 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤眼影很漂亮，裡面有亮粉，化出來很有光澤。
examples.english_sentence: This eyeshadow palette is pretty; it has glitter, and when applied it looks glossy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗啲含閃粉嘅高光，晚宴時面上好閃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zo2 di1 ham4 sim2 fan2 ge3 gou1 gwong1, maan5 jin6 si4 min6 soeng6 hou2 sim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她用了含有亮粉的高光，晚宴時臉上很閃亮。
examples.english_sentence: She used a highlighter with shimmer; her face glowed at the evening party.

mandarin_meaning: 退縮；畏縮
english_meaning: to shrink back; to back down; to chicken out
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示因為害怕、不安或尷尬而退縮、不敢面對或出聲。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to shrink back or back down due to fear, embarrassment, or reluctance to confront/speak up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣，一聽到批評佢就閃縮，冇出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 go2 zan6, jat1 teng1 dou3 pik1 ping4 keoi5 zau6 sim2 suk1, mou5 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候他一听到批评就退缩，没出声。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting he backed down as soon as he heard criticism and stayed silent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來想挑戰佢，但最後閃縮咗，唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 soeng2 tiu1 zin3 keoi5, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 sim2 suk1 zo2, m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来想挑战他，但最后退缩了，不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: I originally wanted to challenge him, but in the end I chickened out and didn't speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好閃縮，講出你嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sim2 suk1, gong2 ceot1 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要退缩，把你的意见说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't back down — speak up and say your opinion.

mandarin_meaning: 閃耀 (shǎnyào)：發出光芒、閃亮；也可比喻光彩照人、耀眼。
english_meaning: to shine; to sparkle; to glitter; to be dazzling (literally or figuratively).
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體發出明亮或閃爍的光，也可用於比喻某人或某事光彩奪目、引人注目。
explanation_english: Denotes emitting bright or sparkling light; can also be used figuratively for someone or something that stands out or dazzles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上閃耀，吸引晒觀眾嘅目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 mou5 toi4 soeng6 sim2 jiu6, kap1 jan5 saai3 gun1 zung3 ge3 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上閃耀，吸引了觀眾的目光。
examples.english_sentence: He shone on stage, attracting the audience's attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜空中星星閃耀，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 hung1 zung1 sing1 sing1 sim2 jiu6, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜空中的星星閃耀，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The stars were sparkling in the night sky; so beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 閃避；迅速移動身體以避開（攻擊、障礙）或在人群中悄悄離開
english_meaning: to dodge; to quickly move the body to avoid something or to slip away
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，表示迅速移動身體以閃開或避開某物／某人；也可指在人群或場合中悄悄離開以避免打擾或見到某人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to quickly move one's body to dodge or avoid something/someone; it can also mean slipping away through a crowd or leaving discreetly to avoid an encounter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓見到狗，立即閃身跳上牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 gin3 dou3 gau2, lap6 zik1 sim2 san1 tiu3 soeng5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻貓看到狗，立刻閃身跳上牆。
examples.english_sentence: The cat saw the dog and immediately dodged and jumped onto the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺人群入面閃身走咗，唔想見到老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jan4 kwan4 jap6 min6 sim2 san1 zau2 zo2, m4 soeng2 gin3 dou3 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在人群中閃身走掉，不想見到老闆。
examples.english_sentence: He slipped away in the crowd; he didn't want to see the boss.

mandarin_meaning: 闪避（躲开、回避）
english_meaning: to dodge; to avoid; to evade
explanation_mandarin: 表示躲开或避开某物、问题或责任等；既可指身体上闪开以免碰撞，也可指在言语或行为上回避、逃避。
explanation_english: Indicates dodging or avoiding something (an object, a question, responsibility, etc.); can mean physically moving aside to avoid contact or figuratively evading topics or obligations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個球向佢飛過，連忙閃避。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 go3 kau4 hoeng3 keoi5 fei1 gwo3, lin4 mong4 sim2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到球朝他飛過，連忙閃避。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the ball flying toward him and quickly dodged it.

mandarin_meaning: 躲避球
english_meaning: dodgeball (team sport)
explanation_mandarin: 一種團隊運動，參與者互相投擲球以擊中對方隊員，被球擊中者通常要出局或暫時離場，常見於學校和體育活動。
explanation_english: A team sport in which players throw balls at opponents to eliminate them; players hit by a ball are typically out. Commonly played at schools and in recreational settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校下星期有閃避球比賽，你要唔要一齊去睇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 sim2 bei6 kau4 bei2 coi3, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們學校下星期有躲避球比賽，你要不要一起去看？
examples.english_sentence: Our school has a dodgeball match next week. Do you want to go watch together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打閃避球好叻，成日都係隊長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 sim2 bei6 kau4 hou2 lak3, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 deoi6 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打躲避球很厲害，經常是隊長。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at dodgeball and is often the team captain.

mandarin_meaning: 闪闪（shǎnshǎn），形容发光、闪烁或动作、态度上含有躲闪、吞吞吐吐的样子
english_meaning: sparkling; twinkling; (can also imply evasive/hesitant when describing behavior)
explanation_mandarin: “閃閃”常用來形容光亮或閃爍的樣子（如星星、首飾），也可在口語中與其他詞連用表示人說話或行為有些躲閃、吞吐的狀態。
explanation_english: “閃閃” is often used to describe something that sparkles or twinkles (e.g., stars, jewelry). In colloquial use it can also appear in expressions implying evasive or timid behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜空中星星閃閃，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 hung1 zung1 sing1 sing1 sim2 sim2, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜空中星星闪闪，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The stars in the night sky are twinkling; so pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條項鍊閃閃發亮，好貴氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 hong6 lin2 sim2 sim2 faat3 loeng6, hou2 gwai3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條項鍊閃閃發亮，很有貴氣。
examples.english_sentence: The necklace sparkles and looks very elegant/expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢閃閃縮縮，畏手畏腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 sim2 sim2 suk1 suk1, wai3 sau2 wai3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話閃閃縮縮，畏手畏腳。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks evasively and seems timid and hesitant.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）一再閃避、推諉責任的人或行為
english_meaning: (slang) to repeatedly dodge or shirk responsibility; a person who habitually avoids duties
explanation_mandarin: 「閃閃令」為廣東話俚語，來自「閃」（躲避）。用以形容某人經常躲躲閃閃、推搪或逃避責任，語氣偏貶義；可作動詞（閃閃令）或名詞（係個閃閃令）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term derived from 閃 (to dodge). It describes someone who habitually dodges, shirks, or makes excuses to avoid responsibility. It carries a mildly derogatory tone and can be used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日閃閃令，叫佢做嘢就搵藉口走開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 sim2 sim2 ling6, giu3 keoi5 zou6 je5 zau6 wan2 zek3 hau2 zau2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是躲躲閃閃，一叫他做事就找借口溜走。
examples.english_sentence: He always dodges—whenever you ask him to do something he finds an excuse and slips away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做閃閃令，遇到問題就要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 sim2 sim2 ling6, jyu6 dou3 man6 tai4 zau6 jiu3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做愛推諉的人，遇到問題就要負責。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be someone who always shirks—when problems arise you should take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 閃閃發光；閃爍
english_meaning: sparkling; twinkling; glittering
explanation_mandarin: 口語或書面語中描述物體表面發出點點光亮、閃爍不定的狀態，類似「閃閃發光／閃閃爍爍」。在粵語中常用作擬聲形容詞，有時也用於形容華麗閃亮的裝飾或飾物。
explanation_english: A Cantonese descriptive (often onomatopoeic) expression for something that sparkles or twinkles. Used to describe surfaces or objects that emit small, flashing lights or a glittering appearance; similar to "sparkling" or "twinkling."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對耳環閃閃炩，好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 ji5 waan4 sim2 sim2 seok3, hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這對耳環閃閃發亮，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: These earrings are sparkling; they're very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚天上啲星星閃閃炩，好浪漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 tin1 soeng6 di1 sing1 sing1 sim2 sim2 seok3, hou2 long6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜晚天上的星星閃閃發亮，很浪漫。
examples.english_sentence: The stars in the night sky are twinkling; it's very romantic.

mandarin_meaning: 闪闪发光 / 发光发亮
english_meaning: to sparkle; to glitter; to shine brightly
explanation_mandarin: 表示光亮闪烁、发出光芒，常用来形容星星、灯光或物体表面光亮的样子。
explanation_english: Describes something that sparkles or shines brightly; often used for stars, lights, or shiny surfaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜空入面啲星星閃閃發光，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 hung1 jap6 min6 di1 sing1 sing1 sim2 sim2 faat3 gwong1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜空裡的星星閃閃發光，很美。
examples.english_sentence: The stars in the night sky are sparkling; it's beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 畏縮、躲躲閃閃；膽怯、不敢正面應對
english_meaning: Timid and evasive; shrinking back, acting shy or evasive instead of confronting directly
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，形容人膽小、畏縮、行為躲避或說話閃爍其詞，不敢正面應對。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, describes someone who is timid, shrinking back, evasive in behavior or speech — not confronting matters directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日閃閃縮縮，唔肯講真話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sim2 sim2 suk1 suk1, m4 hang2 gong2 zan1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是躲躲閃閃，不肯說實話。
examples.english_sentence: He is always evasive and won't tell the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 讓開；閃開（讓路、避開）
english_meaning: move aside; get out of the way; dodge/avoid
explanation_mandarin: 表示讓路或移開位置以避免阻礙，也可引申為迴避、推諉不負責任地避開某事。
explanation_english: Used to tell someone to move aside or step out of the way; can also be used figuratively to mean dodging or shirking something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 閃開！有車嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sim2 hoi1! jau5 ce1 lai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 讓開！有車來！
examples.english_sentence: Get out of the way! A car is coming!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擠，閃開畀我過下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zai1, sim2 hoi1 bei2 ngo5 gwo3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別擠，讓開讓我過一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push, move aside and let me through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日閃開唔做嘢，成日推托。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sim2 hoi1 m4 zou6 je5, seng4 jat6 teoi1 tok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是推諉不做事，總是推托。
examples.english_sentence: He always avoids doing work and keeps making excuses.

mandarin_meaning: 闪电 (shǎndiàn)
english_meaning: lightning; a flash of lightning; (figuratively) very fast, in a flash
explanation_mandarin: 指大氣放電所產生的強烈光閃；也可用作比喻表示非常迅速的動作或事件。
explanation_english: Refers to the bright flash produced by atmospheric electrical discharge; can also be used figuratively to mean something happening very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱有閃電閃過，好靚但有啲驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 jau5 sim2 din6 sim2 gwo3, hou2 leng3 daan6 jau5 di1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剛才有閃電一閃而過，很漂亮但有點嚇人。
examples.english_sentence: There was a lightning flash just now — very beautiful but a bit scary.

mandarin_meaning: 闭 (bì) —— 关闭、合上
english_meaning: to close; to shut; to stop/cease (operation)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把門、口、系統等關上或停止運作，常用於實物（如門、店）或抽象事物（如系統、話題）。
explanation_english: Indicates closing or shutting something (a door, mouth, system) or stopping its operation; used for physical objects (doors, shops) and abstract things (systems, topics).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好開聲，閉埋個口啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hoi1 seng1, bai3 maai4 go3 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别出声，闭上你的嘴吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a sound, shut your mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舖頭已經關閉喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou3 tau2 ji5 ging1 gwaan1 bai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商店已经关闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The shop has already closed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部閉路電視壞咗，要維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 bai3 lou6 din6 si6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台闭路电视坏了，要维修。
examples.english_sentence: This CCTV is broken and needs repair.

mandarin_meaning: 閉上 (bì shàng)：把眼睛、嘴巴、門等關閉
english_meaning: to close/shut (e.g., eyes, mouth, door)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物（如眼睛、嘴巴、門窗）關起來、不讓其開着。常用於命令或描述動作。
explanation_english: Indicates closing or shutting something (such as eyes, mouth, door/window). Commonly used as an imperative or to describe the action of closing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以閉上眼，深呼吸放鬆一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bai3 soeng5 ngaan5, sam1 fu1 kap1 fong3 sung1 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以閉上眼，深呼吸放鬆一下。
examples.english_sentence: You can close your eyes, take a deep breath and relax a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 阻塞、不暢通；（比喻）思想狹窄、保守
english_meaning: blocked, obstructed, not flowing smoothly; (figuratively) closed-minded or stifled
explanation_mandarin: 可指道路或管道等物理上被阻塞、不通暢；也可用於形容人思想保守、接受新事物困難。
explanation_english: Can mean physically blocked or obstructed (e.g., roads, pipes); also used figuratively to describe someone whose thinking is narrow or resistant to new ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路因為山泥傾瀉而閉塞，暫時封路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 jan1 wai6 saan1 nei4 king1 se3 ji4 bai3 sak1, zaam6 si4 fung1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路因为山泥倾泻而闭塞，暂时封路。
examples.english_sentence: This road is blocked by a landslide and is temporarily closed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢思維好閉塞，唔願意接受新意念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si1 wai4 hou2 bai3 sak1, m4 jyun6 ji3 zip3 sau6 san1 ji3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他思维很闭塞，不愿意接受新观念。
examples.english_sentence: His thinking is very closed-minded; he is unwilling to accept new ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 憋尿（憋住尿液）；醫學上對應尿閉/尿潴留
english_meaning: to hold in one's urine; (medical) urinary retention
explanation_mandarin: 「閉尿」為廣東話口語，表示憋住不排尿或排尿困難。醫療情況下常稱為「尿閉」或「尿潴留」，指無法正常排尿，需要就醫處理。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "閉尿" is a colloquial expression meaning to hold in urine or to be unable to urinate. In medical contexts it corresponds to urinary retention and may require treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等巴士等咗好耐，我差啲要閉尿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 baa1 si2 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6, ngo5 caa1 di1 jiu3 bai3 niu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等公交車等了很久，我差點就憋不住尿了。
examples.english_sentence: I waited for the bus for a long time; I almost couldn't hold my pee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為手術後一度閉尿，要插導尿管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sau2 seot6 hau6 jat1 dou6 bai3 niu6, jiu3 caap3 dou6 niu6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為手術後一度出現尿閉，需要置入導尿管。
examples.english_sentence: He experienced urinary retention after surgery and needed a catheter.

mandarin_meaning: 闭幕；结束（会议、展览、演出等）
english_meaning: to close; closing (of an event, exhibition, performance, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指会议、典礼、展览或演出等结束的动作或状态，也可指闭幕仪式。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or state of ending a meeting, ceremony, exhibition, or performance; can also refer to the closing ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次展覽下星期一就閉幕喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zin2 laam5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jat1 zau6 bai6 mok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次展览下星期一就闭幕了。
examples.english_sentence: This exhibition will close next Monday.

mandarin_meaning: 闭嘴 / 别再说了（命令或催促别人安静）
english_meaning: Shut up; be quiet (imperative, often blunt or rude)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 感嘆詞（命令語氣）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，用來命令或催促別人不要再說話，語氣可粗魯或隨意，視語境可帶玩笑或冒犯意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase used to tell someone to stop talking or be quiet. It’s an imperative that can be blunt or rude; depending on context it may be used jokingly among friends or offensively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路講不停，我最後同佢講：「閉恭啦！」
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 gong2 bat1 ting4, ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 tung4 keoi5 gong2: "bai3 gung1 laa1!"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直不停地說話，我最後對他說：「閉嘴啦！」
examples.english_sentence: He kept talking non-stop, and I finally told him, "Shut up!"

mandarin_meaning: 闭月羞花（bì yuè xiū huā）：形容女子容貌极为美丽
english_meaning: An idiom describing an extraordinary beauty (literally: 'the moon hides and flowers feel ashamed')
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容女子容貌極為美麗，甚至使花兒羞愧、月亮黯然，常用作讚美外貌的成語，源於古代文學描寫。
explanation_english: A classical idiom used to praise a woman's exceptional beauty — so stunning that flowers feel ashamed and the moon hides; commonly used adjectivally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係閉月羞花，行出街時吸引晒大家嘅目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 bai3 jyut6 sau1 faa1, hang4 ceot1 gaai1 si4 kap1 jan5 saai3 daai6 gaa1 ge3 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是闭月羞花，出门时吸引了大家的目光。
examples.english_sentence: She is truly breathtakingly beautiful; when she goes out she attracts everyone's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 闭气；屏住呼吸、暂时停止呼吸
english_meaning: to hold one's breath; to stop breathing temporarily
explanation_mandarin: 指暫時停止呼吸或屏住呼吸，既可指刻意練習（如潛水、潛水呼吸訓練），亦可指因緊張或憋氣而停止呼吸的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to temporarily stopping breathing (holding one's breath). It can describe deliberate actions (e.g., diving practice) or involuntary/temporary breath-holding due to tension or exertion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 潛水員要學識閉氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 seoi2 jyun4 jiu3 hok6 sik1 bai6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 潜水员要学会闭气。
examples.english_sentence: Divers need to learn to hold their breath.

mandarin_meaning: 闭目养神
english_meaning: to rest with one's eyes closed; to take a short rest to refresh or recuperate
explanation_mandarin: 表示闭上眼睛稍作休息以恢复精神，通常指短暂休息或放鬆片刻。
explanation_english: To close one's eyes and rest to restore energy or refresh oneself; usually refers to a short break or brief nap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好攰，要閉目養神一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6, jiu3 bai3 muk6 joeng5 san4 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很累，要闭目养神一下。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very tired today; I need to rest with my eyes closed for a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣考試之前，老師叫學生閉目養神，放鬆心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 haau2 si3 zi1 cin4, lou5 si1 giu3 hok6 saang1 bai3 muk6 joeng5 san4, fong3 sung1 sam1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下考试之前，老师叫学生闭目养神，放松心情。
examples.english_sentence: Before the exam, the teacher told the students to rest with their eyes closed to relax.

mandarin_meaning: 封閉、內向；也可指事情或情況複雜、難以解決
english_meaning: closed-off, reserved; (of a situation) knotty, difficult to resolve
explanation_mandarin: 「閉結」常用於粵語口語，形容人封閉、不愛社交、內向；也可用來描述事情或局面糾結、難以理順或解決。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial usage, '閉結' describes a person who is closed-off, reserved, or not sociable; it can also describe a situation that is tangled or hard to resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好閉結，唔太同人傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 bai3 git3, m4 taai3 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很封閉，不太和人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is very closed-off and doesn't chat much with people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事好閉結，唔知點搞先好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hou2 bai3 git3, m4 zi1 dim2 gaau2 sin1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事很糾結，不知道該怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very knotty; I don't know what to do about it.

mandarin_meaning: 閉翳（bì yì）：古漢語/醫學用語，指眼睛被遮蔽或混濁（如白內障），也可比喻對事物視而不見、故意忽視。
english_meaning: bì yì (literary): an obstruction or clouding over the eye (e.g., cataract); figuratively, to be blind to something or to willfully ignore.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（文言或醫學用語）
explanation_mandarin: 閉翳為古代或書面語，原指眼睛被翳物遮蔽或混濁，常用於描述白內障等眼疾；引申為比喻性用法，表示視野或心志被遮掩而看不清事實。
explanation_english: A literary/archaic term originally referring to an obstruction or clouding of the eye (such as a cataract). It can also be used figuratively to mean being blinded or deliberately ignoring reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人眼睛有閉翳，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 ngaan5 zeng1 jau5 bai3 ngai6, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人眼睛有閉翳，需要看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: The elderly person has a cataract and needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好對問題閉翳，面對佢先至可以解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 deoi3 man6 tai4 bai3 ngai6, min6 deoi3 keoi5 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要對問題閉翳，面對它才能解決。
examples.english_sentence: Don't turn a blind eye to the problem; only by facing it can you solve it.

mandarin_meaning: 闭路电视 (bìlù diànshì)
english_meaning: closed-circuit television (CCTV)
explanation_mandarin: 閉路電視是一種封閉式的視訊監控系統，用於在公共或私人場所進行實時監視和錄影。
explanation_english: Closed-circuit television (CCTV) is a closed video monitoring system used to observe and record activity in public or private places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，商場入面有閉路電視架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 bai3 lou6 din6 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，商场里面有闭路电视。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, there are CCTV cameras inside the mall.

mandarin_meaning: 闭门思过（bì mén sī guò）
english_meaning: to shut oneself up and reflect on one's mistakes; to introspect and repent
explanation_mandarin: 指關上門來反省自己的過失或錯誤，通常帶有被要求或自我懲戒、深刻反省的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to shutting oneself away to reflect on one's mistakes; often implies being reprimanded or undertaking sincere self-examination and repentance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗大錯，老闆要佢閉門思過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 daai6 co3, lou5 baan2 jiu3 keoi5 bai6 mun4 si1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了大錯，老闆要他閉門思過。
examples.english_sentence: He made a big mistake; the boss told him to go and reflect on his actions.

mandarin_meaning: 碰壁、被拒绝、受冷落（被人拒绝入內或不受款待）
english_meaning: to be turned away or snubbed; to be refused admission or hospitality
explanation_mandarin: 原指主人關門不招待客人，現多用於比喻遭到拒絕或冷遇，例如面試或拜訪時被拒之門外。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a host closing the door and not receiving guests; now used figuratively for being refused, snubbed, or turned away (e.g., at an interview or visit).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去佢公司面試，點知畀咗閉門羹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 keoi5 gung1 si1 min6 si3, dim2 zi1 bei2 zo2 bai3 mun4 gang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去他們公司面試，結果被拒絕了。
examples.english_sentence: I went to their company for an interview, but ended up being turned away.

mandarin_meaning: 闭门造车（成语），指不听取外界意见，孤立地凭主观办事
english_meaning: To work behind closed doors; to act in isolation without consulting others; to proceed in a narrow, insular way
explanation_mandarin: 形容只在封閉的環境中憑主觀發展或做事，不顧外界情況與意見，通常有負面含義，指方法不切實際或缺乏溝通。
explanation_english: Describes doing things in isolation—relying solely on one's own ideas or methods while ignoring outside input. Often negative, implying impracticality or lack of communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔同部門唔溝通，就係閉門造車，難有好結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 tung4 bou6 mun4 m4 gau1 tung1, zau6 hai6 bai3 mun4 zou6 ce1, naan4 jau5 hou2 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不同部门不沟通，就是闭门造车，很难有好结果。
examples.english_sentence: When a company's departments don't communicate, they're working in isolation and it's hard to get good results.

mandarin_meaning: 閉關（閉門與外界隔絕，專心修行、創作或準備）
english_meaning: to seclude oneself; to shut oneself away to focus on practice, creation, study, or preparation
explanation_mandarin: 指暫時與外界隔絕、關閉門戶，專心從事修行、創作、學習或準備等活動。
explanation_english: Refers to temporarily cutting oneself off from the outside world and closing one's doors in order to concentrate on practices such as meditation, training, creative work, study, or preparation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢排閉關寫歌，希望快啲完成新專輯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 paai4 bai3 gwaan1 se2 go1, hei1 mong6 faai3 di1 jyun4 sing4 san1 zyun1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這段時間閉關寫歌，希望快點完成新專輯。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in seclusion writing songs lately, hoping to finish the new album soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗準備比賽，喺山上閉關練習一個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 zeon2 bei6 bei2 coi3, hai2 saan1 soeng5 bai3 gwaan1 lin6 zaap6 jat1 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們為了準備比賽，在山上閉關練習一個月。
examples.english_sentence: They secluded themselves on the mountain to train for a month in preparation for the competition.

mandarin_meaning: 闭关自守
english_meaning: to shut oneself off from the outside world; to retreat into isolation and remain defensive
explanation_mandarin: 表示閉門不與外界交往、保守防守，不採取積極外向的態度，常用於形容個人、組織或國家採取孤立或保守政策。
explanation_english: Describes closing oneself off from external contact and staying defensive or isolated; often used for people, organizations, or countries adopting an inward-looking or isolationist stance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司如果一直閉關自守，好難跟得上市場變化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jyu4 gwo2 jat1 zik6 bai3 gwaan1 zi6 sau2, hou2 naan4 gan1 dak1 soeng5 si5 coeng4 bin3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司一直闭关自守，就很难跟上市场变化。
examples.english_sentence: If a company keeps shutting itself off, it's hard to keep up with market changes.

mandarin_meaning: 闭关锁国 (bìguān-suǒguó)：指国家实行封闭、不与外界交流的孤立政策或状态。
english_meaning: To close the country and lock its borders; to adopt an isolationist policy—cutting off contact with the outside world. Often used negatively or metaphorically for isolationist attitudes.
explanation_mandarin: 表示国家采取封闭、不与外界交往的政策或状态，通常含消极、保守的意味；也可比喻个人或组织拒绝外界影响。
explanation_english: Refers to a country adopting a closed, isolationist policy that cuts off contact with the outside world. It often carries negative or conservative connotations and can be used metaphorically for individuals or organizations that resist outside influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔可以再閉關鎖國，應該開放同其他國家交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 bai3 gwaan1 so2 gwok3, jing1 goi1 hoi1 fong3 tung4 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 gaau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不可以再闭关锁国，应该开放与其他国家交流。
examples.english_sentence: The government cannot continue to close the country; it should open up and engage with other countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司一直閉關鎖國，就會好難同世界接軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 jat1 zik6 bai3 gwaan1 so2 gwok3, zau6 wui5 hou2 naan4 tung4 sai3 gaai3 zip3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司一直闭关锁国，就很难与世界接轨。
examples.english_sentence: If a company keeps isolating itself, it will be difficult to connect with the global market.

mandarin_meaning: 閉館 (bìguǎn)：關閉（如博物館、圖書館等）不對外開放
english_meaning: to close a venue (e.g., museum, library); venue closure
explanation_mandarin: 指博物館、圖書館、會館或其他場所停止對外開放，可能是暫時或永久的關閉。
explanation_english: Refers to a museum, library, or other venue ceasing to be open to the public; can be a temporary or permanent closure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館星期日閉館，唔可以借書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 sing1 kei4 jat6 bai3 gun2, m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圖書館星期日閉館，不能借書。
examples.english_sentence: The library is closed on Sundays; you can't borrow books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為整修，博物館暫時閉館，預計下個月先會重開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 zing2 sau1, bok3 mat6 gun2 zaam6 si4 bai3 gun2, jyu6 gai3 haa6 go3 jyut6 sin1 wui5 cung4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為整修，博物館暫時閉館，預計下個月才會重新開放。
examples.english_sentence: The museum is temporarily closed for renovations; it's expected to reopen next month.

mandarin_meaning: 开（打开；开动；开始；举行；经营）
english_meaning: to open; to turn on; to start; to hold (a meeting); to operate/run (a business)
explanation_mandarin: 「開」作動詞使用時，可以表示打開（如開門、開箱）、開啟（如開燈）、開始或舉行（如開會）、以及經營（如開店）等多種動作。
explanation_english: As a verb, '開' means to open (e.g. open a door), to turn on (e.g. switch on a light), to start or hold (e.g. a meeting), and to operate or run (e.g. a shop).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以幫我開門嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 hoi1 mun4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以幫我開門嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you open the door for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我開燈啦，房間好暗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 hoi1 dang1 laa1, fong4 gaan1 hou2 aam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫我開燈，房間很暗。
examples.english_sentence: Turn on the light for me; the room is very dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司下星期要開會討論計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 hoi1 wui6 tou2 leon6 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司下星期要開會討論計劃。
examples.english_sentence: The company will hold a meeting next week to discuss the plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺中環開咗間餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zung1 waan4 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在中環開了一間餐廳。
examples.english_sentence: He opened a restaurant in Central.

mandarin_meaning: 加班
english_meaning: work overtime / do overtime
explanation_mandarin: 「開OT」是香港口語，用英文字母OT表示「overtime」，意思是超出正常工作時間繼續工作（加班）。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial expression using the letters OT (overtime). It means to work beyond normal working hours (to do overtime).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我可能要開OT，未必可以咁早走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 ho2 nang4 jiu3 hoi1 ou1 ti1, mei6 bat1 ho2 ji5 gam2 zou2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我可能要加班，未必能那麼早離開。
examples.english_sentence: I might have to work overtime tonight, so I may not be able to leave that early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司下個月好忙，成日都要開OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 hou2 mong4, sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 hoi1 ou1 ti1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司下個月很忙，經常要加班。
examples.english_sentence: The company will be very busy next month; we'll often have to work overtime.

mandarin_meaning: 开派对 / 办聚会
english_meaning: to throw/host a party; to have a party
explanation_mandarin: 來自英文 'party' 的縮寫，用於口語，表示舉辦或參加聚會、派對。
explanation_english: Colloquial abbreviation from English 'party' (the letter 'P'); means to host or attend a social gathering or party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚開P，去唔去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hoi1 P, heoi3 m4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚开派对，要不要去？
examples.english_sentence: We're having a party tonight — are you coming?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企今晚開P，要帶啲嘢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 gam1 maan5 hoi1 P, jiu3 daai3 di1 je5 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今晚在家里开派对，记得带点东西来。
examples.english_sentence: They're having a party at their place tonight — remember to bring something.

mandarin_meaning: 組（樂）隊；演奏／舉辦樂隊表演（口語）
english_meaning: to form/play in a band; to hold a band gig or performance (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「開band」是香港粵語的口語用法，由英語「band」借入，指組成樂隊、與人合奏、排練或在酒吧、場地等舉行樂隊演出。可指排練或正式演出／開騷。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial expression borrowed from English 'band'. It refers to forming or playing in a band, rehearsing with bandmates, or putting on a live band performance (e.g. at a bar or venue). It can mean practising or gigging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋星期五喺酒吧開band，你要唔要一齊去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing1 kei4 ng5 hai2 zau2 baa1 hoi1 baan6, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 jat1 cai4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们星期五在酒吧开乐队，你要不要一起去？
examples.english_sentence: They're playing a gig at the bar on Friday. Do you want to come along?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月開始練歌，準備開band做巡迴演出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 lin6 go1, zeon2 bei6 hoi1 baan6 zou6 ceon4 wui4 jin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月开始练歌，准备组乐队进行巡回演出。
examples.english_sentence: We're starting vocal rehearsals next month and preparing to form a band for a tour.

mandarin_meaning: （開/辦）派對；開趴
english_meaning: to hold/throw a party; to host a social gathering
explanation_mandarin: “開party”是粵語的口語/俚語，來自英語“party”，指舉辦或開一個聚會、派對，通常語氣較隨意，強調社交或慶祝性質。
explanation_english: “開party” is Cantonese colloquial/slang (from English “party”) meaning to host or throw a party — a social gathering, typically casual and celebratory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期六想喺屋企開party，得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 luk6 soeng2 hai2 uk1 kei5 hoi1 paa3-ti1, dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們星期六想在家開個派對，可以嗎？
examples.english_sentence: I want to throw a party at my place on Saturday — is that okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今晚喺酒吧開咗個大party，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 zau2 baa1 hoi1 zo2 go3 daai6 paa3-ti1, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們今晚在酒吧開了個大派對，很熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: They had a big party at the bar tonight; it was very lively.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）全力加速、開足馬力、衝刺
english_meaning: to go all out / to step on the gas; to speed up and work at full power (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「開turbo」是香港粵語口語用法，借用「turbo（渦輪增壓）」意象，表示在短時間內用盡全力加速或衝刺，常用於工作、比賽或需要衝刺的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase borrowing 'turbo' imagery to mean 'go all out' or 'step on the gas' — to accelerate effort or work at full power for a short, intense burst (used for work, competitions, deadlines, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽到最後兩圈，我哋開turbo衝上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 loeng5 hyun1, ngo5 dei6 hoi1 tu1bo1 cung1 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽到最後兩圈，我們開足馬力衝上去。
examples.english_sentence: With two laps to go in the race, we went into turbo and sprinted forward.

mandarin_meaning: 开...次方（表示把某事或某性质放大、成倍提升，作夸张/强调）
english_meaning: To raise ... to the power (figuratively): to amplify or exaggerate something exponentially; an intensifier.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词短语（口语/网络用语）
explanation_mandarin: 口语或网络用法，结构为“開＋X＋次方”，用来表示把X的程度以指数方式放大或极度强调。例如“魅力開三次方”表示魅力增加很多，常带夸张意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial/internet Cantonese pattern '開 + X + 次方' meaning to amplify or exaggerate X as if raising it to a power. Used as a hyperbolic intensifier (e.g., '魅力開三次方' = charm increased many times).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗新髮型，魅力開三次方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 san1 faat3 jing4, mui6 lik6 hoi1 saam1 ci3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了新发型，魅力提升了好几倍。
examples.english_sentence: He changed his hairstyle—his charm went up several times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個湯加咗牛油，味道開十次方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tong1 gaa1 zo2 ngau4 jau4, mei6 dou6 hoi1 sap6 ci3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这汤加了黄油，味道提升到十倍（非常好）。
examples.english_sentence: This soup with butter elevated the flavor to the tenth power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出咗新手機殼，顏值開幾次方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 zo2 san1 sau2 gei1 hok3, ngaan4 zi3 hoi1 gei2 ci3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出了新手机壳，颜值提升了好几倍。
examples.english_sentence: With the new phone case, its looks went up several notches.

mandarin_meaning: 開始做飯；吃飯（粵語口語）
english_meaning: to start cooking / to have a meal together (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「開伙爨」是粵語口語，指開始準備或一起吃飯、做飯，有時也可指成立家庭後自己做飯吃。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to start cooking or to have a meal together. It can also imply setting up a household kitchen and cooking for oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚喺屋企開伙爨，一齊煮飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hai2 uk1 kei5 hoi1 fo2 cyun3, jat1 cai4 zyu2 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚在家開伙（做飯），一起做飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's cook and eat together at home tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 猜測；估價；報價（口語）
english_meaning: to guess or estimate; to give a price or bid (colloquial); to speculate or place a bet
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示提出猜測或估計，有時也指在拍賣或交易時報價或下注。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to make a guess or estimate; it can also mean to state a price/bid (e.g., in auctions) or to speculate/place a bet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺未知道詳情就亂開估啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 mei6 zi1 dou3 zoeng1 cing4 zau6 lyun6 hoi1 gu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在不知道詳情的情況下隨便猜測。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make guesses before you know the details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拍賣開始，主持人叫大家開估價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paak3 maai6 hoi1 ci2, zyu2 ci4 jan4 giu3 daai6 gaa1 hoi1 gu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍賣開始，主持人叫大家報價。
examples.english_sentence: At the start of the auction, the host asked everyone to submit their bids/estimates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺賭局入面開估邊隊會贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou2 guk6 jap6 min6 hoi1 gu2 bin1 deoi6 wui5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在賭局裡猜哪隊會贏。
examples.english_sentence: They were guessing/betting which team would win in the gambling game.

mandarin_meaning: 騰出/預留位置；（公司）開缺
english_meaning: to free up or reserve a spot/seat; (also) to open a vacancy (e.g., job opening)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指為某人預留或騰出座位、位置，或指組織/公司開設職位空缺。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese meaning to reserve or vacate a seat/place for someone, or to open up a spot (including a job vacancy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你開位，快啲嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 hoi1 wai6, faai3 di1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我幫你留位，快點來吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll save a seat for you — come quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司開位喇，佢哋而家搵緊新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hoi1 wai6 laa3, keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 wan2 gan2 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有空缺了，他們正在找新人。
examples.english_sentence: The company has an opening; they're currently hiring new people.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）去大便；排便
english_meaning: to defecate; to have a bowel movement (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，用來表示排便或去大便，常在非正式場合或談論嬰兒、病人時使用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to defecate or have a bowel movement. Commonly used in informal contexts (e.g., talking about children or patients).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路今日仲未開便，媽媽好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3lou6 gam1jat6 zung6 mei6 hoi1 bin6, maa4 maa1 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩今天還沒大便，媽媽很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: The child still hasn't had a bowel movement today; the mother is worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗嗰啲藥之後，我成日開便，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 go2 di1 joek6 zi1hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 hoi1 bin6, hou2 m4 syu1fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了那些藥之後，我一直頻繁排便，感覺不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: After taking that medicine I kept having bowel movements and felt uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我去開便先，馬上返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 heoi3 hoi1 bin6 sin1, maa5 soeng6 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等我去大便一下，馬上回來。
examples.english_sentence: Wait while I go to the toilet; I'll be right back.

mandarin_meaning: 開倉 / 清倉（舉行倉庫特賣或大量減價出售）
english_meaning: to hold a warehouse/clearance sale; to open the warehouse (literal)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指商店或公司舉行清倉、倉庫特賣或大幅減價出售貨品；也可指字面上的打開倉庫或開始調貨。
explanation_english: Commonly refers to holding a warehouse or clearance sale with heavily discounted items; can also be literal — opening a warehouse or starting to move stock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖下星期會開倉，所有貨品低至三折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 wui5 hoi1 cong1, so2 jau5 fo3 ban2 dai1 zi3 saam1 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店下星期會開倉，所有貨品低至三折。
examples.english_sentence: This shop will hold a warehouse clearance sale next week; all items are up to 70% off (as low as 30% of the original price).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日要開倉，大家幫手搬貨落舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jiu3 hoi1 cong1, daai6 gaa1 bong1 sau2 bun1 fo3 lok6 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天要開倉，大家幫忙把貨物搬到店裡。
examples.english_sentence: We need to open the warehouse today — everyone help move the stock to the shop.

mandarin_meaning: 开价；报出价格，提出价钱
english_meaning: to quote/ask a price; to state a price in a sale or negotiation
explanation_mandarin: 在买卖或议价时，提出价格或叫价，用以说明希望买卖的价钱。
explanation_english: To state or quote a price during a sale or negotiation; to name the amount one asks for or offers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賣樓開價比我想像中高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai6 lau4 hoi1 gaa3 bei2 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卖房子开出的价格比我想象的高。
examples.english_sentence: The price he asked for the house was higher than I expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賣家開價五萬元，但我哋可以議價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai6 gaa1 hoi1 gaa3 ng5 maan6 jyun4, daan6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ji5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 卖家开价五万元，但我们可以议价。
examples.english_sentence: The seller quoted fifty thousand dollars, but we can negotiate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔滿意，可以開低啲價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 mun5 ji3, ho2 ji5 hoi1 dai1 di1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不满意，可以开低一点价格。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied, you can offer a lower price.

mandarin_meaning: 开光
english_meaning: to consecrate; to perform a ceremonial 'eye-opening' blessing or inauguration
explanation_mandarin: 指在道教、佛教等宗教中为神像、法器或场所举行的仪式，点眼或祈求祝福，使之具备灵性；也可引申为为新店、雕像等举行开幕或祈福仪式。
explanation_english: Refers to the religious ritual (commonly in Taoist or Buddhist practice) of consecrating a statue or object by 'opening the eyes' or invoking a blessing; can also be used figuratively for inaugurating or blessing a new shop or item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張師傅今日要幫呢尊佛像開光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 si1 fu2 gam1 jat6 jiu3 bong1 ni1 zyun1 fat6 zoeng6 hoi1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 张师傅今天要帮这尊佛像开光。
examples.english_sentence: Master Cheung is going to perform the consecration ritual for this Buddha statue today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住喺新店開張嗰日請道士嚟開光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 hai2 san1 dim3 hoi1 zoeng1 go2 jat6 ceng2 dou6 si6 lai4 hoi1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打算在新店开张那天请道士来开光。
examples.english_sentence: He plans to invite a Taoist priest to consecrate the new shop on its opening day.

mandarin_meaning: 开刀；做手术
english_meaning: to perform or undergo surgery; to operate on
explanation_mandarin: 表示进行外科手术或被施行外科手术，也用于医学语境中描述动手术的动作。
explanation_english: Refers to performing or undergoing a surgical operation; used in medical contexts to describe having or doing surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日要開刀，成個禮拜要住院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 hoi1 dou1, sing4 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 zyu6 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天要开刀，整个星期要住院。
examples.english_sentence: He has to have surgery tomorrow and will be in the hospital for a whole week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要幫佢開刀切除腫瘤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 hoi1 dou1 cit3 ceoi4 zung2 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要帮他开刀切除肿瘤。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said they need to operate to remove the tumor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然要開刀，但成功率好高，唔使太擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jiu3 hoi1 dou1, daan6 sing4 gung1 leot6 hou2 gou1, m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然要开刀，但成功率很高，不用太担心。
examples.english_sentence: Although surgery is required, the success rate is high, so don't worry too much.

mandarin_meaning: 起初；一開始
english_meaning: at first; initially; originally
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情在最開始的時候，與「起初」、「一開始」意思相近，常用於口語與書面語中。
explanation_english: Indicates the beginning of a situation or state; means 'at first', 'initially' or 'originally'. Used in both spoken and written Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開初我以為佢唔會嚟，點知佢最後到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 co1 ngo5 ji5 wai6 keoi5 m4 wui5 loi4, dim2 zi1 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起初我以為他不會來，沒想到他最後來了。
examples.english_sentence: At first I thought he wouldn't come, but he ended up showing up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開初學廣東話好困難，依家就輕鬆啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 co1 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hou2 kwan3 naan4, ji1 gaa1 zau6 hing1 sung1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一開始學廣東話很困難，現在就輕鬆一點。
examples.english_sentence: Learning Cantonese was very difficult at first; now it's easier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋開初唔熟，依家已經做咗朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 co1 m4 suk6, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 zou6 zo2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們起初不熟，現在已經成為朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We weren't familiar at first; now we've become friends.

mandarin_meaning: 把聲音开得很大；大声喧哗
english_meaning: to turn up the volume to be very loud; to make a lot of noise or cause a scene
explanation_mandarin: 俗語／口語，通常用來形容把音量開得很大或大聲喧嘩，也可指人聲張揚、鬧得很嚷。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to turn the volume up very loud or to be noisy/loudly outspoken. Often used to describe loud music or someone making a scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成晚開到聲聽歌，樓下鄰居都投訴咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 maan5 hoi1 dou3 seng1 teng1 go1, lau4 haa6 leon4 geoi1 dou1 tau4 sou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整晚把音量开得很大聽歌，樓下鄰居都投訴了。
examples.english_sentence: He played music loudly all night; the downstairs neighbors complained.

mandarin_meaning: （書面／文言）則；那麼；在這種情況下
english_meaning: A formal/literary conjunction meaning 'in that case', 'then', or 'however'.
explanation_mandarin: 「開則」多見於書面或文言語境，用作連接詞，表示在某種情況下的結果或轉折，相當於「則」、「那麼」。口語中較少使用。
explanation_english: Used mainly in written or classical contexts as a conjunction to indicate consequence or contrast ('in that case', 'then'). It is literary/formal and uncommon in everyday spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 若情況有變，開則另行通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: joek6 cing4fong3 jau5 bin3, hoi1 zak1 ling6 hang4 tung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 若情況有變，則另行通知。
examples.english_sentence: If the situation changes, we will notify you separately.

mandarin_meaning: 开创；创立
english_meaning: to pioneer; to inaugurate; to found; to originate
explanation_mandarin: 表示開始創立或開拓新的事業、方法、領域等，通常含有首創或領先的意思。
explanation_english: Means to start or found something new (a business, method, field, etc.), often implying pioneering or being the first to do so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋開創咗一個新嘅市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoi1cong3 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们开创了一个新市场。
examples.english_sentence: They pioneered a new market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開創咗一種新嘅藝術風格，影響好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1cong3 zo2 jat1 zung2 san1 ge3 ngai6 seot6 fung1 gok3, jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开创了一种新的艺术风格，影响很大。
examples.english_sentence: He/She pioneered a new artistic style that had a great influence.

mandarin_meaning: 开始；启动；开始吃（口语）
english_meaning: to start; to activate; (colloquial) to begin eating / dig in
explanation_mandarin: 「開動」可用來表示開始某個動作或運作，例如啟動機器；在飲食語境中常用作口語邀請大家開始進食（如「開動啦」）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate starting something or activating a device. In a food context it's a colloquial prompt to begin eating (e.g. "Dig in! / Let's eat!").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飯煮好喇，大家開動啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan6 zyu2 hou2 laa3, daai6 gaa1 hoi1 dung6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 饭煮好了，大家开始吃吧！
examples.english_sentence: The meal is ready, everyone, dig in!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機仲未開動，工程師仲喺度測試緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 zung6 mei6 hoi1 dung6, gung1 cing4 si1 zung6 hai6 dou6 caak3 si3 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器还没启动，工程师还在测试。
examples.english_sentence: This machine hasn't been started yet; the engineers are still testing it.

mandarin_meaning: 开卷（打开书本；开始阅读或学习）
english_meaning: to open a book; to begin reading or studying; (idiom) reading is beneficial
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是打開書本，引申為開始閱讀或學習；常見於成語「開卷有益」，表示讀書有益處。
explanation_english: Literally 'open a book'; figuratively to begin reading or studying. Often appears in the idiom 'reading is beneficial' (開卷有益).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家開卷，唔好打擾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 gyun2, m4 hou2 daa2 jiu2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在在看書，別打擾我。
examples.english_sentence: I'm reading right now; don't disturb me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師話開卷有益，所以我每日都會開卷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 waa6 hoi1 gyun2 jau5 jik1, so2 ji5 ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 hoi1 gyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師說「開卷有益」，所以我每天都會看書。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said 'reading is beneficial', so I read every day.

mandarin_meaning: 开叉；分岔（如衣服開衩、道路分岔）
english_meaning: to have a slit/split; to fork or branch (e.g., clothing slit, road fork)
explanation_mandarin: 表示衣物有開縫或裂口（如裙子開叉），或指道路、路徑分成兩支或多支。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has a slit or split (e.g. a skirt with a slit), or that a path/road forks into branches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條裙有開叉，行路嘅時候比較方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 jau5 hoi1 caa1, hang4 lou6 ge3 si4 hau6 bei2 gaau3 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子有开叉，走路的时候比较方便。
examples.english_sentence: This skirt has a slit; it's more convenient when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面條路開叉，你要揀方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 tiu4 lou6 hoi1 caa1, nei5 jiu3 gaan2 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面的路分岔了，你要选择方向。
examples.english_sentence: The road ahead forks; you need to choose a direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條褲開叉咗，要補一補先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fu3 hoi1 caa1 zo2, jiu3 bou2 jat1 bou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裤子裂开了，要补一补才行。
examples.english_sentence: The pants split; they need mending first.

mandarin_meaning: 开口 (kāi kǒu)：张口说话；开始说话；提出请求或开价。
english_meaning: to open one's mouth; to start speaking; to ask/request (e.g. for money); to state an opening price.
explanation_mandarin: 表示开始说话或开口请求、开价等。口语中常用来指有人开口讲话或提出要求（例如借钱或讨价还价）。
explanation_english: Indicates beginning to speak or to make a request/offer. Commonly used to mean someone starts talking, asks for something (e.g. money), or states an opening price in negotiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一開口就令大家笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoi1hau2 zau6 ling6 daai6 gaa1 siu3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一开口就让大家笑。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he opened his mouth, he made everyone laugh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想借錢，唔好怕開口問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 ze3 cin2, m4 hou2 paa3 hoi1hau2 man6 ngo5
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想借钱，不要怕开口问我。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to borrow money, don't be afraid to ask me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆一開口就要一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jat1 hoi1hau2 zau6 jiu3 jat1 baak3 man1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板一开口就要一百块。
examples.english_sentence: The boss immediately asked for 100 dollars as the starting price.

mandarin_meaning: 正在開口／正在說話
english_meaning: in the process of speaking / about to speak
explanation_mandarin: 「開口中」由「開口」（開始說話或提出要求）和「中」（表示動作進行中）組成，屬於口語或非正式書寫用法，用來表示某人正在說話或正要開口。
explanation_english: “開口中” combines 開口 (to open one's mouth / to begin speaking or make a request) with 中 (indicating an action in progress). It is a colloquial/informal expression used to say someone is in the process of speaking or about to speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家開口中，你唔好打斷佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 hau2 zung1, nei5 m4 hou2 daa2 dyun6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在正在說話，別打斷他。
examples.english_sentence: He's speaking right now; don't interrupt him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我開口中，等我講完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hoi1 hau2 zung1, dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在說話，等我說完再說。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in the middle of speaking; wait until I finish.

mandarin_meaning: 脫口而出；說話不經思考
english_meaning: to blurt out; to speak without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 一個粵語俗語/口語表達，字面為「一開口舌頭就出來」，用來形容不經深思便把話說出來或衝口而出。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning 'open the mouth and the tongue follows.' It describes blurting something out or speaking impulsively without thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日開口及着脷，講嘢冇諗清楚就出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hoi1 hau2 kap6 zoek6 lei6, gong2 je5 mou5 lam2 cing1 co2 zau6 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是脫口而出，說話沒想清楚就出事了。
examples.english_sentence: He always blurts things out; he speaks without thinking and then problems happen.

mandarin_meaning: 一開口就不經思考、亂說話；說話衝動，可能會說出不該說的話。
english_meaning: To blurt something out; to speak impulsively without thinking (often causing trouble or revealing secrets).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容一個人說話不經大腦，常常脫口而出或說出不該說的話，可能導致麻煩或洩密。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone who speaks without thinking—blurting things out and often revealing secrets or causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日開口及著脷，啲秘密都講晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hoi1 hau2 kap6 zoek3 lei6, di1 bei3 mat6 dou1 gong2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是一開口就不經思考亂說話，連秘密都說光了。
examples.english_sentence: He always blurts things out; he even revealed all the secrets.

mandarin_meaning: 动不动就/总是提起（某事）
english_meaning: to keep bringing something up; to constantly talk about something
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人经常提起某事、动不动就说，常带有抱怨或不耐烦的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates someone repeatedly brings up a topic or keeps talking about something, often conveying annoyance or impatience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日開口埋口講阿媽嘅事，我聽到都煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hoi1 hau2 maai4 hau2 gong2 aa3 maa1 ge3 si6, ngo5 teng1 dou3 dou1 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是提起妈妈的事，我听着都觉得烦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps bringing up his mother; I'm annoyed just hearing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日開口埋口投訴啦，試下搵解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hoi1 hau2 maai4 hau2 tau4 sou3 laa1, si3 haa5 wan2 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别老是抱怨了，试着找解决办法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep complaining all the time; try to find a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 白日夢；不切實際的幻想／痴心妄想
english_meaning: pipe dream; wishful thinking; unrealistic fantasy
explanation_mandarin: 「開口夢」是香港粵語的口語用法，指不切實際的幻想或期望，常用來形容某人提出不現實的要求或抱有不可能實現的期待。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used in Hong Kong meaning an unrealistic dream or expectation. It's used to describe someone's wishful thinking or when someone makes unrealistic demands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好開口夢啦，嗰份工點可能咁快升職？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hoi1 hau2 mung6 laa1, go2 fan6 gung1 dim2 ho2 nang4 gam2 faai3 sing1 zik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做白日夢了，那份工作怎麼可能這麼快升職？
examples.english_sentence: Don't daydream—how could that job possibly promote you so quickly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你真係諗住買部豪車而家無儲到錢，就係開口夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zan1 hai6 nam2 zyu6 maai5 bou6 hou4 ce1 ji4 gaa1 mou4 cou5 dou3 cin2, zau6 hai6 hoi1 hau2 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你真的打算現在買豪車但沒有存到錢，那就是白日夢。
examples.english_sentence: If you really plan to buy a luxury car now without any savings, that's wishful thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲條件係開口夢，冇人會答應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 tiu4 gin3 hai6 hoi1 hau2 mung6, mou5 jan4 wui5 daap3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的那些條件是痴心妄想，沒有人會答應。
examples.english_sentence: The conditions he mentioned are pipe dreams; no one will agree.

mandarin_meaning: 說話吞吞吐吐、猶豫不決或因尷尬而不敢大聲說話
english_meaning: to speak hesitantly or awkwardly; to be tongue-tied or reluctant to speak
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容開口說話時因緊張、害羞或猶豫而說得很小聲、吞吞吐吐或語無倫次。
explanation_english: Used to describe speaking in a hesitant, timid, or awkward way—often due to nervousness or embarrassment, resulting in a quiet, halting, or tongue-tied manner of speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣，佢開口夾着脷，答唔出啲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 go2 zan6, keoi5 hoi1 hau2 gaap3 zoek3 lei6, daap3 m4 ceot1 di1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候，他說話吞吞吐吐，答不出問題。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview, he spoke hesitantly and couldn't answer the questions.

mandarin_meaning: 張口結舌；說話吞吞吐吐、不敢直說
english_meaning: to be tongue-tied; to speak hesitantly or haltingly; to be unable or reluctant to speak plainly
explanation_mandarin: 口語表達，形容人說話時緊張、尷尬或不敢直說，語無倫次或吞吞吐吐。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who speaks nervously, awkwardly, or hesitantly—literally 'opening the mouth with the tongue clamped,' i.e. tongue-tied or unable to speak clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師問佢係唔係作弊，佢開口夾著脷，答唔出解釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 man6 keoi5 hai6 m4 hai6 zou6 bei6, keoi5 hoi1 hau2 gaap3 zoek3 lei6, daap3 m4 ceot1 gaai2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師問他是不是作弊，他張口結舌，說不出解釋。
examples.english_sentence: When the teacher asked him if he cheated, he was tongue-tied and couldn't give an explanation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺面試嗰陣，佢開口夾著脷，講得好慢又唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 min6 si3 go2 zan6, keoi5 hoi1 hau2 gaap3 zoek3 lei6, gong2 dak1 hou2 maan6 jau6 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在面試時，他說話吞吞吐吐，講得又慢又不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview, he was tongue-tied, speaking slowly and unclearly.

mandarin_meaning: 有話要說／開口說話
english_meaning: to have something to say; to speak up
explanation_mandarin: 表示有人有話想說或有意見要表達，常用來催促或要求對方說出來，亦可指願意開口表達不滿或請求。
explanation_english: Means someone has something to say or wants to express an opinion; often used to urge someone to speak up or to indicate willingness to voice a complaint or request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔開口有話講，啲問題就唔會解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 hoi1 hau2 jau5 waa6 gong2, di1 man6 tai4 zau6 m4 wui5 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不開口說話，問題就不會解決。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't speak up, the problems won't be solved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日有不滿，但係從來都唔開口有話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jau5 bat1 mun6, daan6 hai6 cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 hoi1 hau2 jau5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常有不滿，但從來不說出來。
examples.english_sentence: He often feels dissatisfied but never speaks up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩事就開口有話啦，我哋幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 si6 zau6 hoi1 hau2 jau5 waa6 laa1, ngo5 dei6 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什麼事就開口說，我們會幫你。
examples.english_sentence: If there's anything, just speak up and we'll help you.

mandarin_meaning: （俗語）脫口而出；一开口就插话/说话（多含打断或不经思考的意思）
english_meaning: (slang) to blurt out; to speak out abruptly or interrupt; to open one's mouth and say something without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 「開口棗」是廣東話俗語，字面為「張嘴的棗」，常用來形容一個人一開口就說話、打斷別人或不經思考就脫口而出。屬口語、非正式用法，主要見於香港或粵語社群中。
explanation_english: “開口棗” is Cantonese slang literally meaning “open-mouth jujube.” It describes someone who blurts things out, speaks up abruptly, or interrupts without thinking. It is colloquial and chiefly used in Hong Kong/Cantonese-speaking contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好開口棗，等我講完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hoi1 hau2 zou2, dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要開口棗，等我說完再說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blurt it out; wait until I finish speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日開口棗，成日插嘴，講嘢好衝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hoi1 hau2 zou2, seng4 jat6 caap3 zeoi2, gong2 je5 hou2 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常開口棗，老是插嘴，說話很衝動。
