explanation_english: Means to open up, develop, or pioneer new areas, land, markets, or fields; can refer to physical land reclamation or to expanding markets, horizons, or other abstract domains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司計劃開拓海外市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 gai3waak6 hoi1 tok3 hoi2ngoi6 si5coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司计划开拓海外市场。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to open up/develop overseas markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旅行可以幫你開拓視野。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5hang4 ho2ji5 bong1 nei5 hoi1 tok3 si6je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旅行可以帮助你开拓视野。
examples.english_sentence: Travel can help broaden your horizons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要開拓一片荒地做農田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5dei6 jiu3 hoi1 tok3 jat1 pin3 wong4dei6 zou6 nung4tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要开拓一片荒地做农田。
examples.english_sentence: They want to reclaim a wasteland to make farmland.

mandarin_meaning: 開始打鬥；動手打架
english_meaning: to start a fight; to begin fighting
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示兩人或多人開始動手打架或衝突。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning to start a physical fight or to get into a scuffle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺酒吧度睇唔順眼，結果開拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zau2 baa1 dou6 tai2 m4 seon6 ngaan5, git3 gwo2 hoi1 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在酒吧看不順眼，結果打起來了。
examples.english_sentence: They didn't get along at the bar and ended up fighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搵事，唔想開拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wan2 si6, m4 soeng2 hoi1 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別找事，我不想動手。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble — I don't want to get into a fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一聽到佢哋要開拖，大家趕快拉開佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 teng1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 hoi1 to1, daai6 gaa1 gon2 faai3 laai1 hoi1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一聽說他們要打起來，大家趕緊把他們拉開。
examples.english_sentence: When we heard they were about to fight, everyone quickly pulled them apart.

mandarin_meaning: 开括号；插入附带说明或插入一句话（打断、插入补充说明）
english_meaning: to open a parenthesis; to insert a parenthetical remark or brief digression
explanation_mandarin: 表示在說話或書寫中插入一段補充說明或旁白，相當於中文的“開個括號（說一句）”。
explanation_english: Used when inserting a parenthetical remark or brief aside in speech or writing, equivalent to 'open a parenthesis (to say)...'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣我開括弧講多句，呢件事其實有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 ngo5 hoi1 kwaat3 wu4 gong2 do1 geoi3, ni1 gin6 si6 kei4 sat6 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下我開個括號多說一句，這件事其實有問題。
examples.english_sentence: Let me put in a parenthesis here and say briefly: there's actually a problem with this.

mandarin_meaning: 开括号；（口语）插入一句补充说明
english_meaning: to open a parenthesis; (colloquial) to make a parenthetical remark/aside
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指在書寫或打字時開始使用括號“(”，口語上常用來提示接下來是插入的補充說明或旁述。
explanation_english: Literally means to begin a parenthesis ("(") in writing or typing. Colloquially used to introduce a brief aside or parenthetical comment in speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫數學式嘅時候要開括號，例如 (a+b)×c。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 sou3 hok6 sik1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 hoi1 gwaat3 hou6, lai6 jyu6 (a+b) × c.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写数学式的时候要开括号，例如 (a+b)×c。
examples.english_sentence: When writing a math expression you need to open parentheses, e.g., (a+b)×c.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開括號講，我其實唔太鍾意佢，但工作上要保持專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 gwaat3 hou6 gong2, ngo5 kei4 sat6 m4 taai3 zung1 ji3 keoi5, daan6 gung1 zok3 soeng6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 zyun1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开个括号说一下，我其实不太喜欢他，但在工作上要保持专业。
examples.english_sentence: Parenthetically speaking, I don't really like him, but we need to remain professional at work.

mandarin_meaning: 开采（採礦、提取資源）
english_meaning: to mine; to extract (minerals or natural resources); to exploit resources
explanation_mandarin: 指開採礦產或其他自然資源，例如採掘礦石、煤炭等，亦可泛指提取或利用資源。
explanation_english: Refers to extracting minerals or other natural resources, such as mining ore or coal; can also broadly mean exploiting or extracting resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺郊區開採煤礦，影響咗附近居民嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hai2 gaau1 keoi1 hoi1 coi2 mui4 kwong4, jing2 hoeng2 zo2 fu6 gan6 ge3 geoi1 man4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在郊區開採煤礦，影響了附近居民的生活。
examples.english_sentence: The company is mining coal in the outskirts, which has affected the lives of nearby residents.

mandarin_meaning: 開朗；開闊
english_meaning: cheerful, open/optimistic; spacious/open (for places)
explanation_mandarin: 「開揚」可用來形容人的性格，表示性情開朗、樂觀；亦可用來形容地方，表示空間寬敞、開闊。
explanation_english: “開揚” can describe a person — meaning cheerful and optimistic — or a place — meaning open, airy, and spacious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好開揚，成日笑口常開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hoi1 joeng4, seng4 jat6 siu3 hau2 soeng4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他個性很開朗，常常面帶微笑。
examples.english_sentence: He is very cheerful and is always smiling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房好開揚，有大窗，望到海景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong2 hou2 hoi1 joeng4, jau5 daai6 coeng1, mong6 dou3 hoi2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間房很寬敞，有大窗戶，可以看到海景。
examples.english_sentence: This room is very open and spacious, with big windows and a sea view.

mandarin_meaning: 擺攤、開小攤營業
english_meaning: to set up/open a stall (for selling); to start vending
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指在夜市、街頭或市場等地方擺設攤位開始售賣東西或提供服務。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to set up or open a stall (e.g., at a night market or street market) to sell goods or provide services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期六會喺夜市開攤賣手作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 luk6 wui5 hai2 je6 si5 hoi1 taan1 maai6 sau2 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期六會在夜市擺攤賣手作。
examples.english_sentence: I'll open a stall at the night market on Saturday to sell handmade items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢朝早五點就開始開攤，成日都好早起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ziu1 zou2 ng5 dim2 zau6 hoi1 ci2 hoi1 taan1, sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 zou2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他早上五點就開始擺攤，常常都很早起床。
examples.english_sentence: He starts opening his stall at 5am; he's always up early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果賣得唔好就要收檔，唔好再開攤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 maai6 dak1 m4 hou2 zau6 jiu3 sau1 dong3, m4 hou2 zoi3 hoi1 taan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果賣得不好就要收攤，不要再擺攤了。
examples.english_sentence: If sales are bad, you'll have to close up and stop opening your stall.

mandarin_meaning: 开支 (支出、费用)
english_meaning: expenses; expenditure; costs
explanation_mandarin: 指花費或支出的費用，常用於家庭、公司或個人預算方面描述需要支付的款項。
explanation_english: Refers to money spent or expenditures; commonly used to describe costs in household, company, or personal budgets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月嘅開支比我預算嘅多咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 ge3 hoi1 zi1 bei2 ngo5 jyu6 syun3 ge3 do1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的开支比我预算的多了。
examples.english_sentence: This month's expenses are higher than I budgeted.

mandarin_meaning: 开放 (kāifàng)
english_meaning: to open; to open up; to liberalize; open-minded
explanation_mandarin: 表示打開或放寬限制，使場所或政策對外開放；也可形容態度不封閉、願意接受新事物或不同意見。
explanation_english: Means to open up or relax restrictions — making a place, policy, or border accessible; can also describe an open-minded attitude that is receptive to new ideas or different opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定開放邊境，容許旅客入境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 hoi1 fong3 bin1 ging2, jung4 heoi2 leoi5 haak3 jap6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定开放边境，允许旅客入境。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to open the border and allow travelers to enter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢思想幾開放，接受唔同嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si1 soeng2 gei2 hoi1 fong3, zip3 sau6 m4 tung4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他思想比较开放，接受不同的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He is fairly open-minded and accepts different opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館今晚開放到十點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 gam1 maan5 hoi1 fong3 dou3 sap6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆今晚开放到十点。
examples.english_sentence: The library is open until 10 o'clock tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 开放式（表示不封闭、开敞的布局或设计）
english_meaning: open-plan; open-style (design or layout that is not enclosed)
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有隔間或封閉隔斷的設計或格局，常用來形容廚房、辦公室、教室等空間的開敞布局。
explanation_english: Describes a layout or design that lacks partitions or enclosed separations; commonly used for kitchens, offices, classrooms, etc., indicating an open, shared space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司採用開放式辦公室，溝通會方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 coi2 jung6 hoi1 fong3 sik1 baan6 gung1 sat1, gau1 tung1 wui5 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司采用开放式办公室，沟通会更方便。
examples.english_sentence: Our company uses an open-plan office, so communication is more convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新屋有個開放式廚房，客廳同廚房連成一體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 uk1 jau5 go3 hoi1 fong3 sik1 cyu4 fong4, haak3 teng1 tung4 cyu4 fong4 lin4 sing4 jat1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新房有个开放式厨房，客厅和厨房连成一体。
examples.english_sentence: The new house has an open-plan kitchen; the living room and kitchen form a single space.
